metadata.title: 樟宜機場(SIN)攜手SATS推出自主導航輪椅服務

a-20260804-1529-changi-airport-rolls-out.text: 樟宜機場(SIN)攜手SATS推出自主導航輪椅服務 根據 AeroTime 報導,樟宜機場集團與地勤夥伴 SATS 於 2026 年 8 月 4 日宣布推出自主導航輪椅,旨在提高行動不便旅客的便利性。該輪椅配備智慧導航與安全功能,預計全面推廣後可分擔約 10% 的日常行動協助需求,此前測試已有逾 1.3 萬名旅客使用。 樟宜機場(SIN)集團(CAG)與地勤合作夥伴 SATS 於 2026 年 8 月 4 日宣布,在新加坡樟宜機場正式推出自主導航輪椅,以協助行動不便的旅客在航廈內更獨立地移動,並釋放地勤人力以專注於高需求的旅客。 該自主輪椅計畫屬於 SATS「未來樞紐地勤」倡議的一環。此款輪椅配備感測器與安全帶監測等安全機制,預計全面部署後可處理該機場約 10% 的日常行動協助需求。該技術自 2025 年 3 月起在第 3 航廈展開測試,至今已服務逾 1.3 萬名旅客。 Changi Airport (SIN) Rolls Out Autonomous Wheelchairs for Mobility-Impaired Travelers According to AeroTime, Changi Airport Group (CAG) and its ground handling partner SATS announced the rollout of autonomous wheelchairs at Singapore Changi Airport on August 4, 2026. The self-driving wheelchairs are designed to help passengers with reduced mobility navigate terminals independently, reducing the need for one-on-one staff assistance. The initiative, part of SATS' 'Hub Handler of the Future' project, is expected to eventually handle approximately 10% of Changi's daily mobility assistance demands. The technology underwent trials beginning in March 2025, serving over 13,000 passengers during the testing phase. Changi Airport (SIN) Group (CAG) and ground handling partner SATS announced on August 4, 2026, the rollout of autonomous wheelchairs at Changi Airport. The self-driving wheelchairs allow passengers with reduced mobility to navigate transit areas with greater independence, reducing the need for one-on-one assistance from ground staff. The program is part of SATS' "Hub Handler of the Future" initiative and is expected to manage approximately 10% of daily mobility assistance needs at Changi once fully deployed. Equipped with sensors and seatbelt monitoring, the technology was first trialed in March 2025 and has already served more than 13,000 passengers. 樟宜機場集團與地勤合作夥伴 SATS 於 2026 年 8 月 4 日宣布,在新加坡樟宜機場推出自主導航輪椅以協助行動不便旅客。 Changi Airport Group (CAG) and ground handling partner SATS have begun rolling out autonomous wheelchairs at Changi Airport, aiming to make travel easier for passengers with reduced mobility. The deployment, announced August 4, 2026, follows a series of successful trials 該計畫屬於 SATS「未來樞紐地勤」倡議,全面推廣後預計可分擔樟宜機場約 10% 的日常行動協助需求。 The autonomous wheelchair program falls under SATS’ “Hub Handler of the Future” initiative and is expected to handle about 10% of daily mobility assistance needs at Changi once fully rolled out. 該技術自 2025 年 3 月起於第 3 航廈進行測試並擴展至第 2 航廈,至今已服務超過 1.3 萬名旅客。 The technology was first trialed in Terminal 3 starting in March 2025, before later expanding to Terminal 2. Since then, more than 13,000 passengers have used the autonomous wheelchairs.

metadata.title: 漢光42號實兵演習首日空軍戰機實施戰備轉場保存戰力

a-20260805-0635-han-kuang-42-drills-begi.text: 漢光42號實兵演習首日空軍戰機實施戰備轉場保存戰力 國軍漢光42號實兵操演於8月5日展開。演習首日,空軍各型戰機實施戰備轉場前往指定地區以保存戰力,防空部隊全面戰備部署;海軍各式艦艇在完成整補後也緊急出港,前往指定的疏泊區待命,以防範敵軍「由演轉戰」及灰色地帶襲擾。 國軍漢光42號實兵操演於2026年8月5日正式展開,演習預計實施至8月14日,共計10天9夜。首日演練重點主要為防範敵軍以灰色地帶襲擾,並預防敵方「由演轉戰」,陸海空三軍及防空部隊皆展開全面戰備部署與演練。 在具體部署方面,空軍各型戰機實施戰備轉場,前往指定地區以進行戰力保存,防空部隊亦全面部署。同時,海軍各式艦艇於完成整補後緊急出港,前往指定疏泊區待命,海軍機動雷達與飛彈車組亦前往戰術位置待命接戰,並完成水雷整備。 Han Kuang 42 Drills Begin as Air Force Relocates Jets for Combat Preservation The Han Kuang 42 live-fire military exercise commenced on August 5, 2026, and is scheduled to run for 10 days and 9 nights until August 14. On the first day of the major drills, Taiwan's Air Force fighter jets conducted tactical relocations to designated areas for combat preservation, while air defense forces were fully deployed in combat readiness. Simultaneously, Navy vessels completed replenishment and departed for designated anchorage areas to guard against potential grey-zone harassment and any transition from exercises to active combat by opposing forces. The Han Kuang 42 live-fire military exercise began on August 5, 2026, and is scheduled to run for 10 days and 9 nights until August 14. The first day of the exercise focused on responding to potential grey-zone harassment and preventing any sudden transition from exercises to combat operations by opposing forces. As part of the initial maneuvers, the Air Force relocated various fighter jets to designated areas for combat preservation, and air defense units deployed. Simultaneously, Navy vessels completed replenishment and departed for designated anchorage areas, while mobile radar and missile vehicle groups moved to tactical positions. The Han Kuang 42 live-fire military exercise began on August 5, 2026, and is scheduled to run for 10 days and 9 nights until August 14. 國軍漢光42號今天起至14日一連10天9夜實施 Taiwan's Air Force fighter jets conducted tactical relocations to designated areas for combat preservation. 空軍戰機也戰備轉場,前往指定地區戰力保存 Navy vessels completed replenishment and departed for designated anchorage areas to prepare for potential grey-zone harassment and prevent a transition from drills to combat. 應對敵軍以民兵船、海警等方式對台遂行灰色地帶襲擾,並預防「由演轉戰」,除了海軍各式艦艇完成整補後緊急出港並前往指定疏泊區待命外 Air defense forces were fully deployed in combat readiness, and mobile radar and missile vehicle groups moved to tactical positions. 海軍機動雷達及飛彈車組則機動前往各自戰術位置實施待命接戰;另外,空軍戰機也戰備轉場,前往指定地區戰力保存,防空部隊亦全面戰備部署。

metadata.title: 漢光42號演習首日 陸戰隊搭CH-47SD直升機北上防護中樞

a-20260805-0942-han-kuang-drills-begin-w.text: 漢光42號演習首日 陸戰隊搭CH-47SD直升機北上防護中樞 國軍漢光42號實兵演習於8月5日展開。首日演練中,海軍陸戰隊官兵兵分兩路增援,除陸路長程機動外,部分官兵搭乘2架CH-47SD直升機飛抵台北附近降落,執行中樞防護演練。此外,海軍濱海作戰大隊中午亦於高雄出動機動飛彈車組,開赴指定位置實施待命放列部署。 國軍漢光42號實兵演習於2026年8月5日正式展開,進行為期10天9夜的實兵操演。在演習首日,為驗證關鍵防區的快速反應能力,海軍陸戰隊官兵依循日前的操演模式,採取兵分兩路的方式北上進行增援。除主要兵力自高雄林園駐地出發、透過陸路長程機動北上之外,部分官兵則搭乘2架CH-47SD契努克運兵直升機,執行長程空中機動任務。 根據現場拍攝與相關消息,這2架CH-47SD直升機編隊直接飛抵台北一帶降落。此次演練著重於政經中樞遭到突發威脅時,海軍陸戰隊官兵如何即時投入戰場,以有效反制敵方的空降或滲透行為,進而確保整體戰略縱深的防禦安全。除了陸戰隊之外,演習首日亦有其他相關單位循相同空中機動模式進行增援。 與此同時,海軍「濱海作戰大隊」亦於5日中午在高雄地區出動機動飛彈車組。當日中午12時21分許,共有4輛飛彈發射車、1輛射控指管車及各式附屬車輛,在完成整補整備後,依序駛出高雄市左營區的海軍左營基地大門,出發前往指定的戰術位置實施放列與部署。據了解,這些機動車組將在抵達戰力保存位置後待命,並依後續戰略命令採取行動。 此次演習自8月5日起實施至14日止。在衡山指揮所於清晨下達演習命令後,各軍種均展開全面戰備部署,以防範敵軍「由演轉戰」。除了海軍各式艦艇緊急出港前往指定疏泊區、海軍機動雷達與飛彈車組實施機動外,空軍各型戰機也進行戰備轉場以保存戰力,防空部隊全面部署,陸軍亦同步實施重要目標防護與阻絕架設演練。 Han Kuang Drills Begin with Marines Deploying via CH-47SD Helicopters The Han Kuang 42 live-troop military exercise commenced on August 5, 2026, for a ten-day period. On the first day of the drills, Taiwan's Marine Corps conducted reinforcement operations using both land and air routes. Specifically, some marines boarded two CH-47SD Chinook transport helicopters and landed near Taipei to perform critical political and economic center protection drills. Simultaneously, the Navy's Coastal Combat Force deployed mobile missile launcher vehicles and control trucks from Tsoying Base in Kaohsiung to tactical positions, enhancing rapid response readiness. The Han Kuang 42 live-troop military exercise commenced on August 5, 2026, and is scheduled to run for ten days and nine nights until August 14. To verify the rapid reaction capabilities of critical defense zones, Taiwan's Marine Corps conducted reinforcement operations on the first day of the drills, dividing their forces into land and air routes to move north. While the primary forces executed long-distance overland maneuvers from their station in Linyuan, Kaohsiung, other troops boarded two CH-47SD Chinook transport helicopters for a long-distance aerial mobilization. According to reports from the field, the two CH-47SD transport helicopters flew in formation and landed directly in the Taipei area. The deployment focused on simulating immediate battlefield intervention by the Marine Corps during sudden threats to the political and economic center. The drill aimed to counter simulated enemy airborne drops or infiltration, securing strategic defense depth. Other military units also followed similar aerial mobilization patterns to reinforce key positions during the first day of the exercise. Simultaneously, the Navy's Coastal Combat Force deployed mobile missile vehicle units in Kaohsiung around noon on August 5. At approximately 12:21 PM, four missile launcher trucks, one fire control command vehicle, and various support vehicles departed from the main gate of the Tsoying Naval Base in Kaohsiung's Tsoying District after completing preparation. These mobile units traveled to designated tactical positions to await subsequent strategic orders while preserving combat capabilities. a-20260805-1521-apac-airlines-see-june-2.text: 亞太航空六月客運量年減百分之一點一 貨運需求保持韌性 亞太航空公司六月國際客運量達三千零五十萬人次,較去年同期下滑百分之一點一,主因部分區域市場運能縮減與票價上升。同期國際貨運需求以貨運噸公里計算成長百分之三點二,受惠於AI相關半導體與硬體穩定出貨。上半年累計國際客運量一億九千二百五十萬人次,年增百分之三點二。 亞太航空公司六月運載三千零五十萬名國際旅客,較去年同期下滑百分之一點一,依據亞太航空公司協會發布的初步運量資料。該總部位於吉隆坡的產業組織將客運放緩歸因於燃油價格攀升後部分區域市場的運能縮減與票價上漲。 儘管旅客總數下滑,以營收客公里計算的需求仍較去年同期成長百分之一點一,顯示長途旅行維持相對韌性。可用座位運能僅小幅增加百分之零點三,使國際客運平均載客率上升零點七個百分點至百分之八十二點六。 國際航空貨運方面則呈現不同走勢。六月以貨運噸公里計算的國際貨運需求年增百分之三點二,受惠於AI相關半導體與硬體的穩定出貨。貨運運能僅微增百分之零點二,帶動國際貨運平均載貨率上升一點八個百分點至百分之六十二點六。 AAPA理事長Wong Hong指出,六月客運放緩因部分市場航空公司調高票價並縮減運能。他表示今年國際旅行大體維持穩定,亞太區航空公司上半年累計運載一億九千二百五十萬名國際旅客,較去年同期成長百分之三點二。 Wong Hong將貨運視為亮點,指出上半年國際航空貨運需求成長百分之七點零,歸功於AI相關半導體出貨及其他高價值、時效性商品的持續需求。展望未來,他提及中東衝突引發的燃油價格波動、企業信心偏弱及地緣政治與貿易政策風險,可能使未來數月旅遊與航空貨運成長放緩。 APAC Airlines See June 2026 Passenger Dip; Cargo Demand Stays Resilient Asia Pacific airlines carried 30.5 million international passengers in June 2026, down 1.1% year-on-year, amid capacity reductions and higher airfares following a fuel price spike. He pointed to cargo as a bright spot, saying that international air cargo demand grew 7.0% in the first half of the year, crediting that growth to continued demand for AI-related semiconductor shipments and other high-value, time-sensitive goods. a-20260805-2119-lockheed-martin-signs-mo.text: 洛克希德馬汀簽署MOU 尋求本土戰機鈧金屬供應 洛克希德馬汀與礦業開發商 NioCorp 簽署不具約束力的備忘錄,探討在未來十年每年購買最多15公噸氧化鈧,用於戰機結構與積層製造,降低對中國供應的依賴。 洛克希德馬汀(Lockheed Martin)於2026年8月5日發布消息,該公司已與礦物開發商 NioCorp Developments 簽署一份不具約束力的諒解備忘錄(MOU),探討在未來十年內每年向 NioCorp 購買最多15公噸的氧化鈧,或以鋁鈧合金形式交貨。 這項安排延伸自雙方自2025年10月啟動的聯合開發計畫,該計畫獲美國國防部依據《國防生產法》撥款1000萬美元,由洛克希德馬汀旗下臭鼬工廠(Skunk Works)與 NioCorp 共同為戰機生產鋁鈧合金原型零件。 NioCorp 董事長兼執行長 Mark Smith 指出,這份備忘錄顯示減少美國在鈧金屬上對中國依賴的論據更加充分。鈧以極低比例添加至鋁合金中即可提升強度、耐腐蝕性與可焊接性,適合用於機身結構及積層製造。 不過,AeroTime 報導指出,NioCorp 位於 Elk Creek 的礦場計畫雖已在2026年2月展開坑道開挖,但整體專案尚未完全取得融資與投產。該公司正向美國進出口銀行尋求最高8億美元的債務融資,申請自2023年提交後仍待最終批准。 報導也提及,全球鈧市場規模極小。美國地質調查局(USGS)估計2025年全球氧化鈾消費量僅60公噸,且中國是最大生產國。美國在2025年並無商業開採或回收任何鈾,完全仰賴進口。 Lockheed Martin signs MOU for domestic fighter scandium supply amid China export controls Lockheed Martin has signed a non-binding memorandum of understanding with minerals developer NioCorp covering the potential purchase of up to 15 tonnes of scandium oxide per year over the next decade, aiming to reduce U.S. dependence on Chinese supply for fighter aircraft manufacturing. Lockheed Martin has signed a non-binding memorandum of understanding with minerals developer NioCorp Developments covering the potential purchase of up to 15 tonnes of scandium oxide a year over the next decade, NioCorp announced on August 4, 2026. The material could be delivered either as oxide or as aluminum-scandium alloy. Tyler Robinson, vice president for technology roadmaps at Lockheed Martin Skunk Works, said the company appreciated NioCorp’s work on domestic sourcing and alloying and would continue to evaluate that supply as part of its wider alloy development effort. NioCorp chairman and chief executive Mark Smith framed the agreement as evidence that the argument for reducing U.S. dependence on China for scandium had strengthened. The MOU extends a joint development program announced in October 2025, under which NioCorp and Skunk Works are producing prototype aluminum-scandium alloy components for fighter aircraft. That work draws on a $10 million award from the U.S. Department of Defense under Title III of the Defense Production Act. However, the wider Elk Creek project is not yet fully financed or in production. NioCorp began constructing the mine portal in February 2026 but is still seeking up to $800 million in debt financing from the U.S. Export-Import Bank, with the application remaining subject to due diligence and final approval since its submission in 2023. Scandium added to aluminum in fractions of a percent improves strength, corrosion resistance and weldability with little weight penalty, making it attractive for airframe structures and additive manufacturing. But the market remains extremely small: the U.S. Geological Survey put global consumption of scandium oxide at just 60 tonnes in 2025, with China the leading producer and the United States wholly import-dependent. a-20260806-0638-han-kuang-exercise-troop.text: 漢光演習國軍搭客輪馳援綠島蘭嶼驗證防衛能量 國軍「漢光42號演習」於2026年8月6日進入第2天,逾百名官兵在台東富岡漁港搭乘客輪,運送建制武器與物資馳援綠島及蘭嶼。第二作戰區表示,本次演練採實兵實物驗證離島應援能量,官兵登島後即構築防禦工事並操作無人機進行戰術偵查。 國軍「漢光42號演習」於2026年8月6日進入第2天。台東富岡漁港上午集結逾百名官兵,在登上客輪並完成建制武器與軍需物資裝載後,搭船前往綠島與蘭嶼。 第二作戰區表示,本次「登島防衛作戰演練」採實兵、實地與實物方式,驗證離島應援能量。部隊登島後進入戰術位置,構築防禦工事並操作無人機實施戰術偵查。 軍方人士說明,演練想定包含阻斷敵軍奪取離島作為直升機與無人機起降的前進基地,或藉此突破第一島鏈,國軍遂迅速馳援離島以驗證守備能量。 Han Kuang Exercise: Troops Board Ferries to Reinforce Green Island and Orchid Island On August 6, 2026, during the second day of the Han Kuang 42 exercise, over 100 military personnel gathered at Fugang Fishery Harbor in Taitung to board passenger ferries with weapons and supplies, embarking for Green Island and Orchid Island. a-20260806-0945-iberia-to-operate-specia.text: Iberia將派A321XLR執飛日全食觀測包機 西班牙Iberia航空將於2026年8月12日,使用全新空中巴士A321XLR客機執飛代號IB1473的特別觀測包機。該航班將搭載Shelios計畫的科研團隊,從馬德里起飛並於1萬公尺高空觀測日全食。航空公司亦計畫利用機上的SpaceX Starlink衛星網路在社群媒體進行空中直播。 西班牙Iberia航空宣布將於2026年8月12日執飛一班特別包機,以觀測當天在西班牙部分地區出現的日全食。該航班代號為IB1473,計畫於當地時間18時45分自馬德里-巴拉哈斯國際機場(MAD)起飛,並使用其全新的空中巴士A321XLR客機,飛越西班牙中北部的帕倫西亞省。 此航班將搭載Shelios計畫的科研團隊,於1萬公尺高空提供無雲阻礙的視野,用以測量太陽形態及觀測其他天體。此外,Iberia航空計畫利用該A321XLR客機配備的SpaceX Starlink衛星網路,在社群媒體上實況直播此次日全食畫面。 Iberia to Operate Special A321XLR Flight for Solar Eclipse Observation Spanish flag carrier Iberia has announced plans to operate a special charter flight on August 12, 2026, to observe a total solar eclipse. a-20260806-0945-joby-aviation-targets-se.text: Joby規劃9月展開美國eVTOL整合試飛計畫 Joby Aviation於2026年8月5日表示,預計將於2026年9月在德克薩斯州展開美國eVTOL整合試飛計畫(eIPP)的首次飛行,並維持在2026年底前載運首批乘客的目標。該試飛計畫允許參與者在與美國聯邦航空總署協議下,操作尚未取得型別認證的航空器以收集營運數據。 Joby Aviation於2026年8月5日公佈第二季財報時表示,預計將於2026年9月在德克薩斯州展開美國eVTOL整合試飛計畫(eIPP)的首次飛行任務。這家總部位於加利福尼亞州的製造商同時維持其在2026年底前載運首批乘客的既定目標。 美國eVTOL整合試飛計畫由白宮行政命令設立,聯邦航空總署(FAA)與美國運輸部於2026年3月9日選出首批八個項目。該計畫允許參與者在與FAA直接協商的協議下,操作尚未獲得型別認證的航空器,以收集營運數據供未來制定法規參考。 在德克薩斯州推動的項目由德克薩斯州運輸部主管,參與企業除了Joby Aviation外,還包括Archer Aviation、Beta Technologies與Wisk。該項目計畫連結達拉斯、奧斯汀與聖安東尼奧,並預計最終延伸至休士頓。 財務方面,Joby Aviation報告第二季來自其於2025年收購的直升機營運商Blade之營收為3,620萬美元,並將2026全年的營收展望上調至1.15億美元至1.25億美元之間。公司截至2026年6月30日持有23億美元的現金與短期投資。 此外,該公司於2026年8月4日宣佈與Travis Kalanick創辦的工業人工智慧與基礎設施企業Atoms建立合作夥伴關係,旨在於美國首發市場開發多模態交通樞紐。 Joby Aviation Targets September for First US eVTOL Integration Pilot Program Flights Joby Aviation announced on August 5, 2026, that it expects to begin its first flights under the US eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP) in September 2026, with initial operations scheduled in Texas. The manufacturer maintained its goal of carrying its first passengers before the end of 2026. Under the White House-backed program, participants can operate uncertified aircraft under FAA agreements to collect operational data for future rulemaking. The Texas project, led by the Texas Department of Transportation alongside Archer Aviation, Beta Technologies, and Wisk, aims to connect Dallas, Austin, San Antonio, and eventually Houston. Joby Aviation expects to conduct its initial flights under the US eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP) in September 2026, with first operations taking place in Texas. The California-based manufacturer released the timeline on August 5, 2026, alongside its second-quarter financial results, while maintaining its target to carry its first passengers before the end of 2026. The eIPP initiative was established by presidential executive order, with its first eight projects selected on March 9, 2026, by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and the US Department of Transportation. The program framework allows participating companies to operate aircraft that have not yet received type certification, under agreements negotiated directly with the FAA, to gather operational data for future regulatory frameworks. The Texas project under eIPP is led by the Texas Department of Transportation and includes participation from Archer Aviation, Beta Technologies, and Wisk. The regional initiative is designed to link Dallas, Austin, and San Antonio, with plans to expand operational routes to Houston in later phases. Alongside its operational guidance, Joby reported second-quarter revenue of $36.2 million from Blade, the helicopter operator acquired in 2025. The company raised its full-year 2026 revenue outlook to between $115 million and $125 million, while holding $2.3 billion in cash and short-term investments as of June 30, 2026. metadata.title: 漢光演習台北港防禦 動員貨輪漁船封阻航道

a-20260806-0945-taiwan-han-kuang-exercis.text: 漢光演習台北港防禦 動員貨輪漁船封阻航道 國軍漢光42號實兵演習於8月6日第2天在台北港進行要港防禦演練,動員1艘800噸貨輪與16艘漁船執行航道封阻,並部署貨櫃與水泥塊架設道路阻絕設施,以強化關鍵設施防禦並爭取縱深防禦時間。 台灣國軍「漢光42號」實兵演習於2026年8月5日至14日實施,展開為期10天9夜的演訓。在8月6日演習第二天,軍方於台北港進行要港防禦演練,旨在強化關鍵基礎設施防禦並爭取縱深防禦時間。 在台北港演練中,軍方動員1艘800噸貨輪及16艘漁船進行航道封阻。演練亦投入1座浮箱站台與28個貨櫃進行港務整合,並部署80個太空包及150塊2噸水泥塊架設聯外道路阻絕設施。 此外,宜蘭縣後備指揮部後備軍人輔導中心亦配合蘭陽地區指揮部,於轄區灘岸聯外道路執行阻絕架設。國防部表示,相關課目旨在執行反資敵與航道阻絕,以延滯敵軍推進並爭取應處時間。 Taiwan Han Kuang Exercise Tests Taipei Port Defense with Vessel Blockade During the second day of Taiwan's Han Kuang 42 live-troop exercise on August 6, 2026, the military conducted key port defense drills at Taipei Port to strengthen critical infrastructure defenses and gain time for depth defense. Reservists were mobilized with one 800-ton cargo vessel and 16 fishing boats to perform shipping channel blockades. The exercise also deployed 150 concrete blocks, 80 jumbo bags, and 28 containers for port integration and road obstacle setups, while Yilan reserve auxiliary units supported beach defense operations. Taiwan's Armed Forces conducted key port defense exercises at Taipei Port on August 6, 2026, marking the second day of the 10-day, 9-night Han Kuang 42 live-troop exercise running from August 5 to 14. The drill aimed to strengthen critical infrastructure defense and gain time for depth defense operations. As part of the channel blockage exercise at Taipei Port, the military mobilized one 800-ton cargo ship and 16 fishing vessels through reserve recruitment. The drill also utilized one floating pontoon platform, 28 containers, 80 jumbo bags, and 150 two-ton concrete blocks for port logistics integration and outer road obstacle deployment. Additionally, reserve auxiliary centers in Yilan County cooperated with the Lanyang Regional Command to execute beach obstacle operations on coastal roads. The Ministry of National Defense stated that these measures, including anti-denial and channel obstruction maneuvers, are designed to delay enemy advances and buy time for troop maneuvering. The Han Kuang 42 live-troop exercise is being conducted for 10 days and 9 nights from August 5 to 14, 2026. 國軍漢光42號實兵演習5日至14日一連10天9夜實施 On August 6, the second day of the exercise, Taipei Port conducted a key port defense drill to strengthen critical infrastructure defense and gain depth defense time. 國軍漢光42號實兵操演今天第2天,為強化關鍵基礎設施的台北港防禦及爭取縱深防禦時間,台北港上午進行要港防禦演練 The exercise mobilized 1 800-ton cargo vessel and 16 fishing boats through reserve mobilization to perform channel blockage. 由後備動員1艘800噸貨輪、16艘漁船進行航道封阻 The drill prepared 1 floating pontoon platform, 28 containers, 80 jumbo bags, and 150 2-ton concrete blocks for port integration and outer road obstacle deployment. 有1座浮箱站台、28個貨櫃;聯外道路阻絕課目部分,則有80個太空包、150塊2噸水泥塊投入演練 Yilan County Reserve Officer Auxiliary Centers collaborated with the Lanyang Regional Command to conduct defense obstacle setup on coastal roads. 宜蘭縣後備指揮部所屬後備軍人輔導中心配合蘭陽地區指揮部,於轄區灘岸聯外道路實施阻絕作業

metadata.title: 空中巴士A350F完成地面震動測試 預計今年底前首飛

a-20260806-1037-airbus-completes-ground-.text: 空中巴士A350F完成地面震動測試 預計今年底前首飛 空中巴士首架A350F貨機在法國土魯斯完成為期三天的地面震動測試,為預計於2026年底前進行的首飛做準備。此項測試旨在驗證飛機結構動態與氣動彈性模型。空中巴士預計該款基於A350-1000機型開發的貨機將於2027年投入營運。 歐洲飛機製造商空中巴士(Airbus)宣佈,首架A350F貨機已在法國土魯斯完成地面震動測試(GVT)。此項測試為該機型地面測試計畫的重要里程碑,旨在為預計於2026年底前進行的首飛做準備。 本次地面震動測試於2026年6月進行,歷時三天,測試機型為MSN700。地面震動測試為飛機進行首飛前的必要驗證程序,主要目的在於量測機身結構對動態刺激的反應,並驗證飛機的氣動彈性行為是否符合設計階段所建立的數學模型。 在測試過程中,工程師透過連接於翼尖、後機身與發動機等處的外接震動器,結合飛機本身的控制面動作對機身進行震動刺激。資料採集則結合了飛機內建的飛行測試儀表(FTI)數據與專為測試安裝的自主感測器數據。 在此次地面震動測試之前,空中巴士已於德國不萊梅設施完成主艙門(MDCD)驅動與貨物裝載系統(CLS)的測試台演示。此外,測試團隊亦針對防尾傾保護、排水系統及最大載重能力等項目進行了多項地面評估。 A350F為基於A350-1000客機平台開發的全專用貨機,與廣體客機版本具備高度共通性,共享約90%的零組件。該款貨機設計最大酬載能力可達111公噸,主艙位最多可容納30個集裝板位置。 空中巴士預計A350F將於2026年底前完成首次飛行。隨著相關試飛與認證工作持續推進,該型貨機目前的商業營運時程規劃於2027年正式投入市場。 Airbus Completes Ground Vibration Testing on A350F Freighter Ahead of First Flight Airbus has completed ground vibration testing on its first A350F freighter test aircraft in Toulouse, France, marking a key milestone ahead of the type's planned first flight before the end of 2026. The three-day test campaign evaluated the airframe's structural dynamics and verified its aeroelastic behavior using sensors and shakers across the fuselage, wings, and engines. Based on the A350-1000 passenger aircraft, the A350F is designed to carry up to 111 tonnes of payload. Airbus currently expects the freighter to enter commercial service in 2027. European aircraft manufacturer Airbus has completed ground vibration testing on the first A350F freighter test aircraft, marking a major technical milestone in the ground test campaign ahead of the aircraft's scheduled first flight before the end of 2026. The testing campaign took place in Toulouse, France, over the course of three days in June 2026 on test aircraft MSN700. Ground vibration testing represents a critical evaluation to validate structural dynamics and aeroelastic behaviour before flight testing, ensuring that dynamic responses across the airframe match the mathematical models used during initial design. During the test series, the aircraft airframe was excited using external hydraulic shakers connected at key positions—including the wingtips, rear fuselage, and engines—in combination with movements from the aircraft's own flight control surfaces. Engineers collected data through onboard Flight Test Instrumentation alongside autonomous sensors installed throughout the airframe. The vibration trial follows months of extensive ground testing across Airbus facilities. Prior to the Toulouse campaign, Airbus conducted test rig demonstrations of the Main-Deck Cargo Door actuation system and Cargo Loading System at its facility in Bremen, Germany, alongside evaluations of drainage systems and maximum payload handling. The A350F is a dedicated cargo derivative of the A350-1000 passenger airliner, sharing around 90 percent of its components with the baseline aircraft. The new freighter is designed to accommodate a payload of up to 111 tonnes across 30 main-deck pallet positions. Airbus maintains its expectation for the A350F to perform its maiden flight before the end of 2026. Commercial entry into service for the freighter program is currently planned for 2027, when it will enter service for air cargo operators. a-20260806-1037-iberia-to-operate-specia.text: 西班牙航空將派A321XLR執飛日全食觀測包機 西班牙航空計劃於2026年8月12日派遣空中巴士A321XLR執飛IB1473特別包機,從馬德里巴拉哈斯國際機場(MAD)起飛,前往西班牙中北部帕倫西亞省上空觀測日全食。該航班將搭載Shelios計畫研究團隊,並透過SpaceX提供的Starlink衛星網路進行空中直播。 西班牙航空計劃於2026年8月12日執飛一班特別包機,以觀測西班牙部分地區出現的日全食。該航班編號為IB1473,致敬16世紀波蘭天文學家哥白尼的出生年份,預計當地時間18時45分從馬德里巴拉哈斯國際機場(MAD)起飛。 該任務將採用空中巴士A321XLR客機執飛,航線專門規劃於西班牙中北部的帕倫西亞省上空,飛行高度為10,000公尺。航班將載運由天文學家Miquel Serra-Ricart領導的Shelios計畫研究團隊,機組人員中的飛行員Javier Meana Fernández亦具備天體物理學背景。 此外,西班牙航空計劃透過社群媒體直播空中觀測過程。本次執飛任務的A321XLR客機為該航空公司首批配備SpaceX Starlink衛星網路連線功能的飛機之一。 Iberia to Operate Special A321XLR Solar Eclipse Flight with Starlink Spanish flag carrier Iberia plans to operate a special charter flight on August 12, 2026, to observe a total solar eclipse visible over parts of Spain. metadata.title: Joby規劃2026年9月於德州展開首批eVTOL試飛

a-20260806-1037-joby-targets-september-2.text: Joby規劃2026年9月於德州展開首批eVTOL試飛 Joby Aviation於2026年8月5日公布第二季財報時表示,預計將於2026年9月在德州展開美國「eVTOL整合試飛計畫」(eIPP)下的首次飛行任務。該公司同時維持在2026年底前載運首批乘客的目標,並持續推進美國聯邦航空總署(FAA)的第五階段型別檢定作業。 總部位於加州的電動垂直起降飛行器製造商 Joby Aviation 於 2026 年 8 月 5 日發布第二季財務報告時宣布,預計將於 2026 年 9 月在德克薩斯州展開美國「eVTOL 整合試飛計畫」(eIPP)架構下的首批飛行任務。該公司同時確認,將持續維持在 2026 年底前實現首次載客營運的既定目標。 美國「eVTOL 整合試飛計畫」(eIPP)是由行政命令設立,並由美國聯邦航空總署(FAA)與美國交通部於 2026 年 3 月 9 日選出首批八個合作項目。該計畫允許參與單位在與 FAA 直接簽署協議的框架下,操作尚未取得型別檢定證的航空器進行飛行,藉此累積實際營運資料,作為未來相關法規制定之參考依據。 在德克薩斯州的試飛計畫中,該項目由德克薩斯州交通廳主導,參與企業除了 Joby Aviation 之外,還包括 Archer Aviation、Beta Technologies 以及 Wisk。該計畫旨在建立連接達拉斯、奧斯汀與聖安東尼奧的空中交通網路,並規劃未來進一步擴展至休士頓。 在認證進度方面,Joby Aviation 正處於 FAA 型別檢定的第五階段兼最終階段。該公司自 2026 年 3 月 11 日展開首架符合型別檢查授權設計標準的飛機 N547JX 試飛以來,目前已有 5 架航空器投入飛行測試,另有 12 架正在生產線中,並預計在 2026 年內再完成 2 架飛機的交付。 在財務表現方面,Joby Aviation 報告第二季來自其於 2025 年收購的直升機營運商 Blade 的營收為 3620 萬美元,並將 2026 全年營收預測調升至 1.15 億美元至 1.25 億美元之間。截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日,該公司持有 23 億美元的現金與短期投資,並預估在 2026 年下半年使用 3.85 億美元至 4.15 億美元資金。 Joby Targets September 2026 for First US eVTOL Pilot Flights in Texas Joby Aviation announced on August 5, 2026, alongside its second-quarter financial results, that it expects to launch its first flights under the US eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP) in Texas in September 2026. The California-based manufacturer maintained its operational target to carry its first passengers before the end of 2026. The eIPP framework enables participants to fly uncertified aircraft under dedicated agreements with the Federal Aviation Administration to gather operational data for future rulemaking. Joby also reported entering the fifth and final stage of FAA type certification, with five aircraft currently flying and twelve more in production. California-based Joby Aviation announced on August 5, 2026, alongside its second-quarter financial results, that it expects to launch its first flights under the US eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP) in September 2026, with initial operations planned in Texas. The electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft developer also confirmed that it maintains its target of flying its first passengers before the end of 2026. Established under a presidential executive order, the eIPP saw its first eight projects selected by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and the US Department of Transportation on March 9, 2026. The program permits participants to fly aircraft that have not yet obtained FAA type certification under specialized agreements negotiated directly with the agency, enabling companies to collect operational data to support future aviation rulemaking. The Texas eIPP initiative is led by the Texas Department of Transportation and includes Joby Aviation alongside industry partners Archer Aviation, Beta Technologies, and Wisk. The project aims to establish regional aerial connections linking Dallas, Austin, and San Antonio, with plans to later expand connections to Houston. Joby reported significant progress in its type certification journey, currently navigating the fifth and final stage of FAA certification. Since beginning flight testing of its first conforming aircraft, registered N547JX, on March 11, 2026, Joby now has five aircraft actively flying and twelve additional units in production, with plans for two further deliveries before the end of 2026. a-20260806-1215-typhoon-white-dolphin-pr.text: 颱風白海豚逼近 華航與星宇調整8月6日起沖繩航班 受中度颱風白海豚影響,中華航空與星宇航空宣布調整2026年8月6日至8日的往返沖繩航班。其中,華航在此期間共取消14架次航班,並對部分航班進行時間調整或放大機型;星宇航空則於8月6日取消2架次,且8月7日往返沖繩的航班全數取消。 受中度颱風白海豚移動影響,中華航空與星宇航空於2026年8月5日宣布調整8月6日至8日期間往返沖繩之航班。 中華航空表示,自8月6日至8日共有14架次往返沖繩航班取消,包含6日CI122/CI123,7日CI120/CI121、CI122/CI123、CI310/CI311、CI2132/CI2133、CI132/CI133,以及8日CI310/CI311。此外,華航6日部分航班將提前或放大機型執飛,8日部分航班則將延後。 星宇航空則於8月6日取消台中往返沖繩JX312/JX313,其餘四架次沖繩航班(JX870、JX871、JX302、JX303)將提前起飛。8月7日台灣往返沖繩航班也將全數取消。 Typhoon White Dolphin Prompts China Airlines and STARLUX Flight Adjustments to Okinawa Due to the approach of Typhoon White Dolphin, China Airlines and STARLUX Airlines have announced flight adjustments for their routes between Taiwan and Okinawa from August 6 to 8, 2026. China Airlines will cancel 14 flights and adjust other schedules, including upgrading some flights to larger aircraft. Meanwhile, STARLUX Airlines will cancel two flights on August 6 and advance the departure times of four others, followed by the cancellation of all its Taiwan-Okinawa flights scheduled for August 7. Due to the movement of Typhoon White Dolphin, China Airlines and STARLUX Airlines announced flight adjustments for their routes between Taiwan and Okinawa from August 6 to 8, 2026. China Airlines has cancelled 14 flights scheduled between August 6 and 8. These include Taoyuan-Okinawa flights CI122/CI123 on August 6, as well as CI120/CI121 and CI122/CI123 on August 7. It also includes Taichung-Okinawa flights CI310/CI311 on August 7 and 8, and Kaohsiung-Okinawa flights CI2132/CI2133 and CI132/CI133 on August 7. Some flights on August 6 will be advanced or upgraded, while some on August 8 will be delayed. STARLUX Airlines will cancel JX312/JX313 between Taichung and Okinawa on August 6, while four other flights (JX870, JX871, JX302, and JX303) on August 6 will depart early. Furthermore, all STARLUX flights between Taiwan and Okinawa on August 7 are cancelled. 中華航空因颱風白海豚調整2026年8月6日至8日往返沖繩航班,共取消14架次,部分架次提前、延後或放大機型。 華航公布明起至8日飛沖繩航班異動,14架次取消,部分架次提前、延後或放大機型 星宇航空調整8月6日至7日台灣往返沖繩航班,其中6日取消2架次,7日航班全數取消。 星宇航空明天6架次異動,包含2架次取消,7日往返沖繩航班全取消。 華航取消之航班包括8月6日CI122/CI123,7日CI120/CI121、CI122/CI123、CI310/CI311、CI2132/CI2133、CI132/CI133,以及8日CI310/CI311。 航班取消包括6日CI122/CI123桃園往返沖繩、7日CI120/CI121、CI122/CI123桃園往返沖繩、CI310/CI311台中往返沖繩、CI2132/ CI2133、 CI132/CI133高雄往返沖繩、8月8日CI310/CI311台中往返沖繩。 星宇航空調整部分8月6日航班,包括JX870、JX871、JX302、JX303提前起飛。 台北-沖繩JX870提前至上午9時起飛,沖繩-台北JX871提前至中午12時50分起飛,台中-沖繩JX302提前至上午8時起飛,沖繩-台中JX303提前至上午11時30分起飛。

a-20260806-1215-china-airlines-airlifts-.text: 華航免費直飛福岡 協助慈濟運送熊本震災避難隔屏 慈濟基金會於8月4日表示,為支援日本熊本強震避難所需求並降低染疫風險,緊急調度200頂福慧隔屏至桃園八德倉儲打包,並由中華航空於當日下午免費協助直飛運送至日本福岡機場,投入災區救援。首批援助物資已於8月3日抵達熊本八代市物資中心。 慈濟基金會於8月4日表示,為因應日本熊本地震後的避難所需求,緊急調度200頂福慧隔屏前往桃園八德倉儲進行打包作業,並預計於當日下午由中華航空免費協助直飛運送至日本福岡機場,以投入災區的後續救援工作。 日本熊本縣於7月28日下午發生規模7.1強烈地震,避難所隨後於8月2日出現COVID-19確診個案。慈濟指出,首批援助的148張福慧床與40頂隔屏已於8月3日運抵熊本八代市緊急救援物資中心,後續將與當地討論設置地點,以降低避難所的染疫風險並保障災民隱私。 China Airlines Airlifts Relief Partitions to Fukuoka for Kumamoto Earthquake Relief The Tzu Chi Foundation announced on August 4 that China Airlines provided free direct flight assistance to airlift 200 folding relief partitions to Fukuoka Airport, supporting shelter operations following a magnitude 7.1 earthquake in Kumamoto, Japan. The disaster hit Kumamoto on July 28, causing crowding in evacuation shelters where a COVID-19 infection was subsequently reported on August 2. An initial batch of 148 folding beds and 40 partitions previously arrived at the Yatsushiro emergency relief supply center on August 3. The newly dispatched partitions were gathered and packed at a Taoyuan warehouse before being flown directly to Japan to reduce infection risks in disaster shelters. China Airlines provided free direct flight assistance on the afternoon of August 4 to transport the relief supplies directly to Fukuoka Airport in Japan to support ongoing relief operations following a recent earthquake in Kumamoto. A magnitude 7.1 earthquake struck Kumamoto Prefecture on the afternoon of July 28, leading to overcrowded conditions in evacuation centers where a COVID-19 case was identified on August 2. Tzu Chi noted that an initial shipment of 148 folding beds and 40 partitions arrived at the emergency relief supply center in Yatsushiro, Kumamoto on August 3, aimed at improving privacy and reducing infection risks for displaced residents. 慈濟基金會表示,中華航空於8月4日下午免費協助將200頂福慧隔屏直飛運送至日本福岡機場。 預計下午由中華航空免費協助直飛日本福岡機場,投入後續援助工作當中。 慈濟送往日本熊本的第一批148張福慧床與40頂隔屏已於8月3日抵達八代市緊急救援物資中心。 第一批送往熊本的148張福慧床、40頂隔屏已於8月3日抵達熊本八代市緊急救援物資中心 慈濟於8月4日緊急調度200頂福慧隔屏集結至桃園八德倉儲進行打包作業,以降低避難所染疫風險。 今天也再緊急調度200頂福慧隔屏集結前往桃園八德倉儲並進行打包作業 日本熊本縣於7月28日發生規模7.1強烈地震,避難所於8月2日出現COVID-19感染者。 日本熊本縣於7月28日下午發生規模7.1強烈地震

a-20260807-0009-typhoon-white-dolphin-pr.text: 颱風白海豚影響國籍航空沖繩航班多數取消 受到颱風白海豚影響,台灣虎航、星宇航空、中華航空及長榮航空等國籍航空公司,已調整並取消2026年8月8日多數往返沖繩的航班。部分航空公司為此調整起飛時間,或於8月8日與9日安排加班機以疏運旅客,長榮航空也規劃於8月9日放大機型協助運送。 受到颱風白海豚影響,台灣各國籍航空公司調整並取消了2026年8月8日多數往返沖繩的航班。台灣虎航已取消8日桃園與高雄往返沖繩那霸,以及桃園往返石垣島的航班。中華航空也宣佈取消8日桃園、台中及高雄往返沖繩的全部航班。 星宇航空除了取消8日台中往返沖繩航班外,另規劃於8日和9日安排加班機協助疏運。長榮航空則取消8日桃園往返沖繩航班,並宣佈於9日往返該航線的航班皆放大機型為波音777-300ER。旅客出發前應留意最新航班異動資訊。 Typhoon White Dolphin Disrupts Taiwanese Airlines Flights to Okinawa Due to the impact of Typhoon White Dolphin, Taiwanese carriers including Taiwan Tigerair, STARLUX Airlines, China Airlines, and EVA Air have cancelled or rescheduled most of their flights to Okinawa on August 8, 2026. a-20260807-0355-eva-air-to-launch-nonsto.text: 長榮航空12月1日起開航桃園至印度德里直飛航線 長榮航空宣布將於12月1日起正式開航桃園-印度德里直飛航線,該航線即日起開放旅客訂位購票。根據長榮航空說明,開闢桃園至印度德里直飛服務,主要目的在於拓展南亞市場,並藉此串聯北美航網。 長榮航空正式宣布,規劃自12月1日起開航桃園至印度德里之直飛航線。對於有訂位需求之旅客,相關班機的訂位與購票服務已自即日起公開開放辦理。 長榮航空表示,開闢桃園-印度德里直飛航線,主要目的在於拓展南亞市場。透過提供直飛航班服務,進一步促進台灣桃園與印度德里之間的空中客運聯繫。 長榮航空同時指出,新開航的德里航線不僅能深化南亞市場的營運佈局,同時亦可有效串聯其北美航網,提供更為便捷的跨洲航網連接服務。 EVA Air to Launch Nonstop Taoyuan-Delhi Route on Dec 1 Taiwanese carrier EVA Air has officially announced that it will launch direct flights between Taoyuan and Delhi, India, beginning December 1. Reservations and ticket sales for the new nonstop service have been opened to the public starting today. According to statements from EVA Air, opening the direct air connection between Taoyuan and Delhi is designed to expand the airline's presence in the South Asian market, while also linking and strengthening its broader North American route network. EVA Air has announced that it will launch a new nonstop service between Taoyuan and Delhi, India, starting December 1. Reservations and ticket sales for flights on the new route are open to passengers starting today. According to EVA Air, the launch of the direct Taoyuan-Delhi route is primarily intended to expand the airline's market presence in South Asia. Furthermore, the carrier highlighted that establishing flights to Delhi will allow it to effectively link its South Asian offerings with its existing North American route network, facilitating seamless intercontinental air connections for passengers. 長榮航空將於12月1日起開航桃園至印度德里直飛航線。 長榮航空12月1日起開航桃園-印度德里直飛航線 該航線即日起開放旅客訂位購票。 即日起開放訂位購票 開航德里航線旨在拓展南亞市場並串聯長榮航空的北美航網。 拓展南亞市場、串聯北美航網

a-20260807-0728-gibraltar-launches-aircr.text: 直布羅陀設立新航空器註冊處 採用VP-G國籍標誌 根據AeroTime報導,英國海外領地直布羅陀於2026年8月4日與Aviation Registry Group簽署協議,設立專屬航空器註冊處,飛機註冊編號將使用VP-G前綴。該註冊處目前尚未開放營運,須先通過直布羅陀民航局稽核,預估飛機所有人可在2026年底前提出註冊申請。 英國海外領地直布羅陀政府於2026年8月4日與專門從事航空服務的Aviation Registry Group簽署協議,正式設立該領地專屬的航空器註冊處。在該註冊處註冊的航空器,將獲得「VP-G」前綴作為國籍登記標誌。 該新成立的航空器註冊處目前尚未開放營運,未來須先通過直布羅陀民航局(GCAA)進行的稽核。直布羅陀民航局於2024年成立、2026年2月開始運作,並接受英國民航局(CAA)的監督。 管理機構規劃,航空器所有人可在2026年底前提出註冊申請。負責營運的Aviation Registry Group由David Colindres領導,目前同時管理阿魯巴與聖馬利諾的航空器註冊處。 Gibraltar Launches Aircraft Registry with VP-G Prefix According to AeroTime, the British overseas territory of Gibraltar signed an agreement on August 4, 2026, with Aviation Registry Group to launch its own aircraft registry, using the "VP-G" registration prefix. metadata.title: 漢光演習第3天新竹基地演練跑道搶修與幻象緊急起飛
airline: 空軍第2戰術戰鬥機聯隊

a-20260807-1153-han-kuang-exercise-day-3.text: 漢光演習第3天新竹基地演練跑道搶修與幻象緊急起飛 國軍漢光42號實兵演習第3天,空軍第2戰術戰鬥機聯隊在新竹基地執行幻象2000戰機潛力裝掛、跑道搶修及緊急起飛演練,展現作戰韌性與持續力。 國軍漢光42號實兵演習進入第3天,演習想定為共軍以飛彈襲台,國防部邀請媒體赴空軍第2戰術戰鬥機聯隊駐地新竹基地採訪。空軍在基地執行幻象2000戰機空對空飛彈潛力裝掛、跑道搶修及戰機緊急起飛等演練。 在潛力裝掛演練方面,2聯隊機務分隊為幻象2000單座機(機號2035)掛載魔法二型與雲母飛彈。魔法二型屬空對空短程飛彈,由官兵徒手搬運掛載於機翼下;屬中程飛彈的雲母飛彈則由專用掛彈車掛載在機腹。此次裝載構型為「恢復」標準防空外型,分別掛載2枚雲母飛彈、2枚魔法飛彈及2個副油箱。 跑道搶修演練模擬跑道遭共軍飛彈炸出巨型坑洞,設施中隊依序由輪式挖土機、傾卸車、壓路機等重型機具將彈坑回填並壓實,再以堆高機及人力將玻璃纖維墊展開組合,拖至修補彈坑上方完成復原。設施中隊中隊長林至軒中校表示,規範是以4小時內完成彈坑填補,目前以無人機進行跑道受損勘查。 2聯隊最後在基地南側南警戒室演練緊急起飛任務,2架幻象2000單座機採攜掛2枚雲母飛彈、2枚魔法飛彈與2個翼下副油箱的防空警戒外型,執行6分鐘警戒姿態。警鈴一響後,飛行員與地勤人員奔向戰機完成檢整作業,2架戰機在不到5分鐘內滑出警戒機堡執行起飛任務。 空軍指出,潛力裝掛是指專業人員應於指定時限內完成戰機各項武器外載、副油箱裝掛作業,依戰備需求區分為「完成」及「恢復」戰備。聯隊幹部與待命飛行員在演練時均配戴國造T75K3手槍並穿著戰術背心與頭盔,模擬戰時狀態。 Han Kuang Exercise Day 3: Hsinchu Base Drills Runway Repair and Mirage Emergency Takeoff On the third day of Taiwan's Han Kuang 42 live-troop exercise, the Air Force's 2nd Tactical Fighter Wing conducted Mirage 2000 missile loading, runway crater repair, and emergency scramble drills at Hsinchu Air Base under a scenario simulating a missile attack on Taiwan. The Han Kuang 42 live-troop exercise entered its third day with a scenario simulating a PLA missile attack on Taiwan. The Ministry of National Defense invited media to cover the drills at the Hsinchu base, home to the Air Force's 2nd Tactical Fighter Wing. The Air Force conducted Mirage 2000 air-to-air missile loading, runway repair, and emergency fighter takeoff exercises. For the weapons loading drill, the wing's maintenance unit loaded Magic II and MICA missiles onto a single-seat Mirage 2000 (aircraft number 2035). The Magic II, a short-range air-to-air missile, was loaded by hand onto the wing; the MICA, a medium-range missile, was loaded onto the fuselage using a dedicated bomb-loading vehicle. The configuration was the "restore" standard air defense loadout: two MICA missiles, two Magic missiles, and two drop tanks. The runway repair drill simulated a large crater caused by an enemy missile strike. The facilities squadron used excavators, dump trucks, and rollers to backfill and compact the crater, then deployed fiberglass mats over the repaired area. Squadron leader Major Lin Zhi-xuan stated the standard is to complete crater filling within four hours, with drones currently used to assess runway damage. The wing concluded with an emergency takeoff drill at the south alert facility. Two single-seat Mirage 2000s, carrying two MICA missiles, two Magic missiles, and two underwing drop tanks, executed a six-minute alert posture. After the alarm sounded, pilots and ground crew rushed to the aircraft, and both fighters taxied out of the alert shelter in under five minutes to execute their takeoff mission. The Air Force stated that weapons loading requires specialized personnel to complete external weapon and drop tank loading within a designated time limit, categorized as either "complete" or "restore" combat readiness. Wing officers and standby pilots wore domestically produced T75K3 pistols, tactical vests, and helmets to simulate wartime conditions. Han Kuang 42 live-troop exercise entered its third day on August 7, 2026, with a scenario simulating a PLA missile attack on Taiwan. 國軍漢光42號實兵演習今天第3天,演習想定為共軍以飛彈襲台 The Air Force's 2nd Tactical Fighter Wing conducted Mirage 2000 air-to-air missile loading, runway repair, and emergency takeoff drills at Hsinchu base. 空軍在新竹基地執行幻象2000戰機空對空飛彈潛力裝掛、跑道搶修,以及戰機緊急起飛等演練 The maintenance unit loaded Magic II and MICA missiles onto a single-seat Mirage 2000 (aircraft number 2035) in a "restore" standard air defense configuration with two MICA, two Magic missiles, and two drop tanks. 為幻象2000單座機(機號2035)執行潛力裝掛,官兵接獲命令後,依序掛載魔法二型與雲母飛彈 The runway repair drill simulated a large crater from an enemy missile, with the facilities squadron using heavy equipment to backfill and compact the crater, then deploying fiberglass mats; the standard is to complete filling within four hours. 規範是以4小時內完成彈坑填補 Two single-seat Mirage 2000s executed a six-minute alert posture emergency takeoff, taxiing out of the alert shelter in under five minutes. 2架戰機在不到5分鐘內就滑出警戒機堡,執行起飛任務 The Air Force stated weapons loading requires specialized personnel to complete external weapon and drop tank loading within a designated time limit, categorized as "complete" or "restore" combat readiness. 潛力裝掛是指專業人員應於指定時限內,完成戰機各項武器外載、副油箱裝掛作業。另依戰備需求區分為「完成」及「恢復」戰備

a-20260807-1153-airbus-a320-b-lpn-observ.text: A320 B-LPN 觀測抵達桃園機場 公開 ADS-B 觀測資料顯示,註冊號 B-LPN 的 Airbus A320 於 2026 年 8 月 7 日確認抵達臺灣桃園國際機場(TPE),呼號 CRK261。 公開 ADS-B 觀測資料顯示,一架註冊號為 B-LPN 的 Airbus A320 航空器於 2026 年 8 月 7 日被觀測抵達臺灣桃園國際機場(TPE)。本站監測系統記錄到該航空器的首次有效觀測時間為 2026-08-07T09:37:44Z,確認抵達時間則為 2026-08-07T11:22:16Z。 觀測資料指出,該航空器的 ICAO hex 碼為 780a99,呼號為 CRK261,營運者 ICAO 代碼為 CRK,但營運者名稱欄位顯示為「未識別」。航空器 ICAO 機型代碼為 A320,機型顯示名稱為 Airbus A320。 抵達判定方面,系統將本次觀測標記為 confirmed_arrival,確認依據為「位於機場地理圍欄內且 alt_baro 為 ground」。本次觀測的主要資料來源為 Airplanes.live,第二資料來源為 ADSB.lol,交叉確認狀態為 secondary_unavailable。 機場資訊方面,觀測記錄顯示機場 ICAO 代碼為 RCTP,機場名稱為臺灣桃園國際機場。有效觀測筆數為 2 筆。 統計說明欄位指出,系統觀測歷史累積中,尚無可比較的長期統計。本站系統目前無法提供更長時間區間的比較數據,因此無法判斷此組合在歷史觀測中的出現頻率。 本次觀測的事件 ID 為 fw-b0b6dac6f0cfbc0f,資料類型為公開 ADS-B 觀測。由於營運者名稱為未識別,本報告僅依觀測資料記錄航空器型號與註冊號,不對營運者身分進行推測。 Airbus A320 B-LPN observed arriving at Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) Public ADS-B observation data shows an Airbus A320 registered as B-LPN, using callsign CRK261, confirmed arriving at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) on 7 August 2026. a-20260807-1501-taiwan-drill-integrates-.text: 漢光演習第3天 第一作戰區動員無人機與戰車演練 「漢光42號」演習於2026年8月7日進入第3天,第一作戰區於澎湖進行應援作戰演練。演習模擬敵特工襲擾海軍港口彈藥庫,軍方升空監偵型無人機提供即時影像,並結合M60A3戰車與海軍陸戰隊兵力實施圍捕封控,完成重要設施防衛任務。 台灣國軍「漢光42號」實兵演習於2026年8月7日進入第3天,第一作戰區於澎湖縣實施應援作戰演練。演習模擬敵方特工人員襲擾海軍軍區內的港口彈藥庫,國軍隨即啟動整合無人機與M60A3戰車等兵力進行防衛應處。 演練期間,監偵型無人機率先升空傳輸即時畫面,協助指揮官掌握敵情與規劃部署。M60A3戰車依據情資調整火力配置,封控彈藥庫周邊;海軍陸戰隊官兵則向目標搜捕並壓制模擬敵軍,完成軍事設施防護任務。 根據國軍先前公布資訊,「漢光42號」實兵演習自2026年8月5日展開,預計持續進行至8月14日。 Taiwan Drill Integrates Drones and M60A3 Tanks for Base Defense On August 7, 2026, during the third day of Taiwan's Han Kuang 42 live-troop exercise, the First Operational Zone conducted a support operation drill in Penghu County. The exercise simulated an enemy commando attack on a naval port ammunition depot, utilizing reconnaissance drones to stream real-time video imagery for command situational awareness. Integrated M60A3 tanks and Marine Corps personnel subsequently established crossfire positioning to encircle simulated hostile forces and protect key military infrastructure. On August 7, 2026, the third day of Taiwan's Han Kuang 42 live-troop exercise, the First Operational Zone conducted a support operation drill in Penghu County. The drill simulated enemy commando forces raiding a port ammunition depot inside a navy base, prompting defensive responses using reconnaissance unmanned aerial vehicles and M60A3 tanks. Reconnaissance UAVs launched first to transmit real-time video feeds to commanders for battlefield situational awareness and movement planning. M60A3 tanks adjusted positioning to establish crossfire around the depot, while Marine Corps personnel advanced to suppress simulated hostile forces and secure the facility. According to military information, the Han Kuang 42 live-troop exercise commenced on August 5, 2026, and is scheduled to continue through August 14. metadata.title: 陽光國家航空因機師轉至達美大幅減班航班

a-20260807-1659-sun-country-airlines-cut.text: 陽光國家航空因機師轉至達美大幅減班航班 陽光國家航空CEO承認,因眾多機師轉職達美,該公司大幅削減航班,導致九月明尼阿波利斯機場容量下降近四成。 陽光國家航空的CEO在公開場合承認,自今年八月起,有不少機師離職轉往達美航空。 此種人員流失促使公司主動減少航班排班,以避免無法保證班點的情況發生。 根據該航空公司內部數據,九月份從明尼阿波利斯國際機場(MSP)出發的座位容量較原計畫減少了近百分之四十。 航空公司表示,此舉是為了應對飛行員 shortage,同時維持現有航線的基本營運需求。 雖然航班削減將影響部分旅客行程,但航空公司強調將盡力安排改簽或退票。 Sun Country Airlines Cuts Flights as Pilots Move to Delta, CEO Says Sun Country Airlines has announced a significant reduction in its flight schedule after many of its pilots left to join Delta Air Lines, a move acknowledged by the airline’s CEO. The cuts have sharply lowered the carrier’s September capacity at Minneapolis–Saint Paul International Airport, which fell by almost 40 percent compared with previous plans. The airline says the staffing shortage forced the adjustments as it seeks to stabilize operations today. Sun Country Airlines’ CEO admitted in a recent interview that a notable number of pilots have resigned to join Delta Air Lines since August. The loss of flight crew prompted the airline to pre‐emptively trim its flight schedule to avoid operational disruptions. Internal data shows that the airline’s September seat capacity out of Minneapolis–Saint Paul International Airport (MSP) is nearly 40 percent lower than originally planned. The carrier states that the schedule adjustments are necessary to cope with the pilot shortage while preserving essential route coverage. Although the cuts will affect some travelers, Sun Country says it will work to re‐book or refund affected passengers where possible. Sun Country Airlines drastically cut flights because its pilots left for Delta, CEO admits. a-20260807-1756-finland-and-sweden-debut.text: 芬蘭瑞典首次參與澳洲PitchBlack演習印度Rafale首秀 芬蘭與瑞典首次派官方代表團參加澳洲Pitch Black 26演習,觀摩多國空軍作戰;印度空軍Rafale戰機亦首次參與該演習,測試遠距作戰能力並加強與夥伴國的合作。 芬蘭與瑞典於2026年8月6日發佈的AeroTime報導指出,兩國首次派遣官方代表團前往皇家澳洲空軍(RAAF)達爾文基地,觀摩Exercise Pitch Black 26。此次標誌著芬蘭與瑞典北歐國家首次參與澳洲旗艦多國空軍對抗演習。 代表團於7月20日至8月7日期間在北澳洲地區進行觀摩,重點在於了解澳洲如何在大規模多國環境中協調第四代與第五代戰鬥機,以及指揮與控制系統的整合。芬蘭空軍作戰中心上校Ville Uggeldahl表示,該團隊特別關注澳洲的指揮管制與快速噴射機平台整合經驗。 瑞典代表團則聚焦於快速噴射機在高強度演習中的維護與後勤支援。瑞典空軍飛機技師Master Sergeant Ronny Hagman指出,他們觀察了RAAF對F/A-18F Super Hornet機隊的維護流程,並認為此次演習提供了敏捷作戰部署與力量姿態的寶貴經驗。 同時,印度空軍的Rafale戰機在同一演習中首次亮相。根據AeroTime於8月7日的報導,Rafale在第26屆Pitch Black中參與高強度、低能見度訓練,測試其多用途戰鬥能力。 印度空軍第101中隊指揮官Group Captain Arun Kumar強調,此次部署彰显印度空軍進行遠距任務及在嚴苛多國環境中有效作戰的成長能力,並指出在演習中建立的夥伴關係對維護印太地區穩定具重要意義。 Finland and Sweden Debut at Pitch Black Exercise as Indian Rafale Makes Historic Appearance Finland and Sweden sent official delegations to Exercise Pitch Black 26 for the first time, marking their initial participation in Australia’s flagship multinational air combat exercise. The delegations visited RAAF Base Darwin to observe the training, which ran from July 20 to August 7, 2026. Meanwhile, the Indian Air Force’s Rafale fighter jet made its historic debut at the same exercise, taking part in high‐tempo, low‐visibility scenarios to test the aircraft’s capabilities alongside international partners and to strengthen defence cooperation in the Indo‐Pacific region. According to an AeroTime article published on August 6, 2026, Finland and Sweden dispatched official delegations to Exercise Pitch Black 26 for the first time, observing the exercise at RAAF Base Darwin. This marked the inaugural participation of the two Nordic nations in Australia’s premier multinational air combat exercise, which ran from July 20 to August 7 across northern Australia. The Finnish delegation, led by Lieutenant Colonel Ville Uggeldahl of the Finnish Air Warfare Centre, focused on fighter capability integration, specifically how Australia coordinates fourth- and fifth-generation fighter aircraft within a large-scale multinational setting and integrates command and control systems, fast jet platforms, and coalition partners. The Swedish delegation, represented by Master Sergeant Ronny Hagman, an aircraft technician with the Swedish Air Force, concentrated on observing how the RAAF maintains its fleet of F/A-18F Super Hornets under the operational tempo of a major exercise, gaining insight into agile combat deployment and force posture. In parallel, the Indian Air Force’s Rafale fighter jet made its debut appearance at Exercise Pitch Black 26, as reported by AeroTime on August 7, 2026. The Rafale participated in high-tempo, low-visibility training scenarios, providing a rare opportunity to test the aircraft’s capabilities alongside a wide range of international partners. Group Captain Arun Kumar, Commanding Officer of 101 Squadron and Exercise Director for the IAF at Pitch Black, noted that the deployment reflected the IAF’s growing ability to conduct long-range missions and operate effectively within a demanding multinational environment, and emphasized that the relationships built during the exercise are as valuable as the missions flown. metadata.title: Ampaire在猶他州展開混合電動飛行測試

a-20260807-2050-ampaire-begins-hybrid-el.text: Ampaire在猶他州展開混合電動飛行測試 Ampaire宣布參與美國運輸部與FAA的eIPP計畫,旗下EEL混合電動飛機已調渡至猶他州並完成uFLY計畫飛行。該公司另計畫以Eco Caravan進行後續測試,評估區域航線營運整備度。 Ampaire於2026年8月6日宣布,已開始參與美國運輸部與聯邦航空總署(FAA)的eVTOL整合試飛計畫(eIPP)。相關飛行測試在猶他州進行,屬於eIPP計畫下名為uFLY的特定倡議。 2026年8月3日,Ampaire將其EEL飛機從加州長灘調渡至猶他州鹽湖城,航程648英里(1,042公里),以單次電池充電耗時4小時18分鐘完成。三天後的8月6日,EEL再飛行1小時45分鐘,涵蓋鹽湖城至猶他州西南部錫達城之間240英里(386公里)的距離。隨後完成返回長灘基地的航程。 EEL為改裝版Cessna 337 Skymaster,配備混合電動動力系統。Ampaire試飛員Zack Kraus在新聞稿中表示,在猶他州山區地形與高密度高度條件下,額外的電力助推功率幫助飛機爬升通過傳統發動機配置下會受到更大限制的條件。 在uFLY計畫期間,Ampaire與州政府官員將評估在猶他州及鄰近各州引入混合電動區域航線所需的營運整備度與基礎設施需求。uFLY是FAA選定的八項計畫之一,旨在推動美國先進空中交通發展。 Ampaire計畫後續在猶他州以Eco Caravan飛機進行額外測試飛行。Eco Caravan採用改裝的Cessna Grand Caravan機身,配備AMP-H570混合電動推進系統,為EEL原型機的技術升級版本,預計成為Ampaire首款商業產品。 Ampaire Begins Hybrid-Electric Flight Tests in Utah Under eIPP Program Ampaire announced it has started participating in the US Department of Transportation and FAA's eIPP program, conducting flight tests in Utah under the uFLY initiative. The company ferried its EEL aircraft to Salt Lake City (SLC) and completed test flights, with plans for additional Eco Caravan tests ahead. On August 6, 2026, Ampaire announced that it had started its participation in the eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP) of the US Department of Transportation and Federal Aviation Administration. The flight tests are taking place in Utah under a specific initiative called uFLY, part of the eIPP program. On August 3, 2026, Ampaire ferried its EEL aircraft from Long Beach, California, to Salt Lake City, Utah, covering 648 miles (1,042 kilometers) in 4 hours 18 minutes using a single battery charge. Three days later, on August 6, the EEL flew a further 1 hour 45 minutes to cover the 240 miles (386 kilometers) between Salt Lake City and Cedar City (CDC) in southwestern Utah. The itinerary was completed with the return flight to Ampaire's base in Long Beach. The EEL is a modified Cessna 337 Skymaster retrofitted with a hybrid-electric powertrain. In a press release, Ampaire test pilot Zack Kraus said the additional electric boost power helped the aircraft climb through conditions that would have been much more limiting in a conventional-engine-only configuration over Utah's mountainous terrain and high-density-altitude conditions. During the program, Ampaire and state officials will assess the operational readiness and infrastructure needs required to introduce hybrid-electric regional air routes within Utah and across neighboring states. The uFLY program is one of eight projects selected by the FAA to advance the development of advanced air mobility in the United States. a-20260807-2246-american-airlines-offers.text: 美國航空推出無薪假方案 因空服員人力過剩 美國航空正向員工提供無薪休假方案,主要原因為該公司目前出現空服員人力過剩的情況。這項獲得工會支持的計劃將提供為期一個月的無薪假,讓參與員工在保留相關福利的同時,也能為資淺空服員釋出更多飛行執勤的機會。 根據 Simple Flying 報導,美國航空目前正在向旗下空服員提供自願性質的無薪休假方案。航空公司採取此項措施的主要原因,在於該公司現階段出現空服員人力過剩的情況。 這項特別方案獲得工會的正式支持,為選擇參與的員工提供為期一個月的無薪休假時間。在無薪假期間,參與員工將能夠繼續保留原有的各項權益與福利。 此外,這項無薪休假機制在保留參與員工福利的同時,也能夠為資淺空服員釋出更多的飛行執勤機會。 American Airlines Offers Unpaid Leaves of Absence Due to Excess Flight Attendants American Airlines is offering unpaid leaves of absence to cabin crew because the airline currently has too many flight attendants. While taking part in the program, crew members preserve their overall benefits, and the temporary leave program simultaneously serves to open up flight opportunities for junior flight attendants within the airline. a-20260808-0253-starlux-cancels-all-okin.text: 受颱風白海豚影響星宇航空8月8日往返沖繩航班全數取消 受颱風白海豚持續影響沖繩地區,星宇航空於2026年8月8日宣布,當天台灣往返沖繩的所有航班全數取消,包含原訂安排的加班機JX1870與JX1871。根據中央氣象署8日上午8時觀測,颱風白海豚中心位於台北東北東方約510公里處,航空公司提醒旅客搭機前關注最新航班資訊。 受颱風白海豚持續影響沖繩地區,星宇航空於2026年8月8日宣布,當天台灣往返沖繩的所有航班全數取消,其中包括原訂安排的加班機JX1870與JX1871。星宇航空先前曾規劃於8月8日及9日增開加班機以疏運旅客,但因天候影響決定調整航班作業。 根據中央氣象署於8日上午8時的觀測數據,颱風白海豚的中心位置位於台北東北東方約510公里處。星宇航空呼籲搭機旅客於出發前密切留意最新航班動態,並可透過星宇航空官方網站或客服中心查詢詳細資訊。 STARLUX Cancels All Okinawa Flights Aug 8 Due to Typhoon Dolphin STARLUX Airlines announced on August 8, 2026, that all flights between Taiwan and Okinawa scheduled for the day have been canceled due to the ongoing impact of Typhoon Dolphin. The cancellations include extra flights JX1870 and JX1871, which were previously scheduled to help transport affected passengers. According to Taiwan's Central Weather Administration, Typhoon Dolphin was positioned approximately 510 kilometers east-northeast of Taipei as of 8:00 a.m. on August 8. The airline has urged passengers to check the official website for updated flight information prior to departure. Registered as N329AE, the aircraft completed a five-hour flight from Bellingham International Airport (BLI) to Anchorage Ted Stevens International Airport. The freighter will be deployed on scheduled and chartered cargo operations throughout Western Alaska, supporting essential supply movement to more than 80 communities. a-20260808-0704-japan-airlines-and-malay.text: 日本航空與馬來西亞航空推動福岡吉隆坡共享航班 日本航空與馬來西亞航空深化合作,自2026年8月7日起為馬來西亞航空預計於9月2日開航的福岡至吉隆坡航線預售代碼共享機票。馬來西亞航空亦將在日航執飛的日本國內接駁航班掛牌。該營運計劃仍需取得政府許可。 日本航空與馬來西亞航空展開新階段合作,著眼於推進日本區域旅遊發展。雙方針對馬來西亞航空預計於2026年9月2日開航的福岡至吉隆坡航線實施代碼共享,日本航空自8月7日起已開始銷售該航線機票,航班號碼分別為JL7098與JL7099。 除了這條國際航線外,馬來西亞航空也將在其班號掛載於日本航空營運、往返福岡機場(FUK)的日本國內線航班,以利國際旅客接駁至日本各地區。此外,日本航空針對里程計畫會員推出雙倍里程活動,註冊時間為8月7日至10月31日,適用搭乘期間為9月2日至2027年3月31日。相關航線營運仍須視政府審查批准而定。 Japan Airlines and Malaysia Airlines Launch Fukuoka-Kuala Lumpur Codeshare Japan Airlines and Malaysia Airlines have expanded their partnership with a codeshare arrangement centered on Malaysia Airlines' new Fukuoka-Kuala Lumpur route, scheduled to launch on September 2, 2026. Sales for the codeshare flights opened on August 7, 2026, under JAL flight numbers JL7098 and JL7099. Furthermore, Malaysia Airlines will add its flight code to JAL-operated domestic flights connecting through Fukuoka Airport (FUK) to give incoming international passengers smoother access to regional Japan. All schedules and operations remain subject to government approval. Japan Airlines (JAL) has extended its partnership with Malaysia Airlines to support regional tourism in Japan. metadata.title: FAA啟用阿什維爾機場新管制塔臺 投入資金升級設施

a-20260808-0704-faa-opens-new-air-traffi.text: FAA啟用阿什維爾機場新管制塔臺 投入資金升級設施 美國聯邦航空管理局宣布啟用阿什維爾區域機場全新121英呎高的航空管制塔臺,取代1961年建造的舊設施。該計畫由《基礎設施投資與就業法案》資助3,170萬美元興建,並另撥款1,000萬美元擴建航廈,以因應當地顯著成長的航空交通需求。 美國聯邦航空管理局(FAA)於2026年8月7日宣布,位在北卡羅來納州的阿什維爾區域機場(Asheville Regional Airport(AVL), AVL)全新121英呎高的航空管制塔臺正式啟用。這座新設施取代了建造於1961年的舊有塔臺,旨在為航空管制員提供現代化的工作環境與技術支援,以應對北卡羅來納州西部日益增長的航空交通需求。 根據FAA公布的資料,過去十年間,阿什維爾區域機場的航空公司營運起降量成長超過百分之三百,使其成為北卡羅來納州第三繁忙的機場。FAA局長 Bryan Bedford 表示,管制員在2024年海倫颶風災後復原期間曾處理大幅增加的航空交通,新設施將有助於繼續提供安全且高效的航空管制服務。 這座新管制塔臺的興建資金由FAA透過《基礎設施投資與就業法案》(IIJA)提供,總計投入3,170萬美元。此外,FAA亦透過該法案撥款1,000萬美元用於擴建與現代化該機場的航廈設施,預計將登機門數量從原本的5個增加至12個。 在全新航空管制系統計畫下,阿什維爾管制塔臺預計於2028年底前完成多項關鍵設備升級,包括新型雷達系統、取代1990年代類比系統的現代語音交換機,以及能在各種天候條件下即時追蹤地面飛機與車輛的地面意識倡議(SAI)技術。同時,FAA近期也在阿什維爾安裝了塔臺模擬系統(TSS),以加速管制員的訓練流程。 FAA Opens New Air Traffic Control Tower at Asheville Regional Airport (AVL) The Federal Aviation Administration announced the opening of a new 121-foot air traffic control tower at Asheville Regional Airport in North Carolina, replacing a facility built in 1961. Constructed with $31.7 million in funding from the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act, the new tower supports significant air traffic growth at North Carolina's third-busiest airport. The FAA is also providing $10 million to expand the terminal gate capacity and plans additional technology upgrades through 2028. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) announced on August 7, 2026, the opening of a new 121-foot air traffic control tower at Asheville Regional Airport (AVL) in North Carolina. The newly constructed facility replaces an older control tower that was originally built in 1961, providing air traffic controllers with updated workspace and modern technology to handle increasing flight volumes across western North Carolina. Over the past decade, air carrier operations at Asheville Regional Airport have expanded by more than 300 percent, establishing AVL as the third-busiest airport in North Carolina. According to FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford, controllers previously managed a sharp increase in traffic during recovery efforts following Hurricane Helene in 2024. The new tower is intended to support continued air traffic growth and operational efficiency in the region. Construction of the new control tower was funded with $31.7 million provided by the FAA through the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act (IIJA). In addition to the tower project, the agency awarded $10 million in IIJA funding to expand and modernize the airport's passenger terminal, which will increase total gate capacity from five gates to 12. The FAA plans further technology upgrades at the Asheville facility by the end of 2028 under the Brand New Air Traffic Control System initiative. These planned upgrades include state-of-the-art radars, modern voice switches replacing 1990s analog systems, and the Surface Awareness Initiative (SAI) for real-time tracking of aircraft and surface vehicles. Additionally, the agency recently installed a Tower Simulation System (TSS) at Asheville to project airport-specific scenarios and accelerate controller training. a-20260808-0704-delta-air-lines-to-launc.text: 達美航空將於10月開辦亞特蘭大直飛沙烏地阿拉伯利雅德航線 達美航空將自2026年10月23日起開辦亞特蘭大至沙烏地阿拉伯首都利雅德的直飛航線。此為達美航空首條直飛沙烏地阿拉伯航線,亦是美籍航空公司首次營運連接美國與利雅德的直飛服務。該航線將以空中巴士 A350-900 執飛,於10月23日至30日期間每日營運,隨後調整為每週三班。 達美航空宣布將於2026年10月23日起,開啟美國亞特蘭大與沙烏地阿拉伯首都利雅德之間的直飛航線。這項新服務代表該航空公司首度建立前往沙烏地阿拉伯的直達連繫,亦是美國國籍航空公司營運的首條美國至利雅德直飛航線。 根據航班規劃,亞特蘭大至利雅德航線自2026年10月23日至10月30日期間將提供每日一班的營運服務,隨後班次調整為每週三班。該航線將使用空中巴士 A350-900 廣體客機執飛,客艙配置包含多個等級,並將於機上提供清真餐點選項。 達美航空總裁 Peter Carter 對此表示,開辦此項新服務反映了航空公司致力於將旅客連接至快速成長區域的努力。 Delta Air Lines to Launch Nonstop Flights Between Atlanta and Riyadh in October 2026 Delta Air Lines will launch nonstop service between Atlanta and Riyadh starting October 23, 2026. metadata.title: 美國FAA與猶他州完成油電混合動力飛機貨運測試飛行

a-20260808-0704-faa-and-utah-dot-conduct.text: 美國FAA與猶他州完成油電混合動力飛機貨運測試飛行 美國聯邦航空總署宣佈,Ampaire Inc.與猶他州運輸廳已沿猶他州15號州際公路走廊完成油電混合動力展示飛行,以測試未來的空中貨運服務。該趟飛行在鹽湖城國際機場(SLC)與西達城區域機場(CDC)之間進行,標誌著美國運輸部在FAA eVTOL整合先導計畫下,安全整合先進空中交通航空器的第二個重要步驟。 美國聯邦航空總署(FAA)宣佈,Ampaire Inc.與猶他州運輸廳(UDOT)合作,在猶他州15號州際公路走廊完成了一項油電混合動力展示飛行,旨在測試未來的空中貨運服務。該次飛行航線連接鹽湖城國際機場與西達城區域機場。 此次飛行是美國運輸部在FAA eVTOL整合先導計畫(eIPP)推動下的第二個重要步驟,目標是將先進空中交通(AAM)航空器安全地整合至國家空域系統中。該先導計畫源自川普總統頒布的「釋放無人機主導地位」行政命令,旨在為下一代航空器打造全美最大的真實環境測試平台之一。 FAA副署長克里斯·羅謝洛(Chris Rocheleau)表示,FAA很高興能在eIPP計畫下支持猶他州運輸廳與Ampaire Inc.。他強調,這項展示飛行將提供寶貴的營運經驗,並協助主管機關了解如何將先進空中交通安全地整合至國家空域系統。 猶他州運輸廳廳長卡洛斯·布拉塞拉斯(Carlos Braceras)指出,運輸廳的責任是為猶他州的交通系統做好未來準備。他表示,透過「uFLY」倡議,猶他州正凝聚產業、政府與研究夥伴的力量收集資料,以便FAA能安全地評估新興航空技術,提升區域連結性並改善社群移動能力。 根據美國運輸部的規劃,當局已於2026年3月選出橫跨26個州的8個專案參與eIPP計畫,猶他州運輸廳為其中之一。FAA將利用從這些展示飛行中獲得的經驗來識別缺口並改善操作程序,猶他州運輸廳及其他參試單位亦計劃在今年剩餘時間內進行更多的測試飛行。 FAA and Utah DOT Conduct Hybrid-Electric Demonstration Flight for Future Cargo The Federal Aviation Administration announced that Ampaire Inc. and the Utah Department of Transportation conducted a hybrid-electric demonstration flight along Utah’s I-15 corridor to test future cargo service. The flight took place between Salt Lake City International Airport (SLC) and Cedar City Regional Airport (CDC). This flight marks the second major step in the U.S. Department of Transportation’s efforts to safely integrate Advanced Air Mobility aircraft into the National Airspace System under the FAA eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP). The FAA plans to use data from the demonstration to evaluate emerging aviation technologies and improve airspace procedures. a-20260808-0945-typhoon-dolphin-prompts-.text: 颱風白海豚逼近 台北往返金門8日晚間多航班取消 受颱風白海豚影響,2026年8月8日晚間台北往返金門有多個航班取消或調整時間。立榮航空取消2個往返航班並有1班提早起飛;華信航空亦取消與調整部分航班。金門氣象站指出,颱風預計於8月9日與10日對金門產生較大影響。 受颱風白海豚影響,2026年8月8日晚間台北往返金門的多個航班宣告取消或調整起飛時間。航空公司已依據氣象動態更新官網航班資訊,提醒往返兩地的旅客注意交通異動。 依據立榮航空官網訊息,8日晚間共有2個台北往返金門航班取消,另有1個航班提前起飛。華信航空官網異動資訊則顯示,台北往返金門有1個航班取消、1架次金門往台北取消,以及1架次台北往金門航班提前起飛。 金門氣象站主任林依締表示,颱風白海豚預計於8月9日與10日對金門影響最大,預估最大陣風達7至8級、平均風力約5級。隨颱風逐漸進入內陸,相關警報解除後航班影響將隨之減小。 Typhoon Dolphin Prompts Taipei-Kinmen Flight Cancellations Multiple flights between Taipei and Kinmen were cancelled or rescheduled on the evening of August 8, 2026, due to the influence of Typhoon Dolphin. a-20260808-1040-japan-orders-evacuations.text: 海豚颱風逼近日本 下令疏散並取消500個航班 根據路透社報導,隨著海豚颱風逼近,日本當局已發布疏散命令,並已取消500個航班。為因應颱風帶來的威脅,相關部門與交通單位實施預防性應變措施,維護民眾與旅客安全。氣象與航空相關動態仍持續受到關注與評估。 隨著海豚颱風持續逼近日本,當地政府已發布疏散命令,並同步取消500個航班。此項防颱措施旨於因應惡劣天候威脅,維護民眾與旅客的安全。 路透社報導指出,海豚颱風的逼近促使當地政府與交通部門採取預防應變措施。大量航班的取消對區域空中運輸造成影響,相關單位已啟動預防性疏散計畫。 針對海豚颱風帶來的潛在影響,當局提醒相關區域民眾注意安全避難。同時航空業者與交通單位將持續監控氣象動態,並根據天候狀況評估營運與交通恢復情形。 Japan Orders Evacuations and Cancels 500 Flights as Typhoon Dolphin Approaches According to reports from Reuters, Japan has issued evacuation orders while preparing for the arrival of Typhoon Dolphin. In addition to the official evacuation directives, a total of 500 flights have been cancelled as the typhoon approaches. The severe weather disruption has impacted air travel operations across the affected regions, leading authorities and transportation providers to take precautionary measures. Further operational adjustments remain tied to the progression of Typhoon Dolphin as officials monitor the storm's impact on public safety and transport infrastructure. As Typhoon Dolphin approaches Japan, authorities have ordered evacuations and cancelled 500 flights to ensure public safety and manage severe weather risks. The administrative orders and widespread flight cancellations were initiated as the storm moved closer to the region. According to reports from Reuters, the cancellation of 500 flights reflects significant operational disruptions across air transportation services. Local emergency management agencies have advised residents in affected areas to follow evacuation instructions while preparations continue. Aviation operators and local transport authorities remain focused on monitoring weather conditions as Typhoon Dolphin progresses, with flight schedules subject to further adjustment based on safety developments. metadata.title: 美國航空使用電氣化永續航空燃料完成商業航班飛行

a-20260808-1040-american-airlines-operat.text: 美國航空使用電氣化永續航空燃料完成商業航班飛行 美國航空已使用電氣化永續航空燃料(eSAF),完成自科珀斯克里斯蒂國際機場(CRP)至達拉斯-沃斯堡國際機場(DFW)的航班飛行。該燃料由 Infinium 位於德州的 Pathfinder 設施生產與混合,為美國商業機場首度接收非生物基原料 SAF。美國航空並已就 Project Roadrunner 簽署商業採購協議。 美國航空已使用電氣化永續航空燃料(eSAF),完成自德克薩斯州科珀斯克里斯蒂國際機場飛往達拉斯-沃斯堡國際機場的商業客運航班。此項飛行展示了電力轉液體合成燃料能夠直接整合至現有機場燃料供應系統中,且無需進行特殊的處理或設備修改。 本次航班所使用的 eSAF 燃料,是由 Infinium 位於德州科珀斯克里斯蒂的 Pathfinder 設施進行生產與混合。該設施為全球首座商業規模的電力轉液體燃料生產基地。該燃料與傳統噴射燃料進行混合後,通過測試符合 ASTM International 之 JetA 規格標準,這也是美國商業機場首次接收由非生物基原料所製成的永續航空燃料。 美國航空執行長 Robert Isom 對此表示,該航班展現了次世代技術如何從早期投資走向實際應用,而擴大生產規模並降低價格對於減少排放及提升長期競爭力至關重要。Infinium 執行長 Robert Schuetzle 則指出,自 2023 年以來該公司已生產可用於商業卡車的電力柴油與電力石腦油,將 eSAF 納入產品線並為商業航班提供動力,是推動低碳燃料解決方案的重大進展。 此外,美國航空已與 Infinium 的 Project Roadrunner 簽署商業規模 eSAF 的採購協議。該設施目前正在興建中,預計將於明年開始生產與交付 eSAF,達到全產能後每年可生產超過 500 萬加侖。根據國際航空運輸協會(IATA)最新數據,目前全球營運中與興建中的 eSAF 產能僅約 0.02 百萬噸,全球亦僅有一處生產基地正在營運。 American Airlines Operates Commercial Flight Using Electro-Sustainable Aviation Fuel American Airlines has completed a commercial passenger flight from Corpus Christi International Airport (CRP) to Dallas Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) using electro-sustainable aviation fuel (eSAF). The fuel was produced and blended at Infinium's Pathfinder facility in Corpus Christi, Texas, representing the first delivery of non-biobased SAF to a commercial US airport. The eSAF was blended with conventional jet fuel and tested under ASTM International specification JetA standards. American Airlines has also established an offtake agreement for commercial eSAF volumes from Infinium's Project Roadrunner facility currently under construction. American Airlines has operated a commercial passenger flight from Corpus Christi International Airport (CRP) to Dallas Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) using electro-sustainable aviation fuel (eSAF). The flight demonstrated that power-to-liquid eSAF can be integrated directly into regular airport fuel supply infrastructure without requiring any special handling procedures. The eSAF utilized on the flight was part of a batch produced and blended at Infinium’s Pathfinder facility in Corpus Christi, Texas, the world’s first commercial-scale power-to-liquids eFuels production site. Blended with conventional jet fuel and tested to meet ASTM International specifications for JetA, the flight marked the first delivery of sustainable aviation fuel from non-biobased feedstocks to a commercial airport in the United States. eSAF offers lifecycle greenhouse gas emission reductions of over 90 percent compared to standard petroleum jet fuel. Chief Executive Officer Robert Isom stated that through the partnership with Infinium, American Airlines is demonstrating how next-generation technologies like eSAF can move from early investment to real-world application. Infinium Chief Executive Officer Robert Schuetzle noted that the company has produced drop-in eDiesel and eNaphtha at its Pathfinder facility since 2023, and adding eSAF to power a commercial passenger flight represents a meaningful step forward in low-carbon fuel solutions. American Airlines holds an offtake agreement for commercial volumes of eSAF from Infinium’s Project Roadrunner. Project Roadrunner is currently under construction and expected to begin eSAF production and deliveries next year, with an estimated full capacity exceeding 5 million gallons annually. Figures from the International Air Transport Association (IATA) indicate that global operating and under-construction eSAF capacity totals approximately 0.02 million tonnes, with only one operational production site. a-20260808-1135-typhoon-dolphin-disrupts.text: 颱風白海豚影響 華航調整8月10日上海航班 受颱風白海豚影響,中華航空宣布2026年8月10日松山往返上海虹橋CI201/CI202航班取消,桃園與高雄往返上海浦東航班延後並放大機型。此外,國籍航空亦針對沖繩航線採取放大機型與加開班機等疏運措施。 受颱風白海豚影響,中華航空於2026年8月9日宣布調整8月10日台灣往返上海航班。其中,CI201與CI202松山往返上海虹橋航班取消;CI501與CI502桃園往返上海浦東航班,以及CI583與CI584高雄往返上海浦東航班則予以延後,並調整放大機型執行。 為因應颱風對沖繩航線的影響,長榮航空於8月9日將桃園往返沖繩航班之機型放大為波音777-300ER,以利疏運旅客。星宇航空則於8月9日與10日安排沖繩加班機,包括台北往返沖繩之JX1870與JX1871航班,協助疏運受影響旅客。 歷史紀錄顯示,星宇航空先前於8月8日因颱風白海豚持續影響沖繩地區,曾取消當日台灣往返沖繩之全部航班,包含原訂之加班機JX1870與JX1871。 Typhoon White Dolphin Prompts China Airlines Shanghai Flight Adjustments Due to the impact of Typhoon White Dolphin, China Airlines announced adjustments for its flights between Taiwan and Shanghai on August 10, cancelling flights CI201 and CI202 between Taipei Songshan and Shanghai Hongqiao. Additionally, services CI501 and CI502 from Taoyuan to Shanghai Pudong, alongside CI583 and CI584 from Kaohsiung to Shanghai Pudong, will be delayed and operated with larger aircraft. Other Taiwanese carriers, including EVA Air and STARLUX Airlines, have also deployed upscaled aircraft and extra flights to accommodate passengers affected on Okinawa routes. China Airlines announced operational adjustments for its Taiwan to Shanghai flights on August 10 in response to Typhoon White Dolphin. Under the revised schedule, flights CI201 and CI202 between Taipei Songshan Airport and Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport are cancelled. Meanwhile, flights CI501 and CI502 operating between Taoyuan and Shanghai Pudong, as well as CI583 and CI584 between Kaohsiung and Shanghai Pudong, will experience departure delays and utilize upscaled aircraft capacity. To assist passenger transportation on Okinawa routes affected by the typhoon, EVA Air assigned larger Boeing 777-300ER aircraft for its Taoyuan-Okinawa flights on August 9. STARLUX Airlines also scheduled relief flights JX1870 and JX1871 between Taipei and Okinawa on August 9 and August 10 to clear passenger backlog. Historical records show STARLUX Airlines had previously cancelled all Taiwan-Okinawa flights on August 8, including scheduled relief flights JX1870 and JX1871. 中華航空於2026年8月9日宣布,8月10日CI201/CI202松山往返上海虹橋航班取消,CI501/CI502桃園往返上海浦東及CI583/CI584高雄往返上海浦東航班延後並放大機型。 明天CI201/CI202松山往返上海虹橋航班取消;CI501/CI502桃園往返上海浦東、CI583/CI584高雄往返上海浦東航班延後,且放大機型。 長榮航空於2026年8月9日將桃園往返沖繩航班機型放大為波音777-300ER以疏運旅客。 長榮航空明天桃園往返沖繩航班皆將放大機型為波音777-300ER,以利疏運旅客。 星宇航空於2026年8月9日與10日安排台北往返沖繩加班機JX1870與JX1871疏運旅客。 安排8月9日、10日沖繩加班機,協助旅客疏運,加班機時間為8月9日、10日的台北-沖繩 JX1870下午2時起飛、沖繩-台北 JX1871 下午5時50分起飛。 星宇航空先前於2026年8月8日因颱風白海豚持續影響沖繩地區,取消當日台灣往返沖繩全部航班(含原訂加班機JX1870/JX1871)。 受颱風白海豚(Dolphin)持續影響沖繩地區,星宇航空8月8日台灣往返沖繩航班全數取消(含原訂加班機JX1870/JX1871)。

metadata.title: 瑞士國際航空擬於2027年底前退役全數A220-100客機

a-20260808-1303-swiss-to-retire-remainin.text: 瑞士國際航空擬於2027年底前退役全數A220-100客機 瑞士國際航空宣布計劃在2027年底前退役旗下剩餘的空中巴士A220-100窄體客機,全面過渡至由A220-300組成的機隊。該航司過去共引進9架A220-100,目前已有5架退役,僅剩4架仍在營運。此舉亦受普惠發動機供應與維修資源調配影響。 瑞士國際航空(SWISS)宣布計劃在2027年底前退役旗下剩餘的空中巴士A220-100窄體客機機隊,結束約十年的營運,並將業務全面過渡至全A220-300機隊。在該航司最初取得的9架A220-100之中,目前已有5架退出服務,僅剩4架機體仍維持運作,預計將於2027年底前全部退役。 瑞士國際航空於2016年7月成為A220-100(當時稱為龐巴迪CSeries CS100)的全球首發客戶。該機型的引進代表了當時航司機隊更新戰略的重要一步,用以取代逐漸老化的Avro RJ100區域客機,該型機採用全新設計並由雙具普惠PW1500G齒輪傳動渦輪風扇發動機驅動。 在機隊組成方面,瑞士國際航空共引進了9架較小的A220-100以及21架較大的A220-300客機。在瑞士國際航空的客艙配置下,A220-300可容納約145名乘客,而較小的A220-100則僅有125個座位。在面對營運成本上升與運力限制的環境下,A220-300提供的額外座位展現出更強的商業效益。 此外,淘汰A220-100機隊的決定亦與普惠發動機的供應與維修瓶頸有關。面對維修延誤與零組件短缺導致的運營挑戰,瑞士國際航空選擇將有限的發動機、零組件與MRO維修資源優先集中於運量較大的A220-300機隊,最終決定全數退役A220-100機型。 SWISS to Retire Remaining Airbus A220-100 Fleet by End of 2027 SWISS has announced plans to retire its remaining Airbus A220-100 fleet by the end of 2027 as the airline transitions to an all-A220-300 narrowbody operation. Having served as the global launch customer for the aircraft type in July 2016, SWISS originally acquired nine A220-100s. Five of these airframes have already been removed from service, leaving four active aircraft. The decision is driven by fleet simplification goals, higher seat capacity on the A220-300 variant, and ongoing Pratt & Whitney engine availability and maintenance challenges. Swiss national flag carrier SWISS has announced official plans to withdraw its remaining Airbus A220-100 narrowbody airliner fleet from commercial service by the end of 2027 after a decade of operations. The carrier is transitioning its narrowbody fleet to an all-A220-300 operation. Out of the original nine A220-100 aircraft acquired by SWISS, the airline has already removed five airframes from active service, leaving four operational units set for retirement. SWISS originally became the global launch customer for the Airbus A220-100 in July 2016, when the aircraft platform was known as the Bombardier CSeries CS100. The arrival of the clean-sheet airliner represented a major milestone in the carrier's fleet renewal strategy, replacing its aging fleet of Avro RJ100 regional jets. The aircraft were equipped with advanced aerodynamics and powered by a pair of Pratt & Whitney PW1500G geared turbofan engines. Throughout its operational history, SWISS acquired a total of nine smaller A220-100s alongside a larger fleet of 21 A220-300 aircraft. In the SWISS cabin configuration, the larger A220-300 accommodates around 145 passengers, whereas the smaller A220-100 provides only 125 seats. Amid industry-wide pressures from rising operating costs and capacity constraints, the additional passenger seats offered by the -300 variant present a stronger commercial proposition while maintaining overall fleet efficiency. The decision to retire the A220-100 fleet also comes as SWISS manages the ongoing impact of Pratt & Whitney engine availability issues affecting geared turbofan platforms. Maintenance delays, spare-part shortages, and extended engine shop visits created persistent operational challenges. SWISS initially prioritized engine availability for its larger A220-300s by sacrificing smaller -100s, later concluding that its limited spare engines, components, and MRO resources are best focused on the larger variant. metadata.title: Wizz Air 2027會計年度首季客運成長仍錄約1.98億歐元淨虧損

a-20260808-1737-wizz-air-reports-approxi.text: Wizz Air 2027會計年度首季客運成長仍錄約1.98億歐元淨虧損 Wizz Air公布2027會計年度第一季淨虧損約1.98億歐元,座位運能年增25%,可用座位公里成長15%,主因票價下降、燃料成本上升及機隊持續受干擾。執行長Váradi表示燃料價格短期內難以回落,將維持機隊計畫並持續追求冬季成長機會。 Wizz Air公布2027會計年度第一季財報,快速擴張帶動強勁客運成長,但票價下降、燃料成本上升及機隊持續受干擾,使該航空公司錄得淨虧損。該超低成本航空公司在該季座位運能年增25%,可用座位公里上升15%,並將ASK成長放緩歸因於從較長的中東航線轉向歐洲境內較短航線。 該公司報告該期淨虧損約1.98億歐元。管理層表示需求維持強勁,儘管運能大幅增加,載客率仍維持持平。Freetrade分析師Alex Pugh指出,廉價航班需求仍在,客運成長強勁且飛機維持滿載,但Wizz Air「載運更多乘客但每座位收入減少」。 中東衝突在該季增加了燃料成本與營運干擾。Wizz Air執行長József Váradi表示,該公司不假設地緣政治條件或燃料價格會快速改善,並稱其基線預期為燃料價格維持高檔,因其他假設均屬推測性。 儘管面臨壓力,Wizz Air計畫營運其預定機隊計畫並持續追求冬季成長機會。Váradi指出該公司擁有23億歐元流動資金部位,相當於近40%的流動性覆蓋率,並稱此水準可能是歐洲甚至全球航空公司中最佳或至少名列前茅。 Wizz Air預期第二季可用座位公里將上升約20%,載客率大致持平,RASK略降。商務長Ian Malin表示需求維持韌性,8月已約79%至80%訂位,9月介於40%至50%之間,均領先去年同期。然而票價較上年同期下降中個位數至高個位數百分比。 Wizz Air持續將運能從較長的中東航線重新分配至較短的國內及歐洲境內航線。管理層預期平均航段長度將自下一會計年度起穩定於約1,500公里。此調整旨在透過讓飛機在較短航線上每日執飛更多班次來提升航段生產力。 Wizz Air reports approximately €198 million net loss for Q1 FY2027 despite strong passenger growth Wizz Air reported a net loss of approximately €198 million for the first quarter of its 2027 financial year, as lower fares, higher fuel costs and continued fleet disruption offset rapid expansion. a-20260808-1849-porter-airlines-cancels-.text: 波特航空班機因幼童站立返門 延誤超過宵禁遭取消 根據 Simple Flying 報導,波特航空(Porter Airlines)一班深夜航班因機組人員無法成功安頓一名在座位上站立的幼童,導致飛機被迫返回登機門。該班航班隨後因作業延誤時間超過機場宵禁規定而宣告取消,造成機上所有人員被迫滯留過夜。 根據 Simple Flying 報導,波特航空(Porter Airlines)一班深夜營運的航班於地面階段發生客艙處置狀況。事發時機組人員無法順利安頓並固定一名在座椅上站立的幼童,基於客艙安全無法完成起飛前準備,該班飛機隨後決定返回登機門。 飛機返回登機門處理該起事件時,造成航班起飛時間嚴重遞延。由於該航班過後延誤時間過長,已不幸超越了該機場規定的夜間宵禁限制,使得該班機無法在宵禁時間內順利離站起飛。 在評估相關宵禁限制後,航空公司最終決定將該趟航班予以取消。該起取消事件導致機上全數乘客無法按原定計畫出行,所有乘客被迫滯留在機場過夜。 Porter Airlines Cancels Flight After Toddler Stands in Seat and Delays It Past Curfew According to a report from Simple Flying, a late-night Porter Airlines flight was forced to return to the airport gate before departure after the cabin crew was unable to properly secure a young toddler standing on a seat. As a direct result of the delay caused by the seat incident, the departure missed its scheduled window and pushed past the local airport's overnight curfew rules, forcing the airline to cancel the flight and leaving all onboard passengers stranded overnight. According to a report from Simple Flying, a late-night Porter Airlines flight returned to the airport gate before departure. The return occurred after cabin crew members were unable to secure a standing toddler in their seat during pre-flight preparations. The operational delay associated with resolving the cabin issue pushed the flight past the airport's enforced overnight curfew threshold. Consequently, the aircraft was prevented from taking off within the allowable operational timeframe. Due to the curfew restriction, Porter Airlines ultimately canceled the flight entirely. metadata.title: 北羅格曼與波音完成MQ-4C Triton與P-8A Poseidon首次自動人機協同示範

a-20260808-1936-northrop-grumman-and-boe.text: 北羅格曼與波音完成MQ-4C Triton與P-8A Poseidon首次自動人機協同示範 北羅格曼與波音完成MQ-4C、P-8A首次自動人機協同示範 北羅格曼與波音於2026年8月6日發布的 Aerospace Global News 報導指出,兩公司已完成他們所描述的「第一次自動人機協同示範」,涉及MQ-4C Triton海上監視無人機與P-8A Poseidon海上巡邏機。 該示範在實驗室環境中進行,利用人工智慧與開放式系統介面,使兩機系統能夠共享情報、規劃任務並協同執行海上監視與反水面作戰任務。 一名P-8A操作員下達指示,讓模擬的Triton飛往預定區域;Triton接著自行規劃航線、啟動其傳感器、在機上處理所得資訊,並將結果回傳至P-8A。 資料傳輸部分透過衛星中繼進行,以模擬真實作戰通訊;任務管理系統透過Open Mission Systems與Universal Command and Control Interface交換指示,而非依賴專屬點對點連線。 北羅格曼與波音表示,此 jointly funded 技術示範的目的在於展示「兩系統在開放系統架構下協同自動化任務控制」的能力,並相信此舉可降低操作員工作量、加速決策並讓新平台更易、更低成本地接入。 兩家公司進一步指出,透過標準化介面,Triton與Poseidon能夠實現機對機的任務規劃與執行,此種共通標準旨在讓美軍及其 allied 平台未來無需為每種機型組合重新開發點對點整合方案。 報導同時提及,Triton為美國海軍計畫採購68架(截至2026年中已交付約43架),而澳洲皇家空軍則為Triton的唯一出口用戶,並同時擁有P-8A機隊。 Northrop Grumman and Boeing Complete First Automated MQ-4C Triton–P-8A Poseidon Manned-Unmanned Teaming Demonstration Northrop Grumman and Boeing complete first automated MQ-4C and P-8A teaming demonstration According to Aerospace Global News dated August 6, 2026, Northrop Grumman and Boeing have completed what they describe as the first automated manned-unmanned teaming demonstration between an MQ-4C Triton maritime surveillance drone and a P-8A Poseidon maritime patrol aircraft. The demonstration took place in a laboratory setting, employing artificial intelligence and open-system interfaces to enable the two aircraft systems to share intelligence, plan missions, and coordinate maritime surveillance and anti-surface warfare tasks. A P-8A operator instructed a simulated Triton to fly to a designated area; the Triton then autonomously planned its transit, activated its sensors, processed the gathered information onboard, and transmitted the findings back to the Poseidon. Data exchange was partially routed through a satellite relay to simulate realistic operational communications, with the mission-management systems communicating via Open Mission Systems and the Universal Command and Control Interface rather than relying on a bespoke point-to-point link. Northrop Grumman and Boeing characterized the effort as a jointly funded technology demonstration intended to show the "ability for the two systems to collaborate and automate mission control over open systems architecture," noting that such interoperability could reduce operator workload, speed decision-making, and simplify future platform integration. The companies added that the standardized interface used enables machine-to-machine mission planning and execution across platforms, a capability they hope will allow U.S. and allied forces to connect various aircraft without needing new point-to-point integrations for each combination. The report also notes that the U.S. Navy plans to acquire 68 MQ-4C Tritons, with around 43 delivered by mid‐2026, while the Royal Australian Air Force operates both the Triton and the P‐8A Poseidon, having received its final P‐8A in May 2026. a-20260808-1936-women-in-aviation-intern.text: 國際女飛行員協會推動全球擴展計畫 Women in Aviation International 執行長 Lynda Coffman 於今年法恩堡羅國際航空展中表示,該組織正擴大國際佈局,在歐洲、亞洲及非洲等地設立新分會,並依各地經濟指數調降會費,以降低加入門檻,吸引更多女性投入航空業。 Women in Aviation International(WAI)執行長 Lynda Coffman 在今年法恩堡羅國際航空展受訪時表示,這個成立三十六年的非營利組織正加強全球擴展計畫,目標是建立更堅實的國際網絡、消除會費障礙,並鼓勵更多女性投入這個傳統上以男性為主的產業。 Coffman 本人在聯合航空擁有三十年職涯,最終擔任該航空公司總裁,並為 United Ground Express 創辦總裁。她指出,WAI 目前約有兩萬名會員,但多數位於美國,因此組織現正聚焦提升國際能見度,涵蓋歐洲、亞洲、非洲等地區。 在分會網絡方面,WAI 在美國已有超過一百個分會,現正於歐洲(包括英國)、亞洲及非洲設立更多分會。近期新增的分會涵蓋泰國、新加坡、東歐及若干非洲國家。Coffman 表示,英國分會的籌建工作尤其受到重視。 為支援國際擴展,WAI 重新調整會費結構。Coffman 說明年費為五十九美元,但組織依各地經濟指數調降費用,部分地區降幅達三分之二。她指出,會費減少所造成的資金缺口已由董事會成員透過捐款全額補足。 WAI 的全球導師計畫利用人工智慧,依據經驗、職涯目標、所在地及專業挑戰配對導師與學員。Coffman 以去年「年度導師」得主為例,該名位於杜拜的導師成功指導一名美國會員,展現計畫跨越國界的運作模式。 Coffman 補充,儘管組織名稱強調女性,約百分之二十的會員為男性,董事會中亦有兩名男性成員。她強調組織不歧視,歡迎男性盟友參與。 Women in Aviation International Steps Up Global Expansion Plans Women in Aviation International CEO Lynda Coffman said at this year's Farnborough International Airshow that the non-profit is expanding its international profile by establishing new chapters across Europe, Asia and Africa, and restructuring membership fees based on regional economic indices to lower barriers to joining. Women in Aviation International (WAI) CEO Lynda Coffman said during this year's Farnborough International Airshow that the 36-year-old non-profit organisation is stepping up its global expansion plans to build a stronger international network, remove financial barriers to membership and inspire more women to pursue careers in a traditionally male-dominated sector. Coffman, who has a 30-year career history at United Airlines culminating in her role as president of the airline and founding president of United Ground Express, said WAI currently has around 20,000 members, the majority based in the US. The organisation is now focused on raising its international profile across Europe, Asia, Africa and beyond. WAI has more than 100 chapters in the US and is working to establish more chapters across Europe, including the UK, as well as in Asia and Africa. Recent additions include new chapters in Thailand, Singapore, Eastern Europe and several African countries. Coffman said there is significant energy around building UK chapters. To support international expansion, WAI has restructured its fees. Coffman said annual membership costs US$59, but the organisation looked at areas of the world and their economic index to lower fees where needed, resulting in a two-thirds decrease in dues in some areas. The financial shortfall has been covered entirely through donations from WAI's board of directors. WAI's global mentoring programme uses artificial intelligence to match mentors and mentees based on their experience, career goals, location and professional challenges. Coffman cited last year's Mentor of the Year recipient, based in Dubai, who successfully mentored a member in the US as an example of the programme's international reach. Coffman noted that despite the name, around 20% of WAI's members are men, and two board members are male. She said the organisation does not discriminate and welcomes male allies.
