metadata.title: 國家航空波音777貨機完成蘇格蘭直飛澳洲紀錄航程

a-20260813-1140-national-airlines-operat.text: 國家航空波音777貨機完成蘇格蘭直飛澳洲紀錄航程 國家航空波音777貨機直飛墨爾本;耗時19小時23分;運送緊急航材零件 美國國家航空(National Airlines)旗下的一架波音(Boeing)777貨機完成了一項跨洲直飛任務。該架註冊號為N792CA的貨機自蘇格蘭格拉斯哥普雷斯威克機場(Glasgow Prestwick Airport(PIK))起飛,不經停直飛至澳洲墨爾本,航程達9,849海里(約18,240公里),總飛行時間為19小時23分鐘。國家航空表示,這是該機型有史以來營運過最長的商業貨運航班。 本次包機任務的主要目的,是為另一家在墨爾本面臨飛機地面故障(AOG)的航空公司運送緊急航空零件。由於該批零件具有極高時效性,縮短運送時間成為首要考量,其重要性高於載貨重量。國家航空在接獲客戶初始詢問後,於30小時內便完成了整個包機計畫的籌劃、協調與起飛執飛作業。 國家航空主席克里斯·阿爾夫(Chris Alf)表示,這項任務充分展現了國家航空的創立宗旨,即以速度、精準度與可靠性將關鍵貨物運送至全球任何地點。他指出,完成這項航班不僅是一項傑出的營運成就,也展現了全球團隊的專業能力與協作精神。 執飛本次紀錄航班的N792CA貨機,是國家航空最新引進的波音777貨機之一,於2026年4月正式加入機隊。該公司在2024年法恩堡國際航空展上訂購了四架全新波音777貨機,作為機隊現代化計畫的一環。目前國家航空營運三架波音777貨機,另有一架訂單,同時亦營運九架波音747-400貨機、一架空中巴士(Airbus)A330-300與兩架A330-200客機。 National Airlines Operates Record 19-Hour Nonstop Boeing 777F Cargo Flight to Australia National Airlines flies Boeing 777F nonstop from Scotland to Melbourne; delivers urgent aircraft components in 19 hours. A National Airlines Boeing 777 Freighter has completed what the carrier states is the longest commercial cargo flight ever operated by the aircraft type, flying nonstop from Scotland to Australia. The record-setting flight, operated by one of National Airlines' newest Boeing 777 Freighters with registration N792CA, covered a total distance of 9,849 nautical miles (18,240 kilometers) from Glasgow Prestwick Airport (PIK) to Melbourne in an elapsed time of 19 hours and 23 minutes. The urgent charter mission was arranged to transport critical Aircraft on Ground (AOG) components required by another airline in Melbourne. Due to the urgent nature of the shipment, reducing transit time was deemed more important than carrying a large payload weight. National Airlines successfully planned, coordinated, and launched the entire charter flight within just 30 hours of receiving the initial customer enquiry. National Airlines chairman Chris Alf stated that the mission exemplifies the carrier's core purpose of delivering mission-critical cargo anywhere in the world with speed, precision, and reliability. He added that completing the historic flight represents a significant operational achievement and reflects the dedication and expertise of the airline's global teams. The Boeing 777F aircraft used for the flight, registered N792CA, is a recent addition to the fleet, having entered service with National Airlines in April 2026. The carrier originally ordered four new 777 Freighters from Boeing during the 2024 Farnborough International Airshow as part of its fleet modernization strategy. National Airlines currently operates three 777 Freighters with one more on order, alongside nine Boeing 747-400 freighters, one Airbus A330-300, and two A330-200 passenger aircraft. metadata.title: 波音任命高爾航空前執行長費雷爾為拉丁美洲總裁

a-20260813-1252-boeing-names-former-gol-.text: 波音任命高爾航空前執行長費雷爾為拉丁美洲總裁 波音任命高爾航空前執行長費雷爾出任拉丁美洲總裁;9月4日生效 波音公司宣布任命塞爾索·費雷爾(Celso Ferrer)出任波音拉丁美洲與加勒比海地區總裁,該項人事任命將於2026年9月4日正式生效。費雷爾履新後,將負責強化波音在該區域的營運、策略與業務據點,並支持拉丁美洲及加勒比海地區的成長機會。 在加入波音之前,費雷爾曾擔任高爾航空(GOL Linhas Aéreas)執行長達四年時間。他過去亦曾在高爾航空擔任營運長及規劃副總裁等高階管理職務。此外,費雷爾是一名現役合格的民航飛行員,曾為高爾航空的波音737機隊執行飛行任務。 學歷方面,費雷爾擁有聖保羅大學(USP)經濟學學位、聖保羅天主教大學(PUC-SP)國際關係學位,以及位於法國的歐洲工商管理學院(INSEAD)高階管理碩士學位。 Boeing Names Former GOL Chief Celso Ferrer President for Latin America Boeing appoints former GOL chief Celso Ferrer as Latin America president, effective September 4. Boeing has appointed Celso Ferrer as president of Boeing Latin America and the Caribbean, effective September 4, 2026. In this role, he will be responsible for strengthening the company's operations, strategy, and regional presence, as well as supporting growth opportunities throughout Latin America and the Caribbean. Prior to joining Boeing, Ferrer served for four years as Chief Executive Officer of GOL Linhas Aéreas. He previously held leadership roles at the airline as Chief Operating Officer and Vice President of Planning. Ferrer is also an experienced, currently certified airline pilot who flew as part of GOL's flight crew on the Boeing 737 fleet. Ferrer holds a degree in Economics from the University of São Paulo (USP), a degree in International Relations from PUC-SP, and an Executive MBA from INSEAD in France. a-20260813-1417-noemi-aerospace-signs-se.text: NOEMI Aerospace與印度及菲律賓業者簽署水上飛機協議 NOEMI Aerospace於2026年8月簽署兩項協議;旨在探索亞洲電動兩棲機營運 挪威飛機製造商 NOEMI Aerospace 於 2026 年 8 月簽署了兩項獨立協議,以探索在印度與菲律賓的電動兩棲機營運。 NOEMI 於 2026 年 8 月 10 日與印度直升機營運商 Pawan Hans 簽署備忘錄(MoU),旨在探索於印度進行區域空中運輸的電動水上飛機方案。 該合作案將重點評估印度市場的營運概念、基礎設施需求及商業機會。 2026 年 8 月 12 日,NOEMI 宣布與菲律賓水上飛機營運商 Horizon Sun Charters (HSC) 簽署另一項備忘錄,後者有意採購三架 NOEMI 飛機,並保有兩架的選擇權。 NOEMI Aerospace signs seaplane deals with India and Philippine operators NOEMI Aerospace signs agreements in August 2026; exploring electric amphibious aircraft operations Norwegian aircraft manufacturer NOEMI Aerospace is expanding its footprint in Asia through two separate agreements signed in August 2026 to explore electric amphibious aircraft operations. metadata.title: 漢光42號演習 海軍玉山軍艦與海巡首度實兵護航物資進港

a-20260813-1558-han-kuang-42-drill-navy-.text: 漢光42號演習 海軍玉山軍艦與海巡首度實兵護航物資進港 海軍玉山軍艦偕海巡艦艇首度實兵護航物資商船進花蓮港、蘇澳港 國軍漢光42號實兵演習5日至14日實施,進入「縱深防禦與持久作戰」階段。軍聞社報導,第二作戰區與海巡署於花蓮港演練要港防衛、聯合反封鎖護航及戰略物資接轉,首度由海軍玉山軍艦偕同海巡署2艦、2艇護航物資商船進入花蓮港、蘇澳港。 軍聞社報導,第二作戰區昨天由海軍、海巡署共同執行「聯合反封鎖護航」課目護送重要物資商船進港;今天模擬敵潛伏部隊企圖阻止物資接轉作業,守備部隊迅速進行要港防衛,以鞏固港區安全及確保物資接轉順利進行。 確認港區安全無虞後,官兵於花蓮港實施「戰略物資接轉」演練,模擬戰時境外物資運抵花蓮港後,結合港埠裝卸及徵用民用拖板車運輸,完成物資接收、裝載及接轉,驗證民間資源整合及後勤支援能力。 海巡署透過新聞稿表示,海巡署昨天執行漢光演習最核心的「聯合反封鎖護航」任務,海巡「台中艦」、「八里艦」2艦及2艘100噸級巡防艇,於台灣東部演訓海域,偕同海軍軍艦成功護航運送重要物資的商貨船(由玉山軍艦模擬商貨船),將重要物資順利護入花蓮港。 海巡署強調,本案是海巡首度協同海軍以實兵演練方式,執行海上「聯合反封鎖護航」任務,海巡在演練過程中,精準掌握海上即時資訊,展現台灣維護台海及區域和平穩定的決心。 第二作戰區指出,透過漢光實兵演習,實際驗證戰略物資接收及裝卸等作業流程,並整合軍民運輸資源,強化跨軍種協調及後勤支援效能,確保戰時物資能依任務需求迅速輸送至指定地區,維持部隊持續作戰量能及強化跨區增援韌性。 Han Kuang 42 Drill: Navy Vessel Yushan and Coast Guard Conduct First Joint Escort of Supply Ships into Hualien and Suao Ports Navy Yushan and Coast Guard vessels first joint live-force escort of cargo ships into Hualien and Suao ports The military's Han Kuang 42 live-fire exercise, running from August 5 to 14, has entered the "deep defense and sustained operations" phase. According to Military News Agency reports, the Second Operational Zone and the Coast Guard Administration conducted drills at Hualien Port covering key port defense, joint anti-blockade escort, and strategic materiel transfer, with the Navy vessel Yushan for the first time escorting cargo ships into Hualien and Suao ports alongside two Coast Guard vessels and two patrol boats. The Military News Agency reported that yesterday the Second Operational Zone had the Navy and Coast Guard jointly execute the "joint anti-blockade escort" course, escorting cargo ships carrying critical supplies into port. Today, troops simulated enemy infiltrators attempting to disrupt materiel transfer, with defense forces rapidly conducting key port defense to secure the port area and ensure smooth transfer operations. After confirming port security, personnel conducted a "strategic materiel transfer" drill at Hualien Port, simulating wartime delivery of overseas supplies, combining port loading and unloading with requisitioned civilian flatbed trailers to complete materiel receipt, loading, and transfer, validating civilian resource integration and logistics support capabilities. The Coast Guard Administration stated in a press release that it executed the core "joint anti-blockade escort" mission yesterday, with Coast Guard vessels Taichung and Bali, two 100-ton patrol boats, and Navy vessels successfully escorting a cargo ship carrying critical supplies (simulated by the Yushan) into Hualien Port in eastern Taiwan training waters. The Coast Guard Administration emphasized that this was the first time it collaborated with the Navy in a live-force drill to execute the maritime "joint anti-blockade escort" mission, demonstrating Taiwan's resolve to maintain peace and stability in the Taiwan Strait and the region. The Second Operational Zone noted that the Han Kuang exercise validated strategic materiel receipt and unloading procedures, integrated military-civilian transport resources, and strengthened cross-service coordination and logistics support effectiveness to ensure wartime supplies can be rapidly delivered to designated areas, sustaining operational capability and reinforcing cross-area support resilience. 國軍漢光42號實兵演習5日至14日實施,進入「縱深防禦與持久作戰」階段。 國軍漢光42號實兵演習5日至14日一連10天9夜實施,目前已進入「縱深防禦與持久作戰」階段 第二作戰區與海巡署於花蓮港演練要港防衛、聯合反封鎖護航及戰略物資接轉,首度由海軍玉山軍艦偕同海巡署2艦、2艇護航物資商船進入花蓮港、蘇澳港。 第二作戰區與海巡署昨天、今天於花蓮港演練要港防衛、聯合反封鎖護航及戰略物資接轉,首度由海軍玉山軍艦偕同海巡署2艦、2艇護航物資商船進入花蓮港、蘇澳港 第二作戰區昨天由海軍、海巡署共同執行「聯合反封鎖護航」課目護送重要物資商船進港;今天模擬敵潛伏部隊企圖阻止物資接轉作業,守備部隊迅速進行要港防衛。 第二作戰區昨天由海軍、海巡署共同執行「聯合反封鎖護航」課目護送重要物資商船進港;並於今天模擬敵潛伏部隊企圖阻止物資接轉作業,守備部隊迅速進行要港防衛 官兵於花蓮港實施「戰略物資接轉」演練,模擬戰時境外物資運抵花蓮港後,結合港埠裝卸及徵用民用拖板車運輸,完成物資接收、裝載及接轉。 官兵於花蓮港實施「戰略物資接轉」演練,模擬戰時境外物資運抵花蓮港後,結合港埠裝卸及徵用民用拖板車運輸,完成物資接收、裝載及接轉 海巡署表示,海巡「台中艦」、「八里艦」2艦及2艘100噸級巡防艇,偕同海軍軍艦成功護航運送重要物資的商貨船(由玉山軍艦模擬商貨船),將重要物資順利護入花蓮港。 海巡「台中艦」、「八里艦」2艦及2艘100噸級巡防艇,昨天於台灣東部演訓海域,偕同海軍軍艦成功護航運送重要物資的商貨船(由玉山軍艦模擬商貨船),將重要物資順利護入花蓮港 海巡署強調,本案是海巡首度協同海軍以實兵演練方式,執行海上「聯合反封鎖護航」任務。 本案是海巡首度協同海軍以實兵演練方式,執行海上「聯合反封鎖護航」任務

a-20260813-1952-eva-air-to-launch-direct.text: 長榮航空12月1日起開闢桃園直飛德里航線每週5班 長榮航空12月1日開航桃園至德里;每週5班並採用A330-300執飛。 長榮航空將於12月1日起開闢桃園直飛印度德里航線,每週二、三、五、六、日提供5個往返班次,並採用空中巴士A330-300機型執飛。長榮航空成為目前唯一直飛印度的台灣航空公司,該航線自2020年COVID-19疫情期間中斷至今。 駐印度代表陳牧民於8月13日接見長榮航空派駐德里的機場經理劉景嘉,瞭解直飛航線的準備進度。陳牧民表示,桃園直飛德里航線開通後能將航程時間縮短為6個小時,便利兩地商務、觀光及人員往來交流。 EVA Air to Launch Direct Taoyuan-Delhi Flights on December 1 EVA Air will open direct Taoyuan-Delhi flights on December 1 with five weekly flights using A330-300s. EVA Air will launch direct flights between Taoyuan and Delhi, India, starting December 1, operating five weekly flights on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays using Airbus A330-300 aircraft. The carrier will become the only Taiwan-based airline currently offering direct service to India, which had been suspended since 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic. Taiwan representative to India Chen Mu-min met with EVA Air Delhi airport manager Liu Jing-jia on August 13 to review preparation progress for the new route. According to Chen, the direct route will reduce travel time between Taoyuan and Delhi to six hours, facilitating bilateral business, tourism, and official exchanges. 長榮航空宣佈自12月1日起開闢桃園直飛印度德里航線,每週提供5個往返班次,並採用空中巴士A330-300機型執飛。 長榮航空的桃園-印度德里航線自12月1日起,每週2、3、5、6、日將提供往返台灣桃園與印度德里的直飛服務,屆時將採用空中巴士A330-300機型執飛。 長榮航空為目前唯一直飛印度的台灣航空公司。 將於12月1日開闢桃園-印度德里直飛航線,成為目前唯一直飛印度的台灣航空公司。 駐印度代表陳牧民於8月13日接見長榮航空德里機場經理劉景嘉,瞭解桃園-德里航線準備情況。 陳牧民今天接見長榮航空派駐在印度德里的機場經理劉景嘉,瞭解長榮航空桃園-印度德里航線目前的準備情況 台灣與印度之間的直航班機自2020年COVID-19疫情期間中斷。 台灣與印度之間的直航,是2020年COVID-19(2019冠狀病毒疾病)疫情期間停掉的 桃園直飛德里航線可將航程時間縮短為6個小時。 直航能把航程(時間)縮短為6個小時,會有更多人願意過來印度

metadata.title: 達美航空預計於2027年開航奧斯汀直飛巴黎航線

a-20260813-1952-delta-air-lines-plans-no.text: 達美航空預計於2027年開航奧斯汀直飛巴黎航線 達美航空規劃2027年開航奧斯汀直飛巴黎航線;便利德州中部旅客連接全球。 達美航空(Delta Air Lines)宣布規劃於2027年正式開航連結美國奧斯汀與法國巴黎的直飛航線服務。該航空公司確認,此項全新直飛航班營運計畫預計於2027年起開始實施。 達美航空表示,這條全新的奧斯汀至巴黎直飛航線,將能讓德州中部的旅客比以往更加輕鬆且便利地前往世界各地的目的地。 據 Simple Flying 報導,達美航空預估這項規劃於2027年啟動的航線,將有助於強化奧斯汀地區旅客與全球網絡之間的飛航連接。 Delta Air Lines Plans Nonstop Austin to Paris Flights Launching in 2027 Delta Air Lines will link Austin and Paris with nonstop flights launching in 2027. Delta Air Lines has confirmed plans to link Austin and Paris with nonstop flights launching in 2027. The airline announced the new service to expand direct flight options between the two cities. The carrier stated that the route between Austin and Paris will make it easier than ever for passengers originating from Central Texas to connect to various destinations around the world. As reported by Simple Flying, Delta Air Lines expects to launch the new route in 2027, establishing nonstop air service connecting Central Texas with Paris. The legacy carrier noted that the 2027 launch will enhance global access for travelers flying out of Central Texas. Delta Air Lines plans to link Austin and Paris with nonstop flights launching in 2027. Delta Air Lines To Link Austin & Paris With Nonstop Flights Launching In 2027 Delta Air Lines stated the route will make it easier for passengers from Central Texas to reach destinations around the world. make it “easier than ever” for passengers to reach destinations around the world from Central Texas.

metadata.title: 美國航空首架改裝波音777-300ER客機返美

a-20260813-2031-american-airlines-ferrie.text: 美國航空首架改裝波音777-300ER客機返美 美國航空首架波音777客機在香港完成八個月改裝後飛返DFW機場(DFW) 美國航空已成功完成其首架客艙改裝波音777-300ER客機的飛渡航班,將該架飛機送回達拉斯-沃斯堡國際機場(DFW)。這架民用寬體客機先前被安置於香港,並在當地進行了為期長達8個月的客艙翻新與改裝工程。 在香港順利完成這項為期8個月的翻修與改裝工程後,這架機齡達13年的客機重新返回美國航空機隊。這架完成改裝的客機為旅客配備了多項升級後的客艙設施,其中包括尺寸更大的個人娛樂系統螢幕、藍牙音訊配對功能,以及提高乘客個人隱私的隱私門。 American Airlines Ferries First Retrofitted Boeing 777-300ER Back to DFW (DFW) American Airlines has returned its first retrofitted Boeing 777-300ER to DFW after a Hong Kong overhaul. American Airlines has completed the ferry flight of its first retrofitted Boeing 777-300ER passenger aircraft, returning the jet back to Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport . The commercial aircraft had been positioned in Hong Kong, where it underwent an extensive cabin retrofit and overhaul program that lasted for eight months. Following the completion of this eight-month overhaul in Hong Kong, the thirteen-year-old aircraft has returned to the United States. The refurbished jet is equipped with several upgraded cabin features for passengers, which include larger entertainment screens, wireless Bluetooth pairing capabilities, and individual privacy doors. 美國航空已將其首架波音777-300ER客機在香港進行為期8個月的改裝後,飛渡返回達拉斯-沃斯堡國際機場(DFW)。 American Airlines Ferries 1st Boeing 777-300ER Back To DFW After 8-Month Retrofit In Hong Kong 這架機齡13年的客機在翻修後配備了更大的螢幕、藍牙配對功能以及隱私門。 After an 8 month Hong Kong overhaul the 13 year old jet returns with larger screens Bluetooth pairing and privacy doors.

a-20260814-0108-boeing-appoints-gol-ceo-.text: 波音延攬GOL執行長Ferrer出任拉丁美洲總裁;GOL任命Fehlauer接任執行長 波音聘GOL執行長Celso Ferrer任拉丁美洲及加勒比地區總裁;GOL任命André Fehlauer接任執行長 2026年8月13日,波音宣布延攬巴西低成本航空GOL Linhas Aéreas執行長Celso Ferrer,擔任拉丁美洲及加勒比地區總裁。Ferrer將於2026年9月4日加入波音,負責強化波音在該區域的營運、策略與業務布局。 Ferrer自2022年起擔任GOL執行長,任內督導公司重整及與Abra Group的整合。他於2004年以實習生身分加入GOL,在該航空任職超過20年,此前亦曾擔任營運長及規劃副總裁。GOL表示,Ferrer持有波音737-700、737-800 Next Generation及737-8 Max的飛行員資格。 Ferrer將於2026年8月31日卸任GOL執行長。GOL隨後宣布任命André Fehlauer自2026年9月起接任執行長。Fehlauer此前曾在GOL旗下Smiles忠誠度計畫於阿根廷及巴西任職八年,最近擔任巴西忠誠度計畫Livelo執行長。 此外,GOL現任商務長Albert Perez將擴大職責,兼任GOL Linhas Aéreas總裁。Perez於2024年初加入GOL,此前在Avianca、JetSMART及Vueling等航空擔任領導職務。GOL表示,Perez協助改善營運表現,將繼續負責日常營運。 Abra Group執行長Adrian Neuhauser表示,Fehlauer在GOL的過往經驗及Perez的營運背景將支持GOL下一階段的成長。GOL為Abra Group旗下航空,該集團同時擁有Avianca,並對Wamos Air持有策略投資,另持有Sky Airline的少數可轉換債權。 Boeing recruits GOL CEO Celso Ferrer as Latin America president; GOL names André Fehlauer as new CEO Boeing appoints GOL CEO Celso Ferrer as Latin America and Caribbean president; GOL names André Fehlauer as new CEO from September 2026 On August 13, 2026, Boeing announced that it had recruited Celso Ferrer, CEO of Brazilian low-cost airline GOL Linhas Aéreas, as its new president for Latin America and the Caribbean. Ferrer is due to join Boeing on September 4, 2026, and will be responsible for strengthening Boeing's operations, strategy, and presence across the region. Ferrer has served as CEO of GOL Linhas Aéreas since 2022, having joined the carrier in 2004 as an intern. During his tenure he oversaw a restructuring of the company and its integration with Abra Group. He previously held the roles of Chief Operating Officer and Vice President of Planning at the airline. Ferrer will step down from GOL on August 31, 2026. GOL named André Fehlauer as its new CEO, effective September 2026. a-20260814-0526-us-imposes-drone-tariffs.text: 美祭無人機關稅東元評估在美生產為升無直接影響 美祭無人機關稅;東元評估在美生產;為升稱無直接影響 美國總統川普於8月13日宣布,將對進口無人機及其零組件徵收最高達100%關稅,對歐盟、日本、韓國及台灣等盟友產品課徵15%關稅。 東元表示,其無人機動力系統以商用和農用為主,未來將評估在美國在地化生產的可能性。 為升電裝指出,從目前公開訊息看,反無人機設備不在本次關稅課徵範圍內,因此對其業務無直接影響。 怡利電子則說明,其無人機引擎精密組件主要應用於歐洲商用無人機產品,出貨以非北美市場為主,關稅政策對其亦無影響。 US Imposes Drone Tariffs; Taiwan’s Tung Yuan Evaluates US Production, Ascent Sees No Direct Impact US drone tariffs; Tung Yuan evaluates US output; Ascent sees no impact On August 13, 2026, US President Donald Trump announced tariffs of up to 100% on imported drones and components, with a 15% rate on allies including the EU, Japan, South Korea and Taiwan. Tung Yuan said its drone power systems are mainly for commercial and agricultural use and that it will assess the possibility of local production in the United States. Ascent Electric stated that its drone counter‐measure systems fall outside the scope of the new tariffs and therefore will not be directly affected. Yili Electronic noted that its drone engine precision parts are primarily supplied to European commercial drone customers, with shipments mainly to non‐North American markets, so the tariff policy has no impact on it. metadata.title: 千葉豪雨影響成田聯外交通 台灣虎航開放3航班免費改期退款

a-20260814-0710-chiba-rain-impairs-narit.text: 千葉豪雨影響成田聯外交通 台灣虎航開放3航班免費改期退款 受日本千葉豪雨影響,台灣虎航針對成田機場受阻旅客提供免費改期與退款方案。 日本千葉縣發生暴雨,導致連接東京成田機場的當地大眾運輸工具停駛,影響部分旅客前往機場搭機。台灣虎航於2026年8月14日在官網公告應變處理方案,針對因成田機場聯外交通受阻而未能如期搭乘指定航班的旅客,提供免費改期或退款至信用帳戶等彈性措施。 台灣虎航指出,相關應變方案適用於3個特定的成田航線航班,包含2026年8月13日由東京成田飛往桃園的IT701班機,以及8月14日由東京成田飛往桃園的IT201班機與飛往高雄的IT281班機。若上述航班已正常起飛,但旅客因交通中斷未能如期搭乘(No Show),可向東京成田機場的台灣虎航櫃檯尋求協助,若7日內其他航班仍有空位,將免費協助調整航班。 此外,受影響旅客亦可在2026年8月16日晚間9時前,主動聯繫台灣虎航客服中心處理。客服團隊將協助免費改期至7日內仍有空位的航班;或依不可抗力因素規範,提供退還款項至信用帳戶(代金券),供旅客於未來安排行程時使用。若旅客原購票管道為旅行社或第三方平台,則需洽詢原開票旅行社或平台進行處理。 針對千葉暴雨對整體航班營運的影響,星宇航空表示,受交通影響而未如期搭機(No Show)的旅客數量較平時略增,但目前航班均無異動。中華航空表示整體營運皆正常;長榮航空則表示,當天稍早由成田前往高雄的航班中,僅有1名旅客未能如期搭乘。 Chiba Rain Impairs Narita Transit: Tigerair Taiwan Offers Rebooking and Refunds Tigerair Taiwan offers free flight rebooking and refunds after Chiba heavy rain disrupts Narita Airport ground transit. Heavy rain in Chiba Prefecture, Japan, has disrupted local public transportation to Tokyo Narita Airport, preventing some passengers from reaching the airport on time. In response to the ground transit disruptions, Tigerair Taiwan issued an official announcement on August 14, 2026, outlining flexible ticketing measures, including free flight modifications and refunds to credit accounts for affected travelers. The flexible measures apply to passengers booked on three specific routes operated by Tigerair Taiwan: flight IT701 from Tokyo Narita to Taoyuan on August 13, as well as flight IT201 from Tokyo Narita to Taoyuan and flight IT281 from Tokyo Narita to Kaohsiung on August 14. For passengers who missed these flights (no-show) after the aircraft had departed normally due to transit delays, assistance is available at the airline's Narita Airport counter to adjust their flights free of charge to alternative flights within seven days, subject to seat availability. Passengers may also contact the Tigerair Taiwan customer service center prior to 9:00 p.m. on August 16, 2026. Customer service staff will assist in rebooking free of charge on open flights within seven days or issue a refund to a credit account as a voucher under force majeure provisions for future travel. Travelers who purchased tickets through travel agencies or third-party booking platforms are instructed to contact their original ticketing platform to process modifications or refunds. Regarding wider operational impacts from the Chiba rainstorm, Starlux Airlines stated that its no-show passenger volume was slightly higher than usual, though all flight schedules remain unchanged. China Airlines reported normal operations across its flights, while EVA Air noted that only a single passenger failed to show up for an earlier flight operating from Narita to Kaohsiung. Heavy rain in Chiba Prefecture disrupted ground transportation to Narita Airport, leading Tigerair Taiwan to announce ticket modification and refund options for affected passengers on three Narita flights. 日本千葉豪雨影響成田機場聯外交通,台灣虎航公告,受影響3航班旅客,可至成田櫃檯,7日內若有位,免費改期,或16日晚間9時前聯繫客服改期或退款至信用帳戶(代金券)內。 The three affected Tigerair Taiwan flights are IT701 from Tokyo Narita to Taoyuan on August 13, and IT201 to Taoyuan and IT281 to Kaohsiung on August 14. 8月13日IT701東京成田-桃園、8月14日IT201東京成田-桃園、IT281東京成田-高雄 Passengers who missed flights can seek free flight adjustments at the Narita counter for available flights within seven days, or contact customer service by 9:00 p.m. on August 16 for rebooking or credit account refunds. 旅客可向東京成田機場台灣虎航櫃檯尋求協助,若7日內航班仍有空位,將免費協助進行航班調整。 Passengers who booked tickets through travel agencies or third-party platforms must contact their original issuing provider. 若旅客原購票為旅行社或是第三方平台,台灣虎航指出,請洽原開票旅行社或開票平台進行處理。 Starlux Airlines reported slightly higher no-show counts with unchanged flight schedules, China Airlines reported normal operations, and EVA Air reported one no-show on an earlier Narita-Kaohsiung flight. 星宇航空對此透過訊息說明,No Show旅客有比平常多一些,但目前航班無異動;中華航空指出,目前都正常;長榮航空則說,今天稍早從成田前往高雄班機,僅有1名旅客未能如期搭乘。

metadata.title: 瑞士新創PeakJet完成首航 拓展歐洲半私人航空市場

a-20260814-0710-swiss-startup-peakjet-la.text: 瑞士新創PeakJet完成首航 拓展歐洲半私人航空市場 PeakJet完成蘇黎世至馬略卡首航;以輕資產模式進軍歐洲半私人航線 瑞士半私人航空平台 PeakJet 於 2026 年 8 月 1 日完成首航,執飛由蘇黎世(ZRH)至馬略卡島帕爾馬(PMI)的航線。該平台旨在引進半私人飛行概念,投入歐洲短途航空市場。 本次航班由 VistaJet GmbH 使用巴西航空工業 Embraer 650 Legacy 執飛。PeakJet 未持有航空營運人許可證,採用輕資產平台模式營運。公司由前阿提哈德航空執行長 Peter Baumgartner 及高管 Gianni Tronza 共同創立,後續規劃連接蘇黎世至尼斯(NCE)與馬拉加(AGP)等航線,專注 2.5 小時以內的航程。 Swiss Startup PeakJet Launches Semi-Private Europe Flights With Inaugural Zurich Flight PeakJet completed its inaugural Zurich to Palma flight on August 1 using VistaJet operated aircraft. Swiss semi-private aviation platform PeakJet completed its inaugural flight on August 1, 2026, operating between Zurich (ZRH) and Palma de Mallorca (PMI) . The flight was operated by VistaJet GmbH using an Embraer 650 Legacy aircraft, marking the startup's entry into the European short-haul market. PeakJet operates as an asset-light technology platform without holding its own air operator certificate. Co-founded by former Etihad Airways CEO Peter Baumgartner and aviation executive Gianni Tronza, the company plans to target routes connecting Zurich with Nice (NCE) and Malaga (AGP) , focusing on flights under 2.5 hours. PeakJet completed its first flight between Zurich (ZRH) and Palma de Mallorca (PMI) on August 1, 2026. On August 1, 2026, coinciding with Switzerland’s national day, PeakJet completed its first flight between Zurich (ZRH) and Palma de Mallorca (PMI). The inaugural flight was operated by VistaJet GmbH using an Embraer 650 Legacy aircraft, as PeakJet does not hold an air operator certificate. The flight was operated by VistaJet Gmbh (the German subsidiary of the well-known executive aviation group) using Embraer 650 Legacy. This is a key element in PeakJet’s business model, since the startup doesn’t hold its own air operator certificate (AOC). PeakJet was set up by Gianni Tronza and Peter Baumgartner, former Chief Executive Officer of Etihad Airways. At the helm of this project is Gianni Tronza, a Swiss executive with decades of experience across the industry who has held senior executive roles at airlines such as Etihad Airways, American Airlines, British Airways and Crossair, the kernel of what later became SWISS. Also backing this project is Peter Baumgartner, former Chief Executive Officer (CEO) at Etihad Airways PeakJet focuses on short-haul flights up to 2.5 hours, targeting routes connecting Zurich to Mallorca, Nice (NCE), and Malaga (AGP). the focus on the short-haul, defined as flights of up to 2.5 hours. Second home owners is one of the key demographics that PeakJet is targeting, hence the initial choice of routes, linking Zurich to Mallorca, Nice (NCE) and Malaga (AGP).

metadata.title: 台灣民航局舉辦2026航空保安研討會 聚焦韌性與智慧化

a-20260814-1000-caa-taiwan-hosts-2026-av.text: 台灣民航局舉辦2026航空保安研討會 聚焦韌性與智慧化 民航局舉辦2026航空保安研討會;聚焦保安韌性智慧化與桃園機場貨運保安 交通部民用航空局於2026年8月14日舉辦「2026航空保安研討會」,邀集產官學界代表共同參與。本次研討會旨在因應全球新型態威脅並提升台灣航空保安實力,聚焦於保安韌性與智慧化等關鍵議題。 研討會圍繞四大主題進行討論,包括全球航空保安韌性、機場保安智慧化、深植保安文化,以及桃園國際機場(TPE)新貨運園區貨物保安展望。與會代表包含運輸安全委員會、航空警察局、桃園國際機場公司及長榮空儲等單位代表。 民航局局長何淑萍於致詞時表示,航空保安需要主管機關、警察機關與業界緊密結合。她指出,韌性意指事件發生時快速恢復的能力,恢復時間越短代表韌性越強,需要體系中各崗位人員共同努力與設備智慧化精進。 CAA Taiwan Hosts 2026 Aviation Security Symposium Focusing on Resilience and Smart Technology CAA Taiwan hosted the 2026 Aviation Security Symposium, focusing on security resilience and smart airport technologies. The Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) of Taiwan hosted the 2026 Aviation Security Symposium on August 14, 2026. The event brought together industry and official representatives to share operational insights, respond to evolving global threats, and strengthen domestic aviation security capabilities. Discussions focused on four core themes: global aviation security resilience, smart airport security, embedding a strong security culture, and the cargo security outlook for the new cargo park at Taoyuan International Airport (TPE). Participants included representatives from the Taiwan Transportation Safety Board, the Aviation Police Bureau, Taoyuan International Airport Corporation, and Evergreen Air Cargo Services. CAA Director General Ho Shu-ping stated that aviation security requires close coordination between the civil aviation authority, police forces, and industry partners. She emphasized that security resilience refers to the ability to recover rapidly from incidents, requiring ongoing hardware smartification and commitment from personnel across all roles. 交通部民用航空局於2026年8月14日舉辦「2026航空保安研討會」,聚焦保安韌性與智慧化等主題。 2026航空保安研討會」今天登場,會議聚焦保安韌性與智慧化等主題 研討會邀請運安會、航警局、桃機公司及長榮空儲等代表,討論全球航空保安韌性、機場保安智慧化、深植保安文化及桃園國際機場新貨運園區貨物保安展望四大主題。 共同討論「全球航空保安韌性」、「機場保安智慧化」、「深植保安文化」及「桃園國際機場新貨運園區貨物保安展望」四大主題。 民航局局長何淑萍致詞指出,航空保安需要民航局、航警局與業界緊密結合,並表示韌性代表事件發生時快速恢復的能力。 何淑萍致詞時指出,航空保安需要民航局、航警局與業界緊密的結和

a-20260814-1059-etna-eruption-extends-ca.text: 埃特納火山噴發影響 義大利卡塔尼亞機場(CTA)關閉延長至週六 埃特納火山噴發持續;義大利西西里卡塔尼亞機場關閉時間延長至星期六 根據路透社報導,位於義大利西西里島的卡塔尼亞機場(CTA),因埃特納火山噴發影響,機場關閉時間已進一步延長至星期六。火山噴發活動持續進行,導致該機場無法按原訂時程恢復正常的航空營運。 先前報導指出,埃特納火山噴發出的火山灰,最初導致卡塔尼亞機場持續關閉至星期五,並對當地的夏季旅遊交通造成了顯著的干擾與中斷。 隨著埃特納火山噴發持續,卡塔尼亞機場保持關閉狀態,前往與離開西西里島卡塔尼亞的夏季旅遊航空交通持續受到影響。 Etna Eruption Extends Catania Airport (CTA) Closure in Sicily Until Saturday Catania airport in Sicily extends operational closure until Saturday following continued eruption of Etna. According to reporting by Reuters, an eruption of Mount Etna has forced the extended closure of Sicily's Catania airport (CTA) until Saturday. The continuation of volcanic activity has prevented the facility from resuming regular air transport operations as previously anticipated. Previous reporting noted that volcanic ash generated by Mount Etna had initially kept Catania airport shut through Friday. The presence of airborne volcanic ash caused disruptions to summer travel across the affected region in Italy. With the ongoing Etna eruption prolonging the airport shutdown into Saturday, summer travel operations serving Catania and Sicily continue to face operational disruptions. 埃特納火山噴發導致義大利西西里島卡塔尼亞機場關閉時間延長至星期六。 Etna eruption extends closure of Sicily's Catania airport until Saturday 埃特納火山噴出的火山灰最初使卡塔尼亞機場關閉至星期五,並影響夏季旅遊交通。 Etna ash keeps Catania airport shut until Friday, disrupting summer travel

metadata.title: 美國國家航空暨太空總署亮相改裝波音777空中實驗室

a-20260814-1059-nasa-unveils-modified-bo.text: 美國國家航空暨太空總署亮相改裝波音777空中實驗室 美國太空總署展示波音777空中實驗室,接替退役DC-8執行大氣科研任務 美國國家航空暨太空總署(NASA)正式公開其最新引進的波音(Boeing)777-200ER空中科研實驗室。該架客機改裝後的國籍標誌暨登記號碼為N577NA,並於2026年8月12日首度揭曉全新的NASA主題外觀塗裝,隨後返回位於維吉尼亞州的太空總署蘭利研究中心(Langley Research Centre)。此架大型噴射機將成為美國國家航空暨太空總署未來大氣與地球科學研究的核心空中平台。 新引進的波音777-200ER旨在接替並擴充先前DC-8-72科研機的任務功能。太空總署原先使用的道格拉斯(Douglas)DC-8空中實驗室在服役長達37年後,已於2024年正式退役。先前DC-8曾支援包含大氣化學、氣象學、海洋學、火山學、生物學、水文學及考古學等多領域的研究專案,而全新的波音777飛機將具備更遠的航程能力,提供廣泛的全球科研資料收集支援。 根據相關規劃,這架波音777空中實驗室將由太空總署蘭利研究中心負責營運,主要支援多個美國政府機關的大氣科研計畫,以及各項環境與航空相關研究。該機的科研任務包括新感測器開發、衛星感測器校正、科學資料校驗,以及各類地球系統過程的實地觀測,協助研究團隊提升氣候與環境模型的精準度,以利政策決策制定。 該架飛機最初於2003年製造出廠,生產序號為32892,最初交付予日本航空(Japan Airlines)營運,當時國籍編號為JA704J,直至2020年5月自商業客運退役並封存。其後,該機由位於南加州的Logistic Air公司收購並重新登記為N774LG,最終由太空總署選中購得。選擇該機型的主因包含其優異的長程飛行能力、相對年輕的機齡,以及現代化的航電系統與科技。 這架飛機的重度改裝工程於2025年啟動,由位於德克薩斯州韋科(Waco)的L3Harris Technologies公司負責執行。改裝內容包含安裝多個機腹下視(nadir)與機窗感測器開口、資料與通訊系統、電力升級以及儀器操作員席位配置。太空總署預計該架波音777空中實驗室將於2027年初正式投入首次科研飛行營運任務。 NASA Unveils Modified Boeing 777 Airborne Lab as Replacement for DC-8 NASA has unveiled its new Boeing 777 airborne research laboratory to replace the retired DC-8 aircraft. The National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) has officially unveiled its newly acquired modified Boeing 777-200ER widebody jet, which will serve as the agency's new airborne research laboratory. Carrying registration N577NA, the aircraft was presented on August 12 showcasing a new NASA-themed livery before returning to the NASA Langley Research Centre in Virginia. The new Boeing 777-200ER has been acquired to replace and expand upon the capabilities of NASA's previous Douglas DC-8-72 airborne laboratory, which was retired in 2024 after 37 years of service. During its operational history, the predecessor DC-8 supported atmospheric chemistry, meteorology, oceanography, volcanology, biology, and hydrology missions. The Boeing 777's extended range will provide global reach for future data collection projects. Based at NASA's Langley Research Centre in Virginia, the aircraft will support various atmospheric projects for multiple United States government agencies, alongside environmental and aerospace research. Planned scientific missions include sensor development, satellite sensor calibration, data product validation, and field studies on Earth system processes to improve scientific models. Originally manufactured in 2003 with serial number 32892, the Boeing 777-246(ER) was delivered to Japan Airlines and operated commercial flights under registration JA704J until its retirement in May 2020. The jet was later acquired by Southern California-based Logistic Air as N774LG before NASA selected the platform for its age, modern avionics, and long-range capabilities. Extensive retrofitting began in 2025, conducted by L3Harris Technologies in Waco, Texas. Current modification work includes installing nadir and window instrument ports, enhanced power and communications systems, and specialized accommodations for instrument operators. NASA expects the aircraft to begin its initial scientific flight operations in early 2027. NASA revealed its new modified Boeing 777-200ER airborne research laboratory with registration N577NA on August 12, featuring a new NASA-themed livery. Built in 2003, the replacement aircraft (now carrying registration N577NA) was first revealed on 12 August, resplendent in a stunning new NASA-themed livery. The Boeing 777-200ER replaces NASA's vintage DC-8-72 research aircraft, which was retired in 2024 after 37 years of service. The new NASA B777-200ER was acquired to replace and extend the capabilities of NASA’s vintage DC-8-72 , which was retired in 2024, having flown for the agency for 37 years. The modified aircraft will support the NASA Langley Research Centre in Virginia for atmospheric, environmental, and aerospace research, with initial flight operations planned for early 2027. The aircraft will be used to continue the work of the NASA Langley Research Centre based in Virginia, which handles a range of atmospheric projects for several US agencies, as well as other environmental and aerospace-related studies. The aircraft is undergoing modifications including nadir and window ports, power, data, and communications systems, and operator accommodations, retrofitted by L3Harris Technologies in Waco, Texas. The aircraft is currently undergoing various modifications to include several nadir and window ports, power, data, and communications systems, and instrument operator accommodations. Built in 2003, the aircraft previously flew for Japan Airlines under registration JA704J until May 2020 before being acquired by Logistic Air and subsequently NASA. It was delivered to customer Japan Airlines (JAL) later that year and flew commercial routes for JAL under registration JA704J until it was retired in May 2020 and placed in storage.

metadata.title: 印度空軍啟動150架高級教練機替換計畫

a-20260814-1059-indian-air-force-begins-.text: 印度空軍啟動150架高級教練機替換計畫 印度空軍發布資訊需求書;採購約150架高級教練機;回覆截止日為10月5日 印度空軍已正式啟動替換現役Hawk Mk-132高級噴射教練機(AJT)的採購流程,預計尋求採購約150架Stage-III (F)階段高級教練機。該階段機型為印度空軍飛行訓練體系中的最後一環,旨在讓飛行員在銜接Rafale、Tejas等前線主力戰鬥機之前,熟悉先進航空電子與戰鬥系統。 印度空軍已針對本次教練機採購計畫,向印度國內及海外國防製造商發布資訊需求書(RFI),要求意願廠商於10月5日前提交回應文件。在收到製造商回覆後,後續預計於印度當地展開相關試飛與評測作業,該階段將以無須付費且不具強制承諾的形式進行。 現役的Hawk Mk-132教練機自2008年起即承擔印度空軍的高級訓練任務。印度過去曾分兩批次採購總計106架該型教練機,包括2004年簽署的首批66架合約,以及2010年向印度國營國防企業印度航空工業公司(HAL)追加訂購的40架教練機。 目前該項採購計畫仍處於初期資料收集階段,暫定於2027年12月發布正式招標文件(RFP),隨後進行實機評估與試飛。由於相關合約要求在生效後60個月內完成全部交機,這批新型高級教練機預計不太可能在2030年代中期之前正式投入印度空軍服役。 在技術規格方面,印度空軍要求新型教練機配備線傳飛控系統(fly-by-wire)、玻璃座艙,以及可設定的手置節流閥與操縱桿(HOTAS)。導航系統需整合印度本土NavIC衛星導航以及GPS、GLONASS系統;安全配備則要求零零彈射椅、自動恢復飛行穩定功能,並嵌入虛擬航電與電子戰訓練套件。 Indian Air Force Begins Process to Procure 150 Advanced Jet Trainers Indian Air Force issues RFI for 150 advanced jet trainers; responses due October 5 The Indian Air Force (IAF) has initiated the process to replace its fleet of Hawk Mk-132 advanced jet trainers, seeking approximately 150 new Stage-III (F) trainer aircraft. The Stage-III (F) designation represents the final aircraft in the service's flying-training pipeline before student pilots transition to frontline operational fighters such as the Rafale, Tejas, and future combat aircraft. To begin the procurement process, the Indian Air Force has issued an official Request for Information (RFI) to both domestic and international aircraft manufacturers, setting a submission deadline of October 5. Following the submission of manufacturer responses, evaluation flight trials will be conducted within India on a no-cost and no-commitment basis for the military service. The Hawk Mk-132 aircraft has occupied the Indian Air Force's advanced jet training slot since 2008. India previously contracted for a total of 106 Hawk trainers across two separate procurement batches, comprising an initial 66-aircraft agreement signed in 2004 and a subsequent order for 40 additional units contracted from Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd (HAL) in 2010. The current procurement program remains in its preliminary stages prior to a final contract award. A formal Request for Proposal (RFP) is tentatively scheduled for release in December 2027, followed by comprehensive flight trials and evaluations. With aircraft deliveries expected to be completed within 60 months of contract implementation, the replacement jet trainers are unlikely to enter operational service before the mid-2030s. The technical requirements outlined in the Request for Information specify fly-by-wire flight controls, a modern glass cockpit, and configurable hands-on-throttle-and-stick (HOTAS) controls. Additionally, navigation systems must integrate India's indigenous NavIC satellite navigation system alongside GPS and GLONASS, while safety standards require zero-zero ejection seats, automatic recovery capabilities from lost control, and embedded virtual avionics and electronic warfare suites. a-20260814-1143-us-imposes-section-232-d.text: 美國對無人機開徵232條款關稅 行政院:台灣最高享85個百分點優勢 美國依232條款對無人機課稅;政院指台灣適用15%稅率,最高享85個百分點優勢。 美國政府於美東時間8月13日公告,依據「1962年貿易擴張法」第232條,對全球進口無人機系統(UAS)及其零組件開徵關稅。行政院台美經貿工作小組透過新聞稿說明,台灣與歐盟、日本、韓國、瑞士等特定貿易夥伴的相關產品稅率皆為15%且不疊加MFN,英國則為10%不疊加MFN。 台美經貿工作小組指出,上述國家以外的其他國家,25公斤以上大型無人機或具備熱成像等敏感功能的無人機及關鍵零組件,輸美適用100%疊加MFN關稅;不超過25公斤且不具熱成像功能的一般商業或消費型無人機及零組件,則適用25%疊加MFN關稅。 台灣無人機相關產品被課徵15%不疊加關稅。台美經貿工作小組表示,在敏感、大型與熱成像無人機項目,台灣符合美方關鍵零組件及技術來源條件要求的相關輸美產品,相比其他國家適用稅率100%,具85個百分點的關稅差異優勢;一般中小型無人機則適用15%稅率,與其他國家的25%相比,有10個百分點的優勢。 關稅生效時間方面,非敏感零件自簽署後180天、即明年2月9日生效,其餘項目自簽署後21天、即9月3日生效。 台美經貿工作小組也提到,因應美國聯邦通訊委員會(FCC)將外國製無人機及關鍵零組件納入管制含括清單(Covered List)的市場准入要求,經濟部已推動工研院成為美國Green UAS境外唯一認證據點,並促成金屬中心對接Blue UAS認證,協助業者符合美方認驗證要求。 US imposes Section 232 drone tariffs; Taiwan's Executive Yuan cites up to 85 percentage point advantage US Section 232 drone tariffs announced; Taiwan applies 15% rate with up to 85 percentage point advantage. The US government announced on August 13 Eastern Time that, pursuant to Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962, it would impose tariffs on globally imported unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) and their components. Taiwan's Executive Yuan Taiwan-US Economic and Trade Working Group stated via press release that relevant products from Taiwan, the EU, Japan, South Korea, and Switzerland are all subject to a 15% rate not stacked on top of MFN, while the UK's rate is 10% not stacked on MFN. For countries outside the above group, large drones over 25 kg or those with sensitive functions such as thermal imaging, along with their critical components, are subject to a 100% tariff stacked on MFN. General commercial or consumer drones and components not exceeding 25 kg and without thermal imaging are subject to a 25% tariff stacked on MFN. Taiwan's drone-related products are subject to a 15% non-stacked tariff. The working group said that for sensitive, large, and thermal-imaging drones, Taiwan's products meeting US critical component and technology source requirements enjoy an 85 percentage point tariff advantage over other countries' 100% rate. For general small and medium-sized drones, Taiwan's 15% rate offers a 10 percentage point advantage over the 25% rate applied to other countries. Regarding effective dates, non-sensitive parts take effect 180 days after signing, on February 9 next year, while other items take effect 21 days after signing, on September 3. The working group also noted that in response to the US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) adding foreign-made drones and critical components to its Covered List, the Ministry of Economic Affairs has facilitated ITRI becoming the sole overseas certification site for the US Green UAS program and the Metal Industries Research & Development Centre in connecting with Blue UAS certification, helping manufacturers meet US certification requirements. The US government announced on August 13 Eastern Time that it would impose tariffs on globally imported UAS and components pursuant to Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962. 美國政府在美東時間8月13日公告,依據「1962年貿易擴張法」第232條對全球進口無人機系統(UAS)及其零組件對美國國家安全影響所進行的調查結果。 Taiwan, the EU, Japan, South Korea, and Switzerland face a 15% tariff not stacked on MFN; the UK faces 10% not stacked on MFN. 台灣與歐盟、日本、韓國、瑞士等特定貿易夥伴的相關產品稅率皆為15%且不疊加MFN,英國相關產品稅率則為10%不疊加MFN。 For other countries, large drones over 25 kg or those with sensitive functions like thermal imaging face 100% tariff stacked on MFN; general drones not exceeding 25 kg without thermal imaging face 25% stacked on MFN. 若為25公斤以上大型無人機、或具備如熱成像等敏感功能的無人機或其關鍵零組件,輸美是適用100%疊加MFN關稅;若重量不超過25公斤且不具備熱成像功能的一般商業或消費型無人機及零組件,輸美則適用25%疊加MFN關稅。 Taiwan's products meeting US critical component and technology source requirements have an 85 percentage point tariff advantage over other countries' 100% rate for sensitive, large, and thermal-imaging drones, and a 10 percentage point advantage for general small and medium-sized drones. 台灣符合美方關鍵零組件及技術來源條件要求的相關輸美產品,相比其他國家的適用稅率為100%,具85個百分點的關稅差異優勢。 Non-sensitive parts take effect 180 days after signing on February 9 next year; other items take effect 21 days after signing on September 3. 非敏感零件是自簽署後180天生效,幾就是明年2月9日生效,其餘項目則是自簽署後21天生效也就是9月3日生效。 The Ministry of Economic Affairs facilitated ITRI as the sole overseas Green UAS certification site and the Metal Industries Research & Development Centre in connecting with Blue UAS certification to help manufacturers meet FCC Covered List requirements. 經濟部已推動工研院成為美國Green UAS境外唯一認證據點,並促成金屬中心對接Blue UAS認證,協助業者符合美方認驗證要求

metadata.title: 東京豪雨影響交通 華航免收成田羽田退改手續費

a-20260814-1243-china-airlines-waives-ti.text: 東京豪雨影響交通 華航免收成田羽田退改手續費 受東京豪雨影響,華航宣布8月13至14日成田與羽田出發機票免收退改手續費。 受日本東京地區及千葉縣豪雨影響,中華航空(華航)宣布針對2026年8月13日至14日由東京成田機場或羽田機場(HND)出發的機票,提供退改票免收手續費作業。 華航表示,凡持有上述指定日期與航點機票的旅客,若更改訂位至2026年9月4日(含)之前的航班,或是辦理退票,均可免收手續費及未登機費。 華航指出將持續關注東京天氣狀況並與機場保持聯繫。受影響旅客可透過原開票旅行社、華航客服中心或各地分公司協助調整行程,並建議利用官網與行動應用程式查詢最新航班動態。 China Airlines Waives Ticket Rebooking and Refund Fees for Tokyo Flights China Airlines waives fees for Tokyo Narita and Haneda departures on August 13-14 following heavy rain. China Airlines has announced a fee waiver for ticket changes and refunds following heavy rainfall in Japan's Chiba Prefecture and the broader Tokyo area. The measure applies to passengers holding tickets departing from Tokyo's Narita Airport (HND) or Haneda Airport on August 13 and August 14, 2026. According to the carrier, eligible passengers who rebook their flights to on or before September 4, 2026, or opt for a full refund, will be exempt from handling fees and no-show penalties. China Airlines stated that it is closely monitoring weather conditions in Tokyo and maintaining close contact with local airport authorities. Passengers are advised to contact their issuing travel agency, customer service centers, or local branch offices for itinerary adjustments, and to check flight updates via the airline's website, mobile app, or SMS notifications. China Airlines announced that tickets departing from Narita or Haneda airports on August 13 and 14, 2026, can be rebooked to flights on or before September 4 or refunded without handling and no-show fees. 8月13日至14日由成田或羽田機場出發的機票,更改訂位至9月4日前(含)航班或退票,將免收手續費及未登機費。 The ticket policy adjustment follows heavy rain in Japan's Tokyo area and Chiba Prefecture that disrupted ground transport. 受東京地區豪雨影響,凡持華航2026年8月13日至14日由東京成田或羽田出發的機票 China Airlines advised passengers to contact travel agencies, customer service, or branch offices, and monitor flight status via its website, app, or SMS. 旅客可洽原開票旅行社或公司客服中心、各地分公司協助調整行程。

a-20260814-1409-taiwan-legislature-passe.text: 立法院三讀通過115年度無人載具計畫約80億元預算 經濟部:無人載具計畫預算全數通過;朝119年產值破400億元邁進 立法院14日三讀通過115年度中央政府總預算案,經濟部表示,今年度「無人載具產業發展統籌型計畫」約80億元預算全數通過,感謝立法院支持。 經濟部指出,行政院已核定該計畫,114年至119年總經費約442億元,屬6年期計畫,以「產業發展、國防自主、民主供應鏈」為3大政策目標,從市場、技術、環境及法規4大面向整合跨部會資源。 經濟部表示,中部地區已提供漢翔、雷虎、田屋、佳凌等業者研發補助,並規劃於台中建置無人機電磁相容性(EMC)及綜合檢測實驗室;交通部民航局也將於台中光華高工增設無人機測試場域。 經濟部表示,未來將持續推動無人機產業發展,朝119年產值突破400億元目標邁進,推動台灣成為「無人機民主供應鏈亞太中心」。 Taiwan legislature passes TWD ~8 billion UAV budget for FY2026 Ministry of Economic Affairs: unmanned vehicle plan budget fully approved; targeting TWD 40 billion output by 2030 Taiwan's legislature passed the FY2026 central government budget on August 14. The Ministry of Economic Affairs said approximately TWD 8 billion for the Unmanned Vehicle Industry Development Integrated Program was fully approved. The ministry said the Executive Yuan approved the six-year program covering 2025 to 2030 with total funding of approximately TWD 44.2 billion, targeting three policy goals: industrial development, defence self-sufficiency, and democratic supply chains. In central Taiwan, R&D subsidies have been provided to Aerospace Industrial Development Corporation, Ray-Tech, Ten-Wu, and Chia Ling, with plans to build UAV EMC and comprehensive testing laboratories in Taichung. The CAA will also add a UAV testing site at Taichung Guanghua Industrial High School. The ministry said it will continue promoting the UAV industry toward the goal of exceeding TWD 40 billion in production value by 2030, positioning Taiwan as the Asia-Pacific center of the democratic UAV supply chain. 立法院14日三讀通過115年度中央政府總預算案,經濟部「無人載具產業發展統籌型計畫」約80億元預算全數通過。 立法院今天三讀通過115年度總預算,經濟部表示,今年度經濟部「無人載具產業發展統籌型計畫」約80億元預算全數通過 行政院已核定「無人載具產業發展統籌型計畫」,114年至119年總經費約442億元,屬6年期計畫。 行政院已核定「無人載具產業發展統籌型計畫」,114年至119年總經費約442億元,屬6年期計畫 計畫以「產業發展、國防自主、民主供應鏈」為3大政策目標,從市場、技術、環境及法規4大面向整合跨部會資源。 計畫以「產業發展、國防自主、民主供應鏈」為3大政策目標,並從市場、技術、環境及法規4大面向整合跨部會資源 中部地區提供漢翔、雷虎、田屋、佳凌等業者研發補助,並規劃於台中建置無人機EMC及綜合檢測實驗室;交通部民航局將於台中光華高工增設無人機測試場域。 中部地區提供漢翔、雷虎、田屋、佳凌等業者研發補助,協助投入整機及關鍵模組產品開發,並規劃於台中建置無人機電磁相容性(EMC)及綜合檢測實驗室 經濟部表示未來將朝119年產值突破400億元目標邁進,推動台灣成為「無人機民主供應鏈亞太中心」。 朝119年產值突破400億元目標邁進,推動台灣成為「無人機民主供應鏈亞太中心」 美國政府於8月13日美東時間公告,依據1962年貿易擴張法第232條對全球進口無人機系統及其零組件加徵關稅,台灣適用15%且不疊加MFN。 台灣與歐盟、日本、韓國、瑞士等特定貿易夥伴的相關產品稅率皆為15%且不疊加MFN

metadata.title: 美國對無人機開徵232條款關稅 經濟部:台灣有條件適用15%較低稅率

a-20260814-1542-us-imposes-section-232-d.text: 美國對無人機開徵232條款關稅 經濟部:台灣有條件適用15%較低稅率 經濟部表示台灣符合條件可適用15%較低關稅;將助業者符合美方認驗證拓展美國市場 美國政府於美東時間8月13日公告,依據「1962年貿易擴張法」第232條,對全球進口無人機系統(UAS)及其零組件採取差別關稅措施。大型及具敏感功能無人機原適用100%關稅,中小型無人機原則適用25%關稅。 經濟部8月14日發布新聞稿表示,台灣與歐盟、日本、韓國及瑞士等國產品,如符合美方關鍵零組件及技術來源條件,則適用15%關稅,且不疊加MFN,屬此次措施中相對較低稅率的國家。經濟部指出,這將有助維持台灣產品輸美的相對競爭條件,國內業者也可望利用與其他國家的關稅差距,爭取潛在轉單及擴大對美出口商機。 經濟部表示,目前台灣無人機產業主要布局25公斤以下機型,其中5公斤以下機型為外銷主力,主要應用於巡檢、監偵等領域;至於25公斤以上大型無人機,國際民用市場主要應用於農業用途,目前中國廠商仍具一定優勢。經濟部認為,隨著美國等國持續強化無人機供應鏈安全及本土產能布局,也為台灣業者切入大型無人機及關鍵零組件市場提供潛在發展機會。 美方15%較低稅率須符合「實質上關鍵零組件及技術來自指定國家或美國」條件,與政府推動無人機「非紅供應鏈」政策方向一致。經濟部表示,未來將協助業者盤點物料清單及關鍵零組件來源,並持續鏈結美國、日本及歐洲夥伴的技術與供應鏈能量,協助業者符合美方規範,爭取適用較低稅率。 此外,因應美國聯邦通訊委員會(FCC)將外國製無人機及關鍵零組件納入管制清單(Covered List)所衍生的市場准入要求,經濟部指出,現已推動工研院成為美國Green UAS境外唯一認證據點,並促成金屬中心對接Blue UAS認證,協助業者符合美方認驗證要求,提升台灣無人機產品進入美國市場的競爭優勢。 US Imposes Section 232 Drone Tariffs; Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs Says Taiwan Can Apply Lower 15% Rate Ministry says Taiwan eligible for 15% tariff if US component conditions met; will help firms meet US certification to expand market access The US government announced on August 13 Eastern Time that it would impose differentiated tariff measures on globally imported unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) and their components pursuant to Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962. Large drones and those with sensitive functions originally face a 100% tariff, while small and medium-sized drones generally face a 25% tariff. The Ministry of Economic Affairs stated in a press release on August 14 that products from Taiwan, the EU, Japan, South Korea, and Switzerland, if meeting US requirements on critical component and technology sourcing, qualify for a 15% tariff not stacked on MFN, making them among the countries with a relatively lower rate under the measures. The ministry noted that this will help maintain the relative competitive conditions for Taiwanese products exported to the US, and that domestic firms may leverage the tariff gap with other countries to capture potential order transfers and expand export opportunities to the US. The ministry stated that Taiwan's drone industry currently focuses mainly on models under 25 kg, with models under 5 kg being the primary export products, mainly used in inspection and surveillance. For large drones over 25 kg, the international civilian market is primarily used for agriculture, where Chinese manufacturers still hold a certain advantage. The ministry believes that as the US and other countries continue to strengthen drone supply chain security and domestic production capacity, this also presents potential development opportunities for Taiwanese firms to enter the large drone and critical component markets. The 15% lower rate requires that critical components and technology substantially originate from designated countries or the US, which is consistent with the government's policy direction of promoting a non-red supply chain for drones. The ministry said it will assist firms in reviewing bills of materials and critical component sources, and continue to link with US, Japanese, and European partners' technology and supply chain capabilities to help firms comply with US regulations and qualify for the lower rate. In addition, in response to market access requirements arising from the US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) adding foreign-made drones and critical components to its Covered List, the ministry noted that it has facilitated ITRI as the sole overseas Green UAS certification site and the Metal Industries Research & Development Centre in connecting with Blue UAS certification, helping firms meet US certification requirements and enhancing the competitive advantage of Taiwanese drone products entering the US market. The US government announced on August 13 Eastern Time that it would impose tariffs on globally imported UAS and components pursuant to Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962. 美國政府在美東時間8月13日公告,依據「1962年貿易擴張法」第232條對全球進口無人機系統(UAS)及其零組件對美國國家安全影響所進行的調查結果。 Taiwan, the EU, Japan, South Korea, and Switzerland, if meeting US critical component and technology source requirements, qualify for a 15% tariff not stacked on MFN, a relatively lower rate among the measures. 台灣與歐盟、日本、韓國及瑞士等國產品,如符合美方關鍵零組件及技術來源條件,則適用15%關稅,且不疊加MFN,屬此次措施中相對較低稅率的國家。 Large and sensitive-function drones originally face 100% tariff, while small and medium-sized drones generally face 25% tariff. 大型及具敏感功能無人機原適用100%關稅,中小型無人機原則適用25%關稅 Taiwan's drone industry mainly focuses on models under 25 kg, with models under 5 kg as the primary export products used in inspection and surveillance. 目前台灣無人機產業主要布局25公斤以下機型,其中5公斤以下機型為外銷主力,主要應用於巡檢、監偵等領域 The 15% lower rate requires critical components and technology to substantially originate from designated countries or the US, consistent with the government's non-red supply chain policy direction. 美方15%較低稅率須符合「實質上關鍵零組件及技術來自指定國家或美國」條件,與政府推動無人機「非紅供應鏈」政策方向一致 The Ministry of Economic Affairs facilitated ITRI as the sole overseas Green UAS certification site and the Metal Industries Research & Development Centre in connecting with Blue UAS certification to help firms meet FCC Covered List requirements. 現已推動工研院成為美國Green UAS境外唯一認證據點,並促成金屬中心對接Blue UAS認證,協助業者符合美方認驗證要求

metadata.title: IAG對希斯洛機場(LHR)三跑道成本提出嚴重質疑

a-20260815-0042-iag-questions-heathrow-t.text: IAG對希斯洛機場(LHR)三跑道成本提出嚴重質疑 IAG對希斯洛機場三跑道成本提出嚴重質疑;呼籲制定可負擔性保證 英國航空母公司國際航空集團(IAG)在提交給英國運輸委員會的書面證據中,對希斯洛機場(LHR)計劃中的第三條跑道成本表達了嚴重質疑。IAG認為該項目的費用「不只是龐大,而且是異常」。 IAG指出,計劃中的費用為660億美元(合490億英鎊),並認為這『不只是龐大,而且是異常』。集團還表示,該成本『遠超過』阿姆斯特丹史基浦、巴黎戴高樂、法蘭克福和伊斯坦堡等機場的項目。「IAG, which also owns Iberia and Aer Lingus, suggested that the $66 billion (£49 billion) proposed for the project is “not just large, it is exceptional”。」 IAG警告,『可負擔性對擴建的成功至關重要。沒有它,擴建將失敗,可能失去提升全英國連接性、工作、貿易和投資帶來的效益,甚至當前共同享有的效益也將不復存在。』「Affordability is critical to the success of expansion. Without it, expansion will fail and the benefits it could unlock – improved connectivity, jobs, trade and investment across the UK – will not be realized. Indeed, the benefits we all share today will be lost too。」 IAG進一步呼籲,應制定可負擔性保證、制定約束性預算上限、保護乘客免受費用上漲影響,並加強成本控制機制。「IAG正在呼籲制定可負擔性保證、約束性預算上限、保護乘客免受費用上漲影響,並加強成本控制機制。」 運輸委員會於2026年8月14日公布了超過70份書面證據,目前正在審查2026年6月由英國運輸部發布的《希斯洛擴建國家政策聲明》(HENPS)。委員會預計於2026年9月開始舉行口頭證據聽證。 IAG強調,委員會必須評估HENPS是否能「導致可負擔且可交付的擴建」。集團認為,現有草案尚未滿足這些標準,並重申,希斯洛機場的成長必須以能帶來真正公共效益且不會給乘客和航空公司帶來不可承受財務負擔的成本為前提。 IAG questions Heathrow third runway cost in committee evidence IAG questions Heathrow third runway cost; calls for affordability guarantees and budget ceiling British Airways owner International Airlines Group (IAG) has expressed serious questions about the cost of London‐Heathrow Airport (LHR)’s planned third runway in written evidence to the UK Transport Committee. The submission highlights IAG’s concerns that the project’s financial scale may jeopardise its viability. IAG, which also owns Iberia and Aer Lingus, suggested that the $66 billion (£49 billion) proposed for the project is “not just large, it is exceptional”. The airline group added that the costs “far exceed” comparable airport projects such as Amsterdam Schiphol (AMS), Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG), Frankfurt (FRA) and Istanbul (IST). According to IAG, affordability is critical to the success of expansion. Without it, expansion will fail and the benefits it could unlock – improved connectivity, jobs, trade and investment across the UK – will not be realized. Indeed, the benefits we all share today will be lost too. IAG is calling for affordability guarantees, a binding budget ceiling, protections against rising passenger charges and stronger mechanisms to control costs. The group stresses that affordability cannot simply be an aspiration: it must be a binding requirement, tested and enforced throughout the life of the project, not just asserted at the outset. The Transport Committee published more than 70 pieces of written evidence on 14 August 2026 as part of its inquiry into the government’s plans for a third runway at Heathrow. The committee is currently scrutinising the draft Heathrow Expansion National Policy Statement (HENPS), released by the Department for Transport in June 2026, and will begin hearing oral evidence from September 2026. IAG stresses that it is vital for the committees to assess whether HENPS will result in expansion that is affordable and deliverable. The group concludes that the HENPS as drafted does not yet succeed in meeting these criteria, warning that without credible affordability guarantees consumers, airlines and the wider economy will face an impossible financial burden. a-20260815-0517-jetstar-to-charge-for-ov.text: 捷星航空2027年起向大件行李收費新政策 捷星2027年2月2日起對大件行李收費;歐洲廉航同步模式 捷星航空宣布自2027年2月2日起,最低價機票僅含可置座位下的小型手提袋,乘客若需將大件行李放入頭頂行李架,須購買優先隨身行李服務。 同期捷星將隨身行李重量上限由7公斤提高至10公斤,並採用瑞安航空、易捷航空及威茲航空在歐洲已建立的收費模式,將頭頂行李架視為可出售的庫存。 顧問公司IdeaWorksCompany估算,若向頭頂行李架收費,表現最好的航空公司每位乘客可獲約20美元行李收入;歐洲廉航2025年行李費收入約160億美元,佔總收入近五分之一。特拉維亞航空2024年4月推出類似收費,第四季獲利超過2000萬歐元,平均每位乘客貢獻約4歐元。 Jetstar to Charge for Overhead Bin Space Starting February 2027 Jetstar introduces overhead bin fee from February 2027; follows European low‐cost model Jetstar announced that from 2 February 2027 its cheapest fares will include only a small under‐seat bag; passengers who want to place a larger bag in the overhead locker must purchase Priority Carry‐on. At the same time the carrier raises the carry‐on weight limit from 7 kg to 10 kg and adopts the model used by Ryanair, easyJet and Wizz Air in Europe, treating overhead bin space as sellable inventory. IdeaWorksCompany estimates top airlines can earn about US$20 per passenger from overhead‐bin fees; European low‐cost carriers collected roughly US$16 billion in baggage fees in 2025, accounting for nearly one‐fifth of revenue. Transavia introduced a similar charge in April 2024 and disclosed more than €20 million in Q4 revenue, averaging about €4 per passenger with a €30 fee and an estimated 13 % uptake. a-20260815-0659-taiwan-passes-nt-44-2-bi.text: 立院通過無人機預算 貿協將助業者拓展海外 台灣通過百億無人載具預算;外貿協會將協助業者布局國際市場 台灣立法院於2026年8月14日三讀通過為期6年、總額新台幣442億元的「無人載具產業發展統籌型計畫」預算案。外貿協會董事長黃志芳於8月15日表示,該預算案的通過為台灣無人機產業注入強心針,外貿協會將全力協助業者拓展海外市場。 黃志芳指出,台灣在資通訊、晶片設計、電子控制及馬達、電池等關鍵零組件具有優勢,相對欠缺的是國內需求。外貿協會將運用多元平台協助產業與國際接軌,明年台北「國際航太暨國防工業展」將設置無人機主題館,今年10月也將舉辦國防產業論壇,邀請全球專家與國內業者交流。 Taiwan Passes NT$44.2 Billion Budget for Unmanned Vehicle Industry TAITRA will assist Taiwan's drone industry in expanding globally after a budget approval on August 14. Taiwan's Legislative Yuan passed a six-year, NT$44.2 billion budget for the "Unmanned Vehicle Industry Development Coordination Program" on August 14, 2026. In response, Taiwan External Trade Development Council (TAITRA) Chairman Huang Chih-fang stated on August 15 that the approved budget provides a significant boost, and TAITRA will actively assist domestic drone operators in expanding into global markets. According to Huang, Taiwan possesses strong foundations in components like ICT, chip design, electronic controls, motors, and batteries. To facilitate overseas promotion, next year's Taipei Aerospace & Defense Technology Exhibition will feature a drone pavilion, and a defense industry forum focusing on drones will be held this October to promote international exchange. metadata.title: 阿聯酋航空與大韓航空等業者推動退役客機組件再利用

a-20260815-0723-airlines-repurpose-retir.text: 阿聯酋航空與大韓航空等業者推動退役客機組件再利用 阿聯酋航空與大韓航空等業者推動退役客機組件與舊制服再利用 阿聯酋航空工程部門(Emirates Engineering)日前展示一座高達2.4公尺的發光雕塑作品,該作品以退役的空中巴士 A380 與波音 777 客機組件打造而成。這座雕塑融合了 A380 起落架硬體、鈦金屬引氣管道、複合材料地板面板以及波音 777 機身外皮,用以紀念該航空公司與 Arsenal 足球俱樂部合作20週年,並將持續於 Emirates Stadium 展示。 瑞士國際航空(SWISS)則利用旗下退役的空中巴士 A321 客機(國籍標誌暨登記號碼 HB-IOC)推出「SWISS Recraft Collection」系列產品。這架曾服役於 Swissair 與 SWISS 的客機在27年服役期間累計飛行超過73,000小時並載運逾700萬名旅客。在完成拆解零件備用與訓練用途後,剩餘的機身外皮、內部結構與舷窗等材料被設計師重新打造為行李牌、鑰匙圈、壁掛鉤、衣帽架、碗盤、鏡子、邊桌及舷窗壁掛吧檯等物品。 新加坡航空亦透過其升級再利用計畫(Upcycling Project),將退役客機的組件與材料提供給設計師、藝術家、零售品牌及教育機構。相關材料被轉化為包款、家具、服飾、配件與餐具等產品,並與新加坡在地教育機構及支援身心障礙人士的機構 SG Enable 合作,銷售所得收益將回饋給參與製作的創作者。 大韓航空則將關注焦點投向維修人員的舊制服再利用。隨著今年導入環保新制服,該公司與專門從事升級再利用的品牌 Nukak 合作,將700件退役的冬季外套改造成2,000個耐用的工具包,配發給旗下維修團隊使用,進一步落實航空營運中的永續發展理念。 Airlines Repurpose Retired Aircraft Components and Uniforms into New Products Emirates, SWISS, Singapore Airlines, and Korean Air are repurposing retired aircraft parts and uniforms into new items. Emirates Engineering has constructed a 2.4-meter-high illuminated sculpture representing the Arsenal crest, crafted from components recovered from retired Airbus A380 and Boeing 777 aircraft fleets. The project incorporates A380 landing-gear hardware, a titanium bleed-air duct, composite floor panels, and Boeing 777 fuselage skin. Created to mark 20 years of partnership between the airline and Arsenal, the sculpture will remain on display at Emirates Stadium as part of a broader trend giving retired aircraft materials a second life. SWISS has introduced the SWISS Recraft Collection, utilizing parts from a retired Airbus A321 registered as HB-IOC. Over its 27-year career with Swissair and SWISS, the aircraft accumulated more than 73,000 flight hours and transported over seven million passengers. Following standard part-out processes for spare parts and training, designers repurposed remaining fuselage skin, substructure, and aircraft windows into items including baggage tags, key fobs, wall hooks, coat racks, bowls, mirrors, side tables, and wall-mounted window display cases. Singapore Airlines is extending the useful life of decommissioned aircraft components through its Upcycling Project by supplying parts and materials to designers, artists, retail brands, and educational institutions. a-20260815-1013-taiwan-detects-10-pla-ai.text: 國防部:中共10架次軍機出海 6架跨越台海中線 國防部指出,中共10架次戰機出海,其中6架次逾越海峽中線進入北部及中部空域。 國防部於8月15日下午表示,自當日上午8時28分起,陸續偵獲中共殲11、殲轟7及蘇愷30等各型主輔戰機計10架次出海。其中6架次逾越海峽中線,進入台灣北部及中部空域,配合中共軍艦執行所謂「聯合戰備警巡」,對台灣周邊海空域進行騷擾。 國防部指出,國軍運用聯合情監偵手段嚴密掌握相關動態,並檢派任務機、艦及岸置飛彈系統進行適切應處。此外,國軍年度「漢光42號」實兵演習於8月14日落幕,演習自8月5日至14日共實施10天9夜。 Taiwan Detects 10 PLA Aircraft Near Island, 6 Crossing Strait Median Line Taiwan detected 10 PLA aircraft operating around the island, with 6 crossing the Taiwan Strait median line. Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense announced on August 15 that starting from 8:28 AM, 10 sorties of Chinese military aircraft were detected operating off the island. The aircraft types included J-11, JH-7, and Su-30 fighters. Among them, 6 sorties crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait, entering airspace over northern and central Taiwan in coordination with Chinese naval vessels during a joint combat readiness patrol. a-20260815-1413-starlux-airlines-takes-d.text: 星宇航空空山金藝術機抵台20日首航東京成田 星宇航空第二架藝術機空山金抵達台灣;八月二十日將首航東京成田 星宇航空與日本藝術家空山基合作的第二架A350-1000藝術機「空山金」(機身編號 B-58554)於法國時間8月14日完成交機,並於8月16日上午9時43分順利抵達桃園機場。 該機規劃於8月20日正式執飛台北往返東京成田的JX800首航航班。為了展示該藝術機,星宇航空也規劃於東京成田國際機場(NRT)讓「空山金」與首架「空山銀」並肩亮相,並於8月26日飛航曼谷。 隨著該機加入,星宇航空整體機隊規模已達36架,其中包含4架A350-1000型客機。星宇航空表示,該型機具備遠程飛航與高載客量優勢,將持續支撐中長程航網成長。 Starlux Airlines Art Aircraft AIRSORAYAMA GOLD Arrives in Taiwan Starlux Airlines art aircraft AIRSORAYAMA GOLD arrived in Taiwan before its August 20 Tokyo debut. a-20260815-1413-london-heathrow-flooding.text: 倫敦希斯洛機場(LHR)水管破裂淹水 聯合與美國及達美航廈道路受阻 倫敦希斯洛機場爆水管導致周邊道路淹水,聯合、美國與達美航廈道路中斷。 倫敦希斯洛機場(LHR)周邊一條主水管破裂引發淹水,導致中央航廈附近的道路遭水淹沒,造成現場旅客與工作人員受困滯留。 這起積水事件已切斷並關閉通往 United、American 與 Delta 航廈的道路交通,使得相關航廈的陸路連結無法通行。 淹水區域主要集中於希斯洛機場中央航廈周邊幹道,受影響的航廈包含 United、American 及 Delta 航廈。 根據 Simple Flying 消息,道路關閉致使車輛無法正常進入該區,使得現場旅客與工作人員遭滯留於當地。 London Heathrow (LHR) Flooding Cuts Road Access to United, American, and Delta Terminals Flooding from a burst water main at London Heathrow blocked road access to United, American, and Delta terminals. a-20260815-1915-ryanair-abruptly-pulls-o.text: 瑞安航空突撤出亞速群島停飛六條航線砍40萬座位 瑞安航空撤出亞速群島停飛6條航線;大幅削減40萬個座位衝擊旅遊業。 根據Simple Flying報導,瑞安航空(Ryanair)突然決定撤出亞速群島(Azores)市場。這項突發的營運調整將直接關閉當地的6條航線,並於市場中削減多達400,000個航班座位。 航線的停飛與400,000個座位的移除,打亂了當地的季節性觀光客流量。這項座位供給的大幅減少,對於高度仰賴定期航班客流的島嶼旅遊業造成了衝擊與干擾。 報導另外指出,瑞安航空的突然撤出對該島嶼群地區的國內生產毛額(GDP)造成約1.5%的影響。6條航線的關閉不僅影響旅遊流量,也對當地的季節性經濟發展產生負面效果。 Ryanair Abruptly Pulls Out Of Azores, Closing Six Routes And 400,000 Seats Ryanair abruptly pulls out of Azores; six routes closed and 400,000 seasonal seats cut. metadata.title: 桃園機場第二航廈電梯故障23人受困均已安全脫困

a-20260816-0340-twenty-three-people-trap.text: 桃園機場第二航廈電梯故障23人受困均已安全脫困 桃園機場第二航廈電梯發生故障;23名旅客受困近一小時後順利安全脫困 桃園國際機場(TPE)今日上午發生旅客受困電梯事件。第二航廈北側擴建區的N7電梯於上午9時40分發出緊急告警,經機場公司透過監視系統確認,共有23名民眾受困於電梯內。機場公司立即派員並通知電梯維修廠商前往現場搶修。 由於期間有部分旅客反映身體不適,桃園機場公司同步通知醫療單位與桃園市政府消防局派遣救護人員到場待命。經維護人員緊急處置,電梯門於上午10時34分順利開啟,受困的23名民眾安全脫困,經醫療人員現場確認後身體狀況皆無大礙。 據了解,星宇航空的「空山金」彩繪機於16日上午降落桃園機場,吸引大批航空迷前往觀景台守候。部分受困民眾在社群平台上發文表示,因受困電梯而遺憾錯過該班彩繪機。機場公司對此事件致歉,並表示將釐清故障原因與加強設備巡檢。 Twenty-Three People Trapped in Taoyuan Airport Elevator Safely Freed 23 people trapped in a Taoyuan Airport elevator were safely rescued after nearly one hour. An elevator malfunction occurred at Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) on the morning of August 16, trapping 23 people. The N7 elevator located in the North Expansion Area of Terminal 2 triggered an emergency alarm at 9:40 AM. The Taoyuan International Airport Corporation dispatched maintenance personnel and elevator technicians immediately after confirming the situation. As some trapped passengers reported feeling unwell, medical personnel and the Taoyuan City Fire Department were also dispatched to stand by. Maintenance workers successfully opened the elevator doors at 10:34 AM, freeing all 23 individuals, who were found to be in stable condition after medical checkups. The incident occurred as aviation enthusiasts gathered to watch Starlux Airlines' 'Kong Shan Jin' livery aircraft land. Some trapped individuals posted online that they missed the aircraft due to the incident. The airport company apologized and promised to investigate the cause. metadata.title: 班加羅爾HAL機場啟用直升機RNP CAT H進場程序,將進場時間縮短至4分鐘

a-20260816-0723-bengaluru-hal-airport-op.text: 班加羅爾HAL機場啟用直升機RNP CAT H進場程序,將進場時間縮短至4分鐘 印度班加羅爾HAL機場啟用直升機專用衛星導航程序;進場時間縮短至4分鐘。 印度班加羅爾的HAL機場已正式啟用「H類所需導航性能」(RNP CAT H)直升機進場程序,成為印度首個啟用此類專用程序的機場。該系統採用精確的衛星導航技術,引導直升機沿著針對旋翼機飛行特性設計的三維飛行路徑降落,將直升機進場時間從原本的約12分鐘顯著縮短至4分鐘。 這項新進場程序由印度機場管理局(AAI)負責開發,並由印度航空工業公司(HAL)的測試飛行員完成試飛驗證,最終獲得印度民用航空總局(DGCA)的營運批准。此程序旨在於惡劣天氣條件下提升直升機的機場進出能力,同時讓旋翼機得以遵循更高效且可預測的航線運作。 大幅縮短進場時間能提升緊急醫療救護、搜救任務、災害應變及政府緊急航班的營運反應效率,並降低飛行員在關鍵階段的工作負擔。此外,更直接的進場路線亦能減少不必要的航程、降低燃油消耗,並減少航行於人口密集區域上空的時間,進而降低整體噪音影響。HAL董事局主席兼總經理拉維·K(Ravi K)表示,此項成果是印度航空生態系統的重要里程碑。 在班加羅爾HAL機場啟用該程序的大約一個月前,印度甫於安得拉邦的雲達瓦里直升機場(Undavalli Heliport)批准了該國首個直升機點對點(PinS)儀表進場程序。相較於主要用於缺乏傳統儀表設施之直升機場的PinS程序,HAL機場的RNP CAT H程序是印度首個在直升機與定翼機共用之機場環境中投入營運的系統。 Bengaluru HAL Airport Operationalises RNP CAT H Approach, Cutting Helicopter Arrival Times Bengaluru's HAL Airport operationalises RNP CAT H helicopter approach, reducing arrival times from 12 to four minutes. HAL Airport in Bengaluru has operationalised a Required Navigation Performance Category H (RNP CAT H) approach procedure specifically designed for helicopters, becoming the first airport in India to deploy such a system. The precision satellite-guided flight path allows rotorcraft to follow three-dimensional arrival routes tailored to their flight characteristics, cutting approach times from around 12 minutes down to roughly four minutes. The procedure was developed by the Airports Authority of India (AAI), validated through flight trials conducted by HAL test pilots, and granted operational approval by the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA). Designed around rotorcraft performance capabilities—including the ability to slow rapidly, fly steeper approach profiles, and operate at lower speeds—the system enhances airport access during poor weather conditions while enabling safer navigation around terrain and urban obstacles. The eight-minute reduction in approach times is intended to improve operational responsiveness and reduce pilot workload during critical missions, including emergency medical flights, search and rescue, disaster response, and urgent government operations. Direct satellite-based routing also reduces unnecessary track miles, cuts fuel consumption, and decreases time spent over densely populated areas, thereby lowering the overall noise footprint. Ravi K, Chairman and Managing Director of HAL, described the operationalisation as a significant milestone for India’s aviation ecosystem. The operational milestone comes barely a month after India approved its first Point-in-Space (PinS) instrument approach procedure for helicopters at Undavalli Heliport in Andhra Pradesh. While PinS procedures are designed primarily for heliports without conventional instrument infrastructure, the new RNP CAT H procedure at HAL Airport represents the country's first system operationalised in an airport environment shared by helicopters and fixed-wing aircraft. a-20260816-0918-retired-german-luftwaffe.text: 德軍退役C-160D運輸機將改裝為裝甲滅火機 TAS計劃於2027年啟用首架退役C-160D改裝滅火機 根據 AeroTime 報導,總部位於德國下薩克森邦的 Total Aeronautical Services (TAS) 計劃將兩架自德國空軍退役的 Transall C-160D 運輸機改裝為消防滅火機。首架改裝機已被分配民用航空註冊號 D-AMJT,預計於 2027 年夏季野火季投入營運,並獲得德國聯邦航空局(LBA)和德國聯邦國防軍採購局(BAAINBw)的支持。 該機將保留軍役時期配備的 Kevlar 防彈裝甲,以便在含有未爆彈的演習場等高風險區域滅火。改裝使用貨艙內的 Helitak 水箱,可攜帶約 14 噸水或阻燃劑,並透過機腹以每秒 3000 公升的速度排放。 Retired German Luftwaffe Transall C-160D Airlifters to Return as Armored Firefighting Aircraft TAS plans to deploy the first converted C-160D for the 2027 wildfire season. According to AeroTime, Germany-based Total Aeronautical Services (TAS) is preparing two retired German Air Force Transall C-160D airlifters to return to service as firefighting aircraft. The operator aims to have the first aircraft, allocated registration D-AMJT, operational for the summer 2027 wildfire season with support from Germany's Federal Aviation Office (LBA) and Bundeswehr procurement agency BAAINBw. The converted aircraft will retain Kevlar armor from their military service to allow operations over ground contaminated by unexploded ordnance, where ground crews cannot safely enter. The firefighting system features an internal Helitak tank in the cargo hold carrying approximately 14 tonnes of water or retardant, discharging through the belly at up to 3,000 liters per second. a-20260816-2012-american-airlines-launch.text: 美國航空2026年開辦六條跨大西洋直飛航線 美國航空於2026年開辦六條跨大西洋直飛航線,連接美國樞紐與愛丁堡等六城。 美國航空於2026年正式開辦六條全新的跨大西洋直飛航線。這項航線佈局旨在連結美國境內的樞紐機場與多個國際主要城市,進一步拓展其跨大西洋網路服務。 根據相關訊息,美國航空此次新增的直飛服務將連接美國樞紐機場與愛丁堡、布達佩斯、布拉格、雅典、蘇黎世以及米蘭。相關航線提供直飛客運服務,加強美國與這些城市之間的空中航線網路。 此項營運調整代表美國航空在2026年持續擴展其橫跨大西洋的客運航線網路,透過新增的直飛航點,為往返美國樞紐與這些城市的旅客提供直飛營運路線。 American Airlines Launches 6 New Nonstop Transatlantic Routes in 2026 American Airlines launches six new nonstop transatlantic routes in 2026 connecting US hubs with Edinburgh, Zurich and Milan. American Airlines has launched six new nonstop transatlantic routes in 2026 to expand its international service offerings. The new nonstop flights connect major US hubs directly with destinations across the Atlantic, expanding the carrier's global network footprint. The expanded transatlantic network connects US hubs with six destinations, including Edinburgh, Budapest, Prague, Athens, Zurich, and Milan. These nonstop services enhance connectivity between key American hubs and international transatlantic locations. a-20260816-2304-de-havilland-secures-38-.text: 德哈維蘭水陸兩棲滅火機接單38架 首批預計2028年交付 德哈維蘭手握38架滅火機訂單;首批最快2028年交貨;評估擴建產線。 加拿大製造商德哈維蘭已收到來自法國、西班牙、希臘、義大利與葡萄牙等國共計38架Canadair水陸兩棲滅火飛機的訂單。然而受限於零件供應與手工組裝程序,首批2架飛機最快僅能在2028年交付。 目前德哈維蘭廠房在全負載運作下,每年僅能產出約10架滅火機,新訂單交期已排至2032年至2033年。該系列機型最初於1960年代推出,1986年由龐巴迪收購,並於2015年停產,隨後由德哈維蘭於2022年重啟生產線。 為滿足需求,德哈維蘭正評估擴建第二條生產線。若加拿大聯邦政府發出50架的確定訂單,該公司將可立即著手籌建,預計將年產量提升至20架。據政府資料推估,每架飛機售價約為8000萬加元。 De Havilland Secures 38 Orders for Canadair Water Bombers With Deliveries From 2028 De Havilland holds 38 Canadair firefighter orders; initial deliveries set for 2028; second production line under review. metadata.title: DH.88古董飛機於英國老沃登機場降落翻覆受損

a-20260816-2304-historic-dh-88-comet-ove.text: DH.88古董飛機於英國老沃登機場降落翻覆受損 DH.88古董機降落翻覆受損;飛行員獲救送醫已出院;發生於航空展期間 一架於1934年贏得麥克羅伯遜環球航線飛行競賽的 de Havilland DH.88 Comet G-ACSS 飛機,於2026年8月15日在英國貝德福德郡的老沃登機場降落時發生翻覆事故,並遭受嚴重損壞。 根據 Shuttleworth Trust 說明,事故發生於當地時間約 19:20 的 Flying Proms 航空展期間,當時機上僅有一名機組員。緊急救援人員隨後將飛行員救出並送往醫院進行檢查,Shuttleworth 後續證實該名飛行員已經出院。 這架 G-ACSS 為目前全球唯一具備適航狀態的 DH.88 飛機。英國航空事故調查局在報導發布時尚未就此起事故發表評論。 Historic DH.88 Comet Overturns on Landing at Old Warden Aerodrome Shuttleworth DH.88 Comet overturns on landing in Bedfordshire; pilot discharged after hospital evaluation. The de Havilland DH.88 Comet G-ACSS, which won the 1934 MacRobertson England to Australia air race, overturned on landing at Old Warden aerodrome in Bedfordshire, United Kingdom, on August 15, 2026, sustaining extensive damage. The Shuttleworth Trust stated that the accident occurred at approximately 19:20 local time during its Flying Proms air show with one crew member on board. Emergency services extracted the pilot, who was responding at the scene and taken to hospital for assessment, with Shuttleworth later confirming the pilot was discharged. The G-ACSS airframe remains the only airworthy example of the DH.88 model. At the time of reporting, the UK Air Accidents Investigation Branch had not issued a comment regarding the event. 1934年贏得賽事的 de Havilland DH.88 Comet G-ACSS 飛機,於2026年8月15日在英國貝德福德郡老沃登機場降落時翻覆並遭受嚴重損壞。 The de Havilland DH.88 Comet G-ACSS “Grosvenor House”, the aircraft that won the 1934 MacRobertson England to Australia air race, overturned on landing at Old Warden aerodrome in Bedfordshire, United Kingdom, on August 15, 2026, sustaining extensive damage. a-20260816-2304-air-india-a320neo-briefl.text: 印度航空A320neo飛行失控致24人傷 印度航空A320neo失控俯衡300英尺致24傷事件 印度航空班機AI2379於2026年8月4日從普吉起飛,執行飛往德里的航班。 在此航班中,該機的關鍵飛行控制系統突然喪失,持續時間約為四秒。 這四秒的控制喪失使航空機俯衡約三百英尺,相當於急遽下降。 事件導致機上二十四人受傷,來源未說明具體傷勢。 根據路透社報導,空中巴士的初步分析顯示該客機失去全部三套液壓系統。 空中巴士因此請求檢查A320neo的液壓、感測器與線路。 來源未提及飛機是否已安全著陸或後續維修情況。 Air India A320neo Loses Flight Controls, 24 Injured in 300‐Foot Plunge After Phuket‐Delhi Flight on August 4, 2026 Air India A320neo loses controls, 24 hurt in 300‐ft drop Air India flight AI2379 departed Phuket on August 4, 2026, bound for Delhi on a scheduled service. metadata.title: 美陸軍選定羅賓遜R66直升機 執行百億美元飛行訓練計畫
airline: University of North Dakota Aerospace Foundation

a-20260816-2304-us-army-selects-m1-suppo.text: 美陸軍選定羅賓遜R66直升機 執行百億美元飛行訓練計畫 美國陸軍與M1簽署高達百億美元合約;選定R66作為新一代初級直升機教練機 美國陸軍於8月13日宣布,將名為「Flight School Next」的新一代直升機飛行訓練計畫合約,頒發給位於德州丹頓的M1 Support Services L.P.公司。該合約採固定價格、不定量交付(IDIQ)形式,在最長可達26年的執行期內,總金額估計高達100億美元。這項重組計畫將全面變更位於阿拉巴馬州羅克堡(Fort Rucker)的初級旋翼機飛行員培訓模式。 在全新的訓練架構下,美軍選定渦輪動力的羅賓遜(Robinson)R66直升機作為主要教練機,接替現行由空中巴士(Airbus)UH-72 Lakota所擔負的初級飛行訓練任務。軍方指出,這項改採商業化機種的改革,旨在強化新進飛行員的基礎飛行技巧,同時大幅降低初級旋翼機訓練的長期成本。 「Flight School Next」計畫標誌著美國陸軍從傳統依賴軍方自有訓練直升機,轉型為「承包商所有、承包商營運」(COCO)的商業模式。M1公司將整併多項航空訓練功能,提供商用直升機、模擬機、飛行與學科教學、機務維護及各項後勤支援服務。 該訓練體系預估每年可培訓800名至1,500名陸軍直升機飛行員。目前美軍每年在羅克堡培訓約1,250名新進飛行員。軍方表示,這項計畫將以單一整合系統取代過去分散的多項訓練合約。 在最終決選階段,M1團隊以五人座的羅賓遜R66直升機方案,擊敗了提出Bell 505競標的貝爾(Bell)公司。羅賓遜R66搭載勞斯萊斯(Rolls-Royce)RR300渦輪軸發動機;M1團隊成員則包含羅賓遜直升機公司、Quantum Helicopters、通用動力資訊科技,以及北達科他大學航太基金會等單位。 US Army Selects Robinson R66 Helicopter for $10B Flight School Next Program US Army selects M1 Support Services and Robinson R66 turbine helicopters for new training program. The US Army announced that it has awarded the Flight School Next training contract to M1 Support Services L.P., headquartered in Denton, Texas. The fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity agreement is valued at up to $10 billion over a total potential execution period of 26 years. The decision represents a comprehensive overhaul of initial rotary-wing pilot instruction at Fort Rucker, Alabama. Under the Flight School Next initiative, the turbine-powered Robinson R66 will become the US Army's primary helicopter training platform. The R66 will assume the foundational training role currently executed by the larger Airbus UH-72 Lakota fleet. The program aims to strengthen foundational flying skills while reducing overall long-term costs associated with initial rotary-wing training. The contract transitions the service away from relying on Army-owned primary training aircraft toward a contractor-owned, contractor-operated structure. M1 Support Services will consolidate multiple aviation training functions into a single integrated system, providing commercially available aircraft, flight simulators, academic instruction, flight teaching, maintenance, and technical support. Flight School Next is designed to deliver initial entry rotary-wing flight training for between 800 and 1,500 new military pilots each year. For context, the US Army currently trains approximately 1,250 new aviators annually at Fort Rucker, maintaining one of the largest active pilot pools globally. M1's winning bid centered on the five-seat Robinson R66 powered by a Rolls-Royce RR300 turboshaft engine, defeating a rival proposal from Bell that offered the Bell 505. M1's project team includes Robinson Helicopter, Quantum Helicopters, General Dynamics Information Technology, and the University of North Dakota Aerospace Foundation. a-20260816-2304-taiwan-legislature-passe.text: 立法院三讀通過115年總預算 442億無人載具計畫分6年平均編列 立法院三讀通過115年度總預算;442億元無人載具計畫須分6年平均編列 立法院會2026年8月14日三讀通過中華民國115年度中央政府總預算案,原列歲出總額為3兆349億7437萬1000元,審議結果共計減列480億元。 針對行政院訂定為期6年、新台幣442億元的「無人載具產業發展統籌型計畫」,國民黨團與民眾黨團共提主決議,要求行政院應責成經濟部將442億元預算分6年平均編列,每年不得超過平均編列數。 國民黨團發布新聞稿指出,全力支持發展無人機產業與強化國防,針對經濟部6年442億元「無人載具產業發展統籌型計畫」及行政院各部會編列的192億元採購預算,合計634億全數通過,並排除在總預算通刪1.5%之外。 主決議提案指出,行政院核定6年期(114-119)「無人載具產業發展統籌型計畫」,於公務預算共匡列總經費442億元,由經濟部統籌協調,跨部會共同建構無人機產業推動機制。提案表示,為強化國內無人機產業能量與供應鏈韌性,打造民主供應鏈亞太中心,每年投入經費不宜大幅波動。 提案另指出,除國防軍用無人機採購外,其餘各部會非軍規無人機採購得依照「共同供應契約實施辦法」辦理,杜絕重複編列預算或特權統包後再轉包以規避監督。統籌型計畫執行期間各部會如有新增相關無人載具計畫應納入者,須經行政院核定後始得執行。 此前,美國政府於2026年8月13日宣布依據「1962年貿易擴張法」第232條對全球進口無人機系統及其零組件加徵關稅,台灣相關產品適用15%稅率且不疊加MFN。經濟部已推動工研院成為美國Green UAS境外唯一認證據點,並促成金屬中心對接Blue UAS認證,協助業者符合美方認驗證要求。 Taiwan Legislature Passes FY2026 Budget; NT$44.2B Drone Vehicle Plan to Be Evenly Allocated Over 6 Years Legislature passes FY2026 budget; NT$44.2B unmanned vehicle plan must be evenly allocated over six years Taiwan's Legislative Yuan passed the third reading of the Republic of China FY2026 central government budget on August 14, 2026. The original total expenditure was set at NT$3.0349 trillion, with a net reduction of NT$48 billion after deliberation. Regarding the Executive Yuan's six-year, NT$44.2 billion "Unmanned Vehicle Industry Development Coordinated Program," the Kuomintang and Taiwan People's Party caucuses co-sponsored a resolution requiring the Executive Yuan to instruct the Ministry of Economic Affairs to allocate the NT$44.2 billion evenly over six years, with annual spending not exceeding the average amount. The Kuomintang caucus stated its full support for developing the drone industry and strengthening national defense, noting that the Ministry of Economic Affairs' six-year NT$44.2 billion program plus NT$19.2 billion in procurement budgets across Executive Yuan agencies, totaling NT$63.4 billion, were all approved and excluded from the 1.5% across-the-board budget cut. The resolution stated that the Executive Yuan approved the six-year (FY2025-2030) program with NT$44.2 billion in public budget funds, coordinated by the Ministry of Economic Affairs across agencies to build a drone industry promotion mechanism. It cited the need to strengthen domestic drone industry capacity and supply chain resilience to create a democratic supply chain Asia-Pacific hub, noting that annual funding should not fluctuate significantly. The resolution further specified that apart from defense military drone procurement, other agencies' non-military drone procurements may follow the Common Supply Contract Implementation Regulations to prevent duplicate budget allocations or privileged subcontracting to evade oversight. Any new unmanned vehicle projects added during the program period must be approved by the Executive Yuan before implementation. Separately, the US government announced on August 13, 2026, that it would impose tariffs on globally imported unmanned aircraft systems and components pursuant to Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962, with Taiwan's relevant products subject to a 15% tariff not stacked on MFN. The Ministry of Economic Affairs has facilitated ITRI as the sole overseas Green UAS certification site and the Metal Industries Research & Development Centre in connecting with Blue UAS certification to help manufacturers meet US requirements. a-20260816-2304-lufthansa-in-discussions.text: 漢莎航空確認與波音協商 擬拒絕接收早期生產777-9客機 漢莎航空執行長證實,正與波音協商拒絕接收部分早期生產的777-9客機。 漢莎航空執行長卡斯騰·斯波爾(Carsten Spohr)於第二季法說會中證實,公司正與波音就早期生產的777-9客機進行協商。相關討論包含漢莎航空將直接拒絕接收哪些早期生產機型,以及哪些客機在提升至最新標準後仍可被接收,且波音將為該升級作業提供部分資金支持。 漢莎航空已成為第二家表明不願接收部分最早建造777-9客機的大型波音777X客戶。此外,波音公司先前於2026年7月表示,777X計畫已獲得美國聯邦航空局(FAA)批准展開認證飛行測試,並持續預期於2027年進行首次交付。 Lufthansa In Discussions With Boeing To Reject Early Production 777-9 Aircraft Lufthansa CEO confirms ongoing discussions with Boeing regarding rejection of early production 777-9 aircraft. Lufthansa CEO Carsten Spohr confirmed during the airline's second-quarter earnings call that discussions are currently underway with Boeing regarding early-production 777-9 aircraft. a-20260816-2304-trump-orders-future-ford.text: 川普下令福特級新航艦USS Doris Miller改裝蒸汽彈射器 美國總統川普下令第四艘福特級航艦移除電磁彈射並改用傳統蒸汽彈射器 美國總統川普於2026年8月13日簽署備忘錄,指示五角大廈將第四艘福特級航艦「USS Doris Miller」改裝蒸汽彈射器以取代電磁彈射系統(EMALS),並將先進武器升降機改為液壓系統。 正在建造中的「USS Doris Miller」(CVN-81)由紐波特紐斯造船廠承造,預計於2026年底安放龍骨並於2034年初交付。此項決策並不影響「USS Gerald R. a-20260816-2304-aidc-evaluates-us-drone-.text: 美國實施無人機關稅 漢翔評估若有訂單將赴美生產 面對美國徵收無人機關稅,漢翔表示若客戶提出在地需求且有訂單將評估赴美生產。 美國總統川普於8月13日宣布,對進口無人機及其零組件加徵關稅,對台灣、歐盟、日本及韓國等盟友產品課徵15%關稅。面對美國推動無人機供應鏈在地化政策,台灣航太大廠漢翔於14日表示,若美國客戶提出在地製造需求且具備實際訂單,將評估於美國廠生產無人機。 工研院已與美國無人產業協會簽署協議,成為 Green UAS 境外首家認可評鑑機構,漢翔並已攜手學界送驗無人機產品。此外,漢翔先前於法說會指出,其美國廠預計今年完成航太品質驗證,展開發動機零件投產,維繫供應鏈優勢。 AIDC Evaluates US Drone Production Option Following New US Import Tariffs AIDC states it will evaluate US drone manufacturing if requested by clients with actual orders following tariffs. US President Donald Trump announced new tariffs on imported drones and components on August 13, imposing a 15 percent tariff on products from allies including Taiwan, the European Union, Japan, and South Korea. In response to the shift toward localized supply chains, Taiwanese aerospace manufacturer AIDC stated on August 14 that it will evaluate manufacturing drones at its facility in the United States if US customers request local production backed by firm orders. To support verification, ITRI signed an agreement with the Association for Uncrewed Vehicle Systems International to evaluate Green UAS standards, while AIDC has submitted its first drone product for verification. AIDC previously noted that its US plant is scheduled to complete aerospace quality verification this year to begin producing engine parts.
