a-20260820-1020-singapore-airlines-expan.text: 新加坡航空擴展歐洲航網增飛馬德里與多國航點 新加坡航空開辦馬德里新航線並增加倫敦米蘭等歐洲多國航班班次 新加坡航空(SIA)於2026年8月4日宣布擴展歐洲航線網路,除了提高多個主要歐洲城市的航班班次外,亦將開闢前往西班牙馬德里的新航線。航空公司表示,此次航線擴展旨在因應經由新加坡樟宜機場(SIN)轉機前往歐洲日益增加的旅客需求。 新加坡航空將自2026年10月26日起,開辦經由西班牙巴塞隆納往返新加坡與馬德里的航線,每週提供5個班次。這項新航線使馬德里成為該航空公司在歐洲的第15個航點,同時也是在西班牙的第2個航點。該航線將採用253座位的空中巴士 A350-900(ICAO機型代碼A359)長程客機執飛。 在英國航線方面,新加坡航空前往曼徹斯特的航班將從每週5班增加至每日1班。在倫敦蓋特威克機場(LGW),航空公司將於2026年北半球冬季航季期間,將第2個每日班次提升為全每日營運,配合現有的SQ312與SQ309每日航班。結合前往倫敦希斯洛機場(LHR)的每日4班服務,新加坡航空往返倫敦的航班總數將達到每日最多6班。 在歐洲大陸航點方面,前往義大利米蘭的航班將自2026年10月25日起從每週4班增加至每日1班。次日即2026年10月26日,將推出每週3班前往德國慕尼黑的新服務,使新加坡航空往返慕尼黑的每週航班總數達到10班。 新加坡航空菲律賓分公司總經理 Liwei Tai 表示,歐洲持續為熱門旅遊目的地,此次航線網路升級反映了航空公司致力於透過更多選擇與更佳連通性來滿足市場需求。新增馬德里航點以及增加曼徹斯特、倫敦蓋特威克機場、米蘭與慕尼黑的航班,將為亞太地區旅客提供經由新加坡前往歐洲更便捷的轉機選擇。 Singapore Airlines Expands European Network with New Madrid Service and Flight Increases Singapore Airlines expands European flights with a new Madrid route and increased service to key destinations. metadata.title: 美研究指機組員輻射致癌死亡風險居各行業之冠

a-20260820-1228-us-study-finds-aircrew-f.text: 美研究指機組員輻射致癌死亡風險居各行業之冠 美研究顯示機組員輻射致癌死亡風險最高;工會呼籲主管機關實施劑量監測。 據新聞媒體 AeroTime 報導,發表於《美國醫學會雜誌:內科學》(JAMA Internal Medicine)的一項最新研究指出,在美國針對503種職業所進行的分析中,空服員與機師因輻射相關癌症死亡的風險居所有職業之冠,甚至高於直接接觸放射性物質的工人。該研究由哈佛醫學院的維沙爾·帕特爾博士(Dr. Vishal Patel)主持,透過國家衛生統計系統分析2020年至2024年間超過1,200萬份美國死亡證明資料,涵蓋約14,000名機師與7,000名空服員。 研究顯示,在考量各項職業差異後,空服員因輻射相關癌症死亡的機率比一般工作人口高出約50%,機師則高出約36%。在絕對比例方面,輻射相關癌症占空服員總死亡人數的6.9%,占機師總死亡人數的6.7%,而一般工作人口的比例為5%。研究團隊針對白血病、淋巴腫瘤、多發性骨髓瘤以及皮膚癌、乳癌、甲狀腺癌、前列腺癌和中樞神經系統癌症等與輻射相關的癌症進行分析,並排除肺癌以避免吸菸因素干擾結果。 研究人員指出,這兩類機組人員在與輻射無關的癌症死亡率上並未顯著偏高,此一現象顯示其較高的致癌風險更可能源於職場環境中的宇宙輻射暴露,而非生活方式或社會經濟因素。根據美國疾病管制與預防中心(CDC)估計,機組人員每年因飛行航線不同,可能累積3至6毫西弗的宇宙輻射劑量,相較之下,一般旅客每年搭乘約10趟跨國或跨洲來回航班所接收的輻射量僅約0.4毫西弗。 雖然美國聯邦航空管理局(FAA)已正式將機師與空服員列為職業性游離輻射暴露群體,但與其他產業的輻射暴露工人或部分國家的機組人員不同,美國目前並未對機組人員實施聯邦輻射劑量上限或強制監測要求。隨附於研究報告的專家評論指出,現代排班模式已大幅減少過往認為導致皮膚癌的高日照停留時間,因此駕駛艙與客艙內的輻射暴露更是主要的風險來源,建議對高空航線機組人員實施定期皮膚檢查與相應篩檢。 研究結果公布後,代表20家航空公司共55,000名空服員的北美空服員協會(AFA-CWA)理事長莎拉·尼爾森(Sara Nelson)發表聲明,呼籲將輻射相關癌症死亡正式認定為因公職災死亡。尼爾森指出,雖然輻射風險已知,但機組人員未獲得相關資訊或培訓,且缺乏明確監管,與歐洲標準不同,FAA至今仍未要求航空公司監測組員的輻射暴露量。工會要求航空業與主管機關採取具體預防措施,並提供職業死亡相關的照護與撫恤保障。 US Study Finds Aircrew Face Highest Risk of Radiation-Linked Cancer Deaths US study finds pilots and flight attendants face highest radiation cancer mortality; union demands FAA dose monitoring. According to news outlet AeroTime, a new study published in JAMA Internal Medicine has found that US flight attendants and pilots face the highest risk of dying from radiation-related cancers among 503 occupations evaluated, surpassing even workers who directly handle radioactive materials. The research, led by Dr. Vishal Patel of Harvard Medical School, analyzed more than 12 million US death certificates from 2020 to 2024 drawn from the National Vital Statistics System. The dataset covered nearly 13 million decedents across 503 occupations, including approximately 14,000 pilots and 7,000 flight attendants. The study revealed that flight attendants had roughly 50% higher odds of dying from a radiation-related cancer compared to the general working population, while pilots faced approximately 36% higher odds. In absolute terms, radiation-linked cancers accounted for about 6.9% of flight attendant deaths and 6.7% of pilot deaths, compared with 5% among the general working workforce. Researchers examined deaths from radiation-associated cancers, including leukemia, lymphoma, multiple myeloma, and cancers of the skin, breast, thyroid, prostate, and central nervous system, while explicitly excluding lung cancer to avoid confounding from smoking-related factors. Neither pilots nor flight attendants exhibited elevated mortality rates from cancers unrelated to radiation. Researchers stated this pattern points to workplace cosmic radiation exposure rather than lifestyle or socioeconomic variables as the primary driver. According to data cited from the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, aircrew accumulate an estimated three to six millisieverts of cosmic radiation per year depending on flight paths. This is significantly higher than the approximately 0.4 millisieverts an average air traveler receives annually from about ten cross-country round-trip flights. While the Federal Aviation Administration formally recognizes pilots and flight attendants as occupationally exposed to ionizing radiation, US aircrew are not subject to federal dose limits or monitoring requirements, unlike radiation-exposed workers in other industries or flight crews in certain other jurisdictions. Commentary accompanying the study noted that modern airline scheduling has largely eliminated the extended layovers once thought to explain high skin cancer rates, pointing instead to cockpit and cabin radiation exposure during high-altitude flights as the principal cause. Following the publication, Sara Nelson, President of the Association of Flight Attendants-CWA, which represents 55,000 flight attendants across 20 airlines, called for radiation-related cancer deaths among aircrew to be formally recognized as occupational deaths. Nelson highlighted that unlike European regulatory frameworks, the FAA does not require airlines to monitor crew exposure to radiation, urging regulators and the aviation industry to establish clear exposure limits, monitoring standards, and medical oversight for flight personnel. a-20260820-1228-taiwan-s-mnd-says-f-16v-.text: F-16V無法如期全數交機 國防部研擬修特別條例延期限 國防部:66架F-16V因產線排擠無法年底前全數交機,未支用預算將報行政院保留,修訂條例研擬中 國防部依「新式戰機採購特別條例」對美軍購66架F-16V(blk70)戰機,原訂今年底條例到期前全數交機,因產線排擠等因素無法如期完成。國防部8月20日表示,未支用預算將呈報行政院辦理保留,至於是否修訂條例延長期限,現正研擬中,以確保國軍最大權益。 國防部資源司財資處長高志雄少將在下午舉行的記者會中說明,新式戰機採購特別條例在108年由國防部與美軍簽約,屬於已發生債務的契約責任,今年若無法順利支付,將依照預算法、各機關預算作業執行要點呈報行政院辦理保留預算。 空軍透過代號「鳳翔專案」,編列新台幣2472億2883萬元、109年至115年持續性預算,籌購全新66架F-16V(blk70)戰機。由於按特別條例期程,必須在年底前(115年)全數交機,但因產線排擠等因素今年無法如期完成,外界關注是否會修訂條例延長期限。 空軍另以代號「鳳展專案」,由美商洛克希德馬丁與漢翔將140架F-16A/B戰機升級為F-16V(blk20),已在112年12月全數完成。 針對F-16V(blk70)戰機是否近期飛返台灣,國防部副發言人喬福駿少將僅說明,空軍正依規劃全力推動接裝整備工作,管制在計劃節點執行飛返,具體時間仍屬於保密階段,無法說明。 本站紀錄顯示,首批2架F-16V(blk70)戰機已於美東時間8月17日自美國起飛,預計近期飛抵台灣,途中將進行空中加油並停留整備。新購戰機原規劃今年全數返台,因產線搬遷及供應鏈中斷等因素影響有所延宕,美方正採雙班制趕工。 Taiwan's MND says F-16V deliveries cannot meet year-end deadline, mulls special law amendment MND: 66 F-16V fighters delayed by production line constraints; unused budget to be reserved with Executive Yuan; law amendment under study Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense (MND) procured 66 F-16V (blk70) fighters from the United States under the New Fighter Procurement Special Act, originally scheduled for full delivery before the act expires at year-end. Due to production line constraints, the deliveries cannot be completed on time. The MND stated on August 20 that unused budget will be reported to the Executive Yuan for reservation, and whether to amend the act to extend the deadline is currently under study to ensure the military's maximum interests. Maj. Gen. Kao Chih-hsiung, director of the Finance and Information Division of the Resource Planning Office, explained at an afternoon press conference that the New Fighter Procurement Special Act was signed by the MND and the US military in 2019, constituting a contractual obligation of incurred debt. If payment cannot be made this year, the budget will be reported to the Executive Yuan for reservation in accordance with the Budget Act and relevant executive guidelines. The air force, under the programme codenamed Feng Hsiang, allocated NT$247.22883 billion in sustained budgets from 2020 to 2026 to procure 66 new F-16V (blk70) fighters. Under the special act's timeline, all deliveries must be completed before year-end (2026), but production line constraints and other factors mean the target cannot be met this year, drawing public attention to whether the act will be amended to extend the deadline. A separate programme, codenamed Feng Jan, upgraded 140 F-16A/B fighters to F-16V (blk20) configuration by Lockheed Martin and Aerospace Industrial Development Corporation (AIDC), and was fully completed in December 2023. Regarding whether F-16V (blk70) fighters will fly back to Taiwan in the near term, MND deputy spokesperson Maj. Gen. Chiao Fu-chun stated only that the air force is pushing forward with receiving preparations according to plan, controlling the return flight at planned milestones, with specific timing remaining classified. AVWIRE records show that the first two F-16V (blk70) fighters departed the United States on August 17 US Eastern Time and are expected to arrive in Taiwan in the near term, with aerial refuelling and stopovers planned en route. The new fighters were originally planned to all return to Taiwan this year but were delayed by production line relocation and supply chain disruptions, with the US side adopting a two-shift schedule to expedite work. 國防部依「新式戰機採購特別條例」對美軍購66架F-16V(blk70)戰機,原訂今年底條例到期前全數交機,因產線排擠無法如期完成。 國防部依「新式戰機採購特別條例」對美軍購66架F-16V(blk70)戰機,原訂今年底條例到期前全數交機,因產線排擠無法如期完成。 國防部表示未支用預算將呈報行政院辦理保留,至於是否修訂條例延長期限,現正研擬中,以確保國軍最大權益。 未支用預算將呈報行政院辦理保留;至於是否修訂條例延長期限,現正研擬中,以確保國軍最大權益。 國防部資源司財資處長高志雄少將說明,新式戰機採購特別條例在108年由國防部與美軍簽約,屬於已發生債務的契約責任,今年若無法順利支付,將依照預算法呈報行政院辦理保留預算。 新式戰機採購特別條例在108年由國防部與美軍簽約,屬於已發生債務的契約責任,今年若無法順利支付,將依照預算法、各機關預算作業執行要點呈報行政院辦理保留預算 空軍透過代號「鳳翔專案」,編列新台幣2472億2883萬元、109年至115年持續性預算,籌購全新66架F-16V(blk70)戰機。 針對鳳翔專案,國防部108年透過「新式戰機採購特別條例」,斥資新台幣2472億2883萬元、109年至115年持續性預算,籌購全新66架F-16V(blk70)戰機 空軍另以代號「鳳展專案」,由美商洛克希德馬丁與漢翔將140架F-16A/B戰機升級為F-16V(blk20),已在112年12月全數完成。 空軍透過代號「鳳展專案」,由美商洛克希德馬丁與漢翔,將140架F-16A/B戰機升級為F-16V(blk20),已在112年12月全數完成 國防部副發言人喬福駿少將說明,空軍正依規劃全力推動接裝整備工作,管制在計劃節點執行飛返,具體時間仍屬保密階段。 空軍正依規劃全力推動接裝整備工作,管制在計劃節點執行飛返,具體時間仍屬於保密階段,無法說明。

metadata.title: 星宇航空空山金與空山銀雙機首度於東京成田機場(NRT)同框展示

a-20260820-1339-starlux-airlines-display.text: 星宇航空空山金與空山銀雙機首度於東京成田機場(NRT)同框展示 星宇航空空山金藝術機20日首飛東京成田;雙機展示並預計10月投入定期航班 星宇航空與日本藝術家空山基合作打造的A350-1000藝術機「空山金」,於2026年8月20日由星宇航空董事長張國煒親自執飛。該航班於台北時間上午8時30分自桃園國際機場(TPE)起飛,並於東京時間中午12時51分順利飛抵東京成田國際機場(NRT)。 本次航班抵達後,「空山金」與「空山銀」首度於東京成田國際機場停機坪並肩同框展示。這也是星宇航空繼「空山銀」於7月亮相後,兩架旗艦級A350-1000藝術機首度共同亮相。 根據星宇航空規劃,這兩架「空山金」與「空山銀」藝術機預計將於2026年10月1日起正式投入定期航班服務,營運航線將涵蓋東京、鳳凰城及布拉格等熱門國際航線。 STARLUX Airlines Displays Sorayama Gold and Silver Aircraft Together at Tokyo Narita STARLUX Airlines flew Sorayama Gold to Tokyo Narita on August 20, displaying twin art aircraft together. STARLUX Airlines Chairman K.W. Chang piloted the carrier's Airbus A350-1000 art livery aircraft, named Sorayama Gold, from Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) to Tokyo Narita International Airport (NRT) on August 20, 2026. The flight departed Taoyuan at 08:30 Taipei time and arrived at Narita at 12:51 Tokyo time. Following its arrival, Sorayama Gold was displayed side-by-side with sister aircraft Sorayama Silver on the apron at Tokyo Narita International Airport. This marked the first time both flagship art aircraft appeared together following the unveiling of Sorayama Silver in July. According to STARLUX Airlines, both art-themed aircraft are scheduled to formally enter regular commercial passenger service starting October 1, 2026. The aircraft will operate on major international routes, including services to Tokyo, Phoenix, and Prague. 星宇航空「空山金」A350-1000藝術機於2026年8月20日由董事長張國煒執飛,自桃園國際機場起飛並飛抵東京成田機場。 「空山金」今天由董事長張國煒執飛,上午自桃園國際機場起飛,飛抵東京成田機場 「空山金」於台北時間2026年8月20日上午8時30分自桃園起飛,並於東京時間中午12時51分抵達東京成田國際機場。 在台北時間上午8時30分自桃園國際機場起飛,並於東京時間中午12時51分順利飛抵東京成田國際機場 星宇航空兩架A350-1000藝術機「空山金」與「空山銀」首度於東京成田國際機場停機坪並肩展示。 兩架旗艦級A350-1000藝術機「空山金」與「空山銀」首度於東京成田國際機場停機坪並肩展示 星宇航空表示,兩架藝術機預計自2026年10月1日起投入定期航班,飛航東京、鳳凰城及布拉格等航線。 兩架藝術機預計自10月1日起正式投入定期航班服務,飛航東京、鳳凰城及布拉格等國際熱門航線 第一架藝術機「空山銀」於2026年7月交機,第二架「空山金」則於8月16日抵達桃園機場。 星宇航空與日本藝術家空山基合作的A350-1000藝術機「空山金」,今天上午9時43分抵達桃園機場

metadata.title: 卡達航空營運全球首架搭載Starlink之波音787-9客機

a-20260820-1525-qatar-airways-begins-ope.text: 卡達航空營運全球首架搭載Starlink之波音787-9客機 卡達航空投入全球首架Starlink波音787-9;廣體機隊改裝已突破83% 卡達航空正式將全球首架配備 Starlink 衛星網路技術的波音 787-9 廣體客機投入商業營運。隨著這架波音 787-9 完成改裝並加入服務,卡達航空旗下配備 Starlink 衛星高速網路系統的廣體客機總數已累積達到 150 架,進一步擴大其全球航空網路的高速空中連線服務能力。 在波音 787 機隊的改裝進度方面,卡達航空僅耗時七個月的時間,便成功完成了波音 787-8 子機隊的 Starlink 衛星網路設備安裝作業。這家總部位於杜哈的航空公司指出,目前整體改裝進度相當順利,並保持在既定計畫軌道上,預計將於 2026 年底之前,完成旗下所有波音 787 機隊的 Starlink 系統鋪設。 在推進波音 787-9 專案之前,卡達航空已展現了快速的設備安裝能力,先前分別僅花費九個月與八個月的時間,順利完成旗下波音 777 機隊與空中巴士 A350 機隊的 Starlink 衛星網路改裝工程,並營運著全球規模最大的波音 777、空中巴士 A350 與波音 787 之 Starlink 機隊。 自 2024 年 10 月首次在機上推出 Starlink 衛星網路服務以來,卡達航空的連線服務已獲得廣泛使用。根據航空公司統計,截至目前為止,已有超過 2300 萬名乘客在超過 8 萬 6000 個航班上連線使用這項空中高速網路服務。 目前卡達航空在整體廣體機隊的 Starlink 改裝進度上,完成率已正式突破 83%,每天營運多達 323 班配備 Starlink 設備的航班。該衛星網路服務提供高達 500 Mbps 的 Wi-Fi 傳輸速度,乘客可透過 Privilege Club 會員身份驗證免費連線,在飛行途中進行工作、與親友保持聯繫或串流影音內容。 Qatar Airways Debuts World's First Starlink-Equipped Boeing 787-9 Qatar Airways operates the first Starlink-equipped Boeing 787-9; widebody fleet installations surpass 83% completion. Qatar Airways has officially debuted the world’s first Starlink-equipped Boeing 787-9 passenger aircraft into commercial service. The milestone entry into service officially brings the Doha-based carrier’s total number of Starlink-equipped widebody aircraft to 150, further expanding high-speed satellite in-flight connectivity across its extensive international route network. The debut of the Starlink-equipped Boeing 787-9 follows the successful completion of the satellite internet rollout across the airline's Boeing 787-8 sub-fleet within a seven-month period. Qatar Airways confirmed that its installation schedule remains fully on track to complete Starlink installations across its entire Boeing 787 fleet by the end of 2026. This latest Boeing 787 milestone follows a series of accelerated installation programs across Qatar Airways' widebody operational fleet. The airline previously finished its Boeing 777 Starlink fleet rollout within nine months and completed its Airbus A350 fleet rollout within eight months, establishing what it describes as the world's largest Starlink-equipped fleets of Boeing 777, Airbus A350, and Boeing 787 aircraft. Since initially launching Starlink connectivity onboard its flights in October 2024, Qatar Airways has observed rapid passenger adoption of the technology. According to data provided by the carrier, more than 23 million passengers have connected to the high-speed satellite Wi-Fi system across more than 86,000 flights operated to date. With the latest installations, Qatar Airways' Starlink program has now surpassed an 83% completion rate across its entire widebody aircraft fleet, with up to 323 Starlink-equipped flights currently operating each day. The satellite Wi-Fi system offers connectivity speeds of up to 500 Mbps, giving passengers the ability to stream content, perform work, or stay connected while airborne, accessible through the airline's Privilege Club membership authentication process. a-20260820-1924-alaska-airlines-plans-se.text: 阿拉斯加航空擬2027年開航巴黎與雅典季節性航線 阿拉斯加航空擴展西雅圖航線;預計2027年直飛巴黎與雅典;與達美航空競爭 根據 Simple Flying 報導,阿拉斯加航空計劃於2027年推出飛往巴黎與雅典的季節性直飛航班。這項開航計畫將為該航空公司新增兩個歐洲季節性直飛航點。 阿拉斯加航空將巴黎與雅典納入航線網路後,其與達美航空在西雅圖的航線競爭將擴展至五條歐洲航線。兩家航空公司在西雅圖樞紐的航線佈局呈現競爭態勢。 根據報導,相關新航班預計於2027年正式啟動營運,使阿拉斯加航空在歐洲航線的營運選擇增至五種方式。 Alaska Airlines Plans Seasonal Nonstop Flights to Paris and Athens in 2027 Alaska Airlines plans seasonal flights to Paris and Athens in 2027, expanding competition with Delta. metadata.title: 達美航空延長A321neo內華達-亞特蘭大44座一等艙航班至4月11日

a-20260821-0044-delta-air-lines-extends-.text: 達美航空延長A321neo內華達-亞特蘭大44座一等艙航班至4月11日 達美航空延長A321neo內華達-亞特蘭大44座一等艙航班至4月11日 達美航空(Delta Air Lines)宣布擴長其在內華達(Las Vegas, NV)與亞特蘭大(Atlanta, GA)之間航線上的44座一等艙空中巴士A321neo(Airbus A321neo)航班營運時間。內華達是美國內華達州的首府城市,亞特蘭大則為美國亞利桑那州的最大都市,兩者之間距離約2,000多英里(約3,200公里),屬於美國西北航空區的重要航線。 根據Simple Flying於2026年8月20日報導,這些擴長後的航班將持續營運至2027年4月11日。此舉顯示達美航空正積極擴大其在西南部與南中西部地區的航班頻次,並優化客座服務配置。 內華達與亞特蘭大之間的航程約為2,000多英里,屬於北美洲主要的國內航線之一。這條航線在疫情後持續復甦,航班量逐年增加,成為運輸業務的重要收入來源。 A321neo型號的客艙配置採用44座一等艙設計,提供更豪華的乘務服務與舒適空間。一等艙座位寬度較經濟艙提升約5英寸,並配備可調整角度的頭枕、可折疊座椅以及免費餐飲與酒精酒水。 這一擴長決策顯示達美航空持續加強其在西南部航線的競爭力,並維持對高端客座市場的佈局。與同類型的競爭對手相比,達美航空的A321neo一等艙服務在乘客滿意度調查中常居前列。 值得注意的是,A321neo機隊的引入不僅提升了客座舒適度,也降低了燃油消耗與噪聲水平。相較於舊機型,A321neo採用新一代LEAP-1A發動機,燃油效率提升約15%,同時排放量減少,符合環保標準。 Delta Air Lines Extends 44-Seat First Class Airbus A321neo Flights Between Las Vegas and Atlanta Delta Air Lines extends 44-seat first class Airbus A321neo flights between Las Vegas and Atlanta through April 11, 2027. Delta Air Lines announced the extension of 44-seat first class Airbus A321neo flights operating between Las Vegas and Atlanta. Las Vegas, located in Nevada, is the state capital, while Atlanta, situated in Georgia, is the largest city in the state. The distance between the two cities is approximately 2,000 miles, forming an important domestic route in the Northwest United States. According to Simple Flying, published on August 20, 2026, these extended flights will continue operating through April 11, 2027. This move indicates that Delta Air Lines is actively expanding flight frequencies on routes in the Southwest and South Central United States while optimizing premium cabin configurations. The Las Vegas-Atlanta route covers approximately 2,000 miles and is one of the major domestic routes in North America. Following the post-pandemic recovery, this route has seen steadily increasing passenger loads, becoming a significant revenue-generating segment for the airline. The A321neo aircraft is configured with 44 first class seats, offering enhanced service and spacious seating. First class seats provide approximately 5 inches more width than economy class, featuring adjustable headrests, folding armrests, complimentary meals, and alcoholic beverages. This extension decision demonstrates Delta Air Lines' ongoing efforts to strengthen its presence on Southwest routes while maintaining its position in the premium cabin market. Compared to competing carriers with similar aircraft, Delta's A321neo first class service consistently ranks among the top in passenger satisfaction surveys. Notably, the introduction of the A321neo fleet not only improves passenger comfort but also reduces fuel consumption and noise levels. Compared to older aircraft, the A321neo features the new LEAP-1A engine, improving fuel efficiency by approximately 15% while reducing emissions, meeting environmental standards. metadata.title: 星宇航空將於2027年開闢高雄至神戶與沖繩航線

a-20260821-0735-starlux-airlines-to-laun.text: 星宇航空將於2027年開闢高雄至神戶與沖繩航線 星宇航空將於2027年1月1日起開闢高雄至神戶與沖繩航線,每日各一班。 星宇航空於2026年8月21日宣布進軍高雄市場,計畫自2027年1月1日起開闢高雄往返神戶及高雄往返沖繩兩條日本新航線。這是星宇航空首度在高雄設立定期航點。 根據星宇航空規劃,高雄—神戶與高雄—沖繩兩條新航線開航初期均為每日一班,將採用空中巴士A321neo新世代客機執飛。神戶市與星宇航空已於神戶市政廳舉行發表會,由星宇航空策略長劉允富、神戶市長久元喜造及關西機場(KIX)本部長西尾裕共同主持。 星宇航空表示,隨著高雄航線的加入,公司將完成台灣北部、中部及南部三地的航網布局,未來旅客可自由搭配台北、台中與高雄不同地點進出。 Starlux Airlines to Launch Kaohsiung Routes to Kobe and Okinawa in January 2027 Starlux Airlines will launch daily Kaohsiung flights to Kobe and Okinawa starting January 2027 using A321neo aircraft. Starlux Airlines announced on August 21, 2026, that it will expand into Kaohsiung by opening routes to Kobe and Okinawa starting January 1, 2027. This marks the carrier's first establishment of regular scheduled destinations in Kaohsiung. The airline plans to operate daily flights on both the Kaohsiung-Kobe and Kaohsiung-Okinawa routes using Airbus A321neo aircraft. Kobe City and Starlux held a press conference at Kobe City Hall, hosted by Starlux Chief Strategy Officer Liu Yun-fu, Kobe Mayor Kizo Hisamoto, and Kansai Airports Executive Officer Hiroshi Nishio. Starlux noted that adding Kaohsiung will complete its network coverage across northern, central, and southern Taiwan, allowing passengers flexibility to enter and depart via Taipei, Taichung, or Kaohsiung. 星宇航空宣布將於2027年1月1日起開闢高雄至神戶及高雄至沖繩兩條航線,首度在高雄設立定期航點。 星宇航空今天宣布進軍高雄市場,將於2027年1月1日起開闢高雄-神戶及高雄-沖繩兩條日本航線,這也是星宇航空首度在高雄設立定期航點。 高雄至神戶與高雄至沖繩航線規劃採用空中巴士A321neo執飛,開航初期每日一班。 高雄-神戶、高雄-沖繩以Airbus新世代客機A321neo執飛,開航初期每天一班 神戶市與星宇航空於神戶市政廳召開發表會,由星宇航空策略長劉允富、神戶市長久元喜造與關西機場本部長西尾裕共同主持。 神戶市與星宇航空今天在神戶市政廳召開媒體發表會,由星宇航空策略長劉允富、神戶市長久元喜造、關西機場本部長西尾裕共同主持 星宇航空表示,隨高雄航線加入將完成台灣北部、中部及南部三地的航網布局。 隨著高雄航線加入,星宇航空將完成北、中、南三地航網布局

metadata.title: 美上訴法院撤銷運輸部命令 准達美與墨航合資企業繼續營運

a-20260821-0735-us-court-overturns-order.text: 美上訴法院撤銷運輸部命令 准達美與墨航合資企業繼續營運 美國上訴法院撤銷運輸部處分,允許達美航空與墨西哥航空繼續以合資模式營運。 美國聯邦第十一巡迴上訴法院於2026年8月20日作出裁決,撤銷美國運輸部(DOT)先前要求達美航空(Delta Air Lines)與墨西哥航空(Aeroméxico)拆解其跨境合資企業的行政命令。這項裁決允許兩家航空公司在2016年獲得的反托拉斯豁免權架構下,繼續協調美國與墨西哥之間航班的班表、票價以及運能分配。 上訴法院在判決中指出,運輸部未能合理說明為何在本案中採用了較以往航空公司聯盟審查大幅縮減的市場分析模式。在2016年最初批准該項合作時,運輸部針對整個美墨市場以及1,687個城市對進行了全面審查;但在2025年的重新審查中,運輸部卻主要關注墨西哥城貝尼托·胡亞雷斯國際機場(MEX)的營運狀況,該機場約佔美墨兩國間航班總量的21%。 法院補充指出,運輸部在2025年的最終命令中,並未包含更新後的航空公司市場占有率資料,亦未分析若合資企業繼續運作,相關市占率將如何變化,同時也未對個別城市對市場進行新的評估。上訴法院表示,運輸部在未提供合理解釋的情況下,劇烈偏離過去分析國家對與城市對的統一做法,因此該行政命令屬於任意且反覆無常的處分。 這起監管爭議源於墨西哥政府推行的航空政策,包括減少墨西哥城貝尼托·胡亞雷斯國際機場的可分配起降時間(slots),以及強制將貨運業務轉移至費利佩·安吉利斯國際機場(NLU)。美方官員認為相關政策扭曲了市場競爭,並違反2015年《美墨航空運輸協定》,促使美國運輸部於2025年9月決定撤銷對達美航空與墨西哥航空合資企業的批准與反托拉斯豁免權。 由於上訴法院先前已於2025年11月暫緩執行運輸部的拆解命令,達美航空與墨西哥航空的合資企業在此期間始終維持營運。裁決公佈後,兩家航空公司對此表示歡迎,墨西哥航空亦確認其合資架構與反托拉斯豁免權繼續有效。不過,法院亦澄清該裁決僅針對運輸部程序與分析上的缺失進行撤銷,並未就該合資企業是否有助於市場競爭做出最終結論。 US Appeals Court Overturns DOT Order to Dismantle Delta-Aeroméxico Joint Venture US appeals court overturns order requiring Delta Air Lines and Aeroméxico to dismantle their joint venture. The 11th US Circuit Court of Appeals vacated a Department of Transportation (DOT) order on August 20, 2026, that would have required Delta Air Lines and Aeroméxico to dismantle their cross-border joint venture. The appellate court's decision enables both carriers to maintain their commercial partnership and continue coordinating flight schedules, ticket pricing, and capacity under the antitrust immunity originally granted to them in 2016. In its ruling, the court determined that the DOT failed to provide a reasonable explanation for applying a far narrower competitive evaluation than it had historically utilized in previous airline alliance reviews. When the regulatory agency initially approved the partnership in 2016, it conducted a comprehensive examination of competition across the entire US-Mexico market and 1,687 individual city pairs. In contrast, the DOT's 2025 review focused primarily on slot conditions at Mexico City International Airport (MEX), which accounts for approximately 21% of total flights between the two nations. The court emphasized that the department's final order lacked updated airline market share data, omitted any prospective analysis of how market shares might evolve if the joint venture continued, and failed to execute a fresh evaluation of individual city-pair markets. Consequently, the appellate panel held that the DOT's action was arbitrary and capricious, as the agency departed drastically from its uniform practice of analyzing country-pair and city-pair markets without justifying why such comprehensive reviews were unnecessary in this instance. The regulatory dispute originated from policies enacted by the Mexican government, including mandatory reductions in available slots at Mexico City International Airport and a decree relocating all dedicated cargo operations from MEX to Felipe Ángeles International Airport (NLU). US authorities argued these actions distorted market competition and breached the 2015 US-Mexico Air Transport Agreement, prompting the DOT to issue its September 2025 order revoking approval and antitrust immunity for the carriers' alliance. Because the appeals court had previously issued a stay on the DOT order in November 2025, Delta Air Lines and Aeroméxico were never forced to dissolve their joint venture. Both airlines welcomed the latest judicial decision, with Aeroméxico confirming that the joint venture and its antitrust immunity remain fully active. The court clarified that its ruling addresses the department's analytical and procedural shortcomings rather than making a definitive finding on whether the partnership itself is pro-competitive. The 11th US Circuit Court of Appeals vacated a September 2025 Department of Transportation order on August 20, 2026, that required Delta Air Lines and Aeroméxico to dismantle their joint venture. The 11th US Circuit Court of Appeals vacated the September 2025 order on August 20, 2026, finding that the DOT failed to adequately explain why it used a narrower competition analysis than it had applied in previous airline-alliance cases. The ruling allows Delta Air Lines and Aeroméxico to continue coordinating schedules, fares, and capacity under antitrust immunity granted in 2016. allows Delta and Aeroméxico to continue coordinating schedules, fares and capacity under the antitrust immunity granted to their partnership in 2016. The court found the Department of Transportation's 2025 review focused primarily on Mexico City International Airport (MEX) without updating market share data or conducting country-pair and city-pair analyses. Its 2025 review instead focused primarily on conditions at Mexico City International Airport (MEX), which accounts for about 21% of flights between the two countries. The Department of Transportation had withdrawn approval following disputes over Mexican government policy, including slot reductions at MEX and moving cargo operations to Felipe Ángeles International Airport (NLU). US officials objected to reductions in available slots at Mexico City International Airport and the government’s decision to move cargo operations from MEX to Felipe Ángeles International Airport (NLU). Aeroméxico welcomed the ruling and stated that the joint venture and its antitrust immunity remain in effect. Aeroméxico said the joint venture and its antitrust immunity remain in effect, allowing the airlines to continue offering their coordinated network and services.

metadata.title: 聯合航空完成丹佛飛行訓練中心首期擴建 引進40台CAE模擬機

a-20260821-0735-united-airlines-complete.text: 聯合航空完成丹佛飛行訓練中心首期擴建 引進40台CAE模擬機 聯合航空於丹佛訓練中心新增40台CAE模擬機;完成首期擴建;營運52台全動態模擬機 聯合航空已完成其位於丹佛的飛行訓練中心第一階段擴建工程,在引進40台由CAE製造的新型飛行模擬機與訓練設備後,進一步擴充該設施的訓練能量。隨著新設備投入營運,聯合航空目前在該訓練中心共營運52台全動態飛行模擬機與34台固定式訓練設備,為旗下近1,8000名現役機師及新進機組人員提供訓練服務。 這座佔地22英畝的訓練園區位於丹佛的中央公園社區,包含8棟建築物與近70萬平方英呎的訓練空間。聯合航空表示,該中心每日最高可訓練860名機師,每年可執行超過3萬2,000場訓練任務。訓練中心全年運作362天且24小時不間斷營運,機師在取得初始資格後,每9個月均需返回丹佛進行定期複訓。 作為自2022年啟動的擴建專案之一部分,聯合航空於2024年在園區內啟用一座面積達15萬平方英呎的新建築。該公司為該設施投資超過1億4,500萬美元,專為容納更多全動態模擬機、教室及支援區域而設計。自2016年以來,聯合航空已對該園區累計投資3億7,000萬美元,並在訓練中心創造了超過300個額外工作機會。 此外,聯合航空已開始籌備位於丹佛國際機場(DEN)附近的下一階段擴建計畫。丹佛市議會於2026年7月批准了兩塊未開發土地的重新劃定申請。聯合航空預計於2027年動工興建新設施,並計畫於2030年正式投入營運,屆時將與現有的中央公園園區共同運作。自2021年推出United Next成長戰略以來,聯合航空已招聘超過9,500名機師,其中2026年上半年即新增約700名機師。 United Airlines Completes Phase One Expansion at Denver Pilot Training Center United Airlines completes phase one expansion at Denver training center; adds 40 CAE flight simulators. United Airlines has completed the first phase of an expansion at its Denver Flight Training Center following the addition of 40 new CAE flight simulators and training devices. With these new devices in place, the airline now operates 52 full-motion flight simulators and 34 fixed training devices at the facility, supporting training operations for nearly 18,000 active pilots as well as newly hired flight crews. The 22-acre campus in Denver's Central Park neighborhood features eight buildings comprising nearly 700,000 square feet of training space. According to United Airlines, the facility can accommodate up to 860 pilots per day and conduct more than 32,000 training events annually. The center operates around the clock for 362 days each year, serving as the primary facility where United pilots complete qualification and return every nine months for recurrent training. As part of the expansion project initiated in 2022, United Airlines opened a new 150,000-square-foot building at the campus in 2024. The airline invested over $145 million in the facility to accommodate additional full-motion simulators, classrooms, and support areas, bringing its total investment in the campus to $370 million since 2016. The expansion project has created more than 300 additional jobs at the training center. United Airlines is also preparing for a subsequent expansion near Denver International Airport (DEN). In July 2026, the Denver City Council approved a rezoning request for undeveloped land purchased by the airline in 2023. United expects to begin construction on the new facility in 2027 and place it into operation by 2030 to run alongside the existing Central Park campus. Since launching its United Next growth strategy in 2021, the airline has hired more than 9,500 pilots, including approximately 700 pilots during the first part of 2026. metadata.title: 美賓州賽斯納150降落時撞擊警用直升機 釀1死2傷

a-20260821-0735-cessna-150-collides-with.text: 美賓州賽斯納150降落時撞擊警用直升機 釀1死2傷 一架賽斯納150於賓州降落時撞擊警用直升機;小型飛機飛行員身亡;直升機兩人輕傷 2026年8月19日,一架賽斯納150(Cessna 150)單引擎飛機在美國賓夕法尼亞州卡萊爾機場(CAX)嘗試降落時,與一架懸停中的賓夕法尼亞州警察局貝爾407(Bell 407)直升機相撞。事故導致小型飛機飛行員身亡,直升機上兩名人員受輕傷。 卡萊爾機場為無空中交通管制塔台的機場,事發時警用直升機正在草地上方進行例行訓練。撞擊造成直升機旋翼與尾桁斷裂並翻覆,兩名警員隨後脫困並送醫治療,目前情況穩定。賽斯納飛機上僅有飛行員一人,經證實已於事故中罹難。 美國國家運輸安全委員會(NTSB)已主導此起空中相撞事故的調查作業,美國聯邦航空局(FAA)與賓州警察局亦參與協助。目前調查單位尚未確定具體的事故原因。 Cessna 150 Collides With PSP Helicopter in Pennsylvania, Pilot Killed A Cessna 150 collided with a hovering police helicopter in Pennsylvania, killing the airplane pilot. On August 19, 2026, a Cessna 150 collided with a hovering Pennsylvania State Police Bell 407 helicopter while attempting to land at Carlisle Airport (CAX) in Pennsylvania. The pilot of the Cessna airplane was killed in the accident, while two officers aboard the helicopter sustained minor injuries. Carlisle Airport is an uncontrolled field without an air traffic control tower. At the time of the collision, the state police helicopter was conducting a routine training exercise. The impact severed the helicopter's rotor blades and tail boom, causing it to roll onto its side. Both troopers were able to escape and were transported to a hospital in stable condition. The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) is leading the investigation into the mid-air collision, assisted by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and the Pennsylvania State Police. Authorities stated that no official cause has been determined yet. 2026年8月19日,一架賽斯納150飛機於美國賓夕法尼亞州卡萊爾機場嘗試降落時,與懸停中的賓夕法尼亞州警察局直升機相撞。 A Cessna 150 pilot was killed when his airplane collided with a hovering Pennsylvania State Police helicopter while the Cessna was attempting to land at Carlisle Airport in Pennsylvania. 賽斯納飛機飛行員保羅·索科洛斯基在事故中身亡,為機上唯一人員。 The Cumberland County Coroner’s Office identified the Cessna pilot as 57-year-old Paul Sokoloski of Hershey. a-20260821-0828-usdot-announces-615-mill.text: 美國交通部撥款近6.15億美元 挹注238項全美機場改善計畫 美國交通部撥款近6.15億美元,資助全美238項機場基礎設施改善專案。 美國交通部部長蕭恩·達菲(Sean P. Duffy)宣布,將透過「機場改善計畫」(Airport Improvement Program,簡稱AIP)撥款近6.15億美元,資助全美42個州及兩個領地共238項補助款。該項大規模資金投入旨在升級與強化全美各地機場的關鍵基礎設施,改善跑道與滑行道狀況,並優化航廈乘客設施與飛行區安全設備。 依據美國聯邦航空管理局(FAA)發布的撥款計畫細節,重點補助項目涵蓋各類規模的機場設施需求。其中,德克薩斯州的米德蘭國際空天港(MAF;Midland International Air & Space Port)獲得2150萬美元用於跑道整修工程;阿拉斯加州諾阿塔克(Noatak)獲得1950萬美元用於興建一座新機場;加利福尼亞州的聖地牙哥國際機場(SAN;San Diego International Airport)則獲得1530萬美元用於降噪改善計畫。 其他獲得資助的代表性機場項目還包括:印第安納州的蓋瑞/芝加哥國際機場(GYY;Gary/Chicago International Airport)獲撥830萬美元興建新合約管制塔台;維吉尼亞州的林奇堡區域機場(LYH;Lynchburg Regional Airport)獲撥800萬美元興建新航廈;北卡羅來納州的威爾明頓國際機場(ILM;Wilmington International Airport)獲撥630萬美元用於跑道延伸;加利福尼亞州的沙加緬度國際機場(SMF;Sacramento International Airport)獲撥240萬美元用於更新旅客登機橋。 根據交通部說明,機場可將機場改善計畫補助金運用於跑道、滑行道、標誌、照明、標線及其他與安全相關的建設。交通部長達菲指出,升級機場基礎設施是打造高效與安全交通體系的一環;聯邦航空管理局局長布萊恩·貝德福德(Bryan Bedford)亦表示,在全美航空出行需求持續增長之際優先推動這些資助,將有助於提升整體旅客出行體驗。 USDOT Announces $615 Million in AIP Grants for 238 Airport Projects Across US USDOT announced nearly $615 million in grants for 238 airport infrastructure projects across the United States. U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy announced a $615 million investment to fund 238 grants through the Airport Improvement Program across 42 states and two territories. The federal funding initiative from the U.S. Department of Transportation is designed to modernize and reinforce infrastructure at airports nationwide, supporting critical airfield safety upgrades, runway and taxiway rehabilitation, and terminal facility improvements for passengers. Under the announced grant distribution, federal funding targets specific infrastructure and operational needs at airports of varying sizes nationwide. Key major project allocations include $21.5 million awarded to Midland International Air & Space Port (MAF) in Texas for runway rehabilitation, $19.5 million allocated to construct a new airport in Noatak, Alaska, and $15.3 million provided to San Diego International Airport (SAN) for noise mitigation projects. Additional high-priority grant awards detailed by the agency include $8.3 million to Gary/Chicago International Airport (GYY) in Indiana to construct a new contract tower and $8 million to Lynchburg Regional Airport (LYH) in Virginia for a new terminal facility. Furthermore, Wilmington International Airport (ILM) in North Carolina receives $6.3 million for runway extension, while Sacramento International Airport (SMF) in California is awarded $2.4 million for new passenger boarding bridges. According to the agency, airports can utilize Airport Improvement Program funding for infrastructure projects including runways, taxiways, signage, lighting, markings, and other safety-related airfield needs. Transportation Secretary Duffy emphasized that upgrading airport infrastructure helps deliver a safer and smoother travel experience, while Federal Aviation Administration Administrator Bryan Bedford stated that prioritizing these grants supports growing travel volumes and transforms the overall passenger journey. a-20260821-1021-taiwan-protests-etihad-a.text: 阿提哈德航空廣播稱中國台灣 外交部嚴正抗議要求更正 外交部抗議阿提哈德航空廣播稱中國台灣,已協調民航局向總部交涉。 有旅客近日在社群平台反映,日前搭乘阿提哈德航空(Etihad Airways)自阿布達比飛往台灣的航班。降落前,機上中文廣播稱「歡迎回到中國台灣」,並稱若攜帶肉品入境,「中國政府」將會課處罰款。 對此,中華民國外交部於8月21日表達強烈抗議,並嚴正重申台灣是主權獨立國家,與中華人民共和國互不隸屬。外交部強調,任何矮化台灣主權地位的不當作法,政府與全體民眾絕不接受。 外交部發言人蕭光偉指出,外交部已責成駐杜拜辦事處並協調交通部民航局,向阿提哈德航空總部及在台代表提出嚴正交涉,要求其更正不當用語、道歉並提出改進作為。 Taiwan Protests Etihad Airways In-Flight Announcement Calling Taiwan 'China Taiwan' Taiwan's MOFA protested Etihad Airways over a cabin announcement calling Taiwan 'China Taiwan' on August 21. A passenger recently reported on social media that during a flight from Abu Dhabi to Taiwan on Etihad Airways, the Chinese-language cabin announcement welcomed passengers to 'China Taiwan' and warned that the 'Chinese government' would issue fines for bringing meat products. In response, Taiwan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) issued a strong protest on August 21. MOFA reiterated that Taiwan is a sovereign and independent country and is not subordinate to the People's Republic of China, stating that any attempt to demean Taiwan's sovereignty is unacceptable. MOFA spokesperson Hsiao Kuang-wei stated that the ministry has instructed its Dubai office and coordinated with the Civil Aeronautics Administration to lodge representations with Etihad Airways' headquarters and its representative in Taiwan, demanding a correction, an apology, and future improvements. 有旅客搭乘阿提哈德航空自阿布達比返台時,機上中文廣播稱「歡迎回到中國台灣」,並宣導攜帶肉品入境將遭「中國政府」罰款。 日前搭乘阿提哈德航空從阿布達比回台,降落前機上廣播用英文說歡迎回到台灣,中文說的卻是歡迎回到「中國台灣」,廣播接著宣導不要帶肉品入境,否則「中國政府」會罰款。 中華民國外交部對此表達強烈抗議,並嚴正重申台灣是主權獨立國家,與中華人民共和國互不隸屬。 外交部今天表示,表達強烈抗議並嚴正重申,中華民國台灣是主權獨立國家,與中華人民共和國互不隸屬 外交部已要求駐杜拜辦事處並協調交通部民航局,向阿提哈德航空總部及在台代表提出嚴正交涉,要求更正、道歉並改進。 已責成駐杜拜辦事處並協調交通部民航局,向阿提哈德航空總部及在台代表提出嚴正交涉,要求更正不當用語、道歉並提出改進作為

metadata.title: 仁川機場第一航廈櫃檯加裝圍欄 防範插隊與維持出境秩序

a-20260821-1021-incheon-airport-installs.text: 仁川機場第一航廈櫃檯加裝圍欄 防範插隊與維持出境秩序 仁川機場1號航廈櫃檯增設實體圍欄;派駐安全人員並防範旅客插隊爭議 南韓仁川國際機場(ICN)於第一航廈報到櫃檯周邊安裝實體圍欄,以防止旅客插隊搶先報到。這項措施源於2026年7月在網路上引發廣泛關注的現場影片,影片顯示多名旅客在航廈內蜂湧奔向報到櫃檯,引發現場秩序與安全疑慮。 根據仁川國際機場公社說明,圍欄已設置於第一航廈出境大廳E區報到櫃檯周邊,並於透明面板上貼上告示貼紙,以維護視覺辨識度並防止旅客誤撞。此外,機場當局已增派現場安全人員進行巡視,並透過數位螢幕顯示警告訊息,明確指出若工作人員安全受到威脅,機場得拒絕提供報到服務。機場主管表示,自相關防護措施實施以來,已未再發生插隊事件。 此類衝突起因於2026年7月2日的一起事件,當時網路上流傳的影片顯示,數十名預計搭乘飛往中國航班的旅客,在第一航廈出境大廳衝向報到櫃檯。相關旅客繞過原本設為折線型的可收縮帶狀圍欄,直接將行李推車推入或繞過圍欄搶先排隊。南韓當地媒體報導指出,在2026年7月2日至7月10日期間,至少發生過五起類似的擁擠衝撞事件,並有數名機場員工在試圖引導旅客回到指定排隊動線時受傷,出現瘀傷與擦傷。 仁川機場官員將部分擁擠原因歸因於近期仁川至中國主要航線的機型調配變更。部分航班由空中巴士A320(ICAO機型代碼A320)更換為載客量較大的空中巴士A350,使每班次座位數增加約100個,導致更多旅客在相同時段集中湧入報到櫃檯。統計數據顯示,仁川國際機場在2026年上半年共處理3,839萬人次國際旅客,較去年同期成長6.3%。 Incheon Airport Installs Counter Barrier in Terminal 1 Following Queue-Jumping Incidents Incheon Airport installed barriers at Terminal 1 check-in counters following queue-jumping incidents on China flights. Incheon International Airport (ICN) in South Korea has installed a fence around check-in counter E in Terminal 1 to prevent passengers from jumping queues, following viral videos of crowd surges in July 2026. The protective barrier was implemented after videos showed travelers rushing toward departure counters, raising operational and safety concerns among airport management. According to the Incheon International Airport Corporation, transparent panels of the new fence were equipped with safety stickers to increase visibility and prevent accidental collisions by passengers. In addition to the physical structure, airport authorities deployed extra security personnel to monitor the departure hall and introduced digital warning displays stating that check-in services could be denied if the safety of airport staff is threatened. Official sources reported that no further queue-jumping incidents have been observed since the implementation of these measures. The interventions follow a July 2, 2026 incident where footage showed dozens of passengers heading toward check-in counters for a China-bound flight in Terminal 1. Bypassing designated zigzag lines created by retractable belt barriers, travelers pushed luggage carts around or underneath barriers to bypass waiting lines. South Korean media reported that at least five similar crowd surge events occurred between July 2 and July 10, resulting in minor injuries, including bruises and abrasions, to several airport employees who attempted to redirect crowd flow. Airport officials attributed part of the overcrowding to recent aircraft upgauging on major routes between Incheon and China, where operators shifted from the Airbus A320 (ICAO type code A320) to the larger Airbus A350, adding approximately 100 seats per flight. metadata.title: 西捷航空確認所有波音737已恢復174座配置,統一經濟艙座距30吋

a-20260821-1425-westjet-confirms-all-boe.text: 西捷航空確認所有波音737已恢復174座配置,統一經濟艙座距30吋 西捷航空8月18日宣布完成波音737機隊座位改裝,取消28吋座距實驗,統一經濟艙30吋座距 加拿大西捷航空於2026年8月18日發布更新,證實所有先前採用180座高密度配置的波音737-8 MAX與737-800已全數改回174座佈局,並完成內飾刷新及WestJet WiFi presented by TELUS等增強設施。航空公司聲明指出:「All previously affected aircraft are now flying with 174 seats, a refreshed interior and enhanced amenities, including WestJet WiFi presented by TELUS」。 改裝工程原預計延續至2026年秋季,但實際於2026年6月中完成,較原定進度大幅提前。報導說明:「Instead, the airline now says it finished restoring legroom by mid-June。」這標誌著西捷在2025年9月啟動的艙內大修實驗正式畫下句點。 實驗期間,經濟艙後段第20至31排座距僅28吋,第15至19排為29吋,引發旅客與機組強烈反彈,影片於2025年底至2026年初在網路廣傳。西捷曾辯稱額外一排有助維持低票價,但在12月暫停後續安裝,並於2026年1月16日宣佈移除一排、恢復標準座距。 西捷集團執行長Alexis von Hoensbroech當時表示:「WestJet tried seat pitches that are popular with many airlines around the globe as they serve to provide affordable airfares... it’s in our DNA to try new products. At the same time, it is just as important to react quickly if they don’t meet the needs of our guests.」。此言論顯示航空公司願意快速修正不受歡迎的產品。 完成改裝後,受影響機型經濟艙座距統一為30吋,較先前28吋、29吋、30吋混合配置增加約7%個人空間。報導指出:「The revised aircraft have a uniform 30” seat pitch in standard Economy, rather than the previous mix of 28”, 29”, and 30”.」這項變更預期將改善乘客舒適度並平息先前爭議。 WestJet confirms all Boeing 737s reverted to 174‐seat layout with uniform 30‐inch economy pitch WestJet announced on 18 Aug that the 28‐inch seat‐pitch trial is over; all affected 737‐8 MAX and 737‐800 aircraft now fly with 174 seats and a 30‐inch economy pitch Canadian carrier WestJet announced on 18 August 2026 that every aircraft previously configured with the controversial 180‐seat high‐density layout has been returned to a 174‐seat configuration. The airline stated, "All previously affected aircraft are now flying with 174 seats, a refreshed interior and enhanced amenities, including WestJet WiFi presented by TELUS." The retrofit programme, originally expected to run into autumn 2026, was completed by mid‐June, well ahead of schedule. The report notes, "Instead, the airline now says it finished restoring legroom by mid‐June." This marks the end of an experiment launched in September 2025 that introduced a tighter 28‐inch seat pitch in rows 20‐31 of the economy cabin. Passenger and crew backlash erupted late in 2025, with videos of cramped seating spreading online. WestJet initially defended the denser layout as a way to keep fares low, but paused further installations in December 2025 and, on 16 January 2026, announced it would remove a row and restore the previous standard pitch. Group CEO Alexis von Hoensbroech explained the reversal: "WestJet tried seat pitches that are popular with many airlines around the globe as they serve to provide affordable airfares... it’s in our DNA to try new products. At the same time, it is just as important to react quickly if they don’t meet the needs of our guests." After the modifications, the affected 737‐8 MAX and 737‐800 aircraft now feature a uniform 30‐inch seat pitch throughout standard economy, replacing the prior mix of 28‐, 29‐ and 30‐inch rows. The article notes, "The revised aircraft have a uniform 30” seat pitch in standard Economy, rather than the previous mix of 28", 29", and 30"." The change is expected to improve passenger comfort and close a contentious chapter for the airline. a-20260821-1621-cessna-441-charter-crash.text: 塞斯納441包機於阿拉斯加軍用雷達站附近墜毀 機上8人全數罹難 塞斯納包機於阿拉斯加雷達站附近墜毀;機上8人全數罹難;運安會已展開調查 一架載有8人的塞斯納441 Conquest II(Cessna 441 Conquest II)雙引擎渦輪螺旋槳包機,於當地時間2026年8月20日約12時15分,在美國阿拉斯加州西部紐恩漢角長程雷達站機場(EHM;Cape Newenham Long Range Radar Site Airport)以西的陸地上墜毀。美國聯邦航空總署(FAA)證實該起事故,救援人員接報抵達現場後,確認機上8人全數罹難,無人生還。 根據官方資訊,該架失事客機註冊編號為N128EZ,製造年份為1979年,由總部位於安克拉治的安克拉治安全航空(Security Aviation)負責營運。該班機當天自泰德·史蒂文斯安克拉治國際機場(ANC)起飛,機上載有2名飛行員及6名乘客。美國陸軍工兵署(US Army Corps of Engineers)隨後證實該班機為其承租,且罹難者中有2名為該署員工。 事故發生的紐恩漢角長程雷達站機場位於安克拉治以西約450英里處,為美國空軍所屬的私人飛行場,由太平洋空軍區域支援中心管理,專門提供給監視阿拉斯加及周邊領空防務的雷達站使用。該機場設有一條長約3,945英尺、寬150英尺的15/33碎石跑道,跑道位於山坡之上,且兩端高差超過300英尺。 國家運輸安全委員會(NTSB)阿拉斯加辦公室主管指出,該客機是在準備進場降落時發生墜毀。聯邦航空總署的機場資料警告,該跑道兩側及南端均有高聳地形,且重新重飛(go-around)成功的機率極低。據報導,事故發生當時該地區天氣伴隨濃霧,視線受到影響。 目前國家運輸安全委員會已會同聯邦航空總署等相關單位主導事故調查,以釐清航機墜毀的具體原因。調查人員尚未公開殘骸狀況、最終飛行航跡或任何可能存在的機械異常細節,機上全體人員的身分細節亦待官方進一步確認與公布。 Chartered Cessna 441 Crashes Near Alaska Military Radar Site, Killing 8 Security Aviation Cessna 441 crashes near Cape Newenham in Alaska, leaving eight people dead. A chartered Cessna 441 Conquest II turboprop crashed west of Cape Newenham Long Range Radar Site Airport (EHM) in western Alaska at approximately 12:15 local time on August 20, 2026, according to the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). Emergency rescuers reached the accident scene and confirmed that all eight people on board died in the crash, with no survivors reported. The twin-engine aircraft, registered as N128EZ and manufactured in 1979, was operated by Anchorage-based Security Aviation. The destination airport, located about 450 miles west of Anchorage, is a private US Air Force airstrip servicing a remote radar installation managed by the Pacific Air Forces Regional Support Center. The facility features a single gravel runway, designated Runway 15/33, which measures 3,945 feet long on a mountain slope with an elevation change of over 300 feet. According to the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) Alaska office, the plane crashed while on approach to Cape Newenham. Official FAA airport charts warn of steep surrounding terrain and indicate that successful go-around maneuvers are improbable. Local weather conditions included fog at the time of the accident. The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) is leading the multi-agency investigation into the cause of the fatal crash with direct assistance from the FAA and other federal authorities. a-20260821-1720-us-approves-potential-4-.text: 美國批准向卡達出售四架波音KC-46A加油機 估值45億美元 美國國務院批准向卡達軍售四架波音KC-46A加油機,估額45億美元。 美國國務院於2026年8月20日發布通知,批准一項向卡達出售最多四架波音KC-46A飛馬座(Pegasus)空中加油機及相關設備的軍售案(Foreign Military Sale),估計最高總價值達45億美元。這項擬議的軍購案旨在為卡達皇家空軍建立獨立的空中加油能力,以支援其不斷擴大的戰鬥機隊。 根據發布的擬購清單,卡達申請採購最多四架KC-46A加油機,以及八具普惠(Pratt & Whitney)PW4062渦輪風扇發動機(包含四具已安裝於飛機上及四具備用發動機)。採購套件還包含10套AN/ALR-69A雷達警告接收器、用於大型飛機紅外線對抗系統的衛士雷射發射器組件、飛彈警告感測器、保密通訊設備、敵我識別系統、訓練裝置、備用零件與後勤支援。 美國國務院指出,45億美元為該交易套件的最高估算金額,卡達目前尚未簽署正式採購合約。最終交易金額將視最終協議中所包含的實際設備與服務內容而定。此外,該案仍須通過美國國會的審查程序,通知國會並不保證最終交易一定會完成或採購全部四架飛機。 美國國務院表示,這項擬購案將加強美國主要非北約盟友的安全,符合美國的外交政策與國家安全目標。國務院評估,該飛機將提升卡達因應當前與未來威脅的能力,為其戰機提供及時的空中加油支援,且不會改變該地區的基本軍事平衡。該案的主要承包商包括波音、普惠、RTX與諾斯洛普·格魯曼(Northrop Grumman)。 US Approves Potential $4.5 Billion Sale of Four Boeing KC-46A Tankers to Qatar US State Department approved a potential $4.5 billion sale of four Boeing KC-46A tankers to Qatar. The US State Department has approved a potential Foreign Military Sale to Qatar of up to four Boeing KC-46A Pegasus aerial refueling aircraft and associated equipment, valued at an estimated maximum of $4.5 billion. According to an official notification released on August 20, 2026, the proposed transaction aims to establish a dedicated aerial refueling capability for the Qatar Emiri Air Force. Under the requested package, Qatar has sought to procure up to four KC-46A tankers and eight Pratt & Whitney PW4062 turbofan engines, comprising four installed engines and four spares. The package also encompasses ten AN/ALR-69A radar warning receivers, Guardian Laser Transmitter Assemblies for Large Aircraft Infrared Countermeasure systems, missile-warning sensors, secure communications equipment, identification transponders, training equipment, spare parts, and logistical support. The State Department noted that the $4.5 billion figure represents the upper estimate for the total package. Qatar has not signed a formal contract, and the final value could decrease depending on the specific hardware and services included in any prospective agreement. The proposed deal must undergo congressional review, and the initial notification does not guarantee that a purchase contract will be finalized or that all four aircraft will be acquired. According to the State Department, the proposed sale aligns with US foreign policy and national security objectives by enhancing the security of a major non-NATO ally. Authorities stated that the KC-46A tankers will improve Qatar's ability to counter present and future threats through timely refueling of its fighter fleet without altering the basic military balance in the region. The principal contractors named for the potential program are Boeing, Pratt & Whitney, RTX, and Northrop Grumman. a-20260821-1823-uk-mod-fleet-data-shows-.text: 英國國防部公布軍機統計 旋翼機隊減少27架定翼機升至507架 英國國防部;軍用旋翼機總數降至249架;定翼機隊增至507架;無人機系統達189架 英國國防部於2026年8月20日發布年度軍用航空器統計資料。根據這項截至2026年4月1日的最新數據,英國軍方的旋翼機(直升機)總數降至249架,相較於一年前的統計數據減少了27架。根據外媒 AeroTime 報導,國防部數據顯示軍方整體航空器編制出現顯著結構調整。 英國國防部指出,旋翼機數量減少的主要原因,在於皇家空軍退役了服役長達54年的美洲豹(Puma)直升機,該機型已於2025年3月正式走入歷史。國防部先前曾於2024年11月宣布相關裁減計畫,預計退役17架 Puma 直升機與14架契努克(Chinook)直升機以節省運作成本。目前 Chinook 仍是英國軍方規模最大的旋翼機隊,現役數量為45架。 與旋翼機的減少趨勢相反,英國軍方的定翼機總數量有所增加,自上一年度增加3架至507架。國防部將定翼機數量的增長歸因於持續接收洛克希德·馬丁(Lockheed Martin)公司生產的 F-35 閃電II(F-35 Lightning II)戰鬥機。與此同時,颱風(Typhoon)戰鬥機仍是英國最大規模的定翼機隊,現有數量為124架,不過該機隊數量正持續減少,皇家空軍已於2025年4月1日退役絕大部分的第一批次(Tranche 1)颱風戰機。 在無人機系統方面,符合國防部認證或S2類別規範的無人駕駛航空器系統數量增加9架,達到189架。國防部統計資料補充說明,掠奪者(Reaper)無人機已於2025年10月正式退役,並由守護者(Protector)無人機系統接替其任務。此項統計並不包含未達到認證門檻的較小型無人機系統。 在機隊可用率方面,統計顯示定翼機與旋翼機的妥善管理率均有所提升。在納入主動機隊管理紀錄的374架定翼機中,有323架(即86%)被列為現役妥善狀態,高於前一年的82%。而在213架記錄的旋翼機平台中,有165架(即77%)處於現役妥善狀態,亦高於2025年記錄的70%。國防部說明,主動管理定義包含處於封存狀態的飛機,而由合約承包營運的航空器則未納入可用率的分母計算。 UK MoD Fleet Data Shows Rotary Wing Inventory Down to 249 as Fixed Wing Rises UK Ministry of Defence reports military helicopter fleet fell to 249 while fixed-wing inventory rose to 507. The UK Ministry of Defence released its annual military aircraft inventory statistics on August 20, 2026. According to the official data snapshot reflecting the status as of April 1, 2026, the total UK military rotary-wing inventory fell to 249 platforms, representing a decline of 27 aircraft compared to the same period one year earlier. Industry outlet AeroTime reported that the official release outlines substantial structural shifts across the armed forces. The Ministry of Defence attributed the decline in rotary-wing platforms primarily to the disposal of Puma helicopters, which the Royal Air Force officially withdrew from active service in March 2025 after 54 years of operations. The MoD had previously announced in November 2024 a cost-saving measures package that included retiring 17 Pumas and 14 Chinooks. Despite the reduction, the Chinook remains the largest single rotary-wing fleet type in the inventory, with 45 aircraft recorded. In contrast to the decline in helicopters, the UK fixed-wing military aircraft inventory moved in the opposite direction, increasing by three platforms to reach a total of 507. The MoD attributed this increase directly to the ongoing onboarding of Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II stealth fighters. Meanwhile, the Typhoon remains the largest fixed-wing fleet in service at 124 aircraft, though its numbers continue to decrease following the Royal Air Force retiring the majority of its Tranche 1 Typhoons as of April 1, 2025. During the same reporting period, uncrewed aircraft systems operating under the MoD's certified or S2 regulatory categories increased by nine platforms to a total of 189. The official statistics noted that the Reaper system went out of service in October 2025 and has been successfully replaced by the Protector platform. Smaller uncrewed systems that do not meet the specified regulatory certification thresholds fall outside of this official tally. Operational availability metrics showed improvements across both rotary-wing and fixed-wing fleets. Among the 374 tracked fixed-wing aircraft subject to active fleet management, 323 aircraft (or 86%) were counted as in service, up from 82% recorded in the previous year. For rotary-wing aircraft, 165 out of 213 platforms (or 77%) were in service as of April 1, 2026, compared with 70% in 2025. The MoD defines in-service status as any airframe under active management, including stored platforms, while contracted platforms are excluded from availability calculations. a-20260821-2114-american-airlines-charge.text: 美國航空因幼童在旅途中滿兩歲強制收取費用 美國航空要求在旅途中迎來兩歲生日的幼童付費購票;家長面臨意外費用 根據媒體 Simple Flying 報導,一家人在旅途中面臨來自美國航空(American Airlines)高達 871 美元的意外收費。起因是該家庭的幼童在旅程中途迎來兩歲生日,航空公司隨即推翻了原本的抱膝搭乘免位安排,堅持要求該名幼童必須購買獨立座位。 在這起事件中,由於孩童在旅途中跨越兩歲的年齡界線,美國航空便要求母親支付 871 美元的費用,否則可能無法帶同幼童搭機。航空公司推翻原先的抱嬰免票安排並強制購票,使這家人面臨這筆突如其來的財務支出。 American Airlines Charges Family $871 After Toddler Turns Two Mid-Trip American Airlines charged a mother $871 after her child turned two years old mid-trip. According to a report by Simple Flying, a family was confronted with an unexpected $871 charge from American Airlines during a trip. The situation arose when the airline reversed its lap seating policy for a toddler who turned two years old mid-trip, insisting that a separate seat must be purchased. In this incident, since the child crossed the age threshold of two years during the journey, American Airlines required the mother to pay the $871 fee, or potentially leave the toddler behind. a-20260822-0253-boeing-skips-easa-approv.text: 波音略過EASA認證 737 MAX 7延後取得認證 波音略過EASA認證;737 MAX 7將延後取得認證;西南航空為主要營運者 波音(Boeing)在2026年8月22日發布的報導中,表示其737 MAX 7機型目前略過了歐洲航空安全局(EASA)的認證程序。 根據Simple Flying的報導,該機型將「幾乎完全由西南航空(Southwest Airlines)營運」,因此波音決定先行專注於美國聯邦航空局(FAA)的認證流程。 波音在7月份已完成737 MAX 7與MAX 10的認證飛行測試,並預期2026年取得認證,2027年首架交付。 本次決策反映出波音在認證策略上的調整,特別是針對主要客戶西南航空的營運需求。 Boeing Skips EASA Approval For 737 MAX 7 For Now Boeing skips EASA approval for 737 MAX 7; Southwest Airlines to be main operator Boeing has decided to skip European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) approval for the 737 MAX 7 for now, according to a report published on August 22, 2026. The report by Simple Flying states that the aircraft will be operated almost entirely by Southwest Airlines, leading Boeing to focus first on U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) certification. As of July, Boeing had completed certification flight testing on both the 737-7 and 737-10, with certification anticipated in 2026 and first delivery in 2027. This decision reflects an adjustment in Boeing's certification strategy, particularly aligned with the operational needs of its primary customer, Southwest Airlines. a-20260822-0337-delta-air-lines-boeing-7.text: 達美航空波音737-900ER引擎故障緊急返航亞特蘭大 達美航空波音737客機右側引擎故障返航亞特蘭大;造成航班延誤 根據航空新聞媒體 Simple Flying 報導,達美航空(Delta Air Lines)一架波音 737-900ER 客機因右側發動機出現異常故障,被迫立即返回亞特蘭大。該起發動機問題發生後,客機暫時停止服務,對達美航空在亞特蘭大繁忙的樞紐機場營運造成考驗。 報導指出,該架客機因右側引擎故障返航後,導致班機延誤,受影響的旅客只能在現場等待後續處置。目前相關報導並未提供該班機的具體航班號碼、發動機故障原因或詳細的後續維修維護進度。 Delta Air Lines Boeing 737-900ER Returns To Atlanta After Engine Issue Delta Air Lines Boeing 737-900ER returns to Atlanta after right engine glitch; operations disrupted and passengers delayed. The unscheduled return tested Delta Air Lines' busy hub operations in Atlanta and resulted in delays for passengers on board the flight, who were left waiting following the aircraft's out-of-service status. a-20260822-0724-us-and-romanian-forces-c.text: 美羅二軍於波蘭舉行反無人機演習 獵豹戰車追蹤第一人稱無人機 美軍與羅馬尼亞軍於波蘭開展演習;獵豹戰車追蹤美軍無人機;型號與數量未公開 美國陸軍第五軍(US Army V Corps)發布消息指出,美軍無人機操作人員與羅馬尼亞部隊於2026年8月18日在波蘭貝莫沃皮斯基訓練區(Bemowo Piskie Training Area)舉行聯合反無人機演習。演練期間,美軍操縱第一人稱視角(FPV)無人飛行器,供羅馬尼亞官兵使用獵豹式防空戰車(Flakpanzer Gepard)進行目標追蹤。 根據美軍第五軍說明,本次演習使用的無人機來自第37裝甲團第2營總部暨總部連 strike 單位。軍方目前未公開具體的無人機型號名稱,亦未透露演習期間共操縱了多少架飛行器。獵豹式防空戰車配備搜尋與追蹤雷達,並輔以光學瞄準裝置。 派駐波蘭的羅馬尼亞單位為「鐵獵豹」防空派遣隊(Iron Cheetahs),代號為 GBAD XIX,由羅馬尼亞陸軍第348營負責組建。該部隊隸屬於北大西洋公約組織(NATO)波蘭前沿陸軍戰鬥群,由同時擔任美軍營長的史蒂芬·薩克森中校(Lieutenant Colonel Steven Saxion)指揮。 獵豹式防空戰車為一款雷達導向的防空砲系統,最早於1960年代研發,並於1970年代投入西德陸軍服役。該系統採用豹1型(Leopard 1)底盤,裝備兩門35公釐歐瑞康(Oerlikon)機砲。德軍已於2010年退役該型裝備,目前該系統已停產,羅馬尼亞為少數仍在使用該裝備的北約成員國之一。 除了地面防空追蹤演練外,北約戰機於2026年間亦多次執行無人機處置任務。羅馬尼亞空軍一架 F-16 戰鬥機於2026年8月20日在黑海海域執行任務時,曾使用機砲成功擊毀一艘海上無人艇。 US and Romanian Forces Conduct Joint Counter-Drone Drill in Poland US and Romanian forces held a counter-drone drill in Poland; Gepard crew tracked FPV drones US Army V Corps announced that US Army drone operators flew first-person-view aircraft during a joint counter-drone training exercise at Bemowo Piskie Training Area in Poland on August 18, 2026. The training exercise allowed Romanian military crews to practice tracking the unmanned aerial vehicles using a Flakpanzer Gepard anti-aircraft gun system. According to US Army V Corps, the unmanned aircraft used during the exercise were operated by the strike section of Headquarters and Headquarters Company, 2nd Battalion, 37th Armored Regiment. Military officials did not publicly identify the specific drone model or disclose the exact number of aircraft flown during the drill. The Gepard anti-aircraft gun system utilizes search and tracking radars alongside optical targeting sights. The Romanian unit stationed in Poland is the Iron Cheetahs air defense detachment, designated as GBAD XIX and generated by the 348th Battalion. The detachment operates as part of the NATO Forward Land Forces Battle Group-Poland, which is currently commanded by Lieutenant Colonel Steven Saxion, who also serves as the commander of the US battalion. The Gepard is a radar-directed anti-aircraft gun system originally developed in the 1960s to engage low-flying aircraft and entered West German service during the 1970s. Built on a Leopard 1 tank chassis, the vehicle is armed with twin 35 mm Oerlikon automatic cannons. Germany retired its own Gepard fleet in 2010, and the system is no longer in active production, leaving Romania among the few NATO allies still operating the vehicle type. In addition to ground-based air defense training, NATO combat aircraft have engaged unmanned aerial threats on multiple occasions throughout 2026. metadata.title: 澳洲航空延後伯斯至倫敦直飛航線復飛時間至2027年

a-20260822-0724-qantas-delays-return-of-.text: 澳洲航空延後伯斯至倫敦直飛航線復飛時間至2027年 澳洲航空將伯斯至倫敦西向直飛航線延至2027年2月恢復,期間中途停靠新加坡。 澳洲航空(Qantas)宣布推遲其伯斯至倫敦直飛航班服務的恢復時間至2027年2月。這項網路調整主要適用於2026年10月25日至2027年1月31日期間營運的西向QF9航班,搭乘該航班從伯斯前往倫敦希斯洛機場(LHR)的旅客,將繼續經由新加坡進行中途加油與停靠。 根據澳洲航空公佈的營運計畫,東向從倫敦返回伯斯的航班服務將在整個期間內保持全程直飛,不受本次新加坡中轉安排的影響。 除了伯斯至倫敦航線外,澳洲航空亦將在同一時期調整其雪梨至巴黎航線的營運模式。自2026年10月25日至2027年1月31日,雪梨至巴黎的服務將改為經由新加坡營運,而非原先規律中轉的伯斯。至於巴黎返回雪梨的返程航班服務則保持不變。 澳洲航空亦配合新機隊的引進調整多條國際與國內航線。布里斯本至馬尼拉航線將繼續使用空中巴士(Airbus)A330客機營運至2027年1月31日,並於2027年2月1日起開始改由空中巴士A321XLR機型執飛。此外,自10月25日起,澳洲航空將在連結雪梨、墨爾本與布里斯本等關鍵國內航線上,增加更多由A321XLR執飛的航班。 在機場合作與基礎設施方面,澳洲航空集團已與墨爾本機場(MEL)就關鍵商業條款達成協議。這項協議為澳洲航空未來增加航班數量、升級國際航廈貴賓室、改善旅客報到程序,以及配合墨爾本機場交付第三條跑道鋪平了道路。 Qantas Delays Return of Nonstop Perth-London Flights Until February 2027 Qantas delays nonstop Perth to London flights until February 2027 and extends Singapore stopovers. Qantas has pushed back the return of its nonstop Perth-London flight service until February 2027, extending an intermediate Singapore refuelling stop on the ultra-long-haul route for another three months. The change applies specifically to westbound QF9 services operating between 25 October 2026 and 31 January 2027, with passengers travelling from Perth to London Heathrow (LHR) continuing to route through Singapore. The airline confirmed that the eastbound London-Perth flight service will remain nonstop throughout the entire period. In contrast, westbound passenger flights will continue to include the intermediate technical stopover in Singapore throughout this schedule adjustment window. Qantas will separately alter its Sydney-Paris flight service over the exact same period. From 25 October 2026 until 31 January 2027, the service will operate via Singapore rather than Perth, while the return Paris-Sydney flight service will remain completely unchanged during these network adjustments. The airline is also making several network adjustments across its international and domestic routes in connection with the introduction of its incoming Airbus A321XLR fleet. The carrier will continue operating its Brisbane-Manila service with the Airbus A330 until 31 January 2027, before introducing the A321XLR on the route from 1 February. From 25 October, Qantas will also add more A321XLR-operated flights on key domestic routes linking Sydney, Melbourne, and Brisbane. Separately, the Qantas Group and Melbourne Airport (MEL) have agreed on key commercial terms for major airport infrastructure developments. The agreement clears the way for additional flights, upgraded international lounges, improved passenger check-in procedures, and the delivery of Melbourne Airport's third runway project. metadata.title: Cosmic推進Cosmic One電動飛機計畫 預計2028年首飛

a-20260822-0724-cosmic-aerospace-details.text: Cosmic推進Cosmic One電動飛機計畫 預計2028年首飛 Cosmic發布Cosmic One電動飛機,預計2028年首飛、2029年交付。 總部位於美國丹佛的新創航空業者Cosmic Aerospace公布旗下「Cosmic One」四座全電動飛機的開發與交付時程。根據公司規劃,Cosmic One原型機預計於2028年進行首次試飛,並計畫於2029年正式開始向客戶交付。首批生產的100架飛機將組成「創始者系列」(Founder Series),後續亦將持續進行量產,主要瞄準私人機主、飛行俱樂部與飛行訓練機構等通用航空市場。 該項開發計畫主要受惠於美國聯邦航空管理局(FAA)推行的「特別適航檢定現代化」(MOSAIC)法規架構。MOSAIC架構擴大了輕型運動飛機(LSA)類別的認證範疇,包含取消原有的重量上限限制、將最大飛行速度上限提升至250節、允許四座座艙配置,並開放使用新型替代動力系統,為電動飛機的商業認證提供了明確的法規途徑。 在市場發展與訂單方面,飛行俱樂部Centennial Flyers已簽約成為Cosmic One的起始機隊客戶。此外,製造商表示在產品正式發布約三週內,已收到多筆來自私人機主的訂金,顯示通用航空市場對於採用新一代電動動力技術的飛機具備實質需求與興趣。 Cosmic Aerospace高層表示,開發並認證Cosmic One除了開拓通用航空市場外,更重要的是建立製造與法規認證實力。公司計畫以Cosmic One驗證其電動推進技術架構與營運模式,為未來研發規模更大的「Skylark」區域電動客機奠定堅實的技術與實務基礎。 Cosmic Aerospace Details Cosmic One Electric Aircraft Development for 2028 First Flight Cosmic Aerospace plans to fly its electric Cosmic One in 2028 with deliveries starting in 2029. US startup Cosmic Aerospace, based in Denver, has outlined development plans for its Cosmic One four-seat all-electric aircraft. According to the company, the prototype is scheduled to make its maiden flight in 2028, with commercial customer deliveries targeted to begin in 2029. The initial 100 production aircraft will form a designated Founder Series, after which serial production is expected to continue beyond the initial batch to serve private aircraft owners, flight clubs, and pilot training providers. The company's program timeline aligns with the Federal Aviation Administration's (FAA) Modernisation of Special Airworthiness Certification (MOSAIC) regulatory framework. The MOSAIC rules expand certification parameters within the Light Sport Aircraft category by removing previous weight restrictions, raising the maximum airspeed limit to 250 knots, permitting four-seat cabin configurations, and allowing alternative propulsion systems necessary for commercial electric aircraft qualification. Commercial traction for Cosmic One includes flying club Centennial Flyers signing as the launch fleet customer for the platform, alongside initial financial deposits collected from private owner-operators within approximately three weeks of the aircraft's initial product launch. Cosmic Aerospace reported additional interest from other fleet operators seeking to transition away from legacy piston-engine general aviation platforms toward electric aircraft. Cosmic Aerospace leadership emphasized that Cosmic One serves both as a general aviation commercial product and as a technological foundation. Operating and certifying the four-seat aircraft is intended to validate the company's electric propulsion stack while establishing essential manufacturing processes, supply chains, and regulatory certification experience required prior to developing its larger Skylark electric regional airliner project. Cosmic Aerospace plans to fly its four-seat all-electric Cosmic One prototype in 2028 and begin deliveries in 2029. Cosmic plans to fly its prototype in 2028 and begin deliveries in 2029. The first 100 Cosmic One aircraft will form a Founder Series, with serial production continuing beyond the initial batch. The first 100 aircraft will form a Founder Series, and production will continue beyond those initial examples. The FAA's MOSAIC framework expands Light Sport Aircraft certification parameters by eliminating weight limits, increasing speed to 250 knots, allowing four seats, and permitting alternative propulsion. It eliminates the previous weight limit, increases the maximum speed to 250 knots and allows four-seat aircraft. It also permits alternative propulsion systems, which is crucial for Cosmic. Flying club Centennial Flyers is the launch fleet customer for Cosmic One, and Cosmic received initial deposits from private owner-operators. Flying club Centennial Flyers is its launch fleet customer, and Cosmic says other fleet operators are also interested. Cosmic One is designed to serve as a technology, manufacturing, and certification foundation for Cosmic's planned Skylark electric regional aircraft. It is intended to put Cosmic’s electric propulsion technology into service while building the manufacturing and certification experience needed as a foundation to build the commercial Skylark electric regional aircraft.

metadata.title: 瑞士CELLSIUS團隊氫燃料電池飛機移師派耶恩機場(VIP)進行首飛準備

a-20260822-0724-swiss-student-team-prepa.text: 瑞士CELLSIUS團隊氫燃料電池飛機移師派耶恩機場(VIP)進行首飛準備 瑞士學生團隊將H2-Sling氫能實驗機移至派耶恩機場(VIP);進行首飛前最終準備 隸屬於瑞士蘇黎世聯聯邦理工學院(ETH Zurich)的學生工程團隊 CELLSIUS Aero,已將其研發的 H2-Sling 氫燃料電池實驗飛機從原建造地瑞士迪邦多夫(Dübendorf),移師至洛桑附近的派耶恩機場(VIP;Payerne Airport)。此項運送標誌著該項目已進入實際飛行前的最終準備階段,團隊將在該營運中機場完成各項首飛前整備作業。 H2-Sling 機種基於 Sling High Wing 機身架構進行改裝,採用氫電混合動力系統取代傳統內燃機。其動力核心配備額定功率 100 千瓦(kW)的燃料電池系統,經過測試後最大推進功率可達 105 千瓦;同時搭載一座容量為 5.6 千瓦時(kWh)的緩衝電池,用於因應起飛等階段的高動力需求變化。該機最大起飛重量為 1,050 公斤。 在氣體儲存與設計效能方面,H2-Sling 於兩翼下方的雙高壓儲氣罐中儲存 5.2 公斤的高壓氫氣,儲存壓力達 700 bar。該機設計可載運兩名乘客,團隊目標為實現 125 英里(相當於 200 公里)的航程、約 2 小時的飛行時間,以及每小時 100 英里(相當於 162 公里)巡航速度。 CELLSIUS 團隊於 2025 年底首度公開 H2-Sling 概念,並於 2026 年期間持續進行地面測試與監管申請作業。此前,該團隊曾於 2022 年成功試飛全純電池動力的 e-Sling 飛機,其航程為 112 英里(180 公里)。雖然蘇黎世聯邦理工學院尚未正式確認具體日程,但當地媒體報導指出,首飛預計可能於 8 月底前進行。 Swiss Student Team Prepares H2-Sling Hydrogen Aircraft for Maiden Flight Swiss team CELLSIUS transfers the H2-Sling hydrogen fuel-cell aircraft to Payerne Airport (VIP) for final maiden flight preparations. A Swiss student engineering team affiliated with ETH Zurich, CELLSIUS Aero, has transferred its H2-Sling hydrogen fuel-cell demonstrator aircraft from its construction site in Dübendorf to Payerne Airport (VIP) near Lausanne in Switzerland. The transfer marks the project's transition into the final stage of preparations before attempting to demonstrate the aircraft in actual flight at an active airfield. The H2-Sling is built on a Sling High Wing airframe and uses a hydrogen-electric powertrain instead of a conventional internal combustion engine. The aircraft features a fuel-cell system rated at 100 kW, with maximum propulsion power listed by CELLSIUS at 105 kW following testing. The powertrain includes a 5.6 kWh battery buffer to manage short-duration changes in power demand, such as during takeoff. The aircraft's maximum takeoff weight is listed at 1,050 kg. Hydrogen fuel is stored under a pressure of 700 bar across two high-pressure tanks located beneath the wings, providing a total storage capacity of 5.2 kg. The two-seat aircraft is designed to achieve a targeted flight range of 125 miles (200 km), approximately two hours of flight time, and a cruise speed of 100 mph (162 km/h). The technological setup mirrors concepts evaluated for larger hydrogen-electric aircraft by pairing sustained fuel-cell power with battery buffering. CELLSIUS first unveiled the fully integrated H2-Sling in late 2025 and conducted ground tests throughout 2026 while working through legal and regulatory requirements. This new development follows the team's earlier e-Sling project, a battery-electric aircraft that first flew in 2022 with a range of 112 miles (180 km). Local media reports suggest the maiden flight could occur by the end of August, though ETH Zurich has not confirmed the timing. a-20260822-0724-spanish-f-a-18-fighter-i.text: 西班牙F/A-18戰機於羅馬尼亞領空擊落不明無人機 西班牙空軍F/A-18戰機於羅馬尼亞領空攔截並擊落一架疑似來自俄羅斯的無人機。 北大西洋公約組織(NATO)表示,一架不明飛行器於8月16日當地時間凌晨4時44分,從鄰國摩爾多瓦飛入羅馬尼亞領空,位置位於加拉茨以北約24公里處。該目標首先由羅馬尼亞的空域監測系統發現。 當時正在羅馬尼亞執行北約空中警務任務的一對西班牙F/A-18戰鬥機中,其中一架戰機透過雷達掌握該侵入目標。在獲得授權後,該架F/A-18戰機於當地時間5時01分將無人機擊落,殘骸預計落於兩座村莊之間的無人居住區域。 羅馬尼亞當局並未立即確認該飛行器的來源。北約發言人馬丁·歐唐納上校(Colonel Martin O'Donnell)隨後指出,該架遭擊落的無人機「似乎是俄羅斯的」。 Spanish F/A-18 Fighter Intercepts and Destroys Drone in Romanian Airspace A Spanish F/A-18 fighter jet destroyed a suspected Russian drone after it entered Romanian airspace from Moldova. a-20260822-0818-regent-autonomous-squire.text: REGENT自主海洋翼地滑翔機Squire完成美軍演習測試 REGENT自主翼地滑翔機Squire於美軍演習完成測試,執行電子戰任務。 美國載具製造商 REGENT 宣布,旗下自主研發的 Squire 海洋翼地滑翔機(Seaglider)已於美國密西根州舉行的「寂靜蜂群」(Silent Swarm)軍事演習中完成美軍運作測試。這項為期兩週的演習匯集了橫跨陸地、空中與海洋領域的實驗性無人系統,旨在評估各項平台於實戰環境中的整體表現。 在演習期間,Squire 自主翼地滑翔機搭載了專為電子攻擊、電子防護以及電子戰支援所設計的任務載荷。該平台與其他無人系統協同作業,並於複雜的電磁環境中接受測試,面臨包括雷達、無線電通訊、衛星導航、紅外線及定向能量系統等多種威脅與反制措施的考驗。 Squire 屬於翼地效應載具(Wing-in-ground vehicle),利用貼近水面飛行時產生的空氣動力效應提升運作效率。該載具保持於水面上約一個翼展的高度飛行,能有效低於雷達地平線,結合最高 70 節(約每小時 130 公里)的巡航速度與低雷達截面積特性,提供極高的戰術隱蔽性。 Squire 原型驗證機的大小約為 REGENT 旗下一型載客 Viceroy 滑翔機的四分之一,設計航程可達 100 海浬(約 185 公里)。REGENT 指出,這款被稱為 Squire USA-V 的無人水面與空中載具可承載達 23 公斤(50 磅)的任務載荷,適用於情報偵察、前線後勤、搜救以及反潛作戰等多種任務。 REGENT 於 2025 年 7 月正式成立專責的國防部門,積極推動翼地滑翔機技術從民用交通拓展至軍事與民防領域。公司目前正持續透過自研的飛控軟體開發全自主飛行能力,並同步規劃搭載混合動力系統的軍用版 Viceroy 載具,以延伸未來的執勤範圍與任務彈性。 REGENT Autonomous Squire Seaglider Completes Operations in US Military Exercise REGENT completed US military exercise operations with its autonomous Squire seaglider in Michigan. metadata.title: 太空中心島脈探空火箭成功發射完成通訊驗證
airline: 國家科學及技術委員會
airport: 屏東旭海科研火箭發射場域

a-20260822-1220-tasa-successfully-launch.text: 太空中心島脈探空火箭成功發射完成通訊驗證 太空中心島脈火箭於屏東成功發射,完成全程通訊與各次系統飛行驗證。 台灣國家太空中心(TASA)自主研製的首支探空火箭「島脈」(MARAHO)於2026年8月22日清晨在屏東旭海科研火箭發射場域成功執行首次飛試任務。此次發射順利完成了火箭點火、飛行及降落傘展開等關鍵發射作業,並成功進行了全程通訊等關鍵驗證,標誌著太空中心在入軌火箭計畫上取得重要進展。 根據國家太空中心的數據,探空火箭於當天上午7時10分點火升空。在點火後,火箭持續推進了18秒,起飛時的推力達到1500公斤重,最高速度達到每秒408公尺(相當於超音速的1.2馬赫)。火箭在起飛後第49秒順利抵達8.1公里的最高高度,整趟任務的總飛行時間為432秒,各項飛行程序均依規劃順利完成。 此次飛試的核心關鍵目標在於建立地面與火箭之間的全程通訊系統,以即時接收火箭於飛行過程中所下傳的觀測資料。在飛行末段,火箭依程序展開了兩階段降落傘並順利落海。儘管後續因海上風浪過高以及箭體持續漂移,導致回收團隊最終未能成功將箭體打撈上岸,但由於所有必要的飛行資料均已在飛行期間即時回傳,因此這並未影響主要飛試驗證數據的取得。 這款命名為「島脈」的探空火箭,其名稱取自台灣特有種且有「國蝶」之稱的寬尾鳳蝶,箭體外觀視覺設計亦融入其代表性的寬大紅色尾突。在規格方面,箭體總長為7.2公尺,直徑為0.4公尺,其推進系統採用了由90%雙氧水與聚丙烯(PP)組成的混合式推進劑。 國家太空中心自2023年在國家科學及技術委員會(國科會)的指導下啟動了入軌火箭計畫,終極目標是於2034年掌握自主入軌能力。為逐步降低大型載具開發風險,太空中心規劃於2029年以第一代次軌道測試火箭(STV1)驗證各項次系統,並於2031年透過第二代次軌道測試火箭(STV2)驗證完整載具,最終在2034年執行第一代入軌火箭飛試,預計將200公斤級酬載送入低地球軌道。 TASA Successfully Launches First Self-Developed Sounding Rocket MARAHO TASA successfully launches its first self-developed sounding rocket MARAHO in Pingtung for system verification. Taiwan's National Space Agency (TASA) successfully launched its first self-developed sounding rocket, named "MARAHO," on the morning of August 22, 2026, from the Xuhai research rocket launch site in Pingtung. The successful test flight marked a major milestone for TASA's orbital rocket program, completing critical launch procedures including ignition, flight, parachute deployment, and establishing full end-to-end communication. According to official flight parameters, the "MARAHO" rocket lifted off at 7:10 AM. The hybrid propulsion system fired for 18 seconds, generating a liftoff thrust of 1,500 kilograms. The rocket accelerated to a maximum speed of 408 meters per second, equivalent to supersonic speed at Mach 1.2. It reached its peak altitude of 8.1 kilometers 49 seconds after launch, completing a total flight duration of 432 seconds. A primary objective of the mission was to test and verify the ground-to-rocket end-to-end communication system to enable real-time telemetry downlink during the flight. At the final stage of the flight, the rocket deployed its two-stage parachute system and landed in the ocean as planned. While high waves and drifting prevented the recovery team from retrieving the physical rocket body, TASA confirmed that all critical flight data had been successfully transmitted to the ground station during the flight, ensuring no impact on the test results. The "MARAHO" rocket, named after Taiwan's endemic Agehana maraho butterfly, is 7.2 meters long with a diameter of 0.4 meters. Its propulsion system relies on a hybrid design utilizing 90% hydrogen peroxide and polypropylene (PP). The butterfly's prominent red tail protrusion inspired the visual design of the rocket, symbolizing the tail flames of a rocket during liftoff. TASA initiated its domestic orbital rocket development project in 2023 under the guidance of the National Science and Technology Council. The agency aims to build sovereign space launch capabilities, with the long-term goal of sending a 200-kilogram payload into low Earth orbit by 2034. To mitigate development risks, TASA plans to launch the first-generation suborbital test rocket (STV1) in 2029 and the second-generation test rocket (STV2) in 2031 before the final orbital flight test. On August 22, 2026, the Taiwan Space Agency (TASA) successfully conducted the first test flight of its first self-developed sounding rocket, "島脈" (MARAHO), completing ignition, flight, and parachute deployment. 首支自主研製的探空火箭「島脈MARAHO」今天清晨執行首次飛試任務,順利完成火箭點火、飛行及降落傘展開等發射作業 The rocket was launched from the Xuhai research rocket launch site in Pingtung at 7:10 AM, with 18 seconds of thrust, reaching supersonic speed of Mach 1.2 and a peak altitude of 8.1 kilometers. 今天上午7時10分,「島脈」於屏東旭海科研火箭發射場域點火升空,火箭推進18秒,起飛推力達到1500公斤重,最高速度為每秒408公尺,達超音速(馬赫1.2),並於49秒抵達最高高度8.1公里,總飛行時間432秒 The primary objective of the mission was to verify the ground-to-rocket end-to-end communication system and receive real-time data downlinked during flight. 關鍵目標是建立地面與火箭的全程通訊系統,即時接收火箭飛行中下傳的資料 High waves and drifting prevented the recovery team from retrieving the rocket body from the sea, but this did not affect the acquisition of the test flight's validation data. 受到高浪及箭體持續漂移影響,最終未能完成箭體打撈 The "MARAHO" rocket is 7.2 meters long and 0.4 meters in diameter, utilizing a hybrid propulsion system of 90% hydrogen peroxide and polypropylene (PP). 箭體規模長7.2公尺、直徑0.4公尺,推進系統為90%雙氧水與聚丙烯(PP)混合式 TASA initiated its orbital rocket project in 2023 under the National Science and Technology Council's guidance, targeting autonomous orbital launch capabilities by 2034 to carry 200-kg payloads into low Earth orbit. TASA在國家科學及技術委員會指導下,於2023年啟動入軌火箭計畫,目標在2034年掌握自主入軌能力

a-20260822-1325-tigerair-taiwan-to-raise.text: 台灣虎航9月1日起調整訂位服務費 各航段調升50元 台灣虎航9月1日起調漲訂位服務費;非旺季每航段350元,旺季450元 台灣虎航於官網宣布,自2026年9月1日起調整訂位服務費收費標準。非旺季航班每位旅客每航段訂位服務費由300元調升至350元,旺季航班則由400元調升至450元。 航空公司指出,若旅客於2026年8月31日(含)前完成購票,並於9月1日(含)後辦理航班改期,訂位服務費將依變更當時之標準重新計算。若改期後適用費用高於原支付金額需補收差額,低於原支付金額則不退還。 訂位服務費係透過全球分銷系統(GDS)隨機票票券收取。目前包含中華航空、長榮航空、星宇航空及台灣虎航等國籍航空公司,均依使用者付費原則收取相關服務費用。 Tigerair Taiwan to Raise Booking Service Fees Starting September 1 Tigerair Taiwan will adjust booking service fees on September 1, raising rates by 50 TWD per segment. Tigerair Taiwan announced an adjustment to its booking service fees effective September 1, 2026. The fee per passenger per flight segment will increase from 300 TWD to 350 TWD for off-peak flights, and from 400 TWD to 450 TWD for peak season flights. For tickets bought on or before August 31, 2026, that are changed on or after September 1, 2026, booking fees will be recalculated under the new rates. Passengers must pay any price increase, but lower fee differences will not be refunded. Booking service fees are collected alongside airfares for services provided through Global Distribution Systems (GDS). Taiwanese carriers including China Airlines, EVA Airways, STARLUX Airlines, and Tigerair Taiwan collect these fees based on user-pay principles. 台灣虎航公告自2026年9月1日起調整訂位服務費收費標準。 自2026年9月1日起調整訂位服務費收費標準 非旺季航班訂位服務費每位旅客每航段由300元調整至350元,旺季航班由400元調整至450元。 非旺季航班訂位服務費每位旅客每航段從300元調整至350元,旺季航班每位旅客每航段從400元調整至450元。 於2026年8月31日前購票並於9月1日後改期者,訂位服務費依新標準重算補收差額,不退還低於原金額之差額。 若是在2026年8月31日(含)前完成購票,並於2026年9月1日(含)後辦理航班變更(改期) 訂位服務費係透過全球分銷系統(GDS)隨票收取,華航、長榮航空、星宇航空及台灣虎航均隨票收取。 由於機票訂位是透過全球分銷系統(GDS)提供服務,基於使用者付費的概念,隨票券收取訂位服務費

a-20260822-1613-us-pilot-scope-clauses-l.text: 美國幹線航空機師合約條款限制區域客機76座與重量門檻 美國航空公司與機師工會之合約條款限制區域客機最多76座及8.6萬磅 在美國大型航空公司與機師工會簽訂的團體協約中,範疇條款(Scope clauses)針對外包給區域航空公司營運的航班數及機型做出合約限制。 美國區域航空市場最常見的限制,包括區域合作夥伴營運之客機最多僅能設置76個座位,且最大起飛重量不得超過86000磅。相關規範為航空公司與工會協商之商業合約,並非美國聯邦航空局(FAA)的法規。 雖然新型引擎技術能提升燃油效率,但額外重量導致如巴西航空工業E175-E2等新一代機型超出86000磅的合約上限,使其難以在美國區域航空市場順利投入營運。 US Pilot Scope Clauses Limit Regional Aircraft Seats and Weight Limits US airline scope clauses limit regional aircraft to 76 seats and 86,000 pounds maximum weight. Scope clauses contained in collective bargaining agreements between major US airlines and pilot unions establish contractual limits on the extent of flying outsourced to regional carriers and the types of aircraft regional partners may operate. Key restrictions commonly enforced in the US regional market cap regional partner aircraft capacity at 76 seats and set a maximum take-off weight limit of 86,000 pounds. These rules represent contractual agreements negotiated with unions rather than Federal Aviation Administration regulations. While newer engine technologies improve fuel efficiency, added weight causes modern regional aircraft models such as the Embraer E175-E2 to exceed the 86,000-pound contractual weight threshold, restricting their operational deployment across US regional flight networks. Scope clauses in collective bargaining agreements between US major airlines and pilot unions place contractual limits on outsourced regional flying and regional aircraft operations. A scope clause is a provision in a collective bargaining agreement between a major airline and its pilots’ union. It sets out the circumstances under which the airline can outsource flying to another carrier, normally a regional airline. Key restrictions in the US regional market commonly limit regional partner aircraft to 76 seats and a maximum take-off weight of 86,000 pounds. One of the most important restrictions in the US regional market is the commonly cited limit of 76 seats and 86,000 pounds maximum take-off weight. Scope clause restrictions are contractual agreements negotiated between airlines and pilot unions rather than Federal Aviation Administration regulations. It is also important to understand that these restrictions are not Federal Aviation Administration regulations. They are contractual agreements negotiated between airlines and pilot unions. Advanced engine technology adds weight, causing newer models like the Embraer E175-E2 to exceed the 86,000-pound limit and limiting their deployment in the US regional market. The aircraft was designed as a next-generation development of the E175, but its weight exceeds the traditional 86,000-pound limit. metadata.title: 薩博公開A3-001無人戰鬥航空系統概念

a-20260823-1113-saab-unveils-a3-001-uncr.text: 薩博公開A3-001無人戰鬥航空系統概念 薩博發表A3-001無人戰鬥系統概念;預計2030年前進行示範機首飛。 瑞典航太與國防企業薩博於2026年8月22日發表新型無人戰鬥航空系統概念機「A3-001」。該款概念機是在瑞典林雪平附近的馬爾門空軍基地舉行的銀禧航空展上公開亮相,該展覽旨在慶祝瑞典空軍成立100週年。 A3-001旨在高風險及爭議性環境中,與獅鷲E型(Gripen E)等有人戰鬥機協同作戰,而非取代有人戰機。該機型具備低可偵測性與高自主性,任務範疇涵蓋電子戰、壓制敵方防空系統以及精準打擊。 薩博於展覽現場展示了A3-001的全尺寸模型。薩博先進計畫業務負責人尼爾森(Peter Nilsson)表示,該概念代表薩博對2030年代中期以後建構系統的願景,並計畫於2030年前試飛具備戰鬥機特性的無人示範機。 Saab Unveils A3-001 Uncrewed Combat Air System Concept in Sweden Saab unveiled its A3-001 uncrewed combat air system concept in Sweden, planning test flights before 2030. Swedish aerospace and defense company Saab unveiled a new uncrewed combat air system concept named A3-001 on August 22, 2026. The concept was publicly presented at the Jubilee Air Show, held at Malmen Air Base near Linköping, Sweden, to mark the 100th anniversary of the Swedish Air Force. The A3-001 platform is designed to operate alongside manned fighters, such as Saab's Gripen E, in high-risk and contested environments. Featuring low observability and autonomous capabilities, the aircraft is intended for electronic warfare, suppression of enemy air defense, and precision strike missions. Saab displayed a full-scale mockup at the air show. Peter Nilsson, head of Advanced Programs at Saab, stated that the concept represents a vision for systems from the mid-2030s onwards, with plans to fly uncrewed demonstrators before 2030. Rather than replacing manned fighters, such as Saab’s own Gripen E, the new platform has been designed to operate alongside them, particularly in high-risk, contested environments. a-20260823-1325-american-airlines-ai-boo.text: 美國航空人工智慧訂位軟體誤改行程引發反彈 美國航空人工智慧軟體誤改延誤旅客轉機行程;系統運作異常引發反彈 美國航空(American Airlines)近期因其新推出的人工智慧訂位軟體出現運作錯誤,正面臨越來越多的旅客反彈與不滿。該款軟體原先的設計宗旨,旨在當航班出發時間出現延誤時,能自動協助受影響的旅客順利銜接後續轉機航班。 然而在實施過程中,該人工智慧軟體在部分情況下發生錯誤重新訂位的狀況。系統在未事先詢問或取得旅客同意的情況下,逕行修改旅客的航班行程,將旅客改簽至較晚出發的航班,因而給出行旅客帶來諸多困擾與行程混亂。 American Airlines AI Booking Software Faces Backlash Over Erroneous Itinerary Changes American Airlines faces backlash as its AI booking software erroneously changes delayed passengers' itineraries. The airline's automated program was originally designed to make it easier for delayed travelers to catch their connecting flights whenever an initial flight departure falls behind schedule. a-20260823-1513-syberjet-claims-light-je.text: SyberJet聲稱SJ30-2創下美國輕型噴射機跨洲飛行速度紀錄 SyberJet表示SJ30-2橫越美國耗時4小時7分;尚待權威機構認證 根據AeroTime報導,商務噴射機製造商SyberJet Aircraft於2026年8月21日表示,旗下SJ30-2噴射機創下美國由東向西的輕型噴射機跨洲飛行速度紀錄。該次飛行由飛行員Gordon Bryan執飛,自美國佛羅里達州傑克森維爾飛往加州聖地牙哥,耗時約4小時7分鐘,平均時速達505.3英里(約813.2公里)。 SyberJet指出,該項紀錄屬於國際航空聯合會(FAI)的C-1.f飛機類別,涵蓋重量在6000至9000公斤之間的動力陸上飛機。公司預計該紀錄在大約90天內獲得美國國家航空協會與FAI的正式認證。此外,SyberJet執行長Trevor Milton亦隨機飛行,公司目前正規劃於2032年取得新款九座噴射機SJ36的認證並投入營運。 SyberJet Claims Light Jet Transcontinental Speed Record with SJ30-2 Flight SyberJet claims an SJ30-2 light jet speed record after flying across the United States in four hours. Executive aircraft manufacturer SyberJet Aircraft announced on August 21, 2026, that one of its SJ30-2 light jets set a new east-to-west transcontinental speed record in the United States. Flown by pilot Gordon Bryan, the aircraft traveled from Jacksonville, Florida, to San Diego, California, in approximately 4 hours and 7 minutes, achieving an average speed of 505.3 mph. The company stated that the speed record falls under the FAI C-1.f aircraft category for powered landplanes weighing between 6,000 and 9,000 kg. SyberJet expects formal certification of the record from the National Aeronautic Association and the FAI within approximately 90 days. Chief Executive Officer Trevor Milton was also onboard the flight, as the manufacturer targets 2032 for the certification of its planned SJ36 light jet model.
