a-20260825-2119-us-rescinds-syria-terror.text: 美國撤銷敘利亞支恐指定 解除航班往返禁令 美國撤銷敘利亞支援恐怖主義國家登記;國務院豁免敘利亞航班往返美國禁令 美國於2026年8月24日將敘利亞從支援恐怖主義國家名單中除名,並進一步推動解除對敘利亞擁有或控制之航班往返美國的限制。美國國務卿盧比歐(Marco Rubio)在完成45天的國會審查程序後正式撤銷該項指定,標誌著美國對敘利亞航空業相關法律限制的重大調整。 美國國務院同時豁免了依據《化學與生物武器管制與消除戰爭法案》實施的剩餘限制措施,其中包括禁止由敘利亞擁有或控制的航空運輸事業往返美國。國會已於8月24日收到相關豁免通知。根據美國財政部發布的更新指引,該豁免措施將於通知送達20天後正式生效。 美國官方強調,該項豁免並不代表敘利亞籍航空公司可立即獲准開航美國航線。任何有意進入美國市場的航空公司,仍須取得相關的經濟、飛安、航空安保與營運審查批准。此外,美方對部分特定個人與組織的針對性制裁依然有效,航空製造商與相關機構仍須遵守相關合規規範。 在出口管制方面,美國商務部此前已調整針對敘利亞的出口限制,並擴大了針對替換零件、飛機零組件及特定臨時飛機營運的許可豁免。美國商務部指出,針對支援民用航空領域的出口許可申請,只要相關項目不會對敘利亞的軍事能力或支援國際恐怖主義的能力產生重大貢獻,將採取預設批准原則進行審查。 敘利亞近期已著手恢復部分因長期衝突而中斷的國際航線。根據報導,敘利亞航空(Syrian Airlines)已恢復大馬士革往返莫斯科、阿姆斯特丹與麥地那的航班服務;同時,德國航空公司 Sundair 與 LEAV Aviation 也已規劃或啟動往返大馬士革及代爾祖爾等地的航班營運。 US Rescinds Syria Terror Designation and Moves to Lift Aviation Restrictions US State Department rescinds Syria terrorism status, waiving ban on Syrian flight operations. The United States has removed Syria from its official list of state sponsors of terrorism and initiated measures to remove longstanding legal restrictions on Syrian-owned or controlled flights operating to and from the US. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio formally rescinded the terrorism designation on August 24, 2026, following the completion of a required 45-day congressional review period. As part of these regulatory adjustments, the US State Department also waived remaining statutory restrictions imposed under the Chemical and Biological Weapons Control and Warfare Elimination Act. These included a prohibition against Syrian-owned or controlled air transportation serving US destinations. The United States Congress was formally notified of the waiver on August 24, and updated Treasury Department guidance specifies that the measure will take effect 20 days after notification. US authorities emphasized that this statutory waiver does not confer immediate regulatory approval for any Syrian airline to launch direct flights to the United States. Any air carrier seeking to serve the American market must still obtain all applicable economic, flight safety, aviation security, and operational approvals. Furthermore, targeted sanctions against specific individuals and designated organizations remain in place, requiring aviation sector firms to maintain compliance protocols. On the trade front, the US Commerce Department previously eased broader export restrictions and expanded regulatory license exceptions covering aircraft components, replacement parts, and temporary aircraft operations. The department noted that applications supporting civil commercial aviation are reviewed under a presumption of approval, provided that the requested equipment or technology does not make a significant contribution to military capabilities or international terrorism. Amid these regulatory developments, international flight services to Syria have progressively resumed across several routes. State carrier Syrian Airlines has restored air connections linking Damascus with Moscow, Amsterdam, and Madinah. Concurrently, European carriers including Sundair and LEAV Aviation have commenced or announced scheduled passenger operations connecting German cities with Syrian airports in Damascus and Deir Ezzor. metadata.title: FAA宣布新 Frederick 工廠投產 生產數位語音交換設備

a-20260825-2217-faa-opens-new-frederick-.text: FAA宣布新 Frederick 工廠投產 生產數位語音交換設備 FAA在馬里蘭州Frederick啟動新工廠 生產數位語音交換設備 美國運輸部長肖恩·達菲和聯邦航空局局長布萊恩·貝德林在馬里蘭州Frederick啟動一座8.7萬平方英尺的新先進製造工廠。 該工廠將生產數位語音 over IP 語音交換設備,用於空中交通管制員與飲航駕駛員及其他管制設施之間的通訊。 達菲表示:「我們正在確保我們的空中交通管制系統是美製的。」貝德林表示:「這些設備是我們 landmark 空中交通管制現代化工作的關鍵部分。」 貝德林表示新設施支持到2028年底完成新系統的進度,並強化美國生產能力及創造高品質美國就業機會。 FAA表示,僅在過去一年內已將63%的銅線更換為高速光纖、5G無線或LEO能力,並在96座塔樓安裝表面意識識別技術。 FAA Opens New Frederick Plant to Build Digital Voice Switches for ATC Modernization FAA opens new Frederick plant to build digital voice switches for ATC modernization U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy and Federal Aviation Administrator Bryan Bedford celebrated the grand opening of a state-of-the-art 87,000-square-foot manufacturing plant in Frederick, Maryland. The facility will build digital Voice over IP voice switches that help air traffic controllers communicate with pilots and other air traffic control facilities. Secretary Duffy said, “We’re making sure our air traffic control system is American made.” Administrator Bedford said, “This equipment is a critical part of our landmark air traffic control modernization effort.” Administrator Bedford said the new facility supports the aggressive schedule to complete the new system by the end of 2028 while strengthening U.S. production capabilities and creating high-quality American jobs. The FAA noted that in just one year it has replaced 63% of copper wires with high-speed fiber, 5G wireless or LEO capabilities and installed Surface Awareness Initiative technology at 96 towers. a-20260825-2318-latam-secures-505-millio.text: LATAM獲得5.05億美元融資 將引進11架新客機 LATAM獲得5.05億美元融資;將於2026年引進11架新機以加速機隊更新。 拉丁美洲航空集團(LATAM)已成功完成一項金額達5.05億美元的融資案,將用於籌措2026年引進11架新客機的所需資金。此項融資交易旨在協助該航空公司加速推動機隊更新計畫,強化整體營運佈局。 根據Simple Flying報導,在LATAM預計於2026年接收的11架新客機中,包含4架空中巴士A321neo型客機以及6架巴西航空工業E195-E2型客機。航空公司將藉由這筆5.05億美元的資金注入,落實機隊世代更新目標。 LATAM Secures $505 Million Financing Deal For 11 New Aircraft In 2026 LATAM secures $505 million financing to add 11 new aircraft in 2026, accelerating fleet renewal. LATAM has secured a $505 million financing deal to fund 11 new aircraft scheduled to arrive in 2026, according to details reported by Simple Flying. The newly secured financial arrangement is intended to support the airline group by accelerating its overall fleet renewal process. The financing agreement covers 11 new aircraft additions in 2026, including four Airbus A321neo aircraft and six Embraer E195-E2 aircraft. The acquisition of these aircraft forms a central component of LATAM's ongoing fleet renewal program. With $505 million in total funding established for these 11 new aircraft, LATAM is positioned to continue its fleet modernization plans through 2026. a-20260826-0043-taiwan-railways-clears-s.text: 台鐵南迴線枋山至枋野段搶通 8月26日首班車恢復正常營運 台鐵南迴線枋山至枋野區間已完成搶通;列車自8月26日首班車起全面恢復正常行駛。 根據官方營運訊息,台鐵南迴線位於枋山至枋野之間的路段現已順利完成搶通作業。在相關路線經過搶修並確認安全後,該鐵路區間已具備恢復車輛正常通行的條件。 隨著該區間路線搶通,台鐵宣布南迴線自8月26日首班車起全面恢復正常行駛。全線各班次列車將按照原定營運計畫發車,提供正常軌道運輸服務。 枋山至枋野路段搶通作業完成後,台鐵南迴線整體列車調度與班次服務重新恢復銜接。各班次列車將按照既定時刻表正常行駛,維護該鐵路路線的穩定營運與整體運輸順暢。 Taiwan Railways Clears South Link Line Section for Normal Service Resumption on August 26 Taiwan Railways clears South Link Line between Fangshan and Fangye, resuming normal service on August 26. Taiwan Railways announced that the section of the South Link Line between Fangshan and Fangye has been cleared. Repair crews completed necessary operations, allowing rail traffic to safely pass through the affected corridor once again. With the track reopening, Taiwan Railways confirmed that normal train operations on the South Link Line will resume starting from the first scheduled train on August 26. All scheduled rail services will run according to regular timetables. The restoration of service between Fangshan and Fangye reconnects rail transit along the line, ensuring stable operations and consistent schedule reliability across the local railway network. 台鐵南迴線枋山至枋野間路段已完成搶通。 台鐵南迴線枋山至枋野間搶通 台鐵南迴線自8月26日首班車起恢復正常行駛。 26日首班車起恢復正常

a-20260826-0219-heavy-rain-worsens-mudsl.text: 豪雨引發枋山枋野土石流加劇 台鐵南迴線8月25日深夜前全線停駛 豪雨致枋山至枋野土石流加劇;台鐵南迴線於8月25日24時前全線停駛。 根據報導,受豪雨影響,臺灣鐵路位於枋山與枋野路段之間的土石流狀況呈現加劇趨勢。強烈降雨致使該區域鐵路線路周邊土石流現象持續發展。 因應枋山至枋野區間土石流加劇情況,臺灣鐵路管理局針對南迴線採取預警與應變措施。台鐵宣布南迴線全線列車於2026年8月25日晚間24時前實施全面停駛。 本次停駛範圍涵蓋台鐵南迴線整體路線,所有列車服務於2026年8月25日24時前暫停營運。相關單位持續關注該路段豪雨與土石流之最新變化。 Heavy Rain Worsens Mudslides as TRA Suspends South-Link Line Service Taiwan Railways suspended South-Link Line services before midnight on August 25 following heavy rain and mudslides. Heavy rain has intensified mudslides along the railway section between Fangshan and Fangye in Taiwan. Severe rainfall in the region has worsened mudslide activity along the corridor, affecting the local railway infrastructure. In response to the intensifying mudslide conditions between Fangshan and Fangye, Taiwan Railways announced a complete suspension of train operations on the South-Link Line. All train services on the South-Link Line are halted prior to midnight (24:00) on August 25, 2026. The full operational suspension applies across the entire South-Link Line route until midnight on August 25. Rail authorities continue to monitor weather conditions and mudslide development in the affected sector. 受豪雨影響,枋山至枋野路段土石流狀況加劇。 豪雨狂炸...枋山枋野土石流加劇 台鐵南迴線於2026年8月25日當晚24時前全面停駛。 台鐵南迴線今晚24時前全停駛

a-20260826-0431-vice-president-drone-dev.text: 蕭副總統:無人機發展受法規限制 NCC停擺添壓力 蕭副總統談無人機發展;法規、空域限制;NCC停擺衝擊 副總統蕭美琴接受中央社專訪時表示,台灣發展無人機除了技術問題,也面臨測試空域及法規限制。行政院已盤點18個無人機測試空域,並設法縮短申請程序。 她指出,新機型及通訊技術涉及射頻、頻譜使用,主管機關國家通訊傳播委員會(NCC)的停擺也對產業造成壓力。她希望朝野看到台灣在軍事安全與產業發展上的實際需求,讓相關配套及方案儘快到位。 此外,蕭副總統提及部分遠距型無人機因缺乏足夠空域,「只能飛上去繞圈圈」以測試續航時間及距離,這部分可尋求國際合作,將台灣無人機帶到理念相近國家進行測試。 Vice President: Drone Development Faces Regulatory Limits, NCC Paralysis Adds Pressure Vice President cites airspace, frequency regulatory hurdles; NCC paralysis pressures drone industry Vice President Bi-khim Hsiao said in an interview with Central News Agency that Taiwan's drone development faces not only technical challenges but also restrictions on testing airspace and regulations. The Executive Yuan has identified 18 drone testing zones and is working to shorten application procedures. The vice president said new models and communication technologies require approval from the National Communications Commission (NCC), adding that 'the NCC's paralysis is also causing a certain degree of pressure on the industry.' The NCC is responsible for radio frequency and spectrum matters. Hsiao expressed hope that both political camps will recognize the actual needs in military security and industrial development, and enable related plans to come through soon. For long-range drones lacking sufficient airspace, she noted they can 'only fly around in circles' to test endurance and distance, and international cooperation could allow tests in larger airspace in friendly countries. 副總統蕭美琴表示,台灣發展無人機除了技術問題,也面臨測試空間及法規限制。 台灣發展無人機除了技術問題,也面臨測試空域及法規限制 行政院已盤點18個無人機測試空域,並設法縮短申請程序。 行政院已盤點18個無人機測試空域,並設法縮短申請程序。 因為新機通訊技術涉及射頻、頻譜使用,NCC停擺對產業造成壓力。 新機型及通訊技術涉及射頻、頻譜使用,主管機關NCC的停擺也對產業造成壓力。

metadata.title: 工研院攜手奇美等成立塑膠包材循環示範聯盟

a-20260826-0524-taiwan-s-itri-forms-alli.text: 工研院攜手奇美等成立塑膠包材循環示範聯盟 工研院攜手奇美及中華航空等;成立廢塑膠包材轉化循環輕油示範聯盟 工研院今天宣布,攜手奇美實業、全家便利商店、台灣希普思、唯信公司、中華航空,以及熱裂解油供應商海神全球,成立「廢塑膠包材轉化循環輕油應用示範聯盟」,建立廢塑膠包材轉化為循環石化料源的示範模式。 工研院材料與化工研究所所長邱國展表示,工研院開發高效能除雜吸附材料與催化劑技術,將塑膠裂解油升級為符合石化原料規格的循環輕油,相較於焚化發電回收模式,可減少約50%碳排放。 邱國展表示,聯盟將驗證聚烯烴循環產業模式的可行性,並串聯跨產業夥伴建構循環供應鏈,未來持續擴大示範與吸引更多企業投入。 中華航空永續長鄭智仁表示,期望透過參與聯盟,以實際行動推動資源循環、責任生產與服務、能源轉型及氣候行動。 Taiwan's ITRI Forms Alliance with Chi Mei, Others for Plastic Recycling Demonstration ITRI partners with Chi Mei, China Airlines and others to launch a plastic waste recycling demonstration alliance for circular light oil. Taiwan's Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI) announced today that it has formed the Waste Plastic Packaging Conversion Circular Light Oil Demonstration Alliance with Chi Mei Industrial, FamilyMart, Taiwan Chips, Vicome, China Airlines, and pyrolysis oil supplier Poseidon Global, to establish a demonstration model for converting waste plastic packaging into circular petrochemical feedstock. ITRI Materials and Chemical Research Laboratories Director Chiu Kuo-chan said the institute has developed high-efficiency adsorption materials and catalyst technologies that upgrade plastic cracking oil into circulating light oil meeting petrochemical feedstock specifications, with a carbon reduction of about 50% compared to incineration power generation. Chiu noted that the alliance aims to verify the feasibility of the polyolefin circular industry model and build a cross-industry circular supply chain. China Airlines Sustainability Officer Eric Cheng said the company hopes to support resource circulation, energy transition and climate action by participating in the alliance. 工研院宣布與奇美實業、全家便利商店、台灣希普思、唯信公司、中華航空及海神全球共同成立廢塑膠包材轉化循環輕油示範聯盟。 工研院今天宣布,攜手奇美實業、全家便利商店、台灣希普思、唯信公司、中華航空,以及熱裂解油供應商海神全球,成立廢塑膠包材轉化循環輕油應用示範聯盟 該示範模式是將廢塑膠包材轉化為循環石化料源。 跨產業建立廢塑膠包材轉化為循環石化料源的示範模式。 相較於焚化發電,回收模式可減少約50%碳排放。 相較於焚化發電回收模式,相關技術可減少約50%碳排放 工研院開發高效除雜吸附材料與觸媒技術。 工研院開發高效除雜吸附材料與觸媒技術 中華航空參與聯盟,永續長鄭智仁表示將以實際行動推動資源循環等。 中華航空永續長鄭智仁說,期望藉由參與聯盟,攜手產業夥伴以實際行動推動資源循環、責任生產與服務、能源轉型及氣候行動。

metadata.title: 沙烏地航空集團與法國盛陸銀行簽署融資備忘錄籌措客機資金

a-20260826-0832-saudia-group-signs-mou-w.text: 沙烏地航空集團與法國盛陸銀行簽署融資備忘錄籌措客機資金 沙烏地航空集團在巴黎簽署融資備忘錄;攜手盛陸銀行籌措新空中巴士客機資金 沙烏地阿拉伯航空集團(Saudia Group)於2026年8月25日在法國巴黎簽署一項三方瞭解備忘錄,與沙烏地出口進口銀行(Saudi EXIM Bank)及法國盛陸銀行(Crédit Agricole CIB)合作,探討並籌劃購買新型空中巴士(Airbus)客機的融資方案。 根據協議,法國盛陸銀行作為融資與籌劃機構,將依據交付時程安排相應的購機融資結構;沙烏地出口進口銀行則作為國家出口信用機構,提供與交易相關的信用風險保險承保。 此項備忘錄由沙烏地航空集團總幹事易卜拉欣·阿爾奧馬爾、沙烏地出口進口銀行執行長薩阿德·阿爾哈爾布與法國盛陸銀行常務董事安德烈·澤爾武達奇共同簽署。該集團目前仍有60架 A321neo 與13架 A321XLR 客機等待交付。 Saudia Group Signs MoU with French Bank Crédit Agricole to Finance Airbus Aircraft Saudia Group signed an MoU in Paris to arrange financing for new Airbus aircraft deliveries. Saudia Group signed a memorandum of understanding in Paris on August 25, 2026, with Saudi EXIM Bank and French investment bank Crédit Agricole CIB to explore and arrange financing solutions for acquiring new Airbus aircraft. Under the agreement, Crédit Agricole CIB will act as financier and arranger to structure financing in line with delivery schedules. Saudi EXIM Bank will serve as the export credit agency, providing credit risk insurance coverage for the transactions. The tripartite agreement was signed by Saudia Director General Ibrahim Al-Omar, Saudi EXIM Bank CEO Saad Al-Khalb, and Crédit Agricole CIB Managing Director André Zervudachi. Saudia is currently awaiting delivery of 60 Airbus A321neo and 13 Airbus A321XLR aircraft. metadata.title: 聯合航空班機機組員執勤超時 旅客滯留威斯康辛停機坪五小時

a-20260826-0932-united-airlines-passenge.text: 聯合航空班機機組員執勤超時 旅客滯留威斯康辛停機坪五小時 一架聯合航空航班因機組員工時屆滿,旅客受困於威斯康辛州停機坪達五小時。 根據 Simple Flying 報導,聯合航空(United Airlines)發生一起停機坪滯留事件,班機乘客在美國威斯康辛州的地面停機坪上滯留長達五小時。事件起因於客機在地面滑行途中,機組人員因執勤時間屆滿超時,導致航班無法正常進行後續任務。 報導進一步指出,當時客機內部出現物資供應短缺的問題,同時受限於機組人員的執勤時間限制,加上美國海關及邊境保衛局(CBP)相關設施當時處於關閉狀態,多種因素共同影響,致使旅客在停機坪經歷長時間等待。 United Airlines Passengers Stranded on Wisconsin Tarmac for 5 Hours United Airlines passengers were left stranded on a Wisconsin tarmac for five hours after crew timed out. According to news reports from Simple Flying, passengers on a United Airlines flight were kept waiting on a tarmac in Wisconsin for five hours. The severe delay occurred after the flight crew reached their mandatory duty time limits while taxiing on the ground, leaving the airplane unable to continue its planned movement. The situation on the Wisconsin tarmac was further impacted by several complicating operational factors. Reports highlighted onboard supply shortages during the five-hour wait, in addition to strict crew duty limits and closed U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) facilities, which together created major difficulties for the affected passengers. United Airlines left passengers stranded on a tarmac in Wisconsin for five hours after crew reached duty time limits mid-taxi. metadata.title: 瑞科羅啟動新一代R4豪華經濟艙座椅交付 首批客戶未公開

a-20260826-0932-recaro-begins-deliveries.text: 瑞科羅啟動新一代R4豪華經濟艙座椅交付 首批客戶未公開 瑞科羅開始交付R4豪華經濟艙座椅;預計2026年底前正式投入營運服務。 德國座椅製造商瑞科羅(RECARO Aircraft Seating)確認,已於2026年6月開始向未公開名稱的客戶交付其新一代R4豪華經濟艙座椅。該公司預計,這款全新座椅產品將於2026年底前正式投入商業營運服務。 R4座椅概念最早於2023年在德國漢堡舉行的飛機內裝展(Aircraft Interiors Expo)上首次公開,並於2025年的同場展覽中進行公開展示。日本全日空(All Nippon Airways)在2025年展覽期間宣佈已選擇R4座椅來裝備其豪華經濟艙,不過瑞科羅並未說明該航空公司是否為首發啟動客戶。 瑞科羅將這款新一代產品定位為PL3530座椅的後繼機型。PL3530於2015年推出,並獲多家國際航空公司採用於豪華經濟艙,包含阿聯酋航空、英國航空、國泰航空與星宇航空,拉丁美洲航空(LATAM Airlines)亦選擇該機型用於其即將推出的豪華經濟艙產品。 在人體工學與乘客舒適度方面,R4座椅配備瑞科羅標誌性的六向可調頭枕與內建頸部支撐、側邊氣氛燈、整合閱讀燈的隱私翼,以及便於行動不便旅客(PRM)使用的側邊控制台與軟啟閉超寬餐桌。此外,座椅配有16吋機上娛樂螢幕、智慧型手機與平板電腦支架,並支援多種個人電子設備充電選項。目前R4座椅已取得波音787(Boeing 787)的歐洲技術標準訂單(ETSO)認證,瑞科羅正持續推進其他機型的認證工作。 RECARO Begins Deliveries of New R4 Premium Economy Seats to Unnamed Customer RECARO Aircraft Seating began delivering its R4 Premium Economy seats in June 2026 ahead of service entry. RECARO Aircraft Seating has confirmed that it officially began delivering its new generation R4 Premium Economy seat to an undisclosed customer in June 2026. According to the German aircraft seat manufacturer, entry into commercial passenger service for the new seat product is expected to occur before the end of 2026. The R4 seating concept was initially unveiled at the Aircraft Interiors Expo 2023 in Hamburg and subsequently showcased publicly at the 2025 edition of the same industry event. During the 2025 show, All Nippon Airways (ANA) announced that it had selected the R4 seat to equip its Premium Economy cabin, though RECARO's announcement did not clarify whether the Japanese carrier serves as the launch customer for the product. RECARO is marketing the new generation seat model as the direct successor to its PL3530 seat, which was originally launched in 2015 and has been adopted by several major international airlines introducing Premium Economy cabin offerings. The PL3530 seat is currently in operational service with carriers including Emirates, British Airways, Cathay Pacific, and STARLUX Airlines, and has also been selected by LATAM Airlines for its upcoming Premium Economy cabin product. Building upon its predecessor, the R4 seat incorporates improvements in ergonomics and passenger comfort, including RECARO's signature six-way adjustable headrest with integrated neck support, side ambient lighting, privacy wings with reading lights, a side console for Passengers with Reduced Mobility (PRM) access, and an extra-wide tray table with a soft open and close mechanism. In terms of inflight entertainment and connectivity features, the seat comes equipped with a 16-inch monitor, an integrated holder for smartphones and tablets, and options to support power for passengers' personal electronic devices. To date, the R4 seat is European Technical Standard Order (ETSO) certified for the Boeing 787 aircraft, while RECARO continues working to secure additional certifications. a-20260826-0932-taiwan-caa-advances-kaoh.text: 民航局推動高雄機場(KHH)新航廈計畫 投入880億元分兩期興建 民航局投入880.8億元建設高雄機場新航廈;1-2期交通工程已公告招標 交通部民用航空局表示,目前正積極推動高雄機場(KHH)新航廈工程計畫,預計總共投入880.8億元,分兩期建設年旅客容量達1,650萬人次的全新集中式航廈。民航局與工程團隊正全力推進新航廈主體工程的細部設計工作。 新航廈工程採取「先建後拆、半半施工」的方式推進,在維持機場正常營運下進行施工。目前1-1期的東側立體停車場統包工程及A滑行道北移統包工程均在施工中,1-2期的站前交通改善工程也已於7月21日上網公告招標。 Taiwan CAA Advances Kaohsiung Airport (KHH) Terminal Project with NT$88 Billion Budget Taiwan CAA is advancing Kaohsiung Airport's NT$88.08 billion terminal construction project in two phases. The Civil Aeronautics Administration of Taiwan is advancing the Kaohsiung Airport new terminal project, with a total planned investment of NT$88.08 billion. The project will construct a new centralized terminal in two phases to handle an annual capacity of 16.5 million passengers. The CAA and its engineering teams are currently pushing forward with detailed design work for the main terminal building. The project is being implemented using a phased approach of building before demolition while maintaining normal airport operations. Phase 1-1 works, including the eastern multi-story parking lot design-build project and the relocation of Taxiway A to the north, are under construction. The tender for Phase 1-2 station front traffic improvement project was posted on July 21. 交通部民用航空局預計投入880.8億元,在高雄機場分兩期建設年容量達1,650萬人次的全新集中式航廈。 預計總共投入880.8億元,在高雄機場分兩期建設年容量達1,650萬人次的全新集中式航廈。 高雄機場新航廈工程採「先建後拆、半半施工」方式進行,維持機場營運,目前1-1期東側立體停車場與A滑行道北移工程施工中。 新航廈工程最大的挑戰是採取「先建後拆、半半施工」的方式推進 高雄機場新航廈1-2期站前交通改善工程已於7月21日上網公告招標。 1-2期「站前交通改善工程」也已於7月21日上網公告招標 民航局與工程團隊正推進高雄機場新航廈主體工程細部設計工作。 民航局與工程團隊正全力推進新航廈主體工程的細部設計工作

metadata.title: 杜拜國際機場(DXB)2026上半年旅客量跌逾三成

a-20260826-1025-dubai-international-airp.text: 杜拜國際機場(DXB)2026上半年旅客量跌逾三成 杜拜國際機場2026年上半年因衝突導致旅客量下降超過三成 杜拜國際機場(DXB)在2026年上半年錄得旅客數量大幅減少,機場營運商將此下滑歸因於破壞區域航空旅行的軍事衝突。營運杜拜國際機場與阿勒馬克圖姆國際機場(DWC)的杜拜機場公司(Dubai Airports)於2026年8月26日表示,2026年上半年對該公司而言是一段充滿挑戰的時期。 在2026年1月至6月期間,杜拜國際機場共接待了3,150萬人次的旅客,與2025年同期相比下降了31.3%。該機場的起降架次在今年上半年總計為150,600架次,年減32.1%;與此同時,貨運量在上半年達到751,340噸,同比下降了28.7%。 此次營運下滑的主因為美國、以色列與伊朗之間於2026年2月28日爆發的軍事衝突,該衝突使中東及灣區陷入動盪。由於伊朗向該地區國家(包括杜拜)發射了飛彈與無人機,出於安全考量,許多航空公司選擇繞道避開該區域。 儘管上半年面臨挑戰,杜拜機場公司執行長保羅·格里菲斯(Paul Griffiths)強調,隨著旅客信心增強和人數回升,情況正在改善。格里菲斯指出,上半年的形勢考驗了航空系統的各個環節,但隨著運能穩步恢復,需求隨即做出反應。在第二季度中,旅客量逐月增長,從2026年4月的350萬人次增加到5月的450萬人次,並在6月達到500萬人次。 展望未來,杜拜機場公司發言人預期下半年將迎來更強勁的成長動能。這得益於航空公司網路與航次頻率的持續恢復、國際轉機旅客量的增長、主要客源市場旅遊警示的放寬、冬季班表,以及杜拜即將舉辦的一系列全球商業、休閒和體育賽事。作為對比,杜拜國際機場在2025年共接待了創紀錄的9,520萬名旅客,創下該機場歷史上最繁忙的一年,也是全球所有機場中有史以來最高的年度國際旅客吞吐量。 Dubai International Airport (DXB) Passenger Traffic Falls Over 31% in First Half of 2026 Dubai International Airport passenger traffic dropped 31.3% in first half of 2026 amid regional conflict. Dubai International Airport (DXB) recorded a significant decrease in its passenger numbers during the first half of 2026, with airport operators attributing the decline to ongoing regional military conflicts that have disrupted air travel. According to Dubai Airports, which manages both Dubai International and Al Maktoum International (DWC), the first six months of 2026 represented a challenging period for aviation operations in the region. From January to June 2026, Dubai International welcomed 31.5 million passengers, marking a 31.3% decline compared to the corresponding period in 2025. Flight movements at the airport also experienced a downturn, totaling 150,600 aircraft movements during the six-month period, which is a 32.1% reduction year-on-year. Furthermore, cargo volumes handled at the hub decreased by 28.7% year-on-year to 751,340 tons. The operational decline followed the outbreak of a military conflict involving the United States, Israel, and Iran on February 28, 2026, which impacted the Middle East and Gulf regions. Iran launched missiles and unmanned aerial vehicles against regional targets, including Dubai. Consequently, multiple international airlines opted to bypass the airspace in the area to minimize risks. Despite the challenging start to the year, Dubai Airports CEO Paul Griffiths emphasized that the situation has begun to stabilize. Griffiths stated that the first half of the year tested the entire aviation ecosystem, but demand has responded quickly as capacity returns. Passenger numbers showed a steady month-on-month increase throughout the second quarter, rising from 3.5 million in April 2026 to 4.5 million in May, and reaching 5 million in June. Looking ahead, Dubai Airports expressed optimism for the remaining half of 2026. A spokesperson noted that momentum is expected to build due to the recovery of airline networks, an increase in international transit traffic, the winter flight schedule, and Dubai's schedule of business, leisure, and sporting events. In 2025, Dubai International handled a record-breaking 95.2 million guests, which was the highest annual international passenger volume recorded by any airport. a-20260826-1025-latam-secures-505m-finan.text: 南美航空融資引進11架新機 2026年底機隊突破410架 南美航空獲5.05億美元融資,年底前引進11架空中巴士與巴西航空工業客機。 南美航空集團(LATAM Airlines Group)宣布將在2026年底前接收11架新世代窄體客機,以推進機隊現代化進程。本次公布的機隊擴增與更新計畫涵蓋空中巴士(Airbus)與巴西航空工業(Embraer)製造的機型,並獲得總額達5.05億美元的長期融資支持。 在最新一批交付規劃中,南美航空預計接收1架空中巴士A320neo、4架空中巴士A321neo,以及6架巴西航空工業E195-E2客機。引進E195-E2對該集團的巴西營運具有重要意義,南美航空計畫於未來數月內將該機型投入巴西國內航線,這將是該機型首次進入巴西國內航網服務。 本次由法國巴黎銀行(BNP Paribas)主導的5.05億美元融資案中,約有4億美元採用永續連結融資結構。根據該機制,融資利率與南美航空每單位二氧化碳排放強度的減排表現直接掛鉤。南美航空設定目標在2030年前將碳排放強度相較2019年基準降低6%,並朝向2050年實現淨零碳排放的長期目標邁進。 南美航空在2026年前七個月已接收13架新機,包括7架空中巴士A320neo、4架空中巴士A321neo及2架波音(Boeing)787-9客機。加上本次公布的11架引進計畫,該集團預計2026全年新機接收總量將突破40架,並使機隊總規模在2026年底前超過410架。 展望長期營運規劃,南美航空預計在2030年前累計新增多達130架新世代客機,屆時機隊中將有超過半數為新世代機型。此外,該集團首架長程空中巴士A321XLR客機預計於2027年投入服務,機上商務艙將配備Thompson Aero Seating VantageSOLO全平躺座椅。 LATAM Secures $505M Financing to Add 11 Aircraft by Year-End 2026 LATAM Airlines secures $505 million financing to add 11 Airbus and Embraer aircraft by late 2026. LATAM Airlines Group is expanding its fleet with the addition of 11 next-generation narrowbody aircraft before the end of 2026. The latest fleet renewal package includes aircraft manufactured by Airbus and Embraer, supported by a total of $505 million in long-term financing secured by the airline group. Under the newly announced tranche, LATAM expects to take delivery of one Airbus A320neo, four Airbus A321neos, and six Embraer E195-E2s. The addition of the Embraer E195-E2s is particularly strategic for the group's Brazilian operations, as LATAM plans to introduce the type on domestic routes in Brazil in the coming months, marking its first operation of the model in the country's domestic network. The financing structure led by BNP Paribas includes approximately $400 million tied to sustainability-linked metrics. Under this mechanism, LATAM's loan interest rates are linked directly to its carbon dioxide emissions intensity performance, providing financial incentives for the airline to meet its target of reducing emissions intensity by 6% by 2030 compared to a 2019 baseline, ahead of its longer-term goal of reaching net-zero emissions by 2050. Having already taken delivery of 13 aircraft during the first seven months of 2026—comprising seven Airbus A320neos, four A321neos, and two Boeing 787-9 Dreamliners—LATAM projects total new aircraft deliveries to exceed 40 units for the full year. As a result, the airline group anticipates ending 2026 with an active fleet count exceeding 410 aircraft. Looking further ahead, LATAM plans to add as many as 130 next-generation aircraft to its fleet by 2030, which would result in more than half of its total fleet consisting of modern, lower-emission airframes. Additionally, the group is scheduled to introduce its first long-range Airbus A321XLR in 2027, featuring Thompson Aero Seating VantageSOLO full-flat seats in its Premium Business cabin. metadata.title: 華航預計2027年3月起調整一線人員名牌呈現方式

a-20260826-1232-china-airlines-to-revise.text: 華航預計2027年3月起調整一線人員名牌呈現方式 中華航空預計自2027年3月起調整員工名牌;移除中文全名並標示姓氏與別名 中華航空於2026年8月26日證實,因應第一線服務人員的實際職務需求,預計自民國116年(2027年)3月起,分階段換發服務類服制名牌。華航表示,新版名牌呈現方式將拿掉員工原本標示的中文全名,調整改為以中英文姓氏,並與英文名縮寫或外文別名擇一並列呈現。 華航說明,這次宣布調整一線服務人員服制名牌的標示方式,主要是考量第一線人員於工作場合的執勤特性與服務需求。透過修改名牌上的個人姓名資訊,可以在維持與旅客基本互動和識別功能的前提下,妥善保護員工個人隱私與執勤安全。 關於其他台灣國籍航空公司的相關做法,台灣虎航已於2026年2月1日起開放第一線人員申請新版工作證或名牌。第一線員工可依個人意願選擇是否申請,其新版名牌設計移除中文姓氏,並輔以英文別名,主要用於提供外籍旅客辨識與互動溝通。 長榮航空對此回應表示,基於第一線員工與旅客互動的工作特性,以及在適法前提下,長榮航空將持續研擬員工執勤配戴名牌的具體做法。 星宇航空則表示,第一線人員於日常執勤時,名牌維持標示中文全名及英文名,方便各國旅客辨識與溝通。不過在公關活動及拍攝場合,基於同仁隱私與安全考量,皆會事先遮蔽名牌資訊以避免姓名曝光。星宇航空強調,未來將持續研議合理的名牌呈現方式,秉持兼顧服務需求與員工隱私保護的原則。 China Airlines to Revise Frontline Staff Name Tag Format from March 2027 China Airlines will revise frontline staff name tags starting March 2027, removing full Chinese names. China Airlines confirmed on August 26, 2026, that it will adjust the display format of uniform name tags for frontline service personnel starting from March 2027. According to the carrier, the new name tags are scheduled to be issued in phases. The updated design will remove employees' full Chinese names and instead display Chinese and English surnames paired with either an English name abbreviation or a foreign alias. China Airlines explained that the adjustment to frontline service name tags is being made in response to operational requirements and frontline duty characteristics. By modifying the presentation of personal identity details on name tags, the airline aims to maintain practical identification for passenger communication while protecting employee privacy and safety. Regarding practices among other Taiwanese carriers, Tigerair Taiwan introduced an option on February 1, 2026, allowing frontline personnel to voluntarily apply for updated work credentials or name tags. Under Tigerair Taiwan's modified design, Chinese surnames are removed and supplemented with English aliases to facilitate recognition by foreign passengers. EVA Airways stated that, based on the operational characteristics of frontline staff interaction with passengers and under applicable legal premises, it will continue to study practices for staff wearing name tags while on duty. STARLUX Airlines noted that its frontline staff currently wear name tags displaying full Chinese and English names for daily duties to facilitate communication with passengers from different countries. However, during public relations events and filming, name tag information is masked in advance to protect employee privacy and safety. STARLUX Airlines added that it will continue evaluating reasonable name tag presentation formats under the principles of balancing service needs and staff privacy protection. China Airlines confirmed it will adjust frontline service personnel name tags starting March 2027, removing full Chinese names and displaying Chinese and English surnames paired with English name abbreviations or foreign aliases. 華航今天證實,因應職務需求,從明年3月起,員工名牌將拿掉中文全名,改為以中英文姓氏,以及英文名縮寫或外文別名擇一並列。 China Airlines expects to issue the updated uniform name tags in phases starting from March 2027. 預計自116年3月起分階段換發。 Tigerair Taiwan introduced an option on February 1 for frontline staff to voluntarily apply for new work credentials or name tags omitting Chinese surnames and adding English aliases. 台灣虎航今年2月1日起,第一線人員可依個人意願選擇申請新版工作證或名牌,新版設計將移除中文姓氏並輔以英文別名供外籍旅客辨識。 EVA Airways stated it will continue to study name tag practices for duty staff considering employee-passenger interaction characteristics and legal premises. 長榮航空表示,基於一線員工與旅客互動的工作特性及適法前提下,長榮航空將持續研擬執勤配戴名牌作法。 STARLUX Airlines uses full Chinese and English names on frontline name tags for daily duties, masks name info during PR events and filming, and continues to evaluate reasonable name tag formats. 星宇航空表示,第一線人員於日常執勤時,名牌以中文全名及英文名作為識別,方便各國旅客辨識與溝通;但於公關活動及拍攝時,基於同仁隱私與安全考量,皆會事先遮蔽名牌資訊,避免姓名曝光,未來將持續研議合理名牌呈現方式,兼顧服務需求與員工隱私保護的原則。

a-20260826-1610-britten-norman-begins-gr.text: Britten-Norman展開首架英國組裝Islander地面測試 Britten-Norman開始首架英製Islander地面測試;預計9月試飛 英國飛機製造商Britten-Norman已正式開始為首架自生產線全面回遷英國後製造的Islander飛機進行地面測試。該架飛機於2026年7月30日在位於懷特島(Isle of Wight)的設施順利出廠,此前已成功完成首次電氣系統通電測試,象徵著該公司在英國重新建立完整飛機製造能力的重要進展。 該架測試飛機目前的國籍與登記標籤為G-FRZT。按照製造商規劃,飛機在完成地面測試後,預計將於2026年9月開展首次飛行測試。待後續各項飛行測試與客戶交付準備工作告一段落後,該飛機將正式交付予福克蘭群島政府航空服務隊(Falkland Islands Government Air Service, FIGAS),加入其營運機隊。 在飛機順利出廠前,技術團隊已陸續完成發動機、螺旋槳、整流罩、電氣系統、煞車系統以及飛行控制面與相關機構的安裝。此前製造商曾於2026年6月確認該機身結構完成度達到75%,目前該架飛機已進入全面的地面測試階段。 除了首架已出廠測試的飛機外,Britten-Norman指出第二架飛機的機身亦正在懷特島班布里奇(Bembridge)的生產線上持續推進組裝作業,同時後續多架飛機的相關零組件也已進入製造階段,顯示英國生產線已逐步步入連續製造節奏。 Islander機型最早於1967年開始生產,其後主要製造程序移往羅馬尼亞。直到2023年6月,Britten-Norman宣布將製造作業重新遷回英國班布里奇,以強化對生產進度與供應鏈的掌控能力。 Britten-Norman Begins Ground Testing of First Reshored UK-Built Islander Aircraft Britten-Norman has started ground testing the first UK-built Islander aircraft ahead of its September first flight. a-20260826-1850-sepehran-airlines-737-ve.text: 塞佩罕航空737客機伊朗衝出跑道前起落架塌陷 塞佩罕航空客機於馬什哈德降落後衝出跑道;機上127人安全疏散無人受傷 伊朗塞佩罕航空(Sepehran Airlines)一架波音737-500客機於2026年8月25日在伊朗馬什哈德國際機場(MHD)降落後衝出跑道。該班機航班號為IS4310,由德黑蘭梅赫拉巴德機場(THR)飛抵馬什哈德。客機降落後偏離鋪設跑道並駛入未鋪設區域,最終造成機鼻著地、前起落架塌陷。 機上共載有127名乘客與機組人員,事發後均已安全疏散,未收到任何人員受傷報告。受到涉事客機停擺影響,馬什哈德國際機場發布通告,暫時關閉13R跑道以及Q滑行道。 伊朗民用航空組織表示,該客機在降落前未曾接獲任何技術故障通報,降落過程最初屬正常狀態。然而客機在高速動態下向左偏離跑道並進入草地區域。伊朗當局已派遣專業調查小組前往現場,以釐清衝出跑道與起落架損壞的原因。 涉事客機註冊編號為EP-FSF,為1992年5月製造的波音737-529機型。該機最早交付比利時國家航空(Sabena)服役,隨後曾先後營運於烏克蘭空中之航(AeroSvit)、烏克蘭國際航空、印尼廖內航空(Riau Airlines)及卡爾星航空(Kalstar Aviation),並於2016年加入塞佩罕航空機隊。 伊朗各航空公司長期在面對嚴格限制下維持高齡西方客機運作,塞佩罕航空機隊主要由波音737-300與737-500組成。此外,美國財政部於事故前一日(8月24日)宣佈對伊朗航空業實施新一輪經濟制裁,不過塞佩罕航空未被列入該批具體制裁名單中。 Sepehran Airlines 737 Veers Off Runway in Iran with Nose Gear Collapse Sepehran Airlines 737 veers off runway in Iran; 127 passengers and crew evacuate safely without injuries. A Sepehran Airlines Boeing 737-500 veered off the runway after landing at Mashhad International Airport (MHD) in Iran on August 25, 2026. Flight IS4310 was arriving from Tehran Mehrabad Airport (THR) when the aircraft departed the paved surface following what officials described as a normal landing approach. No injuries were reported among the 127 passengers and crew members on board, all of whom evacuated safely after the aircraft came to a stop. Images from the scene showed the aircraft resting nose-down in an unpaved area with its nose landing gear collapsed. The disabled aircraft prompted airport authorities to temporarily close Runway 13R and Taxiway Q at Mashhad. Iran's Civil Aviation Organization stated that no technical issues had been reported by the flight crew prior to landing. According to official reports, the aircraft veered to the left while traveling at high speed on the runway before entering the unpaved field. Iranian aviation authorities have dispatched an investigation team to Mashhad to determine the cause of the runway excursion. The aircraft involved in the accident is registered as EP-FSF, a Boeing 737-529 manufactured in May 1992. Originally delivered to Belgian carrier Sabena as OO-SYJ, the jet later flew for AeroSvit, Ukraine International Airlines, Riau Airlines, and Kalstar Aviation before joining Sepehran Airlines in 2016. Iranian carriers have kept aging Western-built aircraft operational despite long-standing international restrictions that limit access to new airframes and spare parts. Sepehran operates a fleet composed mainly of Boeing 737-300 and 737-500 aircraft on domestic and regional routes. The incident occurred one day after the United States Treasury Department announced expanded economic sanctions targeting Iran's aviation sector, although Sepehran was not specifically named in that announcement. 塞佩罕航空一架波音737-500客機於2026年8月25日從德黑蘭梅赫拉巴德機場飛抵馬什哈德國際機場降落後衝出跑道。 A Sepehran Airlines Boeing 737-500 veered off a runway after landing at Mashhad International Airport (MHD) in northwest Iran 涉事航班號為IS4310,機上127名乘客與機組人員均安全疏散且無人受傷。 leaving the aircraft disabled but causing no reported injuries among the 127 passengers or crew. 現場照片顯示客機前起落架塌陷並以機鼻著地停於未鋪設區域,事故導致13R跑道與Q滑行道暫時關閉。 Images taken after the accident show the 737 resting nose-down with its nose landing gear no longer supporting the aircraft. 伊朗民航組織表示降落前未收到技術故障報告,已派遣調查小組前往現場釐清事故原因。 The organization said no technical problem had been reported before the landing. 涉事機型為1992年5月製造的波音737-529(註冊號EP-FSF),於2016年加入塞佩罕航空。 The aircraft was identified as EP-FSF, a Boeing 737-529 built in May 1992. 美國財政部於8月24日宣佈對伊朗航空業擴大經濟制裁,但塞佩罕航空未在具體名單中。 Sepehran was not named among the entities sanctioned in the August 24 announcement.

a-20260826-1850-first-two-of-66-f-16v-bl.text: 台灣首批2架F-16V Block70戰機啟程赴台 首批2架F-16V Block 70戰機已啟程赴台;目前停留關島等待天氣 根據航太全球新聞報導,台灣採購66架洛克希德馬丁F-16V戰機中的首批2架已啟程飛往台灣。報導引述自由時報指出,這兩架F-16V Block 70戰機(編號6727與6728)已途經夏威夷,目前停留在關島。 報導稱,這兩架戰機目前仍在關島,等待良好天氣條件後飛往台灣的台東空軍基地。報導提到,抵達台灣後將立即展開地面測試與換裝訓練。 報導指洛克希德馬丁預計在2027年及2028年陸續交付其餘63架戰機。報導也指出,台灣在2020年下單時,原訂66架全數於2026年底前交付,但因產線搬運與供應鏈中斷導致延宕。 First two of 66 F-16V Block 70 fighters depart for Taiwan First two of 66 F-16V Block 70 jets depart for Taiwan; currently in Guam awaiting weather Aerospace Global News reports that the first two of Taiwan's 66 Lockheed Martin F-16V fighters have departed for Taiwan. Citing Taiwan's Liberty Times, the report says the two F-16V Block 70 jets, serial numbers 6727 and 6728, transited through Hawaii and are currently in Guam. The report says the two jets remain in Guam, awaiting favorable weather conditions to fly to Taiwan's Taitung Air Force Base. After arrival, they will immediately begin ground testing and conversion training. According to the article, Lockheed Martin expects to deliver the remaining 63 fighters through 2027 and 2028. The report also notes Taiwan initially expected all 66 F-16s delivered by the end of 2026, but production ramp-up has caused delays. metadata.title: 西班牙批准與波蘭合購至少七架A330 MRTT空中加油機

a-20260826-2158-spain-approves-at-least-.text: 西班牙批准與波蘭合購至少七架A330 MRTT空中加油機 西國批准七年框架協議;波蘭2030年前取得四架 西班牙政府已授權與波蘭共同採購至少七架空中巴士A330 MRTT(Multi Role Tanker Transport)空中加油機,其中四架預計在2030年前交付波蘭空軍。據AeroTime報導,西班牙部長會議於2026年8月25日批准此框架協議,估算金額為54億歐元(約63億美元),涵蓋機體及服役所需的後勤支援。 波蘭將透過以歐盟「歐洲安全行動」(SAFE)機制融資的一項增補協議參與。波蘭副總理兼國防部長Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz表示,協議涵蓋「至少七架」空中巴士A330 MRTT,波蘭將在2030年前取得四架;他並補充,下一步是簽署最終協議。 西班牙與波蘭曾於2026年5月29日簽署備忘錄。2026年6月23日柯氏訪問馬德里及空中巴士Getafe改裝中心時表示,雙方正進入實行階段,但尚需確認機數與產能。 波蘭認為國家空中加油機隊對於發揮其引進中的F-35A戰機的航程與續航力至關重要。SAFE提供多達1500億歐元(約1740億美元)的長期貸款資金用於歐洲國防採購,空中加油與戰略運輸皆為符合資格的項目。 新機將補充西班牙現有的三機A330 MRTT計畫;其首架改裝加油機已於2025年4月於第45聯隊服役。兩國尚未確認新一批將採用既有的A330-200或以A330-800為基礎的MRTT+版本。 Spain approves at least seven Airbus A350 MRTT tankers with four bound for Poland Spain backs joint purchase of at least seven Airbus A330 MRTT tankers; Poland to receive 4 by 2030 Spain has authorized a seven-year framework agreement for the joint acquisition of at least seven Airbus A330 Multi-Role Tanker Transport (MRTT) aircraft with Poland, including four for the Polish Air Force by 2030, according to AeroTime. The Spanish Council of Ministers approved the framework on August 25, 2026, with an estimated value of €5.4 billion ($6.3 billion). It covers the aircraft and the logistical support needed to bring them into service. Poland will participate through an addendum financed under the European Union's Security Action for Europe (SAFE) instrument. Polish Deputy Prime Minister and Defense Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamys said the arrangement covered "at least seven" Airbus A330 MRTTs and that Poland would receive four by 2030, adding that the next step would be the signature of the final agreement. Spain and Poland signed a memorandum on May 29, 2026. During a visit to Madrid and Airbus' Getafe conversion center on June 23, 2026, Kosiniak-Kamys said the countries were moving into the implementation phase but still had to settle aircraft numbers and production capacity. Poland considers a national tanker fleet essential to exploit the range and endurance of its incoming F-35A fighters. SAFE provides up to €150 billion ($174 billion) in long-term loans for European defense procurement, with air-to-air refueling and strategic transport among eligible capabilities. The new aircraft would supplement Spain's existing three-aircraft A330 MRTT program, whose first converted tanker entered service with the 45th Wing in April 2025. Neither country has confirmed whether the new batch will use the established A330-200 or the A330-800-based MRTT+ version. metadata.title: 合格但缺乏經驗 新晉飛行員求職難

a-20260826-2158-newly-qualified-pilots-f.text: 合格但缺乏經驗 新晉飛行員求職難 航空業招聘趨向審慎;新晉機師雖合資格仍難獲聘 Aerospace Global News 報道,航空業正面對一個明顯矛盾:一方面長遠就業前景強勁,另一方面新晉飛行員發現完成培訓、取得執照和累計飛行時數已不再保證能獲得職位。 報道指,疫後招聘熱潮已消退,航空公司對招聘對象變得更具選擇性。許多新晉機師面對「經驗門檻」,即使完全符合資格、受過專業訓練且法律上可執業飛行,仍可能因缺乏航空公司認為理想的經驗而在應徵副駕駛席時落選。 報道亦列出長期需求預測,包括波音估計全球航空業未來二十年需要數百萬新航空專業人員;培訓機構 CAE 則估計到二零三四年全球約需三十萬名新機師。文章強調長期勞動力需求與短期招聘需求之間存在區別。 Newly qualified pilots face experience barrier as airline hiring turns more selective Post-pandemic pilot hiring boom fades; airlines more selective, favouring extra hours and experience Aerospace Global News reports the aviation industry faces an apparent contradiction: long-term employment prospects remain strong, yet newly qualified pilots are finding that completing training, earning licences and building flight hours no longer guarantee a job. The post-pandemic hiring boom has faded, and airlines are becoming more selective, according to the report. A pilot can be fully qualified and legally entitled to fly commercially but still lack the experience an airline considers desirable for an entry-level position. Long-term demand is expected to remain significant: Boeing forecast the global aviation industry will require millions of new aviation professionals over the next two decades, and training organisation CAE has estimated around 300,000 new pilots will be needed globally by 2034. 航空業界正面對一個表面矛盾:長期就業前景強勁,但新晉飛行員完成訓練、獲取執照及累積飛行時數後,不再保證能獲得職位。 The pilot paradox: Why newly qualified pilots are finding it harder to find jobs 後疫聘請熱潮已消退,航空公司對招聘對象變得更具選擇性。 The post-pandemic hiring boom has faded, and airlines are becoming more selective about who they recruit. 新晉機師可能完全符合資格、受過專業訓練及法律上可從非商業飛行,但仍因缺乏航空公司認為理想的經驗而在受聘時遇到困難。 a pilot can be fully qualified, professionally trained, and legally entitled to fly commercially, but still lack the experience that an airline considers desirable to bag themselves a job in the right-hand seat. 波音預測全球航空業未來二十年將需數百萬新航空專業人士。 Boeing forecasts that the global aviation industry will require millions of new aviation professionals over the next two decades to support fleet growth and replace workers leaving the industry. CAE 估計全球在二〇三五年底前需要約三十萬名新機師。 CAE has estimated that around 300,000 new pilots will be needed globally by 2034.

metadata.title: 華信立榮提停飛花蓮航線 民航局同意華信適度減班

a-20260827-0746-caa-permits-mandarin-air.text: 華信立榮提停飛花蓮航線 民航局同意華信適度減班 華信與立榮申請停飛花蓮航線,民航局同意華信減班,立榮案件評估中。 交通部民用航空局於2026年8月27日表示,針對華信航空提出暫停營運高雄至花蓮及台中至花蓮航線的申請,初步審查後請業者補充說明並考量地方需求。民航局指出,華信航空後續將採循序漸進方式處理,同意其在訂位狀況不佳時適度減少班次,並將運能轉至其他需求較高的國內航線。 此外,立榮航空亦向民航局申請停止營運台北至花蓮航線,目前民航局尚在評估審查中。根據民航局統計,2023年至2025年間,台北至花蓮航線載客率僅36%,高雄至花蓮為37%,台中至花蓮為44%,三條航線載客率均不及五成。 CAA Permits Mandarin Airlines Flight Cuts to Hualien as UNI Air Suspension Reviewed Mandarin Airlines and UNI Air applied to suspend Hualien flights; CAA approved flight reductions for Mandarin. Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) announced on August 27, 2026, that it has responded to an application from Mandarin Airlines to suspend its Kaohsiung-Hualien and Taichung-Hualien routes. After an initial review, the CAA requested additional information and asked the carrier to consider local transport needs. The CAA agreed to allow Mandarin Airlines to reduce flight frequencies when booking levels are low and reallocate capacity to domestic routes with higher demand. Meanwhile, UNI Air has also submitted an application to the CAA to suspend its Taipei-Hualien route, which remains under evaluation. According to CAA statistics covering 2023 to 2025, load factors were 36% for Taipei-Hualien, 37% for Kaohsiung-Hualien, and 44% for Taichung-Hualien, with all three routes staying below 50%. Mandarin Airlines applied to suspend Kaohsiung-Hualien and Taichung-Hualien routes, while UNI Air applied to suspend the Taipei-Hualien route. 華信航空申請停飛高雄—花蓮與台中—花蓮,立榮航空也向民航局提出申請停飛台北—花蓮航線。 CAA agreed to allow Mandarin Airlines to reduce flight frequencies when booking numbers are low rather than suspending operations completely. 同意華信航空在訂位狀況不佳情況下可適度減少班次,並將運能飛航其他需求較高的國內航線。 CAA stated that UNI Air's application to suspend the Taipei-Hualien route remains under evaluation and review. 至於立榮航空申請停止營運台北—花蓮航線部分,民航局表示,尚在評估審查中。 CAA statistics show average load factors from 2023 to 2025 were 36% for Taipei-Hualien, 37% for Kaohsiung-Hualien, and 44% for Taichung-Hualien. 根據民航局統計從2023年至2025年,台北—花蓮載客率僅36%,高雄—花蓮載客率37%,台中—花蓮載客率44%,3條航線載客率均不及5成

metadata.title: 美國航空737芝加哥奧黑爾(ORD)雙輪爆胎 FAA調查兩週第5起事故

a-20260827-0746-faa-investigates-america.text: 美國航空737芝加哥奧黑爾(ORD)雙輪爆胎 FAA調查兩週第5起事故 美國航空一架737在芝加哥奧黑爾雙輪爆胎;FAA調查兩週內第5起輪胎事故。 美國航空一架波音737客機在芝加哥奧黑爾國際機場(ORD)發生雙輪爆胎事故。針對這起最新發生的客機輪胎爆裂事件,美國聯邦航空總署(FAA)已經正式展開調查程序。 根據Simple Flying的報導資訊,這起美航737客機的雙輪爆胎事件,是芝加哥奧黑爾國際機場自2026年8月13日以來發生的第5起輪胎失效事故。在短短兩週時間內,該機場已累積發生5起輪胎損壞相關事件。 目前美國聯邦航空總署正在調查整起事故的具體情況。主管機關將針對美航737客機雙輪爆胎及奧黑爾機場近期發生的多起輪胎失效事件進行調查與瞭解。 FAA Investigates American Airlines 737 Double Tire Blowout At Chicago O'Hare (ORD) FAA investigates after American Airlines 737 suffers double tire blowout in fifth O'Hare incident since August 13. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) is currently investigating a safety incident after an American Airlines 737 aircraft suffered a double tire blowout at Chicago O'Hare International Airport (ORD). According to reporting published by Simple Flying, the double blowout on the American Airlines jet represents the fifth tire-related failure reported at Chicago O'Hare since August 13. The airport has documented five separate tire incidents over the course of two weeks. Federal aviation authorities are examining the causes and circumstances of the American Airlines 737 double blowout as part of their broader investigation into the recent cluster of tire failures at Chicago O'Hare. a-20260827-0746-taiwan-examination-yuan-.text: 考試院通過民航等特考增列62名額 民航特考總計44名 考試院通過115年特考增列62名額;民航特考增至44名;預計9月5日起舉行。 考試院院會於2026年8月27日審議通過,民國115年公務人員特種考試外交領事人員及外交行政人員、民航人員與原住民族考試,將增列需用名額共計62名。連同先前已公告的需用名額,上述三項特種考試的總需用名額將提升至313名。 本次增列名額係因應外交部、交通部民用航空局及原住民族委員會等用人機關之業務需求提報。其中民航人員特考增列2名需用名額,使民航人員特考總需用名額達到44名。此外,三項特種考試預計將於9月5日起舉行。 Taiwan Examination Yuan Adds 62 Quotas for 2026 Civil Service Exams Including Aviation Taiwan Examination Yuan adds 62 civil service exam quotas; Civil Aeronautics quota reaches 44. The Examination Yuan of Taiwan passed a decision on August 27, 2026, to add 62 recruitment quotas for three specialized civil service examinations, including foreign affairs personnel, civil aeronautics personnel, and indigenous peoples examinations. The total quota across these three exams has increased to 313 positions. The adjustment responds to staffing needs submitted by government agencies, including the Civil Aeronautics Administration of the Ministry of Transportation and Communications. Specifically, two additional quotas were approved for the civil aeronautics examination, raising its overall recruitment quota to 44 positions. All three examinations are scheduled to begin on September 5. 考試院會通過115年公務人員特考增列需用名額62名,包含外交、民航與原住民族特考,總名額達313名。 考試院會今天通過,民國115年公務人員特種考試外交領事人員及外交行政人員、民航人員及原住民族考試增列需用名額62名,連同原公告需用名額,3項考試需用名額共313名。 民航人員特考增列2名需用名額,使總需用名額達到44名。 民航人員特考增列2名 這3項公務人員特種考試預計於9月5日起舉行。 3項考試預計9月5日起舉行

a-20260827-0746-qantas-brings-forward-ai.text: 澳洲航空提前4年淘汰空中巴士A380客機 首批2028年退役 澳洲航空調整客機退役規劃;空中巴士A380首批將於2028年退役 根據 Simple Flying 報導,澳大利亞國家航空澳洲航空(Qantas)調整機隊退役時程,將空中巴士 A380 巨無霸客機的退役計畫提前 4 年。根據最新的機隊規劃,首批空中巴士 A380 客機預計將於 2028 年正式離開機隊並退出服務。 根據過往的紀錄顯示,澳洲航空先前已排定於 10 月 24 日執行從墨爾本飛往洛杉磯的最後一班空中巴士 A380 航班。在該條長程航線上,該航空公司選擇改為調派波音 787-9 客機接替營運。 Qantas Brings Forward Airbus A380 Retirement By Four Years To 2028 Qantas moves up its Airbus A380 retirement schedule by four years, exiting the first superjumbos in 2028. According to reporting from Simple Flying, Australia's flag carrier Qantas has officially moved up its timeline for retiring the Airbus A380 superjumbo fleet by four years. Under the updated operational roadmap, the carrier plans for the first of these long-haul double-deck aircraft to exit its active fleet in 2028. This adjustment builds on prior network fleet decisions made by the airline. Historical records show that Qantas scheduled its final Airbus A380 flight between Melbourne and Los Angeles for October 24, while opting to utilize Boeing 787-9 widebody aircraft for that route instead. Qantas has moved up the retirement of its Airbus A380 fleet by four years, with the first superjumbos set to exit in 2028. a-20260827-0746-egis-group-to-feature-ai.text: 神盾集團參展國際半導體展 展示AI智慧無人機技術 神盾集團將於9月2日參展半導體展;旗下迅杰科技展示AI智慧無人機應用 國際半導體展(SEMICON Taiwan 2026)將於2026年9月2日登場,神盾集團宣佈將再度參展,並以無人機與機器人技術作為本次展出重點。旗下迅杰科技將以AI智慧無人機為展示主軸,呈現半導體晶片技術於實際飛行領域的應用。 迅杰科技表示,其AI軟體透過模擬環境訓練World Model,並結合三軸增穩雲台相機模組,賦予無人機環境感知與自主任務規劃能力。系統同時整合衛星IoT Dongle,支援雙向衛星通訊與多星系GNSS定位,提供遠距離訊息傳輸,拓展多元飛行任務場景。 Egis Group to Feature AI Smart Drones at SEMICON Taiwan 2026 Egis Group will showcase AI smart drones and satellite communications technology at SEMICON Taiwan 2026. Egis Group has announced it will participate in SEMICON Taiwan 2026 starting September 2, 2026, featuring drones and robotics as key exhibition highlights. Its subsidiary, ENE Technology, will focus on AI smart drones to demonstrate how semiconductor chip technology extends to real-world flight applications. According to ENE Technology, its AI software trains a World Model using simulated environments and integrates with a three-axis stabilized gimbal camera module, enabling drones with environmental perception and autonomous mission planning capabilities. The system also integrates a satellite IoT dongle supporting two-way satellite communication and multi-constellation GNSS positioning for long-distance data transmission. SEMICON Taiwan 2026 will open on September 2, where Egis Group will participate with drones and robotics as exhibition highlights. SEMICON Taiwan 2026將於9月2日登場,神盾集團將再度參展,以無人機和機器人為展出重點。 Egis Group subsidiary ENE Technology will focus on AI smart drones at the trade show to demonstrate semiconductor technology application in flight. 神盾集團旗下迅杰科技表示,半導體展將以AI智慧無人機為展示主軸,呈現半導體技術如何從晶片延伸至實際飛行應用。 ENE Technology stated that AI software trains a World Model through simulated environments and integrates with a 3-axis gimbal camera module for environment perception and autonomous mission planning. 迅杰指出,AI軟體透過模擬環境訓練World Model,並與三軸增穩雲台相機模組整合,使無人機具備環境感知與自主任務規劃能力。 The system integrates a satellite IoT dongle supporting two-way satellite communication and multi-constellation GNSS positioning for long-distance message transmission. 同時整合衛星IoT Dongle,支援雙向衛星通訊與多星系GNSS定位,突破傳統網路的覆蓋限制,提供遠距訊息傳輸

metadata.title: 台塑新智能微藻SAF原料通過歐盟ISCC EU認證

a-20260827-0746-formosa-smart-energy-alg.text: 台塑新智能微藻SAF原料通過歐盟ISCC EU認證 台塑新智能微藻SAF原料獲歐盟ISCC認證;助力2030年國籍航空減碳目標 台塑集團旗下台塑新智能於2026年8月27日宣布,其透過轉投資公司澄灝科技以微藻技術開發之國產永續航空燃油(SAF)新興原料,已正式取得歐盟認可的ISCC EU國際永續性與碳驗證。這項驗證展現了相關原料在永續性標準與供應鏈可追溯管理機制上的合規能力,為台灣發展自主永續航空燃油原料供應鏈奠定重要基礎。 根據台塑新智能說明,本次通過的ISCC EU驗證範圍涵蓋微藻培育與藻油製造,並完整納入溫室氣體排放計算及相關管理機制之審查。台塑新智能暨台塑生醫董事長王瑞瑜指出,ISCC EU為歐盟認可之國際永續驗證制度,亦是再生燃料原料進入歐洲永續航空燃油供應鏈的關鍵機制,未來將持續推進製程放大、提升生產效率與優化成本,由試製階段逐步邁向中試與量產驗證。 在微藻技術開發進程方面,台塑新智能總經理劉慧啟表示,澄灝科技已成功開發高效率產油藻株與異營發酵量產技術,結合自有培養條件與工業級模組化設計,藻體含油量可達到50%至60%。目前其設置之500公升試製線已完成階段性量產配方與穩定性評估,產製之藻油產品符合下游煉製端相關原料規格,顯示微藻技術已具備實際進入SAF煉製應用的技術基礎。 此外,台塑集團刻正採取雙軌並行的策略建立自主生質原料供應體系。其中台塑生醫將回收廢食用油提煉為SAF原料,台塑新智能則聚焦以微藻技術開發在地生產之生質原料,兩者分別由資源循環與新興生質技術切入以互相補充。這項布局亦呼應台灣設定之政策目標,預計在2030年實現國籍航空永續航空燃油使用量達到5%的規劃,為航空業淨零轉型提供多元選擇。 Formosa Smart Energy Algae Oil Wins ISCC EU Certification for SAF Formosa Smart Energy secures ISCC EU certification for microalgae oil to support Taiwan SAF goals. Formosa Smart Energy, a subsidiary of Formosa Group, announced on August 27, 2026, that its microalgae-based sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) feedstock developed through its invested company, Chenghao Technology, has officially obtained ISCC EU international sustainability and carbon certification. The certification demonstrates the feedstock's compliance with international sustainability standards and supply chain traceability management, marking a key milestone in developing domestic SAF raw material supply capacity in Taiwan. The scope of the newly acquired ISCC EU certification covers the complete process of microalgae cultivation and algae oil manufacturing, while incorporating greenhouse gas emission calculations and related management system verification. Wang Jui-yu, chairman of Formosa Smart Energy and Formosa Biomedical, stated that ISCC EU is an EU-recognized certification system and a critical verification mechanism for renewable fuel feedstocks entering the European SAF supply chain. Future efforts will focus on scaling up processes, improving production efficiency, and optimizing costs to transition from pilot production to demonstration and commercial mass verification. Addressing technical scalability, Liu Hui-chi, general manager of Formosa Smart Energy, noted that Chenghao Technology has developed high-efficiency oil-producing algae strains alongside heterotrophic fermentation mass-production technology. Utilizing proprietary cultivation conditions and industrial modular design, the microalgae oil content reaches 50% to 60%. A 500-liter pilot line has completed phase-based mass-production formulation and stability evaluations, with the produced algae oil meeting downstream refining feedstock specifications for practical SAF refining applications. To build an autonomous and resilient SAF raw material supply system, Formosa Group is executing a dual-track strategy where Formosa Biomedical refines recycled used cooking oil into SAF feedstock while Formosa Smart Energy develops locally produced microalgae biomass. This dual approach aligns with Taiwan's policy goal of achieving 5% SAF usage among national carriers by 2030, offering diversified choices to support the aviation industry's net-zero transition. 台塑新智能於2026年8月27日宣布,轉投資之澄灝科技以微藻開發的國產永續航空燃油(SAF)原料取得歐盟ISCC EU國際永續性與碳驗證。 台塑集團旗下台塑新智能透過轉投資澄灝科技,以微藻開發國產的永續航空燃油(SAF)新興原料,今天宣布取得ISCC EU國際永續性與碳驗證 本次ISCC EU驗證範圍涵蓋微藻培育與藻油製造,並納入溫室氣體排放計算與相關管理機制。 此次驗證範圍涵蓋微藻培育與藻油製造,並納入溫室氣體排放計算及相關管理機制驗證 澄灝科技已開發異營發酵量產技術使藻體含油量達50%至60%,其500公升試製線已完成配方與穩定性評估,藻油符合下游煉製規格。 澄灝已開發高效率產油藻株和異營發酵量產技術,透過自有培養條件及工業級模組化設計,藻體含油量可達50%至60%。目前500公升試製線已完成階段性量產配方及穩定性評估,產製藻油亦符合下游煉製端相關原料規格 台塑生醫回收廢食用油提煉SAF原料,台塑新智能以微藻技術開發在地生質原料,兩者採取雙軌並行建立供應體系。 台塑生醫與台塑新智能兵分兩路,其中台塑生醫將從循環經濟出發,回收廢食用油提煉為SAF原料;台塑新智能則以微藻技術開發可在地生產的生質原料 台灣設定2030年國籍航空永續航空燃油使用量達到5%的政策目標。 面對台灣2030年國籍航空永續航空燃油使用量達5%的政策目標

metadata.title: 木村拓哉之女擔任星宇航空大使 張國煒親自導覽空山基藝術機

a-20260827-0859-starlux-airlines-appoint.text: 木村拓哉之女擔任星宇航空大使 張國煒親自導覽空山基藝術機 星宇航空邀請木村拓哉之女Kōki,任藝術機大使;董事長張國煒親自導覽 星宇航空日前宣布與日本藝術家空山基合作,推出「STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA」藝術計畫,以旗艦機型空中巴士A350-1000打造兩架獨特的藝術機。此計畫包含兩款特別塗裝,分別為「空山金」與「空山銀」藝術機。為了推廣此項結合航空美學與現代藝術的合作,星宇航空特別邀請日本藝人木村拓哉的女兒Kōki,擔任計畫的藝術機宣傳大使。 根據星宇航空發布的新聞稿,Kōki,日前抵達桃園國際機場(TPE)後,隨即前往星宇航空位於機場的航機修護棚廠,親自一睹「空山銀」藝術機的風采。在參觀過程中,星宇航空董事長張國煒親自現身接待並進行導覽。張國煒向Kōki,分享了AIRSORAYAMA計畫從最初構想到實現的完整歷程,並詳細介紹空山基標誌性的金屬美學與設計元素,如何與星宇航空的品牌精神進行融合。 Kōki,表示,先前在拍攝該計畫的宣傳影片時,只能藉由想像來感受AIRSORAYAMA藝術機的設計,今日終於能親自站在實體飛機旁,感覺非常感動。她表示這是一架結合藝術、設計與航空夢想的作品,很榮幸能成為其中的一部分。 根據本站歷史資料庫,星宇航空與空山基合作的兩架A350-1000客機均已順利交機,機上配置共350個座位。第一架「空山銀」(機身編號B-58553)已於2026年7月交機,並於7月12日首航東京;第二架「空山金」(機身編號B-58554)則是在法國時間8月14日完成交機,並於8月16日返抵桃園國際機場。星宇航空表示,這兩架藝術機預計將自2026年10月1日起正式投入定期航班營運,並將飛航東京、鳳凰城及布拉格等國際熱門航線。 STARLUX Airlines Appoints Kōki, as Art Plane Ambassador with Hangar Tour by Chairman STARLUX Airlines appoints Kōki, as art plane ambassador during a hangar tour in Taiwan STARLUX Airlines announced on August 27, 2026, the launch of its "STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA" art project, a unique collaboration with renowned Japanese artist Hajime Sorayama. The project features two specially designed Airbus A350-1000 flagship aircraft, themed as "AIRSORAYAMA GOLD" and "AIRSORAYAMA SILVER" respectively. To celebrate the debut of these artistic aircraft, STARLUX Airlines has appointed Kōki,, the daughter of famous Japanese actor Takuya Kimura, as the official project ambassador. According to a press release from STARLUX Airlines, Kōki, recently arrived at Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) and visited the airline's aircraft maintenance hangar to inspect the "AIRSORAYAMA SILVER" aircraft. During her visit, STARLUX Airlines Chairman K.W. Chang made a personal appearance to welcome the ambassador and guide her through the aircraft. Chang shared the conceptual journey of the AIRSORAYAMA project from its inception to final realization, highlighting how Sorayama's iconic metallic aesthetics and futuristic elements were seamlessly integrated with the corporate brand identity of STARLUX Airlines. Reflecting on her experience, Kōki, expressed deep gratitude, noting that during the filming of the promotional video, she could only imagine the aesthetic impact of the project. Seeing the actual aircraft in person, she felt deeply moved and honored to be a part of a creation that combines art, engineering design, and aviation dreams. According to AVWIRE historical records, the two flagship A350-1000 aircraft feature a 350-seat configuration, including four First Class seats, 40 Business Class seats, 36 Premium Economy seats, and 270 Economy Class seats. The first art plane, "AIRSORAYAMA SILVER" (registration B-58553), was delivered in July 2026 and completed its inaugural flight to Tokyo on July 12. The second aircraft, "AIRSORAYAMA GOLD" (registration B-58554), completed its delivery in France on August 14 and arrived at Taoyuan International Airport on August 16. The airline plans to deploy both art planes into regular commercial service starting October 1, 2026, on routes serving Tokyo, Phoenix, and Prague. 星宇航空與日本藝術家空山基合作推出STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA藝術計畫,以A350-1000旗艦機型推出一金一銀兩架藝術機。 星宇航空與日本藝術家空山基合作,推出STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA藝術計畫,以星宇航空A350-1000旗艦機型推出一金一銀藝術機 星宇航空邀請日本藝人木村拓哉的女兒Kōki,擔任藝術機大使,Kōki,日前抵達桃園國際機場並參觀棚廠。 並邀請日本藝人木村拓哉的女兒Kōki,擔任大使。Kōki,日前來台,星宇航空董事長張國煒親自導覽 星宇航空董事長張國煒親自導覽並向Kōki,介紹AIRSORAYAMA藝術計畫從發想到實現的歷程。 張國煒更親自現身向Kōki,分享AIRSORAYAMA計畫從發想到實現的歷程 第一架藝術機「空山銀」(機身編號B-58553)於2026年7月交機,並在7月12日首航東京。 「空山銀」(B-58553)7月交機,在7月12日首航東京 第二架藝術機「空山金」(機身編號B-58554)於法國時間2026年8月14日完成交機,並於8月16日抵達桃園國際機場。 機身編號 B-58554「AIRSORAYAMA GOLD空山金」於法國時間14日正式完成交機 星宇航空兩架藝術機預計自2026年10月1日起正式投入定期航班服務,飛航東京、鳳凰城及布拉格等航線。 兩架藝術機預計自10月1日起正式投入定期航班服務,飛航東京、鳳凰城及布拉格等國際熱門航線

metadata.title: 立法院會處理無人機條例草案 朝野就預算編列尚無共識

a-20260827-0859-taiwan-lawmakers-process.text: 立法院會處理無人機條例草案 朝野就預算編列尚無共識 立法院會27日處理無人機條例草案;民眾黨主張視需求由行政院逐年編列預算 立法院會於2026年8月27日排定處理無人機條例草案。先前立法院長韓國瑜召集朝野協商,民進黨團主張特別條例,國民黨團與民眾黨團堅持年度預算編列,國民黨團提出6年共新台幣2400億元,朝野未達共識。 民眾黨立法院黨團總召陳清龍說明黨版草案,主張成立無人載具戰略特別委員會制定發展綱領,預算由行政院依產業需求與財政狀況逐年編列,由立法院監督審查。 本站歷史紀錄顯示,立法院曾於2026年8月20日就無人載具條例草案進行協商,當時因朝野就法案名稱與經費上限等未獲共識,宣告全案保留。 Taiwan Lawmakers Process Drone Act Draft Amid Budget Disagreements Taiwan's Legislative Yuan processes the drone bill draft; parties remain split over budget structure Taiwan's Legislative Yuan scheduled consideration of draft drone legislation on August 27, 2026. Legislative Speaker Han Kuo-yu convened party consultations, where the Democratic Progressive Party caucus advocated a special statute while the Kuomintang and Taiwan People's Party insisted on annual budget allocation. Kuomintang lawmakers proposed allocating NT$240 billion over six years, but no consensus was reached. Chen Ching-long of the Taiwan People's Party outlined their proposal to establish a strategic committee for unmanned vehicles to set development guidelines. Under this plan, the Executive Yuan would compile annual budgets based on industry needs for legislative review. Official archives show lawmakers previously held consultations on the draft act on August 20, 2026, which ended without agreement on funding caps and legislative details. 立法院會於2026年8月27日排定處理無人機條例草案。 立法院會今天將處理無人機條例草案 民眾黨立法院黨團總召陳清龍說明黨版「強化國防自主暨無人機產業發展條例草案」,主張成立無人載具戰略特別委員會制定發展綱領。 要成立無人載具戰略特別委員會,邀集專家學者共同參與,制定無人載具產業發展綱領 民眾黨團主張無人機預算由行政院依產業需求與財政狀況逐年編列,並由立法院監督審查。 可由行政院依照產業需要與財政狀況,逐年編列預算,由立法院監督審查 立法院長韓國瑜召集朝野黨團協商無人機條例草案,民進黨團主張特別條例,藍白堅持年度預算編列,國民黨團主張6年共2400億元,朝野未達共識。 立法院長韓國瑜昨天召集朝野黨團協商,討論無人機條例草案,由於民進黨團強調特別條例較合適,藍白堅持採年度預算編列,國民黨團認為要新台幣2400億元,並分6年平均編列,朝野無法達成共識。 立法院於2026年8月20日就無人載具條例草案進行黨團協商,因未達共識宣告全案保留。 會議主席、民眾黨召委洪毓祥宣告全案保留,後續依相關規定處理。

a-20260827-0859-fly2galicia-plans-decemb.text: 新低成本品牌Fly2Galicia擬於12月開航 採用濕租模式營運 Fly2Galicia計畫12月開航;採FLYYO濕租營運;連結聖地亞哥與歐洲8航點。 西班牙低成本航空新品牌Fly2Galicia計畫於2026年12月1日正式開航,營運基地設於西班牙西北部聖地亞哥–德孔波斯特拉的羅薩利亞·德·卡斯特羅機場(SCQ)。該品牌由Aviation & Mobility Services Group負責行銷與航線開發,旨在提升加利西亞地區前往歐洲主要城市與商業中心之直飛空中交通效益。 根據營運規劃,Fly2Galicia初期不會自行執行航班,而是透過濕租協議由羅馬尼亞航空公司FLYYO負責實際飛航業務。該公司規劃航網包含8個西班牙國內及歐洲航點,涵蓋國內線的阿利坎特、格拉納達與薩拉戈薩,以及布魯塞爾、米蘭、威尼斯、慕尼黑和布拉格等國際航點。 Fly2Galicia Plans December Launch from Santiago de Compostela Under Wet-Lease Agreement Fly2Galicia plans to launch operations from Santiago de Compostela in December using wet-leased aircraft from FLYYO. New budget airline brand Fly2Galicia is scheduled to launch operations on 1 December 2026 from Rosalia de Castro Airport (SCQ) in Santiago de Compostela, northwestern Spain. Marketed by Aviation & Mobility Services Group, the carrier aims to enhance direct regional air connectivity between Galicia and major European business and leisure hubs. Under the operational setup, Fly2Galicia will not operate the flights directly. Instead, Romanian airline FLYYO will execute the flight operations under a wet-lease agreement. The initial network encompasses eight destinations across Spain and Europe, including domestic routes to Alicante, Granada, and Zaragoza, as well as international services to Brussels, Milan, Venice, Munich, and Prague. Fly2Galicia plans to launch flights from Rosalia de Castro Airport in Santiago de Compostela on 1 December 2026. The new budget carrier is due to launch on 1 December, operating from Santiago de Compostela’s Rosalia de Castro Airport . Fly2Galicia flights will be operated under a wet-lease agreement by Romanian carrier FLYYO, while Aviation & Mobility Services Group markets the services. metadata.title: 英國民航局公布第二季旅客人數創新高 廉航成長抵銷中東航線下滑

a-20260827-0859-uk-airport-passenger-num.text: 英國民航局公布第二季旅客人數創新高 廉航成長抵銷中東航線下滑 英國機場第二季旅客達8116萬人次;廉航運量增加;中東航線客流下滑 英國民航局(CAA)於2026年8月27日公布最新資料指出,英國各機場在2026年4月至6月(第二季)期間共處理8116萬人次的旅客人數,創下歷年同期最高紀錄。雖然總客流量相較2025年同期僅微幅增加12萬人次,增幅約為0.15%,但整體客源結構與航線分布出現顯著轉變。 在航空公司表現方面,廉價航空成為推動英國客運成長的主要力量。瑞安航空(Ryanair)在第二季處理1710萬人次,較去年同期成長9%;易捷航空(easyJet)客運量成長2%至1640萬人次;Jet2亦成長9%達到670萬人次。這三家廉價航空公司合計增加225萬名旅客,遠超過英國整體市場的淨增長量。在航班起降架次上,瑞安航空增加約9000架次,易捷航空增加約4000架次,Jet2則增加約2000架次。相對地,英國航空(British Airways)減少約2000架次起降,TUI Airways亦減少約1000架次。 受地緣政治衝突與空域受限影響,中東航線客運量大幅下滑。其中,阿聯酋航空(Emirates)在英國機場的載客人數年減46%,卡達航空(Qatar Airways)亦減少42%。杜拜航線旅客總數下降50%至約73.6萬人次。中東地區的下滑促使旅客轉向歐洲短途目的地,西歐航線增加約100萬名旅客,英國國內線增加約30萬人次,東歐航線則增加約20萬人次。熱門城市如馬德里旅客數成長15%、巴塞隆納成長11%、阿利坎特成長8%、法羅成長7%,都柏林則成長5%。 儘管總旅客人數創下新高,英國航班的營運準點表現卻有所惡化。第二季僅有74%的航班在預定時間15分鐘內起飛或降落,低於去年同期的75%。平均延誤時間從13分鐘增加至14分鐘,而在起飛前24小時內遭取消的航班比例亦上升至0.91%。整體資料顯示,英國航空市場在中東局勢動盪下仍保持成長,但營運效率與準點率均面臨挑戰。 UK Airport Passenger Numbers Hit Record in Q2 2026 as Budget Carriers Offset Middle East Decline UK airports handled record Q2 passengers as low-cost growth offset Middle East traffic declines. Official data released by the UK Civil Aviation Authority on August 27, 2026, shows that UK airports handled a record 81.16 million passengers between April and June 2026 (Q2). Although the quarterly total represents a slight net increase of around 120,000 passengers—up 0.15% compared to the same period in 2025—the underlying market dynamics shifted significantly toward low-cost carriers and European short-haul routes amid geopolitical disruption in the Middle East. Low-cost airlines drove the majority of passenger growth across UK airports during the second quarter. Ryanair recorded a 9% year-on-year increase, carrying 17.1 million passengers, while Jet2 also grew 9% to reach 6.7 million passengers. easyJet, the second-largest UK airport operator by volume, expanded passenger traffic by 2% to 16.4 million. Combined, these three carriers handled 2.25 million additional passengers compared to Q2 2025. In terms of flight activity, Ryanair operated roughly 9,000 additional air transport movements, easyJet added approximately 4,000, and Jet2 added around 2,000, while British Airways and TUI Airways reduced operations by approximately 2,000 and 1,000 movements, respectively. Conversely, carriers and routes exposed to Middle East airspace disruption recorded substantial declines. Emirates carried 46% fewer passengers through UK airports during the quarter, and Qatar Airways recorded a 42% drop. Overall traffic on the Dubai route plummeted 50% year-on-year to approximately 736,000 passengers. Demand redirected primarily to European destinations, with Western Europe generating 1 million additional UK passengers, domestic flying adding 300,000, and Eastern Europe increasing by 200,000. Key European city and leisure destinations showed notable gains, including Madrid up 15%, Barcelona up 11%, Alicante up 8%, Faro up 7%, and Dublin up 5%. The record passenger throughput was accompanied by deterioration in operational reliability across UK airports. Only 74% of flights arrived or departed within 15 minutes of schedule during Q2 2026, down from 75% in the prior-year period. Average flight delays rose from 13 minutes to 14 minutes, while the rate of flights cancelled within 24 hours of departure increased to 0.91%. metadata.title: 澳洲航安會就雪梨機場(SYD)兩起新事件展開調查

a-20260827-0859-atsb-opens-two-new-inves.text: 澳洲航安會就雪梨機場(SYD)兩起新事件展開調查 航安會調查8/16滑行道衝突及8/25推回衝突;已有四起其他事件調查中 澳洲運輸安全局(ATSB)已針對雪梨機場發生的兩起新事件展開調查,分別涉及8月16日澳洲航空與維珍澳洲航空的滑行道衝突,以及8月25日捷星航空空中巴士A320的推回過程衝突。 根據ATSB報告,8月16日維珍澳洲航空VA1589航班(波音737,註冊號VH-IXJ)改降雪梨後在滑行道B滑行,同時澳洲航空QF420航班(波音737,註冊號VH-VZV)從跑道16R經滑行道B8離場。管制指示維珍機組讓路,但維珍機組讀回錯誤且未被管制員察覺,導致雙機接近,最終澳洲航空機組停機並澄清滑行順序。 8月25日,捷星航空VH-VFX空中巴士A320準備從雪梨飛往朗塞斯敦時,管制員據報未向機組提供完整交通資訊,導致推回組未獲知身後有飛機滑行,推回組發現衝突後中止推回並將飛機拉回機位。ATSB將此歸類為「未傳遞交通資訊」。 這兩起新調查加上先前已在進行的四起雪梨機場事件(含一起空服員受傷事件),顯示澳洲最繁忙機場的地面移動與管制資訊流程受到關注。ATSB表示各調查獨立進行但團隊將協調,視證據可能擴大或合併調查。 ATSB預計在六至八周內發布初步報告,但調查可能要到明年才結束。另已在調查8月9日發生的跑道闖入事件,當時維珍澳洲航空VA555起飛滑跑時發現澳洲航空737從滑行道L穿越跑道34L,維珍機組拒絕起飛並停在跑道上。 ATSB opens two new investigations into Sydney Airport (SYD) incidents ATSB investigating August 16 taxiway conflict and August 25 pushback incident; four other Sydney Airport probes ongoing The Australian Transport Safety Bureau (ATSB) has opened two new investigations into incidents at Sydney Airport (SYD), involving a taxiway conflict between Virgin Australia and Qantas on August 16 and a pushback incident involving a Jetstar Airbus A320 on August 25. According to the ATSB, on August 16 Virgin Australia flight VA1589 (Boeing 737, registration VH-IXJ) diverted to Sydney and was taxiing north on taxiway B, while Qantas flight QF420 (Boeing 737, registration VH-VZV) was vacating runway 16R via taxiway B8. Air traffic control instructed the Virgin crew to give way, but the instruction was not correctly read back and the incorrect readback was not identified by the controller. The Qantas crew saw the Virgin 737 approaching, stopped, and both crews clarified the taxi sequence. On August 25, Jetstar Airbus A320 VH-VFX was preparing for pushback for a flight to Launceston when the controller allegedly failed to provide complete traffic information to the crew, who would need to relay it to the tug team. The pilots were not told about another aircraft taxiing behind the A320. The pushback crew identified the conflict, stopped the manoeuvre, and returned the aircraft to its stand. The ATSB described the event as a "failure to pass traffic". The two new investigations add to four other ongoing probes at Sydney Airport, including an event where a flight attendant was injured. The ATSB said the investigations are being conducted separately, though teams will coordinate, and depending on evidence they could be expanded or combined. The regulator expects to publish preliminary reports within six to eight weeks, although investigations are not likely to conclude until next year. The ATSB is also investigating a runway incursion on August 9, when Virgin Australia flight VA555 rejected takeoff on runway 34L after a Qantas 737 crossed the runway from taxiway Lima. a-20260827-1322-eva-air-and-china-airlin.text: 長榮與華航參展亞太永續博覽會展示減碳成果 長榮航空與中華航空於台北參展亞太永續博覽會,呈現各項減碳與航機規劃成果。 2026年亞太永續博覽會於8月27日至29日在台北世貿一館舉行。長榮航空與中華航空均參與展出,分享其在節能減碳與航空永續轉型方面的各項實踐成果。 長榮航空今年為第三度參展。展區聚焦於淨零轉型與永續航空燃油等面向,並呈現多項節能減碳措施。其規劃包括持續擴大波音787客機機隊,並引進空中巴士A350-1000與A321neo等新世代節能航機,同時透過大數據優化航路與引擎清洗提升燃油效率。 中華航空則為首度參展,以永續和淨零為主題。華航在展區分享了攜手合作夥伴推動永續的成果,帶領民眾認識包含永續航空燃油、空地面減碳、機上資源循環利用等行動,以期擴大落實ESG願景。 EVA Air and China Airlines Showcase Decarbonization at Sustainability Expo EVA Air and China Airlines present fleet planning and carbon-reduction initiatives at the Taipei expo. The 2026 Asia-Pacific Sustainability Expo is being held from August 27 to 29 at the Taipei World Trade Center Exhibition Hall 1. Taiwanese carriers EVA Air and China Airlines are participating to showcase their respective carbon-reduction and sustainable aviation efforts. EVA Air, participating for the third time, is highlighting its energy-saving measures. These initiatives include expanding its Boeing 787 fleet, planning the introduction of Airbus A350-1000 and A321neo aircraft, and utilizing big data to optimize flight paths and engine washing to improve fuel efficiency. The carrier is sharing its sustainability practices under the theme of net-zero emissions, showcasing its efforts in sustainable aviation fuel, ground and cabin carbon reduction, and passenger resource recycling to support its ESG vision. 2026年亞太永續博覽會於2026年8月27日在台北世貿一館登場,展期至29日。 2026亞太永續博覽會今天登場 長榮航空今年第三度參展,呈現包括擴大波音787機隊與引進空中巴士A350-1000及A321neo等節能減碳規劃。 長榮航空今年為第3度參展,在展區呈現多項節能減碳措施 中華航空今年首度參展,分享其推動永續航空燃油與減碳措施的成果。 中華航空今年則是首度參展

a-20260828-0802-tigerair-taiwan-marks-12.text: 台灣虎航迎開航12週年推全航線促銷 九州機票提撥捐款應援熊本 台灣虎航推出開航12週年全航線促銷;9月起購買九州機票每張捐贈50元 台灣虎航宣布迎接開航12週年,自2026年9月1日至12日舉辦線上集章抽獎活動,並預計於9月16日推出全航線機票促銷,適用旅行期間為2026年9月16日至2027年3月27日。同時,業者將於9月1日至10月31日實施公益加碼,凡購買九州地區機票每張將捐出新台幣50元予熊本地震義援金專戶。 另一方面,星宇航空亦持續擴展日本航網,先前已宣布正式進軍高雄市場,規劃自2027年1月1日起開闢由高雄出發前往神戶及沖繩的2條日本定期航線。 Tigerair Taiwan Marks 12th Anniversary with Ticket Sales and Kumamoto Relief Donation Tigerair Taiwan launches 12th anniversary flight promotions and donates funds for Kyushu ticket purchases to Kumamoto relief. metadata.title: NTSB調查海軍陸戰隊一號無線電故障 FAA已重設DCA塔台天線

a-20260828-0802-ntsb-examines-marine-one.text: NTSB調查海軍陸戰隊一號無線電故障 FAA已重設DCA塔台天線 NTSB調查顯示視距涵蓋不足致通訊中斷;FAA重置天線解除DCA近距風險 根據美國國家運輸安全委員會(NTSB)發布的初步調查報告,2026年8月4日,搭乘美國總統川普的「海軍陸戰隊一號」(Marine One)Sikorsky VH-3D直升機從起飛點離開時,與美國華盛頓特區羅納德·里根華盛頓國家機場(DCA)的空中交通管制員發生無線電通訊故障。由於通訊中斷,塔台未能收到預期的起飛前3分鐘通報,隨後與特快航空(Envoy Air)一架飛往佛羅里達州彭薩科拉國際機場(PNS)的巴西航空工業(Embraer)E170客機(航班號為 Envoy Flight 3742)發生近距離接近事件。 NTSB指出,事發當時為當地時間約14時34分,海軍陸戰隊一號從Ellipse起飛,而特快航空客機則正從DCA的1號跑道起飛。海軍陸戰隊一號機組曾兩度嘗試呼叫塔台,第一次未能成功傳達,第二次訊號呈現斷續且無法辨識,嘗試透過安那柯斯提亞-博林聯合基地進行轉播亦告失敗。因塔台未收到警告,管制員隨即核准特快航空班機起飛。直到海軍陸戰隊一號爬升至一定高度建立無線電聯繫時,特快航空客機已在空中。 根據美國聯邦航空管理局(FAA)估計,兩架航空器在DCA以北約2海浬處,水平距離最接近時約為0.82海浬,垂直距離約為700英尺。NTSB表示,由於兩機垂直間隔約700英尺,已超過500英尺的最低標準,因此仍維持在規定的隔離限制內。特快航空機組在爬升過程中收到空中交通碰撞防止系統(TCAS)的交通告警(Traffic Advisory),但系統並未發出防撞諮詢命令(Resolution Advisory),雙方飛行員在告警當下均未目視看到對方航空器。 FAA技術人員在事後調查中發現,無線電通訊障礙主因為原設備與起飛點之間的視距涵蓋不足。為解決此一安全隱患,FAA將無線電設備從鄰近住宅區移設至DCA管制塔台頂端。後續測試結果顯示,無線電通訊障礙已獲解決,未再出現通訊中斷情形。 NTSB examines Marine One radio failure at DCA as FAA moves antenna to tower top NTSB reports radio failure led to DCA close proximity; FAA relocated antenna to tower top. According to a preliminary report by the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB), a radio communications failure occurred on August 4, 2026, between Marine One and air traffic controllers at Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport (DCA). The presidential helicopter, a Sikorsky VH-3D carrying US President Donald Trump, departed the Ellipse at approximately 14:34 local time when inadequate line-of-sight coverage prevented the crew's required departure notification from reaching the control tower. At the same time, air traffic controllers at DCA cleared Envoy Air Flight 3742, an Embraer E170 bound for Pensacola International Airport (PNS) in Florida, for takeoff from Runway 1. Marine One crew members made two direct attempts to establish contact with the tower and tried to relay the warning through Joint Base Anacostia-Bolling, but the transmissions were either not received or broken. Radio contact was only established after the helicopter climbed to a higher altitude, by which time the regional jet was already airborne. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) estimated that the two aircraft came within approximately 0.82 nautical miles laterally and 700 feet vertically of each other about two miles north of DCA. The NTSB noted that the aircraft remained within required separation limits because their 700-foot vertical separation exceeded the 500-foot minimum threshold. Pilots of the Envoy jet received a Traffic Collision Avoidance System (TCAS) traffic advisory, though no resolution advisory directing evasive action was issued. Following the encounter, FAA technicians determined that inadequate line-of-sight radio coverage from the former equipment location in a residential neighborhood caused the failure. The agency relocated the radio equipment to the top of the DCA control tower, and subsequent flight testing confirmed that the communications issue was fully resolved. metadata.title: 美國航空接獲運輸部投訴將修改降等退款規則

a-20260828-2030-american-airlines-change.text: 美國航空接獲運輸部投訴將修改降等退款規則 美國航空因應運輸部投訴修改降等退款規則,退款改以平均票價為基準。 根據外媒 Simple Flying 報導,美國航空公司(American Airlines)在接獲美國運輸部(DOT)的投訴意見之後,目前正在著手修改其原本針對遭遇艙等降等之旅客所實施的 40% 比例退款規則。 在先前的政策中,該航空公司對於被調降艙等的旅客,僅採取退還固定百分比的簡單退款方式。然而,在新規劃的政策之下,美國航空的退款金額計算方式,現在將會以平均票價作為計算基準,而不再只是單純地退還固定比例的票價。 American Airlines Changes Downgrade Refund Policy Following DOT Complaint American Airlines is changing its downgrade refund rule following a US DOT complaint. According to a report by Simple Flying, American Airlines is changing its existing policy that provides a flat 40% refund for passengers who experience cabin downgrades. This regulatory adjustment comes after a complaint was filed with the United States Department of Transportation (DOT) regarding the airline's refund practices. Under the airline's previous policy, passengers who were downgraded from their booked cabin classes received a flat percentage refund of their ticket price. With the newly updated policy, American Airlines will now calculate refunds for downgraded passengers using the average fare as a baseline, rather than simply refunding a flat percentage of the ticket cost. 美國航空在收到美國運輸部投訴後,正修改其對艙等降等旅客的40%退款規則。 American Airlines Is Changing Its 40% Refund Rule For Downgrades After DOT Complaint 該航空公司的退款計算現在將以平均票價為基準,而非單純退還固定百分比。 The carrier's refunds now use the average fare as a baseline, rather than simply refunding a flat percentage.

metadata.title: 澳洲航空發表全新商務艙套房 導入A321XLR與波音787機隊

a-20260829-0257-qantas-unveils-new-lie-f.text: 澳洲航空發表全新商務艙套房 導入A321XLR與波音787機隊 澳洲航空發表新一代商務艙套房;引進平躺座椅與隱私滑門;首批2028年交機 澳洲航空(Qantas)發表新一代商務艙產品,為即將引進的空中巴士 A321XLR 單走道客機機隊,以及旗下的波音 787-9 夢幻客機機隊,推出全新的全平躺商務艙套房。該航空公司表示,此項新座艙設計預計將於 2028 年起隨新機交付正式投入服務,為澳洲航空機隊更新計劃中的重要項目。 在空中巴士 A321XLR 部分,澳洲航空計畫在 16 架營運較長航線的該型客機上配備全新商務艙套房。該座艙採用 1-1 反向斜魚骨式配置,為澳洲航空首度在單走道客機上引進可完全平躺的座椅。每套套房均配有獨立滑門,並配備 19 吋機上娛樂螢幕、無線及 USB-C 充電設施、免費高速 Wi-Fi 網路,以及可存放手提電腦與個人物品的專用收納空間。 澳洲航空指出,A321XLR 航程可達 8,700 公里,比波音 737 客機增加超過 3,000 公里,未來將投入往返伯斯(Perth)的橫跨大陸航線,以及短程與中程國際航線。此外,針對波音 787-9 夢幻客機,澳洲航空也升級了現有的商務艙套房,每架客機維持 42 席商務艙,並首度在 Dreamliner 上引進滑門設計,床鋪長度提升至 80 吋,並擴大腳部空間。 澳洲航空集團執行長 Vanessa Hudson 表示,全新座艙反映了市場對高端旅行需求的轉變,目前其國際航線的高端艙等營收成長速度為經濟艙的兩倍。隨著次世代客機陸續加入,新機隊所配置的高端座位比例亦將高於其所替換的舊款機型,以進一步提升旅客的飛行體驗。 Qantas Unveils New Lie-Flat Business Suites for A321XLR and Boeing 787-9 Fleet Qantas unveils lie-flat business suites with privacy doors for its Airbus A321XLR and Boeing 787 fleets. Qantas has unveiled its next-generation business class product, introducing new lie-flat suites for both its incoming Airbus A321XLR narrowbody fleet and its Boeing 787-9 Dreamliners. The announcement marks the first time the Australian carrier will offer lie-flat seats with privacy doors on a single-aisle aircraft, with the new cabins scheduled to begin arriving in 2028 as part of the airline's broader fleet renewal program. The airline plans to install the new Business Suites on 16 Airbus A321XLR aircraft assigned to longer routes. Arranged in a 1-1 angled herringbone configuration, every business class passenger will have direct aisle access. Each suite features a seat that converts into a fully flat bed, a sliding privacy door, a 19-inch in-flight entertainment screen, wireless and USB-C charging capability, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, and dedicated personal storage designed for laptops and travel belongings. With an operational range of up to 8,700 kilometers—more than 3,000 kilometers beyond that of the Boeing 737—the A321XLR will serve transcontinental flights to and from Perth, as well as short- and medium-haul international routes. Concurrently, Qantas unveiled an updated Business Suite for its Boeing 787-9 Dreamliners. The refreshed widebody cabin will retain 42 business suites per aircraft, introducing sliding privacy doors for the first time on a Qantas Dreamliner alongside 80-inch lie-flat beds featuring wider footwells developed through ergonomic testing. Qantas Group CEO Vanessa Hudson noted that the investment reflects a structural shift in premium travel demand, with premium cabin revenue across the airline's international network growing at twice the rate of economy class revenue. The airline confirmed that its next-generation aircraft joining the fleet will carry a higher proportion of premium seating compared with the aircraft they are set to replace. a-20260829-0937-taiwan-tigerair-holds-ca.text: 台灣虎航招募30名客艙組員 近三千人報名爭取 台灣虎航招募30名客艙組員;9月初將開航高雄至小松與石垣島航線。 台灣虎航於2026年8月29日舉行客艙組員招募初試。本次招募預計錄取30名培訓客艙組員,吸引近3000人投遞履歷,經初步書面資料篩選後,約1700人符合資格進入初試,預計於2026年第4季報到。 初試項目包含脫鞋摸高測試與團體面試,著重應試者之語言口條、台風穩定度及臨場反應。通過初試者將於下週進行複試,獲錄取的培訓組員報到後須接受專業地面與空中訓練並通過考核。 此外,因應旅運市場成長,台灣虎航規劃於9月初首航高雄至小松與高雄至石垣島航線,並為2028年起引進第3代機隊積極拓展團隊。公司今年起亦提供員工每年7日福利補休假,並放寬組員配戴眼鏡執勤。 Taiwan Tigerair Holds Cabin Crew Recruitment Test for 30 Positions Taiwan Tigerair holds recruitment for 30 cabin crew roles while planning September Kaohsiung route expansions. Taiwan Tigerair held preliminary screening tests for cabin crew recruitment on August 29, 2026. The airline received nearly 3,000 applications, with approximately 1,700 candidates passing initial document screening to qualify for the preliminary test. The carrier plans to recruit 30 trainee cabin crew members, who are expected to report for duty in the fourth quarter of 2026. The carrier is expanding its network to meet growing travel demand, with inaugural flights on the Kaohsiung-Komatsu and Kaohsiung-Ishigaki routes scheduled for early September 2026. The hiring drive also supports capacity expansion for its third-generation fleet, set for delivery starting in 2028. Additionally, Taiwan Tigerair introduced seven days of annual welfare leave this year and now permits cabin crew to wear glasses while on duty. 台灣虎航於2026年8月29日舉辦客艙組員招募初試,吸引近3000人報名,約1700人通過初審進入初試。 台灣虎航股份有限公司今天客艙組員招募初試,近3000人投遞履歷,經初步書面資料篩選,約1700人符合初試甄選資格 台灣虎航預計招募30名培訓客艙組員,錄取人員預計於2026年第4季正式報到。 預計錄取30名,獲錄取培訓客艙組員預計今年第4季報到。 初試項目包含脫鞋摸高與團體面試,通過初試者下週複試,獲錄取者須接受專業地面與空中訓練並通過考核。 初試項目包含「脫鞋摸高測試」與「團體面試」 台灣虎航規劃9月初開航高雄至小松及高雄至石垣島航線,並為2028年引進第3代機隊積極擴大規模。 9月初將首航「高雄-小松」與「高雄-石垣島」航線,進一步深化南台灣航線布局,而因應2028年起陸續引進第3代機隊運能拓展需求,積極擴大團隊規模 台灣虎航今年起提供員工每年7日福利補休假,並放寬客艙組員可配戴眼鏡執勤。 今年起提供全體員工「每年7日福利補休假」,重視員工身心平衡,更貼心考量客艙環境乾燥對視力的影響,全面放寬組員可戴眼鏡執勤。

metadata.title: 遭大體型鄰座擠壓5小時 達美航空乘客背痛手術提告

a-20260829-0937-passenger-sues-delta-air.text: 遭大體型鄰座擠壓5小時 達美航空乘客背痛手術提告 達美航空乘客稱因鄰座擠壓受困客艙壁,背痛加劇接受手術並提告。 根據 Simple Flying 報導,達美航空(Delta Air Lines)目前面臨一起由搭機旅客發起的法律訴訟案。該起訴訟源於一名乘客在搭乘航班期間所經歷的座位擠壓事件。 根據原告旅客的說法,在一趟長達 5 小時的飛行航程中,由於鄰座為一名體型較大的乘客,導致該名旅客全程被困並緊貼於客艙牆壁旁。 該名旅客表示,這種長時間遭受擠壓的情況導致其背部疼痛嚴重加劇,最終不得不接受昂貴的脊椎手術治療。原告因而針對該次飛行事件向達美航空提出訴訟。 Passenger Sues Delta Air Lines After 5-Hour Flight Leads to Spinal Surgery Delta Air Lines faces a lawsuit after a passenger claimed seating squeeze led to spinal surgery. Delta Air Lines faces a lawsuit filed by a passenger following a five-hour flight, according to a report by Simple Flying. The legal action alleges that physical conditions during the flight resulted in severe injuries requiring surgery. The traveler stated that he was trapped against the cabin wall for the entirety of the five-hour flight. He alleged that the physical confinement occurred because he was seated next to a plus-size seatmate. According to the lawsuit claims, being squeezed against the cabin wall caused worsening back pain during and after the journey. The passenger asserts that the injury ultimately necessitated costly spinal surgery. Delta Air Lines is facing a lawsuit after a passenger reported requiring spinal surgery due to seating squeeze on a flight.
