metadata.title: 英國航空遭乘客提告 掉落瓶子致眼部傷害與腦震盪

a-20260829-0937-british-airways-sued-aft.text: 英國航空遭乘客提告 掉落瓶子致眼部傷害與腦震盪 英國航空遭乘客起訴;掉落瓶子致眼部持續傷害;機組急救後引發腦震盪與複視 英國航空(British Airways)目前面臨一起法律訴訟。根據 Simple Flying 報導,一名女性乘客在搭乘航班期間於睡夢中遭掉落的瓶子擊中,並導致眼睛遭受持續性傷害。 事發當時,航班上的機組人員曾進行急救處理,嘗試撫平該名乘客頭部所產生的頭皮裂傷。然而,機組人員所提供的急救措施最終未能撫平相關傷勢。 該起頭皮裂傷隨後導致更嚴重的後續症狀。乘客在事故發生後出現腦震盪,並相繼引發創傷後壓力症候群(PTSD)相關症狀以及複視等長期身體傷害。 British Airways Sued After Falling Bottle Leaves Passenger With Lasting Eye Damage British Airways faces lawsuit after falling bottle injures passenger; crew first aid followed by concussion and double vision. British Airways is facing a lawsuit after a falling bottle struck a sleeping passenger, causing lasting eye damage. The legal action stems from an in-flight incident where the passenger sustained physical injuries while asleep on board. According to details reported by Simple Flying, cabin crew members provided initial first aid to treat a scalp laceration. However, the first aid measures failed to soothe the injury sustained by the passenger. The scalp laceration ultimately resulted in severe secondary medical conditions. The passenger subsequently experienced a concussion, post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) symptoms, and double vision following the event. British Airways is being sued after a falling bottle left a sleeping woman with lasting eye damage. metadata.title: 美軍於德州邊境發射雷射 擊落三架販毒集團無人機

a-20260829-0937-us-military-high-energy-.text: 美軍於德州邊境發射雷射 擊落三架販毒集團無人機 美軍南方邊境聯合任務部隊於德州擊落三架無人機;運用高能雷射系統反制威脅 美國美軍「南方邊境聯合任務部隊」(Joint Task Force–Southern Border, JTF-SB)於2026年8月28日證實,任務部隊人員在2026年8月25日與26日的深夜時段,於德克薩斯州南部的里奧格蘭德山谷(Rio Grande Valley)動用陸軍「多用途高能雷射」(AMP-HEL)系統,成功攔截並擊落三架無人航空系統(UAS)。這項行動標誌著美軍定向能量武器在面對遭判定為具敵意無人機時的實戰運用。 美軍官方指出,相關無人機因直接支援對美軍地面人員及美國海關暨邊境保護局(CBP)執法人員構成實體威脅的活動,因而被歸類為敵意目標。南方邊境聯合任務部隊指揮官柯蒂斯·泰勒少將(Maj. Gen. Curtis Taylor)表示,犯罪集團與販毒網絡正日益增加無人航空系統的使用,藉此協助非法人口走私,並針對執法人員與美軍哨所進行偵察監控。美軍目前未公開擊落行動的精確地理座標,亦未說明無人機遭摧毀時是位於美國還是墨西哥領空。 此次行動中所使用的 AMP-HEL 系統是由 AeroVironment 開發的機動式反無人機防禦裝備,該公司於2025年向美國陸軍交付首批兩架原型樣機。該系統透過發射高濃縮雷射能量使小型無人機癱瘓或摧毀,旨在提供一種無需消耗傳統導彈或彈藥的高效益反無人機防禦手段。美軍北方司令部表示,本次邊境行動已與區域合作夥伴進行協調,但基於作戰安全考量,拒絕提供進一步細節。 這次雷射反制行動隨後遵循了先前建立的安全規範。在2026年2月,美軍雷射反無人機系統曾在德州漢考克堡(Fort Hancock)附近誤擊一架 CBP 無人機,並引發美國聯邦航空管理局(FAA)劃設臨時飛行限制。此外,埃爾帕索(El Paso)附近的反無人機行動亦曾導致埃爾帕索國際機場(ELP)周邊空域短暫關閉。美國聯邦航空管理局與五角大廈隨後制定了全新作業程序,允許軍方防空雷射在商業民航流量附近運作而無需關閉機場,評估確認在遵守相應安全措施下不會對客機構成不當風險。 US military high-energy laser shoots down three drones along Texas border Joint Task Force–Southern Border used a high-energy laser to destroy three drones along the Texas border. Personnel assigned to the Joint Task Force–Southern Border (JTF-SB) engaged and destroyed three unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) using an Army Multipurpose High Energy Laser (AMP-HEL) during the late-night hours of August 25 and August 26, 2026. The engagements took place in the Rio Grande Valley in southern Texas near the United States–Mexico border. Military officials stated that the directed-energy weapon was deployed after determining that the aircraft posed a direct physical threat to US military personnel and US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) agents operating in the sector. According to military statements, the drones were identified as hostile because they were directly supporting criminal activities that compromised the safety of law enforcement and defense personnel. Joint Task Force–Southern Border Commander Maj. Gen. Curtis Taylor highlighted that cartel networks are increasingly employing unmanned aircraft systems to facilitate human-smuggling operations and conduct aerial surveillance on border personnel. Defense authorities declined to disclose the exact coordinates of the engagements or specify whether the targeted drones were located above US or Mexican territory when destroyed. The AMP-HEL system involved in the engagement is a mobile laser counter-drone platform developed to disable or destroy small unmanned aircraft using concentrated light energy. Manufacturer AeroVironment delivered the first two AMP-HEL prototypes to the US Army in 2025 to establish a cost-effective counter-UAS capability without expending conventional missiles or munition stockpiles. US Northern Command confirmed that border engagements were coordinated with regional enforcement partners, though additional operational specifics remain restricted to protect ongoing security tactics. The recent operational use of counter-drone laser technology follows earlier safety adjustments along the southern border. In February 2026, a military laser counter-drone system mistakenly downed a CBP drone near Fort Hancock, Texas, which prompted initial flight restrictions by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). A separate operation near El Paso also temporarily affected airspace surrounding El Paso International Airport (ELP). Consequently, the FAA and the Pentagon established specialized procedures allowing military lasers to operate near civil air traffic safely without necessitating commercial airport closures. metadata.title: 國泰航空客機因無線電頻率錯誤遭北約戰機攔截

a-20260829-1449-cathay-pacific-jet-inter.text: 國泰航空客機因無線電頻率錯誤遭北約戰機攔截 國泰航空客機因無線電頻率錯誤導致通訊中斷,遭匈牙利戰機攔截。 根據航空媒體 Simple Flying 的報導,在7月4日,一架自香港起飛並前往倫敦的國泰航空(Cathay Pacific)班機在航行期間發生了通訊中斷。在該起通訊中斷發生之後,該客機隨即遭到匈牙利的戰鬥機進行攔截。 Simple Flying 的報導進一步指出,使用錯誤的無線電頻率似乎是這起通訊中斷事件的核心問題。由於客機在航行中經歷了通訊中斷,這架國泰航空班機隨後遭到北約(NATO)的戰鬥機升空進行攔截。 Cathay Pacific Jet Intercepted by NATO Fighter Jets Due to Incorrect Radio Frequency Cathay Pacific flight from Hong Kong to London was intercepted by Hungarian fighter jets on July 4. According to a report by the aviation media outlet Simple Flying, a Cathay Pacific flight traveling from Hong Kong to London was intercepted by Hungarian fighter jets on July 4. The interception took place after the flight experienced a loss of communication during its route. The report from Simple Flying noted that an incorrect radio frequency appears to have been the core issue behind the communication failure. Due to this loss of communication, the Cathay Pacific jet was intercepted by NATO fighter jets, with the radio frequency error identified as the central cause of the occurrence. metadata.title: 韓國國產巡飛彈首度艦載試射失敗 國防科學研究所查明發射器缺陷

a-20260829-1449-south-korean-attack-dron.text: 韓國國產巡飛彈首度艦載試射失敗 國防科學研究所查明發射器缺陷 韓國巡飛彈於艦載試射中墜海;初步調查指出發射器艙門錯位導致失控 韓國國防科學研究所(ADD)於2026年8月28日表示,韓國兩架巡飛彈(自殺式無人機)於8月25日自釜山外海的「馬羅島號」(ROKS Marado)兩棲攻擊艦發射後數秒內墜海。此次試射為該型無人機的首次艦載測試,預計攻擊約2公里外之無人目標船隻,但首架無人機於發射後約2秒墜海,隨後進行的第二次試射亦於發射後約4秒墜毀。 根據國防科學研究所公布的初步調查結果,事故主因為艦載發射器下段機艙門出現偏差錯位。該發射裝置包含雙層發射管,其中下層發射管左側門出現輕微錯位。當無人機從上層發射管發射時,發射過程產生的推力短暫將錯位的艙門推向內部,進而導致離開發射管的無人機受力不均,強烈向右偏轉並迅速失去控制。艙門在變形後迅速恢復原狀,致使事故發生後的初步檢查難以察覺該異常。 國防科學研究所指出,無人機本身及整體系統運作皆完全正常,並表示發射管結構問題並未在先前的測試中出現。在此次海上試驗前,該系統已在陸上成功完成約30次發射測試。調查人員目前正進一步釐清發射器門板錯位究竟發生於組裝階段、運輸過程,抑或是彈藥裝填操作期間。 此次參與測試的無人機屬於韓國自主研發的國產長程巡飛彈「K-LUCAS」計畫。該機型翼展約為3公尺,具備超過10小時的空中滯空能力,可執行偵察、監視與打擊等多元任務。韓國國防部長安圭伯(Ahn Gyu-back)曾於2026年6月宣佈,軍方計劃加速部署K-LUCAS系統。韓國目標於2030年前取得超過2萬架各型低成本無人機,並推動具備人工智慧功能的無人機蜂群技術。 South Korean Attack Drones Crash in Naval Test Due to Launcher Door Defect South Korea attack drones crash during naval test off Busan; launcher defect blamed for control loss South Korea's Agency for Defense Development (ADD) announced on August 28, 2026, that two South Korean loitering munitions crashed into the sea seconds after launch during their first naval test on August 25. The test took place aboard ROKS Marado, a 14,000-ton Dokdo-class amphibious assault ship operating off Busan, South Korea. The mission was designed to demonstrate shipboard launch capabilities and target an unmanned vessel approximately two kilometers away. However, the first drone plunged into the sea roughly two seconds after departure, and a second drone crashed about four seconds after launch. Preliminary investigation by the Agency for Defense Development revealed that the failures were caused by a defect in the shipboard launcher's lower tube door. The launch system utilizes a two-level tube design. According to investigators, a door on the left side of a lower launch tube was slightly out of alignment. When a drone launched from an upper tube, operational forces temporarily pushed the misaligned door inward, generating uneven aerodynamic forces on the exiting aircraft. This imbalance forced the drone sharply to the right and caused an immediate loss of flight control. Investigators emphasized that the drones and their core operational systems functioned normally throughout the test procedure. The Agency for Defense Development stated that the identical launch tube configuration had been successfully operated during approximately 30 prior land-based trials without encountering similar structural issues. Current investigative efforts are focused on determining whether the door misalignment originated during factory assembly, transport logistics, or ammunition loading operations. The aircraft tested belong to South Korea's K-LUCAS project, an effort to develop a domestically manufactured long-range loitering munition. Featuring a wingspan of approximately three meters, the K-LUCAS system is designed to sustain flight for more than 10 hours while executing reconnaissance, surveillance, and precision strike operations. South Korean Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-back announced in June 2026 that the military plans to accelerate the operational deployment of K-LUCAS as part of a strategic initiative to acquire over 20,000 low-cost drones by 2030. Two South Korean loitering munitions crashed into the sea seconds after launch from ROKS Marado off Busan on August 25, 2026. The two aircraft were launched on August 25, 2026, from ROKS Marado, a 14,000-ton Dokdo-class amphibious assault ship operating off Busan, South Korea. South Korea's Agency for Defense Development announced on August 28 that initial investigation attributed the crashes to a misaligned door on the launcher's lower section. a-20260829-1449-czech-startup-zuri-unvei.text: 捷克Zuri發表無人貨運傾轉旋翼機並籌措A輪資金 捷克Zuri發表混合動力無人貨運傾轉旋翼機;現正進行A輪600萬歐元融資 捷克研發業者 Zuri 於 2026 年 8 月 27 日正式發表一款用於貨運運輸的新型混合動力無人傾轉旋翼機。該款飛行器專為民用與軍用雙重用途設計,具備載重超過 165 公斤的貨運能力,巡航速度最高可達每小時 220 公里。 在操作與動力系統方面,該無人機採用由地面操作員進行遠端控制的機制,並結合多項自動化飛行程序。動力架構上,飛行器未單純依賴電池組,而是配置能在飛行過程中發電的電動馬達,並結合可使用航空汽油(AvGas)、車用汽油或生物乙醇的熱機系統,提升在複雜環境下的運作韌性。 總部位於捷克布拉格的 Zuri 由企業家 Michal Illich 創立,自 2018 年起致力於電動垂直起降(eVTOL)飛行器的研發。團隊迄今已製造並測試約 15 架不同規格的原型機,其中「Technology Demonstrator 1.0」曾於 2021 年完成受控懸停測試。目前該公司正在推進名為「Technology Demonstrator 2.0」的全尺寸原型機,並已在捷克基地展開地面測試。 為將全尺寸原型機推向飛行測試階段,Zuri 目前正在進行 A 輪融資,目標募集 600 萬歐元新資金。該公司指出,目前已獲得約 110 萬歐元的認購意向承諾,而先前已從私人投資者手中累積募集約 650 萬歐元資金。 Zuri 預計這款傾轉旋翼機能夠滿足民用與軍用客戶的多元需求,未來可執行包括離岸平台物資補給以及軍事基地運送等任務。報導提及,此項消息由媒體 AeroTime 發布。 Czech Startup Zuri Unveils Hybrid-Electric Cargo Tiltrotor Drone Czech startup Zuri unveiled a hybrid-electric cargo tiltrotor drone and is seeking Series A funding. Czech eVTOL developer Zuri unveiled a new hybrid-electric uncrewed tiltrotor designed for cargo transportation on August 27, 2026. Built with dual-use applications in mind for both civilian and military operators, the aircraft is capable of carrying a payload exceeding 165 kilograms and reaching cruise speeds of up to 220 km/h. The uncrewed aircraft is designed to be operated remotely by a ground control station, featuring automated flight management systems. Rather than relying solely on battery power, the tiltrotor incorporates an electric motor capable of generating electricity during flight, combined with a thermal engine capable of running on aviation gasoline (AvGas), automotive gasoline, or bioethanol to enhance power architecture resilience. Based in Prague, Zuri was founded in 2018 by entrepreneur Michal Illich to develop electric vertical takeoff and landing technology. The startup has designed and test-flown approximately 15 different prototypes to date. Its Technology Demonstrator 1.0 previously achieved controlled hovering flight in 2021, and the company is currently advancing its full-scale Technology Demonstrator 2.0 prototype, which has already undergone initial ground testing in the Czech Republic. To transition the Technology Demonstrator 2.0 prototype to the flight test stage, Zuri is currently raising €6 million in fresh capital through a Series A funding round. The Czech developer confirmed it has already secured €1.1 million in funding commitments, adding to the €6.5 million previously raised from private investors. Zuri anticipates that the tiltrotor will serve both commercial and defense sectors, conducting logistics resupply operations for offshore platforms and remote military outposts, according to reporting by AeroTime. Czech eVTOL developer Zuri unveiled a new hybrid-electric uncrewed tiltrotor for cargo transportation on August 27, 2026. Cruise speed will be up to 220 km/h. The drone is remotely controlled from the ground and utilizes a hybrid powertrain combining an electric motor with a thermal engine. The aircraft will controlled remotely by an operator on the ground, with many flight processes being automated. In fact, Zuri is currently in the process of raising €6 million in fresh capital in a Series A round, in order to move Technology Demonstrator 2.0, onto the flight test stage. Zuri has secured commitments for €1.1 million in the Series A round and has previously raised €6.5 million from private investors. The Czech company claims to have secured commitments for €1.1 million already. Founded in Prague in 2018 by Michal Illich, Zuri has built and test-flown around 15 prototypes. metadata.title: 紐西蘭總理公開批評紐航業績表現 紐航財年稅後虧損達2.42億紐元

a-20260829-1449-nz-prime-minister-scolds.text: 紐西蘭總理公開批評紐航業績表現 紐航財年稅後虧損達2.42億紐元 紐西蘭總理批評紐航年度財報表現;航司受燃油與引擎成本影響虧損2.42億紐元。 紐西蘭航空(Air New Zealand)公布最新財年財務報告,顯示公司稅後淨虧損約1.44億美元(相當於2.42億紐元),稅前虧損則達約2億美元(相當於3.36億紐元)。相較之下,該航司在2025財年的稅前盈餘約為9,700萬美元(相當於1.64億紐元)。儘管面臨虧損,紐西蘭航空表示,此結果仍略優於2026年5月向市場提供的預測區間。 紐西蘭總理克里斯多福·盧克森(Christopher Luxon)對紐西蘭航空的財務表現提出公開批評,稱該航司在過去一個財年的表現「相當糟糕」。身為紐西蘭航空前執行長的盧克森指出,航司需要非常快速地恢復正常運作,並強調紐西蘭航空有責任向外界說明造成如此重大虧損的原因,以及未來將採取何種措施以打造更具競爭力的營運體質。 針對虧損原因,紐西蘭航空指出,主要因素包括中東衝突引發的航空燃油價格飆升、持續上升的航空系統成本,以及今年特別高昂的維修費用。此外,供應商引擎供應問題也嚴重衝擊營運。根據航司說明,勞斯萊斯(Rolls-Royce)Trent 1000與普惠(Pratt & Whitney)PW1100引擎的持續性問題,因運能損失、額外租賃與引擎費用、機隊利用率降低及營運效率下降等因素,對財務結果造成估計約1.9億美元的衝擊。 紐西蘭航空執行長尼基爾·拉維尚卡爾(Nikhil Ravishankar)表示,過去一年對航空業而言極具挑戰性。不過他同時指出,先前限制航司航網擴充的引擎問題目前已大幅緩解,團隊與引擎製造商緊密合作,使停飛的客機比預期更早恢復服務。雖然仍有殘餘風險與成本需要應對,但航司進入2027財年時將擁有顯著更為可靠的機隊狀況。 面對未來展望,紐西蘭航空發言人表示,鑑於中東衝突持續帶來的不確定性,以及航空燃油價格維持在高位與劇烈波動(目前燃油價格約為每桶150美元),航司目前無法針對2027財年提供盈餘指引。航司強調,先前已透過調整票價與縮減運能採取快速且果斷的行動,以平衡旅客負擔能力並最大化營運復甦。 NZ Prime Minister Scolds Air New Zealand Over Financial Loss Driven by Engine and Fuel Costs Air New Zealand reports NZD 242 million net loss amid fuel price hikes and engine issues. Air New Zealand has posted a net loss after taxation of approximately $144 million (NZD $242 million) for the financial year, alongside a pre-tax loss of roughly $200 million (NZD $336 million). The earnings result contrasts with a pre-tax profit of around $97 million ($164 million) recorded in the previous 2025 financial period. Despite the losses, the airline noted that the final financial outcome was slightly better than the market guidance range previously issued in May 2026. New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon, who previously served as the Chief Executive Officer of Air New Zealand, publicly criticized the carrier's financial results, describing the performance over the past financial year as very poor. Luxon stated that the airline must address its operational performance rapidly and urged management to clearly explain the underlying factors behind the substantial loss alongside plans to build a stronger business. According to Air New Zealand, the financial headwinds were driven primarily by sharp spikes in jet fuel prices linked to the conflict in the Middle East, alongside higher aviation system and maintenance expenses. Furthermore, ongoing technical and availability issues involving Rolls-Royce Trent 1000 and Pratt & Whitney PW1100 engines impacted the annual result by an estimated $190 million through lost capacity, supplemental leasing expenses, reduced fleet utilization, and operational inefficiencies. Air New Zealand Chief Executive Officer Nikhil Ravishankar described the period as a very challenging year for the aviation sector but noted that network constraints linked to engine availability are now substantially behind the carrier. Ravishankar highlighted that operational teams worked with engine suppliers to return grounded aircraft to active service earlier than initially anticipated, positioning the fleet for improved operational reliability entering the 2027 financial year. Looking ahead, Air New Zealand announced that it is currently unable to provide financial earnings guidance for the 2027 financial year. An airline spokesperson cited ongoing uncertainty surrounding regional geopolitical conflicts and significant volatility in jet fuel prices, which have reached around $150 per barrel, as the primary reasons for withholding forward guidance. Additionally, starting May 16, 2027, Discover Airlines will launch twice-weekly flights between Munich (MUC) and Glasgow (GLA). All services are to be operated by Airbus A320 (ICAO type code A320) aircraft. Rebranded from Eurowings Discovery in 2023, the carrier plans to expand its fleet to 40 aircraft by 2028. a-20260829-1758-manchester-airport-owner.text: 曼徹斯特機場母公司稱駭客勒索贖款 未造成營運影響 曼徹斯特機場母公司稱駭客勒索贖款 未造成營運影響 曼徹斯特機場(MAN)及倫敦斯坦斯特德機場(STN)的母公司曼徹斯特機場集團(MAG)於2026年8月27日表示,駭客在本次「網路安全事件」中存取了大量客戶資料,並向其提出贖款要求,但該要求遭到拒絕。 MAG指出,駭客已存取約870萬人的資料,包括曼徹斯特機場、斯坦斯特德機場及東米德蘭機場(EMA)的客戶資料。MAG強調,未存取任何銀行或付款資料,但客戶的電子郵件地址、電話號碼、車輛註冊號及郵遞區號等資料可能洩露。 MAG表示,該集團已立即封堵風險,並與專家顧問合作,採取適當措施保護客戶及系統。MAG確認,本次事件未對航空旅行或航空安全造成任何影響,並已通知相關當局。 Manchester Airport owner says hackers demanded ransom in cyber-attack, no operational impact Manchester Airport owner says hackers demanded ransom in cyber-attack, no operational impact Manchester Airports Group (MAG), the owner of Manchester Airport (MAN) and London Stansted Airport (STN), said on August 27, 2026, that hackers accessed a quantity of customer data during a cyber security incident and demanded a ransom, which was refused. MAG stated that approximately 8.7 million individuals' details were accessed across Manchester Airport, Stansted Airport, and East Midlands Airport (EMA). It confirmed that no bank or payment details were accessed, but customer email addresses, phone numbers, vehicle registrations and postcodes were compromised. MAG said it immediately contained the risk, engaged specialist cyber security advisors, and informed the relevant authorities. It stressed that passenger safety and aviation security were not compromised and that the incident caused no operational disruption. Manchester Airports Group (MAG) said hackers demanded a ransom during a cyber security incident on August 27, 2026. On August 27, 2026, Manchester Airports Group (MAG) warned that hackers had accessed a “quantity of customer data” related to car park, lounge and fast track bookings and in-airport WIFI sign-ups. Around 8.7 million individuals' details were accessed across Manchester, Stansted and East Midlands airports. Across Manchester Airport, Stansted Airport and MAG’s other site at East Midlands Airport (EMA), the details of around 8.7 million individuals were accessed. No bank or payment details were accessed, but customer email addresses, phone numbers, vehicle registrations and postcodes were compromised. In a statement, MAG said that no bank or payment details were accessed, but hackers had been able to get hold of customer email addresses, phone numbers, vehicle registrations and postcodes. MAG confirmed the incident did not result in any operational disruption and that passenger safety and aviation security were not compromised. MAG confirmed that the incident had not resulted in any operational disruption. “We would like to reassure customers that Manchester Airport Group takes the security of customer information extremely seriously and we apologize for any inconvenience or concern caused,” added MAG.

a-20260829-2124-manchester-airports-grou.text: 曼徹斯特及史坦斯特機場(MAN)母公司稱遭駭客勒索 MAG稱駭客索取贖金遭拒;約870萬人資料受影響 營運曼徹斯特機場(MAN)、倫敦史坦斯特機場(STN)及東密德蘭機場(EMA)的曼徹斯特機場集團(MAG)表示,於2026年8月27日發生的「網路安全事件」中,駭客曾要求支付贖金以換取資料歸還,但該集團拒絕了要求。 MAG指出,駭客存取與停車場、貴賓室及快速通關預訂,以及機場內WiFi註冊相關的「一定數量的客戶資料」,涉及約870萬人的個人資訊,但不包含銀行或付款資料。 據MAG提交給BBC的資料,集團表示已知曉駭客身份並已通報相關當局。MAG強調事件未影響旅客安全或航空安全,也未造成航班營運中斷。 Manchester Airport (MAN)s Group says hackers demanded ransom in cyber-attack MAG claims ransom was demanded and refused; data of about 8.7 million affected Manchester Airport (MAN)s Group (MAG), which owns Manchester Airport, London Stansted Airport (STN), and East Midlands Airport (EMA), has claimed that hackers demanded a ransom during a "cyber security incident" on August 27, 2026. According to MAG's statement, hackers accessed a "quantity of customer data" related to car park, lounge, and fast track bookings, and in-airport WIFI sign-ups, affecting approximately 8.7 million individuals across the three airports. On bank or payment details were not accessed. MAG told the BBC that the demands were refused and that the hackers' identity was used. MAG confirmed that the incident had not resulted in any operational disruption and that passenger safety and aviation security had been compromised. 曼徹斯特機場集團聲稱駭客在資安事件中要求支付贖金,但已被拒絕。 a MAG representative said hackers had demanded a ransom fee for the return of the data, but this was refused by the airport group. 事件影響約870萬人的個資,涉及曼徹斯特機場、史坦斯特機場和東密德蘭機場。 the details of around 8.7 million individuals were accessed. a-20260829-2343-dhl-boeing-737-cargo-jet.text: DHL貨運波音737機降落洛杉磯爆胎起火 FAA展開調查 DHL貨運波音737降落洛杉磯爆胎起火;機組員全數平安;FAA已展開調查 2026年8月26日,一架由Kalitta Charters II執飛、代表DHL營運的波音737-800BDSF貨機(航班號K5-1814),自鳳凰城天港國際機場(PHX)飛往洛杉磯國際機場(LAX)。該機於當地時間深夜23時左右降落洛杉磯國際機場25L跑道時,疑似發生煞車系統故障,導致主起落架爆胎並冒出火花與火焰。 根據現場拍攝影片顯示,這架國籍標誌登記為N326FL的波音737貨機在跑道正常觸地後,主起落架隨即噴出大量白煙。數秒後現場傳出多聲巨響,機底起落架區域出現閃光與火苗。飛機在起落架夾帶火花與煙霧的情況下繼續滑行,最終在跑道上安全減速停止。 無線電通話紀錄顯示,機組人員在降落過程中向管制塔台回報疑似煞車問題,飛行員指出感覺煞車鎖死。洛杉磯國際機場消防隊隨即趕赴現場,對熱煞車與起落架區域進行噴水處置。受此事故影響,25L跑道暫時封閉以確保安全,其他航班均被指示避開該跑道,直到次日晨間該跑道仍維持封閉狀態。 美國聯邦航空管理局(FAA)發布初步資訊指出,該架貨機在降落時煞車鎖死並造成四條輪胎爆裂,目前FAA已就本起事故展開詳細調查。DHL則在聲明中表示,事故起因為顯著煞車系統異常導致煞車過熱,並確認機上所有機組人員均安全無恙、未有人員受傷。 據FAA登記紀錄顯示,該架波音737-800貨機於2001年出廠製造,並於2022年12月完成從客機改裝為貨機(BDSF)的工程。目前營運方Kalitta Charters II正著手移動該架受損飛機,以便後續進行更詳細的技術檢查與評估。 DHL Boeing 737 Cargo Jet Suffers Tire Blowout and Gear Fire at LAX DHL Boeing 737 freighter suffers brake lockup and tire fire during landing at Los Angeles International Airport. On August 26, 2026, a Kalitta Charters II Boeing 737-800BDSF freighter operating as DHL Flight K5-1814 from Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX) to Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) suffered an apparent brake malfunction upon landing. The aircraft landed on Runway 25L at approximately 23:00 local time when four tires blew out and flames erupted from the main landing gear. Video footage captured at the scene shows the Boeing 737 touching down normally before dense white smoke began billowing from the main gear. Seconds later, multiple loud pops were heard as flashes and flames burst beneath the fuselage. The aircraft continued its landing rollout with sparks and fire trailing behind before coming to a stop on the runway. Air traffic control audio accompanying the flight captured the crew reporting potential mechanical trouble to the tower, with one pilot stating that the brakes felt as though they had locked up. Airport emergency fire crews arrived shortly after the aircraft stopped and sprayed down the overheated landing gear assembly. Runway 25L was kept closed into the following morning while crews remained on site. Preliminary information released by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) indicates that the aircraft’s brakes locked up during landing, resulting in four blown tires. The agency has launched a detailed investigation into the event. DHL confirmed in a statement that the incident was caused by an apparent brake system issue that led to severe overheating, adding that no injuries occurred and all crew members are safe. According to FAA registry records, the Boeing 737-800 aircraft (registration N326FL) was originally manufactured in 2001 and converted from passenger to freighter configuration in December 2022. Operating carrier Kalitta Charters II is coordinating efforts to move the disabled aircraft from the runway to enable comprehensive inspections. a-20260829-2343-german-armed-forces-depl.text: 德國國防軍啟用雷達鳥擊預警軟體平台VoVisWxBw 德國國防軍啟用新軟體平台;每小時分析80萬雷達資料預警鳥擊 德國聯邦國防軍於2026年8月27日公布正式啟用名為VoVisWxBw的新型軟體平台。該平台每小時可處理超過80萬個雷達資料點,並將資料轉換為鳥類活動的即時顯示畫面,協助專家針對潛在的碰撞危害向軍用飛機機組人員發出警報。 VoVisWxBw由德國聯邦國防軍網路與資訊空間數位化暨能力發展中心,與德國聯邦地理資訊中心(ZGeoBw)合作開發。系統研發工作歷時數月並於2025年底完成,用以取代先前用於收集與評估軍用鳥類遷徙雷達資料的舊版應用程式。國防軍指出,舊有系統在技術上已屬過時,且日常維護工作變得日益困難。 在功能設計上,VoVisWxBw可呈現二維與三維的雷達資訊介面。操作人員能夠將最新的雷達回波與歷史紀錄進行比對,藉由動態循環畫面觀察鳥群的移動方向與發展趨勢,同時疊加保護區地圖進行綜合分析。該軟體透過敏捷開發模式打造,讓實務專家能在日常工作中提出需求並進行新功能測試。 在實際維運與防護機制方面,ZGeoBw的專業人員會解讀即時雷達圖樣,並據此繪製發布鳥類飛行通告(BIRDTAM)。這些警告資訊同時提供給軍方與民用航管使用者參考,協助飛行員在規劃與執行任務時納入安全考量。當地區鳥類活動達到第五級強度時,德國聯邦國防軍即會開始對相關飛行作業實施限制。 統計數據顯示,德國聯邦國防軍每年記錄超過130起鳥擊碰撞事故。在2024年的飛行作業中,廣義野生動物撞擊事件中有10%導致設備受損。軍用航空因訓練與任務需要而頻繁於低空進行飛行作業,該高度區間常有大量鳥類活動,使防範鳥擊成為保障軍事飛行安全的重要課題。 German Armed Forces deploy radar-based bird warning software German Armed Forces deployed radar software platform VoVisWxBw in August 2026 to warn aircrews of bird strike hazards. The German Armed Forces (Bundeswehr) unveiled a new software platform named VoVisWxBw on August 27, 2026, designed to process more than 800,000 radar data points per hour. The platform translates incoming radar signals into visual displays of bird movements, allowing specialists to warn military aircrews about potential collision hazards during flight operations. VoVisWxBw was developed by the Bundeswehr Center for Digitalization and Capability Development of the Cyber and Information Domain in cooperation with the Bundeswehr Geoinformation Center (ZGeoBw). System development was completed at the end of 2025 following several months of work. The platform replaces an older radar data collection application that the Bundeswehr described as technically obsolete and increasingly difficult to maintain. The platform presents radar information in two- and three-dimensional views, allowing operators to compare live returns with historical radar data, review animated loops to identify flock trajectories, and overlay maps of protected bird areas. The software was built using an agile development process that permitted ZGeoBw specialists to submit operational requirements and test functions during their daily duties. Specialists at ZGeoBw interpret real-time radar patterns on the platform to formulate Bird Notices to Airmen (BIRDTAMs). These hazard warnings contain specific validity areas, intensity levels, and warning zones, which are made available to both military and civilian airspace users for flight planning. The Bundeswehr initiates flight restrictions when bird activity reaches intensity level five. According to Bundeswehr figures, the military records more than 130 bird collisions each year. In 2024, 10% of recorded wildlife-strike incidents during flight operations resulted in aircraft damage. Military aviation operations are particularly exposed to these risks because training and operational flights frequently take place at low altitudes where bird concentrations are highest. 德國聯邦國防軍於2026年8月27日公布名為VoVisWxBw的新軟體平台。 The Bundeswehr unveiled the system on August 27, 2026. The platform replaced an older application used to collect and evaluate radar data for military bird-migration warnings, which the Bundeswehr described as technically obsolete and increasingly difficult to maintain. 德國聯邦地理資訊中心專家解讀雷達圖樣以製作供軍民使用的鳥類飛行通告(BIRDTAM)。 Specialist personnel at ZGeoBw interpret the radar patterns and use the results to prepare BIRDTAMs, or Bird Notices to Airmen. 當鳥類活動達到第五級強度時,德國聯邦國防軍即開始對飛行作業實施限制。 The Bundeswehr begins restricting flight operations when bird activity reaches intensity level five. 德國聯邦國防軍每年記錄超過130起鳥擊碰撞,2024年有10%的野生動物撞擊事件造成設備損害。 The Bundeswehr records more than 130 collisions with birds each year. a-20260830-0232-american-airlines-adds-s.text: 美國航空公布2027夏季七條新航線 美國航空公布2027夏季;新增波圖、維也納、凱夫拉維克 美國航空(American Airlines)於2026年8月27日公布2027年夏季賽季的七條新國際航線,其中包含兩個全新的歐洲目的地:波多(OPO)與維也納(VIE),兩條直飛航線均由費城(PHL)樞紐營運。 美國航空將成為唯一營運奧地利首都的美國籍航空公司。維也納機場執行長Julian Jäger接受AeroTime採訪時表示,吸引至少一家美國航空公司進駐是航線發展的優先事項。 冰島凱夫拉維克國際機場(KEF)也將重新納入該公司網絡,美航曾在2019年停飛該航線。波線與維也納航線將採用新的空中巴士A321XLR(ICAO機型代碼A21N)營運,而凱夫拉維克則由標準版A321neo執飛。 波線服務將於2027年3月28日開航,維也納與凱夫拉維克則分別於同日五月6日與28日開航。美航也利用A321XLR進駐機隊,部署於紐約(JFK)至阿姆斯特丹史基浦(AMS)與尼斯蔚藍海岸(NCE)等新航線。 巴塞隆納(BCN)自2027年5月27日起將有飛往美國的每日不停站航班,採用波音777-200(B77W)營運;芝加哥歐海爾(ORD)至東京成田(NRT)航線自2027年3月19日起以波音787-9每日營運,紐約至倫敦希斯洛(LHR)也將新增第四班每日航班。 美航也證實將於2027年春季恢復夏洛特至巴黎(CDG)與邁阿密(MIA)至米蘭馬勒彭薩(MXP)的季節性航線。 American Airlines adds seven European routes for summer 2027, including Porto, Vienna and Keflavik American Airlines unveils seven 2027 routes; new Porto, Vienna, Keflavik, plus more American Airlines has unveiled seven new international routes for the 2027 summer season, announced on August 27, 2026. The carrier will add two new European destinations to its network: Porto (OPO) and Vienna (VIE), with both nonstop services operated from its Philadelphia (PHL) hub. American will also become the only US carrier serving Vienna. In a recent exclusive interview with AeroTime, Vienna Airport CEO Julian Jäger said that attracting at least one US carrier to the Austrian capital was a route development priority. Keflavik International Airport (KEF) in Iceland will also be added to the network, although this is more of a comeback, as American had previously served the destination before dropping it in 2019. Both Porto and Vienna will be served by American Airlines' new Airbus A321XLR, while Keflavik will be operated by a regular A321neo, since the standard version has enough range to reach Iceland from the East Coast of the United States. The Porto service starts March 28, 2027, while Vienna and Keflavik begin May 6 and 28, 2027, respectively. American is also leveraging the A321XLR on new routes linking New York (JFK) to Amsterdam-Schiphol (AMS) and Nice-Côte d'Azur (NCE). Barcelona (BCN) will see a new nonstop service, planned to start May 27, 2027 with a Boeing 777-200 daily. A new route from Chicago O'Hare (ORD) to Tokyo-Narita (NRT) will be operated daily with a Boeing 787-9 from March 19, 2027, and a fourth daily frequency between New York (JFK) and London-Heathrow (LHR) with B787-9s. The airline will also bring back seasonal routes, Charlotte to Paris (CDG) and Miami to Milan Malpensa (MXP), in spring 2027. a-20260830-0232-singapore-to-host-inaugu.text: 新加坡將首辦旅客航站區博覽會亞洲展九月登場 新加坡九月首辦PTE Asia;逾3500專業人士參與;孫雪齡致開幕詞 新加坡將於2026年9月23至24日在 Sands Expo & Convention Centre 舉辦首屆旅客航站區博覽會亞洲展(PTE Asia)。交通部及國家發展部政務次長孫雪齡將以榮譽嘉賓身分出席並致開幕詞。 主辦單位預計吸引逾3,500名產業專業人士、200位專家講者及125家展商參與。根據國際機場理事會亞太及中東地區預測,2025至2028年間亞太區旅客流量將年增4.8%,中東地區年增5.4%。東南亞主要機場擴建計畫投資金額至少達400億美元,延續至2030年代初中葉。 大會議程涵蓋聯網旅客體驗、智慧機場營運、永續與氣候領導、投資與商業收入、機場規劃、未來防禦總體規劃及先進空中交通等核心領域。活動總監 Dominic Pinfold 指出:「增長數據令人信服,但真正挑戰在於機場如何將投資轉化為產能、韌性及更好的旅客旅程。新加坡是亞洲、中東及其他地區機場領袖比較成功經驗、審視新興技術並建立下一階段增長夥伴關係的理想場所。」 主要贊助商暨展商包含 AIS-Hill、Vanderlande、Rapiscan Systems、SJ Group、Mitsubishi Elevator、Populous、find inc、Copenhagen Optimization、TAV Technologies、DXC Technology、Analogic Corporation 及 Garrett,涵蓋航廈設計、行李處理、安檢、垂直運輸、旅客流量管理及機場技術等領域。會議期間,Snapsight 將提供 AI 生成的議程摘要、可搜尋洞察、即時字幕及多語言逐字稿,並透過 QR 碼呈現動態觀念雲以利追蹤平行議程。 新加坡樟宜機場(SIN)集團另安排兩場限額參觀:9月22日探訪新一代智慧航廈規劃,9月25日深入體驗 FAST(Fast and Seamless Travel)自動化旅客流程。博覽通行證免費,大會代表證供應商及顧問為新幣500元,合資格機場、航空公司及公部門人員可獲免費大會代表資格(經審核確認)。報名網址為 pte-asia.com/visit-pte-asia/registr。 Singapore to host inaugural Passenger Terminal Expo Asia in September 2026 Singapore hosts first PTE Asia Sept 23-24; 3,500+ attendees; Sun Xueling opens Singapore will host the inaugural Passenger Terminal Expo Asia (PTE Asia) on 23–24 September 2026 at the Sands Expo & Convention Centre. Ms Sun Xueling, Senior Minister of State for Transport and National Development, will attend as Guest of Honour and deliver the opening address. Organizers expect more than 3,500 industry professionals, 200 expert speakers, and 125 exhibitors. Airports Council International Asia-Pacific & Middle East forecasts annual passenger traffic growth of 4.8% in Asia-Pacific and 5.4% in the Middle East between 2025 and 2028. Major disclosed airport developments across Southeast Asia represent at least US$40 billion in investment extending into the early-to-mid-2030s. The conference programme covers connected passenger experience, intelligent airport operations, sustainability and climate leadership, investment and commercial revenue, airport planning, future-proof master planning, and advanced air mobility. Event Director Dominic Pinfold said: "The growth figures are compelling, but the real challenge is how airports translate investment into capacity, resilience and a better passenger journey. Singapore is an ideal place for airport leaders from Asia, the Middle East and beyond to compare what is working, examine emerging technology and build the partnerships needed for the next phase of growth." Key sponsors and exhibitors include AIS-Hill, Vanderlande, Rapiscan Systems, SJ Group, Mitsubishi Elevator, Populous, find inc, Copenhagen Optimization, TAV Technologies, DXC Technology, Analogic Corporation, and Garrett, spanning terminal design, baggage handling, security screening, vertical transport, passenger flow, and airport technology. Snapsight will provide AI-generated session summaries, searchable insights, live captions, and multilingual transcripts via QR code, with Dynamic Idea Clouds visualising emerging themes across parallel sessions. Changi Airport (SIN) Group offers two limited-capacity tours: a 22 September session on next-generation smart terminal plans, and a 25 September behind-the-scenes tour of FAST (Fast and Seamless Travel) examining technology and automation for smoother passenger journeys. Expo passes are complimentary; conference delegate passes cost SGD500 for suppliers, consultants, and industry professionals, while qualifying airport, airline, and public-sector professionals receive complimentary access subject to review. Registration is available at pte-asia.com/visit-pte-asia/registr. a-20260830-0232-five-drones-crossed-mold.text: 摩爾多瓦國慶閱兵前五架無人機入侵領空 摩爾多瓦國軍記錄五起無人機越界事件;國慶閱兵照常舉行 摩爾多瓦國家陸軍記錄到五架未經授權的無人機於2026年8月27日凌晨飛越該國領空,數小時後該國在基希訥烏舉行獨立35週年閱兵。 國家陸軍空中作戰處表示,這些蹤跡是與夥伴共同建立,且飛行緊隨俄羅斯對烏克蘭的夜間空襲。每次飛越均沿東南邊界的Stefan Voda地區。 據報導,第一架無人機於當地時間03:56從Beleaevka方向進入,另一架於05:50在Saiti過境點越界,至06:02離開領空。五個物件中有兩個未追蹤到,第二架於04:10在Carahasani失蹤,第三架於04:24在Transnistrian地區的Pervomaisc失蹤。 聲明未報告殘骸,且未提及關閉空域或航班改道。 Five drones crossed Moldovan airspace hours before Independence Day parade Moldova's National Army records five unauthorized drone crossings; two tracks lost, no wreckage Moldova's National Army recorded five unauthorized drone flights through national airspace during the early hours of August 27, 2026, hours before the country marked 35 years of independence with a military parade in Chișinău. The National Army's Air Operations Service said the tracks were established jointly with partners and that the flights followed Russian air attacks on Ukraine overnight. Every crossing took place along the southeastern border in the Stefan Voda district. According to the report, the first drone entered at 03:56 local time, and a fifth object moved across the border at the Saiti crossing at 05:50 and left toward Lesnoie at 06:02. Two of the five were never tracked out: the second disappeared at 04:10 near Carahasani, and the third at 04:24 near Pervomaisc. The statement reported no wreckage and made no mention of an airspace closure or diversions. 摩爾多瓦國家軍記錄到2026年8月27日凌晨5次未經授權的無人機飛越國家領空。 Moldova’s National Army recorded five unauthorized drone flights through national airspace during the early hours of August 27, 2026 這些飛越事件發生在基希奧烏軍事閱兵數小時前。 hours before the country marked 35 years of independence with a military parade in Chișinău 所有跨界事件發生在東南部的Stefan Voda地區。 Every crossing took place along the southeastern frontier in the Stefan Voda district 五次飛越中有兩次未被追蹤到出口。 Two of the five were never tracked out. 聲明未報告殘骸,也未提及空域關閉或航班改道。 The statement reported no wreckage and made no mention of an airspace closure or diversions

metadata.title: 立院三讀無人機條例 政院稱收到法案後審慎考量

a-20260830-0842-taiwan-executive-yuan-to.text: 立院三讀無人機條例 政院稱收到法案後審慎考量 行政院表示尚未收到無人機條例三讀法案;將就國防與產業需求審慎考量。 針對立法院會於8月27日三讀通過「強化國防自主暨無人載具產業發展條例」,行政院發言人李慧芝於8月30日表示,行政院目前尚未收到三讀法案。收到法案後,行政院將審視相關內容是否符合國防自主及產業發展的需求,並就執行層面進行審慎考量。 該條例明定中央政府應循年度預算程序,連續6年編列總額2400億元預算,原則上每年編列400億元。媒體報導稱行政院將副署該條例並擬於今年度追加預算編列相關費用。李慧芝強調,政府將依據國防戰略儘速編列預算及進行無人載具採購,同時提升關鍵技術自主能力。 Taiwan Executive Yuan to Review Passed Unmanned Vehicle Act Upon Receipt The Executive Yuan says it will review the newly passed unmanned vehicle act upon receipt in Taipei. Following the passage of the Strengthening National Defense Autonomy and Unmanned Vehicle Industry Development Act by Taiwan's Legislative Yuan on August 27, Executive Yuan spokesperson Li Hui-chih stated on August 30 that the executive branch has not yet received the finalized bill. Upon receipt, the Executive Yuan will review whether the legislation aligns with national defense autonomy and industry development needs and will carefully evaluate operational implementation. The passed bill stipulates that the government should allocate NT$240 billion over six consecutive years for unmanned vehicle development. Addressing media reports regarding countersigning the act and submitting supplementary budget proposals, Li emphasized that the government will expedite budget planning and unmanned vehicle procurements according to defense strategic requirements while enhancing domestic technological autonomy. 立法院會於8月27日三讀通過「強化國防自主暨無人載具產業發展條例」,明定中央政府應連續6年編列總額2400億元預算。 立法院會27日三讀通過「強化國防自主暨無人載具產業發展條例」,明定中央政府應循年度預算程序,連續6年,編列總額為2400億元 行政院發言人李慧芝於8月30日表示尚未收到三讀法案,收到後會審視是否符合國防自主與產業發展需求並審慎考量。 行政院發言人李慧芝今天說,尚未收到三讀法案,收到後會審視是否符合國防自主及產業發展的需求,並就執行層面審慎考量。 媒體報導行政院將副署該條例並編入今年度追加預算,明年度總預算案將提出修正草案。 媒體報導,行政院將副署,且編入今年度追加預算,明年度總預算案將提出修正草案。 李慧芝指出政府將依既定國防戰略與作戰需求,儘速編列預算進行無人載具採購,同時提升關鍵技術自主能力。 政府將依據既定國防戰略與作戰需求,儘速編列相關預算及相關無人載具採購作業,同時攜手國內產業,提升關鍵技術自主能力

The fire incident occurred as the aircraft was subjected to scheduled routine maintenance procedures on site. During the maintenance operations, smoke and a visible glow were observed emanating from the aircraft's nose gear bay, which immediately interrupted the ongoing routine servicing work. Following the detection of smoke and fire in the nose gear bay, emergency response crews moved in quickly to address the situation. a-20260830-0842-faa-moves-to-fire-two-la.text: FAA擬解僱拉瓜迪亞機場兩航管員 涉致命撞機當晚早退 FAA針對拉瓜迪亞機場航管員早退啟動解僱程序;事故釀兩機師身亡 美國聯邦航空管理局(FAA)已針對紐約拉瓜迪亞機場(LGA)的兩名空中交通管制員啟動解僱程序。根據調查,這兩名航管員在一起造成兩名機師身亡、數十人受傷的跑道碰撞事故發生當晚,提早約一小時離開工作崗位。 華爾街日報報導指出,這兩名航管員於2026年3月22日班表結束前離去。當時機場因雷雨與延誤導致航班營運受阻,處理的交通流量超過原本排定量的兩倍。兩名航管員提前離職,導致塔台內僅剩兩名航管員在沒有額外人力支援的情況下,應對異常繁忙的空中交通。 該起致命碰撞事故發生於當地時間23時37分。事發時,由 Jazz Aviation 執飛的加拿大航空快捷(Air Canada Express)8646 號班機(機型為 CRJ900 客機)自蒙特婁皮埃爾·埃利奧特·特魯多國際機場(YUL)起飛並降落於拉瓜迪亞機場 4 號跑道,隨後與一輛獲准穿越跑道的機場消防車發生碰撞。該消防車當時正前往應對另一起獨立的飛機緊急狀況。國家運輸安全委員會(NTSB)指出,碰撞造成 CRJ900 機師與副機長身亡,另有 39 人送醫治療,其中 6 人受重傷。 美國運輸部長 Sean Duffy 對此類違規行為發表強烈聲明,表示政府絕不容忍欺詐,並將對濫用納稅人資源及增加同事工作負擔的員工採取行動。航管人員稱提前離崗為「早退」(early shove),在 FAA 官員眼中屬於未實際工作卻領取薪資的打卡欺詐行為。全美空中交通管制員協會(NATCA)表示正與 FAA 領導層就廣泛的假勤與打卡欺詐疑慮進行討論,同時也指出航管員長期在艱困的人力條件下工作。 FAA moves to fire two LaGuardia controllers for leaving early before fatal crash FAA moves to fire LaGuardia controllers; early leave preceded fatal runway collision killing two pilots. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has initiated termination proceedings against two air traffic controllers at New York LaGuardia Airport (LGA). According to findings, the controllers left work approximately one hour early on the night of a deadly runway collision that resulted in the deaths of two pilots and injuries to dozens more. The Wall Street Journal reported that the controllers departed prior to the end of their scheduled shifts on March 22, 2026. At the time, airport operations were disrupted by thunderstorms and delays, forcing controllers to manage more than double the volume of traffic that had originally been scheduled. Consequently, the two controllers remaining in the tower were left working without additional backup support during a period of unusually heavy traffic. The fatal collision occurred at 23:37 local time. Air Canada Express Flight 8646, a CRJ900 operated by Jazz Aviation, was landing on Runway 4 following a flight from Montréal-Trudeau International Airport (YUL) when it collided with an airport fire truck that had been cleared to cross the runway. The fire truck was responding to a separate aircraft emergency. According to the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB), the captain and first officer of the CRJ900 were killed, while 39 people were transported to hospitals, including six who suffered serious injuries. U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy expressed strong disapproval regarding the issue, stating that the government will not tolerate fraud and will take action against employees who take advantage of taxpayers and increase the workload on their colleagues. Leaving before a shift ends is known among controllers as an "early shove," which FAA officials consider a form of timecard fraud. metadata.title: 菲律賓空軍接收最後七架黑鷹直升機 機隊達47架成全球最大S-70i營運者

a-20260830-0842-philippine-air-force-acc.text: 菲律賓空軍接收最後七架黑鷹直升機 機隊達47架成全球最大S-70i營運者 菲律賓空軍接收最後7架S-70i直升機,完成交付後機隊達47架成全球最大。 菲律賓空軍於2026年8月26日在位於帕賽市的耶穌·維拉摩爾上校空軍基地(Colonel Jesus Villamor Air Base)舉行交機儀式,正式接收最後7架S-70i黑鷹(Black Hawk)直升機。菲律賓空軍司令阿瑟·科爾杜拉(Arthur M. Cordura)中將出席並擔任主禮嘉賓。 本次7架直升機的交付,完成了向洛克希德·馬丁(Lockheed Martin)旗下波蘭子公司PZL Mielec訂購32架S-70i直升機的合約。該項於2022年簽署的第二次採購合約金額約為320億披索(約5.71億美元),交付工作自2024年起分階段進行,包括2024年交付10架、2025年交付10架、2026年1月交付5架,以及本次交付的最終7架。 在接收最終批次直升機後,菲律賓空軍的S-70i直升機隊總規模達到47架,成為全球最大的S-70i機型營運者。菲律賓空軍最初於2019年簽署第一份採購合約,以約115億披索(約2.05億美元)購買16架S-70i直升機,該批次除了1架於2021年在塔拉克省卡帕斯墜毀外,其餘15架均在持續服役中。 這項採購案隸屬於第10349號共和國法案下的修訂版菲律賓武裝部隊現代化計畫「Horizon 2」階段。S-70i為中型通用直升機,可搭載約16名全副武裝士兵或20名人員,單次飛行續航時間約2.5小時。新機隊正全面取代服役數十年的UH-1H休伊(Huey)直升機,以執行人員運輸、搜索救援、醫療後送與災害應變等多項任務。 Philippine Air Force Accepts Final 7 S-70i Black Hawks, Completing 32-Unit Order Philippine Air Force accepts final seven S-70i Black Hawks in Pasay City, expanding fleet to 47 aircraft. The Philippine Air Force (PAF) has formally accepted its final seven S-70i Black Hawk helicopters during a ceremony held at Colonel Jesus Villamor Air Base in Pasay City on August 26, 2026. PAF Commanding General Lieutenant General Arthur M. Cordura attended the event as the guest of honor for the official handover. The delivery completes a 32-aircraft acquisition contract signed in 2022 with Lockheed Martin's Polish subsidiary PZL Mielec, valued at approximately PHP 32 billion (US$571 million). Deliveries under this second agreement arrived in multiple phases, starting with 10 units in 2024, followed by another 10 in 2025, five in January 2026, and the final seven on August 26, 2026. With the arrival of the final seven aircraft, the PAF's total S-70i Black Hawk fleet has grown to 47 units, making the Philippines the largest operator of the S-70i variant globally. The PAF previously acquired 16 S-70i helicopters under a 2019 contract worth PHP 11.5 billion (US$205 million), of which 15 remain operational after one aircraft was lost in a 2021 crash in Capas, Tarlac. The helicopter acquisition is part of Horizon 2 of the Revised Armed Forces of the Philippines Modernization Program under Republic Act No. 10349. The S-70i is a medium-lift utility helicopter capable of carrying approximately 16 fully armed troops or 20 personnel with an endurance of roughly two and a half hours per flight. The fleet is replacing older UH-1H Huey helicopters for troop transport, search and rescue, aeromedical evacuation, and disaster response operations across the archipelago. 菲律賓空軍於2026年8月26日在帕賽市耶穌·維拉摩爾上校空軍基地接收最後7架S-70i黑鷹直升機,空軍司令阿瑟·科爾杜拉中將出席儀式。 The final seven aircraft were formally accepted, turned over, and blessed during a ceremony at Colonel Jesus Villamor Air Base in Pasay City on August 26, 2026, with PAF Commanding General Lieutenant General Arthur M. Cordura serving as guest of honor. 本次交付完成了向洛克希德·馬丁旗下PZL Mielec訂購32架S-70i直升機的2022年合約(價值320億披索),使菲律賓空軍的S-70i總數達到47架,成為全球最大的S-70i營運者。 The delivery brings the PAF’s total fleet of the type to 47 units, making the Philippines the largest operator of the S-70i variant in the world. 菲律賓空軍首批16架S-70i合約於2019年簽署(價值115億披索),除了2021年墜毀的1架外,其餘15架仍在服役中。 The first contract, signed in 2019, covered 16 S-70i helicopters for approximately PHP 11.5 billion (US$205 million). 該採購為第10349號共和國法案武裝部隊現代化計畫Horizon 2的一部分,用以取代舊款UH-1H休伊直升機。 The Black Hawk acquisition is part of Horizon 2 of the Revised Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) Modernization Program under Republic Act No. 10349, which aims to develop and modernize the military’s capabilities. S-70i可搭載約16名全副武裝士兵或20名人員,單次飛行續航時間約為2.5小時。 It can carry approximately 16 fully armed troops, or around 20 personnel depending on cargo configuration, and has an endurance of roughly two and a half hours per flight.

metadata.title: 澳洲航空提前於2028年退役A380客機並商討替代機隊訂單

a-20260830-0842-qantas-to-retire-airbus-.text: 澳洲航空提前於2028年退役A380客機並商討替代機隊訂單 澳洲航空將A380退役時間提前至2028年;並與空中巴士及波音商討替代機型 澳洲航空(Qantas)於2026年8月26日確認,將提前退役旗下的空中巴士A380(Airbus A380)客機機隊。該公司原本預計將A380營運至至少2032財政年度,如今已決定將該機型的退役時間提早至2028年執行。 這項退役時程的調整是在雪梨總部舉辦的2026財政年度業績簡報會上公布。澳洲航空表示,2026年早些時候中東爆發衝突導致航空燃油價格飆升,對營運A380這類四引擎老舊機型的成本造成顯著衝擊。該公司估算燃油危機帶來的整體影響原本可能高達6.1億澳元,但經由採取相關緩和措施後,已成功將該影響控制降至4.2億澳元。 為了補足A380退役後的運量需求,澳洲航空規劃與空中巴士及波音(Boeing)展開談判,預計將部分尚未執行的購買權轉換為確認訂單,不過目前未透露具體數量。澳洲航空目前已訂購12架「日出計畫」(Project Sunrise)專用的超長程A350-1000客機,預計自2027年起連結澳洲東岸至倫敦與紐約;同時該公司亦透過「費許計畫」(Project Fysh)訂購了12架標準型A350-1000、8架波音787-10以及4架波音787-9客機,用於替換既有的A330機隊。 在載客能力方面,澳洲航空現有的A380客機配備高達438個座位,而未來預計引進的替代機型(不論是A350-1000或波音787)載客量將減半。例如現行的波音787-9客機配置為236個座位,而超長程A350客機載客量則為最多238人。 Qantas to Retire Airbus A380 Fleet Early in 2028 and Negotiate Replacement Orders Qantas will retire its Airbus A380 fleet in 2028 and negotiate replacement orders with manufacturers. Qantas confirmed on August 26, 2026, that it will retire its Airbus A380 fleet earlier than originally planned. Although the double-deck aircraft were previously expected to remain in active service until at least fiscal year 2032, the airline has decided to bring the retirement schedule forward to 2028. The announcement was made during the presentation of the carrier's FY26 financial results at its headquarters in Sydney. Airline management cited significant spikes in jet fuel prices following conflict in the Middle East earlier in 2026, which heavily impacted the operational economics of four-engined aircraft. Qantas estimated that the total financial impact of the fuel crisis could have reached AU$610 million, but mitigation measures helped lower the final impact to AU$420 million. To address its future widebody requirements, Qantas stated that it will enter formal negotiations with Airbus and Boeing to convert existing purchase options into firm orders, though specific numbers were not disclosed. The carrier already has orders for 12 ultra-long-range A350-1000 aircraft for its "Project Sunrise" routes connecting eastern Australia to London and New York starting in late 2027. In addition, under "Project Fysh," Qantas has ordered 12 standard A350-1000s, eight Boeing 787-10s, and four Boeing 787-9s to replace its aging A330 fleet. The transition will significantly alter per-aircraft passenger capacity across the long-haul fleet. Qantas' current A380 fleet is configured to seat up to 438 passengers, whereas replacement twin-engine widebodies will carry roughly half that capacity. For instance, the airline's Boeing 787-9s carry 236 passengers and the Project Sunrise A350-1000ULR aircraft will seat up to 238 passengers. Qantas confirmed on August 26, 2026, that it will bring forward the retirement of its Airbus A380 fleet to 2028 from fiscal year 2032. While they were expected to serve at least until the fiscal year 2032, retirement of the A380s will now be brought forward to 2028. The retirement announcement was made during Qantas' FY26 results presentation at its Sydney headquarters. The announcement was made during the presentation of the airline’s FY26 results at an event held at its Sydney headquarters. Qantas estimated that the overall impact of the fuel crisis could have been as high as U$610 million (US$438 million), although claims to have managed to reduce this figure to AU$420 million (US$301 million) thanks to mitigation measures. Qantas will enter negotiations with Airbus and Boeing to convert purchase options into firm orders for replacement aircraft. Qantas said that it will enter negotiations with Airbus and Boeing to convert some of its outstanding purchase options into firm orders but did not specify an exact figure. Qantas currently has 12 ULR A350-1000s for Project Sunrise and 12 regular A350-1000s, eight Boeing 787-10s, and four B787-9s for Project Fysh. The carrier currently has 12 ultra-long-range (ULR) A350-1000s on order, which are allocated to “Project Sunrise”, linking the east coast of Australia to London and New York from late 2027. Qantas A380s are configured for up to 438 passengers, while replacement aircraft like the B787-9 and A350ULR seat 236 and up to 238 passengers. Qantas A380s are configured to carry up to 438 passengers, while their replacements, whether A350-1000s or B787s, will carry about half as many people.

Duffy)於2026年8月27日宣布,美國聯邦航空管理局(FAA)正式啟動BEYOND計畫第二階段,以進一步推動無人機系統整合至美國國家空域系統(NAS)。該計畫授權依據為《2024年FAA授權法案》第920條,旨在深化無人機在超視距(BVLOS)營運及公共安全任務等複雜空域環境中的應用。 FAA預計將選出最多八個額外的州、地方、部落及領地單位作為主導參與者,使計畫規模擴大一倍。根據官方資料,在BEYOND計畫第一階段期間,參與單位累計記錄超過7萬架次飛行,其中包括逾4萬8,000架次超視距作業,為制定標準化監管規範提供關鍵數據。 US DOT and FAA Launch Phase 2 of BEYOND Program to Expand Drone Integration The FAA launches BEYOND Phase 2 to double participant entities and expand drone airspace integration. U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy announced on August 27, 2026, that the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) is launching Phase 2 of the BEYOND program. Authorized under Section 920 of the FAA Reauthorization Act of 2024, the initiative aims to expand the integration of unmanned aircraft systems into the national airspace system and address operational challenges in beyond visual line of sight (BVLOS) operations and public safety missions. Under Phase 2, the FAA plans to double the program's scope by selecting up to eight additional state, local, tribal, and territorial entities as lead participants. During BEYOND Phase 1, participants logged over 70,000 flights, including more than 48,000 BVLOS operations, generating operational data to support regulatory standards. metadata.title: 日本公開川崎EC-2電波干擾機 衍生自C-2運輸機機體

a-20260830-0842-japan-unveils-kawasaki-e.text: 日本公開川崎EC-2電波干擾機 衍生自C-2運輸機機體 日本公開川崎EC-2視外電波干擾機;採用C-2機體與突出鼻錐設計 日本於2026年正式公開川崎EC-2視外電波干擾機(EC-2 standoff jammer)。該型電子作戰機為川崎重工(Kawasaki Aerospace Company)產製C-2軍用運輸機的最新衍生型號,研發改裝計畫於2021年啟動,首架改裝完成的機體於2026年3月公開亮相。 EC-2型機是以機號68-1203的C-2運輸機進行改裝。該機體最初於2016年出廠,為生產線上的第三架C-2運輸機。改裝後的EC-2外觀具備顯著特徵,包括巨大的突出鼻錐罩,以及於機背(含主翼上方機身區段)安裝的兩處大型整流罩與後機身兩側的兩處整流罩,並配置J/ALQ-5電子對抗系統。 在作戰角色方面,EC-2的主要任務是在防空威脅射程之外,針對敵方於電磁頻譜上的行動進行電波干擾與壓制。採用大型運輸機作為改裝平台,能解決戰鬥機在電力供應與散熱管理上的限制。EC-2具備82,900磅的酬載能力,較舊款川崎C-1運輸機的26,200磅酬載有顯著提升。 川崎C-2為雙發動機中型運輸機,配備通用電氣(General Electric)CF6發動機,最初用於取代舊型的川崎C-1。截至2026年,該系列機型累計已交付21架,包含17架C-2標準運輸機、3架RC-2電子情報與信號情報(ELINT/SIGINT)偵察機,以及1架最新完成改裝的EC-2視外電波干擾機。 Japan Unveils Kawasaki EC-2 Standoff Electronic Warfare Aircraft Japan has revealed the Kawasaki EC-2 standoff electronic warfare aircraft based on the C-2 airframe. Japan has officially unveiled the Kawasaki EC-2 standoff jammer electronic warfare aircraft in 2026. The new aircraft represents the latest specialized variant of the Kawasaki C-2 military airlifter produced by Japan's Kawasaki Aerospace Company. Development work on the standoff electronic warfare conversion program initially began in 2021, with the modified airframe first appearing publicly in March 2026. The EC-2 platform is converted from a standard C-2 airframe registered as 68-1203, which was originally produced in 2016 as the third aircraft off the C-2 assembly line. The modified airframe features distinct exterior additions, including a prominent bulged nose cone, two large dorsal flarings with one positioned over the wingbox, and two additional flarings on the sides of the aft fuselage to accommodate electronic warfare equipment such as the J/ALQ-5 system. In operational deployment, the primary mission of the EC-2 is to disrupt adversary operations across the electromagnetic spectrum while operating from standoff ranges outside the reach of enemy air defense systems. Utilizing a cargo aircraft platform provides significant operational advantages over fighter jets, particularly regarding electrical power generation capacity and thermal management requirements necessary for high-powered electronic jamming systems. The aircraft possesses a payload capacity of 82,900 pounds, compared to 26,200 pounds on the older Kawasaki C-1. The baseline Kawasaki C-2 is a mid-sized, twin-engine transport aircraft powered by General Electric CF6 turbofans, designed to replace Japan's aging fleet of Kawasaki C-1 airlifters. As of 2026, a total of 21 C-2 family airframes have been delivered to service. a-20260830-1419-singapore-airlines-outli.text: 新加坡航空空中巴士A380航線公布:涵蓋倫敦與雪梨等10條航線 新加坡航空公布A380航線網絡,以倫敦與雪梨為核心,並涵蓋印度與澳大拉西亞航點。 根據 Simple Flying 報導,新加坡航空(Singapore Airlines)的空中巴士 A380 機隊部署計畫包含 10 條主要航線。在其營運的航線網絡架構中,英國倫敦與澳洲雪梨為支撐新加坡航空空中巴士 A380 服務的核心樞紐航點。 除了倫敦與雪梨兩大核心航點外,新加坡航空的空中巴士 A380 航線網絡其餘航點主要由印度與澳大拉西亞(Australasia)地區的航線組成。根據過往報導紀錄,新加坡航空先前亦曾規劃增加約 25% 的空中巴士 A380 航班運量。 Singapore Airlines Outlines 10 Airbus A380 Routes Anchored by London and Sydney Singapore Airlines operates 10 Airbus A380 routes anchored by London and Sydney, with additional regional flights. a-20260830-1419-airbus-a320-family-final.text: 空中巴士A320客機組裝耗時約三週 目標2027年月產75架 空中巴士A320家族組裝需時約三週;預計2027年達到月產75架目標 根據空中巴士(Airbus)公布的最新營運數據,截至2026年7月,空中巴士A320系列(ICAO機型代碼A320)客機已累計交付12,798架,同時握有20,378架的未交付訂單。針對生產產能規劃,空中巴士在2026年7月單月交付55架A320系列客機,並預計在2027年之前將該單走道客機家族的月產量提升至每月75架。由於目前龐大的訂單積壓,現階段新訂購客機的航空公司在進入實際生產程序前可能需要等待超過三年。 在最終組裝網絡方面,空中巴士在全球設有數個A320系列最終組裝線(FAL)。其中,位於法國土魯斯(Toulouse)的基地擁有兩條單走道客機最終組裝線;位於德國漢堡芬肯維德(Finkenwerder, Hamburg)的基地則設有四條單走道最終組裝線,負責生產包含A321neo與A319neo等機型。此外,空中巴士也在中國天津設有主要服務亞洲航空公司的最終組裝線,以及在美國阿拉巴馬州莫比爾(Mobile, Alabama)設有主要供應北美客戶的最終組裝線。 在主要零組件的跨國分工上,A320系列的大型機身結構分由歐洲四國製造。法國負責製造前機身、駕駛艙與中央翼盒;德國製造中後機身、垂直尾翼、襟翼與貨艙門;英國負責製造機翼;西班牙則生產水平尾翼與翼身整流罩。為了在歐洲各廠區之間運輸這些大型結構組件,空中巴士採用其特有的BelugaXL超級運輸機進行運送,而舊款的BelugaST運輸機已於2026年初正式退役。 當各大主要組件運抵最終組裝線後,一架典型的A320系列客機大約需要三週時間完成最終組裝與測試。在組裝初期,工程團隊會利用精密夾具、自動化鑽孔及鉚接技術將機身段、中央翼盒與機翼相互拼接。隨後,技術團隊會陸續安裝電力、液壓、氣動、航空電子、燃料及空調等主要系統,同時進行機艙內部的隔熱層、行李架、座椅、廚房與洗手間安裝,最後在交付前完成電力測試與各項系統檢查。 Airbus A320 Family Final Assembly Takes Three Weeks as Target Reaches 75 Monthly Airbus outlines A320 family assembly timeline of three weeks targeting 75 monthly deliveries by 2027. According to operational data published by Airbus, the manufacturer had delivered 12,798 Airbus A320 family (ICAO type code A320) aircraft by July 2026, while maintaining an order backlog of 20,378 aircraft. To meet market demand, Airbus delivered 55 A320 family aircraft in July 2026 alone and is aiming to expand its single-aisle production rate to 75 aircraft per month by 2027. Due to the significant accumulation of existing orders, airlines placing new orders today face potential wait times of over three years before aircraft enter actual production. Final assembly of the A320 family is distributed across multiple international manufacturing sites. Airbus operates two single-aisle final assembly lines in Toulouse, France, and four single-aisle final assembly lines at Finkenwerder in Hamburg, Germany, which assemble variants including the A321neo and A319neo. Additional assembly lines are located in Tianjin, China, primarily supporting Asian carriers, and in Mobile, Alabama, serving North American customers while also producing the A220. Major structural components for the A320 family are manufactured across four European nations. France produces the forward fuselage, cockpit, and centre wing box, while Germany manufactures the centre and rear fuselage, vertical tail, flaps, and cargo doors. The wings are produced in the United Kingdom, and Spain manufactures the horizontal tail and wing-to-body fairings. Airbus utilizes its BelugaXL fleet to transport these large components across Europe, following the retirement of the older BelugaST transport aircraft in early 2026. Once major sections arrive at a final assembly facility, a standard A320 family aircraft requires approximately three weeks to move through final assembly and testing. Initial structural integration joins the fuselage sections, centre wing box, and wings using precision jigs and automated drilling. Over the subsequent stages, technicians install core electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, avionics, fuel, and environmental control systems, alongside interior cabin fittings such as seats, overhead bins, galleys, and lavatories, prior to final power-up testing and pre-delivery checks. a-20260830-2144-study-links-aircraft-cab.text: 研究發現客艙空氣化學物質具內分泌擾亂活性 新研究顯示42種有機磷化合物中88%擾亂荷爾蒙受體;航空引擎油中的三苯基磷酸鹽效應最強。 根據Aerospace Global News報導,一項經同儕評審的研究檢測了42種有機磷化合物及商業混合物,發現其中88%的化合物在低於造成一般細胞毒性的濃度下,即可干擾雌激素或雄激素受體活性。 研究指出, aryl 和 triaryl 磷酸鹽(包括航空渦輪引擎油中的防磨添加劑)展現出最強的內分泌擾亂效應,所有測試的 triaryl 磷酸鹽群組均具有內分泌活性,其中三分之一在低於1 mg/L濃度下即顯現效應。 雖然研究未證實飛艙氣味事件直接導致不孕或其他健康問題,但作者指出這些化學物質先前已在客艙空氣中被檢測出,現在顯示出與生殖危害相關的生物活性。 Study links aircraft cabin air chemicals to endocrine disruption New study shows 88% of 42 organophosphate compounds disrupt hormone receptors; aryl and triaryl phosphates from turbine oil strongest. Aerospace Global News reports that a peer‐reviewed study assessed 42 organophosphate compounds and commercial mixtures, finding that 88% disrupted estrogen or androgen receptor activity at concentrations below those causing general cell toxicity. The aryl and triaryl phosphate group, which includes anti‐wear additives used in aircraft turbine oils, produced some of the strongest effects; all triaryl phosphates tested showed endocrine activity, with one‐third active below 1 mg/L. While the study does not prove that fume events cause infertility or reproductive illness, it notes that these chemicals have previously been detected in cabin air and now exhibit biological activity linked to reproductive harm. a-20260831-0003-united-airlines-plans-11.text: 聯合航空規劃自西岸樞紐營運11條夏季直飛亞洲航線 聯合航空規劃夏季自美西樞紐營運11條直飛亞洲航線;搭配僅限冬季服務。 根據相關服務規劃,聯合航空預計於下個夏季航季期間,從該公司位於美西的航網樞紐營運11條直飛亞洲的定期航線。這項排程規劃將提供美西樞紐連接亞洲地區的直飛班機服務。 除了下個夏季所要執行的11條亞洲直飛航線外,聯合航空亦將配置僅限冬季營運的季節性航線班次。這代表該航空公司在規劃夏季航線網絡的同時,亦搭配冬季限定的季節服務。 這項航線佈局顯示聯合航空對亞洲市場的運能安排,涵蓋了下個夏季從美西樞紐出發的11條直航路線,以及在冬期間運作的季節性航班服務。 United Airlines Plans 11 Nonstop Summer Asia Routes From West Coast Hub United Airlines plans 11 nonstop summer Asia routes from its West Coast hub alongside winter seasonal flights. United Airlines is planning to operate 11 nonstop summer routes to Asia from its primary West Coast hub. Under the announced schedule, the carrier will provide direct flights connecting its West Coast operational base with key destinations in Asia during the upcoming summer travel season. Alongside the 11 nonstop Asia routes scheduled for next summer, the carrier will also run a winter-only seasonal service. The planned network strategy incorporates both the expanded summer transpacific flight schedule and dedicated seasonal flights reserved specifically for the winter period. The transpacific route lineup establishes United Airlines' scheduled flight offerings between the U.S. West Coast and Asian markets across both next summer's core schedule and the winter seasonal operations. a-20260831-0003-bangladesh-reportedly-cl.text: 孟加拉據報擬購20至24架中國J-10CE戰機 孟加拉據報接近訂購20至24架中國J-10CE戰機;Eurofighter採購仍未定。 據《Aerospace Global News》報導,孟加拉據報接近訂購約20至24架中國成飛J-10CE(ICAO機型代碼J-10CE)戰鬥機。 報導引述孟加拉《每日星報》消息,指孟加拉總理顧問Zahed Ur Rahman表示「若本財政年度有預算支援,採購將繼續;否則將延至下一個預算」。 報導提到,孟加拉是否繼續Eurofighter採購仍未明朗,並分析J-10CE具單引擎、成本較低的優勢,且可沿用既有中國製戰機操作經驗。 亦有報導指出,J-10C飛離成本約6250萬美元,但加計附加項目與援助後可能升至1.15億美元。 目前孟加拉與中國均未確認需求為20或24架戰機,採購案仍屬計畫階段。 Bangladesh reportedly close to ordering 20-24 Chinese J-10CE fighter jets Bangladesh reportedly close to ordering 20-24 Chinese J-10CE fighters; Eurofighter purchase still uncertain. Bangladesh is reportedly close to ordering around 20-24 Chinese Chengdu J-10CE fighter jets, according to Aerospace Global News. Citing a report by Bangladesh's The Daily Star, Prime Minister's Adviser Zahed Ur Rahman was quoted as saying that if budget support is available this fiscal year, the purchase will go ahead; otherwise, it will be deferred to the next budget. It remains unclear whether Dhaka will also proceed with a Eurofighter purchase. The J-10CE is considered cheaper (perhaps half the cost) than the Eurofighter, and would build on Bangladesh's existing Chinese-made fighter fleet. Neither Dhaka nor Beijing has confirmed whether the current requirement is for 20 or 24 fighters. a-20260831-0504-legislature-passes-uav-a.text: 立法院三讀無人機條例 6年編2400億 立法院三讀無人機條例;六年編2400億預算;行政院擬副署追加預算 中央社報導,立法院於8月27日三讀通過《強化國防自主暨無人載具產業發展條例》,明定中央政府須連續六年編列總額2400億元預算。 條例訂定主管機關為經濟部,涉及國防軍用採購則由國防部主管;行政院預計9月3日院會副署並編入今年度追加預算,另將提明年度總預算修正案納入無人載具預算。 國民黨團總召傅崐萁指出,台灣具備完整科技製造產業鏈,若政策資源到位,無人載具產業有機會成為全球最大生產基地,創造大量就業與商機。 Legislature passes UAV act, earmarks NT$240 billion over six years Legislature passes UAV law; six‐year NT$240 bn budget planned, administration to countersign The Legislative Yuan approved the “Strengthening National Defense Autonomy and Unmanned Vehicle Industry Development Act” on 27 August, mandating a six‐year budget totalling NT$240 billion. The Ministry of Economic Affairs is the competent authority, while defence‐related procurement falls under the Ministry of National Defense; the Executive Yuan intends to countersign the act on 3 September and include funds in this year’s supplementary budget, with an amendment to next year’s budget. KMT caucus leader Fu Kun‐chi said Taiwan’s complete high‐tech supply chain gives it a chance to become the world’s largest drone production base, generating thousands of jobs and billions of dollars in business. 立法院於2026年8月27日三讀通過《強化國防自主暨無人載具產業發展條例》 立法院會27日三讀「強化國防自主暨無人載具產業發展條例」 條例規定中央政府須連續六年編列總額2400億元預算 明定中央政府應循年度預算程序,連續6年,編列總額2400億元 主管機關為經濟部,涉及國防軍用採購則由國防部主管 主管機關為經濟部,若涉國防軍用採購事項,主管機關為國防部 行政院擬於9月3日院會副署條例並編入今年度追加預算,另將提明年度總預算修正案納入無人載具預算 媒體報導,行政院擬副署該條例,編入今年度追加預算,預計9月3日行政院會通過。另提明年度總預算案修正案,納入無人載具預算 傅崐萁表示台灣具備科技製造基礎,若政策資源到位,無人載具產業有急起直追機會,可成為全球最大無人機生產基地 台灣具有科技及製造產業基礎,如果政策及資源能夠到位,無人載具產業仍有急起直追的機會

metadata.title: 土耳其航太 Hürjet 量產機完成首飛

a-20260831-0504-turkish-aerospace-hurjet.text: 土耳其航太 Hürjet 量產機完成首飛 Hürjet量產機首飛;飛行18分鐘 土耳其航太(Turkish Aerospace)開發的Hürjet高級噴射教練機,其首架為土耳其空軍生產的量產型已於2026年8月30日完成首飛。 根據AeroTime報導,此架量產型Hürjet在空中的飛行時間為18分鐘。此次飛行是在完成最終組裝、地面測試和滑行測試之後進行。 Hürjet為單引擎、雙座超音速飛機,主要用於高級與導入戰鬥機訓練。航程為1,060海浬,最大速度達1.4馬赫,實用升限為45,000英尺。 此架量產型飛機在交付土耳其空軍前,將持續進行後續的飛行測試與驗證。 Turkish Aerospace Hürjet production aircraft completes maiden flight First production Hürjet for Turkish Air Force completes 18-minute first flight on August 30. The first production Hürjet advanced jet trainer built for the Turkish Air Force completed its maiden flight on August 30, 2026, according to AeroTime. The aircraft remained airborne for 18 minutes. The flight followed final assembly, ground testing, and taxi tests. Hürjet is a single-engine, tandem-seat supersonic aircraft designed primarily for advanced and lead-in fighter training. It has a maximum speed of Mach 1.4 and a service ceiling of 45,000 feet. The first production aircraft will now undergo further flight testing and verification before delivery to the Turkish Air Force. 為土耳其航空軍生產的首架Hürjet量產機於2026年8月30日完成首飛。 The first production Hürjet advanced jet trainer built for the Turkish Air Force has completed its maiden flight Hürjet在2026年8月30日飛行期間滯空18分鐘。 remained airborne for 18 minutes on August 30, 2026 此次飛行為飛機在最終組裝、地面測試和滑行測試完成後進行。 The flight followed the completion of final assembly, ground testing and taxi tests. metadata.title: 以色列引進KC-46A加油機將取代老舊波音707

a-20260831-0626-israel-to-replace-aging-.text: 以色列引進KC-46A加油機將取代老舊波音707 以色列引進全新KC-46A加油機以取代現役老舊波音707 根據航空媒體 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 8 月 31 日的報導,以色列的波音 707 空中加油機時代已接近尾聲。以色列全新的 KC-46A 「基甸」(Gideon)空中加油機將取代老化的 Re'ems 加油機。據報導,這款新型替代機型可多搭載大約 15% 的燃油,為其遠程空中戰力奠定現代化基礎。 在此之前,該地區近期亦有關於波音加油機的其他進展。美國國務院於 2026 年 8 月 20 日批准了一項對卡達的潛在軍售案,計畫出售最多四架波音 KC-46A 「飛馬」(Pegasus)空中加油機及相關設備,預估最高價值達 45 億美元。該筆卡達軍售案在達成最終協議前仍需經過美國國會審查,旨在提升卡達的空中加油能力。 Israel to Replace Aging Boeing 707 Tankers With New KC-46A Gideon Aircraft Israel's Boeing 707 tanker era nears end with replacement by new KC-46A Gideon aircraft. According to aviation news outlet Simple Flying on August 31, 2026, Israel's Boeing 707 refueling tanker era is nearing its end. Israel's aging Re'ems tankers are planned to be replaced by the new KC-46A Gideon tankers, which reportedly haul approximately 15% more fuel and provide a modern foundation for its long-range airpower. This transition follows other recent regional developments involving the Boeing tanker. On August 20, 2026, the US State Department approved a potential Foreign Military Sale to Qatar of up to four Boeing KC-46A Pegasus refueling aircraft and related equipment, estimated at up to $4.5 billion. The proposed sale, which requires US congressional review before a final agreement can be reached, aims to improve Qatar's aerial refueling capability. metadata.title: 台灣海軍編列預算籌購32架銳鳶二與280架V-BAT無人機

a-20260831-0854-taiwan-navy-budgets-for-.text: 台灣海軍編列預算籌購32架銳鳶二與280架V-BAT無人機 台灣海軍編預算籌購32架銳鳶二與280架V-BAT無人機;提升遠海偵蒐 國防部於2026年8月31日上午將116年度國防預算書送抵立法院。根據預算書內容,中華民國海軍將籌購32架國造銳鳶二型無人機,以及280架外購的艦載V-BAT垂直起降無人機。這兩項無人機籌購案於去年原編列於機密預算中,今年度則轉列為公開預算,旨在充實海軍戰場監偵與監控能量。 在國造銳鳶二型無人機(第二代海搜戰術型無人機監偵系統)方面,海軍編列115年至118年(2026年至2029年)的持續預算共計新台幣167億8974萬元,預計籌購32架無人機、8套導控站及48輛運輸載具。該型無人機由國家中山科學研究院研製,採用多功掛載構型,可依任務需求攜帶浮標莢艙或勁蜂一型攻擊無人機,具有16小時的滯空時間與超過300公里的導控距離。 在大宗外購無人機方面,海軍規劃於115年至118年編列360億元持續預算,採購280架艦載智慧垂直起降型V-BAT無人機、140套導控系統及82輛運輸載具。V-BAT無人機由美國國防科技廠商Shield AI研發生產,採用單發動機導管風扇設計,具備在艦載甲板與狹窄空間垂直起降並切換至水平巡航的能力,且能抗GPS與電磁干擾,在複雜電磁環境下執行獨立偵察與目標標定任務。 海軍說明指出,引進這兩款無人機旨在提升遠海戰場透明度、強化海域覺知與擊殺鏈時效,防止作戰初期指管系統遭癱瘓。此外,海軍亦新編約237億元預算,規劃於116年至122年建造12艘水下無人載具,以強化水下偵察與獵雷作業效能,全案已於今年8月7日獲核定並於明年度辦理先期規劃設計。 Taiwan Navy Budgets for 32 Albatross II and 280 V-BAT Drones Taiwan Navy plans to acquire 32 Albatross II and 280 V-BAT drones under multi-year budget proposals. The Republic of China Navy has allocated funding to procure 32 indigenous Albatross II unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and 280 foreign-sourced V-BAT vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) UAVs, according to defense budget documentation submitted to the Legislative Yuan on August 31, 2026. The procurement programs, previously classified under confidential budget items in the prior fiscal year, have now been declassified in the public defense budget. For the Albatross II program, designated as the second-generation maritime tactical UAV surveillance system, the Navy has budgeted NT$16.789 billion (approximately US$525 million) spanning fiscal years 2026 through 2029. The procurement package covers 32 UAV airframes, 8 ground control stations, and 48 transport vehicles. Developed by the National Chung-Shan Institute of Science and Technology (NCSIST), the Albatross II features a multi-payload capacity capable of deploying sonar buoys or Chien Hsiang attack drones, boasting an endurance of 16 hours and a control range exceeding 300 kilometers. Simultaneously, the Navy has budgeted NT$36 billion over the same four-year period from fiscal 2026 to 2029 to acquire 280 shipborne V-BAT VTOL UAVs, 140 control systems, and 82 transport vehicles. Designed and manufactured by U.S. defense technology firm Shield AI, the V-BAT employs a single-engine ducted-fan configuration allowing vertical takeoff and landing on ship decks or confined spaces before transitioning to horizontal cruise. It is engineered to operate autonomously in environments where GPS or communications signals are heavily jammed. The Navy stated that acquiring these tactical unmanned aerial assets will enhance deep-sea battlefield transparency, improve maritime search and target identification, and reinforce command-and-control resilience during initial operational phases. In addition to the aerial systems, the Navy has separately budgeted approximately NT$23.7 billion between fiscal 2027 and 2033 to construct 12 underwater unmanned vehicles, with preliminary design work scheduled to begin next year. 海軍編列115年至118年預算約167.89億元籌購32架國造銳鳶二型無人機、8套導控站及48輛運輸載具。 海軍編列115年至118年、167億8974萬元持續預算籌購32架、8套導控站、48輛運輸載具。 海軍同期間編列360億元預算,籌購280架艦載智慧垂直起降型V-BAT無人機、140套導控系統與82輛運輸載具。 海軍也編列115年至118年、360億元持續預算,籌購280架艦載智慧垂直起降型無人機(V-BAT無人機)、140套導控系統、82輛運輸載具。 銳鳶二型無人機滯空時間達16小時,導控距離超過300公里。 銳鳶二型無人機滯空時間達16小時、導控距離超過300公里。 V-BAT由美國Shield AI研發生產,採單發動機導管風扇設計,能在狹窄空間或艦載甲板垂直起降。 V-BAT是由美國國防科技新創公司Shield AI所研發與生產的產品,採單發動機導管風扇設計,使其能像直升機一樣在狹窄空間或艦載甲板上垂直起降 116年度國防預算書於8月31日上午送抵立法院,銳鳶二型與V-BAT無人機採購案由機密預算轉列公開預算。 116年度國防預算書上午送抵立法院,去年列在機密預算的第二代海搜戰術型無人機監偵系統(銳鳶二型無人機)今年則轉公開 海軍另新編約237億元預算建造12艘水下無人載具,全案於8月7日核定,編列於116年至122年預算。 海軍也新編約237億元,建造12艘水下無人載具,提升偵察獵雷作業效能,全案於今年8月7日核定,納116年到122年預算

metadata.title: 奧地利AXIS進軍直升機模擬器市場 首批支援空中巴士與李奧納多平台

a-20260831-0854-axis-flight-simulation-e.text: 奧地利AXIS進軍直升機模擬器市場 首批支援空中巴士與李奧納多平台 奧地利AXIS進軍直升機模擬器市場;預計20個月內推出首台訓練設備。 奧地利模擬器製造商AXIS Flight Simulation宣布進軍直升機模擬器市場,規劃推出兩款新型訓練設備,包括高真度AX-DH模擬器與固定式飛行訓練設備(FTD),以滿足民用與專業旋翼機營運商日益增長的訓練需求。 該公司表示,兩款設備將採用通用基礎架構與可互換式駕駛艙,首波規劃支援空中巴士直升機(Airbus Helicopters)與李奧納多(Leonardo)機型平台。AXIS預計首台直升機訓練設備將在大約20個月內問世。 AXIS執行董事會成員克里斯蒂安·托爾曼(Christian Theuermann)指出,此次業務擴展主要源於客戶的主動需求。新設備將支援緊急醫療服務、搜救、離岸作業及夜視鏡飛行等任務的個人與多機組訓練。 AXIS Flight Simulation Enters Helicopter Market with Airbus and Leonardo Types AXIS Flight Simulation enters helicopter training market with new devices; first availability targeted within 20 months. Austrian manufacturer AXIS Flight Simulation is entering the rotary-wing market with two new training devices, responding to demand from civil and specialist helicopter operators. The company is developing the high-fidelity AX-DH simulator alongside a fixed-base Flight Training Device designed for regulatory approval. Both devices will feature interchangeable cockpits built on a common architecture. AXIS plans to offer Airbus Helicopters and Leonardo platforms first, expecting its initial helicopter simulator or training device to become available within approximately 20 months. Christian Theuermann, an executive board member at AXIS, stated that the expansion was driven by customers seeking rotary-wing simulation products. The new devices are intended to support single and multi-crew training for missions such as emergency medical services, search and rescue, offshore operations, and night-vision flight. a-20260831-0854-saab-completes-first-fli.text: 薩博雙座Gripen F戰機完成首飛 展開巴西空軍測飛計畫 薩博雙座Gripen F於瑞典首飛;展開巴西空軍飛試與系統評估 瑞典國防製造商薩博(Saab)於瑞典林雪平(Linköping)機場完成雙座戰鬥機Gripen F的首飛,該機在當地時間上午09:40起飛,飛行時間共計40分鐘。此次首飛標誌著這款最新世代雙座戰機正式進入空中測試階段,後續將準備交付予啟動客戶巴西空軍(Brazilian Air Force)。 首飛試飛任務由薩博首席試飛員雅各布·霍格伯格(Jakob Högberg)與巴西空軍試飛員阿布敦·德·雷森德·瓦斯康塞洛斯空軍中校(Lieutenant Colonel Aviator Abdon de Rezende Vasconcelos)共同執行。飛行過程驗證了機載核心系統的運作,並對戰機的飛行性能進行了初步評估。 Gripen F是以單座型Gripen E戰機為基礎開發的雙座構型,額外提供第二名機組人員的乘坐空間。該機型的主要作用在於加速飛行員的轉換訓練,且同時具備執行先進作戰任務的能力。在複雜的作戰任務中,雙人機組人員的分工合作有助於提升整體操作效率。 隨著首飛完成,Gripen F進入飛行測試階段,測試計畫將由薩博位於瑞典的飛行測試中心負責執行。測試項目包含生產接收飛行,並逐步擴展戰機的速度、高度、G值過載與攻角等飛行包線,同時評估戰機的戰術能力與後座專屬功能。 巴西作為Gripen F計畫的啟動客戶,深度參與了該戰機的開發過程。這項合作源於巴西與瑞典之間的戰略夥伴關係及技術轉移計畫,超過350名巴西工程師、技術人員與飛行員參與了相關的開發、生產、飛試與維修培訓。薩博目前尚未提供首架戰機的確切交付日期。 Saab Completes First Flight of Two-Seat Gripen F Fighter for Brazil Saab completes maiden flight of Gripen F in Sweden; begins flight tests for Brazilian Air Force. More than 350 Brazilian engineers, technicians, and pilots have completed training in development, production, flight testing, and maintenance. metadata.title: 捷克Zuri發表油電混合垂直起降無人貨機原型機

a-20260831-0854-czech-firm-zuri-unveils-.text: 捷克Zuri發表油電混合垂直起降無人貨機原型機 捷克Zuri發表油電混合無人貨機原型機,預計2027年初進行首飛測試。 捷克航空企業Zuri於2026年8月27日正式發表新款無人油電混合垂直起降(VTOL)傾轉旋翼貨機驗證機。該型航空器基於先前的「技術驗證機2.0」(Technology Demonstrator 2.0)架構開發,定位為同時具備民用與國防雙重用途的雙用平台,旨在為該公司提供更快速的商業收益轉化途徑。 根據Zuri公佈的技術參數,該機最大有效載重為165公斤,巡航速度達到每小時220公里。在載重超過100公斤的情況下,不保留餘油航程可達679公里以上;若保留30分鐘備用油量,航程則為569公里。該型無人機具備良好的場地適應能力,可在船艦甲板、開闊地面或直升機起降場進行起降作業,主要目標市場包括北海油氣平台、離島及波羅的海區域的貨物運補。 動力系統方面,該機採用內燃機帶動發電機產生飛行所需電能,可使用航空汽油(AVGAS)、一般汽油或生物乙醇燃料,並搭配電池組作為備用電力系統。全機配備8組分散式推進旋翼,當單一旋翼發生故障時仍可保持操控,發電機若失效亦能由電池供電降落。此外,Zuri強調該產品符合無國際武器貿易條例(ITAR-free)規範,並採用歐洲本土供應鏈打造。 目前該型驗證機已在布拉格進行系統整合與地面測試,計畫於2027年初開展首飛測試,並預計在2027年至2029年間交付首批商業客戶。Zuri創辦人兼執行長Michal Illich表示,該機飛行過程仍由地面操作員遠端遙控,目前本階段資金將用於支持全尺寸驗證機及其完整飛行測試計畫。 Czech firm Zuri unveils hybrid-electric cargo VTOL tiltrotor drone demonstrator Czech company Zuri unveiled a hybrid-electric cargo VTOL drone demonstrator, with flight tests planned for early 2027. Czech aerospace startup Zuri unveiled its new uncrewed hybrid-electric cargo VTOL tiltrotor demonstrator on August 27, 2026. Built upon the company's earlier Technology Demonstrator 2.0 architecture, the aircraft is designed for both civil and defense operations. Zuri stated that developing this uncrewed cargo platform serves as a faster path to generating revenue as part of its longer-term vision to build a six-seater passenger aircraft. According to Zuri, the tiltrotor aircraft features a useful load of 165 kg and operates at a cruising speed of 220 km/h. When carrying a payload of over 100 kg, it achieves a flight range exceeding 679 km without fuel reserves, or 569 km with a 30-minute reserve allowance. The drone is engineered to operate from various locations, including ship decks, open ground, and landing pads, with target applications in offshore oil platform supply, island logistics, and regional cargo transport. The aircraft's hybrid propulsion system utilizes an internal combustion engine driving a generator to produce in-flight electricity, capable of running on AVGAS, petrol, or bioethanol, complemented by a backup battery system. Featuring eight distributed rotors, the design maintains flight control in the event of a single rotor failure, while the battery permits a safe landing if the generator fails. Zuri highlighted that the platform is ITAR-free and manufactured using a sovereign European supply chain. The full-scale demonstrator is currently undergoing systems integration and ground testing in Prague. Flight tests are scheduled to begin in early 2027, with initial commercial deliveries expected between 2027 and 2029. Zuri founder and CEO Michal Illich noted that the aircraft will be remotely piloted by a ground operator, and the current funding round supports the completion of the demonstrator and its flight test campaign. a-20260831-0854-air-new-zealand-posts-19.text: 紐西蘭航空年度稅前虧損3.36億紐元 燃油與引擎問題侵蝕獲利 紐西蘭航空公布年度稅前虧損3.36億紐元;燃油價格上漲與引擎故障大幅侵蝕獲利。 紐西蘭航空(Air New Zealand)公布截至6月30日止的財政年度業績,錄得稅前虧損3.36億紐元(約合1.999億美元),與上一年度錄得稅前利潤1.64億紐元(約合9760萬美元)相比出現轉折。航空公司的稅後淨虧損為2.42億紐元(約合1.44億美元),上一年度經重述的稅後淨利潤則為1.08億紐元(約合6430萬美元)。 儘管年度業績整體呈虧損狀態,紐西蘭航空的營收仍有所成長。總收入增加至約70億紐元(約合41.7億美元),其中客運收入增至61億紐元(約合36.3億美元)。然而,營運成本增加的速度明顯超越獲利能力,主因受到燃料價格飆升、飛機引擎可用性限制以及維修費用上漲等多重因素影響。 地緣政治衝突推升全球能源價格,成為航空公司重大意外支出。紐西蘭航空預估中東地區衝突使其下半年的燃料成本較原先預期增加3.28億紐元。在計入燃料對衝營運後,額外成本約為2.05億紐元(約合1.22億美元)。紐西蘭航空雖然透過調整機票價格及減少運力進行因應,但燃料價格上漲仍使其稅前業績減少約1.35億紐元(約合8030萬美元)。 機隊可用性問題亦嚴重衝擊財務表現。紐西蘭航空指出,旗下窄體空中巴士(Airbus)A321neo機隊採用的普惠(Pratt & Whitney)GTF引擎,以及長程波音(Boeing)787機隊採用的勞斯萊斯(Rolls-Royce)Trent 1000引擎均面臨可靠性問題。公司估計引擎可用性問題在最新財政年度造成約1.90億紐元的損失,影響包含運力損失、租賃費用、飛機利用率降低及營運效率下降。此外,不含匯率影響的維修成本較2025年增加了約1.39億紐元(約合8270萬美元)。 Air New Zealand Posts $199.9M Pre-Tax Loss Driven by Fuel and Engine Costs Air New Zealand reports NZ$336 million annual pre-tax loss; surging fuel prices and engine issues hit earnings. Air New Zealand has reported a pre-tax loss of NZ$336 million ($199.9 million) for the financial year ended June 30, reversing a pre-tax profit of NZ$164 million ($97.6 million) recorded in the previous year. a-20260831-1437-raf-a400m-transport-land.text: 英軍A400M運輸機降落北極島嶼運送美英陸戰隊 英國空軍A400M運輸機運送美英陸戰隊與戰術車降落挪威揚馬延島。 英國皇家空軍(RAF)一架空中巴士A400M運輸機於2026年8月29日降落於挪威北極偏遠島嶼揚馬延島,運送美軍與英軍皇家海軍陸戰隊隊員,以及兩輛聯合輕型戰術車(JLTV)。此次任務由來自布萊茲諾頓皇家空軍基地的第LXX中隊執行,屬於「大西洋城26」行動(Operation Atlantic City 26)的一部分。 該行動自2026年8月26日持續至9月4日,是在北約「北極哨兵」加強警戒活動下,由挪威主導、美英三國共同參與的聯合活動。揚馬延島距離挪威本土約1000公里,並無港口而僅有近海錨地。島上唯一的未鋪設砂礫跑道揚馬延斯菲爾德(ENJA)是將重型裝備與車輛直接運送登島的唯一可行途徑。 RAF A400M Transport Lands US and UK Marines on Remote Arctic Island RAF transport aircraft delivers multinational marines and tactical vehicles to Jan Mayen island. A Royal Air Force Airbus A400M Atlas transport aircraft landed on the remote Norwegian Arctic island of Jan Mayen on August 29, 2026. The aircraft delivered US Marines, UK Royal Marines, and two Joint Light Tactical Vehicles (JLTVs) to the island, which is located north of the Greenland-Iceland-UK (GIUK) gap. The deployment was conducted by LXX Squadron from RAF Brize Norton (RAF) as part of Operation Atlantic City 26. Operating from August 26 to September 4, 2026, the operation is a Norwegian-led trilateral activity with the United Kingdom and the United States under NATO's enhanced vigilance activity, Arctic Sentry. Because Jan Mayen has no port and only offshore anchorages, the single unpaved gravel runway at Jan Mayensfield (ENJA) serves as the only practical route for delivering heavy vehicles and equipment directly to the island. a-20260901-0013-easa-lowers-jordan-airsp.text: 歐洲飛安總署調降約旦領空警告風險 約旦、黎巴嫩航警降級;貝魯特機場有條件恢復 歐洲聯盟航空安全總署(European Union Aviation Safety Agency,EASA)於2026年8月31日調降對約旦及黎巴嫩的空域警告,同日約旦軍方表示,在黎明時分攔截了八枚飛進王國空域的飛彈。EASA修訂針對約旦的衝突區域資訊公報(Conflict Zone Information Bulletin,CZIB),取消建議營運業者全面避免進入安曼飛航情報區(FIR)的建議,並將涉入風險評估為中等而非高風險。 修訂後的公報要求營運業者考量潛在風險、維持最新的風險評估與應變計畫,並準備好在短期通知後遵循國家當局的指示。EASA將此變更歸因於2026年8月空域相對安靜,並指出約旦當局未發布與衝突相關的空域限制或航路關閉,營運業者應準備在活動恢復時進行戰術隔離。 同日,約旦武裝部隊官方發言人在國家新聞社Petra的聲明表示,防空系統攔截了於2026年8月31日黎明時侵入王國空域的八枚飛彈,並稱飛彈在被摧毀前未對公民或財產構成威脅。 EASA也修訂了黎巴嫩的公報,恢復貝魯特哈里里國際機場(BEY)的限制,允許在到達與離場均位於海上時進出貝魯特,且需有最新的風險評估與持續監控。黎巴嫩領空除該例外區域外,仍被評估為高風險,EASA指出2026年8月在黎巴嫩南部觀察到一再的停火遊約遭破壞。 另據國家新聞社WAM報導,阿拉伯聯合大公國國防部於2026年8月31日表示,其空軍攔截了一架在領海上空接近的大量無人機,並稱其來自伊朗。EASA曾在2026年7月14日建議航空業者避開巴林、科威特、卡達及阿拉伯聯合大公國的海灣空域。 兩份修訂後的公報效力至2026年9月30日,除非提早審查。CZIB屬建議性質,適用於受歐盟規則965/2012管制的營運商及擁有EASA授權的第三國營運商,而各國政府仍對其領空擁有控制權。 EASA lowers Jordan airspace warning; eight missiles intercepted in a single day EASA eased Jordan, Lebanon warnings; Beirut access restored with conditions; missiles intercepted The European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) downgraded its airspace warnings for Jordan and Lebanon on August 31, 2026, the same day Jordan’s military said it intercepted eight missiles over the kingdom at dawn. The agency revised its Conflict Zone Information Bulletin (CZIB) for Jordan, dropping the recommendation that operators avoid the Amman flight information region (FIR) altogether. The revised bulletin asks operators to take potential risks into account, maintain updated risk assessments and contingency plans, and remain prepared to follow instructions from state authorities at short notice. EASA assessed the risk to civil flights as medium rather than high and extended the bulletin’s validity to September 30, 2026. EASA also restored a limited exception for Beirut Rafic Hariri International Airport (BEY), allowing flights to and from Beirut when the approach and departure are over the hot seat, subject to continuous risk monitoring. Lebanese airspace remains high risk outside that carve-out, with recurrent ceasefire violations observed in August 2026, primarily in southern Lebanon.
