a-20260901-0553-taiwan-caa-increases-fue.text: 國籍航空國際航線燃油附加費9月7日調漲 短程1028元長程2670元 民航局宣布9月7日起調漲國籍航空國際線燃油附加費;短程1028元長程2670元 交通部民用航空局於9月1日宣布,由於國際航空燃油價格近期上漲,國籍航空公司國際航線客運燃油附加費將自9月7日起實施調漲。 根據民航局規範,短程航線燃油附加費將從原先的30美元(約新台幣949元)調漲至32.5美元(約新台幣1028元);長程航線燃油附加費則由原先的78美元(約新台幣2467元)調漲至84.5美元(約新台幣2670元)。短程航線範圍為亞洲(不含印度與中東),長程航線範圍為歐洲、美洲、非洲、大洋洲、南極洲、印度與中東。 本次燃油附加費調漲係依據台灣中油公司公告之國際航空燃油價格。中油公告牌價由每桶147.57美元(約新台幣4668元)調漲至每桶156.79美元(約新台幣4960元),帶動附加費依機制向上調整。 民航局於2005年與國籍航空公司協調建立客運燃油附加費調整機制,以中油公司公告之國際航空燃油每桶牌價為收取基準。當油價未達每桶40美元(約新台幣1265元)時為不收費級距;達40美元至未滿50美元(約新台幣1581元)為起徵第2級距,短程線每人收取5美元(約新台幣158元),長程線每人收取13美元(約新台幣411元)。油價每增加10美元(約新台幣316元),短程線增加2.5美元(約新台幣79元),長程線增加6.5美元(約新台幣206元)。 民航局表示,已要求各航空公司應以適當方式揭露相關背景資訊,例如燃油成本占總成本比例或計算方式等,以化解消費者疑慮。旅客亦可洽各航空公司或至其官網查詢相關調整資訊。 Taiwan CAA Increases Fuel Surcharges for International Flights from Sept 7 Taiwan CAA announced international passenger fuel surcharges for domestic carriers will increase starting September 7. Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) announced on September 1 that international passenger fuel surcharges for domestic airlines will be increased starting September 7, driven by recent increases in international aviation fuel prices. According to the CAA, short-haul fuel surcharges will increase from $30 USD (approximately NT$949) to $32.50 USD (approximately NT$1,028) per passenger. Long-haul fuel surcharges will rise from $78 USD (approximately NT$2,467) to $84.50 USD (approximately NT$2,670) per passenger. Short-haul routes cover Asia excluding India and the Middle East, while long-haul routes encompass Europe, the Americas, Africa, Oceania, Antarctica, India, and the Middle East. The surcharge rate adjustment is based on the latest international aviation fuel prices announced by CPC Corporation. The listed price for international jet fuel increased from $147.57 USD (approximately NT$4,668) per barrel to $156.79 USD (approximately NT$4,960) per barrel, triggering the automatic bracket step-up under the mechanism. The CAA established the passenger fuel surcharge adjustment mechanism in 2005 through coordination with domestic airlines, using CPC Corporation's announced international aviation fuel list price as the baseline standard. Under the agreement, no surcharge is collected when fuel prices remain below $40 USD (approximately NT$1,265) per barrel. The second tier begins between $40 USD and under $50 USD (approximately NT$1,581) per barrel, with charges set at $5 USD (approximately NT$158) for short-haul and $13 USD (approximately NT$411) for long-haul flights. For each subsequent $10 USD (approximately NT$316) increase in fuel price, short-haul and long-haul surcharges increase by $2.50 USD (approximately NT$79) and $6.50 USD (approximately NT$206), respectively. The CAA added that it has instructed airlines to appropriately disclose background information, such as the proportion of fuel costs relative to total operating costs or calculation formulas, to resolve consumer inquiries. Passengers can also contact individual airlines or check official websites for details regarding the upcoming adjustment. The Civil Aeronautics Administration announced on September 1, 2026, that international passenger fuel surcharges for Taiwanese carriers will increase starting September 7. 交通部民用航空局今天宣布,由於航空燃油價格近期上漲,國籍航空公司國際航線客運燃油附加費將自7日起調漲 Short-haul passenger fuel surcharges will increase from $30 USD (approx NT$949) to $32.50 USD (approx NT$1028). 短程航線從30美元(約新台幣949元)調漲至32.5美元(約新台幣1028元) Long-haul passenger fuel surcharges will increase from $78 USD (approx NT$2467) to $84.50 USD (approx NT$2670). 長程航線從78美元(約新台幣2467元),調漲至84.5美元(約新台幣2670元) CPC Corporation's announced international jet fuel price increased from $147.57 USD per barrel to $156.79 USD per barrel. 依據中油今日公告國際航線航空燃油價格,由每桶147.57美元(約新台幣4668元)調漲為156.79美元(約新台幣4960元) Short-haul routes are defined as Asia excluding India and the Middle East, while long-haul routes include Europe, Americas, Africa, Oceania, Antarctica, India, and the Middle East. 所謂短程線為亞洲(不含印度與中東);長程線為歐洲、美洲、非洲、大洋洲、南極洲、印度和中東 The passenger fuel surcharge adjustment mechanism was coordinated by the CAA and domestic airlines in 2005 based on CPC Corporation's listed international aviation fuel price. 民航局於2005年與國籍航空公司協調客運燃油附加費調整機制,以中油公司公告國際航空燃油每桶牌價為收取基準

a-20260901-1048-taiwan-caa-announces-int.text: 台灣國籍航空國際線燃油附加費9月7日起調漲 因航空燃油價格上漲,台灣國籍航空國際線附加費將於9月7日起再度調漲。 台灣交通部民用航空局於2026年9月1日宣布,由於國際航空燃油價格持續上漲,國籍航空器的國際航線客運燃油附加費,將自9月7日起再度調漲。短程航線將調升至32.5美元,長程航線則調升至84.5美元。民航局已要求業者充分揭露資訊以維護權益。 根據中油公司同日公告,國際航空燃油價格自每桶147.57美元調漲至156.79美元,使計價級距由第12級調整至第13級。在此之前,民航局曾於8月3日宣布自8月9日起調漲附加費,當時油價升至每桶147.57美元,短程與長程附加費分別調升至30美元及78美元。 Taiwan CAA Announces International Fuel Surcharge Increase Starting September 7 Taiwan passenger fuel surcharges to rise on September 7 due to higher aviation fuel prices. The Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) of Taiwan announced on September 1, 2026, that passenger fuel surcharges for international flights operated by Taiwanese airlines will increase starting September 7, 2026. Under the new adjustment, the fuel surcharge for short-haul routes will rise to $32.50, while long-haul routes will increase to $84.50. The regulatory authority has instructed carriers to fully disclose this information to safeguard consumers. According to CPC Corporation's announcement, international aviation fuel prices rose from $147.57 to $156.79 per barrel, shifting the pricing bracket from level 12 to level 13. metadata.title: FAA完成eIPP計畫首次遙控混合動力貨運飛機測試飛行

a-20260901-1048-faa-announces-first-remo.text: FAA完成eIPP計畫首次遙控混合動力貨運飛機測試飛行 FAA宣佈Elroy Air於路易斯安那州完成首次eIPP遙控貨運試飛。 美國聯邦航空總署(FAA)宣佈,飛行器開發商 Elroy Air 與路易斯安那州交通暨發展部於2026年8月,在美國路易斯安那州的霍馬-特勒博恩機場(HUM)完成了混合動力電動遠端遙控飛行器的貨運展示飛行。 根據 FAA 發布的資訊,這次試飛是該機構「電動垂直起降整合試點計畫」(eIPP)架構下,首次執行的遠端遙控飛行器測試飛行。該試點計畫源自「釋放無人機主導地位」行政命令,美國交通部於2026年3月選出跨越26個州的八個參與計畫,路易斯安那州交通暨發展部為其中之一。 本次測試使用的是 Elroy Air 開發的 Chaparral 飛行器。該型機為一種高度自動化的混合動力垂直起降(eVTOL)系統,專為在非傳統場地之間進行重型貨物空中運輸而設計。Elroy Air 執行長 Andrew Clare 表示,Chaparral 的設計宗旨是在最需要的地點執行自主重型貨運,包括離岸能源平台、工業供應鏈、災害應變以及傳統基礎設施無法抵達的社區。 FAA 署長 Bryan Bedford 表示,這項展示飛行提供了實務數據,有助於將先進空中交通概念從試驗階段推向實際部署,並展示新型飛行器如何擴大全美社區的貨運選項與改善物流基礎設施。FAA 表示將利用這些測試數據識別規範漏失與程序缺口,支援將遠端遙控貨運飛行器安全整合至美國國家空域系統中。 FAA Announces First Remotely-Piloted eVTOL Cargo Flight Under eIPP FAA and Elroy Air completed the first remotely piloted cargo demonstration flight under eIPP in Louisiana. The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) announced that developer Elroy Air and the Louisiana Department of Transportation and Development conducted a hybrid-electric demonstration flight at Houma-Terrebonne Airport (HUM) in Louisiana, United States, to evaluate cargo delivery capabilities using a remotely piloted aircraft. According to official statements from the agency, this test flight marks the first remotely piloted aircraft flight conducted under the FAA's eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP). The eIPP initiative was established as part of President Trump's Unleashing Drone Dominance Executive Order to create large-scale testing environments for next-generation aircraft. In March 2026, the U.S. Department of Transportation selected eight participating projects across 26 states, with the Louisiana Department of Transportation and Development designated as one of the state-level program participants. The flight test was conducted using Elroy Air's Chaparral aircraft, which is configured as a highly automated hybrid-electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) system designed to move heavy air cargo between non-traditional landing sites. Elroy Air Chief Executive Officer Andrew Clare stated that the Chaparral was designed to transport heavy payloads autonomously for applications including offshore energy platforms, industrial supply chain logistics, disaster response efforts, and communities that lie beyond traditional transport infrastructure. FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford emphasized that the demonstration provides critical data to support transitioning Advanced Air Mobility concepts from experimental trials to operational deployment. Bedford noted that such test flights demonstrate how new aircraft types can expand cargo transport options across the nation and improve general logistics infrastructure. The FAA indicated it will analyze operational findings from these eIPP flights to identify regulatory and procedural gaps, helping ensure the safe integration of autonomous cargo aircraft into the National Airspace System as additional test flights proceed through the rest of the year. metadata.title: 土耳其F-16戰機緊急起飛 應對無人機侵入愛沙尼亞領空

a-20260901-1048-turkish-f-16s-scramble-a.text: 土耳其F-16戰機緊急起飛 應對無人機侵入愛沙尼亞領空 駐愛沙尼亞土耳其F-16戰機緊急起飛;軍方針對無人機入侵發布空中威脅警報 愛沙尼亞國防軍(EDF)表示,部署於愛沙尼亞埃馬里空軍基地(Ämari Air Base)的土耳其空軍 F-16 戰鬥機,於 2026 年 9 月 1 日清晨緊急起飛。這起行動是在多架無人機越境進入愛沙尼亞領空後發起,愛沙尼亞全國性空中威脅警報隨後於當地時間上午 6 時前解除。 根據愛沙尼亞國防軍發布的訊息,軍方於凌晨 3 時 11 分向萊內-維魯縣與伊達-維魯縣居民發送 EE-ALARM 細胞廣播警報,提醒民眾若發現無人機應立即採取避難措施。該警報範圍於凌晨 3 時 48 分進一步擴大至塔爾圖、約蓋瓦、維爾揚迪、瓦爾加、沃魯及普爾瓦等縣。愛沙尼亞政府危機資訊網站 kriis.ee 紀錄顯示,全國警報最終於上午 5 時 30 分正式結束。 愛沙尼亞國防軍戰略溝通部門負責人烏庫·阿羅爾德(Uku Arold)上校接受公共廣播機構 ERR 訪問時指出,相關無人機在進入愛沙尼亞領空前,曾沿著愛沙尼亞與拉脫維亞的東部邊境平行飛行,進而引發防空警報。國防軍目前尚未說明是否有無人機遭攔截,亦未透露相關飛行器的後續去向。愛沙尼亞外長馬爾古斯·查克納(Margus Tsahkna)在社交媒體 X 上表示,北大西洋公約組織(NATO)聯盟已迅速且按計畫作出反應。 本次起飛任務為 NATO 駐波羅的海防空任務運作下的首次緊急起飛。土耳其空軍第 181 中隊自駐地迪亞巴克爾派遣 5 架 F-16 戰鬥機與 76 名人員進駐埃馬里空軍基地,部署期將持續至 2026 年 11 月 30 日。在此同時,周邊國家亦採取防範措施,拉脫維亞國家武裝部隊對阿盧克斯內區發布橘色警報並緊急起飛盟軍戰機;芬蘭國防軍則於凌晨 4 時前在芬蘭灣東部劃設臨時航空與航海管制區。 Turkish F-16s Scramble After Drones Cross Into Estonia Airspace Turkish F-16 fighters scrambled from Estonia after drones crossed the country's eastern border. Turkish Air Force F-16 fighter jets deployed to Ämari Air Base in Estonia scrambled early on September 1, 2026, after unidentified drones crossed into Estonian airspace, according to statements from the Estonian Defense Forces. The Estonian authorities initiated air threat warnings across multiple regions, with nationwide threat alerts officially lifted before 06:00 local time. The Estonian Defense Forces transmitted an EE-ALARM cell broadcast notification to residents in Lääne-Viru and Ida-Viru counties at 03:11, advising individuals to seek shelter upon sighting any drone. The public warning area was subsequently expanded at 03:48 to encompass Tartu, Jõgeva, Viljandi, Valga, Võru, and Põlva counties. Data recorded on the government crisis website kriis.ee confirmed that the nationwide warning concluded at 05:30. Colonel Uku Arold, head of the Estonian Defense Forces Strategic Communications Department, stated to public broadcaster ERR that the drones had operated parallel to the eastern borders of Estonia and Latvia prior to entering Estonian airspace. Military authorities have not confirmed whether any drone was intercepted or where the unmanned aircraft ultimately moved. Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna stated on X that NATO allied forces responded swiftly and as planned. The interception launch marks the first scramble executed under NATO's Baltic air defense mission from Ämari. The Turkish deployment features five F-16 fighters and 76 personnel from the 181st Squadron based in Diyarbakır, with the rotation scheduled to continue through November 30, 2026. Simultaneously, Latvia's National Armed Forces issued an orange alert in Alūksne district while allied jets responded, and the Finnish Defense Forces established temporary airspace and maritime restrictions over the eastern Gulf of Finland. metadata.title: IATA將於10月在布魯塞爾舉行第四屆世界永續高峰會

a-20260901-1048-iata-to-hold-4th-world-s.text: IATA將於10月在布魯塞爾舉行第四屆世界永續高峰會 IATA將於10月在布魯塞爾舉辦永續高峰會,討論2050淨零碳排策略。 國際航空運輸協會(IATA)宣布,第四屆世界永續高峰會(WSS)將於2026年10月13日至14日在比利時布魯塞爾舉行。本屆高峰會將匯聚來自航空業、能源界、金融機構、科技領域、學術界及政府部門的領袖,共同討論推動航空運輸業在2050年前實現淨零碳排放所需的政策與具體行動。 IATA永續發展高級副總裁兼首席經濟學家瑪麗·歐文斯·湯姆森(Marie Owens Thomsen)表示,航空業致力於達成2050年淨零碳排放目標,但能源轉型無法孤立進行。她強調,成功取決於擴大再生能源生產、建設新基礎設施、推進新穎技術、支持投資、轉移風險,並以整體系統思維設計相應政策。 本屆高峰會議程將聚焦於三大核心主題:第一,擴大航空能源轉型解決方案,重點包括氫化可再生酯和脂肪酸永續航空燃料(HEFA SAF)、低碳航空燃料(LCAF)及共加工技術;第二,設計與協調政策,以建立全球透明且具競爭力的SAF與碳信用市場;第三,推進技術創新,深入理解非二氧化碳效應及飛機全生命週期的永續性。 本次大會將首次與歐洲變革之翼(WOCE)會議在同一地點連續舉行,WOCE會議定於2026年10月15日登場。已確認出席的講者包括LATAM航空集團執行長羅貝托·阿爾沃(Roberto Alvo)、空中巴士永續監管與外部參與副總裁貝爾特朗·德·拉孔布(Bertrand de Lacombe)等多位產業與政法界專家。 IATA to Hold 4th World Sustainability Symposium in Brussels in October 2026 IATA will host its fourth World Sustainability Symposium in Brussels to discuss aviation decarbonization policies. The International Air Transport Association (IATA) announced that it will hold the fourth World Sustainability Symposium (WSS) in Brussels, Belgium, on October 13 and 14, 2026. The symposium will bring together leaders from aviation, energy, finance, technology, academia, and government to focus on the policies and concrete actions required to advance the air transport sector's transition toward net zero carbon emissions by 2050. IATA Senior Vice President Sustainability and Chief Economist Marie Owens Thomsen noted that while the air transport industry remains committed to net zero carbon emissions by 2050, the energy transition cannot occur in isolation. She emphasized that achieving success depends on expanding renewable energy production for all sectors, building new infrastructure, advancing novel technologies, supporting investment, transferring risk, and designing policies with the overall aviation system in mind. The event agenda will center on three core themes critical to decarbonization in aviation. These include scaling solutions for energy transition such as Hydroprocessed Esters and Fatty Acids Sustainable Aviation Fuel (HEFA SAF), Low Carbon Aviation Fuels (LCAF), and co-processing; designing and harmonizing policies that foster global and competitive markets for SAF and carbon credits; and advancing technical innovation, non-CO2 climate effects, and lifecycle sustainability. For the first time, the World Sustainability Symposium and the Wings of Change Europe (WOCE) conference will be held consecutively at the same venue, with WOCE scheduled for October 15, 2026. Confirmed speakers for the event include LATAM Airlines Group Chief Executive Officer Roberto Alvo, Airbus Vice President Bertrand de Lacombe, and other representatives from industry, financial institutions, and regulatory authorities. metadata.title: 萊茵金屬LUNA NG無人機獲德國軍方臨時適航認證

a-20260901-1520-rheinmetall-luna-ng-dron.text: 萊茵金屬LUNA NG無人機獲德國軍方臨時適航認證 德國軍方航空局給予萊茵金屬LUNA NG無人機臨時適航認證;許可訓練與測試飛行。 德國軍方航空局(Luftfahrtamt der Bundeswehr,簡稱 LufABw)已向萊茵金屬(Rheinmetall)開發的 LUNA NG 無人偵察系統核發臨時適航認證。該項證書為取得完整機型認證的中間階段,萊茵金屬表示完整認證作業仍在持續進行中,且已符合大部分所需的審查基準。 取得臨時適航認證後,德國聯邦國防軍獲准使用 LUNA NG 系統開展自行控制的訓練與測試飛行任務。根據萊茵金屬公布的訊息,首批德國軍方飛行員與審查人員目前已經完成該型無人機的相關培訓課程。 萊茵金屬指出,在獲得軍方核准之前,LUNA NG 系統已在民用營運執照下完成大約 150 架次飛行,累計飛行時間約 200 小時。此項認證代表該型無人機能在符合民用安全標準的前提下整合至常規管制空域,擺脫僅能在純軍事區域飛行的限制。 萊茵金屬 Air Unmanned Space 事業部執行長 Mike Schmidt 表示,該系統的認證流程比照空中巴士A320等大型客機的標準執行。由於市面上缺乏適用於戰術無人機的現成獲認證組件,包含自動飛行控制系統與導航系統在內的安全關鍵部件均由公司自主研發並完成認證。 德國聯邦國防軍以 HUSAR 為代號引進 LUNA NG 系統。根據 2023 年 9 月 28 日簽署的合約修正案,採購內容涵蓋 12 套量產系統與 1 套先導系統,總金額約為 2 億歐元。每套系統配備 5 架無人機、2 套地面控制系統、2 輛發射車、2 座天線桅桿、維修車間及 3 套運輸平台。單架無人機最大起飛重量為 110 公斤,最高飛行高度達 5,000 公尺,續航時間超過 12 小時。 Rheinmetall LUNA NG Drone Receives Provisional Military Certification Germany's military aviation authority granted Rheinmetall LUNA NG drone provisional airworthiness certification for military training flights. Germany's military aviation authority, the Luftfahrtamt der Bundeswehr (LufABw), has granted provisional airworthiness certification to the Rheinmetall LUNA NG unmanned reconnaissance system. According to Rheinmetall, the issued certificate represents an interim approval step toward full type certification, which remains in progress with the majority of required approval criteria already fulfilled. The provisional certificate allows the Bundeswehr to conduct its own flight operations with the LUNA NG system for training and testing purposes. Rheinmetall confirmed that the first German military pilots and verifiers have already completed their official training on the unmanned aerial system type. Prior to obtaining military approval, the LUNA NG system logged roughly 150 sorties totaling approximately 200 flight hours under civil operating licenses. Rheinmetall stated that the provisional airworthiness certification allows the reconnaissance drone to be integrated into regular restricted airspace while meeting civil safety standards, ending its confinement strictly to designated military zones. Mike Schmidt, CEO of Rheinmetall's Air Unmanned Space business unit, explained that the certification process was conducted against the same rigorous standards applied to large commercial aircraft such as the Airbus A320. Key safety-critical components, including the autopilot and navigation systems, had to be engineered and certified in-house because no certified off-the-shelf equivalents were available for tactical unmanned aircraft. The German armed forces are introducing the system under the military designation HUSAR. A contract amendment executed on September 28, 2023, covers 12 production systems and one pilot system valued at approximately 200 million euros (231 million dollars). Each complete system comprises five aircraft, two ground control stations, two launcher vehicles, two antenna masts, a dedicated repair shop, and three transport platforms. Rheinmetall specifies that each aircraft features a maximum takeoff weight of 110 kilograms, a maximum altitude of 5,000 meters, and an operating endurance of more than 12 hours. a-20260901-1520-air-canada-selects-up-to.text: 加拿大航空選擇最多16架空中巴士A350-1000客機 加拿大航空選擇最多16架空中巴士A350-1000客機,取代延遲的波音777X。 根據相關消息,加拿大航空已選擇最多16架空中巴士A350-1000型廣體客機,以此替代已被推遲交付的波音777X系列客機。 在遠程客機機隊規劃方面,空中巴士A350-1000型客機已被加拿大航空納入選擇,用於因應波音777X計畫出現延遲後的長程航線運能需求。 根據波音公司於2026年7月發布的營運資料顯示,該公司針對波音777X客機計畫的首次交付時間,目前仍持續預計落在2027年。 加拿大航空此項相關機隊決策,呈現出航空業者在規劃未來長程客機機隊時所採行的具體考量與佈局。 Air Canada Selects Up to 16 Airbus A350-1000 Aircraft Air Canada selected up to 16 Airbus A350-1000 aircraft over Boeing's delayed 777X model. Air Canada has selected up to 16 Airbus A350-1000 widebody aircraft to replace or substitute for Boeing's delayed 777X program in its future fleet plans. The airline opted for the A350-1000 as part of its long-haul fleet strategy, addressing operational requirements amid ongoing program delays affecting the Boeing 777X aircraft. According to previously reported financial update information from Boeing, the manufacturer maintains its expectation for the first delivery of the 777X aircraft to take place in 2027. This commitment highlights broader shifts in how commercial carriers plan and structure their future long-haul fleets in response to aircraft delivery timelines. a-20260901-1520-boeing-mh-139a-grey-wolf.text: 波音MH-139A灰狼直升機獲准執行美國核彈飛彈田安全任務 美空軍宣布MH-139A達初始作戰能力;接替UH-1N執行核彈護航 美國空軍全球打擊司令部(AFGSC)於2026年8月31日宣布,波音MH-139A灰狼直升機已在8月10日達到初始作戰能力,正式獲准執行洲際彈道飛彈(ICBM)安全任務。這標誌著該型直升機將接替服役超過半世紀的UH-1N休伊直升機,負責守護彌尼特曼三型飛彈的維修與裝甲安保車隊。 灰狼是義大利李奧納多公司AW139雙引擎中型直升機的軍用改良型。李奧納多在位於費城東北部的廠房生產基礎機身,由波音作為主承包商加裝軍用設備並負責交付後支援。AFGSC表示,灰狼速度比前身快近50%,載員量翻倍,並具備改進的防禦系統。 首次作戰護航任務於2026年1月8日執行,第40直升機中隊兩架灰狼從馬姆斯特洛姆空軍基地出發,護送車隊往返超過100英里(約161公里),全程約六小時無需空中加油。第20航空隊責任區涵蓋懷俄明州沃倫基地、蒙大拿州馬姆斯特洛姆基地與北達科他州邁諾特基地,總面積約33,600平方英里。 根據波音2026年1月29日公開數據,合同共38架MH-139A,已交付21架,其中12架屬2023年簽署的低率初產合同。首架量產機於2024年8月移交。機隊仍在擴建中,AFGSC未說明宣告涵蓋多少架次、機組或基地。 AFGSC並將灰狼與未來LGM-35A哨兵洲際飛彈的轉換掛鉤,指稱其航程與指揮控制系統將支援分階段佈署:新哨兵設施啟用的同時逐步退役彌尼特曼三型據點。哨兵計劃以2030年代初達到初始作戰能力為目標。除護航外,灰狼亦將執行搜救、災害救援與醫療撤運任務。 Boeing MH-139A Grey Wolf cleared for US nuclear missile field security mission USAF declares MH-139A initial operational capability; replaces UH-1N for nuclear convoy escort The US Air Force Global Strike Command (AFGSC) announced on August 31, 2026 that the Boeing MH-139A Grey Wolf helicopter reached initial operational capability on August 10, 2026, clearing it for the intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) security mission it was procured to perform. The declaration formalises the handover from the UH-1N Huey, which has flown in missile fields since 1970. The Grey Wolf is a militarised derivative of the Leonardo AW139 twin‐engine commercial medium‐lift helicopter. Leonardo produces the baseline airframe at its plant in northeast Philadelphia, and Boeing, as prime contractor, installs the military equipment and handles post‐delivery support. AFGSC said the Grey Wolf is nearly 50% faster than its predecessor, carries twice as many troops and has improved defensive systems. The type flew its first operational convoy on January 8, 2026, when two aircraft from the 40th Helicopter Squadron escorted a movement more than 100 miles (over 161 kilometres) from Malmstrom Air Force Base and back over roughly six hours without refuelling. The Twentieth Air Force area of responsibility spans approximately 33,600 square miles (87,000 square kilometres) across F.E. Warren AFB in Wyoming, Malmstrom AFB in Montana and Minot AFB in North Dakota. The most recent public delivery total dates from January 29, 2026, when Boeing stated that 38 MH-139As were under contract and 21 had been delivered, 12 of them under the low‐rate initial production contract awarded in 2023. The first production aircraft was handed over in August 2024. AFGSC did not specify how many aircraft, crews or bases the initial operational capability declaration covers, and the fleet is still being built out. AFGSC also tied the helicopter to the coming transition from Minuteman III to the LGM‐35A Sentinel, saying the Grey Wolf’s range and command‐and‐control systems are needed to secure sites through a phased transition in which new Sentinel facilities come online as Minuteman III sites are decommissioned. The Sentinel programme is targeting its own initial operational capability in the early 2030s. Beyond convoy escort and continuous emergency response, the Grey Wolf will also be used for search and rescue, disaster response and medical evacuation. a-20260901-1600-starlux-airlines-sorayam.text: 星宇航空空山金藝術機飛抵布拉格哈維爾機場 星宇航空空山金藝術機抵達布拉格;於歐洲首個航點投入350座旗艦機。 星宇航空與日本藝術家空山基合作推出的A350-1000「空山金」彩繪機,於2026年9月1日捷克時間上午近9時順利飛抵布拉格哈維爾機場,機場方面特別安排水門儀式盛大迎接這架旗艦級藝術客機。此項名為STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA的跨界合作計畫,將機械構造與藝術美學互相結合。 布拉格哈維爾機場執行長拉夏克在記者會致詞時表示,這對布拉格機場而言是一個特別的早晨,並祝願星宇航空所有航班客滿。星宇航空公關長暨發言人梁文龍則表示,布拉格是星宇航空在歐洲的首個航點,作為台灣與歐洲之間的橋樑,也是公司全球擴張過程中的重大里程碑,在此航線部署彩繪機將提供旅客優質飛行體驗。 在客艙配置方面,該架STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA A350-1000客機共設有350個座位,包括4席頭等艙、40席商務艙、36席豪華經濟艙與270席經濟艙。捷克觀光局日本兼台灣辦事處主任巴士杰指出,星宇航空自8月1日起加入台捷直航營運,未來台北與布拉格每天均有航班往來,預期將顯著帶動雙向觀光與商務旅客流向捷克。 根據本站紀錄,這架「空山金」A350-1000客機先前於2026年8月16日抵達桃園國際機場,並於8月20日首航執飛台北至東京成田航線。該機與先前於7月交機的「空山銀」彩繪機共同組成雙機陣容,規劃投入國際熱門航線的定期航班服務。 STARLUX Airlines Sorayama Gold A350-1000 Lands at Prague Airport STARLUX Airlines landed its Sorayama Gold A350-1000 in Prague; the aircraft features 350 seats across four classes. A STARLUX Airlines Airbus A350-1000 aircraft featuring the special "Sorayama Gold" livery arrived at Václav Havel Airport Prague at approximately 9:00 AM Czech time on September 1, 2026. The airport marked the arrival of the flagship aircraft with a traditional water cannon salute. The long-range jet represents part of the carrier's STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA project created in collaboration with Japanese artist Hajime Sorayama. Radomír Lašák, Chief Executive Officer of Václav Havel Airport Prague, welcomed the carrier at a press conference, highlighting the significance of the arrival for the airport. STARLUX Airlines spokesperson Liang Wen-long stated that Prague serves as the airline's initial gateway in Europe and marks a key milestone in its global route network expansion, noting that deploying the custom-painted flagship aircraft on the route will enhance the passenger travel experience. The STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA A350-1000 flagship aircraft features a total of 350 seats configured across four travel classes, comprising 4 First Class seats, 40 Business Class seats, 36 Premium Economy seats, and 270 Economy seats. Pavel Schoustal, Director of the Czech Tourism Authority Japan & Taiwan Office, noted that STARLUX entered the direct Taiwan-Czech route on August 1, with daily flight connectivity expected to stimulate reciprocal tourism and business travel between the regions. According to historical records, this second A350-1000 art aircraft arrived at Taoyuan International Airport on August 16, 2026, following its acceptance in France. The aircraft was subsequently deployed on the Taipei-Tokyo Narita route on August 20, joining the previously delivered "Sorayama Silver" aircraft to form a dual-liveried flagship fleet assigned to scheduled international services. 星宇航空與空山基合作推出的A350-1000「空山金」彩繪機於2026年9月1日捷克時間早上近9時飛抵布拉格哈維爾機場。 「空山金」今天在捷克時間早上近9時飛抵布拉格哈維爾機場(Václav Havel Airport Prague),機場以水門儀式盛大迎接。 STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA計畫之A350-1000機型配置頭等艙4席、商務艙40席、豪經艙36席與經濟艙270席,共350座位。 機上配置4席頭等艙、40席商務艙、36席豪華經濟艙與270席經濟艙,共350個座位。 布拉格哈維爾機場執行長拉夏克致詞表達歡迎,並祝願星宇航空航班客滿。 布拉格機場執行長拉夏克(Radomír Lašák)在記者會上致詞表示 星宇航空發言人梁文龍表示,布拉格為星宇航空在歐洲的首個航點及全球擴張的重大里程碑。 梁文龍致詞表示,布拉格是星宇航空在歐洲的首個航點,作為台灣與歐洲之間的重要橋梁,也是全球市場擴張中的一個重大里程碑。 捷克觀光局代表巴士杰指出星宇航空於8月1日加入台捷直航,每日航班往來將帶動雙向觀光。 巴士杰表示,星宇航空自8月1日起加入台捷直航行列,未來台灣與布拉格每天都有航班往來,預期將帶動雙向旅遊人潮。 「空山金」A350-1000藝術機於2026年8月16日抵達桃園機場,並規劃執飛東京成田航線。 星宇航空與日本藝術家空山基合作的A350-1000藝術機「空山金」,今天上午9時43分抵達桃園機場

a-20260902-0143-faa-proposes-67-500-civi.text: FAA擬對MIA Solutions處6.75萬美元民事罰款 FAA擬罰MIA Solutions;涉17批鋰電池空運違規 美國聯邦航空總署(FAA)提議對佛羅里達州多勒(Doral)的MIA Solutions LLC處以6.75萬美元的民事罰款,理由是涉嫌違反美國運輸部的危險物品運輸規定。 FAA指稱,MIA Solutions在2024年10月向DHL Express提供了共17批含有鋰離子電池的JBL Endurance Race藍牙耳機以供空運。鋰離子電池被歸類為危險物品。 FAA指稱,這些貨物未附有必要的危險物品運輸文件,且貨物未經正確分級、描述、包裝、標記、貼標,或未處於適當的運輸狀態。此外,MIA Solutions未提供所需的應急處理資訊,且未能對準備該貨運的員工進行有關危險物品空運的適當培訓。 MIA Solutions在收到FAA通知後有30天的時間可以回應該機構。 FAA Proposes $67,500 Civil Penalty Against MIA Solutions LLC for Alleged Hazmat Violations FAA proposes $67,500 fine; MIA Solutions allegedly shipped lithium-ion earbuds improperly. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) proposes a $67,500 civil penalty against MIA Solutions LLC of Doral, Florida, for allegedly violating U.S. Department of Transportation hazardous materials regulations. The FAA alleges that in October 2024, MIA Solutions offered 17 shipments of JBL Endurance Race Bluetooth Earbuds containing lithium-ion batteries to DHL Express for air transportation. Lithium-ion batteries are classified as hazardous materials. The FAA alleges the shipments lacked required hazardous materials documentation and were not proper classed, described, packaged, marked, labeled, or in proper condition for shipment. Further, MIA Solutions allegedly did not provide emergency response information and failed to properly train the employee who prepared the shipments. MIA Solutions has 30 days after receiving the FAA's notice to respond to the agency. FAA proposes a $67,500 civil penalty against MIA Solutions LLC. a-20260902-0217-boeing-mh-139a-grey-wolf.text: 波音MH-139A灰狼直升機達初始作戰能力 守護美洲洲際飛彈 美空軍全球打擊司令部宣布MH-139A達初始作戰能力,接替UH-1N執行洲際飛彈安全任務 美國空軍全球打擊司令部(AFGSC)於2026年8月31日宣布,波音MH-139A「灰狼」直升機已於8月10日達到初始作戰能力(IOC),正式獲准執行洲際彈道飛彈(ICBM)安全任務。這項聲明標誌著該機型正式接替自1970年起服役的UH-1N「休伊」直升機。 「灰狼」是意大利萊昂納多公司AW139雙發商用中型直升機的軍用化衍生型。萊昂納多在位於費城東北部的工廠生產基礎機身,波音作為主承包商負責安裝軍用設備並提供交付後支援。AFGSC表示,灰狼比前代機型快近50%,載員量翻倍,並具備改進的防禦系統。 灰狼的核心任務是護送「民兵III」維修和裝甲安保車隊。第二十航空隊的責任區域約33,600平方英里(約87,000平方公里),橫跨懷俄明州弗朗西斯·沃倫空軍基地、蒙大拿州馬爾姆斯特龍空軍基地和北達科他州邁諾特空軍基地。 2026年1月8日,灰狼執行了首次實戰護送任務,第40直升機中隊的兩架飛機從馬爾姆斯特龍基地出發,護送車隊往返超過100英里(約161公里),歷時約6小時且無需空中加油。 根據波音於2026年1月29日公布的最新數據,公司已交付21架MH-139A,合同總量為38架。首架量產機於2024年8月交付。AFGSC還指出,灰狼的航程和指揮控制系統將支援向LGM-35A「哨兵」洲際彈道飛彈的過渡,後者預計於2030年代初達到初始作戰能力。此外,灰狼還將用於搜救、災害響應和醫療撤運。 Boeing MH-139A Grey Wolf reaches initial operational capability for US nuclear missile security mission US AFGSC declares MH-139A operational for ICBM convoy escort; replaces Huey; first convoy flown January 2026 The US Air Force Global Strike Command (AFGSC) announced on August 31, 2026, that the Boeing MH-139A Grey Wolf helicopter reached initial operational capability (IOC) on August 10, 2026, clearing it for the intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) security mission it was procured to perform. The declaration formalizes the handover from the UH-1N Huey, which the US Air Force has flown in missile fields since 1970. The Grey Wolf is a militarized derivative of the Leonardo AW139 twin-engine commercial medium-lift helicopter. Leonardo produces the baseline airframe at its plant in northeast Philadelphia, and Boeing, as prime contractor, installs the military equipment and handles post-delivery support. AFGSC said the Grey Wolf is nearly 50% faster than its predecessor, carries twice as many troops, and has improved defensive systems. The Grey Wolf’s core task is escorting Minuteman III maintenance and armored security convoys. The Twentieth Air Force area of responsibility covers approximately 33,600 square miles (about 87,000 square kilometers) of prairie, plains, and mountain terrain across F.E. Warren Air Force Base in Wyoming, Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana, and Minot Air Force Base in North Dakota. The type flew its first operational convoy on January 8, 2026, when two aircraft from the 40th Helicopter Squadron escorted a movement more than 100 miles (over 161 kilometers) from Malmstrom and back over roughly six hours without refueling. As of January 29, 2026, Boeing had delivered 21 MH-139As out of 38 under contract, with the first production aircraft handed over in August 2024. AFGSC also tied the helicopter to the coming transition from Minuteman III to the LGM-35A Sentinel, stating the Grey Wolf’s range and command-and-control systems are needed to secure sites through a phased transition. The Sentinel program targets its own IOC in the early 2030s. Beyond convoy escort, the Grey Wolf will also support search and rescue, disaster response, and medical evacuation. metadata.title: Saab雙座戰機Gripen F首飛 巴西飛行員共同參與

a-20260902-0727-saab-two-seat-gripen-f-f.text: Saab雙座戰機Gripen F首飛 巴西飛行員共同參與 Saab雙座戰機Gripen F於瑞典首飛,巴西空軍飛行員共同登機測試。 瑞典國防航太廠商Saab於2026年8月28日成功完成了雙座戰機Gripen F的首次飛行。這架戰機於當日上午9時40分自Saab位於瑞典藍科平(Linköping)的機場起飛,並在空中停留了40分鐘,正式開啟了該機型在交付給巴西之前的空中測試階段。 本次首飛任務由Saab的主測試飛行員Jakob Högberg與巴西空軍測試飛行員Abdon de Rezende Vasconcelos中校共同執行。Saab官方聲明指出,此次飛行驗證了戰機核心系統的功能性以及初步的飛行性能表現,為後續的飛行測試奠定了基礎。 根據Saab的規劃,測試團隊接下來將進行初始生產驗收飛行,隨後進入漸進式飛行包絡線(flight envelope)的擴展階段。在此階段中,測試人員將逐步放寬並清除戰機在速度、高度、重力加速度(G值)和攻角等方面的極限。此外,雙座機型特有的戰術能力以及後座艙功能也將在測試中同步進行評估。這項測試將由Saab位於瑞典藍科平的飛行測試中心負責執行,但該公司並未透露具體的時間表,也未說明何時會向巴西空軍正式交付該戰機。 巴西是雙座Gripen F戰機的首發客戶,並深入參與了該機型的共同開發。雙方於2014年簽署的合約共涵蓋36架戰機,其中包括28架單座型Gripen E及8架雙座型Gripen F。據Saab統計,已有超過350名巴西工程師、技術人員與飛行員參與了該戰機研發、生產、飛行測試和維護的相關培訓。 此次首飛是繼2026年6月2日第一架雙座Gripen F在藍科平亮相(rollout)後的最新進展。此外,第一架在巴西組裝的單座Gripen E已於2026年3月25日在巴西航空工業(Embraer)位於加維奧培克索托(Gavião Peixoto)的工廠出廠。截至2026年6月,在28架單座機型中已有11架完成交付。目前瑞典方面透露,巴西未來可能會追加訂購約20架Gripen戰機,且Saab與巴西航空工業已於2026年7月21日簽署合作協議,將巴西的組裝線作為瑞典藍科平生產線的補充。 Saab Two-Seat Gripen F Fighter Completes First Flight with Brazilian Pilot Aboard Saab flew the two-seat Gripen F fighter in Sweden on August 28 with a Brazilian pilot. Swedish defence manufacturer Saab successfully flew its two-seat Gripen F fighter aircraft for the first time on August 28, 2026. The aircraft took off from Saab’s airfield in Linköping, Sweden, at 09:40 local time and remained airborne for 40 minutes. This flight officially opened the airborne phase of a test campaign that must be completed before the fighter is handed over to the Brazilian Air Force. The maiden flight was piloted by Saab chief test pilot Jakob Högberg, alongside Brazilian Air Force test pilot Lieutenant Colonel Abdon de Rezende Vasconcelos. According to a release from Saab, the flight successfully verified the functionality of the fighter's core systems as well as its initial flight performance. Following initial production acceptance flights, the test campaign will move into progressive flight envelope expansion. This process will clear the aircraft's limits for speed, altitude, G-load, and angle of attack step by step. Parallel evaluations will also assess tactical capabilities and the rear cockpit functions unique to the two-seat configuration. The campaign will be conducted by Saab’s Flight Test Centre in Linköping, Sweden, though the company has not yet set a timeline for completion or subsequent deliveries. Brazil is the launch customer for the Gripen F and has actively participated in its co-development. A contract signed in 2014 covers 36 aircraft, comprising 28 single-seat Gripen E and eight two-seat Gripen F fighters. Saab noted that more than 350 Brazilian engineers, technicians, and pilots have received training related to the aircraft's development, production, flight testing, and maintenance. The test flight follows the rollout of the first Gripen F in Linköping on June 2, 2026. Meanwhile, the first Brazilian-assembled single-seat Gripen E was rolled out at Embraer's plant in Gavião Peixoto on March 25, 2026. As of June 2026, eleven of the 28 ordered Gripen E aircraft had been delivered. Sweden indicated on June 4, 2026, that Brazil might order around 20 additional Gripen fighters, with Saab and Embraer having signed a heads of agreement on July 21, 2026, to position the Gavião Peixoto line as a complement to Linköping. metadata.title: 美FAA核發華盛頓馬納薩斯機場(MNZ)商業營運許可證

a-20260902-0727-faa-grants-part-139-oper.text: 美FAA核發華盛頓馬納薩斯機場(MNZ)商業營運許可證 華盛頓馬納薩斯機場獲美FAA核發證照,將可起降商業客運航班。 美國聯邦航空總署(FAA)於2026年8月31日宣布,已向華盛頓馬納薩斯機場(HEF)核發 Part 139 機場營運許可證(Airport Operating Certificate),此舉將允許該機場接待特定的商業客運航空公司航班。 根據FAA官員說法,這是維吉尼亞州53年來首間獲得此營運許可證的機場。在過去五年中,FAA已在該機場投資超過4600萬美元,以支持跑道重建及未來新建飛航管制塔台等關鍵基礎設施改善計畫。 FAA Grants Part 139 Operating Certificate to Washington Manassas Airport (MNZ) FAA grants Washington Manassas Airport an operating certificate to allow commercial passenger airline flights. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) announced on August 31, 2026, that it has granted Washington Manassas Airport (MNZ) a Part 139 Airport Operating Certificate. This certification will enable the airport to accommodate scheduled commercial passenger airline operations. According to the FAA, this marks the first time in 53 years that an airport in Virginia has received such an operating certificate. Over the past five years, the agency has invested more than $46 million at the airport to support critical infrastructure improvements, including runway rehabilitation and future air traffic control tower construction. metadata.title: 台灣虎航開航高雄往返石垣島與小松雙航線

a-20260902-1224-taiwan-tigerair-launches.text: 台灣虎航開航高雄往返石垣島與小松雙航線 台灣虎航開航高雄往返石垣島與小松航線;自高雄出發航線增至14條 台灣虎航於2026年9月2日在高雄國際機場(KHH)舉行開航儀式,開航高雄往返石垣島與高雄往返小松兩條新航線。 隨著這兩條航線投入營運,台灣虎航自高雄出發的日本航線增加至11條,高雄出發總航線數則由12條增至14條,另包含首爾金浦、濟州島及峴港等航線。 台灣虎航董事長黃世惠指出,目前桃園往返石垣島與小松航線皆已穩定營運,開通高雄航線可便利南台灣旅客並吸引日籍旅客利用雙點進出體驗台灣。 黃世惠預計於9月3日搭乘首航班前往小松出席當地開航活動,並將拜會石川縣知事山野之義。 Taiwan Tigerair Launches Kaohsiung Routes to Ishigaki and Komatsu Taiwan Tigerair launches Kaohsiung flights to Ishigaki and Komatsu, expanding its Kaohsiung network to 14 routes. Taiwan Tigerair held a launch ceremony at Kaohsiung International Airport (KHH) on September 2, 2026, marking the inauguration of two new routes connecting Kaohsiung with Ishigaki and Komatsu in Japan. The addition of the Ishigaki and Komatsu services increases the airline's routes departing from Kaohsiung from 12 to 14, with Japanese destinations expanding to 11. Taiwan Tigerair's Kaohsiung network also includes services to Seoul Gimpo, Jeju Island, and Da Nang. Taiwan Tigerair Chairman Huang Shih-hui stated that routes from Taoyuan to Ishigaki and Komatsu are already operating stably. He noted that the new Kaohsiung services enhance convenience for southern Taiwan travelers and benefit Japanese visitors. Huang is scheduled to board the inaugural flight to Komatsu on September 3 to attend local launch events and meet with Ishikawa Prefecture Governor Yamano Toshiyuki. 台灣虎航於2026年9月2日在高雄國際機場舉行開航慶祝儀式,推出高雄往返石垣島與高雄往返小松航線。 台灣虎航今天在高雄國際機場舉辦高雄-石垣島、高雄-小松雙航線開航慶祝儀式 新航線開航後,台灣虎航自高雄出發的航線由12條增加至14條,其中飛往日本的航線增加至11條。 這2條航線開航後,讓台灣虎航自高雄出發的航線由原本的12條增加至14條。 台灣虎航營運的高雄出發航線除日本11條外,還包括高雄往返首爾金浦、高雄往返濟州島及高雄往返峴港航線。 如再加上高雄-首爾金浦、高雄-濟州島及高雄-峴港航線,則台灣虎航營運高雄出發航線將達14條。 台灣虎航董事長黃世惠表示,桃園往返石垣島與桃園往返小松航線皆已穩定營運,高雄雙航線開航可提升南台灣出國便利性與日籍旅客彈性行程規劃。 目前桃園-石垣島與桃園-小松航線皆已穩定營運,這次高雄雙航線開航後,除了大幅提升南部鄉親出國旅遊的便利性外,對日本籍旅客在行程規劃上也更加友善 台灣虎航董事長黃世惠預計於9月3日搭乘首航班前往小松,出席當地的首航活動並拜會石川縣知事山野之義。 明天黃世惠將搭乘首航班前往小松,出席當地的首航活動,除將拜會石川縣知事山野之義外

metadata.title: 紐約甘迺迪機場加油車擦撞中國國際航空波音747-8機翼致燃油外洩

a-20260902-1224-air-china-boeing-747-8-d.text: 紐約甘迺迪機場加油車擦撞中國國際航空波音747-8機翼致燃油外洩 中國國際航空一架波音747-8在紐約甘迺迪機場遭加油車破壞;燃油洩漏至停機坪。 根據 Simple Flying 報導,於美國紐約甘迺迪國際機場(JFK),一輛地面加油車造成一架中國國際航空(Air China)波音 747-8 型客機受損。事件發生期間,航空燃油自該架客機的機翼位置持續傾瀉湧出。 現場紀錄影像顯示,該輛加油車在運作移動時,自該架處於停放狀態的波音 747-8 客機上拉扯並強行扯斷了連接的加油軟管線路。 加油軟管遭扯斷後,大量的航空燃油隨即自機體洩漏,並噴濺撒落至甘迺迪國際機場的停機坪地面區域。 Air China Boeing 747-8 Damaged by Fuel Truck at New York JFK An Air China Boeing 747-8 was damaged by a fuel truck at New York JFK, spilling fuel. According to news reporting from Simple Flying, an Air China Boeing 747-8 passenger aircraft was damaged by a ground fuel truck at John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) in New York. Jet fuel was observed pouring directly from the aircraft wing during the incident. Video footage recorded at the airport shows the fuel truck ripping hoses away from the parked Boeing 747-8 aircraft as the vehicle operated on the ground. After the fuel hoses were forcibly ripped away from the parked plane, jet fuel spilled across the apron at John F. Kennedy International Airport. a-20260902-1224-ukraine-warns-airlines-o.text: 烏克蘭總統警告航空公司俄羅斯領空安全日已結束 烏克蘭警告航空公司俄領空不再安全;俄方反駁為國家恐怖主義;航空營運仍正常維持 烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基於2026年9月1日發表聲明,警告行經俄羅斯領空的所有航空公司、保險公司及使用俄國主要機場者,俄國領空的安全時期已經結束。澤倫斯基表示,烏克蘭並未對民用航空構成直接威脅,但俄羅斯上空將出現大規模無人機活動,各方必須予以考量。 針對烏克蘭方面的警告,俄羅斯總統普丁回應表示,該份聲明屬於國家恐怖主義的宣布。 儘管烏克蘭提出警告,據航班追蹤網站Flightradar24數據顯示,截至2026年9月2日,俄羅斯上空的航空交通仍維持正常,包括阿聯酋航空與土耳其航空在內的國內外航空公司均持續在該領空營運。 Ukraine Warns Airlines over Russian Airspace as Drones Expand Operation Ukraine warns airlines over Russian airspace risks, while Flightradar24 shows normal commercial operations continuing. In response to the warning, Russian President Vladimir Putin characterized Zelenskyy's statement as a declaration of state terrorism. Despite the statement, air travel over Russia appeared to continue normally on September 2, 2026. a-20260902-1224-taiwan-gifts-drones-to-p.text: 台灣贈無人機予帛琉等友邦 促進人才培訓與技術合作 外交部長林佳龍於帛琉致贈友邦無人機;深化技術應用與產業合作 外交部長林佳龍於2026年8月27日至9月3日率團前往帛琉共和國,出席第55屆「太平洋島國論壇」(PIF)峰會相關活動。林佳龍於9月1日出席「帛琉台灣之夜」活動,與來自帛琉、馬紹爾群島、吐瓦魯及關島的友人交流,並向友邦致贈無人機。 活動期間,台灣「國際青年大使」也在帛琉進行無人機展演。林佳龍指出,希望透過致贈無人機,進一步深化人才培訓、技術應用與產業合作,讓科技真正回應太平洋國家的發展需求。 帛琉總統惠恕仁於致詞時表示,友誼建立在信任之上,帛琉會繼續與台灣並肩同行,並期待雙方友誼持續延伸至整個太平洋地區。 Taiwan Gifts Drones to Pacific Allies to Deepen Technical Cooperation Taiwan Minister Lin Chia-lung gifts drones in Palau; aims to deepen technical and industrial cooperation. Taiwan Minister of Foreign Affairs Lin Chia-lung led a delegation to Palau from August 27 to September 3, 2026, to attend activities related to the 55th Pacific Islands Forum summit. During the Palau Taiwan Night on September 1, Lin interacted with guests from Palau, the Marshall Islands, Tuvalu, and Guam, and presented drones to diplomatic allies. Taiwanese Youth Ambassadors also conducted drone demonstrations in Palau during the visit. Lin stated that gifting the drones aims to further deepen talent training, technical applications, and industrial cooperation, allowing technology to address the development needs of Pacific nations. Palau President Surangel Whipps Jr. stated during the event that friendship is built on trust and expressed appreciation for Taiwan partnership, hoping the relationship between the two nations will continue to extend across the Pacific. 外交部長林佳龍於2026年8月27日至9月3日率團前往帛琉出席第55屆太平洋島國論壇峰會相關活動。 林佳龍8月27日至9月3日率團赴帛琉共和國,出席第55屆「太平洋島國論壇」(Pacific Islands Forum,PIF)峰會相關活動。 林佳龍於9月1日出席帛琉台灣之夜活動,並向友邦致贈無人機。 他1日出席「帛琉台灣之夜」與來自帛琉、馬紹爾群島、吐瓦魯及關島的友人交流,並分享台中芋頭酥及致贈友邦無人機。 台灣國際青年大使在帛琉進行無人機展演。 這幾天,台灣「國際青年大使」在帛琉進行無人機展演 外交部希望透過致贈無人機深化人才培訓、技術應用與產業合作。 希望進一步深化人才培訓、技術應用與產業合作,讓科技真正回應太平洋國家的發展需求。 帛琉總統惠恕仁強調友誼建立在信任之上,期待與台灣持續深化夥伴關係。 帛琉總統惠恕仁(Surangel Whipps Jr.)昨晚致詞時說,友誼建立在信任之上,帛琉繼續與台灣並肩同行,是因台灣也始終與帛琉站在一起,期待台帛友誼一代接一代,持續延伸到整個太平洋

metadata.title: 德國指控俄羅斯策劃萊比錫機場(LEJ)無人機襲擊並關閉領事館

a-20260902-1224-germany-blames-russia-fo.text: 德國指控俄羅斯策劃萊比錫機場(LEJ)無人機襲擊並關閉領事館 德國聯邦政府指控俄羅斯策劃萊比錫機場無人機襲擊;宣佈關閉俄國駐波昂總領事館。 德國聯邦政府於2026年9月1日宣佈,將2026年8月4日發生於德國萊比錫/哈雷機場的無人機襲擊未遂事件歸咎於俄羅斯。德國聯邦內政部長亞歷山大·多布林特(Alexander Dobrindt)指出,根據警方調查結果、案發模式以及德國情報機關與合作夥伴的情報研判,共同證實了俄羅斯對該起針對停泊貨機的攻擊事件負有責任。 根據 AeroTime 報導,該起事件發生於2026年8月4日當地時間約19時30分,一架載有炸藥的無人機飛向停泊於萊比錫/哈雷機場管制區內的烏克蘭安托諾夫航空(Antonov Airlines)安托諾夫An-124貨機,並撞擊其翼部。撞擊時爆炸物分離,但引信未能成功起爆。調查人員隨後在機場西側的卡貝爾斯克塔爾(Kabelsketal)農田收回了第三架無人機及約50公克的黑索金(hexogen)高能炸藥。 針對該起安全事件,德國聯邦檢察總長辦公室已於2026年8月6日自德勒斯登檢察官手中接管此案,目前正朝向意圖引爆爆炸物及危險干擾航空交通罪名方向進行刑事調查。多布林特部長表示,現場收繳的技術裝置表現出高度專業性,顯示出規劃與執行過程具備高度專業知識及相當規模的組織投入,最終執行則由低階人員實施。 為回應此起事件,德國聯邦外交部長約翰·瓦德普爾(Johann Wadephul)宣佈外交反制措施,包括俄羅斯駐德國波昂(Bonn)的總領事館將於2026年9月18日關閉,並終止位於柏林的俄羅斯文化機構合約。瓦德普爾表示,德國將加強對俄羅斯公民的入境管制,並提議歐盟對相關個人實施新制裁。俄羅斯外交部發言人瑪麗亞·扎哈羅娃(Maria Zakharova)對此回應表示,莫斯科當局將採取對等回應措施。 Germany Blames Russia for Drone Attack at Leipzig Airport, Orders Consulate Closure Germany attributed an attempted drone attack at Leipzig Airport to Russia; orders consulate closure in Bonn. Germany's federal government announced on September 1, 2026, that it has officially attributed an attempted explosive drone attack at Leipzig/Halle Airport (LEJ) in Germany to Russia. Federal Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt stated that police investigation results, the pattern of the offense, and intelligence findings from German security services and international partners together established Russian responsibility for the August 4, 2026, security incident. According to reporting by AeroTime, the incident occurred at approximately 19:30 local time on August 4, 2026, when a drone flew toward a parked Antonov Airlines Antonov An-124 cargo aircraft inside the secured area of Leipzig/Halle Airport. The drone struck one of the aircraft's wings, causing the explosive charge to separate upon impact, though the detonator failed to function. Investigators later recovered a third drone along with roughly 50 grams of the explosive hexogen from a field in Kabelsketal, west of the airport. The Federal Prosecutor General's office took over the criminal investigation from Dresden prosecutors on August 6, 2026, focusing on allegations of attempting to cause an explosion and dangerous interference with air traffic. Dobrindt described the technical configuration recovered at the site as professional, indicating significant technical expertise and organizational planning, while noting that the execution of the attempt was carried out by low-level agents. In response to the incident, Federal Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul announced a series of diplomatic measures, including the closure of Russia's last operating consulate general in Bonn, Germany, effective September 18, 2026. Germany will also terminate the contract for the Russian House cultural institute in Berlin, tighten entry controls for Russian nationals, and propose new EU sanctions. Russian Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova stated that Moscow intends to respond in kind to the diplomatic actions. a-20260902-1655-ryanair-to-cut-winter-fl.text: 因應高昂燃料成本 瑞安航空計劃縮減今年冬季航班 瑞安航空計劃縮減今冬與2027財年航班,以應對燃料價格風險。 根據航空媒體《Simple Flying》報導,歐洲廉價航空瑞安航空(Ryanair)表示燃料價格過於高昂,並計劃縮減航班。該航空公司在今年冬季以及2027財年(FY2027)的航班數量可能會有所減少,以此降低因未進行避險的燃料價格變動所帶來的財務風險。 在此之前,其他歐洲廉航也面臨類似挑戰。根據本站歷史資料,另一家超低成本航空公司威茲航空(Wizz Air)於2026年8月公布,其2027財年第一季淨虧損約1.98億歐元。該公司指出,較低的票價、高昂的燃料成本以及持續的機隊營運中斷,是導致其出現季度淨虧損的主因。 Ryanair to Cut Winter Flights Over High Fuel Costs Ryanair plans to reduce flights this winter to mitigate unhedged fuel price risks. Ryanair has indicated that fuel prices are too expensive and has planned to scale back its flight offerings. The airline could see fewer flights operating during this winter season and the 2027 financial year (FY2027) as part of efforts to mitigate the potential financial risks associated with unhedged fuel price fluctuations. This development follows challenges faced by other European low-cost carriers. In August 2026, competitor Wizz Air reported a net loss of approximately €198 million for the first quarter of its 2027 financial year. Wizz Air stated that lower average fares, higher fuel costs, and continued fleet disruption had contributed significantly to its quarterly financial loss. Ryanair may reduce its flights during this winter and the 2027 financial year due to high fuel prices and to mitigate the risk of unhedged fuel price changes. This winter and FY2027 could see less Ryanair flights to ease the risk of unhedged fuel price changes. a-20260902-1934-air-canada-cancels-fligh.text: 加拿大航空宣佈取消全球十六個長途航點的航班 加拿大航空取消涵蓋歐洲與亞太等地區的十六個長途目的地航班。 根據航空新聞媒體 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 9 月 2 日的報導,加拿大航空公司已決定取消飛往全球十六個長途目的地的航班。這些被取消航班的航點均屬於跨洋航線,此項調整將會對該航空公司在多個國際市場的營運規劃造成直接影響。 報導內容進一步指出,這十六個受到影響的長途航點在地理分佈上相當廣泛,其範圍涵蓋了整個歐洲地區、非洲地區、亞洲太平洋地區以及中東地區。目前,有關這些具體受到波及的長途航線名單與相關細節,仍有待該航空公司公佈與確認。 Air Canada Cancels Flights To 16 Long-Haul Destinations Globally Air Canada cancels long-haul flights to 16 destinations in Europe, Africa, Asia-Pacific, and the Middle East. According to a report published by the aviation news website Simple Flying on September 2, 2026, Air Canada has decided to cancel its flights to 16 long-haul destinations. This decision represents a notable operational adjustment to the airline's international flight schedule and its global network. The affected long-haul destinations are distributed across several key geographical regions, which include Europe, Africa, Asia-Pacific, and the Middle East. Although the complete list of the cancelled international routes has not been fully detailed in the report, these operational adjustments are expected to impact the carrier's scheduled services across these global regions. metadata.title: 西南航空宣布開設首批機場貴賓室

a-20260902-1934-southwest-airlines-to-op.text: 西南航空宣布開設首批機場貴賓室 西南航空擬於2027年底前開設首批四間機場貴賓室 西南航空(Southwest Airlines)於2026年9月2日宣布,計劃於2027年底前在奧斯汀、巴爾的摩、檀香山及納什維爾四座機場開設首批貴賓室。 首批貴賓室位於奧斯汀伯格史壯國際機場(AUS)、巴爾的摩/華盛頓瑟古德·馬歇爾國際機場(BWI)、檀香山丹尼爾·井上國際機場(HNL)及納什維爾國際機場(BNA),興建工程已展開。 西南航空表示,未來數年將在熱門商務及休閒市場額外規劃至少七間貴賓室,但未透露具體地點。貴賓室將與摩根大通(Chase)合作開發,並結合Chase Sapphire Reserve貴賓室網絡的既有特色。 貴賓室的使用資格將與預定於2027年推出的Chase聯名西南航空Rapid Rewards信用卡掛鉤,航空公司尚未公布年費或其他進入方式。 Southwest Airlines to open first airport lounges in Austin, Baltimore, Honolulu and Nashville Southwest plans to open first airport lounges in four cities, with construction started and more locations planned. Southwest Airlines announced on September 2, 2026, plans to open its first airport lounges in Austin, Baltimore, Honolulu and Nashville, beginning in late 2027. The first four lounges are located at Austin-Bergstrom International Airport (AUS), Baltimore/Washington International Thurgood Marshall Airport (BWI), Daniel K. Inouye International Airport (HNL) and Nashville International Airport (BNA). Construction has already started on these locations. The airline said at least seven additional lounges are planned over the following several years, although it did not identify the markets. The lounges are being developed in partnership with Chase and will draw on features from the Chase Sapphire Reserve Lounge Network. Access will be tied to a new premium Southwest Rapid Rewards credit card from Chase scheduled to launch in 2027. a-20260902-2210-teen-fleeing-police-cras.text: 17歲嫌犯衝入樸茲茅斯機場撞毀PC-12 17歲駕駛衝入機場撞毀PlaneSense PC-12;嫌犯被捕將出庭 8月29日晚間約20時09分,一名17歲駕駛為逃避新罕布夏州警攔截,闖入樸茲茅斯國際機場(PSM)圍籬,撞上庫伯塔拖車後再撞擊停泊的PlaneSense Pilatus PC-12。 PlaneSense證實該PC-12當時在總部待維修,機身左翼斷裂、起落架塌陷,損毀嚴重,但無員工受傷,飛行業務未受影響。 警方已逮捕駕駛Wyatt Seely,依加重酒駕、魯莽駕駛、抗拒警員及肇逃等輕罪起訴,定於9月9日在樸茲茅斯地方法院出庭。 Teen fleeing police crashes into PlaneSense PC-12 at Portsmouth Airport Teen crashes stolen Mustang into parked PlaneSense PC-12 at Portsmouth Airport; driver charged Around 20:09 local time on 29 August 2026, a 17‐year‐old driver fleeing New Hampshire State Police crashed through the perimeter fence of Portsmouth International Airport (PSM), striking a Kubota ground‐support tractor and then a parked PlaneSense Pilatus PC‐12. PlaneSense confirmed the PC‐12 was at its headquarters awaiting routine maintenance; the aircraft suffered a severed left wing and collapsed landing gear, but no employees were injured and flight operations continued unaffected. The driver, identified as Wyatt Seely of Rochester, was taken into custody and charged with aggravated DWI, reckless driving, disobeying an officer and conduct after an accident; he is scheduled to appear in Portsmouth District Court on 9 September. a-20260902-2210-vueling-postpones-boeing.text: Vueling推遲B737 MAX服役 座椅認證延誤 Vueling確認B737 MAX延至2027上半年服役;RECARO座椅認證拖延 巴塞隆納廉價航空Vueling確認推遲引進波音737 MAX機隊,新服役目標推至2027年上半年。根據西班牙媒體報導,此次延期乃因RECARO座椅認證流程漫長,Vueling已證實正與RECARO協商解決,預計延誤將持續數月。 國際航空集團(IAG)於2019年巴黎航展下單150架B737 MAX(含50架確定訂單與100架選擇權),Vueling初期獲分配50架。2026年5月,IAG行使10架選擇權,Vueling配置增至60架。 ch-aviation數據顯示,截至2026年9月2日,Vueling機隊共137架,其中97架為A320ceo,另有A320neo、A321neo、A321ceo與A319。該航司計劃在數年內完成向全波音機隊的轉型。 首批引進機型為737 MAX 8-200,配置197座艙位,較現行A320的189座多出8席。737 MAX 10(IAG至少訂購25架)將於型別認證後陸續加入,認證預計2026年第四季完成。 原定首航安排為2026年12月巴塞隆納(BCN)飛阿利坎特(ALC),隨後開闢塞維亞(SVQ)、馬略卡島(PMI)與羅馬(FCO)航線,現須配合新時程調整。 座椅認證延誤已波及多家歐洲航空:漢莎航空被迫以無新款Allegris頭等艙座椅執飛部分航班,荷蘭皇家航空預計新引進A350將缺乏商務艙配置。 Vueling Postpones Boeing 737 MAX Entry Into Service to First Half 2027 Over Seat Certification Delays Vueling delays 737 MAX launch to H1 2027; RECARO seat certification issues cited Barcelona-based low-cost carrier Vueling has confirmed it will postpone the entry into service of its new Boeing 737 MAX fleet, pushing the target date to the first half of 2027. According to Spanish media reports, the delay stems from the protracted certification process for RECARO seats slated for installation. Vueling has acknowledged it is in discussions with RECARO to resolve the issue, though the setback is expected to last several months. The aircraft originate from International Airlines Group (IAG)'s 2019 Paris Air Show order for 150 737 MAX jets (50 firm orders plus 100 options). Vueling was initially allocated 50 aircraft; in May 2026 IAG exercised 10 options, raising Vueling's allocation to 60. Per ch-aviation data dated 2 September 2026, Vueling operates 137 aircraft, predominantly 97 Airbus A320ceos alongside A320neos, A321neos, A321ceos and A319s. The airline intends to transition to an all-Boeing fleet over several years. The first batch will be the 737 MAX 8-200 configured with 197 seats — eight more than the current 189-seat A320 layout. The 737 MAX 10 (IAG has at least 25 on order) will join later, contingent on type certification expected in the fourth quarter of 2026. Vueling's inaugural commercial 737 MAX flight was scheduled for December 2026 on the Barcelona (BCN) to Alicante (ALC) route, followed by services to Sevilla (SVQ), Palma de Mallorca (PMI) and Rome Fiumicino (FCO). That schedule must now be revised. Seat certification delays have recently affected other European carriers: Lufthansa has flown some aircraft without its new Allegris First Class seats, and KLM is expected to debut its Airbus A350s without a business class cabin. Vueling postpones Boeing 737 MAX entry into service to first half of 2027 Vueling, the Barcelona-based low-cost subsidiary of International Airlines Group (IAG), will have to wait to induct its new Boeing 737 MAX aircraft into service, with the carrier reportedly pushing the date back to the first half of 2027. Delay caused by protracted RECARO seat certification process According to Spanish media reports, the postponement, which adds to other prior delays, is due to the protracted certification process of the RECARO seats which are expected to be fitted onboard. Vueling confirmed discussions with RECARO to resolve seat certification issue Vueling has confirmed it is in conversation with RECARO to solve the issue, although the delay is expected to take several months. IAG 2019 order for 150 737 MAX; Vueling allocation raised to 60 in May 2026 Vueling was initially allocated 50 aircraft from the mega-order IAG placed at the 2019 Paris Air Show for 150 B737 MAX aircraft (which included 50 firm orders and 100 options). In May 2026, this figure was increased to 60 aircraft after IAG exercised 10 of those options. Vueling fleet 137 aircraft as of 2 September 2026, mostly A320ceos; plans all-Boeing transition According to ch-aviation data, as of September 2, 2026, Vueling has a fleet of 137 aircraft, the majority of which (97 aircraft) are A320ceos, but also includes several A320neo, A321 (both neo and ceo) and A319 aircraft.

metadata.title: 阿聯酋航空獲Skytrax高端經濟艙獎 但腿部空間不如日本航空

a-20260902-2210-emirates-wins-skytrax-pr.text: 阿聯酋航空獲Skytrax高端經濟艙獎 但腿部空間不如日本航空 阿聯酋航空奪Skytrax高端經濟艙獎;腿部空間較日本航空少 根據 Simple Flying 報導,阿聯酋航空在最新 Skytrax 獎項中奪得高端經濟艙座椅類別冠軍,成為全球最舒適高端經濟艙的得主。 同報導指出,阿聯酋航空該艙等腿部空間仍少於日本航空同級產品,顯示舒適度不完全取決於腿部空間大小。 Simple Flying 強調此獎項僅涉及座椅設計評分,並未將腿部空間納為唯一判斷標準。 讀者可參考該報導以了解完整評比細節與數據比較。 報導發布於 2026 年 9 月 2 日。 Emirates wins Skytrax premium economy award despite less legroom than Japan Airlines Emirates wins Skytrax premium economy award; legroom less than Japan Airlines According to Simple Flying, Emirates captured the Skytrax premium economy seat category, being named the world’s most comfortable premium economy product. The same report notes that Emirates’ premium economy still offers less legroom than the comparable Japan Airlines product, indicating comfort is not solely determined by legroom. Simple Flying emphasises that the award reflects seat design scores and does not make legroom the sole criterion; the article was published on 2 September 2026. Readers can consult the full Simple Flying piece for detailed scoring methodology and comparative data. The publication date is 2 September 2026. a-20260903-0053-ryanair-cuts-passenger-t.text: 瑞安航空下修客運目標並示警同業冬季燃油危機 瑞安航空下修年度客運目標並警告部分同業恐難撐過冬季燃油危機 瑞安航空(Ryanair)於2026年9月2日宣布,將其2027財年客運目標下調至2.14億人次,低於先前預測的2.16億人次,以減少在通常虧損的冬季期間對燃油成本的曝險。 該公司表示,其已對截至2027年3月的燃油需求約80%進行避險,鎖定價格約每桶67美元;目前市場燃油價格約為每桶140美元,超過其鎖定價格的兩倍。 瑞安航空預測,避險比例較低的競爭同業,若油價在2027年仍居高不下,「可能難以維持運能,甚至可能無法撐過這個冬季」。 瑞安航空亦估計,相關調整將使冬季虧損減少約7000萬至1億歐元,並警告若油價持續偏高,短程票價可能上漲。 Ryanair cuts passenger target and warns rivals may not survive winter fuel crisis Ryanair cuts fiscal 2027 target; warns less-hedged rivals may not survive winter fuel prices Irish low-cost carrier Ryanair said on September 2, 2026, that it now expects to carry 214 million passengers in its fiscal 2027 year, down from an earlier forecast of 216 million, as it trims exposure to high fuel costs during the winter season. The airline has hedged about 80% of its fuel through March 2027 at roughly $67 per barrel, while jet fuel currently trades around $140 per barrel, according to Ryanair. Ryanair warned that competitors with less protection "could struggle to maintain capacity or even survive this coming winter season" if high oil prices persist into 2027. The carrier estimates the move will cut its winter losses by between EUR70 million and EUR100 million and said short-haul fares could rise if oil prices remain high into summer 2027. metadata.title: 漢莎航空技術與阿聯酋航空延長A380維修合約

a-20260903-0522-lufthansa-technik-emirat.text: 漢莎航空技術與阿聯酋航空延長A380維修合約 漢莎技術與阿聯酋航空延長A380維修合約至2030年 漢莎航空技術(Lufthansa Technik)與阿聯酋航空(Emirates)宣布延長基地維修服務合約,以支援該航空公司在亞洲的空中巴士A380機隊。 雙方於2026年9月2日表示,位於馬尼拉的漢莎航空技術菲律賓公司將繼續為阿聯酋航空的A380進行重檢(heavy checks),直至2030年。 漢莎技術表示,這項新協議是其菲律賓據點歷史上價值最高的協議之一。 阿聯酋航空也將成為漢莎技術菲律賓位於克拉克國際機場(MNL)新廠房的啟動客戶,該廠房亦將支援空中巴士A350與波音787。 Lufthansa Technik, Emirates extend A380 base maintenance contract through 2030 Lufthansa Technik extends Emirates A380 base maintenance contract through 2030; Emirates to be launch customer at Clark facility. Lufthansa Technik and Emirates have extended their base maintenance services contract to support Emirates' fleet of Airbus A380 aircraft in Asia. On September 2, 2026, the two organizations said that Lufthansa Technik Philippines will continue to perform heavy checks on Emirates' A380 aircraft through 2030. At the Lufthansa Technik Philippines facility in Manila, the MRO company provides two dedicated base maintenance lines to Emirates, the world's largest A380 operator. According to Lufthansa Technik, the new agreement is one of the largest by value in the history of its Philippines facility. Emirates will also become the launch customer for Lufthansa Technik Philippines' new facility at Clark International Airport (MNL) once operations begin. The new facility at Clark International Airport will support Airbus A350 and Boeing 787 aircraft. 漢莎技術與阿聯酋航空於2026年9月2日宣布延長基地維修合約,以支援阿聯酋航空在亞洲的空中巴士A380機隊。 On September 2, 2026, the two organizations said that Lufthansa Technik Philippines will continue to perform heavy checks on Emirates ’ A380 aircraft through 2030. 漢莎技術表示這項新協議是其菲律賓據點歷史上價值最高的協議之一。 According to Lufthansa Technik, the new agreement is one of the largest by value in the history of its Philippines facility. 阿聯酋航空將成為Lufthansa Technik Philippines位於克拉克國際機場新廠房的啟動客戶。 Emirates will also become the launch customer for Lufthansa Technik Philippines’ new facility at Clark International Airport (CRK) once operations begin. a-20260903-0522-rheinmetall-luna-ng-dron.text: 德軍核准Rheinmetall LUNA NG無人機訓練飛行 德軍航太局核准LUNA NG臨時適航認證;允許訓練與測試飛行 德國軍用航空當局已授予Rheinmetall LUNA NG無人偵察系統臨時適航認證。根據AeroTime報導,這份由德國聯邦國防軍航空局(Luftfahrtamt der Bundeswehr,LufABw)發出的證書,是邁向完整型別認證的中繼步驟。Rheinmetall表示,完整核准所需的標準大部分已達成,但未說明尚有哪些項目待補。 此臨時證書允許德國軍方以該系統自行進行訓練與測試飛行作業。Rheinmetall並表示,首批德國軍方飛行員與驗證員已完成該機型的相關訓練。 在取得軍方核准前,LUNA NG以民用飛行執照執行了約150架次的飛行作業,總計約200飛行小時。根據Rheinmetall的說明,認證作業係依照與空中巴士A320等大型飛機相同的標準進行;包括自動駕駛與導航系統在內的安全關鍵零組件,因戰術無人機無現成等效產品,必須由公司自行開發並完成認證。 Rheinmetall指出,此核准使LUNA NG得以在符合民用安全標準下,納入「正常受限空域」運作,不再僅限於軍事區域;若能符合航空測試規範,最終或可於歐洲人口稠密地區的民眾領空進行常態性作業。 德國軍方以HUSAR為代號導入LUNA NG。Rheinmetall在原始製造商EMT破產後接手該計劃;2023年9月28日簽署的合約修訂案涵蓋12套量產系統與1套先導系統,總價約2億歐元(約2.31億美元)。Rheinmetall未在其認證消息中提出更新的交運時程。 Rheinmetall LUNA NG drone gets provisional Bundeswehr airworthiness approval German military aviation authority grants LUNA NG provisional certification; enables Bundeswehr training and test flights Germany's military aviation authority has granted provisional airworthiness certification to the Rheinmetall LUNA NG unmanned reconnaissance system. The certificate from the Luftfahrtamt der Bundeswehr (LufABw) is an interim step toward full type certification, which Rheinmetall said remains in progress. The company said the majority of the criteria required for full approval have been met, without specifying which remain outstanding. The provisional certificate allows the Bundeswehr to conduct its own flight operations with the system for training and testing. Rheinmetall said the first German military pilots and verifiers had completed training on the type. Before receiving military approval, the system completed roughly 150 sorties totaling approximately 200 flight hours under civil operating licenses, according to Rheinmetall. Mike Schmidt, CEO of Rheinmetall's Air Unmanned Space business unit, said certification was conducted to the same standards applied to large aircraft such as the Airbus A320. Safety-critical components, including the autopilot and navigation systems, had to be developed and certified in-house because no certified equivalents were available for tactical unmanned aircraft, he added. Rheinmetall said the approval allows LUNA NG to be integrated into regular, restricted airspace while meeting civil safety standards, removing its confinement to purely military areas. Compliance with aviation testing procedures could ultimately permit regular operations over densely populated European territory, according to the company. The Bundeswehr is introducing LUNA NG under the designation HUSAR. Rheinmetall took over the program from the original manufacturer, EMT, after the company became insolvent. A contract amendment signed on September 28, 2023, covered 12 production systems and one pilot system, with a total value of approximately €200 million ($231 million). a-20260903-1025-philippine-airlines-take.text: 菲律賓航空接收第四架空中巴士A350-1000客機 菲律賓航空第四架A350-1000客機抵達馬尼拉;機隊擴增計畫持續推進 菲律賓航空(Philippine Airlines)已正式接收其第四架空中巴士(Airbus)A350-1000長程客機。這架國籍標誌暨登記號碼為RP-C3513的新機,在完成從法國土魯斯空中巴士生產設施的交機飛行後,於2026年9月2日當地時間19:22降落於馬尼拉的尼諾伊亞奎諾國際機場(MNL)。 本次交付的RP-C3513客機,是菲律賓航空於2023年訂購的9架A350-1000客機中的第四架,屬於該公司機隊現代化與國際營運擴展策略的核心部分。菲律賓航空目前仍是東南亞地區首家且唯一營運空中巴士A350-1000機型的航空公司。 作為菲律賓航空長程航線的旗艦機型,該架A350-1000採用三艙等配置,共設有382個座位。商務艙配備具有滑動隱私門的獨立包廂,同時設有專屬的豪華經濟艙與升級的經濟艙產品。目前該機型已投入營運舊金山、紐約及多倫多等主要國際長程航線。 除了已運作的現役機隊外,菲律賓航空亦持續進行未來的機隊佈局。在2026年6月舉行的范保羅國際航空展期間,該航空公司簽署了瞭解備忘錄,擬增購9架空中巴士A350-1000客機(並附帶5架額外購買權),以及15架波音(Boeing)787-10廣體客機(附帶5架選購權)。相關合約預計交機期將持續至2036年。 菲律賓航空擁有APEX四星級航空認證,並於2025年獲評為亞太地區準點率最高的航空公司。此外,該航空公司已於2026年獲得正式邀請,準備加入寰宇一家(oneworld)航空聯盟,進一步拓展其全球航線網路。 Philippine Airlines Takes Delivery of Fourth Airbus A350-1000 Philippine Airlines receives its fourth Airbus A350-1000 aircraft in Manila as fleet expansion continues. Philippine Airlines has taken delivery of its fourth Airbus A350-1000 long-haul aircraft. The widebody jetliner, registered RP-C3513, touched down at Ninoy Aquino International Airport (MNL) in Manila at 19:22 local time on September 2, 2026, following a delivery flight from Airbus' manufacturing facility in Toulouse, France. The onboard product includes business class suites with sliding privacy doors, alongside dedicated premium economy and enhanced economy class passenger cabins. The delivery forms part of a broader fleet expansion framework for Philippine Airlines. During the Farnborough International Airshow in June 2026, the carrier signed Memoranda of Understanding for nine additional Airbus A350-1000 aircraft with purchase rights for five more, as well as 15 Boeing 787-10 Dreamliners with options for an additional five aircraft. metadata.title: 美國正式對進口無人機開徵最高100%關稅

a-20260903-1025-us-tariffs-of-up-to-100-.text: 美國正式對進口無人機開徵最高100%關稅 美國正式對進口無人機課徵最高達100%關稅;盟國產品可申請關稅上限優惠。 根據 AeroTime 報導,美國於2026年9月3日東部時間凌晨12時1分起,正式對進口無人機及關鍵零組件徵收最高達100%的關稅。此項措施依據美國總統川普於同年8月13日簽署的第11055號公告執行。最大起飛重量超過25公斤的無人機系統將面臨100%的關稅,而25公斤以下的較小型無人機關稅則為25%。 來自日本、南韓、台灣、瑞士、列支敦斯登或歐盟成員國等盟國的產品,在進口商證明關鍵零組件實質源自合格經濟體的前提下,可申請最高15%的關稅上限。此外,名列五角大廈 Blue UAS 清單或聯邦通信委員會(FCC)條件批准清單的企業,其產品關稅將延後至2027年2月9日實施。 US Tariffs of Up to 100% on Imported Drones Take Effect US begins imposing tariffs of up to 100% on imported drones starting September 3, 2026. According to AeroTime, the United States began imposing tariffs of up to 100% on imported drones and critical components at 12:01 a.m. Eastern Time on September 3, 2026. Under Proclamation 11055, signed by President Donald Trump on August 13, 2026, unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) with a maximum takeoff weight above 25 kilograms are subject to a 100% tariff. Smaller drones weighing 25 kilograms or less face a 25% tariff. Products originating in allied nations, including Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Switzerland, Liechtenstein, or European Union member states, can qualify for a capped tariff of 15% if critical components and technology originate in eligible economies. Additionally, products from suppliers on the Pentagon's Blue UAS lists or the FCC's Conditional Approval List as of September 2, 2026, will have their tariff implementation delayed until February 9, 2027. The United States began imposing tariffs of up to 100% on imported drones and critical components starting at 12:01 a.m. Eastern Time on September 3, 2026. The United States began imposing tariffs of up to 100% on imported drones and critical components at 12:01 a.m. Eastern Time on September 3, 2026. Under Proclamation 11055, unmanned aircraft systems with a maximum takeoff weight above 25 kilograms face a 100% ad valorem tariff, while smaller ones weighing up to 25 kilograms face a 25% tariff. Under the proclamation, unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) with a maximum takeoff weight above 25 kilograms (55 pounds) are subject to a 100% ad valorem tariff. Drones and components from Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Switzerland, Liechtenstein, or EU member states can qualify for a capped tariff of 15% under certain certification conditions. Products originating in Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Switzerland, Liechtenstein or a European Union member state can qualify for a tariff capped at 15%, including the existing Column 1 duty rate. Companies listed on the Pentagon's Blue UAS Cleared List or Framework, or the FCC's Conditional Approval List as of September 2, 2026, will not be subject to the new duties until February 9, 2027. Products and components supplied by companies included on the Pentagon’s Blue UAS Cleared List or Blue UAS Framework as of September 2, 2026, will not become subject to the duties until February 9, 2027.

metadata.title: 美國航空首架改裝Flagship套房波音777客機首航布宜諾斯艾利斯

a-20260903-1025-american-airlines-unveil.text: 美國航空首架改裝Flagship套房波音777客機首航布宜諾斯艾利斯 美國航空首架改裝Flagship套房波音777客機執飛紐約至布宜諾斯艾利斯。 美國航空(American Airlines)公佈首架改裝Flagship套房(Flagship Suites)的波音777-300ER客機,該機於2026年9月2日執飛紐約(JFK)前往布宜諾斯艾利斯(EZE)的航班,正式投入商業服務。 本次改裝移除頭等艙,將原本8個頭等艙與52個舊型商務艙座位替換為70個Flagship套房,特選經濟艙座位亦由28個增加至44個。美航計畫對旗下20架波音777-300ER機隊進行改裝。 隨著Flagship套房推出,舊型頭等艙預計於2026年11月19日起停止提供預訂。該改裝機型未來亦將營運東京(NRT)、聖保羅(GRU)與雪梨(SYD)等長途航線。 American Airlines Unveils First Retrofitted Boeing 777-300ER American Airlines launched its first retrofitted Boeing 777-300ER featuring Flagship Suites on a flight to Buenos Aires. American Airlines has unveiled its first Boeing 777-300ER retrofitted with its new Flagship Suites. The upgraded widebody aircraft officially entered commercial service on September 2, 2026, operating a flight from New York (JFK) to Buenos Aires (EZE). The retrofit eliminates First Class on the Boeing 777-300ER fleet, replacing eight first-class and 52 legacy business-class seats with 70 new-generation Flagship Suites. The cabin reconfiguration also expands Premium Economy capacity from 28 to 44 seats across the carrier's 20 B777-300ER aircraft. Following the deployment of Flagship Suites, legacy First class bookings will end on November 19, 2026. American Airlines also plans to operate the retrofitted aircraft on long-haul routes connecting the United States to Tokyo (NRT), Sao Paulo (GRU), and Sydney (SYD). Following the Flagship introduction, the legacy First class will no longer be available for booking from November 19, 2026. metadata.title: 行政院追加1457億元國防預算納入無人機採購

a-20260903-1025-taiwan-approves-nt-145-7.text: 行政院追加1457億元國防預算納入無人機採購 行政院通過追加預算,編列559億元採購濱海監偵與攻擊型無人機。 台灣行政院於2026年9月3日通過了中華民國115年度中央政府總預算追加預算案,其中國防部追加預算共編列新台幣1457億元。該預算主要用於提升防衛作戰能力的武器購製,以及因國軍招募人力成長所增編的戰鬥部隊加給等需求。 根據主計總處資料,在國防追加預算的1457億元中,包含濱海監偵型無人機等3項無人系統項目共計559億元。此外,預算案還編列了中層反戰術彈道飛彈系統等7項共130億元、2項機密計畫共645億元、急缺彈藥補充73億元,以及台灣戰術網路跨網域情資整合案9億元。另有25億元用於因應招募人力成長的薪資預算,以及16億元用於增加戰鬥部隊加給。 國防部戰略規劃司長黃文啓在院會後記者會說明,由於無人機部隊已於去年陸續成編並在今年1月定位,目前主要缺乏無人載具裝備。國防部預計於今年啟動濱海監偵型、濱海攻擊型無人機及自殺無人艇的先期採購作業。預計在116年(2027年)開始建置使用單位的初始戰力,並期盼在2027年底前讓相關單位達到基本戰備存量的要求。 黃文啓指出,無人載具追加預算具有指標性意義,預期能為國內業者提供足夠信心,並挹注非紅供應鏈中的關鍵導航、飛行控制等晶片項目,以落實本土產能建置。此外,急缺彈藥補充預算則旨在將戰備庫存從30天逐步提升至120天,並補充因演訓頻率增加而消耗的彈藥。 國防部補充說明,原先「強化防衛韌性及不對稱戰力計畫採購特別條例」上限為1.25兆元並包含23個項目,但部分項目先前未獲通過。因此,本次追加預算案中,已將過去未獲全數通過的13項委製、商購及台美共同研發採購的武器裝備項目全部納入。一旦預算經立法院審議通過,國防部將加速招決標及武器裝備籌獲,以縮小因時間延宕產生的戰力缺口。 Taiwan Approves NT$145.7 Billion Defense Budget Supplement Including UAV Procurement Taiwan's Executive Yuan approves defense supplementary budget on September 3 to procure military UAVs. Taiwan's Executive Yuan on September 3, 2026, approved a central government supplementary budget, allocating NT$145.7 billion for national defense. The funding is intended to procure weapons to enhance defense combat capabilities and support combat troop allowances amid growth in military recruitment. According to the Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics, the NT$145.7 billion defense allocation includes NT$55.9 billion for three unmanned system programs, such as coastal surveillance unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). Additionally, NT$13.0 billion is designated for seven items including mid-tier anti-tactical ballistic missile systems, NT$64.5 billion for two classified programs, NT$7.3 billion for urgent ammunition replenishment, and NT$900 million for a cross-domain tactical network integration project. Huang Wen-chi, Director of the Strategic Planning Department of the Ministry of National Defense, explained that while UAV units were formed last year and positioned by January this year, they currently lack unmanned systems. The ministry plans to launch procurement for coastal surveillance UAVs, coastal attack UAVs, and suicide unmanned surface vessels this year, with initial combat capabilities scheduled for establishment in 2027 to meet basic combat stock requirements. Huang noted that the NT$55.9 billion UAV budget carries symbolic significance, offering confidence to local industry players while channeling resources into key chips for navigation and flight control within "non-red" supply chains. Regarding ammunition, the NT$7.3 billion replenishment will gradually raise combat stock levels from 30 days to 120 days to cover resources consumed by increased military exercises. The defense ministry noted that the supplementary budget incorporates 13 previously unapproved programs from a larger NT$1.25 trillion special purchase statute, which originally comprised 23 items. These remaining projects consist of domestic production, commercial military purchases, and joint Taiwan-U.S. research and development. Following legislative approval, the ministry aims to accelerate bidding, contract awards, and equipment acquisition to mitigate combat capability gaps. 台灣行政院於2026年9月3日通過中華民國115年度中央政府總預算追加預算案,國防部分編列新台幣1457億元。 行政院今天通過今年度追加預算案,國防部分包含提升防衛作戰能力的武器購製、戰鬥部隊加給需求共新台幣1457億元 國防追加預算編列新台幣559億元用於濱海監偵型無人機等3項無人系統項目。 濱海監偵型無人機等3項559億元 國防追加預算包含中層反戰術彈道飛彈系統等7項共130億元,以及2項機密計畫共645億元。 中層反戰術彈道飛彈系統等7項130億元、濱海監偵型無人機等3項559億元、機密計畫2項645億元 國防部戰略規劃司長黃文啓表示,規劃於今年啟動濱海監偵型與攻擊型無人機及無人艇採購,並於116年建置初始戰力。 預計今年開始啟動濱海監偵型跟濱海攻擊型無人機的採購,以及無人艇先期採購作業,再於116年針對濱海監偵型無人機跟濱海攻擊型無人機的使用單位初始戰力進行建置

a-20260903-1025-ccp-contact-probes-expan.text: 中探針連接器切入無人機領域 預計2027年展現貢獻 中探針連接器切入無人機;研發微機電探針;預期2027年帶來貢獻。 中探針總經理馮明欽於2026年9月3日在SEMICON Taiwan展覽上表示,公司連接器產品已成功切入無人機以及人工智慧(AI)智慧眼鏡等應用領域。同時,中探針正與半導體大廠共同研發微機電探針(MEMS)與清針紙等新產品,相關項目正按進度推進,預計至2027年將產生實質業務貢獻。 在業務結構方面,中探針說明目前連接器業務約占總營收6成多,半導體相關業務則占約25個百分點。隨著新產品導入,公司設定目標至2027年將半導體業務營收占比提升至3成。 CCP Contact Probes Expands Connectors into Drones and Develops MEMS Probes for 2027 Growth CCP Contact Probes expands connectors into drones; develops MEMS probes; targets 2027 operational contributions. Driven by new product introductions, the company aims to increase the revenue share of its semiconductor business segment to 30 percent by 2027. 中探針總經理馮明欽於2026年9月3日在SEMICON Taiwan表示,連接器產品已切入無人機與AI智慧眼鏡應用。 連接器產品切入無人機、人工智慧AI智慧眼鏡應用 中探針與半導體大廠研發微機電探針及清針紙,預期2027年將有實質貢獻。 與半導體大廠共同研發微機電探針(MEMS)、清針紙(clean sheet)等產品,按進度進行,預期2027年將有實質貢獻。 中探針目前連接器業績占比約6成多,半導體業務占比約25%,目標2027年半導體業務占比達3成。 目前連接器業績占比約6成多,半導體相關業務占比約25%,預估2027年半導體業務占比目標3成。

metadata.title: 日本消防廳訂購首架空中巴士H160直升機
airline: Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications

a-20260903-1025-japan-s-fire-and-disaste.text: 日本消防廳訂購首架空中巴士H160直升機 日本消防廳訂購首架空中巴士H160直升機,將駐紮熊本執行災害偵察與救援。 日本總務省消防廳已簽署單架空中巴士H160直升機的訂購合約,這是該機構首次採購這款新世代直升機。空中巴士於2026年9月3日證實此項交易,該機將加入消防廳機隊,提升日本全國的緊急應變能力與救援涵蓋範圍。 該架直升機未來將駐紮於九州地區的熊本縣,主要任務為在發生重大自然災害時執行快速空中偵察與即時視覺情報收集。該機將配備Helisat先進衛星技術以確保通訊順暢,空中巴士也正在開發專用雪地起落架以因應冬季嚴寒氣候。 目前日本全國已有四架H160直升機投入實際服役,分別執行執法、新聞採訪及地方消防任務。這次採購將使消防廳進一步強化緊急救災反應速度。 Japan Fire and Disaster Management Agency Orders First Airbus H160 Japan Fire and Disaster Management Agency orders its first Airbus H160 for disaster reconnaissance missions. Japan's Fire and Disaster Management Agency (FDMA) has signed an order for a single Airbus H160 helicopter, marking its first acquisition of the next-generation aircraft. Airbus confirmed the agreement on September 3, 2026, stating that the new helicopter will join the agency's fleet to boost emergency response speed and nationwide coverage. The H160 will be stationed in Kumamoto Prefecture in the Kyushu region. Its primary role will involve rapid aerial reconnaissance and real-time visual intelligence gathering during major natural disasters. To maintain communications during crises, the aircraft will feature Helisat satellite technology, while Airbus is also developing specialized snow landing gear for winter conditions. a-20260903-1815-ge-aerospace-secures-pen.text: 通用電氣航太獲美國國防部合約開發5馬赫極音速測試載具 通用電氣航太獲國防創新單位合約;開發5馬赫極音速載具;預計2028年首飛 通用電氣航太(GE Aerospace)已獲得美國國防創新單位(Defense Innovation Unit, DIU)頒發之合約,將負責開發一款速度可達5馬赫的空中發射極音速測試載具。該款採用液態燃料的測試載具被命名為「Derecho」,將結合火箭推進器與由通用電氣航太雙模式衝壓發動機技術驅動的巡航器。 整套Derecho載具將作為美國國防部「極音速與高頻次空中測試能力」(Hypersonic and High-Cadence Airborne Testing Capabilities, HyCAT)計畫之測試平台。通用電氣航太表示,最新獲得的合約將用於資助該載具的全機整合,以及關鍵子系統的首批資格認證與組件級測試。該公司並未公開此項國防合約的具體金額。 根據規劃,通用電氣航太目標於2028年進行Derecho載具的首次飛行測試,這也將是該公司首次在飛行中展示液態燃料雙模式衝壓發動機技術。雙模式衝壓發動機具備兼具傳統衝壓發動機與超音速燃燒衝壓發動機(scramjet)的功能,使其能在更廣泛的超音速與極音速飛行速度範圍內運作。 由於該發動機利用大氣中的氧氣進行燃燒而非自行攜帶氧化劑,此項設計有助於提升測試載具的燃料或酬載能力。Derecho的初始配置將暫不包含轉動爆震燃燒系統,但相關技術未來可能被納入該測試平台的後續升級版本中。 通用電氣航太最初於2023年透過其在2022年收購的Innoveering公司參與HyCAT計畫,並於2025年完成全套載具的初步設計審查。美國國防部推動HyCAT計畫旨在提高極音速飛行測試的頻率並降低相關成本,用以支援能在極音速狀態下搭載實驗性推進系統、感測器、通訊設備及導引技術之測試載具開發。 GE Aerospace Secures Pentagon DIU Contract for Mach 5 Hypersonic Test Vehicle GE Aerospace wins US Defense contract to develop Mach 5 hypersonic test vehicle for 2028 flight test. GE Aerospace has received a contract from the US Defense Innovation Unit (DIU) to develop an air-launched hypersonic test vehicle capable of reaching Mach 5. Known as Derecho, the liquid-fueled vehicle will combine a rocket booster with a cruiser powered by GE Aerospace's dual-mode ramjet technology. The integrated vehicle will serve as an airborne testing platform for the Pentagon's Hypersonic and High-Cadence Airborne Testing Capabilities (HyCAT) program. According to statement details released by GE Aerospace, the latest contract will fund full vehicle integration alongside initial qualification and component-level subsystem testing for key flight components. The company did not disclose the specific monetary value of the Pentagon defense contract. The initiative supports national defense priorities through scalable hypersonic testing capabilities. The aerospace manufacturer is targeting 2028 for the initial flight of the Derecho vehicle, which will mark its first flight demonstration of liquid-fueled dual-mode ramjet technology. Dual-mode ramjets are designed to function as both conventional ramjets and scramjets, allowing efficient operation across a wide operational spectrum of supersonic and hypersonic speeds. By utilizing atmospheric oxygen for internal engine combustion rather than carrying an onboard oxidizer, the propulsion system design allows test vehicles to carry additional fuel or larger payloads. Derecho's initial baseline configuration will not include rotating detonation combustion technology, though the subsystem could potentially be integrated into future production variants of the test platform. GE Aerospace originally began working on the HyCAT program in 2023 following its 2022 acquisition of Innoveering, advancing through preliminary design review in 2025. metadata.title: 亞航首度代碼共享合作夥伴飛馬航空 開闢五歐洲目的地

a-20260903-1815-airasia-launches-first-c.text: 亞航首度代碼共享合作夥伴飛馬航空 開闢五歐洲目的地 亞航與飛馬航空代碼共享啟動;吉隆坡經伊斯坦堡通往五歐洲城市 亞航集團宣布與土耳其低成本航空公司飛馬航空建立首度代碼共享合作夥伴關係,雙方於2026年9月2日正式簽署協議,將亞航在東南亞與亞洲的廣泛航點網絡,透過伊斯坦堡薩比哈·格克琴國際機場(SAW)連接飛馬航空覆蓋的歐洲航線。 此代碼共享首階段開放五個歐洲目的地,旅客可從吉隆坡國際機場(KUL)經伊斯坦堡前往莫斯科伏努科沃國際機場(VKO)及雅典國際機場(ATH)等城市,採單一機票與聯程託運行李,無需在伊斯坦堡轉機時提取並重新辦理行李。 為支撐擴展聯運,亞航計畫將吉隆坡至伊斯坦堡航班頻率由每週四班增至每週七班,預計2027年2月實現每日一班;亞航X早於2025年11月已開航吉隆坡直飛伊斯坦堡航線。 亞航集團執行長Bo Lingum表示,此合作是亞航邁向「真正全球旅遊網絡」的重要里程碑,正值亞航成立25週年;飛馬航空執行長Gulis Ozturk則強調伊斯坦堡作為歐亞天然樞紐的優勢,雙向聯運將惠及雙方旅客。 配合啟動,亞航推出優惠單程票價,吉隆坡經伊斯坦堡飛五歐洲目的地最低馬幣799元(約180美元),歐洲反向飛吉隆坡最低199美元,倫敦史坦斯特最低299美元;優惠購票期9月2日至6日,適用出發至2027年3月27日,含稅費與20公斤託運行李額度,可透過AirAsia MOVE平台訂購。 AirAsia launches first codeshare with Pegasus, opens five European destinations AirAsia partners with Pegasus on first codeshare; five European cities via Istanbul from Kuala Lumpur AirAsia Group announced its first-ever codeshare partnership with Turkish low-cost carrier Pegasus Airlines on September 2, 2026, linking AirAsia's extensive network across ASEAN and Asia with Pegasus' European reach via Istanbul Sabiha Gökçen International Airport (SAW). The codeshare initially opens five European destinations accessible from Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KUL) via Istanbul, including Moscow Vnukovo (VKO) and Athens (ATH). Passengers can travel on a single ticket with through-checked baggage, eliminating the need to reclaim and recheck luggage during the Istanbul stopover. To support the expanded connectivity, AirAsia will increase the frequency of its Kuala Lumpur-Istanbul route from four to seven flights per week by February 2027, making it a daily service. AirAsia X first launched direct flights between Kuala Lumpur and Istanbul in November 2025. AirAsia Group CEO Bo Lingum called the partnership a significant milestone in the airline's 25th anniversary year, describing it as a new chapter in AirAsia's evolution into a truly global travel network. Pegasus Airlines CEO Gulis Ozturk said the collaboration reflects the strength of Pegasus' network built from Istanbul over two decades, calling Sabiha Gökçen Airport a natural link between Europe and Asia. To mark the launch, AirAsia is offering promotional one-way fares from Kuala Lumpur to the five European destinations via Istanbul starting from MYR 799 (US$180). Fares from Europe to Kuala Lumpur start from US$199 one-way, with London Stansted fares from US$299. The promotion runs from September 2 to 6, 2026, for travel through March 27, 2027, and includes departure fees, fuel surcharges, and a 20 kg checked baggage allowance.
