metadata.title: 捷藍航空發表區域頭等艙BlueFirst 預計9月起改裝空中巴士機隊

a-20260903-2131-jetblue-unveils-bluefirs.text: 捷藍航空發表區域頭等艙BlueFirst 預計9月起改裝空中巴士機隊 捷藍航空發表國內頭等艙BlueFirst;預計2028年前完成客艙改裝。 美國捷藍航空(JetBlue)正式發表名為「BlueFirst」的全新區域頭等艙產品,標誌著該航空公司首次在其無機載「Mint」商務艙的國內航線上推出傳統頭等艙座椅。這項新產品將首度引進至捷藍航空未配置Mint商務艙的空中巴士A220、空中巴士A320(ICAO機型代碼A320)以及空中巴士A321(ICAO機型代碼A321)客機機隊,為廣大國內線旅客提供更高等級的搭乘選擇與舒適體驗。 根據捷藍航空公佈的規劃與相關監管進展,該營運項目已取得美國聯邦航空總署(FAA)的認證。首架客機的艙房改裝工程預定於2026年9月21日正式展開,並預計於2028年前完成全機隊的改裝作業。全新BlueFirst客艙產品預計於2026年稍晚開始投入實際航班營運,相關機位預訂服務則規劃於今年秋季正式對外開放。 在座椅硬體規格方面,BlueFirst客艙採用每排兩座位的「二對二」(2-2)配置,規劃於客艙前方二至四排。新座椅具備5英吋傾斜角度,並提供較標準經濟艙增加多達7英吋的腿部伸展空間。此外,該座椅特別選用由床墊製造商Tuft & Needle開發的T&N Flex專利泡棉,以提升乘客在飛行過程中的支撐力與舒適度。 客艙娛樂與個人設備方面,每張BlueFirst座椅皆配備13.3吋個人視訊螢幕,支援藍牙無線耳機連接功能,並附設USB-A、USB-C充電埠與110伏特標準電源插座。旅客可透過個人螢幕使用「座艙點餐」系統選購餐點與調酒,且飛行距離達899英哩(含)以上的航班將提供包含主餐、副餐與甜點的便當風格餐盒。所有BlueFirst乘客並可繼續享有免費Fly-Fi高速機上Wi-Fi網路服務。 購買BlueFirst機票的旅客將享有優質的地勤與搭機服務,包括第1組優先登機、專屬頭等艙頂棚行李置物空間、優先辦理報到手續,以及在超過30座機場使用快速安檢通道。此外,乘客亦可享有兩件免費托運行李及行李優先提領服務。捷藍航空執行長Joanna Geraghty表示,國內頭等艙市場需要創新,客戶對高階體驗的需求持續成長,BlueFirst將為旅客提供兼具精緻服務與高價值的升級體驗。 JetBlue Unveils BlueFirst Domestic First Class Cabin With Fleet Retrofit by 2028 JetBlue unveils its new BlueFirst domestic first-class cabin, planning full fleet retrofits by 2028. JetBlue has unveiled "BlueFirst," its first traditional domestic first-class cabin, marking a major product shift for the carrier as it introduces dedicated first-class seating across its broader domestic network. The new cabin will be retrofitted across JetBlue's aircraft fleet that do not feature its flagship lie-flat Mint business class, specifically targeting its Airbus A220, Airbus A320 (ICAO type code A320), and Airbus A321 (ICAO type code A321) narrowbody aircraft. With Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) certification already secured, the airline is scheduled to begin its first aircraft modification on September 21, 2026. JetBlue aims to complete a full fleet retrofit by 2028. Flights featuring the new BlueFirst product are scheduled to commence later in 2026, with customer ticket bookings set to open in the fall. The carrier noted that details regarding specific inaugural routes, fares, and initial aircraft types will be released later this year. The BlueFirst cabin design features recliner seats arranged in a two-by-two configuration spanning two to four rows depending on the aircraft type. The seats offer five inches of recline and up to seven inches of additional legroom compared to JetBlue's main cabin seating. To maximize passenger comfort, the seats incorporate custom-designed T&N Flex foam developed in partnership with mattress manufacturer Tuft & Needle, along with adjustable headrests and high-backed privacy shells. In terms of inflight technology and amenities, each seat is equipped with a 13.3-inch seatback entertainment screen featuring Bluetooth headphone connectivity, USB-A and USB-C charging ports, and a standard 110-volt power outlet. Passengers can utilize seatback screen ordering for onboard food and drinks, including a "Mixologist Mode" for custom beverage orders. On flights covering at least 899 miles, JetBlue will serve bento-style meals, complemented by free access to the airline's high-speed Fly-Fi internet service. Passengers traveling in the BlueFirst cabin will receive premium ground and airport privileges, including Group 1 priority boarding, dedicated overhead bin space, priority check-in, and access to expedited security lanes at more than 30 airports. The ticket includes two free checked bags with priority baggage delivery services. JetBlue Chief Executive Officer Joanna Geraghty stated that customers are increasingly seeking premium travel experiences, and that BlueFirst offers an elevated product tailored to deliver strong customer value. a-20260903-2342-boeing-737-max-7-receive.text: 波音737 MAX 7小型客機正式獲認證 暫不立即投入營運 波音737 MAX 7客機獲認證;暫不立即投入營運;主要將由西南航空營運。 據 Simple Flying 報導,波音公司(Boeing)旗下民航機產品線中最小型的機型 737 MAX 7,目前已正式獲得航空監管機構認證。然而,取得這項關鍵認證並不意味著 737 MAX 7 機型會立即投入客運服務。 根據過往公開紀錄顯示,波音公司先前暫未向歐洲航空安全組織申請該機型的相應認證。該款客機未來預計將幾乎完全由美國西南航空(Southwest Airlines)負責營運。波音先前預估在 2026 年取得認證後,首批機隊將於 2027 年展開交付。 Boeing 737 MAX 7 Receives Certification But Will Not Enter Service Immediately Boeing 737 MAX 7 achieves certification; entry into service not immediate; aircraft destined mainly for Southwest Airlines. According to a report from Simple Flying, Boeing's smallest variant in the 737 MAX family, the 737 MAX 7, has officially achieved certification. However, securing official certification from regulators does not mean that the single-aisle aircraft will enter commercial revenue service immediately. According to historical aviation records, Boeing previously chose not to pursue certification approval for the 737 MAX 7 from European regulatory authorities at this stage. The aircraft model will be operated almost entirely by Southwest Airlines. Furthermore, Boeing had previously stated in July that it anticipated receiving official certification in 2026, with the first delivery expected to take place in 2027. 波音737 MAX 7客機已正式獲得認證。 Boeing's Smallest 737 MAX Is Finally Certified 取得認證並不代表737 MAX 7會立即投入服務。 Getting the certification does not mean the MAX 7 will enter service immediately. 波音先前暫未向歐洲航空安全局申請737 MAX 7的認證許可。 Why Boeing Skipped EASA Approval For The 737 MAX 7 For Now 737 MAX 7機型未來預計將幾乎完全由西南航空營運。 The aircraft will be operated almost entirely by Southwest Airlines. 波音截至7月預計於2026年取得認證,並於2027年展開首次交付。 The company continues to anticipate certification in 2026 and first delivery in 2027 for both variants.

metadata.title: REGENT完成Viceroy載人地效翼水上飛機首次試飛

a-20260904-0733-regent-completes-first-h.text: REGENT完成Viceroy載人地效翼水上飛機首次試飛 REGENT在羅德島州完成Viceroy地效翼水上飛機首次載人試飛;飛行30秒 水上飛機製造商REGENT於2026年9月2日宣佈,已成功完成旗下Viceroy地效翼水上飛機的首次載人飛行測試。根據AeroTime報導,本次試飛地點位於REGENT總部所在地美國羅德島州的納拉甘西特灣(Narragansett Bay),標誌著該款純電動客運載具邁入新的測試階段。 在本次於納拉甘西特灣進行的試飛過程中,Viceroy地效翼水上飛機共搭載2名機組人員。該載具在水面上方33英呎(約10公尺)的高度飛行了30秒,飛行距離達到1,956英呎(約596公尺)。在此次載人試飛之前,REGENT已對Viceroy進行了船體水上測試與水翼(hydrofoils)測試。水翼能在風浪較大的海況下提供穩定性,並在載具加速時協助過渡至完全飛行的狀態。 Viceroy採用全電動動力系統,利用稱為「地面效應」(ground effect)的氣動力學原理,設計載客量高達12名乘客,能在海面上方以高達每小時180英里(約289公里)的速度掠海飛行。隨著此次試飛完成,Viceroy成為載人飛行的最大型全電動地面效應載具。相較之下,蘇聯於1970年代運行的大型載人實驗性地效翼載具(即地效飛行器)則採用傳統動力,且專用於軍事用途。 在此次載人試飛完成的前兩天,REGENT才剛宣佈完成金額達2.4億美元的B輪融資,相關資金將用於加速其地效翼水上飛機計劃的開發進程。此外,REGENT亦於2026年期間,針對名為Squire的較小型無人地效翼載具進行了飛行測試,該載具主要設計應用於軍事領域。 REGENT Completes First Human-Crewed Flight of Viceroy Seaglider REGENT completes the first human-crewed flight test of its Viceroy ground-effect seaglider in Rhode Island. Seaglider developer REGENT announced on September 2, 2026, that it has successfully completed the first human-crewed flight test of its Viceroy wing-in-ground effect craft. According to reporting by AeroTime, the inaugural flight test was conducted over Narragansett Bay in Rhode Island, where REGENT is headquartered, representing a significant technical operational step for the electric passenger craft program. During the milestone flight test on Narragansett Bay, the Viceroy seaglider operated with a crew of two individuals on board. The craft sustained flight above the water for 30 seconds, traversing a total distance of 1,956 feet (596 meters) while maintaining an elevation of 33 feet (10 meters) above the sea surface. Prior to achieving this human-crewed flight, REGENT had engaged in preliminary testing, evaluating the vehicle with its hull directly on the water as well as on hydrofoil fins designed to provide stability in choppy sea conditions and support the transition to full aerodynamic ground-effect flight as the vehicle accelerates. The Viceroy is designed as an all-electric craft capable of accommodating up to 12 passengers while skimming over the ocean surface at speed up to 180 mph (289 km/h). The craft utilizes an aerodynamic principle known as ground effect to operate close to the water. With the successful completion of this test, the Viceroy becomes the largest all-electric wing-in-ground-effect vehicle to fly with human occupants on board. Larger historical crewed wing-in-ground craft, such as Soviet ekranoplans from the 1970s, relied on conventional military propulsion rather than electric power. The successful test flight follows additional corporate and program milestones for REGENT. Just two days prior to completing the crewed flight, the company announced the successful closing of a $240 million Series B funding round dedicated to accelerating the development of its broader wing-in-ground seaglider program. In addition to the Viceroy development, REGENT has also conducted flight tests in 2026 for Squire, a smaller uncrewed wing-in-ground effect vehicle designed for potential military applications. metadata.title: 美國FAA完成第100座塔台地面意識系統部署 涵蓋近半預定機場

a-20260904-0733-faa-deploys-surface-awar.text: 美國FAA完成第100座塔台地面意識系統部署 涵蓋近半預定機場 FAA完成第100座塔台地面意識系統部署;2026年底前預計再擴增44座機場。 美國運輸部長肖恩·杜菲(Sean P. Duffy)於2026年9月2日宣布,美國聯邦航空管理局(FAA)已完成第100座飛航管制塔台的地面意識倡議(Surface Awareness Initiative,簡稱SAI)系統部署。該系統為一款針對地面航空器與車輛的監控工具,本次部署完成標誌著該計畫邁入新里程碑,目前已覆蓋預計接收該系統的220座機場中接近一半的數量。 SAI系統旨在提升跑道運作效率,並協助飛航管制員確保航空地面作業安全。該技術主要利用來自航空器與車輛的廣播式自動監視(ADS-B)數據,使管制員能夠即時掌握機場地面的交通狀況。即使在惡劣天氣條件下或航空器處於管制塔台視線死角時,管制員仍可透過該系統進行實時動態追蹤。 目前SAI系統已在全美100座飛航管制塔台投入運作。近期完成安裝營運的機場包括安阿伯市立機場(Ann Arbor Municipal Airport(ARB))、比靈斯-洛根國際機場(Billings-Logan International Airport(BIL))、海港-比洛克西國際機場(Gulfport-Biloxi International Airport(GPT))、格林維爾-斯帕坦堡國際機場(Greenville-Spartanburg International Airport(GSP))以及科珀斯克里斯蒂國際機場(Corpus Christi International Airport(CRP))。FAA計畫在2026年底前,繼續將該系統擴展安裝至另外44座機場。 除了SAI系統之外,FAA亦持續在全美各地機場與飛航設施推護其他具備靈活度與成本效益的跑道監控技術。其中,進場跑道確認系統(Approach Runway Verification)的部署速度已提升至原本的三倍,目前已在超過260處飛航設施上線運作;跑道入侵警示裝置(Runway Incursion Device)則已在全美超過56座飛航管制塔台投入使用。 FAA Deploys Surface Awareness Initiative System to 100th Airport Control Tower The FAA has installed its 100th Surface Awareness Initiative system, targeting 44 more airports by late 2026. U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy announced on September 2, 2026, that the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has completed the installation of its 100th Surface Awareness Initiative (SAI) tool at air traffic control towers. SAI is a surveillance system designed for aircraft and vehicles on the ground. This deployment marks a key milestone in the agency's air traffic control overhaul, covering nearly half of the 220 airports slated to receive the technology. The SAI tool is engineered to enhance runway efficiency and support air traffic controllers in maintaining operational safety. Utilizing Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast (ADS-B) data transmitted from aircraft and ground vehicles, the system enables controllers to monitor surface movement in real time. This capability assists controllers during adverse weather conditions or when aircraft are positioned out of direct line of sight from the control tower. SAI is now operational at 100 control towers across the nation. Among the most recent installations are Ann Arbor Municipal Airport (ARB), Billings-Logan International Airport (BIL), Gulfport-Biloxi International Airport (GPT), Greenville-Spartanburg International Airport (GSP), and Corpus Christi International Airport (CRP). The FAA plans to expand the installation of SAI to an additional 44 airports by the end of 2026. In addition to the SAI rollout, the FAA is continuing the deployment of other agile and cost-effective surface surveillance systems across national air traffic facilities. The agency has tripled the deployment speed of Approach Runway Verification technology, which is now operational at more than 260 air traffic facilities. Additionally, the Runway Incursion Device is currently active at more than 56 air traffic control towers. U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean P. a-20260904-1223-us-air-force-retires-ec-.text: 美國空軍EC-130H電戰機完成最後飛行正式退役 美國空軍EC-130H型電戰機完成最後飛行;由新一代EA-37B接替任務 美國空軍(USAF)於2026年9月2日在亞利桑那州戴維斯-蒙森空軍基地完成EC-130H Compass Call電戰機的最後一次飛行任務,正式宣告該款服役逾40年的主力電子攻擊機退役。這次最後飛行標誌著該型機數十年第一線作戰任務的終結。 在最後的飛行任務中,EC-130H與接替其任務的新一代EA-37B Compass Call電戰機同台亮相。根據美國空軍第355聯隊發布的資訊,這是兩種新舊電戰機首次進行編隊飛行。戴維斯-蒙森空軍基地為第55電子戰群的所在地,該單位長期負責操作與管理美軍整個EC-130H機隊。 EC-130H型電戰機於1980年代初期開始服役,由C-130 Hercules運輸機深度改裝而成,總計改裝了14架機體。該型機主要用於干擾敵方的通信、雷達及導航訊號,並執行壓制敵方防空系統任務。第355聯隊指出,僅在過去20年間,EC-130H機組人員即已累積超過7萬6000小時的實戰飛行時數。 作為後繼機型的EA-37B電戰機採用灣流(Gulfstream)G550商務機為基礎平台,機上乘員數為9人,少於EC-130H所需的13人機組。在Compass Call任務轉移計畫下,舊款EC-130H上約70%的任務核心設備被直接轉移安裝至新機體上,以維持電戰能力的延續性。 在2027財政年度的預算申請中,美國空軍已提出6.6億美元預算申請,預計採購額外3架EA-37B,並計畫在2031年前再增購7架。若相關計畫獲得國會完全撥款,未來EA-37B機隊規模將達到22架,超過原先EC-130H機隊的14架規模。 US Air Force Retires EC-130H Compass Call After Final Flight in Arizona The US Air Force retired its EC-130H Compass Call fleet following a final flight in Arizona. The United States Air Force officially retired its EC-130H Compass Call electronic attack aircraft following the platform's final operational flight on September 2, 2026. The historic final sortie took place at Davis-Monthan Air Force Base in Arizona, ending more than four decades of continuous service for the specialized military airframe. During the final Arizona sortie, the EC-130H flew alongside its designated successor, the EA-37B Compass Call. According to official imagery and statements from the 355th Wing, this flight represented the first time both electronic warfare aircraft types flew together in formation. The 55th Electronic Combat Group, based at Davis-Monthan, operated the entire legacy EC-130H fleet throughout its service life. Entering front-line military service in the early 1980s as a heavily modified variant of the C-130 Hercules transport, a total of 14 EC-130H airframes were produced. The specialized aircraft was developed to jam adversary communications, radar, and navigation signals, while also supporting the suppression of enemy air defenses. Aircrews operating the fleet accumulated more than 76,000 combat hours over the past two decades. The replacement EA-37B aircraft is based on the Gulfstream G550 business jet platform and is operated by a crew of nine personnel, compared to the 13-person crew required for the EC-130H. Under the Compass Call Rehost program, approximately 70% of the mission equipment from the older EC-130H platform is being transferred directly to the new EA-37B airframes to preserve operational capabilities. In its fiscal year 2027 budget submission, the Air Force requested $660 million to procure three additional EA-37B jets, alongside plans to acquire seven more through 2031. If Congress fully funds these budget requests, the Air Force plans to expand the overall EA-37B fleet to 22 aircraft, surpassing the original 14-aircraft footprint of the retired EC-130H platform. metadata.title: DHL與樟宜機場(SIN)合作打造醫療保健冷鏈物流樞紐

a-20260904-1223-dhl-global-forwarding-to.text: DHL與樟宜機場(SIN)合作打造醫療保健冷鏈物流樞紐 DHL全球貨運於新加坡樟宜機場設立醫療冷鏈樞紐,預計2027年底完工。 樟宜機場(SIN)集團(CAG)宣布,DHL全球貨運(DHL Global Forwarding)將於新加坡樟宜機場設立專用的醫療保健物流設施「DHL新加坡冷鏈樞紐」(DHL Singapore Coldchain Hub)。該設施將位於樟宜航空貨運中心的 Changi Nexus One 大樓內,預估將於2027年底前完工啟用。 該座占地 3,047 平方公尺的物流樞紐將依照優良分銷規範(GDP)標準建造,旨在維護經過新加坡及周邊地區醫療貨物的完整冷鏈。設施將配置符合 GDP 資格的冷藏室、即時溫度監控系統,以及直通空側的運送能力,提供從航機至設施再到客戶倉庫的全程溫控運輸解決方案,支援 2°C 至 8°C 與 15°C 至 25°C 的控溫貨物需求。 該設施所在的 Changi Nexus One 為一座物流建築,提供近 8,000 平方公尺的倉儲空間與停機坪直連設施,並為樟宜機場首座獲得 BCA 綠建標章白金級(BCA Green Mark Platinum)與白金級正能源建築認證的建築物。新樞紐將補充樟宜機場既有溫控設施,包含溫控拖車與超過 9,000 平方公尺的空側溫控處理能力,該等設施每年支援超過 37.5 萬噸貨物。 此項新投資屬於敦豪集團(DHL Group)在「2030策略」計畫下向其 DHL 醫療保健物流部門承諾的 20 億歐元(約 22 億美元)投資的一部分,旨在透過擴建基礎設施與專業解決方案推動全球生命科學及醫療保健領域的成長。 敦豪全球貨運新加坡、馬來西亞暨印度尼西亞執行長 Praveen Gregory 表示,亞太地區對生物製劑與特種藥品的需求正在增加,該樞紐對滿足未來供應鏈需求至關重要。樟宜機場集團空運樞紐與貨運發展執行副總裁 Lim Ching Kiat 則強調,該設施深化了雙方長期合作夥伴關係,並有助於發揮樟宜機場在航空連通性與專門貨運處理方面的優勢。 DHL Global Forwarding to Build Healthcare Cold Chain Hub at Changi Airport (SIN) DHL Global Forwarding will build a healthcare cold chain facility at Singapore Changi Airport by late 2027. Changi Airport (SIN) Group (CAG) has announced that DHL Global Forwarding will establish a dedicated healthcare logistics facility, named the DHL Singapore Coldchain Hub, at Singapore's Changi Airport. The new facility will be located at Changi Nexus One within the Changi Airfreight Centre and is targeted for completion by the end of 2027. Spanning 3,047 square meters, the hub will be designed in accordance with Good Distribution Practice (GDP) standards to handle healthcare and life sciences shipments requiring controlled temperatures of 2°C to 8°C and 15°C to 25°C. It will feature GDP-qualified cold rooms, direct airside connectivity, real-time temperature monitoring, and dedicated temperature-controlled transfer solutions operating from aircraft to the facility and onwards to customer warehouses. The hub will be situated inside Changi Nexus One, an air logistics building offering close to 8,000 square meters of warehousing space and direct apron connectivity for accelerated cargo handling. Changi Nexus One is the first building at Changi Airport to achieve both BCA Green Mark Platinum and Green Mark Platinum Positive Energy Building certifications. The facility will complement existing airport infrastructure, which includes cool dollies and over 9,000 square meters of airside temperature-controlled handling capacity supporting more than 375,000 tons annually. This investment forms part of DHL Group's broader 2 billion euro (2.2 billion US dollars) commitment to its DHL Health Logistics division under its Strategy 2030 plan. The broader strategy targets growth in the life sciences and healthcare sectors by expanding infrastructure, specialized cargo solutions, and global logistics capabilities. Praveen Gregory, CEO of DHL Global Forwarding for Singapore, Malaysia, and Indonesia, noted that regional healthcare supply chains are evolving rapidly amid growing demand for biologics and specialty medicines, making the new hub essential for future supply chain resilience. Lim Ching Kiat, Executive Vice President of Air Hub and Cargo Development at Changi Airport Group, added that the project deepens a longstanding partnership while leveraging Changi's air connectivity and cargo handling capabilities. metadata.title: 香料航空引進20架租賃客機 冬季每日航班預計擴增至200班

a-20260904-1640-spicejet-finalizes-deal-.text: 香料航空引進20架租賃客機 冬季每日航班預計擴增至200班 香料航空租賃20架客機擴充機隊;預計冬季每日營運約200班航班。 印度低成本航空公司香料航空(SpiceJet)已與三家客機營運商達成協議,將在2026年10月中旬至11月中旬之間引進20架租賃客機,以在冬季旅遊旺季前重建營運運能。本次引進的機隊涵蓋15架波音(Boeing)客機與5架空中巴士(Airbus)客機,並採用濕租(wet lease)與濕混租(damp lease)的方式營運,以投入國內與國際航線。 香料航空目前的活躍營運機隊僅有11架客機。在新增20架租賃客機後,其營運機隊規模將擴增至約31架,並可支援冬季班表提升至每日約200個航班。引進的5架空中巴士客機中包含具備較高載客量的空中巴士A321(ICAO機型代碼A321),能在高需求航線上提供額外座位,並與15架波音客機一同服役。 香料航空商務長德博喬·馬哈爾西(Debojo Maharshi)指出,引進這20架客機將使航空公司能夠強化航網、增加航班頻率,並於旺季期間提供更多出行選擇。在濕租架構下,出租方通常提供飛機、機組員、維修與保險;濕混租則由出租方提供飛機與飛行員,並由香料航空提供客艙組員。兩種租賃型態均可協助航空公司相較乾租或新機交付更快速地補充運能。 本次機隊擴充背景為香料航空先前因出租人回收飛機與長期停飛,導致活躍機隊規模大幅縮減。該航空公司先前曾透過濕混租柬埔寨吳哥航空(Sky Angkor Airlines)的空中巴士A320客機來維持營運。香料航空預計將從德爾加女神節(Durga Puja)帶動的冬季需求高峰開始部署這批客機,並持續營運至隨後的夏季旅遊旺季。 SpiceJet to Lease 20 Aircraft to Expand Winter Operations to 200 Daily Flights SpiceJet finalized agreements to lease 20 aircraft for the winter schedule, targeting 200 daily flights. Indian low-cost carrier SpiceJet has finalized agreements with three aircraft operators to lease 20 aircraft under wet- and damp-lease arrangements ahead of the winter travel season. Deliveries are scheduled to take place in phases between mid-October and mid-November 2026. The lease package consists of 15 Boeing aircraft and five Airbus aircraft to support domestic and international services. SpiceJet currently operates an active operational fleet of 11 aircraft. Adding 20 leased jets will increase its operational fleet to approximately 31 aircraft, enabling the airline to expand its overall schedule to around 200 flights per day during the winter period. The five Airbus aircraft included in the deal will feature the higher-capacity Airbus A321 (ICAO type code A321), providing extra seat capacity on high-demand routes alongside the 15 Boeing aircraft. SpiceJet Chief Business Officer Debojo Maharshi stated that bringing in these 20 aircraft will allow the carrier to strengthen its network, add flight frequencies, and offer more travel options during peak travel periods. Under a wet lease structure, the lessor typically provides the aircraft, crew, maintenance, and insurance, while a damp lease sees the lessor supply the aircraft and flight crew with the leasing carrier providing cabin staff. Both lease types enable the airline to introduce operational capacity more rapidly than through dry leases or new deliveries. The fleet expansion follows a sharp drop in SpiceJet's active operational fleet due to aircraft returns to lessors and long-term groundings. The carrier previously utilized short-term leases, including Airbus A320 aircraft damp-leased from Cambodia's Sky Angkor Airlines, to supplement its flying schedule. The carrier intends to operate the newly leased aircraft through the festive winter schedule—starting around the Durga Puja festival—and retain them into the following summer travel season. a-20260904-1640-air-india-a320neo-loses-.text: 印度航空A320neo巡航時三套液壓系統失效 24傷 印度航空A320neo三液壓系統失效 24傷 機長藥檢呈陽性 印度航空一架空中巴士A320neo(註冊號VT-EXO)於2026年8月4日執飛AI2379航班,從普吉國際機場(HKT)前往英迪拉·甘地國際機場(DEL),在36,000呎巡航時,三套液壓系統在4秒內相繼失壓。印度航空器事故調查局(AAIB)初步報告指出,綠色液壓系統於UTC 04:02:43失壓,4秒後藍色與黃色系統也失壓,導致自動駕駛於04:02:48斷開,失速警告於04:02:51鳴響2秒。 飛機隨後爬升372呎超過指定高度,隨後下降292呎低於指定高度,總垂直偏離達664呎。液壓壓力在數秒內恢復,藍色系統於04:02:52左右恢復,黃色與綠色系統隨後恢復。AAIB指出三套系統相互獨立,無液體轉移。 事發時繫安全帶指示關閉,導致20名乘客與4名機組人員受傷,其中4人傷勢嚴重住院。機組決定繼續飛往德里,於UTC 05:30降落。機艙受損包括天花板面板破裂、行李艙門脫落、緊急出口把手斷裂及廁所馬桶脫離固定。 飛行員與空管均未報告惡劣天氣。根據印度民航局(DGCA)要求,因航班起飛地在印度境外,兩名飛行員抵達後接受檢測。酒精測試合格,但機長精神活性物質篩查呈非陰性,確認性血液檢測亦同;副駕駛兩項測試均陰性。報告未披露檢出物質。 AAIB發布暫時安全建議,要求DGCA打擊精神活性物質濫用,稱此發現屬嚴重關切,但未將機長檢測結果與液壓失效建立關聯。該機於7月28日依最低裝備清單(MEL)延派動力傳輸單元(PTU),AAIB記錄該延派但未認定與失壓有關。空中巴士專家透過法國民航安全調查分析局(BEA)於8月13至15日檢查飛機,液壓部件與油樣已送測。 Air India A320neo loses all three hydraulic systems at 36,000 ft; 24 injured Air India A320neo loses three hydraulic systems; 24 injured; captain tests positive for psychoactive substance An Air India Airbus A320neo (registration VT-EXO) operating flight AI2379 from Phuket International Airport (HKT) to Indira Gandhi International Airport (DEL) lost pressure in all three hydraulic systems within four seconds while cruising at 36,000 feet on August 4, 2026. India's Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau (AAIB) preliminary report states the green system pressure loss was detected at 04:02:43 UTC, followed by the blue and yellow systems four seconds later. The autopilot disengaged at 04:02:48 UTC and a stall warning sounded for two seconds at 04:02:51 UTC. The aircraft climbed 372 feet above its assigned altitude and then descended 292 feet below, a total vertical excursion of 664 feet. Hydraulic pressure returned within seconds, with the blue system recovering at approximately 04:02:52 UTC, followed by the yellow and green systems. The AAIB noted the three systems are independent, with separate reservoirs and no fluid transfer. The seat belt signs were off at the time. Twenty passengers and four cabin crew received medical attention after landing in Delhi at 05:30 UTC, with four people hospitalized for serious injuries. Cabin damage included cracked ceiling panels, dislodged overhead bin doors, a broken emergency exit handle, and a lavatory commode torn from its mounting. Neither the flight crew nor air traffic control reported adverse weather. Under DGCA Civil Aviation Requirements for flights originating outside India, both pilots underwent post-flight medical checks. Breath analyzer results were satisfactory, but the captain's psychoactive substance screening returned a non-negative result, confirmed by a laboratory blood test; the co-pilot tested negative in both screenings. The report does not identify the substance. The AAIB issued an interim safety recommendation urging the DGCA to act against psychoactive substance abuse, calling the finding a serious concern, but drew no link between the captain's test result and the hydraulic failure. The aircraft had been dispatched from Phuket on July 28 under a Minimum Equipment List item covering the power transfer unit, an auxiliary pressure source for the green and yellow systems; the AAIB recorded the deferral but made no connection to the pressure losses. Airbus specialists, working through France's BEA, examined the aircraft from August 13 to 15, and hydraulic components and fluid samples have been removed for testing. AAIB found Air India A320neo lost pressure in all three hydraulic systems within four seconds at 36,000 feet on August 4, 2026. India’s Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau (AAIB) has found that an Air India Airbus A320neo lost pressure in all three of its hydraulic systems within four seconds while cruising at 36,000 feet. The incident, which occurred on August 4, 2026 Flight AI2379 operated by VT-EXO from Phuket (HKT) to Delhi (DEL) with 145 people on board. The aircraft, registered VT-EXO, was operating flight AI2379 from Phuket International Airport (HKT) to Indira Gandhi International Airport (DEL) in Delhi with 145 people on board. Green hydraulic pressure loss at 04:02:43 UTC, blue and yellow loss four seconds later; autopilot disengaged at 04:02:48 UTC; stall warning at 04:02:51 UTC. According to the preliminary report , the flight control system detected a loss of green hydraulic pressure at 04:02:43 UTC. Four seconds later, it also registered the loss of the blue and yellow systems. The autopilot disengaged at 04:02:48 UTC, and a stall warning sounded for two seconds at 04:02:51 UTC. Aircraft climbed 372 feet above assigned level then descended 292 feet below, total vertical excursion 664 feet. The aircraft climbed 372 feet above its assigned level and then descended 292 feet below it, a total vertical excursion of 664 feet. 20 passengers and 4 cabin crew injured, 4 hospitalized with serious injuries. The seat belt signs were off at the time of the event. As a consequence, twenty passengers and four cabin crew received medical attention after landing in Delhi, where four people with serious injuries were hospitalized. Captain's psychoactive substance screening non-negative, confirmatory blood test also non-negative; co-pilot negative; AAIB issued interim safety recommendation to DGCA on psychoactive substance abuse. However, the captain’s psychoactive substance screening returned a non-negative result, as did a confirmatory laboratory test on a blood sample. The report does not identify the substance detected. The co-pilot tested negative in both screenings. The AAIB issued an interim safety recommendation calling on the DGCA to act against psychoactive substance abuse, describing the finding as a serious concern.

a-20260904-1640-all-nippon-airways-final.text: 全日空確認追加訂購八架E190-E2訂單 全日空確認追加八架E190-E2;價值6.42億美元;2028年起交付 巴西航空工業於2026年9月3日發布聲明,確認全日空控股已在2025年合約基礎上再下單八架E190-E2,並在聲明中指出「On September 3, 2026, Embraer issued a statement confirming that ANA Holdings had placed a second order for additional E190-E2s on top of the contract from 2025.」。 根據在東京證券交易所披露的SEC文件,這八架飛機價值6.42億美元(約1,050億日圓),文件載明「A SEC Filing , disclosed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, placed the price of the eight aircraft at $642 million (Y105 billion).」。 全日空控股表示,首批飛機預計在2028財年開始交付,追加的八架E190-E2則安排在2029至2032年間陸續到貨,原文稱「Deliveries of the first aircraft are expected to commence in the 2028 fiscal year, while the eight additional E190-E2s are scheduled to arrive from 2029 to 2032, according to ANA Holdings.」。 全日空控股社長兼執行長柴田浩二指出:「This additional E190-E2 order accelerates our efforts to build a sustainable regional aviation network in Japan... It also underscores our confidence in Embraer’s technology to reduce both environmental impact and operating costs.」,強調訂單將加速日本地區航空網絡建設並降低環境影響與營運成本。 巴西航空工業商用飛機部門社長兼執行長Arjan Meijer回應:「We are honored by ANA HD’s continued confidence in Embraer E2 small narrowbody aircraft and look forward to supporting the airline’s growth plans in Japan.」,表達對合作深化的榮譽與期待。 背景方面,全日空於2025年2月宣布首度引進E-Jet機隊,訂購20架E190-E2(含15架確定訂單與5架選擇權),選擇權仍保留;2026年7月29日董事會決議再購區域噴射機,隨後於9月完成本次八架確定訂單。 All Nippon Airways finalises additional order for eight Embraer E190-E2 jets All Nippon Airways confirms eight more E190-E2 jets worth $642M; deliveries from 2028 On 3 September 2026 Embraer issued a statement confirming that ANA Holdings had placed a second order for additional E190‐E2 aircraft on top of the 2025 contract, noting “On September 3, 2026, Embraer issued a statement confirming that ANA Holdings had placed a second order for additional E190-E2s on top of the contract from 2025.”. A SEC filing disclosed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange values the eight aircraft at $642 million (¥105 billion), stating “A SEC Filing , disclosed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, placed the price of the eight aircraft at $642 million (Y105 billion).”. ANA Holdings said deliveries of the first aircraft are expected to commence in the 2028 fiscal year, with the eight additional E190‐E2s scheduled to arrive from 2029 to 2032, quoting “Deliveries of the first aircraft are expected to commence in the 2028 fiscal year, while the eight additional E190-E2s are scheduled to arrive from 2029 to 2032, according to ANA Holdings.”. ANA Holdings President and CEO Koji Shibata said the order “accelerates our efforts to build a sustainable regional aviation network in Japan... It also underscores our confidence in Embraer’s technology to reduce both environmental impact and operating costs.”. Embraer Commercial Aviation President and CEO Arjan Meijer responded that the company is “honored by ANA HD’s continued confidence in Embraer E2 small narrowbody aircraft and look forward to supporting the airline’s growth plans in Japan.”. Background: In February 2025 ANA announced its first E‐Jet order for 20 E190‐E2s (15 firm, 5 options), with the options still outstanding. On 29 July 2026 the board approved the acquisition of more regional jets, leading to the finalised eight‐aircraft order announced in September. On 3 September 2026 Embraer confirmed that ANA Holdings placed a second order for eight additional E190‐E2 aircraft, adding to the 15 already on order. On September 3, 2026, Embraer issued a statement confirming that ANA Holdings had placed a second order for additional E190-E2s on top of the contract from 2025. The eight aircraft are valued at $642 million (¥105 billion) per an SEC filing disclosed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. A SEC Filing , disclosed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, placed the price of the eight aircraft at $642 million (Y105 billion). Deliveries of the first aircraft are expected to commence in the 2028 fiscal year, while the eight additional E190-E2s are scheduled to arrive from 2029 to 2032, according to ANA Holdings. ANA Holdings CEO Koji Shibata said the order accelerates building a sustainable regional aviation network in Japan and underscores confidence in Embraer technology to cut environmental impact and operating costs. “This additional E190-E2 order accelerates our efforts to build a sustainable regional aviation network in Japan,” Koji Shibata, President and CEO of ANA Holdings, said. “It also underscores our confidence in Embraer’s technology to reduce both environmental impact and operating costs. Embraer Commercial Aviation CEO Arjan Meijer expressed honor at ANA HD’s continued confidence and looks forward to supporting the airline’s growth plans in Japan. “We are honored by ANA HD’s continued confidence in Embraer E2 small narrowbody aircraft and look forward to supporting the airline’s growth plans in Japan,” Arjan Meijer, President and CEO, Embraer Commercial Aviation, said. metadata.title: 荷蘭皇家航空首架A350-900完成首飛 預計10月投入商業營運

a-20260904-1913-klm-s-first-airbus-a350-.text: 荷蘭皇家航空首架A350-900完成首飛 預計10月投入商業營運 荷蘭皇家航空首架A350完成首飛;預計10月23日投入阿姆斯特丹至多倫多航線。 荷蘭皇家航空(KLM)預計接收的首架空中巴士 A350-900 客機,於 2026 年 9 月 4 日順利完成首次試飛。該架新機目前使用臨時國籍標誌暨登記號碼 F-WZNM,於法國圖盧茲-布拉尼亞克機場(TLS)起飛,在法國南部上空進行了長達 1 小時 34 分鐘的測試飛行後,順利降落於同一機場,完成交付前例行的新機測試流程。 這架空中巴士 A350-900 被命名為「夜巡」(The Night Watch),名稱取自荷蘭畫家林布蘭(Rembrandt)的著名藝術傑作。這是荷蘭皇家航空預計接收的 22 架 A350 客機中的第一架,源自法航-荷航集團(Air France-KLM Group)於 2023 年所訂購的 50 架客機訂單(另含 40 架選擇權)。荷航數十年來主要營運波音機隊,此機交付標誌著其機隊轉型的重要里程碑,該公司自 2024 年 1 月接收首架空中巴士 A320neo 後,便逐步引進空中巴士機型。 根據營運規劃,「夜巡」號預計於 2026 年 10 月 23 日正式投入商業營運。此日期較荷蘭皇家航空原本規劃的 10 月 9 日推遲了數日。該機首航將執飛阿姆斯特丹史基浦機場(AMS)至多倫多皮爾遜國際機場(YYZ)的客運航線,航班號碼為 KL691 與 KL692,目前該跨大西洋航線係由波音 787 機型負責執飛。 在客艙配置方面,荷蘭皇家航空的 A350 客機規劃設置 332 個座位,其中包括 34 個商務艙座位、26 個豪華經濟艙座位以及 271 個經濟艙座位。然而,由於商務艙座椅認證過程出現延誤,荷蘭皇家航空在該型客機投入營運初期,可能面臨必須在商務艙不載客的情況下執行航班的挑戰。 KLM's First Airbus A350-900 Completes Maiden Flight Ahead of October Launch KLM's first Airbus A350-900 completed its maiden flight; commercial service starts October 23 to Toronto. The first Airbus A350-900 aircraft scheduled for delivery to Dutch flag carrier KLM completed its maiden flight on September 4, 2026. Bearing the provisional registration F-WZNM, the widebody jet departed from France's Toulouse-Blagnac Airport (TLS) and returned to land at the same airport 1 hour and 34 minutes later, after executing a routine test flight circuit over southern France prior to its official customer delivery. Named 'The Night Watch' after Rembrandt's iconic masterpiece, the widebody airliner is the first of 22 A350 aircraft that KLM is set to receive. The aircraft are part of a broader order for 50 aircraft, accompanied by 40 options, placed by the Air France-KLM Group in 2023. This delivery marks a significant milestone in KLM's fleet renewal, as the Dutch carrier undergoes a major transition toward Airbus after operating primarily Boeing aircraft for many decades. The airline's shift to Airbus began in January 2024 when it took delivery of its first A320neo. 'The Night Watch' is scheduled to enter commercial passenger service on October 23, 2026, representing a brief postponement from KLM's original target date of October 9, 2026. The new aircraft will make its commercial debut on the route connecting Amsterdam-Schiphol (AMS) Airport and Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ). Operating under flight numbers KL691 and KL692, this transatlantic service is currently performed using Boeing 787 aircraft. KLM's A350 configuration is designed to accommodate a total of 332 passengers, featuring 34 seats in business class, 26 in premium economy, and 271 in economy class. However, regulatory delays in seat certification mean that the Dutch airline may be required to operate its initial A350 commercial flights with an empty business class cabin until official certification approval is finalized. The first Airbus A350-900 to be delivered to KLM, bearing provisional registration F-WZNM, completed its 1-hour and 34-minute maiden test flight from Toulouse-Blagnac on September 4, 2026. The first Airbus A350-900 to be delivered to Dutch flag carrier KLM completed its maiden flight on September 4, 2026. The aircraft is named 'The Night Watch' and is the first of 22 A350s expected by KLM, part of a 50-aircraft order with 40 options placed by Air France-KLM Group in 2023. This first aircraft, which has been named ‘The Night Watch’ after Rembrandt’s famous masterpiece , is the first of 22 which KLM is expected to receive. Commercial operations for 'The Night Watch' are scheduled to begin on October 23, 2026, on the Amsterdam-Schiphol to Toronto Pearson route under flight numbers KL691/692. ‘The Night Watch’ is scheduled to start commercial operations on October 23, 2026, a date KLM has pushed back a few days from the originally planned date of October 9, 2026. KLM's A350s will feature 332 seats, though initial flights may operate with an empty business class cabin due to seat certification delays. KLM’s A350s are due to be fitted with 332 seats, including 34 in business class, 26 in premium economy and 271 in economy. KLM is undergoing a major fleet transition to Airbus after decades as a primary Boeing operator, having taken delivery of its first A320neo in January 2024. The switch to Airbus started to materialize in January 2024, when KLM took delivery of its first Airbus A320neo.

a-20260904-1913-britten-norman-completes.text: Britten-Norman完成英製Islander首飛 Britten-Norman宣布Islander首款英國製機完成首飛 飛機製造商Britten-Norman宣布,自2023年全面生產重返英國後,首架於英國製造的Islander飛機已完成首次試飛。 2026年9月3日,Britten-Norman確認,從懷特島新生產線下線的首架Islander已成功起飛。公司聲明指出:「這是我們新生產線下線的第一架飛機,機身是在懷特島上從零件開始組裝。」 八天前,公司才宣布在滾出廠房後開始地面測試;該機自7月30日出廠。 目前正在測試的飛機未來將加入福克蘭群島政府航空服務(FIGS)機隊。 Britten-Norman completes maiden flight of first UK-built Islander Britten-Norman completes first flight of UK-built Islander from Isle of Wight line; aircraft destined for FIGS. Planemaker Britten-Norman has celebrated the maiden test flight of the first Islander aircraft built in the UK since full production returned to British shores in 2023. On September 3, 2026, Britten-Norman confirmed that the first Islander to come off the new production line on the Isle of Wight had taken to the skies. The company said the airframe was built from detail components on the Isle of Wight, with the aircraft rolling out over a month later, on August 27. The Islander currently being tested is destined to join the Falkland Islands Government Air Service (FIGS) fleet. In June 2026, Britten-Norman announced that a second airframe was nearly 25% complete and that components for follow-on aircraft were in manufacture. 2026年9月3日,一架Islander在懷特島完成首飛。 On September 3, 2026, Britten-Norman confirmed that the first Islander to come off the new production line on the Isle of Wight had taken to the skies. 這架Islander的下中確定問題,它將加入福克蘭群島政府公機隊(FIGS)。 The Islander currently being tested is destined to join the Falkland Islands Government Air Service (FIGS) fleet. 2026年7月30日,該機從懷特島工廠出廠。 the aircraft had rolled out at the company’s Isle of Wight facility on July 30, 2026

a-20260905-0714-frontier-airlines-confir.text: Frontier Airlines確認退出紐約JFK 轉向LGA與EWR Frontier Airlines將退出JFK;營運重心轉至LGA與EWR Frontier Airlines 已正式確認其在紐約約翰·甘迺迪國際機場(JFK)營運的最後一天服務日期。在該座紐約繁忙機場提供客運服務僅兩年時間後,該航空公司決定劃下句點並結束營運。 根據這項調整規劃,Frontier Airlines 將削減成本較高昂的航線營運,以提升整體營運資源的利用效率。 此外,Frontier Airlines 將營運資源進一步轉向紐約地區的其他機場,持續強化自紐約拉瓜地亞機場(LGA)與紐華克自由國際機場(EWR)起降的全年航班服務。 Frontier Airlines Confirms Departure From New York JFK Airport Frontier Airlines confirms exit from New York JFK; focuses flights on LGA and EWR airports. metadata.title: 工研院推出首套非紅供應鏈檢測平台 逾20家無人機業者提出評測
airline: 美國無人載具系統國際協會

a-20260905-0714-itri-unveils-non-red-sup.text: 工研院推出首套非紅供應鏈檢測平台 逾20家無人機業者提出評測 工研院開發非紅供應鏈檢測平台;已有逾20家無人機廠商提出評測需求 工業技術研究院(工研院)宣佈與美方合作,開發出全台首套自製「非紅供應鏈檢測平台」。該平台將評測標準進行工具化與數位化轉換,旨在協助國內無人機及關鍵零組件業者進行產品健檢,確立供應鏈與資訊安全規範。工研院表示,目前已有超過20家國內無人機整機及關鍵零組件廠商提出評測需求,希望藉此進攻海外非紅供應鏈商機。 工研院指出,該院於今年6月正式與美國無人載具系統國際協會(AUVSI)簽署Green UAS授權評鑑及服務協議,成為AUVSI在台灣的第三方認可評鑑機構,同時也是美國境外首家取得該項認證資格的機構。透過此一資格,工研院得以協助台灣無人機廠商執行資安與供應鏈安全評測,為拓展國際市場建立可信度。 工研院機械與機電系統研究所智慧機械產業推動組長錢睿宏說明,目前工研院執行的Green UAS評測架構,直接對準美國國防合約管理局(DCMA)所建立的Blue UAS評測標準。Green UAS與Blue UAS在產品資安與供應鏈安全的評測要求上高度一致,兩者主要差異在於發證機關與目標市場,前者鎖定商業及非美國國防市場,後者則主要對準美國國防體系。 針對業者面臨範本不一與資料收集困難等挑戰,工研院開發的「非紅供應鏈檢測平台」可協助廠商從整架無人機一路盤點至關鍵零組件,確認製造商、供應商來源及潛在風險。業者可在正式申請Green UAS評測前進行預先分析與資料補強,避免送件後重複退件。此外,在台灣完成Green UAS評測後建立的測試數據與證據,未來亦可作為銜接Blue UAS審查的重要基礎,大幅降低營運與測試成本。 ITRI Unveils Non-Red Supply Chain Testing Platform for Drone Sector ITRI launched a non-red drone testing platform, with over 20 manufacturers seeking supply chain evaluations. Taiwan's Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI) has collaborated with US partners to develop the nation's first self-built non-red supply chain testing platform. The platform digitizes and toolifies evaluation standards to assist domestic drone and critical component manufacturers with cybersecurity and supply chain safety checks. ITRI announced that more than 20 domestic manufacturers have already requested evaluations to capture opportunities in global non-red supply chains. The initiative follows ITRI's agreement signed in June with the Association for Uncrewed Vehicle Systems International (AUVSI). Under the agreement, ITRI became AUVSI's third-party evaluation institution in Taiwan and the first entity outside the United States authorized to conduct Green UAS assessments. This certification allows ITRI to provide domestic drone and component manufacturers with recognized security evaluations required for overseas market entry. According to ITRI, the Green UAS evaluation framework executed by the institute aligns directly with the Blue UAS evaluation standard established by the US Defense Contract Management Agency (DCMA). While Blue UAS targets the US defense market and Green UAS focuses on commercial and non-US defense sectors, both frameworks maintain highly consistent standards regarding product cybersecurity and supply chain risk verification. The newly developed testing platform enables manufacturers to conduct pre-assessments and inventory tracking from complete drone units down to key components before formal Green UAS application. By auditing manufacturers, component suppliers, and potential cybersecurity vulnerabilities in advance, firms can avoid formal application rejections. Furthermore, product security data and supply chain evidence established through Green UAS testing in Taiwan can serve as a vital foundation for future Blue UAS reviews, saving testing time and reducing costs for local companies. ITRI collaborated with the US side to develop Taiwan's first self-developed non-red supply chain testing platform to digitize evaluation standards. 進一步與美方合作開發全台首套自製「非紅供應鏈檢測平台」,將評測標準工具化、數位化。 Over 20 domestic drone and key component manufacturers have expressed testing demand for the non-red supply chain platform. 目前已有逾20家國內無人機及關鍵零組件業者提出評測需求,搶搭非紅供應鏈出海商機。 ITRI became AUVSI's third-party evaluation institution in Taiwan in June, making it the first authorized entity outside the US for Green UAS. 工研院在今年6月正式成為美國境外首家取得Green UAS(綠色無人機)認證資格機構後 ITRI's Green UAS evaluation framework aligns directly with the US DCMA Blue UAS evaluation standards. 目前工研院執行的Green UAS評測架構,直接對準美國國防合約管理局(DCMA)建立的Blue UAS評測標準。 The non-red supply chain platform allows drone manufacturers to conduct supply chain inventory and pre-analysis prior to applying for Green UAS. 業者可在正式申請Green UAS評測前,先透過平台進行供應鏈盤點及預先分析,及早補強資料或排除風險 Product data and supply chain evidence created under Green UAS testing in Taiwan can serve as a foundation for future Blue UAS reviews. 業者在台灣完成Green UAS評測後所建立的產品資料、資安測試及供應鏈證據,未來可作為銜接Blue UAS審查的重要基礎。

metadata.title: 空中巴士A330neo尾翼檢查影響夏季交付;已找出原因並恢復交付

a-20260905-0714-airbus-resumes-a330neo-d.text: 空中巴士A330neo尾翼檢查影響夏季交付;已找出原因並恢復交付 空中巴士因尾翼檢查致A330neo夏季交付延誤;根源已確定並已恢復交付 空中巴士(Airbus)旗下的 A330neo 客機交付作業在2026年夏季遭受嚴重延誤。根據相關消息指出,此波延誤主要是因為該型客機的水平尾翼(水平安定面)結構出現品質疑慮,導致空中巴士必須執行額外檢查並放緩整體生產系統運作。 據路透社引述知情人士消息透露,這項檢查程序的誘因,是在一次交付前的例行檢查過程中,工作人員在一架 A330neo 的機身結構內部發現了一件留置工具。為了維持航空安全標準,空中巴士管理層隨後要求工作人員對每一架 A330neo 客機進行全面檢驗,因而減緩了組裝線的產出速度。 空中巴士公布的數據反映出夏季檢驗對營運的影響。其官方交付紀錄顯示,該公司在2026年6月與7月的兩個月期間,完全未向客戶交付任何 A330neo 客機。而在2026年8月,空中巴士僅完成交付一架 A330neo 客機予星宇航空。在此之前的2026年前幾個月,空中巴士累計交付了九架 A330neo,分別為3月交付三架、4月交付兩架以及5月交付四架,而1月與2月則無交付紀錄。 對於交付受阻情事,空中巴士在發給彭博的聲明中證實,問題的根本原因已經被成功識別,並將該狀況描述為單一孤立事件。空中巴士明確指出,A330 系列客機的交付作業現已正式恢復。依據此前的營運預測,空中巴士原定目標為每月交付約四架 A330neo 客機,並規劃於2029年將該型號的月產量進一步提升至五架。 雖然 A330neo 機型的交付在夏季陷入短暫停頓,空中巴士的整體商用客機交付表現仍維持穩定增長。空中巴士於2026年8月7日確認,其於7月份單月向39家客戶共交付了67架客機。截至當時,該公司在2026年的年度累計交付量已達418架,優於2025年同期的373架。空中巴士在先前發布上半年與第二季財務業績時,亦重新確認其2026年全年交付約870架商用飛機的營運目標。 Airbus Resumes A330neo Deliveries Following Tail Inspection Delays Airbus resumes A330neo deliveries after horizontal tail inspections delayed summer aircraft handovers to customers. Deliveries of Airbus A330neo aircraft experienced significant delays over the summer of 2026 following concerns related to the aircraft's horizontal tail plane. The extra inspection steps required on the horizontal stabilizer slowed down the production system across the manufacturing line. According to reports from Reuters citing a person familiar with the matter, the inspections were triggered after a tool was discovered inside the structure of an A330neo during a pre-delivery inspection. Following the discovery, Airbus staff were directed to check every A330neo aircraft, creating a temporary disruption in output. Delivery data published by Airbus underscores the impact of the inspection process on commercial operations. Airbus delivered no A330neo aircraft during June and July 2026. In August 2026, Airbus delivered only a single A330neo aircraft, which was transferred to STARLUX Airlines. Prior to August, Airbus had delivered nine A330neos in 2026, including three in March, two in April, and four in May, following zero deliveries in January and February. In a statement provided to Bloomberg, Airbus confirmed that the root cause of the issue has been identified and described the situation as an isolated occurrence. Airbus emphasized that A330 deliveries have officially resumed. Based on earlier operational targets, Airbus aims to deliver around four A330neos per month, with plans to increase output to five per month in 2029. Despite the summer bottleneck affecting the A330neo line, Airbus's overall commercial aircraft deliveries remained on an upward track. On August 7, 2026, Airbus confirmed that it delivered 67 aircraft to 39 customers during July 2026. Total year-to-date deliveries reached 418 aircraft compared to 373 at the same point in 2025, with Airbus reaffirming its annual goal of delivering around 870 commercial aircraft in 2026. metadata.title: 波音預測非洲民航機隊2045年前增逾一倍至1625架

a-20260905-0714-boeing-forecasts-africa-.text: 波音預測非洲民航機隊2045年前增逾一倍至1625架 波音預測非洲航空客運量年增近6%;機隊2045年前將倍增至1625架 波音(Boeing)於肯亞奈洛比發布2026年《商業市場展望》(Commercial Market Outlook)報告指出,受惠於年輕且日益城鎮化的人口、不斷增長的平民階級以及基礎設施改善,非洲地區的商業航空客運量預計在2045年前將以每年近6%的速度增長,成為全球增長最快的區域之一。 根據波音預測,為滿足日益成長的空中交通需求,非洲地區的商業飛機機隊規模將在未來20年內翻倍以上,從目前的755架大幅增加至2045年的1,625架。在預計交付的近1,200架新飛機中,約有870架將是單通道客機,主要用於支援不斷擴張的區域與國內航線網絡。 在遠程與貨運需求方面,波音預估非洲雙通道廣體客機的需求將成長一倍以上,以推動機隊現代化並支援長途國際航線發展。此外,隨著電商物流與高價值出口市場擴增,非洲的貨機機隊規模也預計將從現有的60架增加至150架。 針對航空服務與專業人才需求,波音《商業服務市場展望》指出,到2045年非洲的維修、修理、大修與改裝(MRO)及數位解決方案市場規模將達到1,400億美元。同時,波音《飛行員與技術人員展望》預估,隨著航空公司擴展機隊與航線網絡,該地區將需要75,000名新進航空專業人員,包含22,000名飛行員、25,000名技術人員與28,000名客艙組員。 波音商業行銷總經理沙哈布·馬丁(Shahab Matin)表示,非洲航空市場正進入由連通性改善與區域內旅遊擴展所推動的持續成長期。要滿足此項需求,需要致力於機隊現代化、擴充運能、數位解決方案以及人才培訓等全面投入。 Boeing Forecasts Africa Commercial Airplane Fleet to Double to 1,625 by 2045 Boeing projects African airline fleets to double by 2045 driven by six percent annual passenger growth. Boeing released its 2026 Commercial Market Outlook for Africa in Nairobi, Kenya, forecasting that the continent's commercial air passenger traffic will grow by nearly 6 percent annually through 2045. Driven by a young and increasingly urban population, an expanding middle class, and ongoing infrastructure improvements, Africa's air travel expansion is projected to rank among the fastest global growth rates over the next two decades. To meet this expanding travel demand, Boeing projects that Africa's commercial airplane fleet will more than double over the next 20 years, expanding from 755 aircraft to 1,625 by 2045. The continent will require nearly 1,200 new airplane deliveries to support this expansion, with single-aisle aircraft accounting for 870 units to serve growing domestic and regional flight networks across the region. Demand for widebody airplanes is also expected to more than double over the forecast period to support long-haul network growth and ongoing fleet modernization. In addition, Boeing forecasts that Africa's dedicated freighter fleet will expand from 60 to 150 aircraft as logistics operations, e-commerce adoption, and high-value export markets continue to develop across the continent. The expansion of the regional aviation sector is anticipated to drive substantial demand for commercial aviation services and skilled workforce. Boeing's Commercial Services Market Outlook projects a $140 billion market for maintenance, repair, overhaul, modifications, and digital solutions in Africa through 2045. Furthermore, the manufacturer estimates that regional airlines will need 75,000 new aviation professionals, including 22,000 pilots, 25,000 technicians, and 28,000 cabin crew members. Shahab Matin, Boeing managing director of Commercial Marketing, noted that Africa's aviation market is entering a sustained growth phase supported by improving connectivity and expanding intraregional travel. Meeting this growing demand will require sustained commitments to fleet modernization, capacity expansion, digital infrastructure, and workforce development across the continent. metadata.title: 聯合航空發表Mountain Ascent彩繪機身 擬2027年初投入營運

a-20260905-0714-united-airlines-unveils-.text: 聯合航空發表Mountain Ascent彩繪機身 擬2027年初投入營運 聯合航空發表Mountain Ascent塗裝;預計2027年初投入營運 聯合航空發表名為「Mountain Ascent」的全新山脈主題飛機塗裝,旨在宣傳其橫跨美國的冬季及滑雪航線。該特殊塗裝將塗刷於一架巴西航空工業E175客機上,預計於2027年初正式投入營運,服務包括阿斯彭、太陽谷及韋爾等滑雪勝地。 此設計機身後半部包裹著涵蓋雪山與綠坡的山脈圖案,並逐漸過渡至聯合航空標誌性的藍色尾翼。此外,聯合航空今年冬季新增的波士頓至傑克遜霍爾航線,將由126座波音737-700執飛,而非塗有新塗裝的E175客機。聯合航空同時也是美國滑雪與單板滑雪協會至2027年的官方夥伴。 United Airlines Unveils 'Mountain Ascent' Livery for Winter Ski Routes United Airlines unveiled its 'Mountain Ascent' livery, entering service on an Embraer E175 in early 2027. United Airlines has unveiled a new mountain-themed aircraft livery named 'Mountain Ascent' to promote its winter and ski routes across the United States. The special design will be applied to an Embraer E175 aircraft serving mountain destinations, including Aspen, Sun Valley, and Vail, with entry into service planned for early 2027. The aircraft design wraps the rear half of the fuselage in a snow-capped mountain motif before transitioning into the carrier's traditional blue tail. Separately, United's new winter route between Boston and Jackson Hole will be operated using a 126-seat Boeing 737-700 rather than the E175. The airline remains an official partner of US Ski and Snowboard through 2027. Emirates has unveiled a new electrically powered premium economy seat featuring a full-height adjustable privacy screen, which will debut on its newly delivered Airbus A350 aircraft. The upgraded cabin section is fitted with 28 seats arranged in a 2-3-2 seating configuration. The new A350 aircraft also feature additional left and right-side external cameras. metadata.title: 美國FAA投資4.81億美元補助191處機場改善基礎設施

a-20260905-1129-faa-awards-481-million-i.text: 美國FAA投資4.81億美元補助191處機場改善基礎設施 美國FAA投入4.81億美元補助,升級全美36州與兩領地共191處機場設施。 美國運輸部長 Sean P. Duffy 宣布,聯邦航空管理局(FAA)將透過「機場基礎設施補助計畫」(Airport Infrastructure Grants, AIG)投入 4.81 億美元,用於改善全美各地機場的基礎設施並提升整體安全表現。該項資金發放時間適逢美國勞動節長假旅行高峰前夕,旨在協助機場因應日益增長的旅客需求。 根據 FAA 發布的資訊,本次補助共劃分為 191 筆款項,涵蓋美國 36 個州以及 2 個海外領地的機場。補助資金可用於機場規劃、開發、航廈改善、行李系統升級、跑道與滑行道翻修、道路與聯外交通改善,以及其他與航空安全相關的基礎設施需求。 在個別機場獲得的資助項目中,喬治亞州亞特蘭大哈茨菲爾德-傑克遜國際機場獲撥最高額度的 1 億美元資金,用於跑道、滑行道與航廈的重建工程,以及跑道安全區域的改善計畫。此外,肯塔基州路易斯維爾穆罕默德·阿里國際機場獲得 3,250 萬美元以重建航廈,加州聖地牙哥國際機場(SAN)則獲撥 3,030 萬美元用於航廈建設。 其他獲得重點補助的設施還包括:威斯康辛州密爾瓦基米切爾國際機場獲頒 1,420 萬美元,用於滑行道建設與翻修;德州埃爾帕索國際機場獲得 870 萬美元,用於停機坪翻修工程。另外,威斯康辛州的通用航空機場共計獲得 250 萬美元補助,用於航廈重建、跑道與滑行道翻修以及除雪設備建築的重建工程。 美國運輸部長 Sean P. Duffy 表示,這項關鍵基礎設施投資將為美國家庭提供更順暢與高效的出行體驗,升級跑道基礎設施則是推動交通發展的一部分。FAA 署長 Bryan Bedford 則指出,這些補助金將協助全美各地機場維持安全與高效運作,並滿足現代旅客的需求與未來的挑戰。 FAA Awards $481 Million in Airport Infrastructure Grants Across US The US FAA is providing $481 million in grants across 36 states and two territories for 191 airport projects. U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy has announced that the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) is investing $481 million to upgrade infrastructure and enhance safety at airports across the United States. The funding release comes ahead of the busy Labor Day travel period, targeting infrastructure improvements across American airports. The total allocation delivers 191 individual grants to airports located across 36 states and two territories through the Airport Infrastructure Grants (AIG) program. Under program parameters, AIG funding can be utilized for airport planning, development, terminal improvements, baggage system upgrades, runway and taxiway rehabilitation, roadway and access improvements, and other safety-related infrastructure needs. Key individual awards include $100 million designated for Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL) in Georgia to support runway, taxiway, and terminal reconstruction as well as runway safety area improvements. Additionally, Louisville Muhammad Ali International Airport (SDF) in Kentucky receives $32.5 million to reconstruct its terminal, while San Diego International Airport (SAN) in California is awarded $30.3 million for terminal construction. Specific grants also include $14.2 million for Milwaukee Mitchell International Airport in Wisconsin for taxiway construction and rehabilitation, alongside $8.7 million for El Paso International Airport (ELP) in Texas to rehabilitate its apron. Furthermore, general aviation airports in Wisconsin receive a combined $2.5 million for terminal reconstruction, runway and taxiway rehabilitation, and snow-removal-equipment building reconstruction. Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy noted that investing in critical infrastructure aims to deliver a more seamless and efficient travel experience for American families, describing runway upgrades as an essential component of transportation development. FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford highlighted that these infrastructure investments maintain passenger safety and operational efficiency, helping airports fulfill present travel demands while preparing for future operational requirements. The FAA first proposed the $3,139,319 penalty in September 2025, stating it had used its “maximum statutory civil penalty authority consistent with law.” Both the FAA and Boeing separately confirmed the payment to Reuters, though neither publicly announced the settlement at the time. The violations occurred between September 2023 and February 2024, during a period of intense scrutiny of Boeing’s manufacturing and quality-control systems. The FAA said its investigation identified “hundreds of quality system violations” at Boeing’s 737 production facility in Renton, Washington, and at the Wichita, Kansas, 737 fuselage factory, then operated by Spirit AeroSystems (a former Boeing division sold in 2005 and re-acquired in 2025). The FAA also found that a Boeing employee who was not part of the ODA (Organisation Designation Authorisation) unit pressured an ODA representative to approve a 737 MAX to help meet delivery schedules, even though the representative had determined the aircraft did not comply with applicable standards. The finding raised questions over the independence of Boeing’s delegated safety representatives, who are expected to exercise regulatory responsibilities independently despite being employed by Boeing. The $3.1 million penalty also covered violations associated with the January 5, 2024 accident involving Alaska Airlines Flight 1282. A door plug separated from the Boeing 737 MAX 9 shortly after departure from Portland International Airport, causing rapid decompression and leaving a large opening in the fuselage. The aircraft returned safely to Portland with no fatalities. Investigators later determined that four bolts intended to prevent the door plug from moving upward were missing when Boeing delivered the aircraft. a-20260906-0656-boeing-mh-139a-grey-wolf.text: 波音MH-139A灰狼達初始作戰能力 接替UH-1N執行核彈安全任務 MH-139A灰狼8月10日達IOC;首度護航民兵三型車隊;速度快50%、載員倍增 美國空軍全球打擊司令部(AFGSC)的波音MH-139A灰狼直升機於2026年8月10日達成初始作戰能力(IOC),正式開始取代服役超過五十年的UH-1N休伊直升機,執行洲際彈道飛彈(ICBM)發射場的核安全任務。這項里程碑標誌著美國陸基核威嚇力量的空中支援能力邁入新階段。 MH-139A以商用的李奧納多AW139直升機為基礎,由波音依軍規改裝而成。根據空軍聲明,灰狼的巡航速度比UH-1N快近50%,可攜帶雙倍兵力,並具備增強防禦系統與前視紅外線感測器,大幅提升對廣大飛彈基地的快速反應與態勢感知能力。 以蒙大拿州馬姆斯特洛姆空軍基地為例,其飛彈綜合體佔地約13,800平方英里(35,740平方公里),擁有逾百個發射設施。龐大的防禦區域使得直升機的速度、航程與載員量成為關鍵,灰狼的性能優勢正是為因應這類地理挑戰而設計。 2026年1月,第40直升機中隊的兩架MH-139A首度執行實戰護航任務,陪同民兵三型飛彈維修與裝甲安保車隊往返距離基地超過100英里(160公里)的發射設施,全程約六小時且無需空中加油。這次任務實證了灰狼在長距離護航中的持久作戰能力。 除護航外,灰狼還負責核安全突發事件的快速反應、發射設施奪回與恢復等任務。空軍測試已涵蓋護航支援、緊急反應及設施奪回等情境,旨在驗證機組人員能多快起飛並將戰術部隊投送至需加強安保的地點。 Boeing MH-139A Grey Wolf reaches IOC, replaces UH-1N for US nuclear missile security Grey Wolf achieves IOC; first Minuteman III convoy escort; 50% faster, double troop capacity The Boeing MH-139A Grey Wolf helicopter achieved Initial Operational Capability (IOC) on 10 August 2026, marking the start of its operational replacement of the Vietnam-era UH-1N Huey in the US Air Force Global Strike Command’s nuclear security mission. metadata.title: 希臘空軍F-4戰機於飛行展墜毀兩飛官殉職

a-20260906-0835-greek-air-force-f-4-phan.text: 希臘空軍F-4戰機於飛行展墜毀兩飛官殉職 希臘空軍F-4戰機於航空展墜毀;兩名飛行員殉職;地面觀展民眾無人受傷 希臘空軍一架F-4幽靈式(F-4 Phantom)戰鬥機於2026年9月5日在雅典附近的塔納格拉空軍基地(Tanagra Air Base)參加「雅典飛行週」(Athens Flying Week)航空展期間發生墜機事故,造成機上兩名飛行員殉職。該架雙座戰鬥機當時正在執行低空機動飛行,隨後於基地附近墜毀並引發火勢。 根據現場觀展民眾拍攝的影片顯示,該架戰鬥機在進行低空右轉彎時高度持續下降,隨後隱沒於樹林後方並撞擊地面爆出烈火。希臘空軍官員隨後證實,兩名飛行員的遺體已經尋獲。儘管當時現場有數千名民眾前往觀賞航空展,地面觀展民眾並未有人員受傷。 事故發生後,現場隨即展開大規模緊急救援行動。由於墜機引發的火勢蔓延至周邊植被,救援單位共派遣約85名消防人員、23輛消防車輛,以及11架消防飛機與直升機投入滅火工作。火災狀況初期曾一度阻礙搜救進度,主辦單位隨後指示觀眾撤離空軍基地,並宣布取消該週末剩餘的所有飛行表演行程。 希臘總理米佐塔基斯(Kyriakos Mitsotakis)於事故發生後向殉職飛行員家屬致上深切哀悼,表示全國上下皆感到無比悲痛,希臘空軍亦隨之宣布全國空軍舉哀三日。「雅典飛行週」為希臘年度國際航空盛事,匯集來自希臘及多國軍民用航空器,2026年展演原定於9月5日與6日舉行。 希臘空軍自1970年代起即開始操作美製F-4幽靈式戰鬥機。儘管該型戰鬥機在多數原操作國已相繼退役,希臘空軍目前仍持續維運經升級改進後的同型機隊。 Greek Air Force F-4 Phantom Crashes at Airshow Near Athens, Killing Both Pilots Greek Air Force F-4 Phantom crashed during an airshow near Athens; both pilots were killed. A Hellenic Air Force F-4 Phantom fighter jet crashed during an airshow near Athens on September 5, 2026, resulting in the deaths of both pilots aboard the aircraft. The two-seat fighter jet crashed while performing a low-altitude maneuver during the Athens Flying Week event at Tanagra Air Base, situated approximately 40 miles north of the Greek capital. Video footage recorded by spectators at the event showed the fighter aircraft making a low right turn shortly before it descended behind a tree line and struck the ground. The jet erupted into flames immediately following the impact. Officials from the Hellenic Air Force subsequently confirmed the recovery of both pilots' bodies from the crash site. No spectators were injured during the incident despite the presence of thousands of attendees. The crash and subsequent fire prompted a large-scale emergency service response. Approximately 85 firefighters, 23 specialized emergency vehicles, and 11 firefighting aircraft and helicopters were dispatched as flames quickly spread into surrounding vegetation. Early recovery efforts were initially hindered by the intensity of the fire, leading organizers to instruct all spectators to evacuate Tanagra Air Base and formally cancel the remainder of the weekend's scheduled flying program. Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis expressed his deep condolences to the families of the fallen pilots, stating that the sense of grief was widespread across the country. Following the fatal accident, the Hellenic Air Force officially declared a three-day period of mourning. Athens Flying Week is an annual international aviation showcase featuring diverse military and civilian aircraft from Greece and other participating nations. The Hellenic Air Force has operated the United States-manufactured F-4 Phantom since the 1970s. While the iconic fighter type has been phased out and retired by most of its former operator nations worldwide, upgraded and modernized variants remain in active operational service with Greece. a-20260906-0835-archer-begins-midnight-a.text: Archer展開Midnight空中計程車巡迴試飛 Archer啟動Midnight空中計程車巡迴試飛;首階段聚焦加州城際航線 美國電動垂直起降飛行器製造商Archer Aviation宣佈啟動名為「No Roads」的巡迴飛行計畫,將其Midnight電動空中計程車的試飛範圍,從傳統機場區域擴展至連接城市間的跨城點對點航線。這項巡迴試飛計畫是在與美國聯邦航空管理局(FAA)協調下進行,旨在評估整體營運準備狀況,並為該公司預計於2028年洛杉磯奧運及帕運期間提供空中計程車服務進行前置測試。 該計畫的首階段試飛聚焦於北加州地區,預計連接包括蒙特雷、霍利斯特、聖馬丁、庫比蒂諾附近的聖荷西、奧克蘭以及舊金山等據點。Archer日前已完成過往單月超過70架次試飛,近期更成功執行Midnight飛行器在沙利納斯市立機場與蒙特雷地區機場之間的往返飛行,首度展示該機型在兩個獨立機場之間的城際航線營運能力。 Archer開發的Midnight是一款由一名機師駕駛、可搭載四名乘客的電動垂直起降飛行器,專為短程都市及區域接駁設計。該公司指出,Midnight採用的電動推進系統能實現零直接排放,且噪音水平遠低於傳統直升機。該計畫旨在模擬商業營運中的實際旅程,目標是將地面車程需要一小時以上的陸路交通,縮短至約10至20分鐘的空中飛行,同時測試地面充電設施與空域操作程序。 此外,本次巡迴試飛計畫亦與白宮的電動垂直起降整合試點計畫(eIPP)緊密串聯,Archer計畫將跨城測試進一步延伸至洛杉磯,隨後擴大至德克薩斯州與佛羅里達州。該公司先前已獲選為2028年洛杉磯奧運的官方空中計程車合作夥伴,並於近期與AEG集團達成合作協議,規劃在洛杉磯市中心LA LIVE開發專用垂直機場。 Archer Begins Midnight Air Taxi Flight Tour Across US Starting in Northern California Archer Aviation launches Midnight electric air taxi tour in California ahead of planned LA28 operations. California-based Archer Aviation has launched its US-wide "No Roads" flight tour to expand testing of its Midnight electric air taxi beyond airport-based operations. The programme is designed to demonstrate point-to-point regional routes linking city pairs in coordination with the US Federal Aviation Administration. The testing aims to evaluate operational readiness ahead of Archer's planned commercial air taxi services during the Los Angeles 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games. The initial phase of the tour focuses on Northern California, with flight operations planned across key locations including Monterey, Hollister, San Martin, San Jose, Oakland, and San Francisco. The initiative follows more than 70 test flights completed in August, including a round-trip flight between Salinas Municipal Airport (SNS) and Monterey Regional Airport (MRY) that demonstrated the Midnight aircraft operating between two separate regional airports. Archer's Midnight is a piloted, four-passenger eVTOL aircraft tailored for short urban and regional transit. Powered by an electric propulsion system designed for zero direct emissions and low noise levels compared to conventional helicopters, the aircraft is intended to replace road journeys taking an hour or longer with flights lasting approximately 10 to 20 minutes while validating supporting charging infrastructure and operational procedures. The tour is integrated with Archer's participation in the White House's eVTOL Integration Pilot Program and serves as preparation for expanding tests to Los Angeles, Texas, and Florida. In addition to being selected as the official air taxi provider for LA28, Archer recently partnered with sports and entertainment group AEG to develop a dedicated vertiport at LA LIVE in downtown Los Angeles. South African regional carrier Airlink has cancelled its planned formation flypast scheduled for 5 September 2026 over FNB Stadium in Johannesburg. The decision comes as the South African Civil Aviation Authority (SACAA) reviews flight data from the airline's controversial low-altitude flyover in Cape Town on 29 August. The Cape Town event involved two Embraer E195 (ICAO type code E195) regional jets performing a formation flight over DHL Stadium. Flight-tracking data from Flightradar24 indicated the leading aircraft flew approximately 41 to 46 feet (12.5 to 14 meters) above the stadium's roof. On 2 September, SACAA confirmed it has initiated compliance checks and retrieved flight data recorder downloads from the aircraft. Airlink stated that the cancellation of the Johannesburg flyover was due to unfavorable weather forecasts rather than the regulatory investigation. a-20260906-1439-mount-anak-krakatau-erup.text: 印尼喀拉喀托之子火山噴發 8座機場暫停營運 印尼火山噴發導致八座機場暫停航班營運;雅加達蘇凱諾哈達國際機場(CGK)受影響。 印尼交通部長波瓦甘迪(Dudy Purwagandhi)於2026年9月6日證實,受到喀拉喀托之子火山(Mount Anak Krakatau)噴發及隨之產生的火山灰雲影響,印尼共有八座機場的營運服務已暫時停止,包含首都雅加達的主要國際樞紐蘇凱諾哈達國際機場(CGK)。火山灰噴發導致多個航點的航班陷入停擺,數以千計的旅客行程受到影響。 根據印尼國家通訊社安塔拉(Antara)引述火山暨地質災害減緩中心(PVMBG)資料,本次火山噴發始於2026年9月4日晚間23時07分,並於9月6日凌晨00時04分結束,隨後在9月6日當天又發生了兩次後續噴發。印尼氣象、氣候與地球物理局(BMKG)氣象代理副局長藍達尼(Andri Ramdhani)指出,觀測紀錄顯示火山灰向東擴散高度達20,000英呎,向西擴散高度則高達50,000英呎。 因應火山灰對飛航安全的威脅,印尼導航局(AirNav Indonesia)已發布多份飛航通告(NOTAM),關閉相關機場周邊空域。波瓦甘迪部長列出的八座受影響機場包括:蘇凱諾哈達國際機場(CGK)、Halim Perdanakusuma Airport(HLP)、Radin Inten II Airport(TKG)、Husein Sastranegara Airport(BDO)、Budiarto Curug Airport(RTO)、Pondok Cabe Airport(PCB)、Taufik Kiemas Airport(TFY)以及 Atung Bungsu Airport(PXA)。當天稍早原本僅有六座機場關閉,後因風向改變,致使受影響名單增加兩座機場。 交通部長波瓦甘迪要求各大航空公司,必須就航班時間異動、取消或轉降向旅客提供明確資訊,並確保依據適用法規保障乘客權益。國營航空公司印尼鷹航(Garuda Indonesia)向乘客表示,由於喀拉喀托之子火山灰影響,目前已對多班往返雅加達的航班進行調整。BMKG則表示正針對火山噴發動態及其對大氣、航空和海象的影響進行24小時密切監測。 Mount Anak Krakatau Eruption Grounds Flights at Eight Indonesian Airports Indonesia grounds flights at eight airports including Jakarta (CGK) following Mount Anak Krakatau volcanic eruption. Indonesian Minister of Transportation Dudy Purwagandhi confirmed on September 6, 2026, that operational services at eight airports have been temporarily suspended following the eruption of Mount Anak Krakatau and the resulting ash cloud. The closures include Soekarno-Hatta International Airport (CGK), Jakarta's primary international gateway. The flight groundings have impacted travel schedules for thousands of passengers across the region. According to the Center for Volcanology and Geological Hazard Mitigation (PVMBG) cited by Indonesian news agency Antara, the eruption commenced at 23:07 on September 4, 2026, and ended at 00:04 on September 6, 2026, followed by two subsequent eruptions later on September 6. Andri Ramdhani, Acting Deputy for Meteorology at the Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics Agency (BMKG), stated that ash dust was recorded moving up to an altitude of 20,000 feet to the east and 50,000 feet to the west. In response to the hazards posed by the volcanic ash, AirNav Indonesia issued several Notice to Airmen (NOTAM) alerts closing the airspace surrounding the impacted airports as a safety precaution. Minister Purwagandhi detailed the eight affected facilities as Soekarno-Hatta International Airport, Halim Perdanakusuma Airport (HLP), Radin Inten II Airport (TKG), Husein Sastranegara Airport (BDO), Budiarto Curug Airport (RTO), Pondok Cabe Airport (PCB), Taufik Kiemas Airport (TFY), and Atung Bungsu Airport (PXA). Earlier in the day, only six airports were shut down, but shifts in wind direction forced authorities to add two additional airports to the closure list. Minister Purwagandhi instructed operating airlines to provide passengers with transparent information regarding schedule changes, flight cancellations, or diversions, while ensuring that passenger rights are met according to governing regulations. Flag carrier Garuda Indonesia informed travelers that several flights to and from Jakarta are currently being adjusted due to the ash cloud from Mount Anak Krakatau. Meanwhile, BMKG confirmed it is intensifying round-the-clock monitoring of the eruption's development and its operational effects on atmospheric, aviation, and maritime conditions. a-20260906-1439-ramp-agent-dies-after-be.text: 蒙特婁機場地勤人員遭空中巴士A350撞擊不治身亡 蒙特婁機場8月24日發生意外,一名地勤人員遭空中巴士A350客機撞擊不治身亡。 加拿大蒙特婁特魯多國際機場(Montreal-Trudeau International Airport)於2026年8月24日發生一起地面安全意外。根據航空新聞媒體Simple Flying於9月6日發布的報導,一名地面勤務人員在現場作業期間,遭到一架空中巴士A350-900型客機撞擊,隨後不幸傷重不治身亡。 相關消息指出,該名受害地勤人員是在客機進行地面後推作業(pushback)過程中不慎跌倒,隨後遭移動中的客機撞擊。目前報導中並未透露涉事航空公司的具體名稱、航班編號,亦未列出事故發生的確切時間與當地調查機構的最新調查進度。 Ramp Agent Dies After Being Struck by Airbus A350 at Montreal Airport A ramp agent died after being struck by an Airbus A350 at Montreal Airport on August 24. metadata.title: Recaro交付新型R4豪華經濟艙座椅 全日空787-9機隊2026年底導入

a-20260906-1439-recaro-begins-r4-premium.text: Recaro交付新型R4豪華經濟艙座椅 全日空787-9機隊2026年底導入 Recaro交付R4豪華經濟艙座椅;全日空預計2026年底於787-9啟用 德國座椅製造商Recaro Aircraft Seating已開始交付其新款R4豪華經濟艙座椅。日本全日空(All Nippon Airways)預計將於2026年底前,在其波音(Boeing)787-9長程客機隊上正式導入這款全新座椅產品。 Recaro指出,新型R4座椅的交付工作已於2026年6月展開。作為Recaro熱門PL3530長程豪華經濟艙座椅的後續產品,R4座椅已順利取得波音787客機的歐洲技術標準訂單(ETSO)認證。先前PL3530座椅已廣泛獲印度航空(Air India)與南美航空(LATAM)等多家航空公司採用。 新型R4豪華經濟艙座椅在設計上導入了整合於頭靠的隱私翼板並附設閱讀燈,旨在為乘客提供更好的隔絕感與個人隱私空間。此外,該產品配備16吋機上娛樂螢幕、具備頸部支撐功能的六向可調式頭靠、側邊環繞照明、多種電源配置介面、便利行動不便乘客使用的側邊控制台,以及具備軟啟閉機制並整合手機和平板電腦固定架的超寬餐桌。 相較於前代PL3530座椅,R4座椅擴大了座位寬度,椅距增加至約40吋,傾斜角度亦增加約2吋,同時提供小腿靠與單臂設計的腳踏板。Recaro表示,該座椅採用輕量化結構設計,有助於降低飛機總重量,進而減少碳排放並提升燃料燃燒效率。航空公司亦可針對顏色、飾條與材質進行客製化調整。 全日空計劃於2026年底前,在下一代波音787-9長程機隊上同步引進R4豪華經濟艙座椅以及R3經濟艙座椅。根據產業歷史紀錄,Recaro於2023年在漢堡舉辦的航空內飾展首度公開R4座椅概念,全日空則於2025年展會期間宣布選用該款座椅配備其豪華經濟艙。 Recaro Begins R4 Premium Economy Seat Deliveries for ANA Boeing 787-9 Fleet Recaro begins R4 seat deliveries with All Nippon Airways introducing the product on Boeing 787-9s in 2026. Recaro Aircraft Seating has officially commenced deliveries of its new R4 premium economy seat product, with Japanese carrier All Nippon Airways (ANA) scheduled to launch the advanced seating option across its Boeing 787-9 long-haul fleet before the end of 2026. Deliveries of the R4 seat originally began in June 2026. Marketed as the successor to Recaro's popular PL3530 long-haul premium economy seat—which is currently deployed by international air carriers including Air India and LATAM—the new R4 seating model has officially secured European Technical Standard Order (ETSO) certification for the Boeing 787 aircraft family. The R4 premium economy seat incorporates headrest-integrated privacy wings with integrated reading lights, providing passengers with increased separation and enhanced personal privacy in the cabin. Additional passenger amenities include a 16-inch inflight entertainment screen, a six-way adjustable headrest with neck support, side ambient lighting, multiple power supply configurations, a side console offering dedicated access for passengers with reduced mobility, and an extra-wide tray table featuring a soft open-and-close mechanism and dedicated device holders. When evaluated against its predecessor, the R4 features an expanded seat width, an increased seat pitch extending to approximately 40 inches, and an enhanced recline capability of about 2 inches. The seat is equipped with a calf rest and a single-arm footrest design. Furthermore, Recaro highlighted that the lightweight construction of the seat reduces overall aircraft weight, contributing to lower carbon emissions and improved fuel efficiency while offering customizable color and finish options. All Nippon Airways will introduce the R4 seat alongside Recaro's R3 economy seat across its next-generation Boeing 787-9 long-haul fleet, with operational deployment scheduled to begin by late 2026. Verified industry context indicates that the R4 seating concept was initially unveiled at the Aircraft Interiors Expo 2023 in Hamburg and showcased in 2025, when All Nippon Airways formally selected the product to equip its long-haul premium economy cabins. a-20260906-1726-american-airlines-to-lau.text: 美國航空開辦紐約JFK至歐洲10條直飛航線 美國航空將開辦紐約JFK至歐洲10條直飛航線,預計2027年新增2個航點。 美國航空(American Airlines)正著手擴展其從紐約甘迺迪國際機場(JFK)前往歐洲地區的國際航線網路。根據 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 9 月 6 日發布的報導資訊,該航空公司將開辦 10 條從紐約甘迺迪國際機場直飛歐洲的航線服務。 在此次航線規劃中,美國航空預計將於 2027 年在其航網中新增兩個全新的歐洲航點。此項航線拓展計畫涵蓋了美國航空從紐約甘迺迪國際機場營運至歐洲地區的多項直飛航線服務。 American Airlines to Launch 10 Nonstop Routes From New York-JFK (JFK) to Europe American Airlines plans ten nonstop routes from New York-JFK to Europe including two new destinations in 2027. According to information published by Simple Flying on September 6, 2026, the major U.S. carrier is launching 10 nonstop routes connecting its New York-JFK (JFK) hub with destination points across Europe. The airline's operational planning includes expanding its overall European presence over the coming years, with two new international destinations scheduled to be added to its service network in 2027. a-20260906-1752-uss-abraham-lincoln-depa.text: 美軍林肯號航空母艦結束泰國訪問;重新展開第7艦隊任務 林肯號航空母艦於9月6日離開泰國;結束5天休整並恢復第7艦隊常規任務 美國海軍尼米茲級核動力航空母艦林肯號(USS Abraham Lincoln)於2026年9月6日確認已離開泰國林查班(Laem Chabang),結束為期5天的休整停留,重新展開在美國海軍第7艦隊轄區的常規任務。林肯號為第3航空母艦打擊群(CSG 3)的旗艦。 林肯號航空母艦於9月2日抵達泰國,此前該艦已在海上執行長達286天的部署,期間曾參與霍爾木茲海峽的封鎖行動。在泰國停留期間,近5000名水兵與海軍陸戰隊員前往是拉差(Sri Racha)及芭達雅(Pattaya)地區,透過美軍士氣福利暨娛樂計畫參與當地行程。 林肯號艦長基勒上校(Dan Keeler)表示,此次港口訪問為官兵提供了寶貴的休整機會,並感謝泰國方面的盛情款待。美軍隨後將繼續與泰國及區域盟友共同執行第7艦隊防務任務。 USS Abraham Lincoln Departs Thailand to Resume US 7th Fleet Operations USS Abraham Lincoln departed Thailand on September 6 after a five-day port visit to resume operations. The aircraft carrier arrived in Thailand on September 2, 2026, following a 286-day deployment at sea that included participation in the naval blockade in the Strait of Hormuz. a-20260906-2322-amazon-prime-air-branded.text: 亞馬遜塗裝波音767在邁阿密衝出跑道造成5死 亞馬遜塗裝波音767在邁阿密衝出跑道,造成五人死亡多人受傷。 根據媒體 Simple Flying 報導,一架掛有 Amazon Prime Air 品牌塗裝的波音767-300F飛機於2026年9月6日星期日在邁阿密國際機場(Miami International Airport)發生衝出跑道事故。該起跑道偏離事件造成五人死亡,另有其他人員受傷。 報導指出,這起偏離跑道的事件是在該架飛機降落觸地後不久發生的。目前有關該起事故的確切發生原因、機上總人數以及其餘受傷人員的詳細傷勢,仍有待調查釐清。 Amazon Prime Air-Branded Boeing 767 Overruns Runway in Miami Leaving 5 Dead Amazon Prime Air-branded Boeing 767 overruns runway in Miami; five dead and others injured According to a report published by Simple Flying, an Amazon Prime Air-branded Boeing 767-300F aircraft went off a runway at Miami International Airport. metadata.title: 空中巴士受整合挑戰影響 A350月產目標受阻

a-20260907-0158-airbus-a350-output-targe.text: 空中巴士受整合挑戰影響 A350月產目標受阻 空中巴士收購廠區整合遭遇挑戰;A350客機2028年月產12架目標面臨延誤 根據媒體 Simple Flying 報導,空中巴士(Airbus)原定於2028年前達成每月生產12架A350客機的目標,目前正面臨嚴重疑慮。相關報導指出,空中巴士在進行 Spirit AeroSystems 廠區資產收購後的整合過程中遭遇挑戰,進而引發了生產作業的延誤。 收購 Spirit AeroSystems 相關廠區後的營運整合難題,對空中巴士的產能提升造成影響。這些持續發生的整合挑戰,致使空中巴士能否按照既定時程於2028年將A350型客機的月產能提高至12架,出現顯著不確定性。 Airbus A350 Output Target In Doubt Over Spirit Site Integration Airbus faces A350 production delays amid integration challenges from Spirit AeroSystems site acquisition. Airbus is facing production delays that put its target of manufacturing 12 A350 aircraft per month by 2028 in serious doubt, according to reporting by news outlet Simple Flying. The current operational delays are being driven by integration challenges resulting from the acquisition of Spirit AeroSystems sites. Operational challenges linked to the integration of the acquired Spirit AeroSystems facilities have created difficulties for Airbus manufacturing activities. STARLUX Airlines announced that it will raise its booking service fee from $30 USD to $33 USD starting October 7, 2026. China Airlines has notified freight forwarders that it will increase fuel surcharges on export cargo from Taiwan starting September 16, 2026, to reflect fluctuations in global oil prices. a-20260907-1335-amazon-air-boeing-767-ov.text: 21 Air波音767貨機邁阿密衝出跑道奪5命 21 Air波音767貨機降落邁阿密衝出跑道;撞擊地面車輛釀5死5傷 一架由21 Air替亞馬遜航空(Amazon Air)營運的波音767-300型貨機(航班號為7598),於2026年9月6日下午在邁阿密國際機場(MIA)降落時衝出30跑道。根據追蹤資料,該架貨機在衝出可用跑道表面時,其移動速度仍高達112節(約每小時129英里或207公里)。該起事故造成5人死亡與5人受傷,其中3名傷者傷勢嚴重。兩名機組人員均在事故中生還。 根據航空新聞網站 AeroTime 與 Aerospace Global News 報導,這架註冊號為 N1997A 的波音767貨機當時正從波多黎各聖胡安的聖胡安路易斯·穆尼奧斯·馬林國際機場飛往邁阿密。飛機在下午13時53分左右降落,但未能及時停止,一路衝過跑道安全區與機場外圍圍欄,最後在機場外的公共道路上停下,並隨即起火燃燒。 美國國家運輸安全委員會(NTSB)主席詹妮弗·霍曼迪(Jennifer Homendy)形容現場慘不忍睹。調查指出,飛機在衝出跑道後撞上了導航輔助設備與多輛車輛,包括一輛載有清潔公司7名員工的福特廂型車,以及一輛豐田SUV。邁阿密-戴德消防救援隊派出超過60個單位及約200名人員趕往現場處置、救出受困人員、撲滅火勢並控制引擎燃油洩漏。 調查人員目前已成功尋獲該架貨機的黑盒子,包括飛行紀錄器(FDR)與駕駛艙通話記錄器(CVR),並已送往位於華盛頓特區的NTSB實驗室進行分析。NTSB與美國聯邦航空總署(FAA)正對這起衝出跑道事故展開調查,波音公司也對此提供支援。調查重點包括確認飛機著陸的精確位置、是否超出正常著陸區,以及煞車系統、推力反向器與減速板的運作狀況。 事故發生時的氣象報告(METAR)顯示,機場上空出現雷雨,風向190度,風速17節,陣風達26節。潮濕的跑道表面與降雨對煞車性能的影響將是早期的調查主線之一。由於事故造成重大傷亡與機場暫時關閉,邁阿密國際機場一度暫停所有航班起降,隨後重新開放了四條跑道中的兩條,但仍造成當晚嚴重的航班延誤。 Amazon Air Boeing 767 Freighter Overruns Miami Runway at 112 Knots, Killing Five 21 Air Boeing 767 overruns runway in Miami; striking vehicles and killing five people on the ground. a-20260907-1335-dutch-flying-car-develop.text: 荷蘭PAL-V飛行車獲EASA生產組織批准書 荷蘭PAL-V飛行車取得EASA生產批准,預計將於2028年開始首批交付。 荷蘭飛行車開發商 PAL-V 於 2026 年 9 月 7 日證實,該公司已正式獲得歐洲航空安全局(EASA)頒發的歐洲生產組織批准書(POA)。這項進展標誌著該公司在將認證的 FlyDrive 行動解決方案推向市場的過程中,邁出了極為關鍵的一步。該項批准確認了 PAL-V 具備製造航空產品的資質。 根據 PAL-V 的說法,該公司是先進空中交通(AAM)領域中,第一家獲得此項生產組織批准書的 FlyDrive 開發商,這使其在該領域的競爭中領先於美國與中國的相關計畫。PAL-V 執行長 Robert Dingemanse 指出,取得生產組織批准書是一項重大的里程碑。這不僅證實了公司已開發出突破性的 FlyDrive 產品平台,也確認其建立了一個有能力開發、認證並製造適航產品的世界級組織。 這家總部位於荷蘭拉姆斯東克斯費爾(Raamsdonksveer)的開發商表示,公司目前已取得數個關鍵的認證里程碑,包括在 2025 年獲得歐洲航空安全局(EASA)核發的「無技術反對」(No Technical Objection)聲明。此外,該公司亦擁有汽車生產的核准文件,使其能夠在工業化規模上製造其產品。 PAL-V 預計將於 2028 年進行其飛行車的首批交付。根據該公司的說法,其預訂訂單量已足夠填滿前三年的生產線。在 2024 年 3 月,PAL-V 曾接獲來自杜拜(Dubai)航太公司 Aviterra 的 100 輛飛行車訂單。在飛行性能方面,該款車輛在飛行時的航程可達 500 公里,最大速度則可達到每小時 180 公里。 Dutch Flying Car Developer PAL-V Secures EASA Production Organization Approval PAL-V secures EASA production organization approval; first deliveries of flying cars are expected in 2028. Dutch flying car developer PAL-V confirmed on September 7, 2026, that it has secured its European Production Organization Approval (POA) from the European Aviation Safety Agency (EASA). According to the company, this milestone represents a significant step toward bringing its certified FlyDrive mobility solutions to the commercial market, granting it the authorization to manufacture aviation products. PAL-V stated that it is the first FlyDrive developer within the Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) sector to receive this approval, placing the company ahead of rival initiatives in both the United States and China. Robert Dingemanse, CEO of PAL-V, emphasized that obtaining the POA confirms the company has established a world-class organization capable of developing, certifying, and manufacturing airworthy products based on its proprietary platform. Headquartered in Raamsdonksveer, the developer also holds automotive production approvals, which allow it to manufacture its products on an industrial scale. The latest POA follows several other critical certification achievements, including the receipt of a "No Technical Objection" statement from EASA in 2025. The company stated that these milestones validate nearly two decades of development, certification, and regulatory expertise. The manufacturer expects to begin the initial deliveries of its flying car in 2028. PAL-V reported that its current reservation portfolio is already sufficient to cover the first three years of production capacity. This backlog includes a March 2024 order for 100 units from Aviterra, a Dubai-based aerospace firm backed by the owners of executive aviation firm Jetex. In flight, the vehicle has a stated maximum speed of 180 km/h and an operational range of 500 km. a-20260907-1335-iai-completes-maiden-fli.text: IAI完成空中巴士A330客改貨機首飛 IAI完成A330-300BDSF客改貨機首飛;設計載重達61噸。 以色列航太工業(IAI)宣布,已成功完成其空中巴士(Airbus)A330-300客機改裝貨機(A330-300BDSF)的首次飛行。此次首飛是該機型認證程序的一部分,此前該機已完成了主要結構階段以及由IAI航空集團進行的地面測試。 根據IAI資料,A330-300BDSF客改貨機設計可容納多達30個貨櫃,最大載重能力達61噸,旨在為區域與中程航線的貨運業者提供具競爭力的選擇。該機型配備了電動貨物裝載系統,並在主甲板前部設有貨艙門以加速裝卸。 此計畫是IAI首度將空中巴士寬體客機納入其客改貨產品線。目前其改裝陣容涵蓋了波音777-300ERSF、波音767-200、波音767-300,以及波音737-700(ICAO機型代碼B737)與737-800等機型。 IAI Completes Maiden Flight of Converted Airbus A330-300 Freighter IAI has completed the maiden flight of its newly converted Airbus A330-300BDSF cargo aircraft. Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI) has announced the completion of the maiden flight of its converted Airbus A330-300 passenger-to-freighter aircraft, designated as the A330-300BDSF. The flight, conducted as part of the certification campaign, followed ground testing by IAI's Aviation Group. The A330-300BDSF is designed to carry up to 30 containers with a maximum payload capability of up to 61 tons, serving regional and medium-haul cargo routes. The aircraft is equipped with an electrical cargo loading system and a forward-positioned main deck cargo door to optimize turnaround times. This program introduces the first Airbus widebody to IAI’s conversion lineup. Its current portfolio also includes the Boeing 777-300ERSF, Boeing 767-200, Boeing 767-300, Boeing 737-700 (ICAO type code B737), and Boeing 737-800 platforms.
