metadata.title: Beechcraft單引擎飛機澳洲布里斯本墜毀釀兩死

a-20260907-1335-two-killed-in-beechcraft.text: Beechcraft單引擎飛機澳洲布里斯本墜毀釀兩死 Beechcraft輕型飛機於澳洲布里斯本墜毀釀2死;澳洲交通安全局已啟動事故調查 澳洲昆士蘭州布里斯本南部的洛根地方政府轄區斯托克利(Stockleigh)於2026年9月7日發生起輕型飛機墜毀事故。緊急救援單位在當地時間上午11時10分左右接獲報案,指出 Musch Road 一處鄉村農地有飛機墜落。救援人員抵達現場後,證實機上兩名乘員已當場死亡。 涉事飛機為一架1979年製造的 Beechcraft A36 Bonanza 單引擎小型飛機,國籍標誌暨登記號碼為 VH-MPT,序號為 E-1456,登記營運者為 Telford Aviation。警方初步調查顯示,該機於上午10時57分自位於布里斯本市中心南方約11公里的阿徹菲爾德機場(Archerfield Airport,代碼YBAF)起飛,隨後在不久後發生墜機事故。 飛機墜毀時在農地現場引發草地火災,救援人員抵達後迅速展開撲救,火勢在大約一小時內獲得控制。警方證實現場無任何地面人員受傷,周邊住宅亦未受到損耗或破壞。警方隨後在現場建立安全警戒線,並呼籲曾目擊飛機飛行過程或擁有相關影像資料的民眾提供資訊。 澳洲交通安全局(ATSB)已針對本起空難正式啟動交通安全調查,並自布里斯本辦事處派遣三名調查人員前往現場。調查團隊將勘查事故現場與飛機殘骸,並將相關零組件送往坎培拉的技術設施進行分析,同時收集飛行追蹤數據、機師與維修紀錄及氣象資料,預計在大約八週內發表初步報告。 Two Killed in Beechcraft Bonanza Light Aircraft Crash Near Brisbane, Australia A Beechcraft Bonanza light aircraft crashed near Brisbane, Australia, killing two people and triggering a safety investigation. Two people were killed on September 7, 2026, when a light aircraft crashed onto a rural property at Stockleigh in the Logan local government area south of Brisbane, Australia. Emergency services responded to reports of the aviation accident on Musch Road at approximately 11:10 local time, where first responders found both occupants deceased at the scene. The aircraft involved was identified as a 1979-built single-engine Beechcraft A36 Bonanza with registration VH-MPT and serial number E-1456, listed as registered to Telford Aviation. Police inquiries established that the flight had departed Archerfield Airport (YBAF), located roughly 11 kilometers south of central Brisbane, at 10:57 local time. Unconfirmed flight tracking estimates indicated that the duration of the flight lasted between 10 and 18 minutes. The crash ignited a grass fire across the property, which emergency responders managed to contain within about an hour. Officials confirmed that no residents or bystanders on the ground sustained any injuries and no nearby homes were damaged. Queensland Police established a safety cordon at the site, while local commanders requested witnesses who observed the aircraft or possessed relevant video footage to contact authorities. The Australian Transport Safety Bureau (ATSB) announced that it has commenced a formal safety investigation into the accident and dispatched three investigators from its Brisbane office. The investigation team will conduct site examinations, retrieve components for analysis at technical facilities in Canberra, gather pilot and maintenance records, and examine local weather conditions. The bureau anticipates releasing a preliminary investigation report in approximately eight weeks. a-20260907-1335-recyclers-reluctant-to-a.text: 航空回收業者面臨空中巴士A350與波音787回收難題 航空回收業者不願接收空中巴士A350與波音787,面臨永續挑戰。 根據 Simple Flying 報導,航空回收業者對於接收空中巴士(Airbus)A350 與波音(Boeing)787 客機面臨阻礙。這兩種機型的回收問題,可能成為航空業面臨的最大永續挑戰之一。 目前客機製造商正在展開競爭,試圖在這些客機開始大規模退役之前,儘速解決相關的回收難題。 根據本站歷史資料紀錄,這兩款機型在全球擁有大量訂單與部署。例如 United Airlines 已針對其機隊進行重組,其中包含訂購大量波音 787 客機,並同時面臨可能影響 45 架空中巴士 A350 客機的 Rolls-Royce 引擎爭議。 Recyclers Reluctant to Accept Airbus A350 and Boeing 787 Aircraft Aircraft recyclers avoid Airbus A350 and Boeing 787 models, posing sustainability challenges for manufacturers. a-20260907-1355-swedish-asc-890-radar-ai.text: 瑞典ASC 890雷達機首次於烏克蘭執行作戰任務 烏克蘭國防部證實;瑞典ASC 890預警機首戰 烏克蘭國防部已證實,瑞典供應的ASC 890空中預警與管制機,已於2026年3月在烏克蘭上空執行首次作戰任務。這是官方首次承認該機型已由交付階段進入實戰運用。 這項揭露出現在國防部於2026年9月4日以烏克蘭語發布、關於空軍能力聯盟(AFCC)的說明文件中。AFCC於2023年10月成立,由丹麥、荷蘭與美國共同領導,成員國共14個。 ASC 890為烏克蘭首款且唯一的專用空中預警與管制機種。在瑞典移交前,烏克蘭空軍並未操作此機型。國防部尚未公布出擊架次、部署地點或任務內容。 瑞典於2024年5月宣布移交該機,作為第16號軍事援助套件的一部分。烏克蘭國防部於2025年8月證實接收,首次作戰飛行則於2026年3月進行。 ASC 890是安裝Erieye主動電子掃描陣列雷達的Saab 340型區間渦輪螺旋槳客機。國防部表示,該機可長距偵測空中目標、協調空戰,並提升戰鬥機的運作效率。 該機在瑞典服役時稱S 100D Argus,為早期S 100B Argus的重建版,搭配北約相容的指揮管制作業與額外任務控制台。瑞典於2022年6月訂購兩架GlobalEye,並於2024年6月行使第三架的選擇權。 國防部並表示,ASC 890與F-16、Mirage 2000及Gripen,共同構成符合北約標準的網路中心空戰系統基礎。 Swedish ASC 890 radar aircraft made combat debut over Ukraine, Defense Ministry confirms Ukraine's Defense Ministry confirms Swedish ASC 890 flew first combat sorties in March 2026. Ukraine's Ministry of Defense has confirmed that the Swedish-supplied ASC 890 airborne early warning and control aircraft flew its first combat sorties over Ukraine in March 2026, the first official acknowledgment that the type has moved from delivery into operational use. The disclosure appeared in a ministry explainer on the Air Force Capability Coalition (AFCC), published in Ukrainian on September 4, 2026. The AFCC was established in October 2023 under the Ukraine Defense Contact Group and is co-led by Denmark, the Netherlands and the United States, with 14 member states. The ASC 890 gives Ukraine its first and only dedicated airborne early warning and control capability. Prior to the Swedish transfer, the Ukrainian Air Force did not operate an aircraft of this type. The ministry has not disclosed a figure for sorties flown, an operating location or a mission profile. Sweden announced the transfer in May 2024 as part of its 16th military support package. The Ukrainian ministry confirmed the transfer in August 2025, and the first combat sorties followed in March 2026. The ASC 890 is a Saab 340 regional turboprop fitted with an Erieye active electronically scanned array radar. The ministry said the type can detect airborne targets at long range, coordinate combat air operations and enable more effective use of fighter aircraft. Known in Swedish service as the S 100D Argus, the ASC 890 is a rebuild of the earlier S 100B Argus, which entered service in 1997. Sweden ordered two GlobalEye aircraft, designated S 106, in June 2022 and exercised an option for a third in June 2024; the Swedish government said in May 2024 it would advance those deliveries to offset the capability loss. The ministry added that, alongside the F-16, Mirage 2000 and Gripen, the ASC 890 forms the basis of a network-centric air combat system aligned with NATO standards. 烏克蘭國防部證實瑞典供應的ASC 890空中預警機於2026年3月在烏克蘭上空執行首次作戰出擊。 Swedish ASC 890 radar aircraft made combat debut over Ukraine 國防部於2026年9月4日以烏克蘭語發布的空軍能力聯盟說明文件中揭露此事。 The disclosure appeared in a ministry explainer on the Air Force Capability Coalition (AFCC), published in Ukrainian on September 4, 2026. a-20260907-1355-british-airways-boeing-7.text: 英國航空波音787緊急滑梯於蒙特婁意外充氣 英國航空波音787緊急滑梯對著餐點卡車充氣;班機延誤數小時 英國航空(British Airways)一架波音787(Boeing 787)客機於加拿大蒙特婁(Montreal)發生緊急滑梯意外充氣事件,滑梯展開後碰觸到一輛餐點卡車(catering truck)。 據Simple Flying報導,這起事件導致該航班起飛延誤數小時。事故地點位於蒙特婁,但報導中未指明具體機場或航班編號。 報導標題「Oops: British Airways Boeing 787 Emergency Slide Inflates Onto Catering Truck In Montreal」指出,緊急滑梯朝餐點卡車方向充氣展開,但報導未詳述滑梯為何觸發、是否造成人員受傷或卡車受損。 British Airways Boeing 787 Emergency Slide Inflates Onto Catering Truck In Montreal British Airways Boeing 787 emergency slide deployed onto a catering truck in Montreal; flight delayed several hours A British Airways Boeing 787 aircraft experienced an emergency slide deployment onto a catering truck in Montreal, Canada, according to Simple Flying. a-20260907-1830-jetblue-launches-eight-n.text: 捷藍航空宣布開通佛羅里達至八個城市新航線 捷藍航空宣布自FLL開通八條新直飛航線;再規劃六條新航線 捷藍航空(JetBlue)於2026年9月7日宣布,自羅德岱堡好萊塢國際機場(FLL)開通八條新的直飛航線,目的地城市包括巴爾的摩、夏洛特、克里夫蘭、納什維爾、底特律、休士頓、芝加哥及波多黎各首府城市邦斯。 捷藍航空並計劃在未來數月內開通前往印第安那也是、聖地牙哥、俄亥俄州哥倫布市、無夏洛特、哥倫比亞卡利、哥倫比亞巴蘭基亞等地的航線,相關服務須待進一步確認。 航空公司表示,計入這八條新航班後,捷藍航空在羅德岱堡的每日出發航班將超過125班,非直飛目的地將超過55個,是該航空公司在這座機場史上最大的班次。捷藍航空並預期今冬每日航班數可達約150班。 JetBlue launches eight new non-stop routes from Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood JetBlue announced eight new non-stop routes from FLL and plans six more; over 125 daily departures JetBlue announced on September 7, 2026, the launch of eight new non-stop routes from Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL) to Baltimore, Charlotte, Cleveland, Nashville, Detroit, Houston, Chicago, and Ponce, Puerto Rico. metadata.title: IATA發布2027年版貨運與地勤作業手冊

a-20260907-1830-iata-releases-2027-cargo.text: IATA發布2027年版貨運與地勤作業手冊 IATA發布2027年版貨運與地勤作業手冊;修訂危規、電池及活體動物規定 國際航空運輸協會(IATA)已發布2027年版貨運與地面作業關鍵業界手冊,內容納入多項重大變更與修訂,以配合全球標準的演進。 手冊修訂重點涵蓋危險物品規則(DGR)、電池運送規則(BSR)與活體動物規則(LAR)。DGR部分包含提升包裝要求明確性、備用電池與行動電源的限制與要求,以及超過300Wh之鋰電池行動輔具的新營運者義務等。 BSR部分納入混合電池(含鋰離子與鈉離子電池芯)的規範,並修訂包裝指示;LAR則新增特定無病原體實驗動物列入物種清單,並更新航空貨艙清潔與消毒程序。 IATA亦提到,其手冊相關的數位工具將逐步運用人工智慧(AI),以協助作業流程數位化。 IATA Releases 2027 Cargo and Ground Operations Manuals IATA releases 2027 editions of cargo and ground operations manuals; updates DGR, BSR and LAR rules The International Air Transport Association (IATA) has released the updated 2027 editions of key industry manuals for cargo and ground operations, incorporating major changes and revisions to align with evolving global standards. Highlights include revisions to the Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR) for clarity on packaging, restrictions and requirements for spare batteries and power banks, and requirements for lithium battery-powered mobility aids, including new operator obligations for devices exceeding 300Wh. The Battery Shipping Regulations (BSR) now include provisions for hybrid batteries with lithium-ion and sodium-ion cells, and clarify exclusions from the 4-cell/2-battery limit for certain battery shipments. The Live Animals Regulations (LAR) add specific pathogen-free laboratory animals to species listings, standardized terminology, and updated aircraft cargo compartment cleaning and disinfection procedures. IATA also described enhanced digital tools, which will increasingly leverage artificial intelligence (AI), to link its manuals more efficiently to industry processes. a-20260907-2151-airbus-august-deliveries.text: 空中巴士8月交付量年增9% 但仍落後2026年870架目標 空中巴士8月交付量成長9%;A321neo單月交付26架領跑 根據 Simple Flying 報導,飛機製造商空中巴士(Airbus)於 8 月份的飛機交付量有所提升,較先前增長 9%。然而,雖然單月交付量出現成長,該公司目前的整體交付進度仍落後於 2026 年交付 870 架飛機的目標。 在 8 月份的各機型交付數據中,A321neo 機型居於首位,單月向包含中國與美國等地區的航空公司客戶共計交付 26 架飛機。 隨着 8 月份完成這 26 架飛機的交付,A321neo 機型在今年度累計的總交付數量已增至 230 架,成為當月交付主力。 Airbus August Deliveries Rise 9% but Lag 2026 Target of 870 Aircraft Airbus August deliveries rise 9 percent; A321neo leads monthly totals with 26 handovers. According to reporting from Simple Flying, major commercial aircraft manufacturer Airbus achieved a 9% increase in total aircraft deliveries during the month of August. Despite this monthly improvement, the company remains behind the overall delivery pace needed to meet its full-year objective of 870 aircraft for 2026. The A321neo aircraft model topped the monthly delivery total in August, accounting for 26 deliveries made to commercial airline customers situated across markets ranging from China to the United States. With these 26 aircraft delivered during August, the cumulative total for A321neo deliveries across the current year reached 230 aircraft. Airbus August deliveries increased by 9%, but remain behind pace for its 870-aircraft 2026 target. a-20260908-0735-shinkong-fibers-partners.text: 新纖攜手瑞士JEDSY引進醫藥物流無人機 新纖聯手極現科技與瑞士JEDSY,引進醫藥物流無人機在台落地。 台灣新光合成纖維(新纖)於2026年9月8日宣布,聯手轉投資的極現科技與瑞士無人機商JEDSY簽署合作意向書,計畫共同成立合資公司「極新科技」,引進醫藥物流無人機方案並在台灣全面落地產製。 JEDSY董事長維拉瑟表示,公司未來計畫將生產線從瑞士移至台灣,並進駐新光幼獅園區InnovHUB。極現科技董事長徐偉城則指出,極現已取得衛福部核發的無人機醫療物流許可,具備救災等多次實際任務經驗。 新纖於2022年取得桃園「幼獅青年創業村暨智慧製造園區」50年地上權,第一期預計2027年5月完工,以打造智慧無人載具中心。新纖計畫利用其工程塑膠與3D列印技術,積極布局低空經濟。 Shinkong Fibers Partners with JEDSY for Taiwan Medical Drone Logistics Shinkong Fibers partners with Swiss firm JEDSY to introduce medical logistics drones in Taiwan. On September 8, 2026, Shinkong Synthetic Fibers, its affiliate Ji-Xian Technology, and Swiss drone manufacturer JEDSY signed a letter of intent to establish a joint venture, Ji-Xin Technology, to localize medical logistics drone solutions in Taiwan. JEDSY Chairman Herbert Weirather stated that drone production will relocate from Switzerland to Taiwan, making JEDSY the first international firm to enter Shinkong's InnovHUB. Ji-Xian Technology will help deploy these services using its medical logistics permit from the Ministry of Health and Welfare. Shinkong secured a 50-year land-use right for Taoyuan's Youth Lion Smart Manufacturing Park in 2022, with the first phase completing in May 2027. The company plans to leverage its engineering plastics and 3D printing to target the low-altitude economy. 新纖、其轉投資公司極現科技與瑞士無人機商JEDSY於2026年9月8日簽署策略合作意向書,引進醫藥物流無人機方案至台灣。 新纖積極布局低空經濟,今天宣布號召轉投資公司極現科技,與瑞士醫藥物流無人機商JEDSY,三方簽署策略合作意向書,希望把JEDSY已經有實績的醫藥物流無人機方案引進台灣。 三方計畫共同成立合資公司「極新科技」,讓JEDSY的無人機方案在台灣全面落地。 共同成立合資公司「極新科技」,讓JEDSY的醫藥物流無人機方案,從設計、研發、產製到服務,全面在台灣落地。 JEDSY計畫未來將生產線從瑞士搬到台灣,且該公司為首家確定進駐新光幼獅園區InnovHUB的國際企業。 未來將搬到台灣產製。JEDSY也成為第1家確定進駐新光幼獅園區InnovHUB的國際企業。 極現科技已取得衛福部核發的無人機醫療物流許可,並具備實際救災等任務經驗。 極現科技已取得衛服部核發的無人機醫療物流許可,且具備多次實際任務經驗 新纖於2022年取得桃園「幼獅青年創業村暨智慧製造園區」50年地上權,第一期工程預計於2027年5月完工。 新纖2022年得標簽約桃園市政府與國產署合作規劃的「幼獅青年創業村暨智慧製造園區」案,取得50年地上權,第一期開發案正在興建中,預計2027年5月完工

metadata.title: 印度延後AMCA匿蹤戰機原型機投標截止日 至10月30日

a-20260908-0735-india-extends-amca-steal.text: 印度延後AMCA匿蹤戰機原型機投標截止日 至10月30日 印度將AMCA匿蹤戰機原型機投標截止日延至10月30日;三組民營團隊競標 印度政府已將「先進中型戰鬥機」(AMCA)原型機競標案的提案截止日期,由原本的8月27日延後至10月30日,給予三組獲選入圍的民營企業團隊額外兩個月時間準備投標文件。印度國防官員表示,此次延期是應競標廠商的要求而批准,投標文件預計將於截止日的次日開啟。 獲選的「開發暨生產夥伴」將與印度航空發展署(ADA)合作,將AMCA設計概念轉化為可飛行之實體機型,建立製造基礎設施,並支援後續的飛行測試與認證工作。根據規劃,該專案預計製造五架原型機與一架結構測試件,首架原型機須在合約簽署後30個月內實現首飛,整個開發計畫預計在84個月內執行約1,800架次的測試飛行。 本次參與競標的三組民營團隊中,塔塔先進系統公司(TASL)是唯一獨立投標的企業。第二組團隊是由Larsen & Toubro領軍的聯盟,成員包括國營的Bharat Electronics Limited(BEL)與Dynamatic Technologies。第三組競標團隊則由Bharat Forge、BEML及Data Patterns共同組成。開放民營企業競標此大型戰機專案,象徵著印度過去由國營企業主導戰鬥機製造的傳統出現顯著轉變。 值得注意的是,過去長期主導印度國產戰鬥機製造、包含生產「光輝」(Tejas)戰鬥機的印度斯坦航空有限公司(HAL),並未進入最終競標名單。HAL曾參與AMCA初始評選階段,但未通過技術與財務評估。HAL事後表示,並未收到確認其被排除於競標之外的官方通知。 根據目前專案規劃,首架AMCA原型機預計於2029年左右首飛,開發階段將於下一個十年結束,量產作業則預計於2035年左右展開。這款重約25噸的雙發動機匿蹤戰鬥機,具備低可偵測性外形、內部彈艙、感測器融合與先進電子航航系統。初始量產型AMCA Mk1預計採用GE Aerospace的F414發動機。 India Extends AMCA Stealth Fighter Prototype Bid Deadline to October 30 India extended its AMCA stealth fighter prototype bid deadline to October 30 for three private-sector teams. India has extended the deadline for Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) proposals from 27 August to 30 October, giving three shortlisted private-sector teams an additional two months to prepare their submissions. According to Indian defence officials, the extension was granted following requests from the competing entities. Bids are now scheduled to open on the day following the new closing date. The selected Development-cum-Production Partner will collaborate with the Aeronautical Development Agency (ADA) to develop the AMCA design into operational hardware, establish manufacturing facilities, and support flight-testing and certification. The development plan outlines five flying prototypes and one structural test article, with the first prototype required to fly within 30 months of signing the contract. The flight-test campaign is expected to encompass around 1,800 test sorties over an 84-month period. Three private-sector industrial groups are competing for the major defence manufacturing contract. Tata Advanced Systems Limited (TASL) is submitting an independent bid. A second team is a consortium led by Larsen & Toubro, alongside state-owned Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) and Dynamatic Technologies. The third bidding group comprises Bharat Forge, BEML, and Data Patterns. Selecting a private entity marks a shift from earlier Indian combat aircraft manufacturing programmes. Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), India's primary state-owned combat aircraft manufacturer that produces the Tejas fighter, is absent from the final bidder shortlist. HAL participated in the initial AMCA process but did not progress past the technical and financial evaluation stages. HAL subsequently stated it had received no official notification confirming its exclusion from the competition. Current programme scheduling projects the first AMCA prototype to take flight around 2029, with development wrapping up in the 2030s and series production targeted to begin around 2035. The approximately 25-tonne twin-engine stealth fighter is specified to feature low-observable shaping, internal weapons bays, sensor fusion, and advanced avionics. The initial AMCA Mk1 version is set to utilize GE Aerospace F414 engines. India extended the proposal deadline for the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) from August 27 to October 30. The deadline for Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) proposals has moved from 27 August to 30 October Three private-sector teams have been granted an additional two months to compete for the contract to build prototypes of India's fifth-generation fighter. India has given three private-sector teams an additional two months to compete for the contract to build prototypes of the country’s first indigenous fifth-generation fighter. The winning Development-cum-Production Partner will work with the Aeronautical Development Agency (ADA) to turn the AMCA design into flying hardware Tata Advanced Systems Limited is competing independently, while consortia led by Larsen & Toubro and Bharat Forge are also bidding. Tata Advanced Systems Limited is the only company competing independently rather than as part of a consortium. HAL participated in the initial AMCA process but did not progress beyond the technical and financial evaluation . metadata.title: 聖嬰現象預估持續至2027年 或使全球冬季航班顛簸加劇

a-20260908-0735-el-nino-forecast-to-inte.text: 聖嬰現象預估持續至2027年 或使全球冬季航班顛簸加劇 世界氣象組織預測強烈聖嬰現象將持續至2027年初,或導致冬季航班亂流增加。 世界氣象組織(WMO)預測,一波非常強烈的聖嬰現象將在未來幾個月內增強,並將持續至2027年初。這項氣候現象預計將在冬季對全球航空與空中旅行產生廣泛影響。航空公司可能面臨更具不可預測性的天氣狀況,這可能導致晴空亂流增加、航班延誤,並對噴射氣流與飛行時間產生影響。 根據提供亂流與飛行員報告(PIREP)資訊的平台 SkyPath 指出,聖嬰現象會改變高空大氣的風切。風切是產生晴空亂流的主因,而這種亂流因肉眼不可見且氣象雷達無法偵測,因此特別具危險性。SkyPath 指出,研究人員分析40年的大氣資料發現,當從強烈的反聖嬰現象轉變為強烈的聖嬰現象時,北大西洋上空飛機巡航高度的風切將增加約35%。此外,SkyPath 表示,北大西洋上空的亂流總量已增加了約30%。 聖嬰現象對亂流的影響因地區而異。SkyPath 的分析顯示,美國、南美洲、東南亞、澳洲和非洲等地區預估將面臨更強的風切與更高的亂流機率。相反地,東亞地區的情況則恰好相反,聖嬰現象會減少當地的風切與亂流,而反聖嬰現象則會使之增加。 除了聖嬰現象之外,北大西洋的晴空亂流在長期上也呈現增加趨勢。一項發表於《地球物理研究通訊》(Geophysical Research Letters)的同儕審查研究,分析了1979年至2020年之間的大氣資料。這項由雷丁大學(University of Reading)與英國氣象局(Met Office)研究人員進行的研究指出,在北大西洋上空的平均觀測點,巡航高度每年發生強烈或以上等級晴空亂流的持續時間增加了55%,從1979年的17.7小時增加到2020年的27.4小時。 此外,聖嬰現象預計還將透過改變熱帶加熱效應和大氣環流,進而改變全球噴射氣流的位置與強度。在聖嬰現象期間,噴射氣流最強的部分通常會向南移動,並向東延伸跨越北太平洋,使其更接近北美洲,這將進一步影響航班的飛行路徑與飛行時間。 El Nino Forecast to Intensify Into 2027, Bringing Increased Winter Flight Turbulence The World Meteorological Organisation warns El Nino could increase winter flight turbulence and delays through early 2027. The World Meteorological Organisation (WMO) has forecast that a very strong El Niño climate pattern will intensify in the coming months and persist into early 2027. This development is expected to have widespread effects on global aviation and air travel during the winter season. Airlines could face more unpredictable weather conditions, which may lead to increased clear-air turbulence, flight delays, and alterations to jet streams and flight times. According to turbulence and PIREP platform SkyPath, El Niño changes wind shear in the upper atmosphere, which is the primary driver of clear-air turbulence. This type of turbulence is particularly hazardous as it is invisible and cannot be detected by weather radar. SkyPath noted that atmospheric data spanning 40 years shows wind shear at aircraft cruising levels over the North Atlantic Ocean increases by approximately 35% when transitioning from a very strong La Niña to a very strong El Niño. Furthermore, SkyPath reported that turbulence over the North Atlantic has already increased by about 30%. The impact of El Niño on flight conditions varies by region. SkyPath's analysis indicates that stronger wind shear and elevated turbulence probabilities are anticipated over the United States, South America, Southeast Asia, Australia, and Africa. However, the phenomenon has the opposite effect in East Asia, where El Niño is associated with a decrease in wind shear and turbulence, while La Niña increases them. This climate pattern occurs alongside a longer-term trend of rising clear-air turbulence. A peer-reviewed study published in Geophysical Research Letters analyzed atmospheric data from 1979 to 2020. Conducted by researchers from the University of Reading and the Met Office, the study found that at an average point over the North Atlantic, the annual duration of severe-or-greater clear-air turbulence at cruising altitudes increased by 55%, rising from 17.7 hours in 1979 to 27.4 hours in 2020. Additionally, El Niño is expected to alter the position and strength of global jet streams by changing tropical heating and atmospheric circulation. During such events, the strongest portions of the jet stream typically shift south and extend farther east across the North Pacific Ocean, bringing the jet stream closer to North America, which can impact flight paths and durations. a-20260908-0735-global-airlines-faces-wi.text: 英國Global Airlines面臨清算聲請 旗下A380復飛進度受阻 英國Global Airlines遭債權人提清算聲請;旗下A380停飛法國 英國新創航空公司Global Airlines面臨新的清算聲請。官方紀錄顯示,債權人Jessica Huffman Reese於2026年5月29日提出聲請,並由律師事務所Vedder Price代表。法院排定7月15日與9月2日舉行聽證會,索賠金額與聽證結果未公開。 該公司2025年亦曾面臨清算聲請後獲撤回。清算聲請為債權人尋求公司解散的程序,不代表已破產。目前Global Airlines旗下唯一的空中巴士A380客機(9H-GLOBL)仍停飛於法國塔布。 執行長James Asquith於6月表示,目標於2026年底前恢復A380飛航並研議新航線。該公司曾於2025年5月透過Hi Fly Malta濕租合作,以A380執飛格拉斯哥至紐約(JFK)包機。 Global Airlines Faces Winding-Up Petition as Airbus A380 Return Plans Stall Global Airlines faces a new winding-up petition while attempting to restore its Airbus A380 to service. a-20260908-0735-volcanic-ash-from-anak-k.text: 印尼喀拉喀托之子火山噴發致雅加達等七座機場關閉 喀拉喀托之子火山噴發;印尼七座機場關閉;逾27萬旅客受阻 印尼七座機場(包含雅加達的兩大門戶:蘇加諾-哈達國際機場 (CGK) 與哈利姆·珀達納庫蘇馬機場 (HLP))於2026年9月7日週一維持關閉。此次關閉是由於喀拉喀托之子火山噴發,其產生的火山灰飄入商業航班使用的空域,導致飛行安全受到威脅。 印尼交通部表示,自2026年9月5日以來,這波火山活動已導致約2,300架次航班及270,337名旅客受到航班取消、延誤或轉降的影響。其他維持關閉的機場還包括:Radin Inten II、Budiarto、Pondok Cabe、Muhammad Taufiq Kiemas 以及 Husein Sastranegara 機場;而 Atung Bungsu 機場則已於週一上午重新開放。 Volcanic Ash from Anak Krakatau Forces Closure of Seven Indonesian Airports Anak Krakatau volcanic ash forces Indonesian airport closures, disrupting over 270,000 passengers. Seven Indonesian airports, including Jakarta's main gateways Soekarno-Hatta International Airport (CGK) and Halim Perdanakusuma Airport (HLP), remained closed on Monday, September 7, 2026. The closures followed eruptions from the Anak Krakatau volcano, which sent volcanic ash into airspace used by commercial aircraft, making flying unsafe. Indonesia's Transport Ministry reported that the ongoing volcanic activity has affected around 2,300 flights and 270,337 passengers through cancellations, delays, and diversions since September 5, 2026. Other affected facilities remaining closed include Radin Inten II, Budiarto, Pondok Cabe, Muhammad Taufiq Kiemas, and Husein Sastranegara airports, while Atung Bungsu Airport reopened on Monday morning. metadata.title: 希臘空軍F-4戰機於航空展失事墜毀 兩名飛行員殉職調查中

a-20260908-0735-greek-air-force-f-4-phan.text: 希臘空軍F-4戰機於航空展失事墜毀 兩名飛行員殉職調查中 希臘空軍一架F-4戰機於塔納格拉基地航空展墜毀;兩名飛官殉職;事故原因調查中 希臘空軍一架雙座型F-4幽靈II(F-4 Phantom II)戰鬥機於2026年9月5日在雅典附近的塔納格拉空軍基地(Tanagra Air Base,代碼LGTG)舉辦的航空展中失事墜毀。根據希臘官方說明,這架戰機當時正在執行低空單機飛行表演展示,於特技機動過程中失控墜毀,造成機上兩名飛行員不幸殉職。官方同時證實,事故發生地點距離機場約兩公里,並未造成地面觀展民眾或旁觀者受傷。 根據航空安全網(Aviation Safety Network)紀錄,這架涉事戰機為麥道F-4E AUP幽靈II型(McDonnell Douglas F-4E AUP Phantom II),隸屬於希臘空軍第117作戰聯隊第338戰術飛行隊。資料顯示,該機在進場接近28C跑道時高度過低,隨後撞擊樹木與一棟工業建築並起火燃燒,墜毀地點距離跑道頭約3公里。希臘相關單位表示,目前事故具體原因與詳細經過仍處於調查階段,官方尚未發布最終調查結論。 希臘自1974年起分批引進約120架F-4幽靈戰機,來源包括新造機以及來自美國空軍國民警衛隊與德國空軍的二手機型。多年來希臘空軍已有約33架F-4戰機因各式事故損失。現役留存的戰機均已透過航電提升計畫(Avionics Upgrade Programme, AUP)完成升級,目前僅有升級後的F-4E AUP機型繼續在希臘空軍服役,並由位於安德拉維達(Andravida)的第117作戰聯隊第338「阿瑞斯」戰術轟炸機隊負責操作。 希臘政府於2024年公布空軍現代化計畫,預計逐步退役包含F-4幽靈II、早期型F-16 Block 30以及幻象2000-5(Mirage 2000-5)等舊型戰機,同時規劃引進達梭疾風(Dassault Rafale)、F-35A匿蹤戰機並升級現役F-16 Block 50戰機。希臘空軍現役F-4戰機的退役時程與新型F-35A戰機交機進度掛鉤,預計將持續服役至2020年代後期,目前官方尚未確定最終退役日期。希臘也是目前全球僅存三個仍在使用F-4戰機的國家之一。 Greek Air Force F-4 Phantom Fighter Crashes at Airshow, Killing Two Pilots Greek Air Force F-4 Phantom crashes during airshow near Athens; two pilots killed; cause under investigation A Hellenic Air Force two-seat F-4E Phantom II fighter jet crashed on September 5, 2026, during an aerial display at an airshow held at Tanagra Air Base (LGTG) near Athens, killing both pilots on board. According to the tracking reports, the fighter came in too low while approaching runway 28C, striking trees and an industrial building before bursting into flames approximately three kilometers from the runway threshold. The retirement schedule for the remaining F-4 fleet is linked directly to the arrival of replacement F-35A fighters, suggesting the aircraft could remain operational into the late 2020s, although no finalized retirement date has been officially confirmed. metadata.title: 澳洲航空QantasLink首架E190抵達伯斯展開機隊更新

a-20260908-1224-qantaslink-receives-firs.text: 澳洲航空QantasLink首架E190抵達伯斯展開機隊更新 QantasLink首架E190抵達伯斯;展開F100替換;預計2027年營運。 澳洲航空(Qantas)旗下區域航空公司QantasLink迎來首架巴西航空工業E190(ICAO機型代碼E190)客機。該架國籍標誌VH-E9A的客機於2026年9月7日飛抵西澳大利亞伯斯,完成自英國諾里奇出發、歷時約20小時的跨國飛行,途中曾在保加利亞、塔吉克、印度、馬來西亞及西澳大利亞布魯姆進行加油停靠。 此架客機為QantasLink引進最多14架中古巴西航空工業E190計畫中的首架客機,旨在逐步替換在西澳大利亞地區營運的福克F100機隊。根據規劃,該客機經檢修與客艙升級後,預計於2027年1月正式投入商業營運,服務當地礦業包機與區域定期航線。 首架引進的E190客機命名為「Exmouth」,承襲了以往以西澳大利亞地名命名的傳統。新客機採用100座配置與2-2座位佈局,配備具備可調式頭靠的新型座椅、USB-A與USB-C充電插孔及個人裝置支架,並導入無線網路系統與Qantas Economy Plus艙等,提供乘客更寬敞的腿部空間與優先登機服務。 為配合新機隊引進,QantasLink計劃在今年底前完成約70名機師、空服員及機務工程師的培訓,累計提供1.8萬小時的訓練課程。隨着轉型計畫推進,預計未來將有超過600名人員接受該機型的操作與維護訓練。 在性能表現方面,巴西航空工業E190在滿載條件下的航程達到4,537公里,相較於現行福克F100的3,170公里增加約1,367公里。更高的燃油效率與更遠的航程,將為航空公司在西澳大利亞廣闊的區域網路中提供更彈性的航線佈局與營運能力。 QantasLink Receives First Embraer E190 in Perth to Begin Fokker F100 Fleet Replacement QantasLink received its first Embraer E190 in Perth to replace its Fokker F100 fleet from 2027. QantasLink has received its first Embraer E190 (ICAO type code E190) aircraft in Perth, Western Australia, on September 7, 2026. The 100-seat regional jet, registered VH-E9A, arrived following a 20-hour delivery flight from Norwich in the United Kingdom, making planned refueling stops in Bulgaria, Tajikistan, India, Malaysia, and Broome before reaching Perth. The aircraft is the first of up to 14 mid-life Embraer E190 jets that will progressively replace QantasLink's aging Fokker F100 fleet across Western Australian operations. The fleet renewal program supports both regional scheduled services and resource sector charter operations, with the first E190 scheduled to enter commercial passenger service in January 2027. Named Exmouth, continuing the airline's tradition of naming aircraft after Western Australian destinations, the jet features a refreshed cabin with a two-by-two seat layout. Customer enhancements include new seats with adjustable headrests, USB-A and USB-C power sockets, personal device holders, onboard Wi-Fi streaming, and Qantas Economy Plus offering increased legroom and priority access. Ahead of entry into service, QantasLink is conducting 18,000 hours of training for approximately 70 pilots, cabin crew members, and maintenance engineers by the end of the year. As the operational deployment reaches full scale, the airline plans to train more than 600 personnel on the new aircraft type. The Embraer E190 offers a published full-payload range of 4,537 kilometers (2,450 nautical miles), representing an increase of roughly 1,367 kilometers compared to the 3,170-kilometer range of the Fokker F100. Powered by twin GE CF34-10E turbofan engines, the aircraft provides improved fuel efficiency, lower noise levels, and greater operational flexibility for long-distance regional routes. QantasLink's first Embraer E190, registered VH-E9A, arrived in Perth on September 7, 2026, after a 20-hour delivery flight from Norwich, United Kingdom. The 100-seat jet, named Exmouth, features updated seating with USB charging, onboard Wi-Fi, and introduces Qantas Economy Plus. a-20260908-1224-japan-scrambles-fighter-.text: 日本連續五日緊急升空戰機 攔截中國Y-9情報偵察機 日本自衛隊連續五日對中國Y-9偵察機緊急升空;未侵入日本領空 日本防衛省統合幕僚監部最新公布的監測資料顯示,航空自衛隊於2026年9月3日至9月7日期間,連續五天針對出現在東海空域的中國軍用Y-9情報偵察機,緊急升空戰機實施對應。防衛省各相應區域航空方面隊在掌握目標動向後,均即時派遣戰機進行監控與跟蹤。 統合幕僚監部於2026年9月7日發布的最新通報指出,當天下午一架中國Y-9情報偵察機自中國大陸方向飛來,先飛抵長崎縣男女群島以南空域,隨後折向西南方向飛行,並在沖繩本島附近改變航向往東北飛行,之後再次於男女群島以南轉向,最終返航飛回中國大陸方向。該次攔截行動由西部航空方面隊及其他單位共同派機執行。 防衛省記錄顯示,前四天的飛行航線與9月7日的路線極為相似。在9月5日的事件中,Y-9偵察機同樣由中國大陸方向接近並於沖繩本島附近轉向,隨後於男女群島附近再次變向後離去,該次任務由南西航空方面隊負責對應;其餘四天則均由管轄男女群島空域的西部航空方面隊執行緊急升空。防衛省強調,相關通報中均未記錄到任何侵入日本領空的情況。 此外,統合幕僚監部於9月7日發布的另一份通報記錄,一架俄羅斯Il-20情報偵察機於9月5日自大陸方向經鄂霍次克海進入太平洋,並一路向南飛至宮城縣沖空域後折返,再經鄂霍次克海返回日本海,北部航空方面隊對此緊急升空戰機監控。統計顯示,在截至2026年3月31日的2025財政年度中,自衛隊共執行595次緊急升空,其中約61%係針對中國航空器。 Japan scrambles fighter jets five consecutive days against Chinese Y-9 spy aircraft Japan Air Self-Defense Force scrambled fighters for Chinese Y-9 aircraft over East China Sea five consecutive days Japan’s Joint Staff recorded a Chinese Y-9 intelligence-gathering aircraft flying over the East China Sea for five consecutive days from September 3 to September 7, 2026, prompting the Japan Air Self-Defense Force (JASDF) to scramble fighter jets in response each time, according to official notices. A notice published on September 7, 2026, detailed the latest flight path, describing a single Y-9 arriving from the Chinese mainland that afternoon. The aircraft flew south of the Danjo Islands in Nagasaki Prefecture, turned southwest, reversed course off Okinawa Island to track northeast, and changed heading again south of the Danjo Islands before returning toward mainland China. Fighters from the Western Air Defense Force responded alongside other units. Similar flight paths were recorded on the four preceding days. On September 5, 2026, the Y-9 approached from the mainland, turned off Okinawa Island, flew northeast, and changed course off the Danjo Islands before exiting the area. While the Southwestern Air Defense Force handled the scramble on September 5, the Western Air Defense Force managed the responses on the remaining four days. None of the official notices reported any incursion into Japanese territorial airspace. A separate notice issued on September 7, 2026, documented a Russian Il-20 intelligence-gathering aircraft flying from the mainland through the Sea of Okhotsk into the Pacific on September 5, 2026. The Russian aircraft traveled south to waters off Miyagi Prefecture before reversing direction and returning to the Sea of Japan via the Sea of Okhotsk, triggering a scramble by Northern Air Defense Force fighters. Official figures for fiscal year 2025, which ended March 31, 2026, show JASDF executed 595 scrambles in total, with approximately 61% directed against Chinese aircraft. metadata.title: 瑞士航空計劃將最後一架空中巴士A340客機捐贈予交通博物館

a-20260908-1224-swiss-plans-to-donate-la.text: 瑞士航空計劃將最後一架空中巴士A340客機捐贈予交通博物館 瑞士航空計劃於2028年初將最後一架A340客機捐贈予盧森交通博物館。 瑞士國際航空(SWISS)目前正與瑞士交通博物館密切合作,計劃將該航空公司最後一架空中巴士A340-300客機保存於盧森(Lucerne)的博物館中,作為永久性的戶外展品。根據雙方的規劃,一旦該客機達到其營運壽命的終點,將會被捐贈給這家位於盧森的博物館,並預計展示於航空航天展覽館前的戶外區域。航空公司表示,希望能於2028年初完成該客機的安置工作。 空中巴士A340-300客機多年來一直是瑞士國際航空長途機隊的重要成員。作為該航空公司機隊中最後一款四引擎機型,其退役將象徵著一個時代的終結。瑞士國際航空執行長 Jens Fehlinger 表示,A340客機多年來將瑞士與世界各地連結在一起,其本身已成為瑞士航空歷史的一部分。博物館方面則計劃在客機內部打造遊客體驗設施,使其成為航空與太空展覽的新核心展品。 然而,這項計劃仍面臨重大的技術與物流挑戰。這架重達約125噸的客機必須從蘇黎世機場(ZRH)經由陸路運送至盧森的博物館,並精確定位於館區內。此一極具挑戰性的運送過程需要進行詳細的可行性研究、專門的運輸方案、博物館場地的結構改造,以及與瑞士相關主管機關的密切協調。瑞士交通博物館館長 Martin Ettlinger 坦言,將如此龐大體積的飛機運送到盧森是一項極其巨大且高度複雜的工程。 除了物流之外,資金籌措同樣面臨考驗。雖然瑞士國際航空將免費捐贈該客機,但運送、場地結構改造以及艙內參觀體驗的建置成本均須由博物館承擔。目前預估總費用高達個位數的百萬級,資金預計主要來自基金會、資助人及企業贊助。由瑞士交通博物館協會主席兼瑞士國際航空前執行長 Christoph Franz 領導的籌款委員會已展開接觸。該項目必須在2026年底前確保資金到位,方能繼續推進。 SWISS Plans to Donate Last Airbus A340-300 to Swiss Museum of Transport SWISS plans to donate its last Airbus A340-300 to Switzerland's transport museum by early 2028. Swiss International Air Lines (SWISS) and the Swiss Museum of Transport are collaborating on a project to preserve one of the airline's last Airbus A340-300 aircraft. Under current plans, once the four-engined aircraft reaches the end of its operational life, it will be donated to the museum in Lucerne to serve as a permanent outdoor exhibit in front of the Aviation and Space Travel Hall. The airline stated that it hopes to have the aircraft positioned at the museum by early 2028. The retirement of the Airbus A340-300 will mark the end of an era for SWISS, as it is the last remaining four-engined aircraft type in the carrier's fleet. SWISS CEO Jens Fehlinger remarked that the aircraft has connected Switzerland with the world for many years, becoming a significant part of Swiss aviation history. The museum plans to transform the interior of the aircraft into a walkthrough visitor experience, making it a new centerpiece of its permanent exhibition alongside a former Swissair Convair 990 'Coronado'. However, the initiative faces significant technical and logistical challenges. The aircraft weighs approximately 125 tons and must be transported overland from Zurich Airport (ZRH) to the museum grounds in Lucerne. This complex undertaking will require detailed feasibility studies, specialized transportation solutions, structural modifications to the museum site, and close coordination with Swiss authorities. Martin Ettlinger, Director of the Swiss Museum of Transport, described the project as an enormous and highly complex task. The project also requires substantial financial backing. While SWISS is donating the aircraft itself, the museum must cover the costs of transport, site preparation, and the interior visitor exhibit. The total cost is currently estimated at a high single-digit million figure. A fundraising committee led by Christoph Franz, President of the Swiss Museum of Transport Association, is seeking sponsors. Funding must be secured by the end of 2026, and a final decision will depend on transportation, permitting, and complete financing. a-20260908-1224-breeze-retires-its-last-.text: Breeze正式退役最後一架E190客機轉用全A220機隊 Breeze正式退役巴西航空工業E190;將全面轉型為空中巴士A220機隊 根據航空媒體《Simple Flying》於2026年9月8日的報導,總部位於美國猶他州的航空公司Breeze已正式退役其最後一架巴西航空工業E190(ICAO機型代碼E190)客機。此項舉措標誌著該航空公司正式步入全新時代,並將全面過渡至由空中巴士(Airbus)A220客機組成的單一機隊。 在此之前,飛機製造商巴西航空工業公司(Embraer)於2026年9月3日向巴西的Azul Linhas Aéreas交付了其第2,000架E-Jet系列飛機,該飛機為E195-E2機型。E-Jet系列客機於2004年首度投入服務,目前已為全球60多個國家的90多家航空公司提供服務,累計飛行時間約4,800萬小時,並載運了超過28.5億名旅客。 Breeze Retires Its Last Embraer E190 To Transition To All-Airbus A220 Fleet Breeze retires its final Embraer E190 to transition to an all Airbus A220 fleet. According to a report by Simple Flying on September 8, 2026, Utah-based airline Breeze has officially retired its last Embraer E190 (ICAO type code E190) aircraft. metadata.title: 聖地牙哥蒙哥馬利-吉布斯行政機場(MYF)賽斯納飛機墜毀釀2死

a-20260908-1224-two-killed-in-cessna-sky.text: 聖地牙哥蒙哥馬利-吉布斯行政機場(MYF)賽斯納飛機墜毀釀2死 一架賽斯納小型飛機於聖地牙哥MYF機場墜毀起火,造成機上兩人死亡。 一架賽斯納天鷹(Cessna Skyhawk)小型飛機於2026年9月7日傍晚,在美國加利福尼亞州聖地牙哥的蒙哥馬利-吉布斯行政機場(MYF)跑道上發生墜毀並起火燃燒,事故造成機上兩名人員不幸死亡。根據聖地牙哥警察局的報告指出,警方的應變單位是在當地時間約17時20分接獲該起空難通報。事發當時正值美國勞工節假期,機場內多數店家與商業設施均處於關閉狀態。 聖地牙哥消防救援局副局長布萊恩·雷恩斯(Brian Raines)在出席當地媒體記者會時表示,救援人員趕抵現場時,飛機主體已遭受極為嚴重的毀損,導致救援人員完全無法從機艙內救出受困人員。雷恩斯隨後證實,機上的兩名人員均已宣告死亡,惟相關單位目前尚未公開死者的具體身份資訊。此外,消防單位亦強調火勢已得到控制,並無蔓延至墜機地點以外區域的風險,現場並已聯繫專業承包商針對跑道上洩漏的航空燃料進行清理。 根據現場目擊者的說法,一名當時在附近停車場高層觀看飛機起降的民眾向《洛杉磯時報》透露,該架飛機在準備進場降落時,機身似乎向右側傾斜,隨後機翼直接撞擊地面;在撞擊發生的數秒之內,飛機前部隨即冒出大火,且在撞擊前並未看見機身發出任何煙霧。另一方面,兩名在附近機庫工作的目擊者則向媒體表示,他們當時聽到巨響並目擊火勢迅速蔓延,兩人雖隨即持滅火器前往救援,但火勢在約90秒內便將整架飛機吞噬。 事發之後,美國聯邦航空管理局(FAA)已立即下令關閉蒙哥馬利-吉布斯行政機場,目前尚未設定恢復營運的時間表。雷恩斯對此說明,機場重啟的決策將與美國國家運輸安全委員會(NTSB)及機場管理當局共同協調後決定,並視調查程序所需的時間而定。目前國家運輸安全委員會已接管並主導整起墜機事故原因的調查工作。據瞭解,蒙哥馬利-吉布斯行政機場為通用航空設施,提供私人、企業、包機、空中救護及飛行訓練等多項服務。 Two Killed in Cessna Skyhawk Crash at San Diego Montgomery-Gibbs Airport A Cessna Skyhawk crashed at San Diego Montgomery-Gibbs Airport, leaving two dead and prompting an NTSB investigation. A small Cessna Skyhawk aircraft crashed and caught fire on a runway at Montgomery-Gibbs Executive Airport (MYF) in San Diego, California, on the evening of September 7, 2026, leaving two people dead on board. According to a report issued by the San Diego Police Department, emergency responders received notice of the crash at approximately 17:20 local time. The fatal incident occurred on the Labor Day holiday, a time when most businesses and shops operating at the general aviation facility were closed. Speaking at a news conference with local media, San Diego Fire-Rescue Assistant Chief Brian Raines stated that the aircraft sustained catastrophic damage before emergency crews could reach the scene, rendering it impossible to extricate anyone from the wreckage. Raines confirmed that both individuals aboard the plane died in the accident, though authorities have not yet publicly released their identities. Officials emphasized that there was no risk of the fire spreading beyond the crash site, and a specialist contractor was summoned to clear spilled aviation fuel from the runway. Witnesses near the airfield described the moments leading up to the impact. A resident watching flights from the top floor of a nearby parking garage told the Los Angeles Times that the aircraft appeared to tilt sharply to the right during its landing approach before its wing struck the ground. According to the witness, the front section of the plane caught fire within seconds of impact, with no visible smoke preceding the collision. Additionally, two workers from a nearby hangar reported hearing a loud explosion before attempting to extinguish the rapidly spreading flames, which completely engulfed the aircraft in about 90 seconds. Following the crash, the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) immediately shut down Montgomery-Gibbs Executive Airport, with no initial timetable established for its reopening. Assistant Chief Raines noted that decisions regarding the airport's reopening will be made in coordination with the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) and airport officials, contingent upon the requirements of the ongoing safety inquiry. The NTSB has assumed the lead role in investigating the cause of the accident. Montgomery-Gibbs Executive Airport serves as a regional general aviation hub supporting private, corporate, charter, medical transport, flight training, and light cargo operations. metadata.title: GE 航太以117.5億美元收購鑄件供應商CPP

a-20260908-1656-ge-aerospace-to-buy-engi.text: GE 航太以117.5億美元收購鑄件供應商CPP GE航太收購CPP;交易預計2027下半年完成 GE Aerospace(GE航太)於2026年9月8日宣布,已同意以117.5億美元收購其鑄件供應商Consolidated Precision Products(CPP),直接取得該零件類別的所有權,此類零件過去限制了業界的引擎產出。 此項交易將從私募投資公司Warburg Pincus與Berkshire Partners手中買下CPP,並預計於2027年下半年完成交割,尚待監管機關批准及其他慣例成交條件。GE航太表示,將以70億美元現金及餘額的新增債務支付,且不會改變其資本配置計畫。 總部位於俄亥俄州克里夫蘭(Cleveland)的CPP成立於1991年,專門生產用於商用與軍用飛機、武器系統、直升機、飛彈及工業燃氣渦輪機的超合金、鈦、鋁、鎂及鋼材精密及精密砂心鑄件。該公司雇有約6,600人,分布在超過20座工廠,而GE航太為其客戶已超過15年。 在向美國證券交易委員會(SEC)提交的投資人簡報中,GE Aerospace指出,CPP供應LEAP、GEnx、T700、F110及F404引擎的鑄件,並預測其自身的葉片需求(以零件數量計算)在2026年至2030年間,將在商用引擎、售後市場及防衛領域中成長超過30%。 GE Aerospace以約2027年EBITDA的18倍來評價CPP,其中包含預期約2億美元的淨綜效,若不含綜效,則為約26倍。若以這些倍數套用至收購價格,CPP在2027年的息稅前項目估約為47.5億美元。公司表示,預期此收購自第一年起將為調整後每股盈餘與自由現金流量貢獻正面,並於五年後產生兩位數的投入資本報酬。 此項收購與歐洲的先例相呼應:空中巴士(Airbus)與Safran於2026年6月25日同意自Tikehau Capital手中收購Aubert et Duval,這兩家集團因而完全掌握一家不易取代的法國金屬與超級合金生產商。 GE Aerospace to buy engine castings supplier CPP for $11.75 billion GE Aerospace signs deal to acquire CPP for $11.75 billion; closure expected in H2 2027 pending approvals GE Aerospace has agreed to acquire Consolidated Precision Products (CPP), one of its own castings suppliers, for $11.75 billion, taking direct ownership of a component category that has constrained engine output across the industry. The company announced the signed agreement on September 8, 2026. It is purchasing CPP from private investment firms Warburg Pincus and Berkshire Partners and expects the transaction to close in the second half of 2027, subject to regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions. GE Aerospace said that it will fund the purchase with $7 billion in cash and the remainder in new debt, with no change to its capital allocation plans. Founded in 1991, Cleveland, Ohio-based CPP specializes in producing investment and precision facility castings in superalloy, titanium, aluminum, magnesium and steel for commercial and military aircraft, weapon systems, helicopters, missiles and industrial gas turbines. The company employs roughly 6,600 people across more than 20 facilities, and GE Aerospace has been a customer for over 15 years. In an investor presentation filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), GE Aerospace noted that CPP supplies castings for the LEAP, GEnx, T700, F110 and F404 engines, and projected that its own airfoil demand, measured in number of parts, would grow by more than 30% between 2026 and 2030 across commercial engines, aftermarket and defense. GE Aerospace valued CPP at approximately 18 times 2027 EBITDA, including expected net synergies of about $200 million, or approximately 26 times without them. Applied to the purchase price, those multiples imply CPP earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization of roughly $450 million in 2027 before synergies, against the approximately $2 billion of 2027 revenue that the presentation attributes to the company. The purchase follows a comparable move in Europe, where Airbus and Safran agreed on June 25, 2026, to buy Tikehau Capital out of Aubert and Duval, leaving the two groups in full control of a French metals and superalloys producer neither could easily replace. a-20260908-1656-russia-s-uac-to-debut-tw.text: 俄羅斯UAC埃及航展首展Su-57E雙新型武器 UAC於埃及航展首展S-71M與S-71K兩種空射武器 俄羅斯聯合航空製造公司(United Aircraft Corporation,UAC)宣布,將於2026年9月8日在埃及阿拉曼國際機場(DBB)舉行的阿拉曼國際航展,首度展出兩種用於蘇愷Su-57E的空射武器,分別為S-71M與S-71K。 UAC表示,S-71K(代號Kovyor)是空射巡弋飛彈,以傳統航空炸彈作為彈頭;S-71M(代號Monokhrom)則設計用於自主目標搜索與接戰。聲明未提供武器的尺寸、射程或酬載數據。 Su-57E已參加飛行展示與靜態展示。俄羅斯國防出口公司(Rosoboronexport)表示,該戰機將搭配RVV-MD2與RVV-BD空對空飛彈,以及霧-38MLE、霧-69巡弋飛彈和霧-58UShKE反輻射飛彈。 Russia's UAC to debut two new Su-57E weapons at Egypt airshow UAC to debut S-71M and S-71K air-launched weapons for Su-57E at Egypt airshow Russia's United Aircraft Corporation (UAC) has announced that it will display two air-launched weapons for the Sukhoi Su-57E for the first time at the El Alamein International Airshow 2026, which opened on September 8, 2026, at El Alamein International Airport (DBB) in Egypt. UAC identified the weapons as the S-71M and S-71K, both intended for fifth-generation fighters. The announcement stated no dimensions, range, or payload figures. a-20260908-1940-japan-airlines-named-off.text: 日本航空成為2026亞洲運動會官方供應商 日本航空簽約;擔任亞運及亞洲帕運客運航空服務供應商 日本航空(Japan Airlines, JAL)已簽約成為第20屆亞洲運動會及第5屆亞洲帕拉運動會的官方供應商。亞運會將於2026年9月19日至10月4日舉行,亞洲帕拉運動會則於10月18日至24日舉行,兩項賽事地點皆位於日本愛知縣與名古屋市。 根據與「愛知·名古屋亞洲運動會暨亞洲帕拉運動會組織委員會」的協議,JAL將擔任兩項賽事的官方客運航空運輸服務提供者。日本航空指出,此夥伴關係旨在支持主辦地區旅遊與經濟活動,並促成亞洲各地運動員、粉絲與社群的交流。 日本航空表示,旗下共有4位具運動員身分的員工將參加本屆賽事,包括標槍選手北口榛花、銳劍選手見延和靖、跳遠選手小浦綾香與110公尺跨欄選手拉希德·穆拉塔克(Rachid Muratake)。 Japan Airlines named official supplier and air travel provider for 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games JAL signs as official supplier; to provide passenger air transport for 2026 Asian and Asian Para Games Japan Airlines (JAL) has signed on as an official supplier to the 20th Asian Games, scheduled for September 19 to October 4, 2026, and the 5th Asian Para Games, scheduled for October 18 to 23, both to be held in Aichi Prefecture and Nagoya City, Japan. Under the agreement with the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games and Asian Para Games Organizing Committee, JAL will serve as the official passenger air transport services provider for both events, according to the airline. JAL said the partnership aims to boost tourism and economic activity in the Tokai region. The carrier also noted that four of its athlete employees will compete in the games, including javelin thrower Haruka Kitaguchi, épée fencer Koki Kano, long jumper Ayaka Kora, and 110-meter hurdler Rachid Muratake. 日本航空已簽約成為第20屆亞洲運動會及第5屆亞洲帕運運動會的官方供應商。 Japan Airlines (JAL) has signed on as an official supplier to the 20th Asian Games 第20屆亞洲運動會將於2026年9月19日至10月4日舉行。 running September 19 through October 4, 2026 兩場賽事皆在愛知縣與名古屋市舉辦。 both set to be held in Aichi Prefecture and Nagoya City, Japan 日本航空將擔任兩項賽事的官方指定客運航空運輸服務提供者。 JAL will serve as the official passenger air transport services provider for both events 日本航空有四名具運動員身分的員工計畫參賽。 four of JAL’s own athlete employees are scheduled to compete in the games

a-20260908-2211-air-cairo-places-firm-or.text: 開羅航空於阿拉敏航展訂購15架空中巴士A320neo客機 開羅航空簽署15架空中巴士A320neo訂單;計畫2034年前機隊達130架 埃及的開羅航空(Air Cairo)於2026年9月8日在2026年阿拉敏國際航展上,與空中巴士(Airbus)正式簽署15架A320neo客機的確認購買訂單。這項協議標誌著該航空公司首次直接向空中巴士採購飛機,開啟自持機隊資產與租賃客機並行的營運模式。 根據空中巴士與開羅航空公布的細節,這批新訂購的空中巴士A320neo客機採用單一客艙配置,最高可搭乘186名乘客。該機型採用新一代發動機與空氣動力學設計,每座燃油消耗及二氧化碳排放量均較前一代窄體客機減少至少百分之二十。開羅航空預計利用新機擴展定期與旅遊航線網路,連結埃及本土與歐洲、非洲及中東地區。 開羅航空董事長兼執行長謝里夫(Hussein Sherif)表示,將自持飛機與租賃機隊相結合,可在公司擴大規模時提供更高的營運靈活性與財務效益。謝里夫指出,A320neo客機將提供擴展網路所需的運力,滿足往返埃及日益增長的旅遊需求,並在與空中巴士的合作下支持埃及航空與觀光產業發展。 空中巴士民用飛機業務銷售執行副總裁聖埃克蘇佩里(Benoît de Saint-Exupéry)指出,這是開羅航空首次直接向空中巴士採購飛機,展現出該公司對A320neo機型的信心。他表示,A320neo能夠提供優異的效率與彈性,協助開羅航空擴大航網,強化埃及與國際主要目的地之間的交通連結。 開羅航空近年的機隊規模持續成長,已從五年前的7架客機大幅增長至目前的45架以上。該公司的長期目標是在2034年前將機隊擴充至130架以上。開羅航空現有機隊除空中巴士窄體客機外,亦營運ATR 72雙螺旋槳客機與巴西航空工業E190(ICAO機型代碼E190)區域客機,並以開羅、赫加達及沙姆沙伊赫等主要機場為營運基地。 Air Cairo Places Firm Order for 15 Airbus A320neo Aircraft at El Alamein Airshow Air Cairo orders 15 Airbus A320neos to expand its network and scale its fleet by 2034. Egyptian carrier Air Cairo signed a firm order with Airbus for 15 A320neo narrowbody aircraft on September 8, 2026, at the El Alamein International Airshow 2026. The agreement marks the airline's first direct purchase order from Airbus, establishing direct aircraft ownership to complement its existing leased fleet. The A320neo aircraft will be configured in Air Cairo's single-class passenger layout carrying up to 186 passengers. Equipped with new-generation engines, the type delivers at least a 20 percent reduction in fuel consumption and carbon dioxide emissions per seat compared with previous-generation aircraft. The new jets will support scheduled and leisure services connecting Egypt with destinations across Europe, Africa, and the Middle East. Hussein Sherif, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Air Cairo, stated that combining owned aircraft with the carrier's leased fleet offers enhanced operational flexibility and financial efficiency during expansion. Sherif noted that the A320neo will provide the needed capacity to serve growing travel demand to and from Egypt while supporting the nation's aviation and tourism sectors. Benoît de Saint-Exupéry, Airbus Executive Vice President of Sales for Commercial Aircraft, welcomed Air Cairo's first direct acquisition. He emphasized that the commitment highlights the airline's confidence in the A320neo to power its next growth phase while delivering the efficiency required to scale connectivity across regional and international networks. Air Cairo has expanded rapidly from seven aircraft five years ago to a fleet of over 45 aircraft today, incorporating Airbus narrowbodies, ATR 72 turboprops, and Embraer E190 (ICAO type code E190) regional jets. The airline aims to scale its fleet to more than 130 aircraft by 2034, operating domestic and international routes from bases including Cairo, Hurghada, and Sharm El Sheikh. metadata.title: 易捷航空因租賃客機爭議面臨租賃公司7200萬美元索償訴訟

a-20260908-2211-easyjet-faces-72-million.text: 易捷航空因租賃客機爭議面臨租賃公司7200萬美元索償訴訟 易捷航空因終止六架空中巴士客機租約,遭俄資租賃公司起訴索償至少7200萬美元。 英國廉價航空公司易捷航空(easyJet)目前在倫敦高等法院面臨一項索償金額至少達7200萬美元的法律訴訟。該起訴訟涉及六架租賃的空中巴士客機,起訴方指控易捷航空以歐盟對俄羅斯實施制裁為由終止租賃合約並棄置相關飛機。易捷航空則明確表示,將針對此案進行全面抗辯。 提出訴訟的實體為 STLC Europe Eight Leasing Limited,該公司為愛爾蘭註冊的飛機租賃公司,隸屬於俄羅斯國營國家運輸租賃公司(GTLK)旗下的 GTLK Europe。愛爾蘭高等法院已於2023年5月31日下令將 GTLK Europe 及 GTLK Europe Capital 進行清算,並指定清算人出售其資產以向債權人償還債務。本次對易捷航空發起的訴訟即為該清算程序與資產追討行動的一環。 根據《金融時報》報導,該項索償金額包含至少3670萬美元的未付租金與利息、3250萬美元的飛機價值損失,以及約280萬歐元的機場相關費用。涉案的六架空中巴士客機在俄羅斯全面入侵烏克蘭前即已停飛,自2020年3月起即因全球嚴重特殊傳染性肺炎(COVID-19)疫情影響而處於封存狀態。 雙方在制裁規定與維修責任上存在嚴重分歧。易捷航空指出,歐盟針對俄羅斯實施的航空制裁政策使其無法對這些飛機進行正常的維護與修復作業。然而起訴方 STLC Europe Eight 對此說法表示異議,主張涉案飛機當時均存放於俄羅斯境外,且租賃公司本體註冊於愛爾蘭,因此不應受相關維護限制影響。 在涉案飛機的現況方面,原先存放於賽普勒斯的三架空中巴士客機隨後已由清算人收回並完成出售,但清算人指出飛機狀況不佳導致最終出售價格受損。另一方面,存放於西班牙麥德林(Madrid)的另外三架空中巴士客機至今仍尚未出售,全案後續將由倫敦高等法院審理。 easyJet Faces $72 Million High Court Lawsuit Over Leased Airbus Aircraft easyJet faces a $72 million lawsuit in London over six leased Airbus A319 aircraft. British low-cost carrier easyJet is facing a lawsuit in London's High Court seeking at least $72 million over six leased Airbus aircraft. The legal action alleges that easyJet abandoned the aircraft after invoking European Union sanctions against Russia to terminate their leasing contracts. In response, easyJet stated that it will defend the case in full before the court. The lawsuit was filed by STLC Europe Eight Leasing Limited, an Irish aircraft-leasing subsidiary of GTLK Europe, which serves as the international leasing division of Russia's state-owned State Transport Leasing Company (GTLK). Ireland's High Court placed GTLK Europe and GTLK Europe Capital into liquidation on May 31, 2023, appointing liquidators to sell off assets and recover funds owed to repay creditors. According to a report by the Financial Times, the legal claim comprises at least $36.7 million in unpaid rent and interest, $32.5 million in lost aircraft value, and €2.8 million in airport fees. The six aircraft involved in the dispute had been grounded since March 2020 during the collapse in air travel caused by the COVID-19 pandemic, well before Russia's invasion of Ukraine. easyJet contended that EU aviation sanctions against Russia legally prevented it from maintaining or repairing the leased aircraft. However, STLC Europe Eight rejected this argument, maintaining that the aircraft were located outside of Russia in Cyprus and Spain and that the leasing company was incorporated in Ireland, meaning maintenance should not have been restricted. Regarding the current status of the aircraft, three Airbus A319 jets stored in Cyprus were recovered and sold, though liquidators noted that their degraded condition resulted in reduced sale prices. The remaining three aircraft stored in Madrid have not been sold, as legal proceedings continue in London. metadata.title: 普惠加拿大修改發動機合約條款 IATA歡迎市場競爭改善

a-20260909-0854-iata-welcomes-pratt-whit.text: 普惠加拿大修改發動機合約條款 IATA歡迎市場競爭改善 普惠加拿大修改發動機二手零件合約;IATA表示歡迎並盼擴大市場競爭 國際航空運輸協會(IATA)對普惠加拿大公司(P&WC)修改發動機二手零件市場的合約條款表示歡迎。此項合約修訂源於歐洲委員會競爭總署(European Commission Directorate-General for Competition)進行的審查與協調,旨在消除該市場中涉及競爭疑慮的相關限制。 本次合約變更放寬了普惠加拿大授權維修網路的限制,移除原先可能阻礙獨立供應商取得二手發動機零件及相關服務的條款。不過,該修訂範圍僅限於普惠 PT6 與 PW100 系列渦輪螺旋槳發動機的二手零件,並不涵蓋普惠旗下大型民航噴射發動機,亦未涉及主管機關批准的替代零件與維修方案。 IATA 營運、安全與安保高級副總裁 Nick Careen 指出,歐盟委員會的審查促使普惠加拿大進行改善,為渦輪螺旋槳發動機售後市場注入更多競爭與選擇。然而,公平取得、市場競爭與客戶選擇權等原則應適用於整個發動機售後市場。航空公司無論使用何種發動機,均應有權自由選擇經監管機構批准的維修設施、零件及維修服務,短期內將有助於緩解零件短缺與維修產能瓶頸。 當前供應鏈挑戰對全球航空公司造成顯著營運壓力。根據 IATA 與 Oliver Wyman 合作的調查研究估計,供應鏈限制在 2025 年使全球航空公司的發動機租賃與維修成本增加了約 57 億美元。推動市場競爭並增加零件與維修選擇,被視為減輕航空公司營運壓力與減少飛機停飛的重要措施之一。 歐盟委員會針對普惠加拿大的調查結果,進一步擴大了今年早些時候 IATA 與 CFM International 就發動機售後市場做法達成續約協議所帶來的效益。該協議透過允許獨立維修服務商參與競爭,並支援使用所有經主管機關批准的零件與維修方案,進一步促進了 CFM 商業發動機系列的維修選擇與市場競爭。 IATA Welcomes Pratt & Whitney Canada Engine Aftermarket Contract Changes IATA welcomed Pratt & Whitney Canada contractual changes to improve engine aftermarket competition. The International Air Transport Association (IATA) has welcomed changes made by Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) to contractual terms that had raised competition concerns in the market for used engine parts. The modifications follow work carried out by the European Commission Directorate-General for Competition. The revised contractual terms remove restrictions on maintenance shops within P&WC's network that could have limited independent suppliers' access to used engine materials and associated services. However, these adjustments are limited strictly to used parts for P&WC's PT6 and PW100-series turboprop engines. They do not cover Pratt & Whitney's larger commercial jet engines or address the use of regulator-approved alternative parts and repairs. Nick Careen, IATA’s Senior Vice President Operations, Safety and Security, stated that while the European Commission's work brought more competition and choice to part of the turboprop engine aftermarket, principles of fair access, competition, and customer choice should apply across the entire engine aftermarket. Careen emphasized that airlines should have the freedom to choose among all regulator-approved maintenance facilities, parts, and repairs, which could help alleviate supply shortages and maintenance constraints. Supply chain constraints continue to exert heavy financial pressures on the global airline industry. According to a joint study by IATA and Oliver Wyman, supply chain disruptions added approximately $5.7 billion to airlines' engine leasing and maintenance costs in 2025. IATA noted that broader competition and additional options for parts and repairs are key measures to help ease these pressures. The outcome of the European Commission's probe into P&WC adds to benefits gained earlier in 2026 through the renewal of IATA's agreement with CFM International regarding engine aftermarket practices. That agreement enhances competition across CFM's commercial engine portfolio by enabling independent maintenance providers to compete and supporting the use of all regulator-approved parts and repair options. metadata.title: 國防部偵獲16架次共機出海 11架次跨越海峽中線警巡

a-20260909-0854-taiwan-detects-16-pla-ai.text: 國防部偵獲16架次共機出海 11架次跨越海峽中線警巡 國防部9日偵獲16架次共機出海,其中11架次逾越海峽中線,國軍派機艦與飛彈應處。 中華民國國防部9日中午發布新聞稿表示,自當日上午9時22分起,陸續偵獲中共殲-10、蘇愷-30、殲轟-7、運-8遠干機及空警-500等各型主、輔戰機與無人機共16架次出海活動。 國防部指出,在偵獲的16架次軍機中,共有11架次逾越台灣海峽中線,進入台灣北部、中部及東部空域,並配合中共軍艦執行所謂「聯合戰備警巡」,騷擾台灣周邊空海域。 針對中共解放軍的軍事動態,國防部強調,國軍已運用聯合情監偵手段進行嚴密掌握,並檢派任務機、艦艇以及岸置飛彈系統進行適切應處。 Taiwan Detects 16 PLA Aircraft with 11 Crossing Median Line in Joint Patrol Taiwan detected 16 PLA aircraft on September 9, including 11 crossing the Strait median line. Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense stated on September 9, 2026, that starting at 9:22 AM, 16 PLA aircraft sorties—including J-10, Su-30, and JH-7 fighters, Y-8 electronic warfare aircraft, KJ-500 airborne early warning aircraft, and drones—were detected operating off Taiwan. According to the ministry, 11 of the 16 detected sorties crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait, entering Taiwan's northern, central, and eastern airspace. The aircraft operated in coordination with PLA naval vessels executing a joint combat readiness patrol in the surrounding sea and airspace. In response, Taiwan's armed forces monitored the military activities using joint intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance systems, and deployed task aircraft, naval vessels, and shore-based missile defense systems to respond appropriately. Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense stated that 16 PLA aircraft of various types were detected operating off Taiwan from 9:22 AM on September 9, 2026. 國防部中午發布新聞稿表示,自上午9時22分起,陸續偵獲中共殲10、蘇愷30、殲轟7、運8遠干、空警500等各型主、輔戰機及無人機16架次出海 Of the 16 detected sorties, 11 crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait into Taiwan's northern, central, and eastern airspace. 其中11架次逾越中線,進入台灣北部、中部及東部空域 The military aircraft operated in coordination with PLA naval vessels carrying out a joint combat readiness patrol in surrounding waters. 配合共艦假所謂「聯合戰備警巡」之名,騷擾台灣周邊空海域 Taiwan's armed forces monitored the situation using joint ISR systems and deployed aircraft, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems. 國軍運用聯合情監偵手段嚴密掌握,並檢派任務機、艦及岸置飛彈系統適切應處。

metadata.title: 蕭美琴倡無人機非紅供應鏈 強化防衛能力

a-20260909-0854-hsiao-bi-khim-advocates-.text: 蕭美琴倡無人機非紅供應鏈 強化防衛能力 副總統蕭美琴強調無人機須採非紅供應鏈;濱海監偵等機型將由台灣國內製造。 副總統蕭美琴於2026年9月9日出席「2026台北安全對話」致詞表示,無人機與反無人機技術已改變戰場型態。她指出,政府已向立法院提出用於無人機採購的特別預算案,其中濱海監偵型、濱海攻擊型與無人攻擊艇將由國內製造,且生產與採購(含民用)必須使用完全的非紅供應鏈,以降低風險與依賴。 此前,立法院已於2026年8月14日三讀通過115年度中央政府總預算案。其中,經濟部主導的「無人載具產業發展統籌型計畫」約新台幣80億元預算獲得全數通過,該計畫以推動台灣成為民主供應鏈中心為目標。 Hsiao Bi-khim Advocates for Non-Red Drone Supply Chain to Enhance Defense Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim advocates for non-Red drone supply chains to strengthen defense. Speaking at the 2026 Taipei Security Dialogue on September 9, 2026, Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim emphasized that unmanned systems and counter-drone technologies have transformed the battlefield. She noted that the government has submitted a special budget proposal to the Legislative Yuan for drone procurement. Among the planned acquisitions, coastal surveillance drones, coastal strike drones, and unmanned strike boats will be manufactured domestically. Furthermore, all government drone production and procurement, including civilian purchases, must utilize a completely non-Red supply chain to mitigate risks and dependency. This policy aligns with ongoing legislative support. On August 14, 2026, the Legislative Yuan passed the central government budget for fiscal year 2026, which fully approved approximately NT$8 billion for the Ministry of Economic Affairs' program to promote the development of the unmanned vehicle industry. 副總統蕭美琴於2026年9月9日指出,政府無人機生產與採購(包括民用採購)必須完全使用非紅供應鏈,以逐步實現在地化生產並降低風險與依賴。 政府無人機生產與採購(包括民用採購)必須使用完全非紅供應鏈,逐步實現在地化生產的同時,降低風險與依賴。 蕭副總統表示無人系統與科技已改變戰場型態,政府已提特別預算案用於無人機採購,其中濱海監偵型、濱海攻擊型及無人攻擊艇將由國內製造。 政府已向立法院提出特別預算案,用於無人機採購計畫,在尋求取得的各式無人機中,濱海監偵型、濱海攻擊型及無人攻擊艇將由國內製造

metadata.title: 清泉崗機場遭無人機干擾 暫停起降影響10架次軍民機

a-20260909-0854-drone-interference-at-ch.text: 清泉崗機場遭無人機干擾 暫停起降影響10架次軍民機 空軍清泉崗基地因周邊無人機活動暫停起降,影響10架次軍民機並移交調查 清泉崗空軍基地於2026年9月8日晚間因無人機干擾而暫停飛機起降。空軍司令部表示,當晚7時37分在機場周邊發現無人機活動,危害飛航安全,隨即通報航警局及飛管單位進行應處,並暫停機場的所有起降作業。 經確證無人機已飛離管制區後,清泉崗基地於同日晚間8時2分恢復起降作業。在該起干擾事件期間,共影響了2架次的民航班機以及8架次的軍用飛機起降。空軍司令部強調,無人機在管制區活動屬於違法行為,危害飛航安全,目前已移請航警局調查。 Drone Interference at Ching Chuan Kang Suspends Flights, Affecting 10 Aircraft Ching Chuan Kang suspends operations due to a drone sighting, affecting 10 flights. Ching Chuan Kang Air Force Base suspended aircraft takeoffs and landings on the evening of September 8, 2026, due to drone interference. The Air Force Command stated that drone activity was detected around the perimeter of the airport at 7:37 p.m., posing a threat to flight safety. The base immediately notified the Aviation Police Bureau and flight control units to respond, and suspended all flight operations. After confirming that the drone had flown out of the restricted airspace, Ching Chuan Kang Base resumed takeoff and landing operations at 8:02 p.m. the same day. According to the Air Force, the temporary suspension affected two civil flights and eight military flights. The Air Force Command emphasized that operating drones within restricted areas is illegal and endangers aviation safety, adding that the case has been referred to the Aviation Police Bureau for investigation. On the evening of September 8, 2026, drone activity was detected around Ching Chuan Kang Base at 7:37 p.m., affecting flight safety and leading to a suspension of aircraft takeoffs and landings. 清泉崗基地昨晚7時37分於機場周邊發現無人機活動、影響飛航安全,立即通報航警局及飛管單位應處並暫停飛機起降 Takeoff and landing operations at Ching Chuan Kang Base resumed at 8:02 p.m. on the same day after the drone was confirmed to have left the restricted airspace. 經確證無人機飛離管制區後,於同日晚間8時2分恢復起降作業 The temporary suspension of operations affected 2 civil flights and 8 military flights, and the case has been referred to the Aviation Police Bureau for investigation. 期間影響民航班機2架次、軍機8架次,目前已移請航警局調查。

metadata.title: 英國航管系統故障致逾千班機受阻 瑞安等航司強烈抗議

a-20260909-0854-uk-air-traffic-control-f.text: 英國航管系統故障致逾千班機受阻 瑞安等航司強烈抗議 英國航管系統發生技術故障;致逾千航班受阻;瑞安航空等航司要求改革 2026年9月8日,英國國家航空交通服務公司(NATS)發生嚴重的技術故障,造成超過1000架次航班受阻。此次航管系統故障在英國全國多個主要機場引發了廣泛的航班延誤與取消,給當天的航空營運造成極大混亂,並引發了多家航空公司的強烈不滿。 NATS表示,系統故障主要影響了其航班處理系統。該機構於當地時間13點46分宣布開始調查該起事件,最初的技術故障限制了航班的起飛。雖然NATS隨後於下午約16點40分實施了系統修復,且系統也已逐步開始恢復,但由於飛機與機組人員的停放位置被打亂,後續的航班受阻情況依然在持續。 根據FlightAware與Flightradar24的監測資料,包括希斯洛、蓋威克、曼徹斯特、倫敦城市、盧頓、愛丁堡、布里斯托及斯坦斯特德在內的多個主要機場均通報出現混亂。統計顯示,當天至少有625架次往返英國機場的航班被取消,大批從英國出發或抵達英國的航班也遭到嚴重延誤。此外,由於歐洲其他地區的航空公司必須將飛往英國的航機留在地面,這起故障也波及了英國以外的歐洲各航點。 面對大規模的混亂,各航空公司表示極度憤怒。瑞安航空指出,其有超過6.5萬名乘客受到高達8小時延誤的影響,該航司更被迫取消了50多個航班。瑞安航空營運長Neal McMahon痛批,在2023年航管系統崩潰後,他們被承諾會吸取教訓並提升系統韌性,然而如今卻再次發生類似事件。瑞安航空已要求NATS執行長Martin Rolfe辭職,而匈牙利低成本航空Wizz Air亦公開宣告該航管機構已「不適任」。 英國航空在希斯洛機場也至少取消了16架次出發的航班。英國民用航空局對此表示,預期NATS將針對這起故障事件提交一份完整的調查報告。監管機構隨後將根據報告內容評估是否需要採取進一步的改善行動,以提升英國航空交通管制系統的可靠性。目前,造成這起9月8日系統故障的確切原因仍未對外公布。 UK Air Traffic Control Failure Disrupts Over 1,000 Flights Triggering Airline Outrage NATS system failure disrupted UK flights on September 8; over 1,000 flights delayed or canceled On September 8, 2026, a major technical failure occurred at National Air Traffic Services (NATS), the United Kingdom's air traffic control provider, disrupting more than 1,000 flights. The system failure triggered widespread delays and cancellations at major airports across the country, causing massive disruption to the aviation industry and sparking strong reactions from several airlines. NATS stated that the technical issue affected its flight-processing system. The organization announced at 13:46 local time that it had initiated an investigation into the matter, which initially restricted flight departures. Although NATS implemented a system fix at approximately 16:40 and systems began to recover, airlines warned that flights would continue to face disruptions because aircraft and crew members had been left out of position. According to FlightAware and Flightradar24 data, major airports including Heathrow, Gatwick, Manchester, London City, Luton, Edinburgh, Bristol, and Stansted experienced disruptions. The monitoring data indicated that at least 625 flights to and from UK airports were canceled during the day. Additionally, the breakdown affected flights across Europe as several airlines held UK-bound aircraft on the ground to manage the situation. Airlines expressed severe frustration over the widespread network failure. Ryanair reported that more than 65,000 of its passengers were affected by flight delays of up to eight hours, and the Irish low-cost carrier canceled over 50 flights. Ryanair Chief Operations Officer Neal McMahon stated that following a similar systemic collapse in 2023, the industry was assured that lessons would be learned and resilience improved. The airline called for NATS CEO Martin Rolfe to resign, while Hungarian low-cost carrier Wizz Air declared that the air traffic control organization was "not fit for purpose." British Airways also canceled at least 16 departures from Heathrow. The UK Civil Aviation Authority announced that it expects NATS to deliver a comprehensive report explaining the incident. The regulator will subsequently evaluate whether further regulatory or corrective measures are necessary to improve the reliable performance of the nation's air traffic control infrastructure. The root cause of the September 8 system failure has not yet been disclosed. 2026年9月8日,英國航管服務公司(NATS)發生技術故障,致逾千航班受阻,在英國各地機場引發廣泛的延誤與取消。 A technical failure at the United Kingdom’s air traffic control provider disrupted more than 1,000 flights on September 8, 2026, triggering widespread delays and cancellations at airports across the country. NATS表示故障影響其航班處理系統,於當地時間13:46起展開調查並暫時限制起飛,隨後於約16:40實施修復,系統開始恢復。 NATS said the problem affected its flight-processing system. The organization announced at 13:46 local time that it was investigating the issue, which initially restricted flight departures. NATS said it implemented a fix at approximately 16:40 and that its systems had begun to recover. 根據FlightAware與Flightradar24資料,多個英國主要機場受阻,當天至少有625架次往返英國機場的航班遭到取消。 Separate data from Flightradar24 showed that at least 625 flights to and from UK airports had been canceled during the day. Heathrow, Gatwick, Manchester, Stansted, London City, Birmingham and several airports in Scotland reported disruptions. 瑞安航空表示其有超過6.5萬名乘客受影響,面臨最長達8小時的延誤,該航司取消了50多個航班,並要求NATS執行長Martin Rolfe辭職。 Ryanair said more than 65,000 of its passengers were affected by delays of up to eight hours. The Irish low-cost carrier also canceled more than 50 flights. 英國航空在希斯洛機場取消了至少16架次起飛航班,而Wizz Air則批評NATS「不適任」。 British Airways canceled at least 16 departures from Heathrow

metadata.title: Tracep Congo Aviation 貨機墜毀 Walikale

a-20260726-1606-tracep-congo-aviation-ca.text: Tracep Congo Aviation 貨機墜毀 Walikale Tracep Congo Aviation 的 LET L-410 貨機於 7 月 24 日星期五自貝尼 Mavivi 機場起飛,載運近兩噸貨物前往 Schabunda territorio 的 Kachungu,起飛不久機長報告左引擎故障並試圖改降 Walikale 機場,隨後失聯。搜索於週末展開,副駕駛於星期天在 crash 區域被發現生還,機長則不幸罹難。事故原因仍在調查中。 Tracep Congo Aviation 的 LET L-410 貨機在尋獲後被證實在位於 Walikale 附近的森林區域墜毀,機上兩名機組員中一人生還、一人死亡。 該機於星期五當地時間 12:36 從貝尼 Mavivi 機場起飛,載運約兩噸貨物前往 Schabunda territorio 的 Kachungu。 起飛不久,機長報告左引擎出現故障,並試圖改向 Walikale 機場降落,隨後失去無線電聯絡。 搜索行動於週末展開,根據 Tracep Congo Aviation 來源,副駕駛在星期天於墜機區域被發現生還,而機長則不幸罹難。 Shabunda 當地 autorités 局表示,飛機原預定抵達 Tchonka-Lulingu 但未到達,並證實在機長報告引擎問題約二十分鐘後,機組人員即成為無法聯絡的狀態。 Tracep Congo Aviation Cargo Plane Crashes in Walikale Forest, One Crew Dead, One Injured Tracep Congo Aviation's LET L-410 cargo aircraft departed Beni's Mavivi airport on Friday at 12:36 local time carrying nearly two tons of cargo bound for Kachungu in Shabunda territory. Shortly after takeoff the captain reported an engine failure and attempted to divert to Walikale airfield before losing radio contact. The plane was found crashed in a forest near Walikale with one survivor and one fatality among the two crew members. Search operations began Friday; the co-pilot was found alive Sunday in the crash zone while the captain died. Local authorities said the aircraft was expected at Tchonka-Lulingu but never arrived, and confirmed that after reporting an engine problem about twenty minutes after takeoff from Beni, the crew became unreachable. The cause of the accident remains under investigation. The Tracep Congo Aviation LET L-410 cargo aircraft was found crashed in a forest area near Walikale with one survivor and one fatality among the two crew members. The aircraft departed from Mavivi airport in Beni at 12:36 local time on Friday, carrying nearly two tons of cargo bound for Kachungu in Shabunda territory. Shortly after takeoff, the captain reported an engine failure on one of the two engines and attempted to divert to Walikale airfield before losing radio contact. Search operations were launched on Friday; according to Tracep Congo Aviation sources, the co-pilot was found alive Sunday in the crash zone while the captain died. Local authorities in Shabunda said the aircraft was expected at Tchonka-Lulingu but never arrived, and confirmed that after reporting an engine problem about twenty minutes after takeoff from Beni, the crew became unreachable. The cause of the accident remains under investigation. A Tracep Congo Aviation LET L-410 cargo aircraft that had been missing since Friday on a flight between Beni and Shabunda territory was found crashed in a forest area near Walikale with one survivor and one fatality among the two crew members. Un avion-cargo de la compagnie Tracep Congo Aviation, porté disparu depuis vendredi lors d'un vol entre Beni, dans l'est de la RDC, et le territoire de Shabunda, a été retrouvé écrasé dans une zone forestière à Walikale avec un survivant et un mort parmi les deux membres d'équipage, selon des sources concordantes. The aircraft departed from Mavivi airport in Beni at 12:36 local time on Friday carrying nearly two tons of cargo bound for Kachungu in Shabunda territory. L'appareil, un LET L-410, avait décollé vendredi à 12h36, heure locale, de l'aéroport de Mavivi, à Beni (Nord-Kivu), avec près de deux tonnes de marchandises à destination de Kachungu, dans le territoire de Shabunda (Sud-Kivu), selon des sources de la compagnie et de la Régie des voies aériennes (RVA). Shortly after takeoff, the captain reported an engine failure on one of the two engines and attempted to divert to Walikale airfield before losing radio contact. Quelques minutes après le décollage, le commandant de bord avait signalé une panne sur l'un des deux moteurs et tenté de se dérouter vers l'aérodrome de Walikale avant que tout contact radio ne soit perdu, selon des informations rapportées par Radio Okapi. Search operations launched on Friday; according to Tracep Congo Aviation sources, the co-pilot was found alive Sunday in the crash zone while the captain died. Des opérations de recherche avaient été engagées dès vendredi. Selon des sources de Tracep Congo Aviation, le copilote a été retrouvé vivant dimanche dans la zone du crash, tandis que le commandant de bord a perdu la vie. Local authorities in Shabunda said the aircraft was expected at Tchonka-Lulingu but never arrived, and confirmed that after reporting an engine problem about twenty minutes after takeoff from Beni, the crew became unreachable. À Shabunda, des autorités locales ont indiqué que l'appareil, attendu à Tchonka-Lulingu, n'était jamais arrivé à destination. Elles ont également confirmé qu'après avoir signalé une panne moteur environ vingt minutes après son décollage de Beni, l'équipage était devenu injoignable.

metadata.title: 熊本強震後啟動航空援助 華航集團捐新台幣1,000萬元並免費運送賑災物資

a-20260730-1856-manual-45737a.text: 熊本強震後啟動航空援助 華航集團捐新台幣1,000萬元並免費運送賑災物資 日本熊本縣日前發生規模7.1強震,造成當地建築、道路及交通設施受損,災後救援與重建工作持續進行。中華航空宣布,華航集團將捐出新台幣1,000萬元,支援熊本地區災後救援及重建工作。 日本熊本縣日前發生規模7.1強震,造成當地建築、道路及交通設施受損,災後救援與重建工作持續進行。中華航空宣布,華航集團將捐出新台幣1,000萬元,支援熊本地區災後救援及重建工作。 除提供現金援助外,華航也將投入航空運輸資源,即日起至8月底前,協助政府機關、公益團體、宗教團體及相關救援組織免費載運賑災物資前往災區,讓急需物資能透過航空運能加速送抵當地。 華航表示,熊本為華航集團飛航航點之一,集團以企業社會責任及人道關懷為出發點,盼藉由捐款與運輸支援,將台灣社會的關懷送往受災地區,協助居民早日重建家園。 熊本縣熊本地方於7月28日下午發生地震,規模為7.1,宇城市及冰川町觀測到最大震度7;日本政府一度針對有明海及八代海發布海嘯注意報。災區後續仍須面對建物受損、道路與橋梁受阻,以及交通與公共設施修復等挑戰。

metadata.title: 星宇航空首航台北-布拉格 正式開啟歐洲航線布局

a-20260801-1453-manual-597198.text: 星宇航空首航台北-布拉格 正式開啟歐洲航線布局 星宇航空於 2026 年 8 月 1 日正式開航台北-布拉格航線,這是該公司首條歐洲定期航線,也使布拉格成為星宇航空進軍歐洲市場的第一個航點。首航班機由星宇航空董事長張國煒親自執飛,該航線初期每週營運 3 班,並預計自 10 月起增為每週 4 班。 星宇航空於 2026 年 8 月 1 日正式開航台北-布拉格航線,這是該公司首條歐洲定期航線,也使布拉格成為星宇航空進軍歐洲市場的第一個航點。首航班機由星宇航空董事長張國煒親自執飛,該航線初期每週營運 3 班,並預計自 10 月起增為每週 4 班。 首航當天,桃園國際機場(TPE)候機室以布拉格城市意象進行布置,並設置蔡依林主題拍照區,呼應星宇航空為本次航線推出的宣傳合作。星宇航空也同步推出與布拉格航線相關的首航禮與聯名贈品,凸顯其將品牌活動、旅客體驗與新航線推廣結合的策略。 根據星宇航空先前公布的航班規劃,台北桃園國際機場(TPE)往返布拉格瓦茨拉夫・哈維爾機場(PRG)的去程航班為 JX101,當地時間凌晨起飛、清晨抵達;回程航班 JX102 則於上午自布拉格出發、翌日清晨返抵台北。該航線使用空中巴士 A350-900 執飛,屬於長程廣體客機,並採多艙等配置,適合洲際直飛市場的營運需求。 布拉格是捷克首都,也是中歐重要的觀光與商務城市,過去與台灣之間的直飛航班選擇相對有限,因此星宇航空此次開航,除了補足台灣與捷克之間的空中連結,也有助於銜接歐洲觀光、商務洽公與轉機需求。對星宇航空而言,這條航線不僅是國際網路擴張的一步,也代表其正式跨入歐洲市場。 Starlux Airlines Launches Taipei–Prague Route, Officially Beginning European Network Expansion Starlux Airlines officially launched its Taipei–Prague route on August 1, 2026, marking the carrier's first scheduled European service and making Prague the first destination in Starlux Airlines' entry into the European market. The inaugural flight was piloted personally by Starlux Airlines Chairman Chang Kuo-wei. The route will initially operate 3 flights per week, with plans to increase to 4 flights per week starting in October. Starlux Airlines officially launched its Taipei–Prague route on August 1, 2026, marking the carrier's first scheduled European service and making Prague the first destination in Starlux Airlines' entry into the European market. The inaugural flight was piloted personally by Starlux Airlines Chairman Chang Kuo-wei. The route will initially operate 3 flights per week, with plans to increase to 4 flights per week starting in October. On the day of the inaugural flight, the departure lounge at Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) was decorated with Prague city imagery and featured a Jolin Tsai-themed photo area, echoing the promotional collaboration Starlux Airlines launched for this route. Starlux Airlines also simultaneously introduced inaugural gifts and co-branded merchandise related to the Prague route, highlighting its strategy of integrating brand campaigns, passenger experience, and new route promotion. According to the flight plan previously announced by Starlux Airlines, the outbound service between Taipei Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) and Prague Václav Havel Airport (PRG) is flight JX101, departing in the early morning local time and arriving at dawn. The return flight, JX102, departs from Prague in the morning and arrives back in Taipei the following morning. The route is operated with the Airbus A350-900, a long-range wide-body aircraft configured with multiple cabin classes, suited to the operational requirements of the intercontinental nonstop market. Prague is the capital of the Czech Republic and an important tourism and business city in Central Europe. Direct flight options between Prague and Taiwan have historically been relatively limited, so this launch by Starlux Airlines not only fills the air link between Taiwan and the Czech Republic but also helps connect European tourism, business travel, and transfer demand. For Starlux Airlines, this route represents not only a step in international network expansion but also its formal entry into the European market.

metadata.title: 達美航空 DL1181 班機於紐約拉瓜地亞機場重飛發生機尾擦地事故 NTSB發布初步調查

a-20260730-2013-manual-729bf9.text: 達美航空 DL1181 班機於紐約拉瓜地亞機場重飛發生機尾擦地事故 NTSB發布初步調查 達美DL1181在拉瓜地亞重飛時機尾擦地;NTSB發布初步調查 7月14日,美國達美航空(Delta Air Lines)一架機身編號 N382DN 的空中巴士 A321-200 客機,執行由佛羅里達州勞德岱堡-好萊塢國際機場(FLL)飛往紐約拉瓜地亞機場(LGA)的 DL1181 航班時,於降落過程中發生機尾擦地(Tail strike)事故。該班機在準備降落於第 22 號跑道的最後進場階段,機組人員執行了重飛(Go-around)程序,在此期間機身尾段與跑道表面發生接觸。 事故發生後,機組人員隨即將客機拉升至約 4,000 呎的安全高度進行盤旋與處置,並在約 13 分鐘後重新進場,順利且安全地降落。根據初步通報,機上所有乘客與機組人員均未在此次事件中受傷。 此次涉事的空中巴士 A321-200 為 A320 家族中機身最長的型號。由於其修長的機體設計,在起飛、降落或執行重飛階段,若機首俯仰角(Pitch attitude)控制過大,相對其他短機身型號更容易產生機尾觸地的風險。此外,拉瓜地亞機場因腹地較小,且第 22 號跑道長度有限,對飛行員的進場精準度要求極高,在重飛等高工作負載(High workload)的動態環境下,更考驗對操作細節的掌握。 美國國家運輸安全委員會(NTSB)已將本案正式定義為「事故」(Accident),並指出該客機的機體尾段在此次接觸中受到了「實質性損害」(Substantial damage)。NTSB 已於 2026 年 7 月 29 日發布初步調查訊息,目前正持續針對事發當時的標準操作程序、飛行數據以及潛在的人為因素進行綜合分析,以釐清確切的肇因與完整經過。 Delta Air Lines Flight DL1181 Tail Strike During Go-Around at New York LaGuardia; NTSB Issues Preliminary Investigation Delta DL1181 suffers LaGuardia tail strike during go-around; NTSB opens preliminary investigation On July 14, 2026, a Delta Air Lines Airbus A321-200 (registration N382DN) operating flight DL1181 from Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL) to New York LaGuardia Airport (LGA) experienced a tail strike during landing. While on final approach to Runway 22, the crew initiated a go-around, during which the aircraft's tail contacted the runway surface. Following the occurrence, the crew climbed the aircraft to a safe altitude of about 4,000 feet to hold and assess the situation, and approximately 13 minutes later conducted a new approach, landing smoothly and safely. According to the preliminary report, all passengers and crew on board were uninjured. The involved Airbus A321-200 is the longest-fuselage variant in the A320 family; its elongated design makes it more susceptible than shorter variants to tail contact if the pitch attitude is excessively high during takeoff, landing, or go-around. Additionally, LaGuardia Airport's constrained surroundings and the limited length of Runway 22 demand high approach precision, and the dynamic, high-workload environment of a go-around further tests pilots' handling of operational details. The U.S. National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) has officially classified the event as an 'accident' and noted that the aircraft's tail section sustained 'substantial damage' from the contact. The NTSB issued a preliminary investigation notice on July 29, 2026, and is continuing a comprehensive analysis of the standard operating procedures, flight data, and potential human factors at the time of the occurrence to determine the exact cause and full sequence of events.

metadata.title: 星宇航空正式開航臺北至布拉格航線 首航班機由董事長張國煒親自執飛

a-20260731-2105-manual-b831ff.text: 星宇航空正式開航臺北至布拉格航線 首航班機由董事長張國煒親自執飛 星宇航空於8月1日凌晨正式開通首條歐洲直飛航線,提供往返桃園國際機場(TPE)與捷克布拉格瓦茨拉夫・哈維爾機場(PRG)的載客服務。這項航線的啟動,代表星宇航空的營運版圖由既有的亞洲與北美市場,進一步延伸至中歐地區。 本次首航任務具備明顯指標意義,由星宇航空董事長張國煒親自駕駛執飛。星宇航空以空中巴士A350-900廣體客機執飛該航線,該機型以長程飛行效率、座艙舒適性與較安靜的客艙環境見長,適合洲際直飛航線運作。 星宇航空於8月1日凌晨正式開通首條歐洲直飛航線,提供往返桃園國際機場(TPE)與捷克布拉格瓦茨拉夫・哈維爾機場(PRG)的載客服務。這項航線的啟動,代表星宇航空的營運版圖由既有的亞洲與北美市場,進一步延伸至中歐地區。 本次首航任務具備明顯指標意義,由星宇航空董事長張國煒親自駕駛執飛。星宇航空以空中巴士A350-900廣體客機執飛該航線,該機型以長程飛行效率、座艙舒適性與較安靜的客艙環境見長,適合洲際直飛航線運作。 依航班規劃,布拉格航線開航初期維持每週三班,於每週二、四、六飛航;自10月1日起,班次將增至每週四班。去程JX101自台北於凌晨00時10分起飛,預定當地時間上午7時50分抵達布拉格;回程JX102則於上午10時20分自布拉格起飛,翌日清晨5時10分返抵台北。 布拉格作為捷克首都,不僅是歷史文化資產豐富的觀光城市,也是中歐重要的交通與商務樞紐。近年隨著半導體等產業供應鏈逐步向中東歐延伸,台灣與捷克之間的商務往來日益密切;星宇航空開闢直飛航線後,可望減少旅客過往轉機所需時間,並進一步強化雙邊觀光、商務與轉運連結。 STARLUX Airlines Officially Launches Taipei–Prague Route with Inaugural Flight Piloted Personally by Chairman Chang Kuo-wei STARLUX Airlines officially launched its first direct European route in the early morning of August 1, operating passenger service between Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) and Václav Havel Airport Prague (PRG) in the Czech Republic. The launch of this route marks the expansion of STARLUX's network from Asia and North America into Central Europe. Serving as a key milestone, the inaugural flight was personally piloted by STARLUX Airlines Chairman Chang Kuo-wei. STARLUX operates the route using Airbus A350-900 widebody aircraft, a model known for long-haul flight efficiency, cabin comfort, and a quieter cabin environment. STARLUX Airlines officially launched its first direct European route in the early morning of August 1, providing passenger service between Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) and Václav Havel Airport Prague (PRG) in the Czech Republic. The launch of this route marks the expansion of STARLUX's operational network beyond Asia and North America into Central Europe. The inaugural flight carried milestone significance, being personally piloted by STARLUX Airlines Chairman Chang Kuo-wei. STARLUX is deploying Airbus A350-900 widebody aircraft on the route, a type noted for its long-range efficiency, cabin comfort, and quiet cabin environment, making it well-suited for intercontinental direct flights. According to the flight schedule, the Prague route will initially operate three times weekly on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays, before increasing to four weekly flights starting October 1. Outbound flight JX101 departs Taipei at 00:10 and is scheduled to arrive in Prague at 07:50 local time; inbound flight JX102 departs Prague at 10:20 and arrives back in Taipei at 05:10 the following morning. As the capital of the Czech Republic, Prague is not only a tourist destination rich in historical and cultural heritage, but also a major Central European transport and business hub. With semiconductor and other industrial supply chains expanding into Central and Eastern Europe in recent years, commercial exchanges between Taiwan and the Czech Republic have grown increasingly close. The new direct service is expected to reduce travel time previously needed for connections while further strengthening bilateral links in tourism, business, and transit.
