metadata.title: 新北空軍三重一村將舉辦夏日煙火活動 推廣眷村與軍事文化

a-20260730-2019-manual-b979b5.text: 新北空軍三重一村將舉辦夏日煙火活動 推廣眷村與軍事文化 新北市三重的「空軍三重一村」將於8月15日舉辦「夏日煙火烤肉趴」活動,並於今日起正式開放限量50組的網路報名。該活動結合了眷村文化體驗、街頭藝人現場表演,以及觀賞大稻埕煙火等多元元素,期望透過軟性的公眾參與拉近民眾與歷史的距離。 空軍三重一村為臺灣北部地區保存最為完整的防砲眷村,過去主要提供給負責首都及台北松山機場(TSA)周邊防空任務的空軍高射砲兵軍眷居住。 新北市三重的「空軍三重一村」將於8月15日舉辦「夏日煙火烤肉趴」活動,並於今日起正式開放限量50組的網路報名。該活動結合了眷村文化體驗、街頭藝人現場表演,以及觀賞大稻埕煙火等多元元素,期望透過軟性的公眾參與拉近民眾與歷史的距離。 空軍三重一村為臺灣北部地區保存最為完整的防砲眷村,過去主要提供給負責首都及台北松山機場(TSA)周邊防空任務的空軍高射砲兵軍眷居住。雖然此次活動並非直接涉及飛航安全或近期的空軍戰備演練,但該地點的活化利用,具體反映了空軍與地方社區在文化連結上的持續努力。透過此類群眾活動,不僅有助於軍事文化的推廣,也讓珍貴的眷村建築與歷史記憶得以在現代都會中被妥善保存與傳承。 「夏日煙火烤肉趴」活動資訊: 活動時間:2026/8/15(六)18:00-21:00 地點:空軍三重一村(新北市三重區正義南路86巷) 名額:限量50組(額滿即截止) 活動亮點:眷村烤肉、街頭藝人表演、抽獎活動、遠眺大稻埕煙火 報名方式:7/29(三)19:00開放報名,詳情請至「空軍三重一村」官方粉絲專頁查詢 New Taipei's Air Force Sanchong Village No. 1 to Hold Summer Fireworks Event to Promote Military Dependents' Village and Military Culture "Air Force Sanchong Village No. 1" in Sanchong, New Taipei City, will host a "Summer Fireworks BBQ Party" event on August 15, with online registration officially opening today for a limited 50 groups. Combining military dependents' village cultural experiences, live street performer shows, and viewing of the Dadaocheng fireworks, the event aims to bridge the distance between the public and history through soft public engagement. Air Force Sanchong Village No. 1 is northern Taiwan's most completely preserved anti-aircraft artillery military dependents' village, historically housing families of Air Force anti-aircraft artillery personnel responsible for air defense missions surrounding the capital and Taipei Songshan Airport (TSA). "Air Force Sanchong Village No. 1" in Sanchong, New Taipei City, will hold a "Summer Fireworks BBQ Party" event on August 15, with online registration officially opening today for a limited 50 groups. The event integrates diverse elements including military dependents' village cultural experiences, live street performer entertainment, and distant views of the Dadaocheng fireworks, hoping to bring the public closer to history through soft public engagement. Air Force Sanchong Village No. 1 is the most intact anti-aircraft artillery military dependents' village preserved in northern Taiwan, which historically served as quarters for military dependents of Air Force anti-aircraft artillery units tasked with air defense missions around the capital and Taipei Songshan Airport (TSA). Although this event does not directly involve aviation safety or recent Air Force combat readiness drills, the revitalization and reuse of this site specifically reflects the ongoing efforts toward cultural connections between the Air Force and the local community. Through such public events, it not only helps promote military culture but also allows precious military dependents' village architecture and historical memories to be properly preserved and passed down in a modern metropolis. metadata.title: 星宇航空「空山金」準備啟程 A350-1000 B-58554將自土魯斯飛往新家臺北

a-20260815-1129-manual-e0059d.text: 星宇航空「空山金」準備啟程 A350-1000 B-58554將自土魯斯飛往新家臺北 星宇航空(STARLUX Airlines)「STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA」藝術塗裝計畫的第二架飛機「空山金」已進入交付階段。根據星宇航空官方 Instagram 公布的最新動態,這架註冊編號 B-58554 的 Airbus A350-1000 正準備自法國土魯斯-布拉尼亞克機場(TLS)啟程,飛往其新家——臺灣桃園國際機場(TPE)。 星宇航空(STARLUX Airlines)「STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA」藝術塗裝計畫的第二架飛機「空山金」已進入交付階段。根據星宇航空官方 Instagram 公布的最新動態,這架註冊編號 B-58554 的 Airbus A350-1000 正準備自法國土魯斯-布拉尼亞克機場(TLS)啟程,飛往其新家——臺灣桃園國際機場(TPE)。 B-58554 是繼「空山銀」B-58553 後,星宇航空與日本藝術家空山基(Hajime Sorayama)合作打造的第二架 AIRSORAYAMA 特別塗裝機。航空專業媒體 Aviation Wire 報導,B-58554 已於 7 月 10 日在土魯斯完成首次飛行,當次測試飛行約持續 3 小時,並規劃於 8 月交付星宇航空。8 月 12 日,日本航空媒體 TRAICY 亦報導,星宇航空預計在 8 月內正式接收這架飛機。 「空山金」以金屬金色為機身主色,搭配銀色元素,與以銀色為主、金色點綴的 B-58553「空山銀」形成一組相互呼應的設計。兩架飛機的機腹均融入空山基代表性的「機械鯊魚(SORAYAMA Shark)」視覺元素,將其擅長的金屬質感與未來主義美學延伸至大型民航客機。星宇航空表示,由於 A350 採用大量碳纖維複合材料,塗裝除了必須呈現金屬光澤外,也須兼顧航空器防雷擊及相關適航要求,因此星宇航空、Airbus 與德國塗料廠商 Mankiewicz 共同開發高濃度特殊雲母與多層塗佈工法,以完成所需的視覺效果。 B-58554 完成交付後,預計將成為星宇航空機隊中的第 4 架 A350-1000。星宇航空共訂購 18 架 A350-1000,首架 B-58551 已於 2026 年 1 月在土魯斯完成交付,使星宇航空成為臺灣首家營運 A350-1000 的航空公司。A350-1000 也是目前星宇航空長程航線布局的重要主力機型。 「空山金」客艙規劃共 350 個座位,包括頭等艙 4 席、商務艙 40 席、豪華經濟艙 36 席及經濟艙 270 席。隨著 B-58554 完成交付並抵臺,「空山銀」與「空山金」兩架 AIRSORAYAMA A350-1000 將正式到齊;星宇航空規劃自 10 月 1 日起,以兩架藝術機搭配專屬機上用品與服務內容展開完整的 AIRSORAYAMA 主題營運。 目前星宇航空官方最新動態顯示 B-58554 已進入返臺前的最後階段;實際自土魯斯起飛、抵達桃園的時間以及後續正式投入載客營運的安排,仍應以星宇航空公布的航班資訊及實際飛航動態為準。 STARLUX Airlines' "STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA Gold" Prepares for Departure: A350-1000 B-58554 Set to Fly from Toulouse to Its New Home in Taipei The second aircraft in STARLUX Airlines' "STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA" art livery project, "STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA Gold," has entered the delivery stage. According to the latest update on STARLUX Airlines' official Instagram, this Airbus A350-1000 registered B-58554 is preparing to depart from Toulouse-Blagnac Airport (TLS) in France for its new home at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE). The second aircraft in STARLUX Airlines' "STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA" art livery project, "STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA Gold," has entered the delivery stage. According to the latest update on STARLUX Airlines' official Instagram, this Airbus A350-1000 registered B-58554 is preparing to depart from Toulouse-Blagnac Airport (TLS) in France for its new home at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE). Following "STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA Silver" (B-58553), B-58554 is the second AIRSORAYAMA special livery aircraft created through a collaboration between STARLUX Airlines and Japanese artist Hajime Sorayama. Aviation trade outlet Aviation Wire reported that B-58554 completed its first flight in Toulouse on July 10, with the test flight lasting approximately three hours, and is scheduled for delivery to STARLUX Airlines in August. On August 12, Japanese aviation outlet TRAICY also reported that STARLUX Airlines expects to officially take delivery of the aircraft within August. "STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA Gold" features metallic gold as its primary fuselage color paired with silver accents, complementing B-58553 "STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA Silver," which is predominantly silver with gold accents. The belly of both aircraft incorporates Hajime Sorayama's signature "SORAYAMA Shark" visual element, extending his signature metallic textures and futuristic aesthetics onto large commercial passenger jets. STARLUX Airlines stated that because the A350 uses a significant amount of carbon fiber composite materials, the paint finish must achieve a metallic luster while meeting lightning protection and related airworthiness requirements for aircraft. Consequently, STARLUX Airlines, Airbus, and German paint manufacturer Mankiewicz jointly developed a high-concentration special mica and multi-layer coating technique to achieve the desired visual effect. Upon completion of delivery, B-58554 is expected to become the fourth A350-1000 in the STARLUX Airlines fleet. STARLUX Airlines has ordered a total of 18 A350-1000s, with the first aircraft, B-58551, delivered in Toulouse in January 2026, making STARLUX Airlines the first airline in Taiwan to operate the A350-1000. The A350-1000 also serves as a key backbone aircraft for STARLUX Airlines' current long-haul route network layout. "STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA Gold" features a cabin layout totaling 350 seats, including 4 in First Class, 40 in Business Class, 36 in Premium Economy, and 270 in Economy. With B-58554 completing delivery and arriving in Taiwan, both the "STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA Silver" and "STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA Gold" A350-1000s will be officially united. STARLUX Airlines plans to commence full AIRSORAYAMA-themed operations starting October 1 using both art aircraft alongside exclusive inflight amenities and service offerings. Currently, STARLUX Airlines' official latest updates show that B-58554 has entered the final stage prior to returning to Taiwan; the actual departure time from Toulouse, arrival time in Taoyuan, and subsequent arrangements for entry into revenue passenger service remain subject to flight information and real-time flight status announced by STARLUX Airlines.

metadata.title: 聯合航空將於休士頓部署「Elevated」波音787-9客機 涵蓋四條洲際航線

a-20260802-0938-manual-e5da01.text: 聯合航空將於休士頓部署「Elevated」波音787-9客機 涵蓋四條洲際航線 聯合航空休士頓部署Elevated 787-9;涵蓋四條洲際航線 聯合航空(United Airlines)計劃自2026年第四季起,於其休士頓喬治布希洲際機場(IAH)樞紐的四條洲際航線部署採用「United Elevated」新客艙配置的波音787-9夢幻客機。此次調整屬既有航線的機型與客艙產品升級,並非新增航點或開闢新航線。 依最新航班時刻資料,休士頓往返巴西聖保羅瓜魯柳斯國際機場(GRU)、日本東京成田國際機場(NRT)及澳洲雪梨金斯福德·史密斯機場(SYD)的航班,預定自2026年10月24日起改由此一新版787-9執飛。休士頓往返英國倫敦希斯洛機場(LHR)的UA880及UA879航班,則預計自2027年1月5日起導入該機型。 聯合航空的「Elevated」787-9採222席配置,為該公司高端座位比例較高的廣體客機版本。客艙設有8席Polaris Studio商務艙套房、56席Polaris商務艙、35席Premium Plus豪華經濟艙、39席Economy Plus加大腿部空間經濟艙與84席經濟艙,其中Polaris Studio設於商務艙前排,提供較大的個人空間、隱私門、27吋4K OLED螢幕及可供同行旅客使用的腳凳座位。 標準Polaris商務艙同樣配備可全平躺座椅、隱私門與19吋4K螢幕;Premium Plus與經濟艙則導入更大的座椅螢幕及藍牙連線功能。聯合航空在2026年3月公布首架Elevated 787-9的商業部署計畫,首批國際航線為舊金山國際機場(SFO)往返新加坡樟宜機場(SIN)及倫敦希斯洛機場(LHR)。 休士頓是聯合航空在美國的重要轉機樞紐之一,服務拉丁美洲、歐洲、亞洲與澳洲等長程市場。隨著此次部署,休士頓將成為繼舊金山後,另一個定期使用Elevated 787-9執飛國際航線的聯合航空樞紐;惟航空公司實際機型安排仍可能因營運調度而變更。 United Airlines to Deploy "Elevated" Boeing 787-9 Aircraft in Houston Across Four Intercontinental Routes United deploys Elevated 787-9s from Houston across four intercontinental routes United Airlines plans to deploy Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner aircraft featuring the new "United Elevated" cabin configuration on four intercontinental routes from its Houston George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH) hub starting in the fourth quarter of 2026. This adjustment represents an aircraft and cabin product upgrade for existing routes rather than the addition of new destinations or routes. According to the latest schedule data, flights between Houston and São Paulo/Guarulhos International Airport (GRU) in Brazil, Tokyo Narita International Airport (NRT) in Japan, and Sydney Kingsford Smith Airport (SYD) in Australia are scheduled to transition to this new 787-9 variant effective October 24, 2026. Flights UA880 and UA879 between Houston and London Heathrow Airport (LHR) in the United Kingdom are expected to introduce the aircraft type starting January 5, 2027. United Airlines' "Elevated" 787-9 features a 222-seat configuration, representing a widebody aircraft version with a higher proportion of premium seating. The cabin includes 8 Polaris Studio business class suites, 56 standard Polaris business class suites, 35 Premium Plus premium economy seats, 39 Economy Plus extra-legroom economy seats, and 84 standard economy seats, with Polaris Studio situated in the front row of business class to provide greater personal space, privacy doors, 27-inch 4K OLED screens, and ottoman seating for an accompanying travel companion. Standard Polaris seats are likewise equipped with lie-flat seats, privacy doors, and 19-inch 4K screens, while Premium Plus and Economy cabins feature larger seatback displays and Bluetooth connectivity. United Airlines announced its commercial deployment plan for the first Elevated 787-9 in March 2026, with initial international routes operating between San Francisco International Airport (SFO) and Singapore Changi Airport (SIN) as well as London Heathrow Airport (LHR). Houston serves as one of United Airlines' major connection hubs in the United States, supporting long-haul markets across Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. With this deployment, Houston will become another United Airlines hub after San Francisco to regularly operate international routes using the Elevated 787-9; however, actual aircraft assignments by the airline remain subject to change due to operational scheduling.

metadata.title: 星宇航空「AIRSORAYAMA GOLD」完成交機 B-58554自法國土魯斯啟程返台

a-20260815-1245-manual-e816db.text: 星宇航空「AIRSORAYAMA GOLD」完成交機 B-58554自法國土魯斯啟程返台 星宇航空與日本當代藝術家空山基(Hajime Sorayama)合作打造的「STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA GOLD 空山金」已完成交機;A350-1000 B-58554 於 8 月 15 日自土魯斯布拉尼亞克機場(TLS)啟程返臺,預計 8 月 16 日上午 9 時 28 分抵達桃園國際機場(TPE)。 星宇航空與日本當代藝術家空山基(Hajime Sorayama)合作打造的「STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA GOLD 空山金」完成交機。這架註冊編號 B-58554 的 Airbus A350-1000,在法國當地時間 8 月 14 日完成交機程序後,於 8 月 15 日中午 12 時 27 分自土魯斯布拉尼亞克機場(TLS)啟程飛往臺灣,預計於臺北時間 8 月 16 日上午 9 時 28 分抵達桃園國際機場(TPE)。 B-58554 為星宇航空「STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA」藝術計畫中的第二架特別塗裝 A350-1000,採金色為主要視覺元素,與先前交付的「AIRSORAYAMA SILVER 空山銀」B-58553 組成一金一銀的雙機設計。星宇航空於 2026 年 1 月公布這項合作計畫,兩架飛機均以空山基長期創作中具代表性的金屬質感作為設計核心,並將其藝術語彙延伸至大型民航客機機身。 為了在複合材料機身上呈現接近液態金屬的反射效果,相關塗裝並非單純使用傳統金、銀色漆料。星宇航空表示,計畫與 Airbus 及航空塗料業者 Mankiewicz 共同研發,使用高濃度特殊雲母及多層塗佈工法,在符合民航機塗裝與飛航安全要求的前提下,呈現空山基作品中的金屬光澤與視覺層次。 率先完成交付的「空山銀」B-58553 已於 7 月 5 日抵達桃園,並在 7 月 12 日投入首趟載客飛行,執飛臺北至東京成田國際機場(NRT)航線。「空山金」返臺後,意味 AIRSORAYAMA 計畫規劃的兩架金、銀藝術機將正式在臺灣會合。 兩架 AIRSORAYAMA 均採用 A350-1000。這款機型是 Airbus A350 系列中尺寸較大的長程廣體客機版本,使用 Rolls-Royce Trent XWB-97 發動機;星宇航空將 A350-1000 定位為長程航線主力機型。依星宇航空公布的 AIRSORAYAMA 客艙配置,每架設有 4 席頭等艙、40 席商務艙、36 席豪華經濟艙及 270 席經濟艙,共 350 個座位。 星宇航空在 2026 年 1 月接收旗下首架 A350-1000,成為全球第 11 家營運這款機型的航空公司;Airbus 當時表示,星宇航空共訂購 18 架 A350-1000,作為其擴充歐洲、北美及其他長程航線運能的重要機隊之一。隨著 B-58554 完成交機返臺,AIRSORAYAMA 金、銀雙機也進入完整集結階段。 依目前公布的飛航安排,B-58554 預計於 8 月 16 日上午 9 時 28 分抵達桃園國際機場;實際抵達時間仍可能受到航路、航管及天候等飛航因素影響。 STARLUX Airlines Completes Delivery of 'AIRSORAYAMA GOLD'; B-58554 Departs Toulouse, France for Taiwan STARLUX Airlines has completed delivery of the A350-1000 B-58554 in its 'AIRSORAYAMA GOLD' livery. The aircraft departed Toulouse-Blagnac Airport (TLS) for Taiwan on August 15 and is scheduled to arrive at Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) at 9:28 AM Taipei time on August 16. STARLUX Airlines has completed the delivery of 'STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA GOLD,' created in collaboration with Japanese contemporary artist Hajime Sorayama. Registered B-58554, the Airbus A350-1000 officially completed delivery procedures on August 14 local time in France and departed Toulouse-Blagnac Airport (TLS) for Taiwan at 12:27 PM on August 15. It is scheduled to arrive at Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) at 9:28 AM Taipei time on August 16. B-58554 is the second specially-liveried A350-1000 in STARLUX Airlines' 'STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA' art project, featuring gold as its primary visual element to form a gold-and-silver dual-aircraft concept paired with the previously delivered 'AIRSORAYAMA SILVER' (B-58553). STARLUX Airlines unveiled this collaboration project in January 2026, with both aircraft centered on the signature metallic texture from Hajime Sorayama's long-standing artistic oeuvre, extending his visual language onto the fuselages of large commercial passenger aircraft. To achieve a liquid-metal-like reflective effect on the composite airframe, the livery does not merely rely on traditional gold or silver paints. STARLUX Airlines stated that the project collaborated with Airbus and aviation coatings specialist Mankiewicz to develop a process using high-concentration special mica and multi-layer application techniques, presenting the metallic luster and visual depth characteristic of Sorayama's artwork while strictly complying with commercial aircraft painting and flight safety requirements. The first to be delivered, 'AIRSORAYAMA SILVER' B-58553, arrived at Taoyuan on July 5 and entered revenue passenger service on July 12, operating the route between Taipei and Tokyo Narita International Airport (NRT). The return of 'AIRSORAYAMA GOLD' to Taiwan signifies that the two gold and silver art aircraft planned under the AIRSORAYAMA project will officially reunite in Taiwan. Both AIRSORAYAMA aircraft utilize the A350-1000. This model is the larger long-range widebody passenger aircraft variant in the Airbus A350 family, powered by Rolls-Royce Trent XWB-97 engines; STARLUX Airlines positions the A350-1000 as the flagship aircraft for its long-haul routes. According to the AIRSORAYAMA cabin configuration released by STARLUX Airlines, each aircraft features a total of 350 seats, configured with 4 First Class seats, 40 Business Class seats, 36 Premium Economy seats, and 270 Economy Class seats. STARLUX Airlines took delivery of its first A350-1000 in January 2026, becoming the 11th airline globally to operate this model; Airbus stated at the time that STARLUX Airlines ordered a total of 18 A350-1000s as a core fleet element to expand capacity on routes to Europe, North America, and other long-haul destinations. With B-58554 completing delivery and returning to Taiwan, the AIRSORAYAMA gold and silver dual-aircraft fleet enters its full assembly stage. According to current flight schedules, B-58554 is expected to arrive at Taoyuan International Airport at 9:28 AM on August 16; actual arrival times remain subject to operational flight factors such as routing, air traffic control, and weather conditions.
